episodes.description: Survey the complete process of gathering, scrutinizing, and organizing documents for publication.

episodes.title: The Translation of the Book of Mormon
episodes.description: Explore portions of the original manuscripts of the Book of Mormon and study the remarkable principles and questions that continue to surface.

episodes.title: Printing the Book of Mormon
episodes.description: Review the time-consuming process of typesetting a 600-page book with nineteenth-century equipment.

episodes.title: A Mother's Account
episodes.description: Examine the origin, motivation, and accuracy of "The History of the Prophet Joseph Smith" by Lucy Mack Smith.

episodes.title: History of a History
episodes.description: Dean Jesse discusses Joseph's anxiety over keeping the history of a work that would change human events forever.

episodes.title: Joseph's Journals
episodes.description: Explore the Prophet's personal journals to learn of his shortcomings, interpersonal conflicts, and challenges in leading the Saints into the future.

episodes.title: Oliver's Story
episodes.description: Study the life of Oliver Cowdery and witness his participation in the events of the Restoration, his apostasy, and his powerful closing testimony.

episodes.title: They Met the Prophet
episodes.description: Enjoy vibrant descriptions from those who met the Prophet. Whether one believed him or not, meeting Joseph Smith always left a deep impression.

episodes.title: Saving Joseph's Leg
episodes.description: Learn how Joseph and his family lived within a few miles of the only man alive who could have saved Joseph's life.

episodes.title: Joseph's New Translation--Part 1
episodes.description: Learn the history of Joseph's new translation of the Bible. Despite its significance, the manuscript was lost to the Church for over a century.

episodes.title: Joseph's New Translation--Part 2
episodes.description: Observe in detail the changes that Joseph made to restore the "plain and precious" meanings of the Bible.

episodes.title: The Letters of Joseph and Emma
episodes.description: Church history scholars review the papers that may have meant more to Joseph than any others: the letters between the Prophet and his wife.

episodes.title: Joseph Smith the Radical
episodes.description: The Prophet's claim to direct revelation was extremely radical. Nevertheless, the revelation he received restored doctrine and structured the Church.

episodes.title: April 6, 1830
episodes.description: Learn about the events surrounding the organization of the Church, including why six men were to become the founding fathers of Mormonism.

episodes.title: Kirtland Beginnings
episodes.description: Scholars discuss the years in Kirtland that were filled with miracles, divine revelation, and instruction.

episodes.title: Visions and Blessings, Tar and Feathers
episodes.description: Revisit the night when Joseph was tarred and feathered. Then, explore the difficulties and joys the Saints faced in their efforts to build a temple.

episodes.title: The Kirtland Temple: An Endowment of Power
episodes.description: Examine the few yet remarkable days in Kirtland that culminated with the appearance of the Savior.

episodes.title: Zion
episodes.description: Examine the idea of Zion and the role mobs and Mormons alike played in its failure. It was the greatest city that never came to be.

episodes.title: Zion's Camp
episodes.description: Travel through four states with 200 men to learn that the mission of Zion's Camp was more about the lessons of a journey than about the destination.

episodes.title: Crisis in Kirtland
episodes.description: Recount the dark days of Kirtland: financial failure, a riot in the temple, betrayal, and mutiny.

episodes.title: Joseph Smith and the Law--Part 1
episodes.description: Hundreds of newly discovered legal documents paint a new impression of the litigious environment surrounding the Mormon leader.

episodes.title: Joseph Smith and the Law--Part 2
episodes.description: Study the lawsuits Joseph faced throughout his life from his first encounter with the law at age 13 to the case of the Kirtland Safety Society.

episodes.title: The Mormon War
episodes.description: Historians recount the pivotal days that would eventually lead to expulsion from Missouri, captivity at Liberty, and a trek out West.

episodes.title: Liberty Jail
episodes.description: For Joseph Smith, Liberty Jail provided an experience that would be described as the most important leadership training the Prophet would receive.

episodes.title: Suffering and Salvation
episodes.description: With an extermination order in effect, thousands of destitute Saints huddled together in desperate circumstances in Missouri. The exodus begins.

episodes.title: The Mission of the Twelve to England
episodes.description: Detail the experience that transformed a group of faithful young men into a quorum who had great influence in the British Isles.

episodes.title: Land, Joseph and "Justice" in Missouri
episodes.description: Historians show how "the law" in Missouri held Joseph hostage to "legally" rid itself of Mormons.

episodes.title: Nauvoo Beginnings
episodes.description: Historians document the beginnings of Nauvoo, the beautiful city, and the implications from Joseph that it wouldn´t last for long.

episodes.title: "I Can Do Nothing for You."
episodes.description: Recount the meeting of the Prophet and the president in 1839, and learn Smith's candid assessment of the people and power of the nation's capital.

episodes.title: Joseph Smith's Sermons
episodes.description: Discuss how the Saints viewed the difference between Joseph's preaching and the revelations he received from God.

episodes.title: Jewel on the Mississippi
episodes.description: Review the remarkable design, organization of labor, and confluence of expertise that created the most notable structure along the Mississippi River.

episodes.title: A Pearl of Great Price
episodes.description: Recount the story of how a remarkable find in Egypt ended up half a world away in the hands of the one man who could translate the Abrahamic text.

episodes.title: Doctrines of Salvation
episodes.description: Examine a period of time in the early Church as Joseph introduces the doctrines that made the construction of a temple extremely urgent.

episodes.title: Joseph and the Relief Society
episodes.description: Scholars examine the first meetings of the Relief Society, including the admonition that the organization become a vital source in the church.

episodes.title: Living by the Law
episodes.description: Legal scholars document the legal wrangling that kept the Prophet on the defense during the Nauvoo years.

episodes.title: Going International
episodes.description: Explore the early foreign missions of the Church in Canada, the British Isles, Palestine, and the Pacific islands.

episodes.title: Gathering Clouds
episodes.description: Join scholars to discuss the fear and frustration of non-Mormons when Latter-day Saints became a political force.

episodes.title: Joseph Smith for President
episodes.description: Follow the Prophet's very unique entry into national politics including his opinions on the role of government.

episodes.title: Martyrdom
episodes.description: Learn about the events leading to the deaths of Joseph and Hyrum Smith.

episodes.title: Lamentation and Leadership
episodes.description: Scholars discuss the extraordinary events that led to consolidation of the Church's new leadership.

episodes.title: Who Will Lead? Who Will Follow?
episodes.description: Discuss the contention that arose over who would succeed Joseph Smith as the leader of the Church.

episodes.title: A Television Foreword
episodes.description: This intriguing documentary explores the ambitious effort to compile, transcribe, edit, and present the papers of, by, and directly related to the Latter-day Saint Prophet Joseph Smith.

episodes.title: Persona of a Prophet
episodes.description: Scholars address some compelling questions, such as how Joseph's physical stature may have impacted the way he worked, played, and defended himself.

episodes.title: Impressions of a Prophet--Part 1
episodes.description: Scholars recount the status of some of the many biographies and histories profiling the Prophet and his times.

episodes.title: Impressions of a Prophet--Part 2
episodes.description: Examine the increased interest in the Mormon prophet from those outside the faith, including the bicentennial celebration of Smith's birth, held at t

episodes.title: Joseph Smith Tour--Part 1: New England
episodes.description: Scholars visit New England, where the Smiths and the Macks, Joseph's noble heritage, originated.

episodes.title: Joseph Smith Tour Part 2: New York and Pennsylvania
episodes.description: Move through New York and Pennsylvania and through the beginnings of Mormonism.

episodes.title: Joseph Smith Tour--Part 3: Ohio
episodes.description: Visit places that figure prominently into what Latter-day Saints believe to be important to the restoration of Christ's gospel on the earth.

episodes.title: Joseph Smith Tour--Part 4: Missouri and Illinois
episodes.description: Discuss the significance of the City of Zion and recount the Saints' most severe persecution and hardship.

episodes.title: Joseph Smith Tour--Part 5: Illinois
episodes.description: Visit Nauvoo, Illinois, and learn of the significance of the original Nauvoo Temple and of the establishment of the Relief Society.

episodes.title: The Family of Joseph Smith--Part 1
episodes.description: Meet the two people who influenced Joseph Smith the most.

episodes.title: The Family of Joseph Smith--Part 2
episodes.description: Learn more about the Smith family, including which of Joseph's siblings stayed true to the faith and why some didn't.

episodes.title: The Family of Joseph Smith--Part 3
episodes.description: Acknowledge the thousands of descendants of Joseph and Emma and their divergent religious connections.

episodes.title: Teachings of Joseph Smith--Part 1
episodes.description: Examine the varied and exhaustive work undertaken to gather and make accessible the Prophet's teachings revealed to his people and to the world.

episodes.title: Teachings of Joseph Smith--Part 2
episodes.description: Learn of the monumental Teachings of the Presidents of the Church—Joseph Smith manual, which was the culmination of efforts by Latter-day Saint scholars.

episodes.title: The Music of Early Mormonism--Part 1
episodes.description: Scholars discuss the revelation directed to Emma Smith to compile a body of music that would reflect the doctrine and character of the faith.

episodes.title: The Music of Early Mormonism--Part 2
episodes.description: Examine the history of hymn books used and produced by early Latter-day Saints. Scholars discuss Joseph's love of music.

episodes.title: First Vision--Part 1
episodes.description: Scholars provide perspectives on how we have come to view the moment when a fourteen-year-old boy dared to ask God which church he should join.

episodes.title: First Vision--Part 2
episodes.description: Scholars present an intimate view of the actual document wherein Joseph describes the First Vision.

episodes.title: First Vision--Part 3
episodes.description: Scholars detail the emergence of the official version of the First Vision.

episodes.title: First Vision--Part 4
episodes.description: Scholars provide a panoramic view of the First Vision and address purported inconsistencies of the event.

episodes.title: First Vision--Part 5
episodes.description: Scholars discuss what Joseph learned about the physical nature of God and of discovering a personal relationship with Him.

episodes.title: Revelations and Translations--Part 1: Book of Mormon
episodes.description: Scholars discuss the revelations received by the Prophet and their eventual publication as part of the Latter-day Saint canon.

episodes.title: Revelations and Translations--Part 2: Book of Mormon
episodes.description: Scholars discuss Martin Harris and the lost manuscript and its dramatic impact on the Smith family.

episodes.title: Revelations and Translations--Part 3: Book of Mormon
episodes.description: Scholars examine the forms and structure of language in the Book of Mormon and challenge some common suppositions proposed by critics.

episodes.title: Revelations and Translations--Part 4: Doctrine and Covenants
episodes.description: Learn of the origins of the Doctrine and Covenants. Scholars discuss the unusual ways the early revelations were dispersed.

episodes.title: Revelations and Translations--Part 5: Coming Forth of the Doctrine and Covenants
episodes.description: Scholars discuss the genealogy of the Doctrine and Covenants in use today and why some rrevelations were canonized while others were not.

episodes.title: Pearl of Great Price
episodes.description: Scholars discuss the eventful history of the Pearl of Great Price, in particular its unusual beginnings.

episodes.title: Joseph Smith and His Papers--Part 1
episodes.description: Scholars describe the tools that provide readers with an exhaustive examination of content from original documents and the variety of annotations.

episodes.title: Joseph Smith and His Papers--Part 2
episodes.description: Scholars demonstrate how tools such as maps, chronologies, a biographical directory, and a Smith family pedigree can enrich reader's experiences.

episodes.title: Joseph Smith and His Papers--Part 3
episodes.description: Get introduced to the intricate treatment of documents containing the revelations received by Joseph Smith.

episodes.title: Word of Wisdom
episodes.description: Review the circumstances that led to the revelation on the Word of Wisdom and the difficulty many of the Saints had in abiding by its precepts.

episodes.title: Joseph Smith, the Statesman
episodes.description: Examine the Prophet's loyalty to the Constitution—a document he called "a glorious standard, a heavenly banner."

episodes.title: Doctrine and Covenants 76
episodes.description: Revisit the setting and circumstances of the revelation on the afterlife in Doctrine and Covenants 76.

episodes.title: Liberty Jail Letters
episodes.description: Dissect the letters dictated by Joseph Smith while in Liberty Jail.

episodes.title: The Pure Religion of Joseph Smith
episodes.description: Peer into the heart of the Prophet to examine how his Christian beliefs were reflected in his actions and his teachings and encased in his character.

episodes.title: Early Members--Part 1: Hyrum Smith
episodes.description: Recall the influential role Hyrum played in the Restoration and his unwavering support for his younger brother.

episodes.title: Early Members--Part 2: The Pratt Brothers, Parley and Orson
episodes.description: Meet Parley and Orson Pratt, who were instrumental in finding and baptizing future Latter-day Saints and their leaders.

episodes.title: Early Members--Part 3: William Clayton and the Knight Family
episodes.description: Review the lives of several prominent Latter-day Saints whose relationships with Joseph Smith were particularly close and steadfast.

episodes.title: Early Members, Part 4: Martin Harris and the John
episodes.description: Review the lives of several prominent Latter-day Saints whose relationships with Joseph Smith were particularly close and steadfast.

episodes.title: Early Members--Part 5: Eliza & Lorenzo Snow
episodes.description: Meet the Snows, whose deep imprints on the Church are still felt today.

episodes.title: Part 1, Question and Answer Forum, Conference Cent
episodes.description: Join a panel of Latter-day Saint scholars as they answer questions posed by students.

episodes.title: Part 2, Question and Answer Forum
episodes.description: Scholars from the project answer questions about skepticism, law and justice, and Joseph the businessman.

episodes.title: Season Finale
episodes.description: Get an overview of the whole project--the books, the website, and the television series; and meet the reason why it exists in the first place.

54f848ee-6d19-4502-9981-070cdbd1f1bf.description: Ancestors demonstrates to viewers how to use a wide variety of records for family history research.

episodes.title: Getting Started
episodes.description: After facing racism from a young age, Victor Villasenor shares how through genealogy he learned that anybody’s story can be wonderful. Author Desmond Walls Allen explains the standard format for anyone getting started with family history.

episodes.title: Looking at Home
episodes.description: Shannon Applegate discovered the importance of searching for family belongings. Antonia Conttrell Martin describes the process of looking for history in our homes and completing group records.

episodes.title: Gathering Family Stories
episodes.description: Fabiana Chiu shares how learning about her Chinese and Peruvian heritage gave her a clear identity. Author Bill Zimmerman explains how to prepare and organize an interview to record oral histories.

episodes.title: The Paper Trail
episodes.description: Rafael Guber learned that remembering his ancestors gave life to names on paper. Sharon DeBartolo Carmak explains how to bridge genealogy gaps using compiled records.

episodes.title: Libraries and Archives
episodes.description: Tom Madrid learns about his hispanic heritage. Jim and Terry Willard take a field trip to the family history library in Salt Lake City and learn that specific objectives can help them branch out on their family trees.

episodes.title: Census and Military Records
episodes.description: Garry Bryant describes his change of heart to serve in the military after learning about his genealogy. Curt Witcher shares how to use census records and military records to expand our family research.

episodes.title: African American Research
episodes.description: Collete DeVerge and Tony Burroughs share how they have been able to discover their African American heritage through specific documents and processes.

episodes.title: Your Medical Heritage
episodes.description: Discovering her family’s medical history saved Carol Krause’s life. Dr. Raymond White and Vickie I. Venne describe the process of creating a medical pedigree and analyzing the health impact of genetics.

episodes.title: High-Tech Help
episodes.description: Prison inmates share how technology has revolutionized their ability to research family history and helped them become accepted again. Richard Eastman explains the process and tools of online genealogy databases.

episodes.title: Leaving a Legacy
episodes.description: Eric, Neeci, and Hannibal share how family history research has reunited them with their ancestors and living family members. They can then carry on their ancestors' legacies and create their own.

episodes.title: Records at Risk
episodes.description: Genealogy experts explain the dangers of natural disasters and carelessness that cause genealogical destruction. They share how family history records can be preserved and restored.

episodes.title: Family Records
episodes.description: Suzanne Ballard shares how a scrap of paper connected her to her Irish ancestors. Genealogical experts discuss the importance of family records from diaries to family bibles, from letters to photographs.

episodes.title: Compiled Records
episodes.description: Sheila Hsia honors her Chinese ancestors by keeping record of her family history. Genealogy experts share how compiled records can be an invaluable resource in finding what research has already been done on a family line.

episodes.title: Genealogy and Technology
episodes.description: Megan Smolenyak used technology to take her family history all the way to Estonia. Genealogy experts share how family history and technology can be used as an invaluable tool.

episodes.title: Vital Records
episodes.description: Jeff Gallup uses vital records, death, marriage, and birth certificates, to rebuild his Italian culture. Genealogy experts discuss what vital records contain and how to find them.

episodes.title: Religious Records
episodes.description: Greg Spacher discovers that his German heritage also includes French blood. He and genealogy experts use religious records, baptisms, marriage, and burial information, to fill missing gaps in family histories.

episodes.title: Cemetery Records
episodes.description: Cemetery records are made up of death, burial, and gravesite information. Beth Uyehare and genealogy experts use those records to find their ancestors.

episodes.title: Census Records
episodes.description: Darius Gray and genealogy experts use census records to find the occupation, ages, and relationships of their ancestors.

episodes.title: Military Records
episodes.description: Susan Hadler uses service records to learn about her father killed in war. Genealogy experts describe the types of military records, including pension and service records.

episodes.title: Newspapers as Records
episodes.description: From newspaper records, Lori Davis learns about her ancestor who was a con-artist. Genealogy experts describe how news about ancestors can be found and how it helps with family history.

episodes.title: Probate Records
episodes.description: Bruce Stewart and genealogy experts learn about their ancestors from probate records, or the wills and other documents ancestors leave after their death.

episodes.title: Immigration Records
episodes.description: Cathy Horn unveils family history secrets through immigration records. Genealogy experts discuss ship passenger lists and naturalization records.

episodes.title: Writing a Family History
episodes.description: Taylor MacDonald preserves his family history in a manuscript. Genealogy experts discuss the organization and publication of a written family history.

9964b7e3-e045-4b24-a124-e362db67fa19.description: Join women from all over the world at the spiritually uplifting BYU Women's Conference.

episodes.title: Elder M. Russell Ballard
episodes.description: Member of the Quorum of the 12 Apostles M. Russel Ballard speaks about the intentional and remarkable influence women have.

episodes.title: Wendy Watson Nelson
episodes.description: Marriage and family therapist Wendy Watson Nelson gives an address about covenants and how nothing is more important than access to the power of God.

episodes.title: Steven Harper
episodes.description: Historian in the Church History Department Steven Harper talks about encouraging a perspective where faith flourishes and doubt diminishes.

episodes.title: Eric Huntsman
episodes.description: Professor of ancient scripture Eric Huntsman speaks about returning to faith after much doubt and the great miracles of trials.

episodes.title: Primary General Presidency
episodes.description: The Primary General Presidency, Rosemary M. Wixom, Cheryl A. Esplin, and Mary R. Durham, give an address about aligning our desires with our father’s eternal perspective.

episodes.title: Linda Burton, Linda Reeves, and Carole Stephens
episodes.description: Lina Burton, Linda Reeves, and Carole Stephens discuss the challenges that threaten marriage and being guardians of the marriage covenant.

episodes.title: Bonnie L. Oscarson
episodes.description: Young Women General President Bonnie L. Oscarson shares how love is the most powerful motivator for obedience.

episodes.title: Kevin J and Peggy Worthen
episodes.description: President of BYU Kevin J. Worthen and his wife Peggy Worthen speak about having joy through trials and the heavenly strength to persevere.

episodes.title: Gaylamarie Rosenberg
episodes.description: Author and adjunct religion instructor Gaylamarie Rosenberg talks about trusting that the Lord will enhance us if we are willing and patient.

episodes.title: Denise Posse Lindberg
episodes.description: Former district court judge Denise Posse Lindberg talks about holding the shield of faith and perfection with our mistakes.

episodes.title: Mary Katherine Eyring
episodes.description: Assistant Professor of English at BYU, Mary Katherine Eyring speaks about tokens of covenant hearts.

episodes.title: John Bytheway
episodes.description: Author John Bytheway gives an address about how truth is patiently becoming like Christ and the small decision that can lead us to him.

episodes.title: Tad and Kathryn Callister
episodes.description: Sunday School General President Tad Callister and his wife Kathryn discuss the sweet joy that comes from repentance as an active pursuit to be Christlike.

episodes.title: Neill & Caroline Marriott, Kate Mitchell, Paige Storheim
episodes.description: Neill Marriott and her daughters, Caroline Marriott, Paige Storheim, and Kate Mitchell, talk about our how feelings are healed as we reach for the Savior.

episodes.title: Gaye Strathearn
episodes.description: Professor of Ancient Scripture Gaye Strathern speaks about becoming holy as the Savior is holy.

episodes.title: Tad R. Callister
episodes.description: Sunday School General President, Tad R. Callister speaks about how we become the things we love and admire.

episodes.title: Carole M. Stephens
episodes.description: First Counselor in the Relief Society General Presidency, Carole M. Stephens talks about the progression of life, one faith filled step at a time.

episodes.title: Kevin J Worthen
episodes.description: President of BYU, Kevin J. Worthen speaks about an eternal skill set that leads us to the ultimate counselor.

episodes.title: Kristen Oaks
episodes.description: Kristen Oaks, author and wife of President Dallin H. Oaks, speaks about the decisions that matter eternally.

episodes.title: Linda K. Burton
episodes.description: Relief Society General President Linda K. Burton talks about how true charity is love in action and being like our Savior.

episodes.title: Sandra Rogers
episodes.description: BYU Women’s Conference Chair Sandra Rogers speaks about being better acquainted with our Savior and the unified power of charity.

episodes.title: Virginia H. Pearce
episodes.description: Daughter of President Hinckley, Virginia H. Pearce speaks about the kingdom of god existing to declare and teach truth.

episodes.title: Carol F. McConkie
episodes.description: First Counselor in the Young Women General Presidency, Carol F. McConkie speaks about the defense of Christ’s doctrine with Christlike love.

episodes.title: Primary General Presidency
episodes.description: Bonnie H. Cordon, Jean B. Bingham, and Joy D. Jones of the Primary General Presidency talk about unifying our families and the power of eternal unity.

episodes.title: Melinda Ashton
episodes.description: Wife of BYU-Pathway Worldwide President, Melinda Ashton speaks about women who teach fearlessly and choosing to believe as you seek eternal truths.

episodes.title: Linda S. Reeves
episodes.description: Second Counselor in the Relief Society General Presidency, Linda S. Reeves speaks about how the Holy Ghost works in perfect unity with Heavenly Father and Jesus Christ.

episodes.title: Elder Dale and Ruth Renlund
episodes.description: Member of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles, Dale G. Renlund and his wife, Ruth L. Renlund, talk about the symbiotic relationship of charity.

episodes.title: Elder Gary E. Stevenson
episodes.description: Elder Gary E. Stevenson shares the positive impact and potential risks of technology. He demonstrates the tools we have been given to share the gospel with those around us.

episodes.title: Sharon Eubank
episodes.description: Sister Sharon Eubank gives an honest perspective into the conversion of a woman using three ingredients: faith to see, discipline to create, and glue to bind.

episodes.title: Anne Clegg
episodes.description: Anne Clegg shares her thoughts on the experiences of Latter-day Saint women who have become closer to the Savior.

episodes.title: Neill F. Marriott
episodes.description: Sister Neill F. Marriott explains how to be covenant-keeping women with godly power in their lives.

episodes.title: Joy D. Jones and Bonnie H. Cordon
episodes.description: Sisters Joy D. Jones and Bonnie H. Cordon educate families on intentional parenting to raise children who are rooted in the gospel.

episodes.title: Lynette N. Gay
episodes.description: Lynette N. Gay encourages women to understand their divine worth and the lengths Christ will go to rescue them.

episodes.title: Carol F. McConkie
episodes.description: Sister Carol F. McConkie implores women to find strength in their Savior and come to know their Father’s unconditional love.

episodes.title: Tad & Kathryn Callister
episodes.description: Tad and Kathryn Callister describe the way to receive the healing power of the Savior: through turning to the Savior, full repentance, and conversion to our divine identity.

episodes.title: Relief Society General Presidency
episodes.description: Sisters Jean Bingham, Sharon Eubank, and Reyna Aburto of the new Relief Society General Presidency express what truly makes Relief Society: belonging, service and love.

episodes.title: Gaye Strathearn
episodes.description: Gay Strathearn shares experiences that brought her a clearer vision of the character of the Father.

episodes.title: Matthew Richardson
episodes.description: Matthew Richardson uses the children’s book “The Story of Little Babaji” to illustrate the majestic grandeur of God; he implores the world to embrace Him in all His power.

episodes.title: Valerie Causse
episodes.description: Sister Valérie Caussé shares her experiences of total submission to the will of the Father and testifies of the ministering of angels.

episodes.title: Bonnie L. Oscarson
episodes.description: Sister Bonnie L. Oscarson teaches that life is a test to our willingness to obey the Father, and testifies of the joy that comes from being swallowed up in the will of the Lord.

episodes.title: Our Roots: A Celebration of Who We Are
episodes.description: An ensemble cast of women from all walks of life celebrate the lives of women who are firmly rooted in the gospel. They powerfully testify why we are here, where we are going, and who we are in this musical performance.

episodes.title: Gerrit & Susan Gong
episodes.description: Member of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles, Gerrit W. Gong and his wife, Susan L. Gong, speak about a sure sense of God’s love for us.

episodes.title: Kevin J. Worthen
episodes.description: President of BYU Kevin J. Worthen talks about embracing and carrying out our ministering efforts.

episodes.title: Laurel McConkie
episodes.description: Child refugee specialist Laurel McConkie speaks about Christ’s doctrine in the ordinance of the sacrament.

episodes.title: Gaye Strathearn
episodes.description: Professor of Ancient Scripture, Gaye Strathern speaks about taking advantage of Christ and His eternal sacrifice.

episodes.title: LDS YW General Presidency
episodes.description: The Young Women General Presidency talks about building character with covenants and relationships.

episodes.title: W. Craig Zwick & Jan Zwick
episodes.description: General Authority, W. Craig Zwick and his wife, Jan, speak about how our challenges will define and identify us.

episodes.title: Relief Society General Presidency
episodes.description: The Relief Society General Presidency First and Second Counselors, Sharon Eubank and Reyna I. Aburto share how we can be reassured and invigorated through God’s will.

episodes.title: Jennifer Brinkerhoff Platt
episodes.description: Professor of Ancient Scripture, Jennifer Brinkerhoff Platt speaks about how to live and elevate others in the simplest of ways.

episodes.title: Heidi Swinton
episodes.description: Historian and Author Heidi Swinton speaks about the importance of praying for a personal testimony of Joseph Smith.

episodes.title: Susan Easton Black
episodes.description: Author Susan Easton Black describes how, like the prophet Joseph Smith, our friends will stay by us.

episodes.title: Nancy Maynes
episodes.description: Nancy Maynes, wife of Elder Richard J. Maynes, talks about how the prophet shares the love Christ has for God’s children.

episodes.title: Kathy S. Andersen
episodes.description: Wife of Elder Neil L. Andersen, Kathy S. Andersen shares that when the prophet counsels, we must respond to be saved.

episodes.title: Primary General Presidency
episodes.description: Cristina B. Franco, Lisa L. Harkness, and Joy D. Jones of the Primary General Presidency speak about the essentials needed to obtain an unshakable testimony.

episodes.title: Elder  D. Todd Christofferson & Sister Kathy Christofferson
episodes.description: Member of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles, D. Todd Christofferson and his wife Kathy give an address about our cherished mortal agency and how God provides a way for us to recover from sin.

episodes.title: Julie B. Beck
episodes.description: Former Relief Society President Julie B Beck speaks about how Jesus Christ is not symbolic or superficial.

episodes.title: Becky Thomas Eyre
episodes.description: Becky Thomas Eyre talks about how the Lord compensates for the losses in our life and shares her experience of finding her eternal partner.

episodes.title: Becky Craven
episodes.description: Second Counselor in the Young Women General Presidency, Becky Craven speaks about living for opportunities to provide much needed help.

episodes.title: Primary General Presidency - Joy D. Jones; Lisa L. Harkness; Cristina B. Franco
episodes.description: Joy D. Jones, Lisa L. Harkness, and Cristina B. Franco of the Primary General Presidency give an address about making our histories have eternal value.

episodes.title: Relief Society General Presidency - Jean B. Bingham; Sharon Eubank; Reyna I. Abu
episodes.description: Jean B. Bingham, Sharon Eubank, and Reyna I. Aburto of the Relief Society General Presidency speak about how women are a source of priesthood power.

episodes.title: Rebecca Pinegar
episodes.description: Former Primary chorister and missionary Rebecca Pinegar talks about the patterns in Joseph Smith's life that can be useful as we receive revelation.

episodes.title: Jean B. Bingham; Bonnie H. Cordon; Joy D. Jones
episodes.description: Relief Society President Jean B. Bingham, Young Women President Bonnie H. Cordon, and Primary President Joy D. Jones answer questions for women of all ages.

episodes.title: Martha Darger Carrington
episodes.description: Social worker Martha Darger Carrington shares how homes can become sanctuaries of faith.

episodes.title: Tyler Griffin
episodes.description: Seminary Teacher and Professor of Ancient Scripture Tyler Griffin speaks about deepening our conversion to Jesus Christ through our homes.

episodes.title: Jean A. Stevens
episodes.description: First Counselor in the Primary General Presidency Jean A. Stevens talks about how the gospel of Jesus Christ is not insurance against pain, but instead a resource.

episodes.title: Michelle D. Craig
episodes.description: First Counselor in the Young Women General Presidency Michelle D. Craig speaks about finding joy in our individual journeys.

episodes.title: Van Gessel
episodes.description: Professor of Japanese Van Gessel speaks about how grace is not God’s backup plan. It is the plan.

episodes.title: Cecilia M. Peek
episodes.description: Professor of Classics and Ancient History Cecilia M. Peek gives an address about the two-sidedness of grace.

episodes.title: Sisters Jean B. Bingham and Sharon Eubank
episodes.description: President Jean B. Bingham and First Counselor Sharon Eubank of the Relief Society Presidency tell stories of ministering during challenging times.

episodes.title: Rosemary Thackeray
episodes.description: President for Planning and Assessment Rosemary Thackeray gives an address about the quest of a lifetime to come to know the Savior.

episodes.title: Maria Luisa and David Torres
episodes.description: David and Maria Luisa Torres discuss how communication with your spouse can affect your entire outlook on life.

episodes.title: Kate Holbrook
episodes.description: Women's historian Kate Holbrook speaks about how hope is something we choose.

episodes.title: Gaylamarie Rosenberg
episodes.description: Religion instructor Gaylamarie Rosenberg gives an address about how focusing on our weaknesses blinds us.

episodes.title: Conversation with Sisters Reyna I Aburto, Becky Craven, Lisa L Harkness, and Tracy Browning
episodes.description: Reyna I. Aburto, Becky Craven, and Lisa L. Harkness discuss the anxieties facing young mothers and the importance of receiving God’s power.

episodes.title: Maria Luisa and David Torres (Spanish Version)
episodes.description: David and Maria Luisa Torres discuss how communication with your spouse can affect your entire outlook on life. This address is given in Spanish.

episodes.title: Sandra Rogers
episodes.description: BYU Women’s Conference Chair Sandra Rogers gives an address about how Christ calls us with love.

episodes.title: Elder Ronald A. Rasband and Sister Melanie Rasband
episodes.description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband uses the scriptures to urge us to understand our divine potential and the role we play in Heavenly Father’s plan.

episodes.title: Sharon Eubank, Michelle Craig, Susan Porter, and Irene Caso
episodes.description: Irene Caso conducts a sister-to-sister conversation with Sisters Sharon Eubank, Michelle Craig, and Susan Porter on topics such as personal revelation, mental health, joy, lack of children, working mothers, inactive loved ones, and speaking up.

episodes.title: Jean Bingham, Sharon Eubank, and Reyna Aburto
episodes.description: Sisters Jean B. Bingham, Sharon Eubank, and Reyna I. Aburto educate women on how to look for and minister to those who need support. They encourage Relief Society sisters that everyone is welcome, regardless of circumstances.

episodes.title: Bonnie H. Cordon, Michelle D. Craig, and Rebecca L. Craven
episodes.description: Sisters Bonnie H. Cordon, Michelle Craig, and Becky L. Craven implore women not to lose their focus on their divine identities as daughters of God.

episodes.title: Camille Johnson, Susan Porter, and Amy Wright
episodes.description: Sisters Camille N. Johnson, Susan H. Porter, and Amy Wright testify that perfection can only be achieved through humble devotion to the Savior, recognizing His hand, and becoming comfortable with discomfort.

episodes.title: Steven J. Lund
episodes.description: Stephen J. Lund emphasizes the importance of the new children and youth programs. He details the vitality of positive role models for youth and children.

episodes.title: Mark L. Pace
episodes.description: Mark L. Pace shares how to navigate the trials of life through the plan of salvation, the experience of Alma, and the promises of the Father.

episodes.title: Young Women Presidency
episodes.description: Notwithstanding My Weakness: Removing the Feeling of Forever Falling Short

episodes.description: Avoiding Spiritual Overwhelm: Progressing Line Upon Line

episodes.description: The New "For the Strength of Youth" Guide

episodes.description: Our Bodies: Essential for Eternal Joy and Progression

episodes.title: Sister Johnson
episodes.description: Aligning with the Lord

episodes.title: Relief Society General Presidency
episodes.description: Bringing His Relief

episodes.title: Kristin M. Yee, J. Anette Dennis, Camille N. Johnson
episodes.description: Come Take Your Place

episodes.title: Andrea Munoz Spannaus, Susan H. Porter
episodes.description: For the Power is in Us: The Lord Loves Effort

episodes.title: Tracy Y. Browning, J. Anette Dennis
episodes.description: Why I Choose to Stay: His Word was in My Heart as a Burning Fire (Jeremiah 20:9)

episodes.title: Camille N. Johnson
episodes.description: Lessons Learned in Inviting Christ to Author My Story

episodes.title: Michael T. Nelson, Bradley R. Wilcox, Steven J. Lund
episodes.description: Principles for Parents: For the Strength of Youth Guide

episodes.title: Kristin M. Yee, Tamara W. Runia
episodes.description: Love One Another; as I Have Loved You (John 13:34)

episodes.title: Amy A. Wright, Emily Belle Freeman
episodes.description: Finding Your Worth Through Jesus Christ

episodes.title: Elder Brent H. Nielson
episodes.description: Children of the Covenant

episodes.title: J. Anette Dennis
episodes.description: As We Abide in Him and He in Us, We Never Walk Alone

episodes.title: Elder Quentin L. Cook
episodes.description: Walk with Him by Faith

episodes.title: Susan H. Porter
episodes.description: Walking with the Savior: Strength through Humility

episodes.title: Sister Tamara W. Runia | Let His Radiance Shine through You!
episodes.description: Sister Tamara W. Runia, First Counselor in the Young Women General Presidency. "And we can let His radiance and His love shine through us because we are His, so let us be one."

episodes.title: President Camille N. Johnson | Throwing the Door Wide Open to More Jesus Christ in Our Lives
episodes.description: President Camille N. Johnson, Relief Society General President. "President Camille N. Johnson, Relief Society General President."

episodes.title: Sister Susan K. Bednar and Elder David A. Bednar
episodes.description: Sister Susan K. Bednar and Elder David A. Bednar Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Arising and shining forth is a miracle that occurs repeatedly in the lives of disciples of the Lord Jesus Christ."

ab3117c2-a74f-4b9c-99c6-c59611a7b3bd.description: A blended family finds their new normal in this heartwarming comedy-drama.

episodes.title: Better Half
episodes.description: Tony and Cleo plan to celebrate their six-month anniversary, but Tony gets distracted at work. Victoria and Nathan try to outdo each other when buying gifts for their parents.

episodes.title: Calling Dr. Anderson
episodes.description: Cleo is eager to return to work after a six-month absence. Tony has to work with his nephew, balancing the roles of agent and uncle.

episodes.title: Bittersweet Sixteen
episodes.description: Tony and Cleo learn the importance of parenting while preparing a party for Nathan’s 16th birthday. Roger is excited that Charlie is named his school’s hall monitor and takes him to work to show him the ropes.

episodes.title: Yes, And…?
episodes.description: To bond with her father and brother, Victoria joins their improv class. Meanwhile, Cleo helps Nick restore his reputation with the city of Chicago.

episodes.title: This Wasn’t the Plan
episodes.description: Tony accompanies Cleo to a dental conference. Victoria and Nathan go to the movies together, but Victoria is bullied for her cosplay.

episodes.title: Parker Anderson Can’t Lose
episodes.description: Victoria enlists Nathan’s help with her student body presidential campaign. Tony asks for a day alone to honor his his late wife, Joy, but keeps getting interrupted.

episodes.title: Father & Sons
episodes.description: The family takes a trip to the mall, where Tony and Nathan are racially profiled in a store. Victoria realizes her own racial prejudices.

episodes.title: Everyone and the Kitchen Sink
episodes.description: Tony and Cleo DIY their kitchen sink. Victoria struggles to work with her team on a group project

episodes.title: A Home for Harvey
episodes.description: Cleo’s father, Harvey, comes to stay with the family after Tony delays his plans to move to a retirement home. With Nick’s guidance, a fragile Roger attempts to rejoin the dating pool.

episodes.title: Great Expectations
episodes.description: When Cleo botches a big presentation, she discovers shocking news that will change the family’s life forever. Tony faces his biggest test as Nick’s agent as he renegotiates a new contract for him.

723af06e-99dd-46f4-beff-9abbe91593f2.description: Enlightening messages from leaders and educators to the BYU student body.

episodes.title: Dallin H. Oaks | The Student Body and the President
episodes.description: President Dallin H. Oaks of Brigham Young University. "This fall I have felt impressed to speak to you about yourselves and about myself, a kind of centennial review of the student body and the President."

episodes.title: Thomas S. Monson | As a Chosen Generation, Be Prepared
episodes.description: Thomas S. Monson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "We have the potential to be a chosen generation. Truth, service, and love will help us be prepared to reach that potential and attain the Lord's approval."

episodes.title: Bruce R. McConkie | Who Shall Declare His Generation?
episodes.description: Bruce McConkie of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "I consider [this] to be the third greatest miracle that has ever occurred in all eternity...the miracle of creation: the fact that God, our Heavenly Father, brought us into being."

episodes.title: L. Tom Perry | The Church and the American Bicentennial
episodes.description: L. Tom Perry of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Let us all show justice, kindness, and charity toward our fellowmen. Let us demonstrate the love and reverence we should exhibit toward our Almighty God."

episodes.title: Marion G. Romney | America's Fate and Ultimate Destiny
episodes.description: Marion G. Romney, Second Counselor- First Presidency; the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "In God's economy, America is now and has always been a choice and favored land. God has decreed for her a final, great, and glorious destiny."

episodes.title: Ernest L. Wilkinson | America 1776-1976
episodes.description: BYU President Ernest L. Wilkinson. "Some of the events which history records took place preparatory to and necessary for the formation of our country and the restoration of the gospel, and whether this nation will continue to survive as a nation."

episodes.title: Dallin H. Oaks | Expectations at BYU
episodes.description: Dallin H. Oaks, President of Brigham Young University. "I will describe nine expectations...It is no exaggeration to say that these mutual expectation explain why we, teachers and students, have chosen to pursue our work at BYU."

episodes.title: Bruce R. McConkie | Jesus Christ and Him Crucified
episodes.description: Bruce R. McConkie of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Repentance means that we have faith in the Lord Jesus Christ, that we forsake our sins, that we come into the church and kingdom of God on earth and receive the Holy Ghost."

episodes.title: LeGrand Richards | The Prophets and the Scriptures
episodes.description: LeGrand Richards of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "If we'll walk in the way of the Lord and follow his holy prophets, as Peter said, we'll have a more sure word of prophecy. We'll never go astray."

episodes.title: L. Tom Perry | "I Need Thee Every Hour"
episodes.description: Elder L. Tom Perry of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Grow mentally each day. Prepare yourself for the eternities to come. Be close to the Lord. Understand the potential within you.”

episodes.title: Elder Thomas S. Monson | Decisions
episodes.description: Elder Thomas S. Monson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "The counsel of prophets and the power of prayer, together with the will to act, will guide us to our potential.”

episodes.title: Elder Gordon B. Hinckley | Forget Yourself
episodes.description: Elder Gordon B. Hinckley of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "The happiest people I know are those who lose themselves in the service of others."

episodes.title: President Ezra Taft Benson | A Vision and a Hope for the Youth of Zion
episodes.description: President Ezra Taft Benson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of latter-day Saints. "I hope that you recognize in the gospel of Jesus Christ a solution to our problems, temporal and spiritual.”

episodes.title: Elder Bruce R. McConkie | Celestial Marriage
episodes.description: Elder Bruce R. McConkie of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "[An obligation] rests upon Latter-day Saints to create for themselves eternal family units patterned after the family of God."

episodes.title: Elder Bruce R. McConkie | Joseph Smith: A Revealer of Christ
episodes.description: Elder Bruce R. McConkie of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "We are here to see if we will believe eternal truth and if we will conform to the principles so accepted and so learned.”

episodes.title: Jeffrey R. Holland | "That Our Children May Know"
episodes.description: Jeffrey R. Holland, President of Brigham Young University. "Will there be times in your life or theirs that they will need the substance of the gospel in a way that only you can teach it?"

episodes.title: Justice Dallin H. Oaks | Revelation
episodes.description: Dallin H. Oaks, Justice of the Utah Supreme Court. "I know that God lives and that revelation to his children is a reality. I pray that we will be worthy and willing, and that he will bless us to grow in this principle of revelation."

episodes.title: Elder Neal A. Maxwell | Meekly Drenched in Destiny
episodes.description: Elder Neal A. Maxwell of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Furthermore, whether you realize it or not, you are a generation drenched in destiny."

episodes.title: Jeffrey R. and Patricia T. Holland | However Long and However Hard the Road
episodes.description: Jeffrey and Pat Holland, President of Brigham Young University and Wife. "You [may] not see the full meaning of your effort in your own lifetime. But your children’s children will, until finally you, with all of them, can give the Hosanna shout."

episodes.title: Jeffrey & Patricia Holland | A Robe, a Ring, and a Fatted Calf // Walking on the Water
episodes.description: President Jeffrey R. Holland and Sister Patricia T. Holland, President of Brigham Young University and his wife. "I want to give to you today the message that we can be washed and pronounced clean if we will but honor the Lamb of God."

episodes.title: Elder Russell M. Nelson | Begin with the End in Mind
episodes.description: Elder Russell M. Nelson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Shape your own destiny...The development of your career, your family, and your faith in God is your individual responsibility."

episodes.title: Elder Marvin J. Ashton | What is Your Personal Ranking?
episodes.description: Elder Marvin J. Ashton of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "The word is 'Remember.' I promise you without any hesitation it can help in your ranking with yourself and God."

episodes.title: Neal A. Maxwell | If Thou Endure Well
episodes.description: Neal A. Maxwell of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles; the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "None of us...will be immune from the trials of life...if we learn to endure our struggles well, they will be turned into blessings in eternity."

episodes.title: President Jeffrey R. and Patricia T. Holland | Some Things We Have Learned - Together
episodes.description: President Jeffrey R. Holland and Sister Patricia T. Holland, President of Brigham Young University and his wife. "Life ought to be enjoyed at every stage of our experience and should not be hurried... to fit an unnatural schedule."

episodes.title: Elder James E. Faust | A Message to Our Granddaughters
episodes.description: Elder James E. Faust of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "You also have a great mission, a great errand, and a great calling. The work of God was devised by God for both men and women."

episodes.title: Jeffrey R. and Patricia T. Holland | "Unless You're a Mormon"
episodes.description: Jeffrey R. Holland, President of Brigham Young University and his wife, Patricia T. Holland. "God bless you to have a beautiful and rewarding new school year. Make it that way because you are Mormons."

episodes.title: President Jeffrey R. and Sister Patricia T. Holland | The Bitter Cup and the Bloody Baptism // The Soul's Center
episodes.description: President Jeffrey R. Holland and Sister Patricia T. Holland, President of Brigham Young University and his wife. "Our health and our wholeness are unquestionably linked with our holiness."

episodes.title: Jeffrey R. Holland and Patricia T. Holland| "Who We Are and What God Expects Us to Do" // Fear Not
episodes.description: Jeffrey R. Holland and Patricia T. Holland, President of Brigham Young University and his wife. "He expects us to remember we are heirs of a gospel dispensation that had among its earliest commandments the challenge to ‘seek out of the best books.'"

episodes.title: President Jeffrey R. Holland and Patricia T. Holland | At Their Most Enlightened and Alert // Be Renewed in the Spirit of Your Mind
episodes.description: President Jeffrey R. Holland and Patricia T. Holland, President of Brigham Young University and his wife. "There must be no concession to escapism here, that we must not be 'soothed' regarding sacrifice and learning."

episodes.title: President Jeffrey R. and Patricia Holland | The Will of the Father // Filling the Measure of Your Creation
episodes.description: President Jeffrey R. Holland and Sister Patricia T. Holland, President of Brigham Young University, and his wife. "So what can I be? What can be? We can be what heavenly parents designed us and intend us and help us to be."

episodes.title: Elder Neal A. Maxwell | "A Wonderful Flood of Light"
episodes.description: Elder Neal A. Maxwell of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Even as you and I come to love him, God loved us first all while he endures our insensitivity, our ingratitude, and our relapses."

episodes.title: Elder Russell M. Nelson | Reflection and Resolution
episodes.description: Elder Russell M. Nelson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "This evening is a real milestone—the first Sabbath day of new semester, of a new year, and of a new decade."

episodes.title: President Rex E. and Janet G. Lee | Find Beauty in the Storm
episodes.description: President Rex E. and Janet G. Lee, President of Brigham Young University and his wife. "I have grown to understand that to have ultimate faith in God is to know he is with us and will give us unfailing strength to help us through life’s challenges."

episodes.title: Eder Neal A. Maxwell | The Children of Christ
episodes.description: Elder Neal A. Maxwell of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "We must, like the prodigal son, arise and go to our father and be prepared for that resplendent reunion."

episodes.title: Elder Boyd K. Packer | The Edge of the Light
episodes.description: Elder Boyd L. Packer of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "I feel contrary breezes blow and see dark clouds appear. It is them that I cry out in my prays at night."

episodes.title: Elder L. Tom Perry | Where There Is No Vision
episodes.description: Elder L. Tom Perry of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Never be satisfied with where you are. Always be reaching out to make the world a better place, to make your sacrifice for the benefit of your fellowmen."

episodes.title: Elder Richard G. Scott | The Fruits of Obedience
episodes.description: Elder Richard G. Scott of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Yours is a future without limit because you have decided to be unwavering in obedience to the Lord."

episodes.title: Elder Dallin H. Oaks | Sin and Suffering
episodes.description: Elder Dallin H. Oaks of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Repentance, which is an assured passage to an eternal destination, is nevertheless not a free ride.”

episodes.title: Elder Howard W. Hunter | No Less Serviceable
episodes.description: Elder Howard W. Hunter of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Serve and grow, faithfully and quietly. Be on guard regarding the praise of men."

episodes.title: President Rex E. and Janet G. Lee | Keeping an Open Mind about Things that Matter
episodes.description: President Rex E. and Sister Janet G Lee, President of Brigham Young University and his wife. "Keep an open mind about things that really matter.”

episodes.title: President Gordon B. Hinckley | Out of Your Experience Here
episodes.description: President Gordon B. Hinckley, 1st Counselor of the First Presidency of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "We can offer our own witness of the truth, quietly, sincerely, honestly, but never in a manner that will give offense to others."

episodes.title: Elder Russell M. Nelson | Standards of Standard-Bearers of the Lord
episodes.description: Elder Russell M. Nelson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Living in accord with these twelve standards will help us be worthy standard-bearers of the Lord."

episodes.title: President Rex E. Lee | The Constitution and the Restoration
episodes.description: Rex E. Lee, President of Brigham Young University. "I am satisfied that whatever else may eventually hang in the constitutional balance, this much is clear: The continuation of the blessings of liberty depends finally on our spiritual righteousness."

episodes.title: Elder Boyd K. Packer | "I Say unto You, Be One"
episodes.description: Elder Boyd K. Packer of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Each of us must accommodate the mixture of reason and revelation in our lives. The gospel not only permits but requires it."

episodes.title: Thomas S. Monson (3-3-91)
episodes.description: Highlights of the Church in 1990

episodes.title: Elder Neal A. Maxwell | "In Him All Things Hold Together"
episodes.description: Elder Neal A. Maxwell of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Oh, how we adore Jesus for his atonement! For his free gift of immortality to all!”

episodes.title: Elder Marvin J. Ashton | "And in Everything Give Thanks"
episodes.description: Elder Marvin J. Ashton of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Truly, if we love God, we will serve him now, and give thanks now."

episodes.title: President Thomas S. Monson | Be Thou an Example of the Believers
episodes.description: President Thomas S. Monson, Second Counselor of the First Presidency of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "You have the tremendous power to set an example for others who may come to know Christ through you."

episodes.title: Elder Howard W. Hunter | The Dauntless Spirit of Resolution
episodes.description: Elder Howard W. Hunter of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "It is worthy to make resolutions regarding our behavior, goals, or pursuits. Such resolutions become mileposts to guide our lives."

episodes.title: Elder Russell M. Nelson | Jesus the Christ-Our Master and More
episodes.description: Elder Russell M. Nelson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Sinless and flawless as Jesus was in mortality, even He had to endure to the end. Can you and I be expected to do any less?"

episodes.title: Elder L. Tom Perry | "And Jesus Increase in Wisdom and Stature, and in Favour with God and Man"
episodes.description: Elder L. Tom Perry of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints "Learn to appreciate the power and potential in your heads. Get out of your comfort zone! Expand your vision!"

episodes.title: President Gordon B. Hinckley | This I Believe
episodes.description: President Gordon B. Hinckley, First Counselor of the First Presidency of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Everyone of us is largely the product of his or her beliefs. Our behavior is governed by these."

episodes.title: Boyd K. Packer (3-29-92)
episodes.description: Boyd K. Packer speaks to BYU students about "The Fountain of Life."

episodes.title: Elder Dallin H. Oaks | Our Strengths Can Become Our Downfall
episodes.description: Elder Dallin H. Oaks of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "A person who engages in self-congratulation over a supposed strength has lost the protection of humility and is vulnerable to Satan."

episodes.title: Elder Joseph B. Wirthlin | "The Lord's Side"
episodes.description: Elder Joseph B. Wirthlin of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "The Lord has left no doubt in defining his side and where the Saints should be in their thoughts, words, actions, and practices.”

episodes.title: Elder Neal A. Maxwell | The Inexhaustible Gospel
episodes.description: Elder Neal A. Maxwell of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Quite understandably, given its very nature, God’s latter-day work will be regarded with much skepticism by many.”

episodes.title: President Gordon B. Hinckley | Trust and Accountability
episodes.description: President Gordon B. Hinckley, First Counselor of the First Presidency of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Trust and accountability are two great words by which we must guide our lives if we are to live beyond ourselves."

episodes.title: Elder Marvin J. Ashton | "Know He Is There"
episodes.description: Elder Marvin J. Ashton of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Quietly we can pray for the patience to have our secret prayers answered.”

episodes.title: President Rex E. and Sister Janet G. Lee | Selective Attitudes and the Happy Life
episodes.description: Rex E. and Janet G. Lee, President of Brigham Young University and his wife. "Selective attitudes—particularly when combined with the truths of the restored gospel—affect the quality of life itself."

episodes.title: Elder Russell M. Nelson | Integrity of Heart
episodes.description: Elder Russell M. Nelson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Your precious identity deserves your precious integrity! Guard it as the priceless prize that it is."

episodes.title: Elder Richard G. Scott | Acquiring Spiritual Knowledge
episodes.description: Elder Richard G. Scott of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "There is only one arena of study where we may learn absolute truth—and that is centered in the gospel of Jesus Christ."

episodes.title: Janet G. Lee and Michael Lee | Visualizing Our Success
episodes.description: Janet G. Lee, wife of Rex E. Lee, President of Brigham Young University, and her son Michael S. Lee, ASBYU President. "The Lord wants us to learn from our mistakes because that is how we become strong. He does not expect us to be perfect."

episodes.title: Elder L. Tom Perry | "To Everything There Is a Season"
episodes.description: Elder L. Tom Perry of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "We must continually be thinking about our preparation for the time of the harvest."

episodes.title: Thomas S. Monson (2-15-94)
episodes.description: Presidents of the Church

episodes.title: Elder Neal A. Maxwell | "Called to Serve"
episodes.description: Elder Neal A. Maxwell of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Be assured that God is 'in the details' and in the subtleties of the defining moments and the preparatory moments.”

episodes.title: Elder Dallin H. Oaks | Sins and Mistakes
episodes.description: Elder Dallin Oaks of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "In the treatment process we should not require repentance for mistakes, but we are commanded to preach the necessity of repentance for sins.”

episodes.title: President Gordon B. Hinckley | Codes and Covenants
episodes.description: President Gordon Hinckley, First Counselor of the First Presidency of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Codes and covenants are as old as mankind and as contemporary as marriage.”

episodes.title: Elder Dallin H. Oaks | Adversity
episodes.description: Elder Dallin H. Oaks of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Like the mortal life of which they are a part, adversities are temporary. What is permanent is what we become by the way we react to them."

episodes.title: President Rex E. Lee & Sister Janet G. Lee | Your Time on Earth: When Would You Have Chosen to Come? // The Lord Doesn't Grade on a Curve
episodes.description: President Rex E. and Sister Janet G. Lee, President of Brigham Young University and his wife. "Never will our eternal value be measured in comparison with another’s performance. The Lord doesn’t think in terms of quotas—only qualities.”

episodes.title: President Gordon B. Hinckley | To a Man Who Has Done What This Church Expects of Each of Us
episodes.description: President Gordon B. Hinckley, President of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "God is our Almighty Father. He is our anchor and our strength...We must look to Him. We must extend our thanks to Him and seek His direction.”

episodes.title: Elder Neal A. Maxwell | "Brim with Joy" (Alma 26:11)
episodes.description: Elder Neal A. Maxwell of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "One of the great blessings the gospel gives us is the lens through which we can see with proportion.”

episodes.title: Elder M. Russell Ballard | When Shall These Things Be?
episodes.description: Elder M. Russell Ballard of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles for the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "These are the [challenging] last days. Safety, peace, joy, and security are found only in the life and mission of Jesus Christ."

episodes.title: President Merrill J. and Marilyn S. Bateman | A Peculiar Treasure // The Best Gifts
episodes.description: President Merril J. Bateman and Marilyn S. Bateman, President of Brigham Young University and his wife. "As covenant children of the Lord and as his peculiar treasure, we must strengthen continually our faith in him and in his atonement.”

episodes.title: President Gordon B. Hinckley | Stand Up for Truth
episodes.description: President Gordon B. Hinckley, President of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "In this world so filled with problems, so constantly threatened, you can and must rise above mediocrity, above indifference."

episodes.title: President Merrill J. and Marilyn S. Bateman | A Faith That Preserves and Strengthens // One's Personal Influence
episodes.description: President Merrill J. Bateman and Sister Marilyn S. Bateman, President of Brigham Young University and his wife. "We can trust him. He earned our trust in the Garden and on the cross."

episodes.title: Elder Joseph B. Wirthlin | Being Righteous in Our Hearts
episodes.description: Elder Joseph B. Wirthlin of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "How glorious is integrity! Those who have it display a constancy of character. Their behavior is the same in private as in public.”

episodes.title: Elder L. Tom Perry | The Value of a Good Name
episodes.description: Elder L. Tom Perry of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "We cannot isolate ourselves from those around us. Our good name can be a special valued asset worth more than the riches of the world."

episodes.title: President Thomas S. Monson | In Search of Treasure
episodes.description: President Thomas S. Monson, First Counselor of the First Presidency of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "There are keys in our past, present, and future that can help us find our eternal treasure—the kingdom of God."

episodes.title: President Merrill J. and Marilyn S. Bateman | One by One // "To Thine Own Self Be True"
episodes.description: President Merrill J. Bateman and Marilyn S. Bateman, President of Brigham Young University and his wife. "May each of us accept the Savior’s invitation to approach him and to spiritually see and feel the wounds in his hands, feet, and side."

episodes.title: Elder Henry B. Eyring | A Child of God
episodes.description: Elder Henry B. Eyring of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "You are a child of God. Our Heavenly Father lives. Jesus is the Christ, our Savior."

episodes.title: President Gordon B. Hinckley | The BYU Experience
episodes.description: President Gordon B. Hinckley, President of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "You came because you wanted the BYU experience, although perhaps you could not define it. Having gained it, never lose it."

episodes.title: President James E. Faust | Learning for Eternity
episodes.description: President James E. Faust, Second Counselor of the First Presidency of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "You need to know the purpose for your being. Each of you needs to ask yourself, Why am I here on earth?”

episodes.title: President Merrill J. Bateman | The Eternal Family
episodes.description: Merrill J. Bateman, President of Brigham Young University. "Each one of us may be part of an eternal family if we are obedient to gospel principles. A fullness of joy is found only within the framework of an exalted family."

episodes.title: Thomas S. Monson (3-10-98)
episodes.description: Thomas S. Monson delivers an address entitled "Your Choice."

episodes.title: President Merrill J. & Marilyn S. Bateman | Children of the Covenant // Our Sacred Honor
episodes.description: President Merrill J. Bateman and Marilyn S. Bateman, President of Brigham Young University and his wife. "It is one of the cornerstones of character. Integrity implies honesty, moral soundness, and a quality of being undivided."

episodes.title: Richard G. Scott (9-15-98)
episodes.description: Richard G. Scott of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Decisions Based upon Eternal Truth. That pattern of life will lead you to success, accomplishment, peace, happiness, and great joy."

episodes.title: President Gordon B. Hinckley | The Quest for Excellence
episodes.description: Gordon B. Hinckley, President of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Reach for the stars. If you touch them, great shall be your reward. If you stumble and fall while reaching upward, you will be happy knowing you have made the effort."

episodes.title: Merrill and Marilyn Bateman (1-5-1999)
episodes.description: President of Brigham Young University, Merrill J. Bateman, and his wife Marilyn S. Bateman. "May our testimonies motivate us to improve our lot in life."

episodes.title: Elder Dallin H. Oaks | Weightier Matters
episodes.description: Elder Dallin H. Oaks of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "We know that the work of God cannot be done without unity and cooperative action.”

episodes.title: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland | "Cast Not Away Therefore Your Confidence"
episodes.description: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Perseverance saved Moses when he was surrounded by enemy forces, and it can save you too.”

episodes.title: President Merrill J. and Marilyn S. Bateman | Gathered in the Tops of the Mountains // Evolution of the Mind, the Heart, and the Soul
episodes.description: Merrill J. Bateman and Marilyn S. Bateman, President of Brigham Young University and his wife. "Read the scriptures daily, even if only for a few minutes. Accept Church assignments and fulfill them. Make daily prayer a pattern in your life.”

episodes.title: Elder James E. Faust | Our Search for Happiness
episodes.description: Elder James E. Faust of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "The Savior of the world taught us to seek that inner peace which taps the innate happiness in our souls.”

episodes.title: President Gordon B. Hinckley | Keep the Chain Unbroken
episodes.description: President Gordon B. Hinckley, President of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Life is a great chain of generations that we in the Church believe must be linked together."

episodes.title: President Merrill and Marilyn Bateman (1-11-00)
episodes.description: President Merrill J. and Sister Marilyn S. Bateman, President of Brigham Young University and his wife. "If we continue earnestly with faith and hope in Christ to seek the gift of charity, it will be granted to us."

episodes.title: Elder M. Russell Ballard | The Lord Has a Work for You to Do
episodes.description: Elder M. Russell Ballard of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. " It is more important than what you do, even as vital as your work is and will be.”

episodes.title: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland | How Do I Love Thee?
episodes.description: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "You want capability, safety, and security in dating and romance, in married life and eternity? Be a true disciple of Jesus."

episodes.title: Thomas S. Monson (9-12-00)
episodes.description: Thomas S. Monson delivers an address entitled "What God Expects."

episodes.title: President Merrill J. & Marilyn S. Bateman | Light, Visions, and Dreams // Tapestry of Life
episodes.description: President Merrill J. & Sister Marilyn S. Bateman, President of Brigham Young University and his wife. "If we make Christ the center of our lives, our tapestries will be rich in color and beautiful in design."

episodes.title: Elder Joseph B. Wirthlin | "Live in Thanksgiving Daily"
episodes.description: Elder Joseph B. Wirthlin of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles for the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Gratitude is a mark of a noble soul and a refined character. They tend to be more humble, more joyful, more likable."

episodes.title: Merrill J. and Marilyn S. Bateman | Christ Is the Reason
episodes.description: Merrill J. and Marilyn S. Bateman, President of Brigham Young University and his wife. "Christ is the basis for all that we do. Without the Savior and His Atonement, there would be no good news to spread."

episodes.title: Elder Richard G. Scott | To Acquire Knowledge and the Strength to Use It Wisely
episodes.description: Elder Richard G. Scott of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "You can learn vitally important things by what you hear and see and, especially, by what you feel, as prompted by the Holy Ghost."

episodes.title: Elder M. Russell Ballard | "Here Am I, Send Me"
episodes.description: Elder M. Russell Ballard of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "We cannot fulfill our mission as a Church without the inspired insight and support of women."

episodes.title: President Merrill J. and Marilyn S. Bateman | "Lay Hold upon Every Good Thing"
episodes.description: Merrill J. and Marilyn S. Bateman, President of Brigham Young University and his wife. "Family relationships are sacred. The bonds within families have spiritual roots. We know that we lived as brothers and sisters before coming to earth."

episodes.title: Merrill J. and Marilyn S. Bateman | How Knoweth This Man Letters
episodes.description: Merrill J. and Marilyn S. Bateman, President of Brigham Young University and his wife. "Do you feel the beauty and power of the scriptures? Can you sense the blessings that await if you drink deeply of Christ's living water?"

episodes.title: Elder Dallin H. Oaks | Timing
episodes.description: Elder Dallin H. Oaks of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Accept the Lord's planning and the agency of others in matters that inevitably affect you. Take the long view- the timing of eternity."

episodes.title: President Merrill J. Bateman | Temples of Learning
episodes.description: Merrill J. Bateman, President of Brigham Young University. "Remember and honor those whose lives were lost in last year’s tragedy. May we live in a manner that will add to the Spirit in this temple of learning. May we be worthy of the Holy Ghost."

episodes.title: Russell M. Nelson | Christ the Savior is Born
episodes.description: Elder Russell M. Nelson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "With a testimony of the Lord we have the privilege in faith to testify of His divine parentage and that Jesus is the Son of [God]."

episodes.title: Merrill J. and Marilyn S. Bateman | Mortality and Our Eternal Journey
episodes.description: Merril J. and Marilyn S. Bateman, President of Brigham Young University and his wife. "We are the spirit offspring of an Eternal Being who has given us the opportunity to experience mortality-a brief but critical time in an eternal journey."

episodes.title: Elder Joseph B. Wirthlin | Improving Our Prayers
episodes.description: Elder Joseph B Wirthlin of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "As we approach our Heavenly Father in the name of Christ, we open the windows of heaven."

episodes.title: President Cecil & Sharon Samuelson | Outward Expressions of the Inner Self // Be Thou an Example
episodes.description: President Cecil O. and Sister Sharon G. Samuelson, president of Brigham Young University and his wife. "When we show that we really know who we are, we benefit not only ourselves but others."

episodes.title: Thomas S. Monson (1-20-04)
episodes.description: Thomas S. Monson delivers this address entitled "I Will Serve the Lord."

episodes.title: Elder Neal A. Maxwell | "Free to Choose"
episodes.description: Elder Neal A. Maxwell of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "The vital revelations about the agency of man…inevitably and simultaneously portray the perfect generosity and perfect justice of God.”

episodes.title: President Cecil O. & Sharon Samuelson | Integrity // A Good Name- A Priceless Possession
episodes.description: President Cecil O. Samuelson and Sister Sharon G. Samuelson, President of Brigham Young University and his wife. "May we honor our names and thus our forebears as we strive to live righteous lives."

episodes.title: Dallin H. Oaks (11-9-2004)
episodes.description: Dallin H. Oaks of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "What seem to be only small detours from the straight and narrow path can result in huge differences in position down the road of life."

episodes.title: Cecil O. & Sharon G. Samuelson (1-18-05)
episodes.description: Cecil O. and Sharon G. Samuelson, president of Brigham Young University. "Each one of us here is writing the book of his or her life, and reading, learning, loving, serving, and worshipping are integral parts of the process."

episodes.title: James E. Faust (3-1-05)
