episodes.description: James E. Faust of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints should be in our hearts, and when it is in our individual hearts, it will also be in our great in our buildings of worship."

episodes.title: David A. Bednar (5-10-05)
episodes.description: David A. Bednar of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Like baptism by water comes before the baptism by fire, so being quick to observe is a prerequisite to and a preparation for the gift of discernment."

episodes.title: Cecil O. & Sharon Samuelson (8-30-05)
episodes.description: Cecil O. and Sharon G. Samuelson, president of Brigham Young University. “Our prophet’s voice and the message it shares can be trusted to teach and guide us."

episodes.title: Gordon B. Hinckley (9-20-05)
episodes.description: President of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, Gordon B. Hinckley. "President Joseph F. Smith had an understanding of the eternal nature of man that few others have ever possessed."

episodes.title: Robert D. Hales (11-15-05)
episodes.description: Robert D. Hales of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "The temple is a sacred edifice, a holy place where essential saving ceremonies and ordinances are performed to prepare us for exaltation."

episodes.title: Cecil O. & Sharon G. Samuelson (1-10-06)
episodes.description: Cecil O. and Sharon G. Samuelson, president of Brigham Young University. "Our eternal worth is given to us by God. We can lose sight of our self-worth if we do not keep the commandments and consequently disregard the divinity within us."

episodes.title: Cecil O. & Sharon G. Samuelson (9-12-06)
episodes.description: Cecil O. and Sharon G. Samuelson, president of Brigham Young University. "The Honor Code is an outward manifestation of our inner appreciation for and understanding of the privilege of being at BYU."

episodes.title: Gordon B. Hinckley (10-31-06)
episodes.description: Gordon B. Hinckley, President of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "[Experiences] have influenced my thinking and my behavior. They have affected my life in an unforgettable manner. You likewise will have significant experiences."

episodes.title: Thomas S. Monson (11-14-06)
episodes.description: Thomas S. Monson of the First Presidency of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "The gate of history swings on small hinges, and so do people’s lives. You must pass through each gate to be successful in your journey through mortality."

episodes.title: Cecil and Sharon Samuelson (1-09-07)
episodes.description: Cecil O. and Sharon G. Samuelson, president of BYU. "The seeds of faith and light are planted, cultivated, nurtured, and grow bathed in the glow of His tender care."

episodes.title: Boyd K. Packer (1-16-07)
episodes.description: Boyd K. Packer, Acting President of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "If you hold on to the rod, you can feel you way forward with the gift of the Holy Ghost."

episodes.title: Pres. Cecil Samuelson and Sharon Samuel (9-11-07)
episodes.description: Cecil O. Samuelson and his wife, Sharon G. Samuelson. "Do not neglect your private and personal prayers, your scripture study, or your appropriate acts of anonymous service as as the public manifestations you make of you devotion to God and country."

episodes.title: Gordon B. Hinckley (9-18-07)
episodes.description: President of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, Gordon B. Hinckley. "God is no respecter of persons. All are deserving of our consideration. Love and mercy must be the foundation principles of our relationships."

episodes.title: L. Tom Perry (10-30-07)
episodes.description: L. Tom Perry of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "In this first dispensation we learn that we are sons and daughters of an Eternal Father and have the right to communicate with Him."

episodes.title: President Thomas S. Monson (11-13-07)
episodes.description: First Counselor in the First Presidency of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, Thomas S. Monson. "I testify to you today that turning away from God brings broken covenants, shattered dreams, and crushed hopes."

episodes.title: Cecil O. and Sharon Samuelson (1-8-06)
episodes.description: Cecil O. and Sharon G. Samuelson, president of BYU. "I do know that in this extraordinary community of students, staff, faculty, and administrators there are many who deserve our respect, admiration, and appreciation."

episodes.title: Pres. Henry B. Eyring (1-15-08)
episodes.description: Henry B. Eyring of the First Presidency of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Your experience in enduring well in the trials of life can bring you the assurance you need to find peace in this life and confidence for the next."

episodes.title: Richard G. Scott (3-18-08)
episodes.description: To Establish a Secure Foundation for Life

episodes.title: Cecil O. and Sharon Samuelson (9-9-08)
episodes.description: Cecil O. and Sharon G. Samuelson, president of BYU. "We are really agents of God the Father in providing these little ones the very best mortal experiences possible."

episodes.title: President Cecil & Sister Sharon Samuelson (1-6-09)
episodes.description: President Cecil O. and Sharon G. Samuelson of Brigham Young University. "Each of you has the light of Jesus Christ within you. How wonderful that is for you as you strive to discern what is truly of great worth in your life."

episodes.title: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland (1-13-09)
episodes.description: Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Faith builds on the past but never longs to stay there. Faith trusts that God has great things in store for each of us.'"

episodes.title: President Cecil & Sister Sharon Samuelson (9-8-09)
episodes.description: President Cecil O. and Sharon G. Samuelson of Brigham Young University. "The things of greatest ultimate importance to us are largely in our control and are within the scope of our agency."

episodes.title: President Thomas S. Monson (9-15-09)
episodes.description: Thomas S. Monson, president of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Remember whom you can follow- even the Lord Jesus Christ. Let us follow Him. He has sent Presidents of the Church, whom we can have as guides and whom we can follow."

episodes.title: Cecil O. & Sharon Samuelson (1-5-10)
episodes.description: Lessons Taughts by Two Prophets/Act Well Thy Part

episodes.title: Cecil O. & Sharon Samuelson (9-7-10)
episodes.description: Appropriate Zeal/Gratitude -- a Commandment of God

episodes.title: Elder Robert D. Hales (9-14-10)
episodes.description: Elder Robert D. Hales of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles speaks to students on the subject "Our Essential Spiritual Agency."

episodes.title: Cecil O. and Sharon Samuelson (1-4-11)
episodes.description: Seven Suggestions/Remembering and Honoring Your Covenants

episodes.title: D. Todd Christofferson (10-19-1999)
episodes.description: D. Todd Christofferson of the Presidency of the Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "May your reverence for these holy beings and your allegiance to them be the shining guide of your life forever."

episodes.title: Robert H. Daines (6-20-00)
episodes.description: Robert H. Daines, Driggs Professor of Strategy in the BYU Marriott School of Management. "Let us establish clearly our priorities in life. Let us go to the sacrament table repenting of our sins and renewing our covenants on a weekly basis."

episodes.title: LaVell Edwards | Take upon Yourself the Whole Armor of God
episodes.description: LaVell Edwards, Former Brigham Young University Head Football Coach. "As members of the Church, we must seek truth in all areas, be it spiritual, educational, scientific, or in the social and moral settings of society."

episodes.title: W. Gibb Dyer Jr. | Repentance: The Key to Eternal Progression
episodes.description: W. Gibb Dyer Jr, Professor of Organizational Behavior at Brigham Young University. "To recognize sin we must not rely on the world but rely on our living prophet, President Hinckley; the scriptures; and our ecclesiastical leaders to show us the way."

episodes.title: Lynn E. Garner | Learning in an Eternal Context
episodes.description: Lynn E. Garner, Chair of the Department of Mathematics at Brigham Young University. "The knowledge of most worth comes first as we learn to place all learning in the context of the gospel of Jesus Christ and seek the gifts of the Spirit as we learn."

episodes.title: Kristine Hansen | Lift Up Thine Eyes to the Mountains
episodes.description: Kristine Hansen, Associate Dean of General Education and Honors and Professor of English. "I propose that in striving to achieve the aims of a BYU education, you will simultaneously be advancing in your quest for perfection and eternal life."

episodes.title: Mary Williams | To Know and to Be Known of God
episodes.description: Mary Williams, Associate Dean in the College of Nursing at Brigham Young University. "Sooner or later every person who has lived on this earth will be given knowledge regarding the divinity of Jesus Christ.”

episodes.title: Jeffrey D. Keith | Feeling the Atonement
episodes.description: Jeffrey D. Keith, professor of Geology at Brigham Young University. "If we are constantly seeking to know the breadth and depth of His atoning love and how very personal it really is, our seeking will not be in vain."

episodes.title: David A. Bednar | "In the Strength of the Lord"
episodes.description: David A. Bednar, President of Brigham Young University-Idaho. "As you and I come to understand and employ the enabling power of the Atonement in our personal lives, we will pray and seek for strength to change our circumstances."

episodes.title: Elder Cecil O. Samuelson | The Importance of Asking Questions
episodes.description: Elder Cecil O. Samuelson of the Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "One of the key ways that we learn—not only here at BYU but throughout life—is by asking questions."

episodes.title: John D. Lamb | Witnesses in Stars and Stones
episodes.description: John D. Lamb, professor and associate dean of General Education and Honors at BYU. "The Lord has sent you witnesses in stars and stones that He lives, that He loves you, and that He has set in place a plan. All He has created can be  yours."

episodes.title: Elaine Michaelis | Anxiously Engaged
episodes.description: Elaine Michaelis, Director of Women's Athletics at Brigham Young University. "We cannot be slackers in our commitment to the Lord, in our effort to be an example of His teaching, or in our desire to share."

episodes.title: Bruce Chadwick (5-7-2002)
episodes.description: Bruce A. Chadwick, professor of sociology at Brigham Young University. "Today I want to share with those of you who are single some of the appropriate ways to establish an eternal relationship. A good marriage and family life is crafted, not found."

episodes.title: Alan Parkinson (5-14-02)
episodes.description: Alan Parkinson delivers a message entitled "The Savior's Example in Doing the Father's Will."

episodes.title: Elder Sheldon F. Child | Follow the Prophet
episodes.description: Elder Sheldon F. Child of the Seventy for the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "We sustain 15 men as prophets, seers, and revelators. [President Hinckley] holds the keys of the kingdom. He is the Lord's chief apostle on the earth today."

episodes.title: Dennis B. Neuenschwander (11-12-2002)
episodes.description: Dennis B. Neuenschwander of the Presidency of the Seventy for the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Much trouble in life originates from forgetting what we should remember and remembering what we should forget."

episodes.title: Robert L. Marshall | Becoming
episodes.description: Robert L. Marshall, Chairman of the Department of Visual Arts at Brigham Young University. "We are being prepared to perform many great and marvelous things in our families, communities, and church.”

episodes.title: Keith J. Karren | Ultimate Health: God's Gift and Our Personal Responsibility
episodes.description: Keith J. Karren, professor of Health Sciences at Brigham Young University. "Our Father in Heaven desires us to be joyful and well, to nurture and care for the garden that is entrusted to each of us."

episodes.title: Bishop Keith B. McMullin | Make God and His Kingdom the Center of Your Life
episodes.description: Bishop Keith B. McMullin, 2nd Counselor of the Presiding Bishopric of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Position yourself firmly inside God's kingdom; allow it to encompass you."

episodes.title: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf (11-11-2003)
episodes.description: Dieter F. Uchtdorf of the Presidency of the Seventy. "The Holy Ghost will be the wind beneath your wings, placing in your hearts the firm conviction of the divinity of the Lord Jesus Christ and His place in the eternal plan."

episodes.title: Sheri L. Dew | You Were Born to Lead, You Were Born for Glory
episodes.description: Sheri L. Dew, President and CEO of Deseret Book Company. "You simply must understand this, because you were born to lead by virtue of who you are, the covenants you have made, and the fact that you are here now in the 11th hour."

episodes.title: John K. Carmack | Bless the Poor and Needy
episodes.description: John Carmack, managing director of the Perpetual Education Fund for the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Let's do what we can, according to our circumstances, to lift those arms that hang down."

episodes.title: Lee Wakefield | Feel and Follow the Holy Spirit
episodes.description: Lee Wakefield, professor of dance at Brigham Young University. "Appreciate the wisdom of placing ourselves in situations where the Spirit of the Lord can be present. It makes a difference where we are, what we are doing, and when we are doing it."

episodes.title: Elder D. Todd Christofferson | Moral Agency
episodes.description: Elder D. Todd Christofferson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "The beauty of the gospel of Jesus Christ is that it pours knowledge into our souls and shows things in their true light.”

episodes.title: President Cheryl C. Lant | God's Love
episodes.description: Cheryl C. Lant, Primary General President for the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Pure love is a gift and is at the very foundation of His gospel. Our love for Him is constantly being redefined as we learn, grow, and experience."

episodes.title: Stephen Jones | "He Hath Made with Us an Everlasting Covenant, Ordered in All Things, and Sure"
episodes.description: Stephen Jones, dean of the College of Fine Arts and Communications at Brigham Young University. "Surely, returning to our loving Father is the final purpose of our attempts to order our lives in full and complete wholeness."

episodes.title: Thomas B. Griffith | "The Very Root of Christian Doctrine"
episodes.description: Thomas B. Griffith, Judge on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit. "When we are speaking of what the Savior has done for us, we are at the core of the meaning of life, and we are connected to the root of Christian doctrine."

episodes.title: Robert C. Oaks (3-21-06)
episodes.description: Robert C. Oaks of the Presidency of the Seventy for the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Here, you owe it to yourself to make an extra effort to discover who you really are—to discover your true and eternal potential in God’s plan."

episodes.title: Andrew C. Skinner | The Nature and Character of God
episodes.description: Andrew Skinner, Executive Director of the Neal A. Maxwell Institute for Religious Scholarship at Brigham Young University. "We may rest assured that our Father knows all things and He does all that He does out of love."

episodes.title: Edward Blaser (5-9-06)
episodes.description: Edward Blaser delivers an address entitled "The World is Our Stage."

episodes.title: Elder Neil L. Andersen | Seeing Through the Generations
episodes.description: Elder Neil L. Andersen of the Seventy for the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "You will see more clearly who you are and what you must become. Your place in this vast, beautiful plan of happiness is no small place."

episodes.title: Joseph D. Parry | On Being a Christian Perfectly
episodes.description: Joseph D. Parry, associate professor in the Department of Humanities, Classics, and Comparative Literature at Brigham Young University. "I want to think with you about being a Christian perfectly, rather than doing Christianity perfectly."

episodes.title: Elder Donald L. Staheli | "Be Strong and of Good Courage"
episodes.description: Elder Donald L. Staheli of the Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "While you will be tried and tested, your faithful adherence to the Lord’s standards will be seen as a beacon in the night to those around you.”

episodes.title: Gerald R. Williams | Learning from Our Conflicts
episodes.description: Gerald R. Williams, professor of law at Brigham Young University. "When we remember our conflicts and reflect on them, they are like mirrors that can teach us things about ourselves that are otherwise difficult to discover."

episodes.title: Jo Ann C. Abegglen | The Power of One: Selfless Service
episodes.description: Jo Ann C. Abegglen, associate professor of Nursing at Brigham Young University. "It is easy to give away excess money, used equipment, and used clothing. It is more difficult to give of our time, to give of our personal presence to help others."

episodes.title: William H. Baker | Knowing, Doing, and Being
episodes.description: William H. Baker, professor of management communication at Brigham Young University. "In addition to increasing what we know and improving how we apply that knowledge, we must refine who we are deep down in our heart."

episodes.title: Scott D. Sommerfeldt | Exactness in Our Discipleship
episodes.description: Scott D. Sommerfeldt, department chair of physics and astronomy at Brigham Young University. "As we become more exact in our discipleship of the Savior, there is an impressive power that comes into our lives that aids us in our spiritual growth."

episodes.title: David A. Hunt | "Fresh Courage Take"
episodes.description: David A. Hunt, assistant administrative vice-president of Student Auxiliary Services at Brigham Young University. "The Lord has promised to give us His power and protection as we live righteous lives."

episodes.title: Douglas L. Callister (9-19-06)
episodes.description: Douglas L. Callister of the Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "The nearer we get to God, the more easily our spirits are touched by refined and beautiful things. Refinement is a companion to developed spirituality."

episodes.title: Thomas A. Holmoe | Brotherly Love
episodes.description: Thomas A. Holmoe, athletic director of Brigham Young University. "In our present-day situations, we would all do well, as children of our Heavenly Father, to contemplate our answer to that same question: 'Am I my brother’s keeper?'"

episodes.title: Joseph Fielding McConkie | Finding Answers
episodes.description: Joseph Fielding McConkie, emeritus professor of ancient scripture at Brigham Young University. "It is not the design of heaven that we be rescued from all difficult situations. Rather, it is the system that we grow up and learn to handle them."

episodes.title: Peter M. Johnson | Faith, Family, and Friendship
episodes.description: Peter M. Johnson, Assistant Professor of Accounting at the Marriott School of Business at Brigham Young University. "We have been given much; therefore we must give of ourselves and incorporate and strengthen faith, family, and friendships."

episodes.title: President Bonnie D. Parkin |  Personal Ministry: Sacred and Precious
episodes.description: President Bonnie D. Parkin, Relief Society General President in the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "I believe we received our personal ministry in the premortal world. It was divinely given and lasts a lifetime."

episodes.title: Elder Quentin L. Cook | Be a Missionary All Your Life
episodes.description: Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Peace in this life does not come from merely pursuing worldly objectives. Eternal life… does not come from pursuing merely worldly objectives.”

episodes.title: Richard O. Cowan |  Preparing for That Which Is to Come
episodes.description: Richard O. Cowan, Professor of Church History and Doctrine at Brigham Young University. "May we ponder our personal part in helping the Lord's kingdom roll forth."

episodes.title: Neil J. Anderson | Responding to the Savior's Invitation: "Come"
episodes.description: Neil J. Anderson, Professor of Linguistics and English Language at Brigham Young University. "As we desire to respond to the Savior's invitation to come, we will have to leave behind our weaknesses and our sins."

episodes.title: Elder Richard G. Hinckley | "Prophetic Priorities"
episodes.description: Elder Richard G. Hinckley of the Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Some of you struggle with certain doctrines or practices of the Church, past or present. That's okay. Be patient, but be persistent."

episodes.title: Gary K. Palmer | The Spokes of a Balanced Life
episodes.description: Gary K Palmer, Professor of Recreation Management and Youth Leadership at Brigham Young University. "We need to remember that all we take with us is who we have become through serving God.”

episodes.title: Earl C. Tingey | The Watchman on the Tower
episodes.description: Elder Earl C. Tingey of the Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "We do not change all this because we have living prophets who ‘stand in holy places,’ and [are not] moved."

episodes.title: John Telford | "Gladly, Gladly We'll Walk in the Light"
episodes.description: John Telford, Professor of Visual Arts at Brigham Young University. "To be the best in the world, all of the attention is focused on the individual. To be the best for the world, the attention is focused on others."

episodes.title: Delora Bertelsen | The Care and Keeping of BYU's Human Resources
episodes.description: Delora Bertelsen, Managing Director of Employee Relations, Equal Opportunity, and Benefit Services at Brigham Young University. "As children of our Heavenly Father, we should know that how we treat each other is very important in His eyes.”

episodes.title: Tina Taylor Dyches | "Walk as Children of Light"
episodes.description: Tina Taylor Dyches, Associate Professor of Counseling Psychology and Special Education at Brigham Young University. "Let us shine the Light of Christ at home, at school, at play, at work, and in any other place where we may be found.”

episodes.title: Brian K. Evans | Your Contract with BYU
episodes.description: Brian K. Evans, Chief Financial Officer and Administrative Vice President at Brigham Young University. "Let our campus be an inclusive community, not an exclusive fraternity."

episodes.title: Ronard Brough | Balance in Life
episodes.description: Ronald Brough, Professor of Music at Brigham Young University. "Prayer is a tool to help us commune with our Father in Heaven. It is also the vehicle He can use to reveal His will to us.”

episodes.title: Elder Bruce C. Hafen | A Disciple's Journey
episodes.description: Elder Bruce C. Hafen of the Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Christ is so eager for our return that He comes to meet and strengthen us all along our way. No matter where we are on that path, we are never lost to Him."

episodes.title: Gregory Clark | Some Lessons on Faith and Fear
episodes.description: Gregory Clark, associate dean of the College of Humanities at Brigham Young University. "In faith, we are blessed with peace that comes in the form of confidence- confidence that in the midst of all the storms of this life, all is well."

episodes.title: David A. Thomas | A Law upon Which All Blessings Are Predicated
episodes.description: David A. Thomas, professor at J. Reuben Clark Law School at Brigham Young University. "One of the things we should think about each day is whether [the blessings received] seem to be coming to us in response to our obedience to… the Lord."

episodes.title: Mary Anne Prater | Using Spiritual Maps to Navigate Through Life
episodes.description: Mary Anne Prater, chair of the Department of Counseling Psychology and Special Education at Brigham Young University. "We have spiritual maps to help guide and direct us to our ultimate destination- back to our heavenly home."

episodes.title: E.J. Caffaro | Our Personal Game Plan
episodes.description: E.J. Caffaro, director of the Student Athletic Center at Brigham Young University. "Know what your personal game plan is for today and for your future. Incorporate these strategies into your lives and protect yourselves from the adversary."

episodes.title: Rae Jeanne Memmott | Learning Eternal Truths Through Our Relationships with Others
episodes.description: Rae Jeanne Memmott, associate professor of nursing at Brigham Young University. "I have come to realize that there isn’t much to do with the gospel that isn’t about relationships- either with Heavenly Father and the Savior or with our fellowmen."

episodes.title: Scott M. Ritter | "Come Ye, and Let Us Walk in the Light of the Lord"
episodes.description: Scott M. Ritter, chair of the Department of Geological Sciences at Brigham Young University. "Appreciate the blessings of this greater light and knowledge in our lives and understand the methods by which it has been, and continues to be, obtained."

episodes.title: Rodger Sorensen | Evidences of the Heart
episodes.description: Rodger Sorensen, Department Chair of Theatre and Media Arts at Brigham Young University. "We must learn the language of the Spirit for ourselves and find our own sacred places in which we personally come to know the things of God by [the Spirit]."

episodes.title: Craig H. Hart | Our Divine Nature and Life Decisions
episodes.description: Craig H. Hart, professor of human development in the School of Family Life at Brigham Young University. "There is an important spiritual dimension of our beings that cannot be probed by scientific means. Our [spirits] and biology are intertwined."

episodes.title: Fred E. Woods | The Soul of Kalaupapa
episodes.description: Fred E. Woods, professor of religious understanding at Brigham Young University. "In a world of religious varieties, the unconditional love and spirit of acceptance that exist on Kalaupapa stand as an example to us all."

episodes.title: Elder Robert R. Steuer | Just in Case Someone Asks, I Will Be Ready
episodes.description: Elder Robert R. Steuer of the Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Embracing key scriptures and doctrines can help us simplify and prepare for life’s important decisions.”

episodes.title: Bishop Richard C. Edgley | Faith, Hope, and You
episodes.description: Bishop Richard C. Edgley of the Presiding Bishopric of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "I would like to talk about how the powerful twin forces of faith and hope can affect your future. Hope [is] the result of exercising faith."

episodes.title: C. Terry Warner | An Education of the Whole Soul
episodes.description: C. Terry Warner, professor of philosophy at Brigham Young University. "God desires the flourishing of your whole soul for the glories He has in mind that is why He intends to bless you, if you will exert yourself, with a soul-stretching education."

episodes.title: Sarah Westerberg | Pastry, Chalk Circles, and Other Words to Live By: A Guide to Keeping Commitments
episodes.description: Sarah Westerberg, Associate Dean of Students at Brigham Young University. "As we ponder the wonder of His birth and life on earth, let us also review the commitments we have made and recommit to labor with greater zeal during the coming year."

episodes.title: Elder Bruce D. Porter | A Child Is Born
episodes.description: Elder Bruce Porter of the Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Whatever binds us, whatever sins, circumstances, or past events hold each of us captive, the Lord Jesus Christ, the great Immanuel, has come to set us free."

episodes.title: J. Matthew Shumway (1-20-09)
episodes.description: J. Matthew Shumway, professor of geography at Brigham Young University. "Our life's journey is intended to be difficult. Otherwise we would not be pure enough to return and live with our Father in Heaven and receive His eternal blessings."

episodes.title: Barbara Culatta (2-3-09)
episodes.description: Barbara Culatta, professor of education at Brigham Young University. "If we were to give others the benefit of the doubt by looking at their intentions, our lives would be much richer and we would be more tolerant."

episodes.title: Ronald A. Rasband (2-10-09)
episodes.description: Ronald A. Rasband of the Presidency of the Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Temples are houses of the Lord, where our Savior’s teachings are reaffirmed through sacred ordinances which unites families for all eternity."

episodes.title: Stephen J. Bahr (3-3-09)
episodes.description: Stephen J. Bahr, professor of sociology at Brigham Young University. "Our Savior wants us to succeed and will support us through our trials if we have the faith to follow Him and the counsel He has given through His prophets."

episodes.title: Jay E. Jensen (3-10-09)
episodes.description: Jay E. Jensen of the Presidency of the Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "I know that we will face both current and future storms successfully because of this rock which we build our lives, our faith, and our testimonies."

episodes.title: Carol Wilkinson (3-17-09)
episodes.description: Carol Wilkinson, professor of exercise sciences at Brigham Young University. "If trials haven't come into your life yet, rest assured that they will come to each of you at some point...another reason trials come is that they can help us develop."

episodes.title: David V. Dearden (3-31-09)
episodes.description: David V. Dearden, professor of chemistry and biochemistry at Brigham Young University. "It is fun to think about what science can teach us about the gospel in general and about agency in particular. For me, science is highly faith affirming."

episodes.title: Michael A. Jensen (5-5-09)
episodes.description: Michael A. Jensen, professor of electrical engineering at Brigham Young University. "We must identify those things currently keeping us from following the Savior as fully as we should and be willing to put those things on the altar of sacrifice."

episodes.title: Brett G. Scharffs (5-12-09)
episodes.description: Brett G. Scharffs, professor of law at Brigham Young University. "Faith, hope, and charity...are [foundational]. Each is a trait of character to be cultivated...a set of attitudes and beliefs to guide thought and action...a choice...a gift from God."

episodes.title: Steven C. Wheelwright (5-26-09)
episodes.description: Steven C. Wheelwright, President of Brigham Young University- Hawaii. "Following the Lord's process of decisions making results in consistently and powerfully righteous decisions. And that pattern of...decision making in turn develops our character."

episodes.title: Glenn L. Pace (1-11-05)
episodes.description: Glenn L. Pace delivers an address entitled "Your Work is Not Yet Finished."

episodes.title: Elder Gene R. Cook | The Love of God: Suffering Tribulation in the Redeemer's Name
episodes.description: Elder Gene R. Cook of the Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "[God] has blessed me with many wonderful days-more of those than of difficult days of suffering and despair."

episodes.title: Brad W. Farnsworth | Reflections of the BYU Experience
episodes.description: Brad W. Farnsworth, Administrative Vice President of Brigham Young University. "I didn't really appreciate what BYU offered until I had graduated and left the campus."

episodes.title: Thomas Sederberg (3-29-05)
episodes.description: Professor of Computer Science, Thomas W. Sederberg. "To ignore or violate the principle of faith will hamper our own progression and diminish our spiritual influence on others. The mastering of faith gives us joy."

episodes.title: Shirley R. Klein | Protect Our Homes, Renew Our Powers
episodes.description: Shirley R. Klein, Associate Professor of Family Life at Brigham Young University. "Our social fabric has been attacked around the edges, and now it is moving to the center—our homes! I'll use Moroni’s strategies of preparing places of security."

episodes.title: Van C. Gessel | The "Welding Link" of Culture
episodes.description: Van C. Gessel, Dean of the College of Humanities at Brigham Young University. "The more links you forge with your ancestors through their culture, the richer the legacy you will have to pass along to your own children and grandchildren."

episodes.title: Douglas M. Chabries | Talents
episodes.description: Douglas M. Chabries, professor of Electrical and Computer Engineering at Brigham Young University. "I would invite each of you to study and prepare your minds and then make a commitment to develop your talents."

episodes.title: Dana T. Griffen | Choices and Changes, Burdens and Blessings
episodes.description: Dana T. Griffen, Associate Dean of the College of Physical and Mathematical Sciences at Brigham Young University. "If we are to emulate the Savior, then our choices must repeatedly lead us to Christlike behavior.”

episodes.title: Hal B. Heaton | Truth
episodes.description: Hal B. Heaton, professor of Finance at Brigham Young University. "If you really understood that truth, you would sacrifice anything—everything—to achieve it. Understanding this truth is central to your purpose for being on the planet."

episodes.title: Lynn A. Mickelsen (6-28-05)
episodes.description: Lynn A. Mickelsen of the Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Growing up requires constant decision making. We must learn to be decisive, because indecision is no choice at all. If we fail to choose, we fail to act."

episodes.title: Arnold H. Green | Discernment for Journeying Through Babylon to Athens and Zion
episodes.description: Arnold H. Green, professor of History at Brigham Young University. "Discerning our journey through the world entails, first, choosing specific worthy destinations rather than just drifting somewhere."

episodes.title: Gordon B. Lindsay | "And Always Remember Him"
episodes.description: Gordon B. Lindsay, Associate Dean of the College of Health and Human Performance at Brigham Young University. "The Lord does not want some form of general, always-sort-of-in-the-back-of-the-mind kind of remembering."

episodes.title: Janielle Christensen (8-2-05)
episodes.description: Artistic Director of Brigham Young University Living Legends, Janielle Christensen. "Opportunities to serve are available to all of us if we will seek for them and have the faith and courage to accept them when they come."

episodes.title: R. J. Snow | "The Ends of the Earth Shall Inquire After Thy Name"
episodes.description: R. J. Snow, professor of Political Science at Brigham Young University. "The Lord’s firm assurance to the Prophet was laden with profound implications for the future of missionary work in the Church."

episodes.title: Timothy J. Powers (10-25-05)
episodes.description: Coach of the Brigham Young University's Men's Swim Team, Timothy J. Powers. "Constant effort yields perfection in a skill and a glimpse of the capacity our Heavenly Father has endowed us with. Trust and coachability are akin to faith and obedience."

episodes.title: K. Richard Young (11-1-05)
episodes.description: Dean of the David O. McKay School of Education, K. Richard Young. "Thus kindness is a test of the quality or genuineness of our character. Each act of kindness leaves a yellow or positive mark on our personal touchstone."

episodes.title: Carri P. Jenkins | A Solemn Obligation
episodes.description: Carri P. Jenkins, Assistant to the President for University Communications at Brigham Young University. "Each one of us has the ability and the obligation to testify and defend the work of the Lord.”

episodes.title: Heidi S. Swinton | Joseph Smith: Love of the Cause of Christ
episodes.description: Heidi S. Swinton, award-winning author, screenwriter and member of the Relief Society General Board.  "Joseph’s life was one of pure integrity to the cause of Christ, who he loved. He loved what the Lord loved. He lived the Lord’s way. It wasn't easy

episodes.title: Daniel E. Johnson | The Cycle of Becoming
episodes.description: Daniel E. Johnson, assistant dean in the College of Physical and Mathematical Science at Brigham Young University. "This cycle...is literally going on in some micro or miniature form every day of our lives. That's how we've become who we are today."

episodes.title: David Day | Lessons of Pride and Glory from the Doctrine and Covenants
episodes.description: David Day, music and dance librarian for the Harold B. Lee Library at Brigham Young University. "Pride is Satan's great counterfeit for glory."

episodes.title: C. Raymond Smith | Depending on the Lord: Gospel Insights from a Musician
episodes.description: C. Raymond Smith, professor of Music at Brigham Young University. "If we consecrate our preparations unto the Lord and leave the outcome in His hands, the outcome will always be a blessing to us. He can control the outcome much better than we can."

episodes.title: Lynette B. Erickson | Flags, Faith, and Finishing the Race
episodes.description: Lynette B. Erickson, associate professor of Teacher Education at Brigham Young University. "An important part of the race of life is that the Creator of the plan knows who we are and has given us the necessary...tools for [successful completion]."

episodes.title: Richard D. Draper | Light, Truth, and Grace: Three Interrelated Principles Necessary for Exaltation
episodes.description: Richard D. Draper, professor of Ancient Scripture at Brigham Young University. "When they accept grace by accepting the light, they are capacitated to receive truth. As they continue by giving grace...they are eventually glorified in truth."

episodes.title: Jeffry H. Larson | What Do You Expect?: A Key to Personal Happiness
episodes.description: Jeffry H. Larson, professor of Marriage and Family Therapy at Brigham Young University. "By being more aware and...realistic in our expectations and thoughts about life..., we can become happier than...by expecting life or others to change for us."

episodes.title: Curtis D. Lebaron | Face-to-Face Leadership: "As a Man Speaketh unto a Friend"
episodes.description: Curtis D. Lebaron, associate professor of organizational leadership and strategy in the Marriott School at Brigham Young University. "I want to talk about today...the private conversations whereby leaders change people and transform organizations."

episodes.title: Erin D. Maughn | Be Still, and Know God
episodes.description: Erin D. Maughan, assistant professor of Nursing at Brigham Young University. "Instead of stressing over [disappointments] or blaming others, sometimes it is best for 'be still,' become humble, and put your trust in God that all is well."

episodes.title: President Kim B. Clark | "Are Ye Stripped of Pride?"
episodes.description: Kim B. Clark, President of Brigham Young University- Idaho. "The message is clear: whether in prosperity or in adversity, if we are not diligent and faithful, even the elect of God...can fall prey to the Great Lie and become hard-hearted."

episodes.title: Susan Sessions Rugh | Our Journey into the Wilderness
episodes.description: Susan Sessions Rugh, associate dean of the College of Family, Home, and Social Sciences at Brigham Young University. "After our life's journey, we will be reunited with Him and our loved ones, and we can say: 'I am back. I am safe. I love you.'"

episodes.title: Elder Walter F. Gonzalez | A Brave Generation
episodes.description: Elder Walter F. Gonzalez of the Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "You may draw courage to defend the principles of righteousness from your faith in God and also from your love toward God and your fellow man."

episodes.title: Elder Jon M. Huntsman Sr. | God Did Not Put Us Here to Fail
episodes.description: Elder Jon M. Huntsman Sr., Area Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Our Heavenly Father expects the best from each of us. We must believe in ourselves. Don't give in when the going gets rough."

episodes.title: Bishop H. David Burton | These Are the Times
episodes.description: Bishop H. David Burton, Presiding Bishop of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "It is an awesome and exciting time to be alive because the fullness of the gospel of Jesus Christ has again been restored to the earth in our day."

episodes.title: Rollin H. Hotchkiss | God Loves You
episodes.description: Rollin H. Hotchkins, associate chair of the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering at Brigham Young University. "If Heavenly Father loves me and knows of me- since He is no respecter of persons- He loves you as well."

episodes.title: President Cheryl C. Lant | Hold Tight to the Iron Rod
episodes.description: President Cheryl C. Lant, General Primary President of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Be true to everything that you are and everything you can become It is so worth it... It will bring you full circle back to Him."

episodes.title: Richard B. Miller | Repentance and Forgiveness in Marriage
episodes.description: Richard B. Miller, professor in the School of Family Life at Brigham Young University. "Repentance includes striving to forsake our shortcomings and weaknesses... We endeavor to become better listeners and less judgmental."

episodes.title: Rosemary Thackeray | Strengthened by the Hand of the Lord
episodes.description: Rosemary Thackeray, associate professor in the Department of Health Science at Brigham Young University. "As we wait upon the Lord and prepare ourselves to be strengthened by the hand of the Lord, we will become the person [He] desires us to become."

episodes.title: Elder Spencer J. Condie | A Disposition to Do Good Continually
episodes.description: Elder Spencer J. Condie of the Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Your righteous thoughts and deeds will overcome any susceptible disposition to do evil...the Holy Spirit will be your constant companion."

episodes.title: Barbara A. Heise | Grow Toward Christ
episodes.description: Barbara A. Heise, professor in the College of Nursing at Brigham Young University. "We don't have to be perfect- after all we can do, the Savior does the rest... we choose to be changed, to be spiritually stronger, and to come closer to the Savior."

episodes.title: Elder Glenn L. Pace | The Divine Nature and Destiny of Women
episodes.description: Elder Glenn L. Pace of the Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "My associations... with the righteous women in my life have created a metamorphosis of my spirit and have been purifying and sanctifying."

episodes.title: C. Jeffrey Belliston | Gospel Gifts
episodes.description: C. Jeffrey Belliston, assistant university librarian for the Harold B. Lee Library at Brigham Young University. "The giving and receiving of gospel gifts are two separate actions...the true receipt of a gospel gift is manifested by keeping the gift."

episodes.title: Ross Spencer | Scholarship and Faith
episodes.description: Ross Spencer, chair of the Department of Physics and Astronomy at Brigham Young University. "The priesthood and science both help us live better in this complex world."

episodes.title: Steven C. Baugh | The Parable of the Cherry Tree: How to Enjoy the Constant Companionship of the Holy Ghost
episodes.description: Steven C. Baugh, professor of education at Brigham Young University. "Branches separated from their roots wither and die, but when they are connected, they receive nourishment, which brings abundant life."

episodes.title: W. Vincent Wilding | Tenacious Faith and Selfless Service
episodes.description: W. Vincent Wilding, professor of chemical engineering at Brigham Young University. "If we show tenacious faith and are prepared to lose ourselves in service, our Father in Heaven will prepare the way for us to accomplish all that He asks of us."

episodes.title: Jeffrey F. Ringer | Finding Sanctuary
episodes.description: Jeffrey F. Ringer, director of the Kennedy Center for International Studies at Brigham Young University. "We can find sanctuary...in the open, loving arms of a Father in Heaven and a Savior who love us both for who we are and who we may become."

episodes.title: Jeffery A. Thompson | What Is Your Calling in Life?
episodes.description: Jeffery A. Thompson, associate professor in the Romney Institute of Public Management at Brigham Young University. "The grace of Christ...is what will guide us to our callings and enable us to excel in them."

episodes.title: Marilyn W. Berrett | Earnest Prayer
episodes.description: "Marilyn W. Berrett, professor of dance at Brigham Young University. ""I know that God hears and answers our prayers, and I testify that the act of praying changes us... This gesture of humility and reverence does so much for the one kneeling.""

episodes.title: Steven L. Taylor | The Sure Foundation
episodes.description: Steven L. Taylor, assistant dean of the College of Life Sciences at Brigham Young University. "Our true desires, priorities, and aspirations guide our lives now and will determine our future possibilities...[Christ] is the sure foundation."

episodes.title: Richard E. Bennett | Martin Harris and Three Wise Men
episodes.description: Richard E. Bennett, professor in the Department of Church History and Doctrine at Brigham Young University. "I... have chosen to see the hand of the Lord not only in our history but also in... new understandings of His handiwork in the Restoration."

episodes.title: Paul B. Farnsworth | Avoiding Spiritual Drift
episodes.description: Paul B. Farnsworth, professor in the Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry at Brigham Young University. "The admonitions that we receive... can be viewed as reminders to regularly correct our courses by reference to divine standards."

episodes.title: David B. Paxman | Zoram and I: Getting Our Stories Straight
episodes.description: David B. Paxman, professor in the Department of English at Brigham Young University. "Zoram's life story is like all of ours. He could see God's providence or man's manipulation... his choice would influence his posterity far into the future."

episodes.title: Randal Day | The Sacred Matters
episodes.description: Randal Day, professor in the School of Family Life at Brigham Young University. “As we negotiate the challenging and dangerous paths of this life, we can draw on the power of the sacred, holy, divine, awe-inspiring, sanctified, and hallowed.”

episodes.title: Alton L. Thygerson | Saving Lives
episodes.description: Alton L. Thygerson, professor of health science at Brigham Young University. "Only Jesus can save us... To be saved by Jesus Christ means to be saved by the Atonement."

episodes.title: Russell C. Taylor | The Gardener of Gethsemane
episodes.description: Russell C. Taylor, department chair of the L. Tom Perry Special Collections. “If we are looking, we will see the caring hands of the Gardener of Gethsemane shaping our lives in ways we cannot now imagine.”

episodes.title: Claudio R. M. Costa (11-2-10)
episodes.description: Claudio R. M. Costa of the First Quorum of the Seventy of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. “I promise you that if you have faith in God, you will have the lighthouse of the gospel to help you and to bless your life.”

episodes.title: Cecilia M. Peek | “Yea, They May Forget, Yet Will I Not Forget Thee”
episodes.description: Cecilia M. Peek, associate professor of classics and ancient history in the Department of Humanities, Classics, and Comparative Literature at Brigham Young University. “I testify to you that you are His most important work.”

episodes.title: Elder Donald L. Hallstrom | The Heart and a Willing Mind
episodes.description: Elder Donald L. Hallstrom of the Seventy of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. “Both the heart and the mind must be fully engaged in this holy process.”

episodes.title: Elder Yoshihiko Kikuchi | How Do You Open Your Heart to Heaven?
episodes.description: Elder Yoshihiko Kikuchi of the Seventy of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. “When you hold a personal morning devotional every day, I promise you again that your life will be changed.”

episodes.title: Andrew S. Gibbons | The Skills of a Saint
episodes.description: Andrew S. Gibbons, graduate research assistant at Brigham Young University. “Skilled performance is a very important manifestation of human knowledge. It is a kind of knowledge that improves with use.”

episodes.title: Len B. Novilla | Journey of the Soul, Anchors of the Heart
episodes.description: Len B. Novilla, associate professor in the department of health science at Brigham Young University. “Throughout the uncertainties of life, only Christ and His love are constant. There is no more perfect example of love than the Atonement itself.”

episodes.title: Elder Christoffel Golden Jr. | To Know Thee, the Only True God
episodes.description: Elder Christoffel Golden Jr. of the Seventy of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. “Because of the Restoration and… a true and fuller understanding of mankind’s origin and destiny, we know that we are not predestined to anything.”

episodes.title: James C. Brau | Spiritual Thoughts in the Classroom
episodes.description: James C. Brau, professor of finance at Brigham Young University. "I have made it a point to share a spiritual thought in each section I teach every day I am in the classroom.”

episodes.title: President Russell T. Osguthorpe | What If Love Were Our Only Motive?Russell T. Osguthorpe | What If Love Were Our Only Motive?
episodes.description: President Russell T. Osguthorpe, Sunday School general president of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. “It’s important to remember that we should not try to judge another’s motives.”

episodes.title: James P. Porter | Receiving and Recognizing the Holy Ghost
episodes.description: James P. Porter, associate dean of the College of Life Sciences at Brigham Young University. “One of the most important skills we must learn in this life is to receive and recognize the quiet whisperings of the Spirit.”

episodes.title: Derek A. Marquis | “To Every Nation, Kindred, Tongue, and People”
episodes.description: Derek A. Marquis, managing director of BYU Broadcasting. “May we recognize a loving Heavenly Father’s hand in the miracles of the technologies around us and remember that He gave them to us to bless us and our families and to advance His purposes.”

episodes.title: Cory W. Leonard | By Persuasion, Longsuffering, Meekness, and Love
episodes.description: Cory W. Leonard, assistant director at the David M. Kennedy Center for International Studies at Brigham Young University. “Perhaps it is fear that limits much of our ability to listen, learn, persuade—and be persuaded—by others and by the Spirit.”

episodes.title: Ed Adams (5-10-11)
episodes.description: Ed Adams, dean of the College of Fine Arts and Communications. “My life was forever changed and set on a different trajectory, one other than where it could have headed.”

episodes.title: Parris K. Egbert | Confess the Lord’s Hand in All Things
episodes.description: Parris K. Egbert, chair of the computer science department at Brigham Young University. “As wonderful as modern technology is, it still pales in comparison to God’s power and ability. We get to view the wonders of the universe; He [creates] them.”

episodes.title: Larry L. Howell | Faith: An Essential Principle of the Gospel
episodes.description: Larry L. Howell, professor in the Department of Mechanical Engineering. “Eventually I will stand before the judgment bar of God. No one there is going to ask me what I did for a living… those things are going to be totally irrelevant.”

episodes.title: Val Jo Anderson | “Into the Burn!”
episodes.description: Val Jo Anderson, professor of plant and wildlife sciences at Brigham Young University. “Regardless of the trial or the setting, it is important to know in advance whom you trust and whom you will follow, even if it seems counterintuitive to you.”

episodes.title: Kent P. Jackson | Receiving
episodes.description: Kent P. Jackson, American scholar and professor of ancient scripture at Brigham Young University. “He stands at the door and knocks—sometimes in person and sometimes through the service of others.”

episodes.title: Brad Wilcox | His Grace Is Sufficient
episodes.description: Brad Wilcox of the Sunday School General Board of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. “Grace is not achieved somewhere down the road. It is received right here and right now. It is not a finishing touch; it is the Finisher’s touch.”

episodes.title: Douglas F. Prawitt | Line upon Line: Finding Joy in Progress
episodes.description: Douglas F. Prawitt, Professor of Accountancy. “May we openly and honestly acknowledge to ourselves and to God where we are in our own personal path of progress, wherever that may be.”

episodes.title: Janet B. Bradford | Carry On!
episodes.description: Janet B. Bradford, senior librarian at Brigham Young University’s Harold B. Lee Library. “No one else can do what you can do. Please do not compare yourselves to others. Rather, bloom where you’re planted!”

episodes.title: Elder Jay E. Jensen | Building upon the Rock
episodes.description: Elder Jay E. Jensen of the Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "I know that we will face both current and future storms successfully because of this rock which we build our lives, our faith, and our testimonies."

episodes.title: Ramona O. Hopkins | A Miracle in the Making: Finding the Meaning in Adversity
episodes.description: Ramona O. Hopkins, professor of psychology at Brigham Young University. “All of us will experience difficult challenges in life. How you deal with and overcome adversity is what is important.”

episodes.title: Gregory F. Burton | Lessons from Life’s Laboratory
episodes.description: Gregory F. Burton, chair of the Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry at Brigham Young University. “The experiences of my life… logically teach me of a loving Heavenly Father and Savior who are vitally interested in us.”

episodes.title: William G. Eggington | “Therefore Ye Are No More Strangers and Foreigners"
episodes.description: William G. Eggington, professor and chair of the Linguistics and English Language Department at Brigham Young University “...let me suggest that going into the world means righteously interacting closely and lovingly with all of God’s children.

episodes.title: Damon L. Bahr | The Unique Opportunities of Living at This Time in This Dispensation
episodes.description: Damon L. Bahr, associate professor of Religious Education. “We must stand with our arms open, ready to catch them, accepting the Lord’s invitation to ‘come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers [or catchers] of men.’”

episodes.title: Elder Tad R. Callister | Becoming Men and Women of Integrity
episodes.description: Elder Tad R. Callister of the Seventy of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. “When all the scaffolding is removed, it is our integrity that both defines us and identifies us.”

episodes.title: President Cecil O. & Sharon Samuelson | "Be Ye Therefore Perfect" // Building Your Bridges
episodes.description: President Cecil O. and Sister Sharon G. Samuelson, President of Brigham Young University and his wife. “One can be fully worthy in a gospel sense and yet still be growing while dealing with personal imperfections.”

episodes.title: Elder Neil L. Andersen | Honesty—The Heart of Spirituality
episodes.description: Elder Neil L. Andersen of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. “For a disciple of Christ, honesty is at the very heart of spirituality.”

episodes.title: President Thomas S. Monson | Be a Light to the World
episodes.description: President Thomas S. Monson, President of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. “As you keep the flame of testimony burning brightly, you will become a beacon of righteousness—even a light—for all to see.”

episodes.title: President Cecil O. & Sister Sharon G. Samuelson | Why We Appreciate BYU
episodes.description: President Cecil O. Samuelson, president of Brigham Young University, and his wife, Sister Sharon G. Samuelson. “We love the Spirit of the Y. We know this means different things to different people.”

episodes.title: President Julie B. Beck | Why We Are Organized into Quorums and Relief Societies
episodes.description: President Julie B. Beck, General Relief Society President. “There is much work a quorum must do as a quorum and much a Relief Society is to do as a circle of sisters, and there is much that is to be coordinated between them.”

episodes.title: Michael L. Dunn | The Miracle of Forgiveness
episodes.description: Michael L. Dunn, chair of the Department of Nutrition, Dietetics, and Food Science at Brigham Young University. “There is no superhuman feat or great thing that we must do to receive God’s forgiveness.”

episodes.title: Tom Fletcher (2-7-12)
episodes.description: Thomas H. Fletcher, director of the Advanced Combustion Engineering Research Center (ACERC). “It is my prayer that we can all strive to be great at what we do but good at who we are.”

episodes.title: Elder Patrick Kearon | Messages of Love
episodes.description: Elder Patrick Kearon of the Seventy of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. “His messages are often quiet, and we all know that we can miss them if we are not ready to receive.”

episodes.title: Dallan R. Moody | What Happens When Life Gets One Degree Colder?
episodes.description: Dallan R. Moody, associate athletic director of athletics at Brigham Young University. “Through our faith, courage, hope, and trust, God will bless us—no matter how cold our lives may feel. I know that God loves us.”

episodes.title: Elder Stanley G. Ellis | The Courage to Choose Wisely
episodes.description: Elder Stanley G. Ellis of the Seventy of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. “Choosing wisely is a critical part of His plan of happiness and an integral part of the test of our earth life.”

episodes.title: Amy Petersen Jensen | Some Hopeful Words on Media and Agency
episodes.description: Amy Petersen Jensen, associate dean in the College of Fine Arts and Communications at Brigham Young University. “The tools of technology that surround us are easily tasked to our benefit and refinement when they facilitate conversations.”

episodes.title: Thomas H. Morris | Time: A Precious Commodity; a Finite Resource
episodes.description: Thomas H. Morris, author and geologist. “I have found that on occasion it is healthy for me to step back and contemplate what I really want to gain from this life and the precious time that I have.”

episodes.title: John P. Hoffman | Prophet, Priest, and King
episodes.description: John P. Hoffman, professor in the Department of Sociology at Brigham Young University. “It is my desire that all of us may get to know the Savior better, including his roles as the perfect Prophet, Priest, and King.”

episodes.title: J. Michael Hunter | Small Things
episodes.description: J. Michael Hunter, chair of the Department of Religion and Family History at the Harold B. Lee Library at Brigham Young University. “There’s nothing negligible about the simple acts of kindness and assistance that you and I offer to those around us.”

episodes.title: Melissa Heath | Becoming More Teachable
episodes.description: Melissa Heath, associate professor of Counseling Psychology and Special Education at Brigham Young University. “When we are teachable, the Holy Ghost bears witness of truth and we increase in knowledge and wisdom.”

episodes.title: Stanley A. Johnson | The Simpleness of the Way
episodes.description: Stanley A. Johnson, teaching professor of Ancient Scripture at Brigham Young University. “If a prophet of God tells us we can look upon the brazen serpent and be healed, then we can look upon the brazen serpent and be healed.”

episodes.title: Douglas R. McKinlay | The Approachable Master
episodes.description: Douglas R. McKinlay, associate professor of Advertising in the Department of Communications at Brigham Young University. “I testify that as we boldly approach Him, our own personal performance becomes our own personal legacy.”

episodes.title: D. Gordon Smith | What’s in a Name?
episodes.description: D. Gordon Smith, associate dean at BYU’s J. Reuben Clark Law School. “I have sometimes thought of the experience of changing my name in relation to my baptism—an ordinance in which I took upon myself the name of Jesus Christ.”

episodes.title: Patricia Ravert | Persistence, Patience, and Posies
episodes.description: Patricia Ravert, dean of the College of Nursing at Brigham Young University. “I urge you to be persistent and persevere and exercise patience to find your plan and reach your goals.”

episodes.title: Donald W. Parry | Angels, Chariots, and the Lord of Hosts
episodes.description: Donald W. Parry, member of the International Team of Translators of the Dead Sea Scrolls. “Angels can move about the earth conducting the Lord’s divine work, and they serve, minister, and mingle among mortals, usually without our awareness.”

episodes.title: Elder Tad R. Callister | Our Identity and Our Destiny
episodes.description: Elder Tad R. Callister of the Seventy of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. “I testify there are no ordinary people, no ciphers, no zeros—only potential gods and goddesses in our midst.”

episodes.title: Cecil O. Samuelson | Character/ Sharon G. Samuelson | Beware the Dragons
episodes.description: President Cecil O. & Sister Sharon G. Samuelson of Brigham Young University. "Hold on to the iron rod...it is your only way to have sure footings as you make your way on the roadways of life."

episodes.title: Elder Steven E. Snow | Stepping-Stones and Stumbling Blocks
episodes.description: Elder Steven E. Snow of the Seventy of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. “You will avoid many stumbling blocks by living wise, obedient lives and by paying attention to the stepping-stones that will build your faith.”

episodes.title: T. Jeffrey Wilks | Optimism and Joy in the Gospel of Jesus Christ
episodes.description: T. Jeffrey Wilks, former director of the School of Accountancy at Brigham Young University. “Never give up. Do all things cheerfully that lie in your power, and then stand still with the assurance that God will help you.”

episodes.title: Ray L. Huntington | A Grateful Heart
episodes.description: Ray L. Huntington, professor of Ancient Scripture at Brigham Young University. “May we have hearts that can feel, ears that can hear, and eyes that can see our blessings and live in continual gratitude toward God and those around us.”

episodes.title: James R. Rasband | Faith to Forgive Grievous Harms: Accepting the Atonement as Restitution
episodes.description: James R. Rasband, dean of the J. Reuben Clark Law School at Brigham Young University. “...to have saving power—our faith in Christ and His Atonement must include both His power to pay for our sins and His power to pay for the sins of others.”

episodes.title: Paul V. Johnson | Free to Choose Liberty or Captivity
episodes.description: Paul V. Johnson, commissioner of the Church Educational System of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. “Individually we can be free from any power the adversary would like to have over us by living righteously.”

episodes.title: Nancy Wentworth | Our Eternal Education
episodes.description: Nancy Wentworth, Chair of the Department of Teacher Education at Brigham Young University. “Our eternal education begins with an understanding of where we have come from, why we are here, and where we are going after this life.”

episodes.title: Elder Bruce D. Porter | "Did You Think to Pray?"
episodes.description: Elder Bruce D. Porter of the Seventy of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. “I am deeply thankful for the gift of prayer, which is surely among the greatest of gifts given by our Father in Heaven to His children on earth.”

episodes.title: President Cecil O. & Sharon G. Samuelson | The Lord’s Hand in Our Lives
episodes.description: President Cecil O. Samuelson and Sharon G. Samuelson, president and his wife of Brigham Young University. "We know that God lives and loves us and will guide, correct, and direct us if we are willing to have Him do so."

episodes.title: President Elaine S. Dalton | Prophetic Priorities and Dedicated Disciples
episodes.description: President Elaine S. Dalton, Young Women general president of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. “You have been reserved to be here now on account of your exceeding faith in the premortal existence in our Heavenly Father’s plan.”

episodes.title: David Rolph Seely | Created in the “Image and Likeness of God”: Apprentices in the Master’s Workshop
episodes.description: David Rolph Seely, religion professor of Brigham Young University's Jerusalem Center. “As we help the Master with His masterpieces, we are engaged in His work and His glory: ‘the immortality and eternal life of man.’”

episodes.title: Janie Penfield | Live Your Life with Purpose
episodes.description: Janie Penfield, associate athletic director and senior woman administrator at Brigham Young University. “We can live our life with purpose—the purpose to gain eternal life and be counted as a disciple of Jesus Christ.”

episodes.title: Elder Donald L. Hallstrom | Living a Reverent Life
episodes.description: Elder Donald L. Hallstrom of the Seventy of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. “My aspiration is for each of us to want to live a more reverent life—a life reflective of our love for God the Eternal Father and Jesus Christ.”

episodes.title: Gordon E. Limb | Recognizing and Responding to the Promptings of the Spirit
episodes.description: Gordon E. Limb, director of the School of Social Work in the College of Family, Home, and Social Sciences at Brigham Young University. “As we learn to better recognize and respond to the promptings of the Spirit, we will find answers to our prayers”

episodes.title: President Rosemary M. Wixom | The Covenant Path
episodes.description: President Rosemary M. Wixom, Primary General President of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. “We are a making-and-keeping-covenants people, and nothing better shapes us than the sacred covenants we make to the Lord.”

episodes.title: James D. Gordon III | The Joy of Education and Lifelong Learning
episodes.description: James D. Gordon III, professor of Law at the J. Reuben Clark Law School. “If we do our best and seek Heavenly Father’s help, He will strengthen us beyond our natural abilities and help us to learn.”

episodes.title: Michelle Marchant | “My Life Is a Gift; My Life Has a Plan”
episodes.description: Michelle Marchant, associate professor in the Department of Counseling Psychology and Special Education at Brigham Young University. “The Lord knows you by name. He is so eager to share His infinite love with you.”

episodes.title: Ryan Holmes | The Truth of All Things
episodes.description: Ryan Holmes, director of digital media for BYU Broadcasting. “I am worried that the companionship we have with our smartphones is competing with the companionship of the Holy Ghost.”

episodes.title: Gary E. Arnoldson | The M&M’s of Missionary-Minded Members
episodes.description: Gary E. Arnoldson, controller for the McKay School of Education at Brigham Young University. “Missionary work is exactly what it is: hard, scary, consuming, exciting, fulfilling, and many other words.”

episodes.title: Larry Tucker | The Human Body: A Gift and a Responsibility
episodes.description: Larry Tucker, professor of health science at Brigham Young University. “Our bodies are sacred temples, worthy of special care and respect. Sacrifice is required to keep our temples in good condition. Do not give up.”

episodes.title: Kelly D. Patterson | Wandering and Wondering
episodes.description: Kelly D. Patterson, professor in the Department of Political Science at Brigham Young University. “We can creatively use the examples of wandering and wondering to blaze a reliable and exhilarating path back into the presence of our Heavenly Father.”

episodes.title: Brian Santiago | Safely on the Lord’s Side
episodes.description: Brian Santiago, senior associate athletic director at Brigham Young University. “Each one of us has the opportunity to join a winning team by being full of integrity, following the promptings of the Holy Ghost, and persevering.”

episodes.title: D. Kelly Ogden | The Miracle of Repentance
episodes.description: D. Kelly Ogden, professor emeritus of ancient scripture at Brigham Young University. “Whatever your past has been, your future is spotless, so tie yourself to your potential, not to your past.”

episodes.title: Tyler J. Jarvis | “That’s How the Light Gets In”
episodes.description: Tyler J. Jarvis, professor of mathematics at Brigham Young University. “The realities of living in our limited, imperfect world mean that we have no choice but to make do with an approximation—to admit and accept imperfection.”

episodes.title: Gary C. Barton | The Light Through the Dark Glass
episodes.description: Gary C. Barton, associate dean in the College of Fine Arts and Communications at Brigham Young University. “As we repent, are faithful…the path that leads us to the presence of our Heavenly Father will be illuminated.”

episodes.title: Curt Holman | Raising Your Ebenezer: A Monument to Remember
episodes.description: Curt Holman, associate professor in the Department of Dance at Brigham Young University. “We will raise our own Ebenezers—our own stones of remembrance—that will enable us to see God’s hand in our past.”

episodes.title: Kristin L. Matthews | The Worth of Souls Is Great
episodes.description: Kristin L. Matthews, associate professor of English and coordinator of the American Studies Program at Brigham Young University. “I hope you know that you are above and beyond those false measures of worth that we humans have created.”

episodes.title: Elder M. Russell Ballard | “Let Us Think Straight”
episodes.description: Elder M. Russell Ballard Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. “Sisters, your sphere of influence is a unique sphere—one that cannot be duplicated by men.”

episodes.title: President Cecil O. and Sharon G. Samuelson | Failure and Success // Shall I Laugh or Shall I Cry?
episodes.description: President Cecil O. Samuelson of Brigham Young University and wife Sharon G. Samuelson. “Personal growth comes from being stretched, and you will likely find yourselves challenged in ways you have never previously experienced or expected.”

episodes.title: Elder Lynn G. Robbins | “Avoid It”
episodes.description: Elder Lynn G. Robbins of the Seventy of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. “...one of life’s most helpful guiding principles: It is easier to avoid temptation than it is to resist temptation.”

episodes.title: Neal L. Cox | “And They Did Fellowship One with Another”
episodes.description: Neal L. Cox, associate dean of students at Brigham Young University. “I testify that this is true and rejoice in the many students who have discovered this emancipating principle of the gospel of Jesus Christ.”

episodes.title: Peggy H. Anderson | The Lord Desires Your Success
episodes.description: Peggy H. Anderson, professor in the College of Nursing at Brigham Young University. “He desires your success in all aspects of your life—in your profession, in your education, in your family, in your relationships. The Lord desires your success.”

episodes.title: Elder Ulisses Soares | Becoming a Work of Art
episodes.description: Elder Ulisses Soares of the Seventy of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. “It is possible to reject the temptations in our lives and develop the attributes of Christ—if and only if we hold onto the iron rod.”

episodes.title: C. Shane Reese | On the Measurements We Make in Life
episodes.description: C. Shane Reese, professor of statistics at Brigham Young University. “I pray that we will all be a little more fair in our measurements of ourselves and a little more patient in our measurements of others.”

episodes.title: Bishop Gérald Caussé | “For When I Am Weak, Then Am I Strong"
episodes.description: Bishop Gérald Caussé, Presiding Bishop of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. “You will have the ability to meet the challenges you will face in your life. With Paul you will be able to say, ‘For when I am weak, then am I strong.’”

episodes.title: Scott E. Ferrin | Christmas and Christ’s Invitation to Become as a Little Child: What Manner of Child Ought We to Be?
episodes.description: Scott E. Ferrin, professor and graduate coordinator in the Department of Educational Leader­ship and Foundations at Brigham Young University. “May we trust our Father and develop the childlike attributes Christ and our prophet exemplify.”

episodes.title: Cecil O. and Sharon G. Samuelson |  “Why We Do Some of the Things We Do
episodes.description: Cecil O. and Sharon G. Samuelson, president of Brigham Young University and his wife. “BYU is a great institution established by the Lord’s prophets to fulfill sacred purposes. It is prospered under the hand of heaven.”

episodes.title: Bishop Gary E. Stevenson | “Lean Not unto Thine Own Understanding”
episodes.description: Bishop Gary E. Stevenson, Presiding Bishop of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. “I have great expectations for each of you, as does the Lord.”

episodes.title: Jonathan G. Sandberg | Healing = Courage + Action + Grace
episodes.description: Jonathan G. Sandberg, professor in the School of Family Life at Brigham Young University. “Healing is much more than ‘getting better’ or ‘having our problems go away.’ Healing is growth, development, and maturation. In a word, healing is change.”

episodes.title: Elder Anthony D. Perkins | “Nevertheless I Went Forth”
episodes.description: Elder Anthony D. Perkins of the Seventy of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. “Be confident that the Savior will fulfill His promise to lead you along to an abundant life, even when the immediate path sometimes seems uncertain.”

episodes.title: Suzanne Julian | Led by the Spirit
episodes.description: Suzanne Julian, Instructio Coordinator for the Harold B. Lee Library of Brigham Young University. “Our faith and His love will help us succeed when the hard things we are asked to do seem impossible.”

episodes.title: Jane H. Lassetter | “Lead Me, Guide Me, Walk Beside Me”: Life Lessons with the Holy Ghost
episodes.description: Jane H. Lassetter, associate professor of nursing at Brigham Young University. “Live your life in a way that invites His presence and helps you sense His tender whispers.”

episodes.title: Elder Larry M. Gibson | Following Heavenly Father’s Plan
episodes.description: Elder Larry M. Gibson, 1st Counselor in the Young Men's General Presidency of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. “Heavenly Father believes in plans. He has a plan for the salvation of His children—a specific plan just for you.”

episodes.title: Chad W. Lewis (3-25-14)
episodes.description: Chad Lewis, associate athletic director of development. “People will love to hear your stories. Don’t be afraid to reach out and share them. Your stories did not just happen for you; they are meant to be shared.”

episodes.title: Lawrence C. Walters | Citizenship
episodes.description: Lawrence C. Walters, professor of public management at Brigham Young University. “Active engagement in the functioning of government and in addressing community concerns is an inherent responsibility of our citizenship and demands our best efforts.”

episodes.title: Steven M. Glover | “The Assurance of Things Hoped For”
episodes.description: Steven M. Glover, professor and associate dean of the BYU Marriott School of Management. “It is said that when we wish to communicate with God, we do so through prayer, and when God wishes to communicate with us, it is often through the scriptures.”

episodes.title: Trenton L. Hickman | Weaknesses Into Strength in Our Search for Knowledge
episodes.description: Trenton L. Hickman, associate professor of English at Brigham Young University. “The Spirit can also give me the knowledge and language that I need in unexpected, even extemporaneous, moments when I need to be wise beyond my own previous capacity.”

episodes.title: Brent E. Nelson | “I Know That He Loveth His Children . . .”
episodes.description: Brent E. Nelson, member in the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering at Brigham Young University. “The Lord has provided me some specific tender mercies over the years to give me comfort and at least partial answers to these questions.”

episodes.title: Alexander L. Baugh | Joseph Smith: Seer, Translator, Revelator, and Prophet
episodes.description: Alexander L. Baugh, professor of Church history and doctrine at Brigham Young University. “Joseph Smith’s life exemplified the role of what a prophet was, is, and should be.”

episodes.title: James L. Slaughter | The Blessings of Choice
episodes.description: James L. Slaughter, Chaplain of Brigham Young University. “I hope we can all be happy with who we are and who we are becoming. I like ‘me,’ and I hope to like myself even better as I become a better version of me.”

episodes.title: R. Bruce Money | The Lord’s Country and Kingdom—Your Passport
episodes.description: R. Bruce Money, professor of Marketing and International Business at Brigham Young University. “Do not ever let your passport to the Lord’s country and kingdom lapse. If you do, you will find yourself outside its borders.”

episodes.title: Sherri Patten Palmer | Convenient Service
episodes.description: Sherri Patten Palmer, associate teaching professor in the College of Nursing at Brigham Young University. “Even though there are material inequalities in the world, we all can have the righteous desire to serve.”

episodes.title: William B. Lund | For God So Loved You
episodes.description: William B. Lund, Associate University Librarian for Information Technology at Brigham Young University. “We aren’t specks in the universal expanse of God’s creations but individuals loved and cherished by God.”

episodes.title: Elder David A. Bednar (8-19-14)
episodes.description: David A. Bednar addresses BYU students with a speech titled "To Sweep the Earth as with a Flood."

episodes.title: Elder Dale G. Renlund | Constructing Spiritual Stability
