episodes.title: Brad P. Owens | Let Us Run with Patience the Race That Is Set Before Us
episodes.description: Brad P. Owens, Business Ethics professor, Marriot School of Business at Brigham Young University. "In a very real way, our lives are like an ultra-marathon that tests the limits of our spiritual endurance."

episodes.title: Kimberly O. Jenkins | Bring Healing Light into Your Life
episodes.description: Kimberly O. Jenkins, Communications Director, BYU College of Computational, Mathematical, and Physical Sciences. "It’s not always an instantaneous process to let light into our lives. It’s more of a process requiring effort and action."

episodes.title: Ellen S. Knell | Look for the Light
episodes.description: Ellen Knell, Associate Director at the Center for Language Studies at Brigham Young University. "We don’t always know where our experiences... will take us. Over time, we will detect a pattern and we will see God’s hand in our life."

episodes.title: Richard A. Gill | The Covenantal Journey of Disciple-Scholarship
episodes.description: Richard A. Gill, Dean of Undergraduate Education at Brigham Young University. "Being covenantal creates a unique type of acceptance and wonder along the voyage of discovery, inviting us to discover who God intends us to become."

episodes.title: Tonya H. Fischio | Illuminating Your Place in God's Masterpiece
episodes.description: Tonya H. Fischio, Assistant Dean of Communications at Brigham Young University. "If you invite the Spirit into all your life’s endeavors and seek to follow... the Holy Ghost, you will be right where you need to be right when you need to be."

episodes.title: Darron M. Billeter | Learn of Christ
episodes.description: Darron M. Billeter, associate professor of Marketing at Brigham Young University. "The gate that leads to His strength, His healing, and His guidance is wide open to us if we choose to learn of Him."

episodes.title: Elder Neil L. Andersen | Educating Our Righteous Desires
episodes.description: Elder Neil L. Andersen of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "As we educate our desires, we shape our lives in a way that will allow our desires to be realized."

episodes.title: President C. Shane Reese and Sister Wendy W. Reese | An Invitation to Become: Vision, Work, and Covenants  | The Power of Positivity
episodes.description: President C. Shane Reese of Brigham Young University and Sister Wendy Reese. "We won’t know how to become if we don’t first know what we want to become... who we may become. Having eyes to see ourselves as something more... is a gift worth seeking."

episodes.title: Elder Patrick Kearon | "Flecks of Gold"
episodes.description: Elder Patrick Kearon of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "As you look out, and as you look up, you become flecks of gold to an often troubled world. You rejoice in becoming flecks of gold. You build yourselves while you’re here."

episodes.title: Shima Baughman | Giving All Our Heart to Christ
episodes.description: Shima Baughman, Professor at the Brigham Young University Law School. "Whatever shame Satan is putting in your heart, remember that Jesus has conquered it."

episodes.title: Elder Takashi Wada | Journey to a Land of Promise—Obtaining Charity
episodes.description: Elder Takashi Wada, General Authority Seventy. "The blessings associated with the trials in our lives are to become closer to the Lord and to develop the characteristics of charity, even the pure love of Christ."

episodes.title: Elder Jörg Klebingat | The Atonement of Jesus Christ, Judgment Day, and You
episodes.description: Elder Jörg Klebingat, General Authority Seventy. "The Savior’s Atonement must not be cheap, instead, it should mean everything to us."

episodes.title: Sister Amy A. Wright | The Divine Pattern of Deliverance
episodes.description: Sister Amy A. Wright, First Counselor in the Primary General Presidency. "Instead of 'wishing for the day'—wishing and waiting and hoping for calmer waters—we would be wise to strengthen and fortify our anchors."

episodes.title: J. Ty Hopkins | Lessons on Endurance
episodes.description: J. Ty Hopkins, professor at Brigham Young University. "There will be rough terrain, blisters, and crashes; but there will also be a meadow of flowers... The process, not the product, will allow us to find joy on our way to the finish."

episodes.title: Elder Anthony D. Perkins | Becoming God's Peculiar Treasure
episodes.description: Elder Anthony D. Perkins, General Authority Seventy. "If we are not ashamed of Jesus Christ, then He will not be ashamed of us."

episodes.title: Sister J. Anette Dennis | Finding Peace Amidst Uncertainty
episodes.description: Sister J. Anette Dennis, First Counselor in the Relief Society General Presidency. "We have the Lord, the Spirit, and angels around us to bear us up. That includes you! There really is no limit to the Savior’s capacity to help you!"

episodes.title: President C. Shane Reese and Sister Wendy Reese | God Loves Underdogs // Connections
episodes.description: President C. Shane Reese of Brigham Young University and his wife Sister Wendy Reese. "God’s grace goes beyond improbable victories—God wins impossible victories."

episodes.title: Elder Gary E. Stevenson | Banners for Discipleship
episodes.description: Elder Gary E. Stevenson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Strive to make a meaningful contribution as you engage in new countries, communities, neighborhoods, and wards—wherever you may be."

episodes.title: Elder Kevin R. Duncan | Jesus Christ Is the Answer
episodes.description: Elder Kevin R. Duncan, General Authority Seventy. "Christ’s grace isn’t about us being perfect. It’s about trusting in and relying on Him when we’re at our lowest and letting His strength carry us through."

episodes.title: Elder Ricardo P. Giménez | My "Why" Is My Love for the Savior
episodes.description: Elder Ricardo P. Giménez, General Authority Seventy. "Seek to understand the reason 'why' you do what you do. Seek to find the connection between what you do to worship the Savior and your love for Him."

episodes.title: Elder Michael A. Dunn | These Foolish Things
episodes.description: Elder Michael A. Dunn, General Authority Seventy. "The very highest and Christlike ideals within us... are well worth clinging to and standing up for, even despite the ridicule and biting scorn of a very naysaying world."

episodes.title: Kalani Sitake | Discovering God's Plan for You
episodes.description: Kalani Sitake, head football coach at Brigham Young University. "Struggles in school mean you’re learning new skills. Being low on funds means you’re learning how to budget and will be thankful... God will provide. And good times are ahead."

episodes.title: Gabriel W. Reid | Go to Work and Build
episodes.description: Brother Gabriel W. Reid, Second Counselor in the Sunday School General Presidency of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "When you go to work and build, God builds you."

episodes.title: Teresa Bell | The Hand of God in Your Life
episodes.description: Teresa Bell, Faculty Member at Brigham Young University. "Every time you wonder what you should do with your life, study your patriarchal blessing. Every time you want to feel God’s love, read your patriarchal blessing."

episodes.title: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf | Joyfully Receive the Unexpected Messiah
episodes.description: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf, Member of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "If you wait for sorrow to end before you experience joy, you might miss joy completely."

episodes.title: Hal Boyd | A Bonfire of Faith
episodes.description: Hal Boyd Chief of Staff at Brigham Young University. "Christ calls to us to continue to hold fast to our spiritual mission, our sacred light."

episodes.title: Salani Lesā Pita | The Most Desirable Above All Things
episodes.description: Salani Lesā Pita, analyst in the Brigham Young University budget office. "Every time I act in faith on a prompting from the Lord, His purposes are accomplished."

episodes.title: Sarah Clark | Jesus Christ, The Master Teacher
episodes.description: Dean Sarah Clark from the Mckay school of education. "By picking up these stories again and again, we allow the Savior to help us rewrite them in ways that can make us whole."

episodes.title: Richard Houseman | BYU: A Place we can Go to Light, Be Filled with Light, and Share Light
episodes.description: Richard Houseman, Dean of Continuing Education. "Have the faith to go to Jesus Christ! His light is the most joyous influence in our lives when we make Him the most desirable influence in our lives."

episodes.title: William Clayton | Answering the Dual Calls for Academic Excellence and Discipleship
episodes.description: William Clayton, professor and associate dean at BYU law school. "When you are willing to work hard and your motivations are righteous, God can help you do more than you think you’re capable of."

episodes.title: Dawan Coombs | Working Through Wobble
episodes.description: Dawan Coombs, Associate Professor of English. "The Saviors Atonement fills the gaps in our path of where we are versus where we think we need to be."

episodes.title: Brennan Platt | We Chose This! Agency, Atonement, and Joy
episodes.description: Brennan Platt, a professor in the college of Home & Family Sciences. "We chose this. We shouted for joy! We knew it was right."

episodes.title: Sherami Jara | Fear Not, Little Flock
episodes.description: Sherami Jara, Assistant Dean of Humanities. "Faith is not the absence of sorrow, sadness, struggle or pain. They often coexist."

episodes.title: Amy Jex | Doin’ the Plan: Trusting in God’s Love and Help
episodes.description: Amy Jex, an associate professor in the Department of Dance. “In trusting in His plan, we can also grow to trust ourselves and our ability to choose wisely.”

episodes.title: Elder Gerrit W. Gong | An Ear to Wisdom, a Heart to Understanding
episodes.description: Elder Gerrit W. Gong of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Instead of our being held captive to old pasts, His Atonement can free us to new futures. Jesus Christ atones. He redeems. He restores not only what was, but what can be."

episodes.title: BYU Sesquicentennial Kickoff | Celebrating Gifts of Light
episodes.description: BYU's 150th year kicks off with a sesquicentennial devotional. “Together, we will hasten the fulfillment of the prophetic promises to become the Christ-centered, prophetically directed university of prophecy, 150 years in the making.”

episodes.title: President Shane Reese and Sister Wendy Reese | Lessons in Giving Gifts of Light/Becoming a Student of BYU
episodes.description: President Shane Reese and Sister Wendy Reese. "In dark times, Christ’s light brings peace and hope. Choose love over contention, share your gifts, and become a beacon of light to others."

episodes.title: Elder Ronald A. Rasband | The Family is Ordained of God
episodes.description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Decide that in spite of what happens or does not happen, you will not be distracted from your eternal goal."

episodes.title: Mike Roberts | Guided by Faith and Love
episodes.description: Mike Roberts, managing director of BYU Alumni and External Relations. "You are here for a divine purpose. You are in a place where people love you and want you to succeed.”

episodes.title: Elder Edward B. Rowe | Jesus Christ Is Our Rock and Covenants Are Our Anchors
episodes.description: Elder Edward B. Rowe, a general authority seventy. “It’s easy to look for confidence in all the wrong places. If our confidence is based on what we believe others think of us… it will be based on things we ultimately cannot fully control,”

episodes.title: Elder B. Corey Cuvelier | What Desirest Thou?
episodes.description: Elder B. Corey Cuvelier of the Quorum of the Seventy. “Any spiritual blessing or experience requires our active participation.”

episodes.title: President D. Todd Christofferson | The Condescension of Christ
episodes.description: President D. Todd Christofferson, second counselor in the First Presidency. "I invite you to reflect on the mortal life and mission of Jesus Christ to save you. And to reflect on your own condescension."

episodes.title: Elder John A. McCune | The Gift of Revelation
episodes.description: Elder John A. McCune of the Quorum of the Seventy. "As revelation from God is given efficiently, it is also given in an orderly manner."

episodes.title: President Shane Reese and Sister Wendy Reese | How to Follow Your Heavenly GPS / A Sense of Prophetic Urgency
episodes.description: President Shane Reese and Sister Wendy Reese. "Become something. Become a disciple."

episodes.title: Elder Matthew S. Holland | The Path and Power for Your Promised Land
episodes.description: Elder Matthew S. Holland of the Quorum of the Seventy. "Wildernesses are waystations, not destinations."

episodes.title: Elder Steven D. Shumway | Simplicity That Is in Christ
episodes.description: Elder Steven D. Shumway of the Quorum of the Seventy. "Learn to simplify. Sacrificing lesser endeavors and consecrating time each day to that which is essential."

episodes.title: President Dallin H. Oaks | Coming Closer to Jesus Christ
episodes.description: President Dallin H. Oaks, president of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Whatever those doubts, the way to overcome them is to get closer to our Savior Jesus Christ."

episodes.title: Elder Quentin L. Cook | Faith in Jesus Christ in the Information Age
episodes.description: Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "My challenge for you precious students is to choose truth when deception is easy."

episodes.title: Shayla Bott | Be Still and Know That I am God
episodes.description: Shayla Bott, Associate Dean of Fine Arts and Communications. "Slow down your body, slow down your life."

episodes.title: Sean R. Dixon | Everyday Disciples of Jesus Christ
episodes.description: Brother Sean R. Dixon, second counselor in the Young Men general presidency. “Many everyday disciples have gone before us. May we join their ranks!”

episodes.title: BYU 150 Easter Devotional
episodes.description: Speakers address the student body for an Easter celebration. “How could they imagine an empty tomb? How could anyone imagine that?”

episodes.title: Trevor Wilson
episodes.description: Trevor Wilson, a senior associate athletic director.  “Your capacity to learn at BYU is enhanced when you bind yourself to Heavenly Father, and His Son, Jesus Christ.”

episodes.title: Brian Radford | What are you becoming at BYU?
episodes.description: Brian Radford, information technology vice president and CES CIO. “You are part of something bigger than we often realize, and at an unprecedented time in the world and in the Church.”

episodes.title: Arlene Sewell | The Gift and Power of Your Light
episodes.description: Arlene P. Sewell, Portfolio Director of Artificial Intelligence. "No matter how advanced [the world] becomes, do not let it dim your light."

episodes.title: Elysa Dishman
episodes.description: Elysa M. Dishman, law professor at BYU. “A community that isolates its vulnerable members is itself in need of healing.”

episodes.title: Jennifer Brooks | That the works of God should be made manifest
episodes.description: Jennifer Brooks, professor of mathematics. “Blindness is symbolic of the inability to perceive or the refusal to acknowledge the works of God.”

episodes.title: Anton E. Bowden
episodes.description: Anton E. Bowden, Associate Chair of Mechanical Engineering at BYU. "By studying how our bodies work, we can learn a bit more about Him".

episodes.title: Bruce Brockbank | Share in the Light (7-14-26)
episodes.description: Bruce R. Brockbank Jr., Head Coach of the BYU Men's golf team. "The people you come to serve around often become some of life's greatest blessings."

episodes.title: Jeff Bednar | To Those Enduring Trials with No End
episodes.description: Jeffrey S. Bednar, Associate Professor of Management at BYU. "True disciples endure with Christ through every mortal storm, even those that may never cease in this life."

episodes.title: The Need for Greater Hope | Jamal Willis
episodes.description: Jamal Willis, Assistant Director of Student Wellness at BYU. "We must never forget who our greatest hope giver is, and that is our Savior Jesus Christ."

episodes.title: Rebecca Hunter | "What Kind of a Being Is God?" What, How, and Why We Worship
episodes.description: Rebecca K. Hunter, Associate teaching professor at BYU. "Undoubtedly, the most loving relationship we can have is the covenant relationship God has unfolded through His prophets.

episodes.title: Peace and Rest - Even Now | Elder Patrick Kearon
episodes.description: Elder Patrick Kearon of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "A truth I hope will sink deeply into your soul is that your best is certainly good enough."

episodes.title: In Appreciation of Friction: Embracing the Awkward/ "Ears to Hear" (9-8-26)
episodes.description: President Shane Reese and Sister Wendy Reese. "Our highest desire is for each of you to succeed on your journeys back to our heavenly home."

episodes.title: "Settle This In Your Hearts" | Elder Neil L. Andersen
episodes.description: Elder Neil L. Andersen of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Settle this in your heart, and walk the road less traveled toward the Savior."

episodes.title: Choose Christ | Elder Alexander Dushku
episodes.description: Elder Alexander Dushku of the Seventy. "Why choose Christ? Because He is real! He is the most real thing in this world. He is in all and through all things, the light and life of the whole world, and of your individual world and mine."

episodes.title: Rebekka Matheson | Presence in the Refiner's Fire
episodes.description: Rebekka Matheson, Associate Director of the BYU Neuroscience Center. "I have come to believe that it is our choice to be present— with our senses and our attention, with other people in their afflictions— that purifies our love into charity."

episodes.title: Bishop L. Todd Budge | Sacred Resources, Sacred Purposes: Caring for God's Children Around the World
episodes.description: L. Todd Budge, First Counselor in the Presiding Bishopric. "The Lord wants our hearts; He wants us to become “new creatures in Christ.” As we present our offerings with heartfelt love for Him, they sanctify us and draw us closer to Him."

episodes.title: Elder Ronald A. Rasband | "Hurrah for Israel!"
episodes.description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Nothing you do in your life will be more important than gaining and living your testimony of our Father in Heaven and His Son, our Lord and Savior."

episodes.title: Audrey Perry Martin | Undaunted in the World
episodes.description: Audrey Perry Martin, Assistant to the President and University Spokesperson. "My Personal appeal to each of us is to be IN the wolrd enough to contribute, and to be rooted in Christ enough to contribute in His way, as a peacemaker."

episodes.title: Elder Joni L. Koch | Spiritual Intelligence
episodes.description: Elder Joni L. Koch of the Seventy. "When obtained and maintained, spiritual intelligence will permeate every aspect of your life: personal, professional, social, and how you serve in the Church and community."

f5fbaddb-c450-4314-93c8-7220a031f52a.description: Family comes first at the Heartland Ranch. Watch 15 seasons for free.

episodes.title: Coming Home
episodes.description: Animal-loving Amy discovers a horse named Spartan being abused at Mallen's farm and convinces her mother to rescue him. But when a storm on the way home sends their truck and trailer off the road, Amy wakes up in the hospital at the center of tragedy

episodes.title: After the Storm
episodes.description: Lou sends home Mrs. Roach's horse, despite the fact that his fear of vehicles has yet to be cured. Val Stanton begins spreading rumors about Heartland and their skills without Marion. Ty's probation officer comes to the ranch while he is off showing

episodes.title: Breaking Free
episodes.description: Heartland has its first open house, and Lou invites their dad. Amy works with Lisa's horse Promise, and at the open house Val accuses Amy of giving Promise drugs. Meanwhile, Pegasus is depressed.

episodes.title: Taking Chances
episodes.description: A new guy, Ben, is staying at Heartland and wreaks havoc on Amy and Ty's relationship.

episodes.title: The Best Laid Plans
episodes.description: Lou drives friends and family to distraction as she arranges to have a video made to promote Heartland.

episodes.title: One Trick Pony
episodes.description: Lou's New York boyfriend Carl comes for a visit, but he has to adjust to the ranch's lifestyle.

episodes.title: Come What May
episodes.description: Heartland takes in a pregnant mare, Mallory gives Ty riding lessons, and Ben competes in a horse show.

episodes.title: Out of the Darkness
episodes.description: Amy tries to help a champion stallion and his trainer, who were injured. Mallory gives advice.

episodes.title: Ghost From the Past
episodes.description: After elderly Mrs. Bell has a heart attack, Amy takes in her pony, Sugarfoot, to whom Lou grows surprisingly attached. Ty's old girlfriend from the juvenile group home shows up looking for him, having taken a job at Briar Ridge.

episodes.title: Born to Run
episodes.description: Mallory discovers a crooked ranch-hand who plans to sell a herd of wild mustangs to a slaughterhouse.

episodes.title: Thicker Than Water
episodes.description: When Amy invites Tim up to the ranch, Lou tries to impress their estranged father, not wanting to admit to him her fear of horses. Jack escapes from the family reunion by going on a fishing trip with Lisa while Ty practices his cattle skills.

episodes.title: Rising From the Ashes
episodes.description: A sudden barn fire puts Heartland in financial straits, just as Lou was preparing to return to her old life in New York. Looking to expand neighboring ranch Briar Ridge, Val makes an offer to buy some of Jack's land.

episodes.title: Coming Together
episodes.description: Ashley Stanton reluctantly seeks Amy's aid with her horse Apollo when Ashley's domineering mother threatens to sell him. Meanwhile, Ty tries to share a pressing secret.

episodes.title: Ghost Horse
episodes.description: Amy's birthday party isn't the only surprise when she discovers that Ty has returned to Heartland.

episodes.title: Letting Go
episodes.description: A wild mustang forces Amy and Ty to examine their own issues.

episodes.title: Gift Horse
episodes.description: Amy is having a hard time keeping up with school, her chores, and her competitions on the show jumper Storm.

episodes.title: Dancing in the Dark
episodes.description: The simmering rivalry between Ty and Caleb for Amy's affections erupts and triggers a stampede.

episodes.title: Corporate Cowgirls
episodes.description: Lou pairs up with Tim to lead a group of young career women on an overnight trail ride.

episodes.title: Holding Fast
episodes.description: Amy devotes herself to working with a police horse that has been traumatized by an accident.

episodes.title: Sweetheart of the Rodeo
episodes.description: Amy backs Soraya in becoming the rodeo queen while helping to pull Ashley out of a downward spiral.

episodes.title: The Long Road Home
episodes.description: Scott and Tim join forces with the Flemmings to deal with a truckload of sick horses.

episodes.title: Cattle Call
episodes.description: Jack is upset when Tim hires Ty and Caleb to watch over his cattle.

episodes.title: True Enough
episodes.description: When Amy's teacher, Ms. Adams, brings a horse names Boxer to Heartland, Amy learns a lesson.

episodes.title: Starstruck
episodes.description: When Hollywood comes to Heartland, Amy is so starstruck she loses track of what's really important.

episodes.title: The Divorce Horse
episodes.description: Lisa meddles into Lou's business and personal life with disastrous results.

episodes.title: Seismic Shifts
episodes.description: Lou goes head to head with big Bedford Oil when seismic surveyors force their way onto Heartland.

episodes.title: Do or Die
episodes.description: Clint brings two tough kids on probation to Heartland, forcing Ty to deal with a part of his past.

episodes.title: Dark Horse
episodes.description: Lou resurrects the Hudson Derby, stirring up an age-old grudge between Jack and Tim.

episodes.title: The Ties that Bind
episodes.description: Once discovering that Spartan has been taken, Amy and Ty will stop at nothing to get him back.

episodes.title: Full Circle
episodes.description: Amy heads into the mountains to visit a horse healer and leaves with a new understanding.

episodes.title: Step by Step
episodes.description: Ty and Amy are finally forced to deal with their feelings for each other after being stranded.

episodes.title: Miracle
episodes.description: Amy is thrust into the limelight when she performs a “miracle” and a video of the event is posted.

episodes.title: Little Secrets
episodes.description: Amy is caught in the middle of a family crisis when she tries to help a girl after an accident.

episodes.title: Man's Best Friend
episodes.description: Jack's truck is getting old, forcing him to find the courage to say goodbye to part of his past.

episodes.title: The Haunting of Hanley Barn

episodes.title: Growing Pains
episodes.description: When Amy and Ty become parents of an orphaned foal, the strength of their relationship is tested.

episodes.description: Tim buys a racehorse from Lisa and puts everything on the line, including Amy, to win big.

episodes.title: Second Chances

episodes.title: Spin Out

episodes.description: Amy's gift with horses and her self-confidence are put to the test in a professional competition.

episodes.title: In the Cards

episodes.title: Homecoming

episodes.description: Amy and Ty convince the town hermit to let them treat her sick horse and face her own ghosts.

episodes.description: Amy realizes she must reclaim her "Miracle Girl" status and focus on her work with horses.

episodes.description: Jack is avoiding doctor's appointments while driving throughout the country with Ty.

episodes.title: Wrecking Ball
episodes.description: Maggie's being sold, and an impending doom hangs over Hudson. Buck Burger comes to town.

episodes.title: The Penny Drops
episodes.description: Mallory has to decide whether to become the manager of Maggie's or follow Jake to Paris.

episodes.title: Thread the Needle
episodes.description: Amy teams up with RMCP to help a rider and his horse become one.

episodes.title: Now or Never
episodes.description: Georgie has high hopes for becoming a trick rider.

episodes.title: Best Man
episodes.description: Ty's old friend comes to town and brings nothing but problems to Heartland.

episodes.title: Hotshot

episodes.title: Darkness and Light
episodes.description: As Amy struggles with her injuries, family members are pitted against each other.

episodes.title: Better Days

episodes.title: Walking Tall
episodes.description: Amy goes undercover to catch a Tennessee Walker's abusers.

episodes.title: Lost Highway
episodes.description: Jack's old flame reappears, and everyone thinks they should give it another chance.

episodes.title: Things We Lost

episodes.title: Smoke 'N' Mirrors
episodes.description: Tim buys a young horse and convinces Amy to train him so he can go back on the rodeo circuit.

episodes.title: On the Line
episodes.description: Amy contemplates a job offer from Prince Ahmed.

episodes.title: Be Careful What You Wish For
episodes.description: Jack and Lisa make a decision about their future, and Ahmed makes Amy an offer she can't refuse.

episodes.title: There and Back Again

episodes.title: Secrets and Lies

episodes.title: Walk a Mile

episodes.description: When a potential cull looms over a herd of wild horses, Jack and Amy go to an old friend's aid.

episodes.description: With the fate of the wild horses hanging in the balance, Amy and Ty find themselves drawing closer.

episodes.title: The Silent Partner

episodes.title: Broken Heartland
episodes.description: When Amy is invited to do a horse clinic in Montana, she and Ty decide to take a road trip together.

episodes.title: Riders on the Storm
episodes.description: Amy and Ty help Scott's nephew realize he can continue his family tradition of relay racing.

episodes.description: Georgie tries to find the strength she needs to deal with the news of her parents' separation.

episodes.title: All I Need Is You
