episodes.description: When one of Tim's team-building events turns competitive, Georgie gets stuck partnering with Jade's cocky rival. Meanwhile, Amy and Cass have a falling out over Ty's partnership at the vet clinic.

episodes.title: The Green-eyed Monster
episodes.description: When Amy helps a mounted archer reconnect with her horse, she also unravels the mystery behind Spartan's recent behavior.

episodes.title: Riding Shotgun
episodes.description: When Lou is given a horse, Amy helps her sister nurture a connection with the animal while Lou wrestles with the implications of the unexpected gift.

episodes.title: Here And Now
episodes.description: Fearing the worst, Jack is shocked to learn the reason for an old friend's unexpected visit.

episodes.title: A Horse With No Rider
episodes.description: An out-of-town horse clinic takes a dangerous turn for Amy, Tim, and Georgie.

episodes.title: Together and Apart
episodes.description: While Amy deals with a panicked horse trapped in a trailer, Georgie heads off on a desperate search for Tim. Meanwhile, Bob and Ty tackle a difficult surgery to save an endangered bear cub's life.

episodes.title: Change of Course
episodes.description: When Georgie unexpectedly struggles with a new challenge, Amy steps in to help her unearth the cause. Then, Amy's worst fears are realized when an eager Tim attends a pregnancy clinic with her.

episodes.title: Sound of Silence
episodes.description: After tragedy strikes, Amy and Georgie work together to help Tim's traumatized barrel-racing horse. Meanwhile, jack helps Tim, Casey, and the entire rodeo community pull through a devastating loss.

episodes.title: Home Sweet Home
episodes.description: When an unexpected guest arrives at Heartland, Amy and Jack question the real reason for the surprise visit. Meanwhile, Lou is upset to learn that her future plans with Mitch may be in jeopardy.

episodes.title: Written In the Stars
episodes.description: Jake's unexpected arrival at Heartland forces Mallory to admit to Amy and Jack the real reason she came back to Heartland. Meanwhile, Lou and Mitch struggle to find the right time to tell the family about their relationship.

episodes.title: Forest for the Trees
episodes.description: Amy struggles with the feeling that something is not right with Ty while she and Jack strive to help the ghost horse.

episodes.title: A long Shot
episodes.description: A secret from Jack's past threatens to change his relationship with the family forever. Meanwhile, Amy tries to uncover the connection between her new client and her reticent grandfather.

episodes.title: Dreamer
episodes.description: Amy and the family pull together as the gravely ill Ty returns home and is admitted to the hospital. And as Ty's health status continues to deteriorate, he faces an important choice.

episodes.title: Greater Expectations
episodes.description: Amy, Ty, and the entire Heartland family are thrilled to welcome a new member into the fold. Meanwhile, the ghost horse returns, and Amy disagrees with Georgie's plan to capture and gentle him.

episodes.title: Baby on Board
episodes.description: Ty struggles with control issues when his mom stops by for an unexpected visit.

episodes.title: Highs and Lows
episodes.description: The family bands together to support Georgie as she decides whether to face a ghost from her past.

episodes.title: Decision Time
episodes.description: Tim steps up Jade's training regimen when a fierce new competitor shows her up at practice.

episodes.title: How to Say Goodbye
episodes.description: Amy and Ty work together to prepare a wild horse for overseas transport.

episodes.title: Measuring Up
episodes.description: Lou returns from New York and finds that things are not running as smoothly as she would like.

episodes.title: Strange Bedfellows
episodes.description: Amy has to get creative when asked to work with Lisa's racehorse, but conflict arises.

episodes.title: Our Sons and Daughters
episodes.description: Amy tries to teach some old friends about the life-changing power of connecting to a horse.

episodes.title: Truth Be Told
episodes.description: Tim's erratic behavior sparks concern from his loved ones, so Jack gets suspicious.

episodes.title: Challenges
episodes.description: Amy tries to get everything at Heartland organized before joining Ty on a work-related journey.

episodes.title: A Fine Balance
episodes.description: Ty finds himself in a dangerous situation and Amy looks to unexpected guidance to save him.

episodes.title: Somewhere In Between
episodes.description: Tim is forced to open up when an emergency traps him with an unexpected visitor.

episodes.title: Out of the Shadow
episodes.description: Tim rallies the family to go on another memorial ride for Marion.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.description: The family struggles to deal with Tim’s news, and Lou throws herself into planning.

episodes.title: Past Imperfect
episodes.description: A threat from Ty’s past arrives in Hudson, putting the entire Heartland family in danger.

episodes.title: Strength of Bonds
episodes.description: As Thanksgiving approaches, Georgie convinces Amy to work with a high-strung and dangerous jumping horse.

episodes.title: A Place to Call Home
episodes.description: A training accident results in a serious injury.

episodes.title: Doubt
episodes.description: In the aftermath of a vicious viral video, Georgie reconsiders her future in show jumping.

episodes.title: Naming Day
episodes.description: The Heartland family members keep secrets from each other.

episodes.title: Dare to Dream
episodes.description: Amy and Ty face parenting problems, but healing a wild mare and her foal may help them.

episodes.title: Hearts Run Free
episodes.description: Amy and Ty plan a romantic trip to Pike River, but Jack tags along to visit an old friend.

episodes.title: Just Breathe
episodes.description: Ty is asked to mentor a troubled kid, but finding common ground proves harder than he expected.

episodes.title: Risk and Reward
episodes.description: Amy and Ty take Lyndy on her first camping trip, but things go awry when they find an injured animal along the way.

episodes.title: Change of Heart
episodes.description: Georgie enlists Wyatt’s help in reuniting a famous trick rider with her long-lost horse.

episodes.title: Diamond in the Rough
episodes.description: Amy and Ty disagree about how best to treat a horse.

episodes.title: Running Scared
episodes.description: Amy and Tim organize a team penning event for the family.

episodes.title: Stress Fractures
episodes.description: Lou returns to Heartland with an unconventional idea to attract guests to the dude ranch.

episodes.title: Long Road Back
episodes.description: Amy and Ty work together to treat a doped racehorse.

episodes.title: All Hearts Lead Home
episodes.description: After receiving tragic news, the family finds ways to cope with their grief.

episodes.title: Room to Grow
episodes.description: When Jack finds out Will Vernon’s wild horses are in danger, the family rallies to bring them home.

episodes.title: Snakes and Ladders
episodes.description: A disgruntled horse owner causes trouble for Ty and Amy’s business, leading to a disagreement about whether to take him on as a client.

episodes.title: Wild One
episodes.description: Amy is hired to gentle one of the wild horses, but its temperament may prove impossible to work with. Meanwhile, Georgie is dragged to a university open house by Peter and ends up face to face with Wyatt after months apart.

episodes.title: Rearview Mirror
episodes.description: Jack is faced with painful memories from his past, and the family is at a loss on how to help him. Meanwhile, Amy works with Jade’s new roping horse, who is displaying serious problems.

episodes.title: The Eye of the Storm
episodes.description: A dangerous windstorm wreaks havoc on Hudson. While taking refuge in Heartland’s old root cellar, Jack encounters mementos from his past that lead him to reveal a painful secret.

episodes.title: Fairytale
episodes.description: Amy and Ty worry about the impact a surprise visitor will have on Luke. Meanwhile, Georgie bonds with a client’s horse she’s caring for and tries to convince Amy to confront the horse’s owner about its wellbeing.

episodes.title: A Time to Remember
episodes.description: Georgie’s graduation has finally arrived, but so has a mysterious figure from her past. Meanwhile, Amy retrains one of Lisa’s racehorses as a jumper and learns more about Georgie’s surprise visitor in the process.

episodes.title: The Art of Trust
episodes.description: Amy is asked to spend time at an art retreat to work with an artist’s allegedly traumatized horse.

episodes.title: Legacy
episodes.description: Tim is roped into organizing an important rodeo when an old flame blows back into Hudson asking for his help. Then, put to task by Tim, Jack discovers the hardships faced by aging rodeo stars after retirement and decides to incite change.

episodes.title: Fight or Flight
episodes.description: Amy and Ty get some unexpected news about Luke just as Amy has to face an upsetting truth about Spartan. Meanwhile, as Ty deals with an influx of injured animals, Lou thinks she knows what’s causing the problem.

episodes.title: The Passing of the Torch
episodes.description: Faced with the fear of letting go, Amy throws herself into gentling a colt, but intense emotions threaten to cloud her judgement. Meanwhile, the reappearance of Ty’s spirit animal puts him on edge and leads to a life-threatening situation.

episodes.title: Keep Me In Your Heart
episodes.description: The past year has brought unexpected change to the Heartland family; Amy deals with a major upheaval in her life; Lou copes with the reality of being the mayor of Hudson; Georgie revisits her dream of the Olympics.

episodes.title: The Last Goodbye
episodes.description: Amy must face a difficult truth when her efforts to help a young girl form a connection with her new horse takes an unexpected turn; Lou faces harsh criticism as mayor; a cattle drive brings up difficult memories for Jack.

episodes.title: Making Amends
episodes.description: Amy grudgingly helps Ty's mother, Lily, with a traumatized racehorse; Lou gets into even more hot water when she tries to sell Hudson as a "must see" tourist destination.

episodes.title: Through the Smoke
episodes.description: Disaster strikes Hudson when a train derails and causes an explosion that threatens the town; a wild fire quickly spreads toward the rodeo grounds and, Amy rushes to save the abandoned horses there.

episodes.title: Outsiders
episodes.description: The wild, black stallion that Amy rehomed from Will's ranch is brutally forced out of the herd by the new leader; leaving Amy to track down the injured horse and nurse him back to health.

episodes.title: The New Normal
episodes.description: A group of wild horses need new homes; Amy must get back to her Miracle Girl roots and host her first horse clinic in over a year.

episodes.title: Courage
episodes.description: Tim seeks out help from an unlikely person when he finds himself competing in a polo match; Amy is concerned her daughter isn't adjusting well to her new reality; she makes a decision that worries Jack.

episodes.title: Changing Gears
episodes.description: Caleb finds a memento from the past that he thinks will have special meaning for Amy; surprisingly, it's Jack who has some mixed emotions stirred up by the gift.

episodes.title: Find Me in the Dark
episodes.description: Quinn's wealthy father arrives at Heartland with a life-changing proposition for both Amy and his son.

episodes.title: Staying the Course
episodes.description: Amy works with a challenging horse to help a friend of Clint's; she also revives a dream to rebuild the jumping course that she and Spartan practiced on so many years ago.

episodes.title: Moving Toward the Light
episodes.description: Amy must help a skeptical performer, and her pair of matched liberty horses work together again; Jack unexpectedly buys Mitch's herd of cattle; Tim returns from his trip with a surprise for everyone.

episodes.title: Runaway
episodes.description: A wild stallion escapes from Sam's ranch during a burglary and Amy will stop at nothing to find him; Lisa's latest business investment is at risk; Tim and Jessica adjust to life back at Heartland.

episodes.title: Bad Moon Rising
episodes.description: Amy discovers a teen with a gift for horses at Cooper's therapy center; Lou is pressured to shut the center down over recent break-ins; Lisa has Jack install a security system with Parker's help.

episodes.title: Sins of a Father
episodes.description: After a break-in at Heartland, unwelcome memories of his father flood Jack; Amy and Logan work with a wild horse; Tim and Parker form an unlikely duo to find the stolen goods.

episodes.title: Blood and Water
episodes.description: Amy and Shadow find themselves in jeopardy on a cattle drive; Lou feels overlooked when the issue of Heartland Beef's succession plan is raised; Parker and Katie babysit Lyndy and things go awry.

episodes.title: Happy Ever After
episodes.description: Tim and Jessica's attempt to throw a "small party" snowballs out of control; Lou struggles to hide a revived past relationship from the family; Amy and Logan continue to work with the wild horse.

episodes.title: Bluebird
episodes.description: The man who shot Ty returns to Hudson and Amy and the rest of the family grapple with how to react; Jessica enlists Katie and Parker's help to deal with a demanding Dude Ranch guest while Lou is away.

episodes.title: Brand New Day
episodes.description: Hudson hosts a lumberjack competition, and Amy must retrain a Clydesdale and his owner to compete in the draft horse race; Tim throws his hat in the ring; Lou tries to avoid a date with Fred Garland.

episodes.title: The Long Game
episodes.description: Amy enters Spartan into an endurance race after realizing he's not ready to retire; Jack is set on gentling an unbroke horse despite the danger; Lou and Katie reveal hidden feelings while camping.

episodes.title: Leaving a Legacy
episodes.description: Amy debates what to do when she receives money from an unexpected source; Lisa's racing plans are in jeopardy after an accident; Tim worries when Jessica is hiding something; Lou makes a big decision.

06d93297-b6fa-49f5-8cce-6bd555b563af.description: Host Stan Ellsworth makes American history come alive, one mile at a time.

episodes.title: The New World
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth traces the historical origins of freedom and independence back to the Renaissance and examines how these concepts inspired the creation of the New World colonies.

episodes.title: Seeds of Independence
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth travels to Mount Vernon and introduces a key player in the founding of the United States, George Washington.

episodes.title: Trigger of the Revolution
episodes.description: Stan Ellsworth tells the story of the daring pilgrims of the Plymouth colony and details how their experiences created the idea behind a government “for the people, by the people.”

episodes.title: The Die Has Now Been Cast
episodes.description: A trip to Lexington, Massachusetts has host Stan Ellsworth breaking down Paul Revere’s famous ride and examining the first hours of the Revolutionary War.

episodes.title: Miracle of Ticonderoga
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth shares how the events at Lexington and Concord inspire Ethan Allen and the Green Mountain Boys to unite with Benedict Arnold to take over Fort Ticonderoga.

episodes.title: We Hold These Truths to Be Self-Evident
episodes.description: The Continental Congress meets in Philadelphia to discuss the destiny of the new nation. Host Stan Ellsworth examines the critical moments leading up to the creation of the Declaration of Independence.

episodes.title: Miracle at New York
episodes.description: A tour of New York City has host Stan Ellsworth describe the critical role that New York plays in the Revolution. General William Howe challenges George Washington and prepares to launch an attack against the colonies.

episodes.title: The Crisis
episodes.description: Following Washington’s surrender in New York, Thomas Payne writes The Crisis and encourages the Continental Army to strike back. Host Stan Ellsworth shares the details behind Washington’s crossing of the Delaware river.

episodes.title: The Battle of Saratoga
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth analyzes the Battle of Saratoga, New York. Alexander Bryan is sent as a spy for General Horatio Gates as the Saratoga campaign looms on the horizon.

episodes.title: Refiner's Fire
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth visits Valley Forge and explains its importance in determining the course of the revolution. Stan emphasizes the importance of faith in George Washington’s success as a military leader.

episodes.title: The War Goes South
episodes.description: In Charleston, South Carolina, host Stan Ellsworth travels to Fort Moultrie to investigate the events that brought the Revolutionary War to the South.

episodes.title: Victory of the Common Man
episodes.description: At the Battle of Cowpens in South Carolina, General Daniel Morgan leads the patriots to victory by trapping the British troops in a complex double envelopment. Host Stan Ellsworth shares what makes this campaign his favorite in the Revolutionary War.

episodes.title: Patriots' Finest Hour
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth details the origins of the United States Navy and shares how an alliance with France guides the Patriots to victory.

episodes.title: We The People--A Miracle
episodes.description: Facing unrest after the revolution, the nation’s delegates meet at Independence Hall to draft the United States Constitution. Host Stan Ellsworth explores the ideas that made the Constitution possible.

episodes.title: Now What? Doubling Our Size
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth details the many challenges faced by George Washington during his tenure as the first president of the United States.

episodes.title: Into the Great Unknown
episodes.description: After making a deal with Napoleon Bonaparte, Thomas Jefferson expands the nation with the Louisiana Purchase and sends Lewis and Clark on their famous expedition.

episodes.title: Hanging On to What We've Got
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth breaks down the causes of the War of 1812. President James Madison is forced to act swiftly as the British troops invade Washington, D.C., while Andrew Jackson defends New Orleans.

episodes.title: Discovery Continues
episodes.description: Westward expansion creates icons like Daniel Boone and Johnny Appleseed as settlers venture into the American frontier.

episodes.title: The Mountain Men
episodes.description: The fur trade brings adventure, exploration, and greed to the American frontier. Mountain men like Jim Bridger connect the Eastern and Western United States through trade.

episodes.title: Rivers and Railroads
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth explains why the creation of canals and railroads made the American economy vastly successful in the early 19th century and tells the story of a momentous race that redefined transportation in America.

episodes.title: The Growing Stain of Slavery
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth visits the National Underground Railroad Freedom Center in Cincinnati, Ohio, to share the heroic stories of the Underground Railroad. Museum curator Dina Bailey explains the impact of the abolition movement in US history.

episodes.title: From Sea to Shining Sea
episodes.description: As American settlers move into the Texas territory, war breaks out with the historic Battle of the Alamo. Host Stan Ellsworth visits New Mexico to break down the causes of the Mexican American War.

episodes.title: Go West, Young Man
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth tracks each of the important pioneer movements from the Oregon Trail to the Mormon exodus. Through the stories of the pioneers, Stan emphasizes the significance of Manifest Destiny in American history.

episodes.title: Moving Forward
episodes.description: The Pony Express connects the country like never before with its short lived, yet revolutionary mail service. Stan Ellsworth shares the stories of the riders who braved the ten day trek across the country to deliver the mail.

episodes.title: Different Visions, Different Dreams
episodes.description: Different ideas about the nature of America’s government and economy separate the Northern and Southern states as the Industrial Revolution changes the character of the United States.

episodes.title: A House Divided
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth examines how a series of failed compromises between the Northern and Southern states, the Dred-Scott case, and the election of Abraham Lincoln ignite the Civil War.

episodes.title: Mr. Lincoln's War
episodes.description: After a tense election, President Abraham Lincoln becomes a pivotal figure in the Civil War. Host Stan Ellsworth shares the stories that shape Lincoln’s character and political career.

episodes.title: The Fires of Secession
episodes.description: Visits to Fort Sumter and Manassas National Battlefield Park has host Stan Ellsworth recount the first major battles of the Civil War. The First Battle of Bull Run illustrates how long and deadly the Civil War will be.

episodes.title: From the Jaws of Victory (They Snatched Defeat)
episodes.description: New technology like armored battleships alter how the Civil War is fought. Host Stan Ellsworth describes the importance of naval blockades in the Union’s strategy.

episodes.title: The Cost of Freedom
episodes.description: The Civil War proves to be more costly than expected as new artillery hits the scene. Host Stan Ellsworth visits the site of Second Manassas where the Union army faces defeat.

episodes.title: Changing of the Guard: Lee and Grant
episodes.description: Learn about the genius of General Robert E. Lee, the last great warrior of the Napoleonic age, and discover what made General Grant the first warrior of a new era.

episodes.title: Gettysburg
episodes.description: The Battle of Gettysburg changes the course of the war as the Union Army prevails and the Confederates face considerable defeat. Stan examines the strategies of both sides during this pivotal battle at Gettysburg.

episodes.title: Price of Honor
episodes.description: Campaigns during the summer of 1863 give the Union Army the upper hand. Stan shares the story of the 54th Massachusetts, the all-black infantry regiment who led the assault on Fort Wagner in South Carolina.

episodes.title: March to the Sea
episodes.description: General William Sherman advances the Union Army for Savannah, destroying the Confederate economy along the way. Host Stan Ellsworth travels to Georgia to follow the course of Sherman’s crusade.

episodes.title: On to Richmond
episodes.description: Generals Ulysses S. Grant and Robert E. Lee face-off in a series of battles during the Overland Campaign of 1864. Host Stan Ellsworth shares how the strategy of a young Union soldier wins the entire war for General Grant.

episodes.title: Lost Cause
episodes.description: After a devastating failure at the Battle of the Crater, General Ulysses S. Grant leads the Union Army to victory in the Siege of Petersburg.

episodes.title: Brothers Again
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth travels to Appomattox where General Lee surrenders to General Grant. After years of conflict and destruction, the Civil War comes to an end.

episodes.title: The Rest of the Story
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth shares what happened to Civil War icons like Robert E. Lee and George McClellan after the South’s surrender.

episodes.title: Legacy of Lincoln
episodes.description: Days after the Civil War ends, President Abraham Lincoln is assassinated by John Wilkes Booth. Host Stan Ellsworth visits the site of the assassination to explore the events that led to that fateful night.

episodes.title: Dust in the Wind
episodes.description: Following Lincoln’s death, tensions between the North and South run high as plans for Reconstruction are underway. Stan shares stories of the Bushwhackers and the Jayhawkers of the Wild West.

episodes.title: Rails, Trails, and Boomtowns
episodes.description: The transcontinental railroad connects the country like never before, as rumors of gold bring thousands out West.

episodes.title: Wanderers, Vagabonds, Drifters, and Saddletramps
episodes.description: Stan travels to Texas to share the true story of the American cowboy and the important role the beef industry has in the post-war economy.

episodes.title: Bad Company
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth shares the stories of American icons like Clay Allison, John Wesley Hardin, and Calamity Jane who put the “wild” in the Wild West.

episodes.title: Order from Chaos
episodes.description: As crime runs rampant in the Wild West, lawmen like Bat Masterson and Wild Bill Hickok bring order to the chaos.

episodes.title: Lookin' Fer Trouble
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth shares stories of some of the Wild West’s most iconic and infamous outlaws, gunfights and crime sprees.

episodes.title: The Earps
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth travels to Dodge City, Kansas, to visit the site where Western legend Wyatt Earp’s story began.

episodes.title: How the West Was Lost--Part 1
episodes.description: While the prospect of great success brings settlers to the American frontier, the Lakota Nation fights to keep their land and their culture alive. Host Stan Ellsworth details the challenges the Lakota leaders face during this era.

episodes.title: How the West Was Lost--Part 2
episodes.description: Stan follows the trail of the Nez Perce, recounting the heroic tale of their leader Chief Joseph in his fight to protect their land from invading settlers.

episodes.title: Range Wars
episodes.description: Disputes over land between cattle barons and incoming settlers ignite a series of range wars across the Western states. Stan visits the sites of these conflicts to discover how the beef industry became bloody.

episodes.title: The Barbary Coast: End of An Era
episodes.description: Stan shares the stories of entrepreneurs like Leland Stanford and George Hearst who found great success in California and developed it into the great state it is today.

episodes.title: The Last Round-Up
episodes.description: The age of the Wild West comes to an end as new technology outsmarts famous crime gangs. Host Stan Ellsworth recounts the final days of America’s legendary outlaws.

episodes.title: The Romance and Mystique of the American West
episodes.description: Tall tales, dime novels, stage shows, and early motion pictures immortalize the days of the Wild West. Host Stan Ellsworth tracks the history of these stories as they become forever associated with the American identity.

episodes.title: Time for a Change
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth ushers in the Gilded Age by introducing the key political players of the late 19th century of Chester A. Arthur and Grover Cleveland.

episodes.title: Immigrant Song
episodes.description: During the Gilded Age, immigrants from China, Ireland, Italy, and Mexico pour into America seeking a fresh start, opportunity and success.

episodes.title: Age of Genius
episodes.description: Inventors like Thomas Edison and Nikola Tesla use their inventions to reinvent modern life during the Gilded Age. Stan shares the stories of these pioneers and how their contributions to technology changed the world.

episodes.title: Captains of Industry
episodes.description: Titans of the Industrial Revolution like Andrew Carnegie, John D. Rockefeller, and Cornelius Vanderbilt find massive economic success in the early 20th century. Stan shares how these men transformed the nature of American industry.

episodes.title: Civil Rights, Civil Wrongs
episodes.description: As industry and commerce boom during the Gilded Age, civil rights movements emerge to protect the rights of workers, women, and African Americans. Stan explores the events that inspire these social awakenings across the country.

episodes.title: Remember The Maine!
episodes.description: The Spanish-American War begins as control over the Philippines and Cuba is contested. Host Stan Ellsworth examines how the influence of yellow journalism fans the flames of the war.

episodes.title: Bull Moose and His Big Stick
episodes.description: Stan recounts the life and legacy of Theodore Roosevelt and describes how his achievements as president made America a global superpower.

episodes.title: The Gathering Darkness
episodes.description: President Woodrow Wilson ushers in a new age of American politics with multiple pioneering policies. Host Stan Ellsworth describes President Wilson’s struggle to remain neutral as war ignites in Europe.

episodes.title: Over There
episodes.description: Stan travels to France to examine the events that brought the United States into World War I where trench warfare and new technologies prove to be costly to the Allied forces.

episodes.title: The War to End All Wars
episodes.description: Stan travels to France to share the story of the Meuse–Argonne offensive led by Sergeant Alvin York. The results of the offensive push the Central powers to an armistice and lead to the creation of the Treaty of Versailles.

episodes.title: The Roaring '20s
episodes.description: An industrial boom after the Great War ushers in an era of excess as Broadway, Hollywood, and baseball provide the average American with new forms of entertainment.

episodes.title: End of a Dream
episodes.description: The Roaring ‘20s come to a screeching halt as the stock market crash of 1929 devastates the American economy. Professor of Economics Larry T. Wimmer breaks down how certain economic practices led to this infamous era.

episodes.title: To Notre Dame
episodes.description: In this special edition of American Ride, host Stan Ellsworth travels to South Bend, Indiana, to share the history of the University of Notre Dame.

episodes.title: FDR
episodes.description: After years of economic turmoil, President Franklin D. Roosevelt offers America a new hope. Stan breaks down Roosevelt’s innovative strategies that helped heal the nation.

episodes.title: Day of Infamy
episodes.description: The United States is thrust into World War II following the attack on Pearl Harbor. Stan travels to Pearl Harbor to honor the fallen and introduce the factors that led to the “Day of Infamy.”

episodes.title: The Giant Arises
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth details the boom of American industry as World War II creates new demands overseas. At home, patriotism runs high as women join the workforce to support the war effort.

episodes.title: Bloodied but Unbowed
episodes.description: Stan highlights the impact of the Battle of Midway as it changes the tides of the war while innovative naval strategies give the United States an advantage in their defense against Japan.

episodes.title: Wolf Pack/Shadow War
episodes.description: U-boats, espionage, and propaganda campaigns create new challenges for the United States as World War II rages on.

episodes.title: Sacred Honor
episodes.description: Following the attack on Pearl Harbor, American suspicion and prejudice increases, leading President Franklin D. Roosevelt to authorize the creation of internment camps for Japanese American citizens.

episodes.title: Terrible Swift Sword
episodes.description: Stan introduces the important military leaders of the United States’ war efforts–Generals George C. Marshall, Dwight D. Eisenhower, and George S. Patton–and shares their stories of success on behalf of the Allied forces.

episodes.title: Overlord
episodes.description: Stan travels to the beaches of Normandy to visit the site of the famous WWII offensive Operation Neptune and shares the Allies’ strategy to liberate France.

episodes.title: Across the Pacific
episodes.description: Operation Cartwheel unfolds in the Pacific Theater with a series of costly battles. Host Stan Ellsworth visits the Pacific to detail the United States’ operations during its arduous campaign against the Japanese Empire.

episodes.title: On to Victory
episodes.description: The outcome of the Battle of the Bulge paves the way for an Allied victory against Nazi Germany. Stan details the roles of General Patton and President Roosevelt in bringing the war to an end.

episodes.title: Uncommon Valor
episodes.description: As V-Day is celebrated across the globe, the conflict in the Pacific Theater rages on. The United States gains new ground in a series of campaigns against the Japanese Empire.

episodes.title: Cost of Victory
episodes.description: The dropping of atomic bombs in Japan and the horrors of the Holocaust take a massive toll on human life across the globe. Host Stan Ellsworth traces the origins of both events and honors the legacies of the lives lost.

episodes.title: Sand, Surf, and Celebration: Miami
episodes.description: Stan travels to Miami to discover the history of a colorful city full of adventure and rich Latin American heritage.

episodes.title: Southern Belles: Charleston and Savannah
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth explores two of the biggest cities in the South–Savannah, Georgia and Charleston, South Carolina–and highlights their beautiful scenery and haunted pasts.

episodes.title: Smoky Mountains
episodes.description: A trip through the Appalachian Mountains finds host Stan Ellsworth learning the history of bluegrass music and discovering the beauty of the Great Smoky Mountains National Park.

episodes.title: Land of the Conquistadores: La Florida
episodes.description: Stan travels to Florida, a land of mystery and adventure with a rich history that dates back to the early 16th century. As he adventures down the A1A, Stan explores the wildlife, tourism, and industry that populates the Florida coast today.

episodes.title: Legends and Legacy--Part 1: American Pirates
episodes.description: Stan’s visit to North Carolina has him track down the story of one of the most popular icons in American history, the pirate Blackbeard.

episodes.title: Liberty: The Hope of Every Human Heart
episodes.description: Stan tours Washington D.C. and explores numerous memorials, monuments, and museums that honor the Founding Fathers and our nation’s history.

episodes.title: Baltimore: The Star-Spangled City
episodes.description: Stan travels to Baltimore, Maryland to discover the history, icons, and cuisine that make up the “Charm City.”

episodes.title: Pennsylvania: Home of Religious Tolerance
episodes.description: Philadelphia enters the spotlight as Host Stan Ellsworth explores the important movements that made it a haven for political and religious freedom.

episodes.title: Legends and Legacy: The Salem Witch Trials
episodes.description: The Salem Witch Trials leave a dark stain on Massachusetts' history. Stan Ellsworth meets with Stacy Tilney, director of communications at the Salem Witch Museum to trace the events that led to a fateful era full of hysteria and injustice.

episodes.title: Nantucket: Children of the Sea
episodes.description: Nantucket, Massachusetts becomes the whaling capital of the world in the 19th century. Host Stan Ellsworth explores the island and learns more about the whaling industry at the Nantucket Whalers Museum.

episodes.title: Atlanta: City of Dreams
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth travels to Atlanta, Georgia to visit the important sites that inspired Civil Rights leader Martin Luther King Jr.

episodes.title: Kentucky Thunder
episodes.description: Stan travels to the famous Kentucky Horse Park to learn about Kentucky’s history as the horse capital of the world.

episodes.title: Music City
episodes.description: Stan swings through Nashville, Tennessee to learn about the icons and events that earned it the title of “Music City.”

episodes.title: Ol' Man River
episodes.description: Memphis, Tennessee is a hub of commerce, culture, and cuisine along the Mississippi River. Host Stan Ellsworth learns about the impact of the Mississippi River, the cotton industry, and blues music on Memphis’ history.

episodes.title: California Dreamin'
episodes.description: Along the Pacific Coast, Stan visits multiple California towns that were the homes of some of the greatest artists of the 20th century.

episodes.title: City by the Bay
episodes.description: Stan makes his way to San Francisco and reflects on its rich history as a hub of 19th century immigration, shares stories of its famous landmarks and sports icons, and tells of its resilience after the tragic earthquake of 1906.

episodes.title: Redwoods
episodes.description: Further up the Pacific Coast, Host Stan Ellsworth marvels at the majesty and history of the Redwood Forest.

episodes.title: The Emerald City
episodes.description: Once a capital of the lumber industry, Seattle has become a center of innovation. Stan traces the history of the city and finds how the aviation and technology industries brought success to the Pacific Coast.

episodes.title: The North West Passage
episodes.description: Stan explores the San Juan Islands, home to some of the richest biodiversity in the country and the site of the Pig War of 1859.

episodes.title: Legacy of Liberty
episodes.description: Stan tours the many historical sites of Boston, Massachusetts and details how the city’s history has created a lasting impact on its citizens.

episodes.title: Sons of the South
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth travels to Williamsburg, Virginia to study how the contributions of overlooked patriots Patrick Henry and Richard Henry Lee paved the way to American Independence.

episodes.title: Storm Bringers
episodes.description: In Boston, Massachusetts four members of the Sons of Liberty fan the flames of the Revolution. Stan shares the stories of Founding Fathers Samuel Adams, John Hancock, Paul Revere, and Joseph Warren as he tours the great city.

episodes.title: Sage of the Age:  Dr. Benjamin Franklin
episodes.description: A journey to Philadelphia has host Stan Ellsworth recounting the life of Founding Father Benjamin Franklin.

episodes.title: The Indispensable Man: George Washington
episodes.description: Stan discovers the true history of George Washington and details his humble beginnings in West Virginia and his tenure as the first President of the United States.

episodes.title: The Eagle & Dove: Adams & Jefferson--Part 1
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth spotlights two of the most prominent Founding Fathers, John Adams and Thomas Jefferson, and recounts what inspired them to lead the fight for American Independence.

episodes.title: Friends, Foes & Friends Again: Adams & Jefferson—Part 2
episodes.description: Thomas Jefferson and John Adams face off in the contentious election of 1800. Stan visits the Massachusetts Historical Society to learn of the events that drew these Founding Fathers apart.

episodes.title: The Federalist: Alexander Hamilton
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth recounts the life of Alexander Hamilton, an unsung Founding Father, pioneering patriot, and George Washington’s right-hand man.

episodes.title: The Architect of American Government: James Madison
episodes.description: Stan travels across Virginia and Pennsylvania to discover the contributions of James Madison as a framer, founder, and president of the United States.

episodes.title: The Last Cocked Hat: James Monroe
episodes.description: One of the least known Founding Fathers James Monroe rises through the ranks and becomes the fifth President of the United States. Host Stan Ellsworth travels through Virginia to trace the pivotal events in Monroe’s life.

episodes.title: Ladies of Liberty
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth highlights the contributions of Martha Washington and Abigail Adams during their years as First Lady of the United States.

episodes.title: JQA
episodes.description: John Quincy Adams wins the election of 1824, causing a rift between the two political parties of the time. Host Stan Ellsworth visits historical sites from Adams’ life to study the events that shaped the sixth President of the United States.

episodes.title: Old Hickory and Jacksonian Democracy (1829-1837)
episodes.description: A trip to Tennessee has host Stan Ellsworth recounting the life and legacy of the seventh President of the United States, Andrew Jackson.

episodes.title: Times of Turmoil: Van Buren, Harrison and Tyler
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth visits the homelands of presidents Martin Van Buren, William Henry Harrison, and John Tyler to share stories of their time in office.

episodes.title: The Alamo
episodes.description: Across Texas, host Stan Ellsworth explores the rich history of the Lone Star State, from the Battle of the Alamo to the Texas Revolution.

episodes.title: James K. Polk: A Man On A Mission
episodes.description: President James K. Polk expands the country further west, bringing economic success and tense political conflicts to the nation. Host Stan Ellsworth visits the important sites in Polk’s life to recount the major events of his presidency.

episodes.title: A Time of Compromise: Zachary Taylor and Millard Fillmore
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth examines the impact of westward expansion and the question of slavery on the presidencies of Zachary Taylor and Millard Fillmore.

episodes.title: Times Of Trouble: Franklin Pierce & James Buchanan
episodes.description: Franklin Pierce and James Buchanan enter the spotlight as host Stan Ellsworth studies how divisive actions of their presidencies drove the Union apart.

episodes.title: A Time of Crisis: Abraham Lincoln and the Case for Union
episodes.description: Host Stan Ellsworth commemorates the presidency of Abraham Lincoln and visits the Gettysburg National Cemetery to honor the site of his famous Gettysburg Address.

episodes.title: Triumph and Tragedy: Andrew Johnson and Reconstruction
episodes.description: Stan travels to Tennessee to uncover the true story of one of the nation’s most misunderstood presidents, Andrew Johnson.

episodes.title: The Enforcer of Federalism: Ulysses S. Grant
episodes.description: President Ulysses S. Grant attempts to piece the Union back together during Reconstruction. Host Stan Ellsworth tracks Grant’s career from his days in the Mexican-American War to his tenure as the 18th President of the United States.

d8911f10-2c82-49c8-afd9-73a726106d45.description: Stories from across the globe that stir souls, nurture hope and inspire personal growth.

episodes.title: Leaps of Faith
episodes.description: Hear stories of faith from Lindsey Stirling and photographer Chris Burkard. Plus, a couple’s parenthood journey brings an extra surprise, and one sister missionary’s return to the field after COVID-19 provides a new connection to the Philippines.

episodes.title: Unexpected Miracles
episodes.description: NFL legend Vai Sikahema's testimony fosters a temple miracle in Philadelphia. Friendship between two neighbors paves the way to adoption. Artist Paige Anderson shares how she depicts "belief". One comedic dad brings laughter and costumes to carpool.

episodes.title: New Perspectives
episodes.description: While covering five thousand miles in a sailboat, the Ortons turn worry into wonder. A Jewish rabbi and Latter-day Saint leader create collaboration from potential disaster. A jet-setting family changes vacations into opportunities to serve.

episodes.title: Life’s Adventures
episodes.description: Vocal Point's music shapes their faith. Kenya Jackson-Saulters encourages time in nature. Athlete Kacey McCallister rises up. An Australian missionary experiences a miracle when he serves a stranger. The Van Hise family has an adventure—on wheels!

episodes.title: Faithful Findings
episodes.description: Composer Robert Elliott creates harmony with music and faith. Author David Butler grows closer to the Holy Ghost. Artist Brian Kershisnik explores the birth of Christ in “Nativity.” Mitch Fennemore serves his Heavenly Father at Deseret Industries.

episodes.title: Lifelong Learning
episodes.description: Blogger Kim Christenson learns something unexpected during a social media fast. Karina Villalba builds bridges for Backman Elementary. Two friends take a trip to discover true Christianity. A grandma teaches her grandkids to love "the good old days."

episodes.title: Dedication
episodes.description: Williamson Sintyl made a promise with God that changed the lives of Haitians. Brent Brown keeps teenagers engaged with church. BYU player Khyiris Tonga trades football for a mission. Pamela E.B. Davis brings family goals to life vision boarding.

episodes.title: Uncovering Courage
episodes.description: Singer-songwriter Leigh Nash shares how faith shapes her music. Runner Rachel Hansen discovers how Heavenly Father cares for her individually. Drummer Clint Pulver encourages others not to be the best in the world, but the best for the world.

episodes.title: Positive Influences
episodes.description: Musician Travis Greene spreads the gospel of Jesus Christ through music. Director Christina Torriente strengthens her testimony by bringing Ishmael's family to life. Brandon Sulser aids others to become who God wants them to be by sharing his trials.

episodes.title: Uplifting Examples
episodes.description: Jon and Michelle Schmidt (The Piano Guys) exercise faith after their daughter Annie goes missing. Nina Ambrose stays close to her dad during lockdown by volunteering in a care center.

episodes.title: Service with a Smile
episodes.description: Celebrity stylist Calyann Barnett follows God through her fast-paced career. The Red Fred Project brings extraordinary books to life. Reverend Jay and Toni Ragsdale keep Jay's brother's dream alive through selfless service.

episodes.title: Discovering Purpose
episodes.description: Ed Attanasio aids pets in need with his colorful portraits. Sahar Qumsiyeh discovers peace through Christ after a challenging childhood in Palestine. Erin Durga makes the ultimate donation to a dear friend.

episodes.title: Lasting Legacies
episodes.description: James Harrison gives blood and saves the lives of over a million babies. The Trejo family chooses joy during a time of exquisite trial when their son Tosh is diagnosed with Hunter syndrome.

episodes.title: Guided by Faith
episodes.description: Fashion designer and Project Runway contestant Ayana Ife shares how she expresses her faith through the clothing she creates. The West family discusses how their faith has been strengthened despite their daughter's passing.

episodes.title: Trust in God
episodes.description: Mariama Kallon-Olayemi, a survivor of the civil war in Sierra Leone, shares her trust in her Heavenly Father. Sarah Frei faces health challenges with a powerful positive outlook. Violinists Daniel D and Eric Stanley use their music to lift others up.

episodes.title: Promptings
episodes.description: Anna He loses her mother to cancer, and incredible women step into her life when she needs them most. One prompting brings thousands together in prayer in Cartersville, Georgia. Gracelyn Wilkinson finds healing for herself by serving others.

episodes.title: Bridges Forward
episodes.description: The writers of the blog Sistas in Zion discuss the importance of inclusivity and community in the gospel. Singer-songwriter Bri Ray turns toward her faith to find peace during a challenge.

episodes.title: Creating Unity
episodes.description: Amajad Kirrish shares how a puppy he met while he was deployed in Syria gave him hope. David Archuleta discuses overcoming challenges. Pastor Dan Chun and twenty-five churches across Hawaii help people renew their faith.

episodes.title: Spiritual Transformation
episodes.description: NASA engineer Michelle Amos chooses to serve a mission though it means missing the Mars rover launch. Pastor Greg Boyle helps former gang members find employment and better lives.

episodes.title: Leadership
episodes.description: MyKayla Skinner finds strength at the 2020 Olympics. Reverend Theresa Dear provides advice on interfaith collaboration. Tanner Gillman transforms Tourette's from a trial into an asset. BYU–Hawaii's new president fulfills a vision for the university.

episodes.title: Cultivating Talents
episodes.description: Brian Kershisnik and Joe Adams improve each other with collaboration. Suzan Johnson Cook served as chaplain of the NYPD during 9/11. Fire knife dancer Jeralee Galeai finds a precious gift. Coworkers share their experiences in an interfaith alliance.

episodes.title: Hope and Healing
episodes.description: Alema Harrington shares his addiction recovery and his relationship with God. Stacy Taniguchi advises on creating a "list to thrive." Amy Grant finds faith through heart surgery. Tim Frost becomes a father to his son Odin who teaches him about love.

episodes.title: Selfless Service
episodes.description: The Sanders family tells their adoption story of going from 5 kids to 11 in their Ohio home. Kirby Heyborne shares what motivates him to serve and what he’s learned. Allison Bond writes letters to lift spirits.

episodes.title: Faithful Storytellers
episodes.description: Sam Mangakahia connects with his Maori heritage by hand carving instruments. Patti Rokus depicts scripture stories creatively through rock art. Ashley Hetherington shares how she teaches cheerleading to those with developmental disabilities.

episodes.title: Callings
episodes.description: Alex Boyé shares about his experience being suicidal and how we can help others who feel the same. Dr. Kwane Stewart, the Street Vet, provides free care to the pets of people experiencing homelessness. The Sammis family personalize scripture time.

episodes.title: Lessons in Love
episodes.description: Podcast host Lisa Valentine Clark finds connection in sharing her grief. Tyler Bastian founded a high school on a farm. Lori Newbold encourages self-reliant scriptures study. Payton and Krissy Wilgar welcome their brothers' children into their home.

episodes.title: God's Grace
episodes.description: Sister Christina Heltsley sees potential in the St. Francis Center in the Redwood City community. Author and podcast host Tammy Uzelac Hall provides insight into how studying Hebrew changes the way she interprets scripture.

episodes.title: Making an Impact
episodes.description: Podcast host Morgan Jones shares what it means to her to be "all in" the gospel of Jesus Christ. Former media executive Ron King starts a donkey rescue in California. Mariya Goodbrake helps refugee youth through a special soccer program.

episodes.title: Hello Sunday Special: Share Your Light
episodes.description: Scout Smith presents some of her favorite Hello Sunday stories. Meet inspiring individuals who are sharing their unique light. Guests include Tim and Odin Frost, the Red Fred Project, Tanner Gillman, and many others.

episodes.title: Stewards of Faith
episodes.description: Civil rights activist Rev. Amos Brown details the experiences that prepared him for ministry and for the NAACP. The Food Nanny champions family dinner. Bonnie H. Cordon discusses FSY. Cotopaxi founders discuss Christ's call to eliminate poverty.

episodes.title: Better Together
episodes.description: Globetrotters coach Barry Hardy fosters spiritual development in himself and his players. Erin Gruwell learns lessons with the Freedom Writers. Two friends draw close to Christ as Best Buddies. Derrick Campana shares the impact of animal prosthetics.

episodes.title: Inspired Service
episodes.description: Sister Sharon Eubank shares the global impact of the Church's humanitarian efforts. Jeanne Albaugh brings showers to people experiencing homelessness. Desange Kuenihira fights for educational opportunities for Ugandan youth.

episodes.title: Enriching Others
episodes.description: Dr. Adolph Brown provides personal advice for parents. Big Dog Ranch Rescue saves the lives of thousands of dogs. A senior missionary couple finds renewed faith in Alaska. Ty Arnold shares stories of courage from humanitarian trips to Ukraine.

episodes.title: Change
episodes.description: Ashley Hess develops her faith while on American Idol. Joshua Coombes provides haircuts to people experiencing homelessness. Batchlor Johnson IV learns at a Krishna Temple. A non-profit receives a miracle when constructing a much-needed new building.

episodes.title: Growing through God
episodes.description: Chelsie Hightower from Dancing with the Stars shares her battle with perfectionism and appreciation for the Savior. Bailey Hughes founds a non-profit delivery service for foster families. Natalie Madsen investigates spiritual topics with children.

episodes.title: Joy in Life
episodes.description: NFL loctician Jhery Brown mentors teen parents, having been a teen parent herself. Zazel-Chavah O'Garra regains mobility and founds a dance company for disabled people. Jamila Hubbard and Alecia Abeling form a special friendship at a deaf university.

episodes.title: Courage and Creativity
episodes.description: TikTok's "Tree Guy" Justin Davies encounters a tree that changes his life. Corey Fox finds a kidney donor in Brandon Robbins. Designer Afa Ah Loo shares how he overcame negativity. Though blind, Elbert Eastmond creates uplifting spiritual artwork.

episodes.title: God’s Guidance
episodes.description: Mike Guido learns and laughs alongside his autistic daughter. Reverend France Davis fights for civil rights. Chris Lamb crochets as part of his mobility therapy. Langi Tuifua discovers a hidden talent for acting after an injury.

episodes.title: Strength
episodes.description: After losing his son, Dan Debenham shares his appreciation for family. Crumbl Cookies' Jason McGowan puts his family life first. Behnaz Karjoo works to be an instrument in God's hands. Batchlor Johnson IV participates in a menorah lighting ceremony.
