episodes.title: CastEval - Tori
episodes.description: Studio C is sketch comedy for the whole family. With Garet Allen, Carl Foreman, Dalton Johnson, Tori Pence, Kiri Case, Aleta Myles, and Jericho Lopez.

episodes.title: Confused Cop
episodes.description: Matthew is pulled over by a cop. He assumes that he was speeding, but the cop's questions soon spiral from normal cop questions into increasingly bizarre existential questions as the cop asks Matthew questions about his own dreams, fears, and goals.

episodes.title: Cry No More
episodes.description: A waitress thinks Arvin made his girlfriend cry, and spills everything on him as payback. Arvin admits he was planning to propose, pulling out a ring. His girlfriend cries harder, prompting the waitress to bring out a flambé, and the couple runs out.

episodes.title: Cyber Bullies
episodes.description: Jeffrey doesn't want to go to school because he's being cyber bullied by the cool kids, who happen to be robots. The cyber bullies tease Jeffrey by poking fun at his mom's weight, his glasses, and other perceived flaws, all in monotonous robot-speak.

episodes.title: Dad Gets Charmed
episodes.description: Dad tries to intimidate his daughter's boyfriend, Jeremy, when Jeremy arrives at his house to pick his daughter up for a date that night. But his tough and menacing pose is undercut when he can't stop laughing hysterically at everything Jeremy does.

episodes.title: Disheveled Airport Woman
episodes.description: A woman who doesn’t understand TSA rules frustrates the agents by walking through with her bags. She complains about removing her electronics, liquids, and pet iguana. Her bag still sets off the machine, however because her iguana always has a knife.

episodes.title: Dodo Fairy
episodes.description: Elanor, the Toothfairy’s daughter, waits for the mystical Dodo Bird Fairy to come take her tooth. The fairy is clumsy and scary rather than graceful and beautiful. She chokes on Elanor’s tooth and falls to the ground when she tries to fly away.

episodes.title: Don't Need Nothing But You
episodes.description: In a 1930s-style musical number, Molly tells Jimmy that she doesn't need their mansion or their fancy possessions, only their love. Jimmy, relieved, confesses to a horrified Molly that he just lost his job and they're about to lose everything.

episodes.title: Drive Thru
episodes.description: Kevin goes to his local Burger Jester and orders a huge meal. However, the drive-thru staff refuse to serve him this order, saying that they can't be responsible for killing him. Instead, they counsel Kevin over the speaker about healthy choices.

episodes.title: Dungulah
episodes.description: Two orphan girls living in a Victorian-era orphanage discuss their dreams for their future lives when they are adopted. They are interrupted by Dungulah, a third orphan girl, who shares that her dream is to have a little man who lives in her pocket.

episodes.title: Essential Witches
episodes.description: Three witches gather in the woods to brew potions together, but it quickly transpires that the potion party was only a pretext for one of the witches, a member of a multilevel marketing scheme, to try and convince her guests to buy essential oils.

episodes.title: Ethel Fights Off Death
episodes.description: Ethel, a sassy and determined grandma, is horrified when Death arrives with his scythe to collect her soul. Instead of accepting her fate, she fends off Death by eating superfoods, doing puzzles to keep her mind active, and finally just running away.

episodes.title: Ezekiel Browngoat
episodes.description: Ezekiel Browngoat, owner of a small-town mattress store, narrates a low-budget commercial about a blowout sale at his store. As it goes on, he slowly breaks down and reveals that he has lost his entire family inside the gigantic mattress warehouse.

episodes.title: First Fender Bender
episodes.description: Two early car owners get in a fender bender when one of them looks down to write a quick letter. With the help of a confused local policeman, they need to figure out a whole new car accident protocol, including exchanging their contact information.

episodes.title: First Words on Mars
episodes.description: An astronaut overthinks the first words on Mars, and tries to be funny. When her attempts flop, she gets back in the spacecraft and tries again. Mission control cuts her off, and she half-heartedly says a scripted line as she plants the flag.

episodes.title: Florida City Council
episodes.description: A Florida city council meeting is derailed when the citizens realize that one of the meeting participants is, in fact, an alligator. They protest to the chairman that an alligator shouldn't be allowed to participate in local Florida government.

episodes.title: Folk Ballad
episodes.description: In the wild west, a guitarist sings a song about a villain, before realizing his subject is actually a nice guy. The singer wanders through the town in search of a bad guy, but each time he is misdirected by actions that turn out to be really nice.

episodes.title: Grandma Likes Being Kidnapped
episodes.description: A family gathers in their living room with a hostage negotiator to try and rescue Grandma, who was kidnapped while on vacation. However, it becomes clear that Grandma has no intention of leaving her idyllic life in Colombia for a retirement home.

episodes.title: Grandpa the Dairy Farmer
episodes.description: Two kids visit their dairy farmer grandpa on his farm and learn to taste different flavors in milk. But when Grandpa starts tasting his cologne and heart medication in the cows' milk, he gets paranoid that the cows are secretly trying to become him.

episodes.title: Hair Height
episodes.description: A chance remark about Tanner's hair drives Tanner and Matthew into an elaborate hair duel. They begin by hairspraying their hair to its most impressive height, then start magically transforming into various movie characters and historical figures.

episodes.title: Hollywood Executive
episodes.description: In a Christmas car commercial, a man decides to give his wife the gift of a shiny new Lexus. But when his wife gets outside to see her Christmas surprise, she is furious that he sold their old car for an expensive new one without even talking to her.

episodes.title: House Always Wins
episodes.description: Rick just wants to get some change from the hotel change machine, but he is continually interrupted by Tara, a fellow guest who thinks that he's gambling at a slot machine and enthusiastically cheers him on for his impressive winning streak.

episodes.title: How Did That Get There
episodes.description: Charlie’s friends don’t seem to understand what their baby is or where he came from. They think it’s bringing them presents, or putting money under their pillows, or if it’s superman. They decide to have another one, but they don’t know what.

episodes.title: Imposter Fieri
episodes.description: Diners, Drive-Ins, and Dives host Guy Fieri shows up to a local restaurant for another episode of his famous food show. To his shock, he must prove his identity when he finds a imposter Guy already there, trying to scam his way into some free food.

episodes.title: It Could Work Theoretically
episodes.description: A scrappy spaceship crew is about to be captured or killed by enemy troops, but the ship's captain won't go down without a fight. With the help of her crew, she tests out the unlikeliest plans for how they could theoretically escape their enemies.

episodes.title: Judge Judy
episodes.description: The beloved show, “Judge Judy” is adapted into “Judge Judge Judy Judge Judy” where the plaintiff, defendant, witnesses, and judge are all played by Judge Judith Sheindlin. The Judy’s argue about who is more experienced and recite isms from the show.

episodes.title: Lady of the Lake
episodes.description: King Arthur and his squire journey to receive the sword Excalibur from the Lady of the Lake. But when they arrive, the lake looks more like a swamp, and the Lady of the Lake is a colorful rural character who tries to sell them homemade stink bait.

episodes.title: Mission Control
episodes.description: Actors freeze and Mission Control steps in to save a sketch with an unamused audience. The team uses statistics, graphs, and imitating the set to try and make the sketch funny, to no avail. Finally, they send in an alpaca and the crowd goes wild.

episodes.title: Morning Show
episodes.description: Studio C is sketch comedy for the whole family. With Garet Allen, Carl Foreman, Dalton Johnson, Tori Pence, Kiri Case, Aleta Myles, and Jericho Lopez.

episodes.title: Office Funny Guy
episodes.description: A painfully boring office has a competition for the role of official office funny guy. The two contenders, both very awkward, must reenact common office scenarios such as dropping off files and running into people at the water cooler.

episodes.title: Phil's Deals
episodes.description: Studio C is sketch comedy for the whole family. With Garet Allen, Carl Foreman, Dalton Johnson, Tori Pence, Kiri Case, Aleta Myles, and Jericho Lopez.

episodes.title: Pizza Breakup
episodes.description: At a sleepover, a group of girls are consoling Stacy after her breakup by eating delicious pizza. One-by-one, the other girls are dumped, leading them to buy increasingly large pizzas. Eventually, the pizza is so huge it’s delivered by a helicopter.

episodes.title: Promposal
episodes.description: Shane asks Janelle to prom with a pun about bananas. She excitedly accepts with a pun about nuts. But when Shane's mischievous little sister sends Janelle a rude message, ostensibly from Shane, the puns and pranks start to spiral out of control.

episodes.title: Rock Concert Questions
episodes.description: A rock star warms up the audience before a concert by asking the usual rhetorical questions about how they're feeling and if they're ready to rock. But he's thrown off his game when audience members answer him, saying that they aren't ready to rock.

episodes.title: Snake Dad at Career Day
episodes.description: At an elementary school’s career day, a dad comes in and explains his work as an amateur immunologist. The kids and teacher are shocked as Jackal allows a snake to bite him, explaining that overtime his blood will become a universal anti-venom.

episodes.title: Sound of Music
episodes.description: Maria tries to teach the Von Trapp kids about music and singing, but every time she says a word they're not familiar with, they have a full-blown existential crisis and start marching, blowing whistles, and yelling in heavy Austrian accents.

episodes.title: Speed Walkers
episodes.description: Two speed walkers take a fast walk through their neighborhood park. They criticize passing runners, cyclists, and skateboarders for being arrogant showoffs and reassure themselves that speedwalking is really much more difficult and dangerous.

episodes.title: Stinky Fridge
episodes.description: Studio C is sketch comedy for the whole family. With Garet Allen, Carl Foreman, Dalton Johnson, Tori Pence, Kiri Case, Aleta Myles, and Jericho Lopez.

episodes.title: Teenage Uber
episodes.description: In this commercial, customers balk at the price of a regular Uber ride and decide to opt for a cheaper alternative: the new Teenage Uber app. But the student drivers who pick them up are a little less than qualified for tricky things like left turns.

episodes.title: The Fainting Goat Boys 1: Birthday Party
episodes.description: A farmer curses boys for messing with his goats. The boys become part fainting goat, falling over whenever they are startled. This interrupts their everyday lives, and all three goat boys fall over when the birthday crowd calls out their surprise.

episodes.title: The Fainting Goat Boys 2: Track Meet
episodes.description: A farmer curses boys for messing with his goats. The boys become part fainting goat, falling over whenever they are startled. This interrupts their everyday lives, passing out at a when a gunshot goes off at the start of a track meet.

episodes.title: The Fainting Goat Boys 3: Jack in the Box
episodes.description: A farmer curses boys for messing with his goats. The boys become part fainting goat, falling over whenever they are startled. This interrupts their everyday lives, and all three goat boys fall over when the jack in the box springs out at them.

episodes.title: Tickle Fight
episodes.description: An executioner approaches the chopping block to kill a prisoner. However, he doesn't know what he's doing and decides to slap the prisoner in the face instead, to the shock and confusion of the official in charge of the execution.

episodes.title: Well, Well, Well
episodes.description: Two spies accidentally rob the same bank. One spy tries to guess the other’s plan incorrectly, but clams that as a spy, confidence is all that matters. While she is distracted with weird theories of his motives, the other spy leaves with the money.

episodes.title: Westminster
episodes.description: The final round of the Westminster Cat Show goes off the rails as the cats refuse to run the track. One cat clings to a judge’s face and his owner drags them both through the course. The judges crown a dog owner from the audience as the real winner.

episodes.title: The Disappearance of Jason Gray
episodes.description: Excited to welcome back Jason Gray, the cast unfortunately mistakes him for an imposter and zaps him into a dimension governed by a mystical cat who does not want to help Jason return to season 14, where he belongs.

episodes.title: Surveilled It
episodes.description: Arvin's stand up comedy set is interrupted by the audience. Rock climbing rescuers surveil the scene. An innovative vacuum will change housework forever. A family takes part in their grandma's funeral. A man has an emotional breakthrough.

episodes.title: Recommended by 5/5 Dentists
episodes.description: Jetta gets locked out of the studio. Cockney shopkeepers hawk their goods. Five dentists recommend a new product. A professional football team owner goes undercover as a player. And a father wears his most expensive shoes to a wedding,

episodes.title: Flippa The Pancake
episodes.description: Embedded in an episode about sports journalists, epic chess games, construction workers, and a trendy restaurant, Dalton discovers the Earth shattering truth that his entire life has been a lie, created for the entertainment of others.

episodes.title: Edgar Allan Crow
episodes.description: Edgar Allan Poe's Halloween Studio C special goes awry when he and his pet crow Butterbean touch a cursed amulet at the same time, switching bodies. Stuck in the body of his crow, Poe is helpless as his tales of terror elicit laughter.

episodes.title: Rat Tail
episodes.description: Studio C confronts a major issue -- Garet's hair. A poker game requires skilled shuffling. A new medication declares war on indigestion. Two New Yorkers enjoy a staycation. Another New Yorker teaches a unique form of self defense.

episodes.title: My Real Dad You Are Not
episodes.description: A teacher tries to motivate his class. An art critic evaluates a painting. Children learn life lessons from microwaved meals. Teens teach about alien attacks. A family attends an action movie. A grown Baby Yoda deals with teen stress.

episodes.title: At Peace With The Mess
episodes.description: Studio C's janitor needs to head home to his family, but a series of messy sketches -- involving leaking pens, food fights, excessive water, and whipped cream pies -- test his patience and lead him on a journey of self discovery.

episodes.title: Boom Shaka Laka
episodes.description: Two boys are playing video games in the year 1995. When one of them says Boom Shaka Laka, a Terminator-type bounty hunter bursts in and zaps him with a laser gun. The bounty hunter explains to the second boy that Boom Shaka Laka is alien code.

episodes.title: The Christmas Special
episodes.description: Tucked in and snuggly in their bed, the cast of Studio C listens to their favorite Christmas tales about Scrooge, wrapping paper hacks, Giuseppe the Italian Elf, office Christmas parties, The Grinch, and Nicolas Cage.

episodes.title: '80s Teen Ghost
episodes.description: A girl getting bullied in a school bathroom meets three 80s teen ghosts, who need to help her gain confidence before they can cross over. However, the ghosts' ideas, like challenging the bullies to a ski race, are too outdated to be much help.

episodes.title: A Good Cry
episodes.description: At a couples' retreat, Talya-Ann leads her workshop participants in expressing their deepest feelings and needs to their partners. One of the participants, Garth, starts crying, but his cry is so loud and jarring it interrupts the entire workshop.

episodes.title: A Special Gift
episodes.description: At a Christmas party, Brian announces that everyone bought a special gift for Eric, who had a hard year after his car broke down. Brian fills his introduction speech with car puns, but when Eric opens the gift, he sees that it is an electric toothbru

episodes.title: Bad Shuffler
episodes.description: James Bond and Le Chiffre cross paths again, this time over a game of poker. However, their witty banter is interrupted by the game's shuffler, who can't seem to shuffle cards without them flying in the players' faces or accidentally flipping over.

episodes.title: Bog Dentist
episodes.description: A toothpaste brand representative presents her products in the hope of receiving the elusive five out of five dentist approval. However, one of the five dentists reviewing her products is a bog dentist, who prefers chewing on twigs to using toothpast

episodes.title: Boom Shaka Laka
episodes.description: Two boys are playing video games in the year 1995. When one of them says Boom Shaka Laka, a Terminator-type bounty hunter bursts in and zaps him with a laser gun. The bounty hunter explains to the second boy that Boom Shaka Laka is alien code.

episodes.title: Boomer Horror
episodes.description: Casey is horrified when she receives a phone call from a man with a hoarse, creepy voice who asks her what her favorite scary movie is. But the man on the other end is Casey's dad, who has a million questions for her about how to log into Hulu.

episodes.title: Caveman Art Critic
episodes.description: Cave artist Grota presents her painting to an audience of cave people. She is interrupted by Jub, a famous cave art critic. Jub proceeds to verbally tear down Grota's painting, using modern art theories presented in simplistic cave person terminology

episodes.title: Chess
episodes.description: Two chess commentators narrate a professional chess championship. When one player's king abdicates the throne in favor of her queen, the chess game spins out of control into a political morass of alliances, betrayals, coups, and puppet leaders.

episodes.title: Christmas Carol
episodes.description: After his night with the ghosts, Scrooge opens his window and calls to a young boy on the street to buy the biggest turkey in the shop for the Cratchit family. His order gets more and more complicated as the shop keeps running out of what he wants.

episodes.title: Clown Pies
episodes.description: A bakery owner is suspicious that his customers, who keep buying whipped cream pies, are secretly clowns who are planning to slam the pies in their faces. However, he keeps accepting their alternative explanations for clearly clownish behavior.

episodes.title: Cockney Market
episodes.description: American tourists try to buy food at a Cockney market, but the vendors there will only describe their products indirectly, using Cockney rhyming slang. The tourists get increasingly frustrated as every rhyming slang term turns out to mean strawberrie

episodes.title: Construction Workers
episodes.description: Construction workers building a house keep stopping their work to take soda breaks for the flimsiest possible reasons. Every time they slip up at their tongue-twister-style dialogue or fail to catch a soda, they have to restart the scene from the top

episodes.title: Dad Justifies Ski Boots at a Wedding
episodes.description: A dad arrives at his daughter's wedding wearing the most expensive pair of shoes he owns: his ski boots. However, when he tries to walk his daughter down the aisle, he finds that the physical aspect of walking in ski boots is difficult to manage.

episodes.title: Edgy Teacher Breaks Chair
episodes.description: A high school teacher gives an inspirational speech to his classroom of at-risk youth. But when he tries to sit down backwards on his chair in classic movie fashion, he can't seem to figure out how to do it and keeps falling off and spinning around.

episodes.title: Emergency Exit Leader
episodes.description: April and Jason welcome everyone to Studio C, but when they mention the emergency exits, they are interrupted by an audience member who designates herself the official emergency exit leader. She starts educating the audience about emergency protocols

episodes.title: Everyone's in on the Prank
episodes.description: Dalton is surprised when April interrupts a sketch to play a prank on him. However, his surprise changes to concern when April and the rest of the cast reveal that the rest of Dalton's life, including his job and his wife, was just part of the prank.

episodes.title: Explosive Pen
episodes.description: A news reporter's pen breaks live on air, splattering her shirt with ink. As she and her colleague attempt to continue the show, the pen spurts ink all over them. The stakes heighten when an art curator arrives on the show with a Van Gogh painting.

episodes.title: Extraterrestrials and You
episodes.description: In the year 2076, students at Lower Dome High School perform a skit about dealing with everyday alien encounters, including common warning signs that someone is an alien (dead eyes, gills, tentacles, and slime) and how to respond to alien threats.

episodes.title: Food Fight
episodes.description: Avery, an elementary school student, tries to start a food fight in the cafeteria, but all the other students are confused and start punching their slices of pizza and strangling their burritos, instead of using their food to fight each other.

episodes.title: Football Pre Game Journalist
episodes.description: On an football pregame show, three ex-football players and a journalist run through a potential play for the upcoming game. When the journalist drops the football instead of making a catch, he insists that they run the play back until he gets it righ

episodes.title: Funeral Talent Show
episodes.description: At Grandma's funeral, Trish plays a song on the piano that Grandma used to enjoy hearing her play. Sibling rivalry immediately kicks in as her brother and sister show off their own talents instead of making speeches about their deceased Grandma.

episodes.title: GI Joe
episodes.description: A commercial promotes Gastrointestinal Joe, also called G.I. Joe, a man-shaped indigestion pill that parachutes into your stomach. The product is aimed at men who want to feel macho about their medication and think Pepto Bismol is excessively pink.

episodes.title: Genie Doesn't get Social Cues
episodes.description: After granting Kevin's three wishes, a genie awkwardly sticks around, wanting to hang out. No matter how many social cues Kevin gives him that it's time to leave, he insists on staying to watch TV, drink Kevin's beverages, and try to be friends.

episodes.title: Good Jason Impression
episodes.description: Jason and Jetta demonstrate their impressions for the audience. When they ask if any audience members can do an impression, Megan does one of Jason. The impression is awful, but the cast can't tell the difference between Megan and the real Jason.

episodes.title: Goosebusters
episodes.description: After losing the ghostbusters.com website domain name, the Ghostbusters rebrand as the Goosebusters and start a new career busting geese. If you have a problem with geese in your local creek, brook, river, or fjord, they'll be there to help you out.

episodes.title: Grinch Cage
episodes.description: When the Grinch sneaks into a family's house to steal Christmas, he is interrupted by Nicolas Cage, who is trying to steal the Declaration of Independence. The two would-be thieves get into an argument over whose mission should take precedence.

episodes.title: Gymnast Parents
episodes.description: Two parents watch their daughter's routine in a gymnastics competition. As they get more invested in her performance, they start performing their own routine, with choreographed dancing, jumping out of their seats, and throwing each other in the air.

episodes.title: Heist Naming
episodes.description: Cameron introduces the members of her heist crew to each other. Along with traditional roles like the hacker, the muscle, and the pickpocket, she has also hired a mailbox with eyelashes, a man with feet for hands, and the Moon, among many others.

episodes.title: Introducing Friends
episodes.description: A woman is excited to introduce her friends Sam and Alex for the first time, but when it turns out that they're old friends from the same hometown, she gets insecure about being the third wheel in the friendship and begins inventing inside jokes.

episodes.title: Italian Elf
episodes.description: The elves in Santa's workshop are trying to get all of their toys finished before Santa leaves in his sleigh, but Giuseppe, an Italian elf, keeps accidentally making his mother's Italian meatball sandwiches and chicken parmesan instead of toys.

episodes.title: Kid Cuisine part 1
episodes.description: A commercial advertises Kid Cuisine, a kids' microwaveable meal that teaches important life lessons. For example, hot apple sauce teaches kids to survive disappointment, and confusing gravy with chocolate sauce shows them how tragedy begets growth.

episodes.title: Kid Cuisine part 2
episodes.description: A commercial advertises Kid Cuisine, a kids' microwaveable meal that teaches important life lessons. For example, hot apple sauce teaches kids to survive disappointment, and confusing gravy with chocolate sauce shows them how tragedy begets growth.

episodes.title: Long Island Ladies
episodes.description: Two women from Long Island, Bernice and Chanice, tan on lawn chairs outside their apartments. They discuss everything from fighting subway pigeons to their relationships with their many ex-husbands, but keep coming back to the joys of a staycation.

episodes.title: MASH Court
episodes.description: In a courtroom, the prosecutor examines Frank N. Stein, a witness for a wrongful death suit. Stein describes his experiences on the night of October 31st, when his lab work was interrupted by a party of vampires and ghouls that poisoned his monster.

episodes.title: Mandela Effect
episodes.description: Studio C is sketch comedy for the whole family. With Garet Allen, Carl Foreman, Dalton Johnson, Tori Pence, Kiri Case, Aleta Myles, and Jericho Lopez.

episodes.title: Mechanic Musical
episodes.description: When a woman goes to the mechanic to get her car fixed, she is confused about the difference between a camshaft and a crankshaft. The mechanic is delighted to explain it to her and brings out a chorus of mechanics who perform a song about cars.

episodes.title: Milk Freak
episodes.description: When they hear there's been a break-in targeting the dairy fridges, grocery store employees worry that a milk freak is on the loose. Their supervisor insists that there is no such thing as a milk freak, but the scared employees refuse to believe her.

episodes.title: Mouse Karate
episodes.description: New Yorker Vinnie Pecorino teaches a self-defense class in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Every time a student tries to attack him, he demonstrates the only move in his self-defense arsenal, which is carrying a mouse and throwing it in your attacker's face.

episodes.title: Pancake Flippers
episodes.description: Business partners and a couple on a first date are excited to go to Benihana, a breakfast restaurant that makes your food right in front of you. But the pancake flippers at the restaurant insist on flipping everything directly at the patrons' faces.

episodes.title: Positive Heckler
episodes.description: Arvin is excited to perform his standup routine for the Studio C audience, but he keeps getting interrupted by hecklers. However, the Studio C hecklers just want to praise Arvin's performance and share random facts with him about their own lives.

episodes.title: Rat Tail Intervention
episodes.description: The cast stages an intervention to convince Garet to get rid of his long, braided rat tail. As they tearfully describe how the rat tail is ruining their friendship with Garet, the rat tail itself interrupts, revealing that it's sentient and can talk.

episodes.title: Roomba Commercial
episodes.description: The new Roomba Max Pro Series 12, made with groundbreaking new technology developed by scientists at NASA, includes a vacuum-style handle to control exactly when and where your Roomba cleans and a charging cable that plugs directly into the wall.

episodes.title: Sad Kids at The Rock
episodes.description: A dad and his three children go to a movie theatre to watch The Rock, starring Nicholas Cage and directed by Michael Bay. The kids don't want to watch a movie, because they're sad that their grandfather died that morning. Dad doesn't know what to do.

episodes.title: Schrodinger's Kitty
episodes.description: Dr. Erwin Schrodinger presents his scientific theory of Schrodinger's cat at the Copenhagen Physicists' Conference, but the other scientists in the room keep getting distracted by the idea that there is a real kitty in the box for them to play with.

episodes.title: Shark Tank
episodes.description: Tim arrives on Shark Tank to present his new product, Christmas Supr-eyes, a pair of glasses with wrapping paper over the eyes so parents don't have to individually wrap kids' presents. He describes the trauma that led him to create this product.

episodes.title: Storage Wars: Texas
episodes.description: A couple on Storage Wars finds the state of Texas inside a jar in an abandoned storage unit. To find out if this Texas in a jar is the real deal, the couple has to call someone living in Texas to see if they're currently inside a glass jar or not.

episodes.title: Studio C Janitor
episodes.description: April welcomes everyone to Studio C, but is interrupted by the janitor, Jerry, who is getting a jump start on the cleaning because he has to make it to his daughter's birthday party that night. Jerry protests the messy sketches the cast has planned.

episodes.title: Surveilled It
episodes.description: A hiker stranded on the side of a cliff is delighted when rescuers Jody and Jony arrive. However, Jody and Jony's philosophy of rescue is that, before you do anything else, you must fully surveil the area and make note of any potential dangers.

episodes.title: Teen Yoda
episodes.description: A sitcom-style show gives us a glimpse into the life of Baby Yoda, now all grown up into a gangly and acne-ridden teenager called Teen Yoda, who struggles with typical teenage problems like arguing with his dad and asking his crush to the dance.

episodes.title: Undercover Football Boss
episodes.description: This week on Undercover Boss, John Livingston, the owner of the Blue Bay Smackers football team, goes undercover as a football player. He's confident in his disguise, but his employees are suspicious of the old man who suddenly joined the team.

episodes.title: Water Bottle Lady
episodes.description: A CEO's speech about the company's poor performance, which will necessitate some layoffs, is interrupted by a thirsty employee named Williams. Williams drinks all of the water in the room, including the vase on the table, before she is finally fired.

episodes.title: With Special Guest Will Forte
episodes.description: Will Forte (Saturday Night Live, The Last Man on Earth) guest stars. A super villain's cat has a secret. A worker is stuck in a vat of cereal. Behind the scenes of the recording session for the Seinfeld theme song.

episodes.title: Dedicated to the Children
episodes.description: Jason Gray struggles in an unnecessarily complex warmup game. Cast members impersonate Tom Cruise, Billie Eilish, Chris Rock, Taylor Swift, Cher, Ariana Grande, Owen Wilson, Adam Driver and James Corden.

episodes.title: The Spy Who Hugged Me
episodes.description: FBI Agents canvas an apartment complex. A waitress compromises a spy mission. A defense program seeks funding. Journalists react to Apollo 13. Loki interviews Nick Fury. A hero's eating habits are revealed.

episodes.title: Live Action Studio C
episodes.description: Bob Iger reveals Disney’s newest live-action remake of Ratatouille. Loki interviews Doctor Strange. A driver claims his car turned invisible. Jason Gray finds a video he made in junior high school.

episodes.title: Tanner & The Deathly Hollers
episodes.description: A Hogwarts sorting ceremony leads to some unexpected pronouncements, including Tourette Syndrome and OCD. Mister Rogers and Mr. McFeely learn about the wonders of crayons. Jetta Juriansz snaps as her roommate says goodnight to everything in the room

episodes.title: Studio C+
episodes.description: Jason Gray announces Studio C's all new streaming platform, Studio C+.  “Shows” on the new app include Loki’s interview with Spider-Man, Garet Allen deciding what to wear, and a snappy West Side Story parody.

episodes.title: Daltline
episodes.description: Dalton Johnson hosts a “True Crime” edition of Studio C. Agent Brinlee (Jetta Juriansz) gets a suspect to reveal information. A clueless juror (Naomi Winders) can’t make up her mind. An Alexa smart speaker is a witness in a criminal case.

episodes.title: History That Surely Happened
episodes.description: John Hancock signs the Declaration so well that the founding fathers name signatures after him. Romeo and Juliet suffer through several rounds of spicy wings as they lie on their deathbed.

episodes.title: GOOOOOOAAAAAAALLLLLLLLL!!!!!
episodes.description: BYU Men's Basketball coach Mark Pope guest stars in this sports-themed episode. Pope subs in as director of the show. A soccer commentator can't wait to announce a goal. Tanner Gillman gives a rousing speech to puppies.

episodes.title: A Studio C Wedding
episodes.description: Jetta struggles to find a date to a wedding. A Christopher Nolan movie about a budding romance gets intense. The bride and groom have some confusion over names.

episodes.title: Alexa Witness
episodes.description: In a courtroom trial for a robbery, the prosecution calls the victims' Amazon Alexa to the stand to testify. However, she realizes that cross-examining an Alexa device is more difficult than she anticipated when Alexa continuously misunderstands her.

episodes.title: Ambulance Chasing Lawyer
episodes.description: Lawyer Joe Phlegm advertises his services to ambulance-chasing lawyers who got in car accidents while chasing ambulances. He offers testimonials from the many ambulance-chasing lawyers he has represented in accidents that were clearly their fault.

episodes.title: Apollo 13
episodes.description: In the middle of the Apollo 13 mission disaster, a NASA scientist holds a news conference with journalists. When she uses a car metaphor to describe the problem the journalists begin to suggest solutions inspired by their knowledge of car mechanics.

episodes.title: Bank Drive Thru
episodes.description: A bank drive thru gets held up by a robber, who sends a gun and a rope through the money tube to taunt the crowd inside. The teller sends a pair of handcuffs through the money tube and its enough for the robber to admit defeat.

episodes.title: Big Booty Opener
episodes.description: Naomi leads the rest of the Studio C cast in a game of Big Booty, but Jason struggles to keep up with the others. As the game gets more and more complicated, involving arcane rules and lengthy synchronised chanting, Jason just can't stop messing up.

episodes.title: Biker Twins
episodes.description: Two tough biker sisters obsessed with being twins terrorize a biker bar full of much bigger men, who are intimidated by their relentless barrage of twin jokes. Their aggressive type of sibling affection results in a lot of glass bottles being broken.

episodes.title: Bride Forgets
episodes.description: During the reading of a couple's wedding vows, the bride tries to hide that she never actually learned the groom's name. As the ceremony proceeds, the officiant and, finally, the groom himself admit that they also don't know the groom's name.

episodes.title: Cerealously
episodes.description: A man eating breakfast calls the Marshmallow Pirates cereal help line to complain about his stale cereal, but the employee he reaches on the other end has been trapped in a vat of cereal for six months after a quality check went horribly wrong.

episodes.title: Choir
episodes.description: Choir director leads choir members in a complex warm-up that starts with vocal exercises, then progresses to reciting famous movie quotes, acting out a conversation between a husband and wife, and fighting each other in a Star Wars-style laser war.

episodes.title: Christopher Nolan Rom Com
episodes.description: A trailer for the romantic comedy Infatuation. Samantha, a wannabe journalist, finds her boyfriend held hostage by her boss. She goes to space to save him and reunites with him behind a bookshelf, much like Christopher Nolan's Interstellar.

episodes.title: Coach Pope
episodes.description: Studio C is sketch comedy for the whole family. With Garet Allen, Carl Foreman, Dalton Johnson, Tori Pence, Kiri Case, Aleta Myles, and Jericho Lopez.

episodes.title: Coach Pope Pirate Office
episodes.description: When the director of Studio C gets food poisoning, Coach Pope of the BYU Basketball team steps in as a sub. Austin is benched after abandoning the script, and Jess must convince Coach Pope that she has enough heart to take over Austin's leading role.

episodes.title: Commercial After the Sale
episodes.description: Theo makes a commercial after his cushion bazaar's storewide Sunday sale is over, scolding blowing their chance to save money and not showing up to the sale. Theo resents the sun for stealing his customers on and builds a rocket ship.

episodes.title: Cool Guy Can't Eat Fruit
episodes.description: The world is about to when and a cool guy enters the briefing room at the Pentagon. He is capable and confident and tells the committee he is ready to save the day. But the committee is unsure when they see him peel fruit, but eat the skins and the r

episodes.title: Coronation
episodes.description: At Napoleon's coronation, the crown bearer struggles to get a normal-sized crown to stay on Napoleon's famously tiny head. He tries all sorts of strategies to get it to stay on, as Napoleon gets increasingly apoplectic with anger and embarrassment.

episodes.title: Dad Runs Hot
episodes.description: Daughter Sarah and her boyfriend Direk are visiting Sarah's parents when Dad decides to show Direk his new air conditioning system. As Dad turns the AC further down, hoping to make the unflappable Direk feel cold, he himself gets increasingly chilly.

episodes.title: Dane's Flowers
episodes.description: Dane picks the best bouquets for customers at a flower shop. A biker gang confronts Dane for giving their gang buddy flowers that got him hitched. Dane hands them a flower arrangement so fine that they calm down and leave Dane in peace.

episodes.title: FBI
episodes.description: Two agents announce their FBI status with literally every sentence as they taunt a resident to open their apartment door. An innocent man finally answers and declares he hasn't seen the suspect. The agents move on to taunt the next door.

episodes.title: Family History
episodes.description: Jason interrupts a sketch to announce that people must pay for Studio C+MAX in order to finish it.

episodes.title: Gender Reveal
episodes.description: Jason and Jetta host a convoluted party for their baby's gender reveal. The party guests must pop a balloon, hit the bullseye on Jason's back with a paintball, open a letter, and stop Grandpa's death before they know the baby's gender.

episodes.title: Goodnight Moon
episodes.description: As Naomi and Jetta settle in for sleep, Naomi wishes goodnight to everything in the room until Jetta snaps. Jetta apologizes and the two wish each other goodnight. Naomi squeezes in a last goodnight to a secret someone in the room.

episodes.title: Goooooooooalllllll!!!!!!!!!!
episodes.description: Dalton and Joe commentate a soccer in Spanish. Joe keeps announcing false goals and Dalton keeps correcting him. A real goal is finally scored. Dalton announces it, but Joe notices too late and misses his chance to announce a true goal.

episodes.title: Goths conform
episodes.description: Two goth kids loiter outside a school building, mocking the other kids for conforming to society. They make a point of their mockery by reciting plays in unison and playing football together. Goth kid Megan promptly straightens up as a theatre kid co

episodes.title: Hancock
episodes.description: Thomas Jefferson scolds John Hancock for signing the Declaration of Independence too big. Benjamin Franklin and George Washington join the party to sign the document and love Hancock's work. Washington deems all signatures John Hancocks.

episodes.title: Invisible Car
episodes.description: Garet claims his car turned invisible when Arvin from roadside services arrives. Arvin isn't convinced but hits his foot on the invisible care when he tries to leave. Garet leaves Arvin in awe, realizing this invisible car isn't his.

episodes.title: Jason Gray vs Jason Gray
episodes.description: Jason encounters a past version of himself in an old video camera. Jason tries to financially advise his past self, ends up insulting him instead. His past self takes revenge by committing to a tattoo that suddenly appears on Jason arm.

episodes.title: Juror didn't Listen
episodes.description: A jury is passionately divided on a trial verdict. As they deliberate, they discover that Juror Marcia paid no attention in the trial. They try to catch Marcia up, but bickering ensues. Marcia leaves them with her verdict on a lunch order.

episodes.title: Little women
episodes.description: The March sisters realize Laurie proposed to both Jo and Amy. Meg and Beth are offended Laurie didn't propose to them, too. Beth coughs in Laurie's face before collapsing. As Beth dies, Laurie mourns that he'll never get to ask her to marry him.

episodes.title: Live Action Ratatouille
episodes.description: Bob Iger shares exclusive clips of the Ratatouille live-action remake. In the clips, Linguini lifts a massive rat onto his shoulders, tries to tell Colette about this rat, and reveals this rat to the food critic who loved its cooking.

episodes.title: Marty the Sketchbot
episodes.description: Marty, the robot that writes most of Studio C's sketches, sings of his want to be a real boy and part of Studio C's human cast. The audience claps for Marty until his entertainment meter is full, transforming him into real boy Will Forte.

episodes.title: Mr. Rogers' Crayon
episodes.description: Mr. Rogers puts Mr. Mcfeely's VHS into the player and a video of crayon production plays. The video cuts to a shot of Mr. Rogers eating an entire green crayon at a painstaking pace. Mr. Rogers and Mr. Mcfeely sit in uncomfortable silence.

episodes.title: Obvious Spies
episodes.description: Two undercover spies track down a villain when a waitress blows their cover. The spies try to ward the waitress off when the villain reveals himself. The waitress posts a pic of the villain on social media and lead the FBI straight to him.

episodes.title: Pen Funeral
episodes.description: Jason's whiteboard marker runs out of ink during a Studio C writing session. While mourning its death, the cast takes equal responsibility for the whiteboard marker's early demise. They hold a funeral before chucking it into the trash.

episodes.title: Price Match
episodes.description: Jason requests a price match for a TV he found at Buy Best and reveals that he stole the TV itself. The store clerk, the store manager, and a Best Buy employee try to take the TV back, but the confusion ends in him towing the TV away.

episodes.title: Puppy Bowl
episodes.description: Coach Tanner lays into his team of puppies after their weak performance on the puppy bowl playing field. He praises only the, who scored the team their only goal. Tanner recalls his youth and rallies the puppies to give the game their all.

episodes.title: Revenge Movie Trailer
episodes.description: Jack Wolfe vows to take revenge on the ocean that murdered his wife. He goes about punching bodies of water, slamming hooligan’s against walls, and answering phone calls through conch shells all for the sake of avenging his wife.

episodes.title: Richard Wants a Perfect Body
episodes.description: When Cleo wakes up to her husband Richard sporting a new muscle suit, she slips as she tries angrily to get it off his body. She gets stuck under fallen armoire and she-hulks it off her body when her faux-muscled husband is no help.

episodes.title: Seinfeld Bass Player
episodes.description: A studio preps to record the Seinfeld opening song. Bass player Shawn Cardigan spoils every take with his improvisation until the music producer dismisses him. On the last take, Shawn busts through the door and smashes everything in sight.

episodes.title: Shower Thoughts
episodes.description: Federal agents Arvin and Tanner bring in Brinlee, an obnoxiously cutesy girl, to torture suspect Jason with shower thoughts. Brinlee gives Jason too much to think about, and he cracks, revealing the location of a hidden bomb.

episodes.title: Sorting Hat
episodes.description: The Sorting Hat assigns Tanner the Hogwarts House of Tourettes. Tanner argues that Tourettes is his disorder, not his house. He can't channel Tourettes on Snape's demand. Voldemort appears. Tanner's Tourettes turns Voldemort into knickers.

episodes.title: Spicy Chicken
episodes.description: Romeo and Juliet perform their final lines with a twist - they eat a spicy chicken wings every time a bell rings. Juliet shares a hot sauce-covered kiss with Romeo's corpse. Juliet weeps over the spice as she drives a dagger into her chest.

episodes.title: Spider Free Movers
episodes.description: Mario and Rey Duggins premiere their Movers business commercial. They get down to business, claiming their vans are spider free, their movers won't mess with client property, and the dark month of May 2019 will never happen again.

episodes.title: Talk to Text
episodes.description: A woman with two broken arms captivates the bus passengers with voice texts about her long-lost father and puppy. The passengers demand closure before she gets off the bus, and find it when her father steps forward, puppy in tow.

episodes.title: Tanner is Mom
episodes.description: The cast of Studio C interrupts Tanner's warm welcome with a Happy Mother's Day wish. Tanner refutes their claim that he is the mom of the cast. A stranger tells him he's a phenomenal mother. He gives up and brings the cast in for a hug.

episodes.title: Time Traveler
episodes.description: Trevor of 2035 pays a visit to Trevor of 2022 and forgets the message he needed to deliver. He tells Trevor of 2022 about the horrors of the future until he remembers the message; he must not to take advice from his future self.

episodes.title: Togbort
episodes.description: The audience pleads for The Human Chainsaw to let Togbort win their wrestling match so he can complete his hobbit quest. Togbort defeats Chainsaw when a witch appears. Chainsaw defeats the witch and Togbort deems Chainsaw his quest buddy.

episodes.title: Villain's Pet
episodes.description: Daniel Danger confronts the evil Tanya Dynamite, who pets a man in a cat costume that sits in her lap. Dynamite tries to take Danger out with her cat, but Danger reveals to Dynamite that her cat is his partner agent. She loses again.

episodes.title: We Are the World
episodes.description: An ensemble of celebrities gathers to sing about the children of the world. Taylor Swift sells her 20th studio album, Adam Driver talks about his height, and the ensemble sings in chorus all for the sake of the world's children.

episodes.title: We Robbed a Zoo
episodes.description: In an exercise to get to know each other, a class of 3rd graders each share their name and the type of exotic pet they own. The class confesses to robbing a zoo. One student says her father's zoo was robbed and the class feels guilty.

episodes.title: Wedding Play
episodes.description: Jack tells the bride of a wedding that he loves her but learns he too late. At first, Jack writes off his confession as part of a play but eventually admits he does love her. The guests think he is performing a monologue from his play.

episodes.title: West Side Snapping
episodes.description: The Jets learn one of their gang members can't snap and refuse his suggestions for alternate forms of intimidation. The Jets fail to scare their rival gang away by snapping, so Joe starts tap dancing. His skill scares the Sharks off.

episodes.title: Wolverine Budget Proposal
episodes.description: Two officials propose the budget for a new project. They ask for $100 billion dollars, detailing their need to create a supersolider that can heal all wounds and how to build a cyborg that doesn't feel pain. The senator greenlights their budget.

episodes.title: Write Me
episodes.description: The teacher separates Megan and Naomi after they disrupt the class. Megan and Naomi write letters to each other, telling of the cold and the cute boy that asked Naomi to Spring Formal. The teacher catches them and sends them to detention.
