episodes.description: Studio C is sketch comedy for the whole family. With Garet Allen, Matt Meese, Dalton Johnson, Tori Pence, Kiri Case, Aleta Myles, Hugh Clark, Michelle Knapp, Carl Foreman, Kiri Case and Jericho Lopez.

episodes.title: Too Many Dogs in Heaven (ft. Rainn Wilson)
episodes.description: Fredrick the angel (guest star Rainn Wilson) guides Naomi through Heaven. It’s perfect, except for the 487 trillion dogs.

episodes.title: Have I Shocked You? with Pete Holmes
episodes.description: Pete Holmes tries out a beard. A husband reveals his wife's secrets. Phil Swift shows how Flex Tape can fix everything. The perfect first kiss needs some work. An eccentric billionaire takes his girlfriend to dinner. Pete Holmes guest stars.

episodes.title: Swiss Polka Demon Hunters️
episodes.description: Swiss polka stars fight dairy intolerant demons. Halloween complicates a car crash. There's an unexpected visitor in the Spider-Verse. Couples have differing opinions about Toy Story. Count Dracula is having problems with his bite.

episodes.title: Bring Out The Brads️
episodes.description: A family finds a bargain cruise. A man waits in the airport arrival area. A mom enthusiastically uses bug spray. The big bad wolf gets an unexpected reaction from a little pig. A woman on a dating show must choose between three bachelors.

episodes.title: Elmo Doesn't Feel Anything Anymore
episodes.description: Cinderella's friends make her a beautiful gown. Gossipers are overheard in the bathroom. Freddy Fazbear's Pizza is re-opening. A girl dad wants to change Star Wars. Cookie Monster is cutting his consumption thanks to three letters.

episodes.title: A Battle Of Wits️
episodes.description: A try-hard server works to impress some shy kids. The Tooth Fairy desperately needs a loan. Westley's wits may not be able to save Buttercup. A recruiter is anxious to fill an important role. A lawyer gets one last question in court.

779eb7d3-96f1-4046-99f2-ab17cd332c15.description: Orphan Hetty and foster brother Gideon rely on each other to find joy despite their trials.

episodes.title: The Escape - Part 1
episodes.description: Hetty is determined to escape the foundling hospital and meets a boy who may be able to help.

episodes.title: The Escape - Part 2
episodes.description: In this double episode, Hetty's hopes of finding her mom are dashed and lead to an attempted escape.

episodes.title: The Tower
episodes.description: Hetty seeks to reunite with Gideon so they can celebrate their birthdays together.

episodes.title: Jack in the Box
episodes.description: Hetty and her friends uncover Matron's plot to sell charity-destined toys for her own profit.

episodes.title: Sisters
episodes.description: Both Hetty and Matron Bottomly receive unexpected visitors at the foundling hospital.

episodes.title: Strike
episodes.description: Hetty and friends stage a strike to protest the firing of Nurse Winterson, but will the plan work?

episodes.title: Raising the Flag
episodes.description: The boys complete grueling tests as they vie for the position of drummer boy in the army.

episodes.title: Foundling Reclaimed
episodes.description: A distraught couple have come to reclaim their child, but which foundling could it be?

episodes.title: Open Day - Part 1
episodes.description: It's open day at the hospital, but Hetty's hopes of finding her real mother are dashed by Matron.

episodes.title: Open Day - Part 2
episodes.description: Matron goes on the warpath after Hetty escapes from the hospital. But is the escape permanent?

episodes.title: Foundling Day
episodes.description: Hetty risks getting into serious trouble with Matron Bottomly when she makes a desperate promise.

episodes.title: The Haunting
episodes.description: Hetty is shocked when a wealthy couple wants to adopt one of her friends.

episodes.title: Words From Home
episodes.description: Hetty has a surprise visitor with important news, but can she meet him without getting caught?

episodes.title: Changes
episodes.description: Gideon tells a lie which gets Hetty into trouble, and Matron Bottomly has mysteriously disappeared.

episodes.title: Blanche
episodes.description: Hetty is determined to discover what secret Matron Bottomly is hiding in the basement.

episodes.title: Remember Me
episodes.description: A tragic accident brings Hetty and Sheila together to find the truth.

episodes.title: Dreams
episodes.description: Hetty is excited when an explorer talks about her adventures, and there's a snake on the loose.

episodes.title: The Letters
episodes.description: Hetty plays a practical joke on Matron Bottomly that has frightening consequences for everyone.

episodes.title: Secrets and Plans
episodes.description: Hetty discovers news that will change her life forever.

episodes.title: The Reunion
episodes.description: Will Hetty be able to keep the truth about her real mother a secret?

episodes.title: News From Nowhere
episodes.description: Hetty runs away from the foundling hospital to find Ida and becomes lost on the streets of London.

episodes.title: The Unexpected Friend
episodes.description: A kind stranger returns Hetty to the orphanage, explaining that this would prevent Ida's firing.

episodes.title: The Break-In
episodes.description: There is a break-in at the orphanage, and someone is on the premises with stolen goods.

episodes.title: Land of Opportunity
episodes.description: Matron Bottomly discovers the book recording her illegal sale of orphans and tries to destroy it.

episodes.title: Dangerous Game
episodes.description: Miss Smith and Cook conspire to let Hetty have a secret meeting with Ida, but Matron finds out.

episodes.title: Cannon Fodder
episodes.description: Hetty stages a theft in order to bring the constable and Nurse Winterson together.

episodes.title: The Last Sunday
episodes.description: Matron Bottomly uses charity money to buy herself a passage to America but is overheard by Hetty.

episodes.title: Farewell Service
episodes.description: Hetty and friends confront Matron Bottomly about the stolen money and prevent her from fleeing.

episodes.title: New Beginnings
episodes.description: Matron Bottomly sends two boys to steal the incriminating book from Hetty, but trouble ensues.

episodes.title: The Past Returns
episodes.description: Hetty and Gideon attempt to rescue Emily from the clutches of matron Bottomly.

episodes.title: The New Arrival
episodes.description: Hetty discovers a secret, while Gideon fears he caused Edwin's life-threatening accident.

episodes.title: Trouble
episodes.description: Rosamund goes missing on the day of the christening.

episodes.title: Family
episodes.description: A new arrival at the hall threatens the jobs of Agnes and Sheila.

episodes.title: Prisons
episodes.description: Hetty is forced to face an old enemy.

episodes.title: For Shame
episodes.description: Agnes's job is put at risk when her family secret is revealed.

episodes.title: Wolves
episodes.description: A figure from Hetty and Gideon's past turns up.

episodes.title: Pride
episodes.description: Jack is stunned to discover the identity of a thief.

episodes.title: Fate
episodes.description: Gideon makes a surprising discovery about Jack.

episodes.title: Truth
episodes.description: Emily discovers Mr. Buscombe has a secret.

episodes.title: The Birthday Party
episodes.description: There's an explosive finale at Emily's 16th birthday party.

episodes.title: The Return
episodes.description: Hetty and the gang play a prank on Sheila, but it has disastrous consequences.

episodes.title: The Proposal
episodes.description: Jack has a romantic proposal in mind, but a new butler spells trouble for the gang.

episodes.title: The Hidden Compartment
episodes.description: The gang follow clues as they search for the Dawn Star, not realizing that Ambrose is looking for it too.

episodes.title: The Folly
episodes.description: Hetty and friends find crucial clues to the Dawn Star, although Flo and Ambrose watch them closely.

episodes.title: The Tunnel
episodes.description: Lizzie discovers a secret tunnel with a clue while the gang races Ambrose to find the jewel.

episodes.title: The Parchment
episodes.description: The gang realize they need to break through a wall to get to the jewel—but can they do it without being discovered?

episodes.title: The Secret Door
episodes.description: The gang are in danger when Rosamund leaves Lady Grenford and Ambrose in charge.

episodes.title: The Accused
episodes.description: The gang are stunned when Hetty is accused of stealing the Dawn Star.

episodes.title: The Search
episodes.description: Hetty, on the run in London, is shocked to discover an old friend in the workhouse.

episodes.title: The Homecoming
episodes.description: Hetty and the gang race back to Callender Hall to stop Ambrose before anyone gets hurt.

episodes.title: A Christmas Adventure Part 1
episodes.description: Hetty is determined to bring Sheila back from the workhouse.

episodes.title: A Christmas Adventure Part 2
episodes.description: Hetty confronts Matron in the street gang's den while Gideon finds Sheila.

episodes.title: The Final Chapter - Part One
episodes.description: Hetty finds herself in the firing line when tragedy strikes Calendar Hall.

episodes.title: The Final Chapter - Part Two
episodes.description: Hetty, now on the streets, is shocked when she discovers her greatest enemy in a desperate situation.

episodes.title: The Final Chapter - Part Three
episodes.description: In great danger, Hetty will need all her strength to save Matron.

c95a6dd1-3fda-4401-aa8d-9f4e7340684b.description: Inspiring stories about lives changed and blessed by a single pivotal decision.

episodes.title: Intermountain Therapy Animals
episodes.description: Patients in need of a little extra love receive visits from the volunteers at Intermountain Therapy Animals, a nonprofit determined to help provide emotional and physical healing to those in need with their friendly service animals.

episodes.title: Whitney Elementary
episodes.description: Sherrie Gahn, Principal at Whitney Elementary School in Las Vegas, Nevada, finds her purpose in providing support and resources to families in the surrounding community that are impacted by recent economic turmoil.

episodes.title: Circus Project
episodes.description: Jen Cohen, director and founder of The Circus Project, makes the impossible possible as she helps homeless and at-risk youth get off the streets through learning professional circus skills.

episodes.title: LILY's Morningside Village
episodes.description: Volunteers at LILY’s Morningside Village in Manhattan give a helping hand to the seniors in their community. The organization’s founder Irene Zola shares the story that inspired her to begin devoting her time to serving the elderly.

episodes.title: Heart2Home
episodes.description: Greg Adamson, president of Heart 2 Home, sets out to help make homes more accessible and accommodating by bringing the community together to perform home renovations for those with disabilities.

episodes.title: Archi's Acres
episodes.description: Karen and Collin Archipley of Archi’s Acres assist veterans suffering from PTSD in their transition to life in the private sector through their six week Veteran Sustainable Agriculture Training program.

episodes.title: Out 2 Play
episodes.description: Andrea Wenner, founder of the Out 2 Play foundation, aims to transform the deteriorated schoolyards at public elementary schools in New York City by providing them with new playgrounds, equipment, and a new sense of safety.

episodes.title: Have Justice, Will Travel
episodes.description: Wynona Ward, founder of Have Justice Will Travel, shares the stories that inspired her to create a legal organization in rural Vermont that provides free legal services for victims of domestic violence.

episodes.title: Musicians on Call
episodes.description: Musicians on Call brings joy and relief to patients across New York City hospitals by using music to compliment the healing process. Co-founders Vivek Tiwary and Michael Solomon share the experiences that inspired them to start the organization.

episodes.title: BAADS
episodes.description: Ed Gallagher, commandeer of the Bay Area Association of Disabled Sailors or BAADS, shares how the organization uses sailing to instill confidence and create strong communication skills for its members with disabilities.

episodes.title: The Gentle Barn
episodes.description: The Gentle Barn rescues severely abused animals, rehabilitates them, and creates powerful connections with children in various therapeutic programs. Founder Ellie Laks shares the life-changing connection that inspired her to start the organization.

episodes.title: Homeboy Industries
episodes.description: Founder of Homeboy Industries Greg Boyle shares how his faith and the struggles facing his community inspired him to create the largest gang intervention rehab and re-entry program in the country.

episodes.title: Diveheart
episodes.description: Founder and President of Diveheart Jim Elliott shares his mission to build confidence and self esteem for children, adults and veterans with disabilities using the craft of scuba diving as a means of physical and emotional therapy.

episodes.title: Angel Flight West
episodes.description: Alan Dias, Executive Director of Angel Flight West, shares the mission of his nonprofit to provide free air transportation for non-emergency medical needs with a fleet of volunteer pilots.

episodes.title: Operation Finally Home
episodes.description: Operation Finally Home founder Dan Wallrath shares the story that inspired him to dedicate his life to building free custom homes for wounded veterans and their families.

episodes.title: Domus
episodes.description: DOMUS strives to help at-risk youth reach their full potential through the power of education, free-after school programs, and vocational workshops in Stamford, Connecticut.

episodes.title: Wasatch Adaptive Sports
episodes.description: Peter Mandler, founder of Wasatch Adaptive Sports, provides a free therapeutic recreational program for children, adults, and veterans with special needs to enjoy winter sports like skiing and snowboarding.

episodes.title: Intersect Fund
episodes.description: Joe Shore and Rohan Mathew, founders of The Intersect Fund, share the mission of their nonprofit to help community members build small businesses by offering free training programs and microloans.

episodes.title: The Bread Lady
episodes.description: Shauna Devonport, known to residents of Salt Lake City as “The Bread Lady,” has provided free food and household items for those in need for over 20 years.

episodes.title: Sweet Beginnings
episodes.description: Brenda Palms Barber shares how she was motivated to give back to her community by creating Sweet Beginnings, a social enterprise designed to train and hire previously incarcerated men and women in Chicago.

episodes.title: South Shore Drill Team
episodes.description: Founder of The South Shore Drill Team of Chicago, Arthur Robertson, describes his role in providing inner-city youth with a sense of structure, support, and a creative outlet through his organization.

episodes.title: Phoenix Multisport
episodes.description: Phoenix Multisport founder Scott Strode provides a safe space for recovering addicts to connect and support one another through the power of exercise and sports.

episodes.title: Eagle Eyes
episodes.description: Jim Gibbs, founder of Eagle Eyes, dedicates his time to developing technology that provides children with severe disabilities a way to connect with the world around them.

episodes.title: Erin Kimball Foundation
episodes.description: The Erin Kimball Foundation offers multiple resources for victims of domestic abuse to start a new life. Founder Sue Kimball shares the story that moved her to dedicate her life to supporting women and children who have been abused.

episodes.title: Adopt a Native Elder
episodes.description: Linda Meyers discusses Adopt a Native Elder, a program she created to pair Navajo elders with sponsors who donate food, healthcare, and supplies to foster creativity and connection in the aging Navajo community.

episodes.title: Free Wheelchair Mission
episodes.description: Don Schoendorfer, founder of Free Wheelchair Mission, shares how he adapted his engineering skills to create a nonprofit that builds and donates wheelchairs to those in need around the globe.

episodes.title: Dogwood Restaurant
episodes.description: Galen Sampson provides individuals transitioning from addiction, incarceration, and homelessness the opportunity to start a new life through an apprenticeship program at his restaurant, Dogwood.

episodes.title: Thistle Farms
episodes.description: Becca Stevens shares the story behind her organization Thistle Farms, a natural bath and body care company owned and operated by women recovering from addiction and sexual abuse.

episodes.title: San Pasqual Academy
episodes.description: The founders of San Pasqual Academy–Ron Roberts, Greg Cox, and Jim Milliken–provide hope to the youth in the foster care system of San Diego through their innovative boarding school.

episodes.title: Sister Tesa
episodes.description: Sister Teresa Fitzgerald of Hour Children strives to help women in the New York Prison system be reconnected with their children and rebuild their lives through multiple support services.

episodes.title: Global Medical Relief Fund
episodes.description: Elissa Montanti, founder and director of the Global Medical Relief Fund, aims to help children around the world who are affected by wars and natural disasters to receive the critical medical attention they need.

episodes.title: The Clarks
episodes.description: Scott and Mary Beth Clark, parents of 21 children, describe their journey in adopting children from broken homes across the globe in need of a better life.

episodes.title: Fullmer Bros. Boxing Gym
episodes.description: Gene, Don, and Jay Fullmer of The Fullmer Brothers Boxing Gym provide young men the ability to mentally and physically challenge themselves as they work to overcome their troubled pasts.

episodes.title: First Descents
episodes.description: Brad Ludden, founder of First Descents, helps young cancer patients reclaim their lives and gain increased confidence through thrilling outdoor adventures throughout the western United States.

episodes.title: Harmony Project
episodes.description: The Harmony Project gives the youth of Los Angeles an opportunity to reach new heights with the power of a free, high quality music education. Founder Margaret Martin shares what inspired her to start the organization.

episodes.title: Godparents for Youth
episodes.description: Tanya Walters inspires her community in Los Angeles with her foundation Godparents Youth Organization, a mentoring travel organization that allows inner-city youth the chance to travel across the country.

episodes.title: Street Soccer
episodes.description: Street Soccer USA uses soccer as a development tool for homeless youth across the country. Founder Lawrence Cann emphasizes the importance of creating a community for young adults to attain their goals and leave homelessness in their pasts.

episodes.title: Echo Clinic
episodes.description: Volunteers at the Echo Clinic in Eureka Springs, Arkansas, provide free healthcare to those in need. Founders Dan and Suzie Bell share what inspired them to help the less fortunate members of their community access medical care.

episodes.title: Car Santa
episodes.description: Terry Franz, known as the “Car Santa” in Kansas City, Missouri, fixes and donates cars to those in need with his organization Cars 4 Heroes.

episodes.title: Surfers Healing
episodes.description: Izzy and Danielle Paskowitz share what inspired them to start Surfers Healing, a non-profit designed to teach children with autism around the world how to surf.

episodes.title: Island Dolphin Care
episodes.description: Deena and Peter Hoagland share the story behind Island Dolphin Care, a non profit therapeutic program aimed to help children with special needs engage in multiple new activities alongside a family of dolphins.

episodes.title: Camp to Belong
episodes.description: Camp to Belong reunites siblings who have been separated by foster care across the United States for one week of reunion and fun. Founder Lynn Price shares the personal experience that inspired her to bring siblings together.

episodes.title: Rocking the Boat
episodes.description: Adam Green, founder of Rocking the Boat, uses boating and environmental education as a way to inspire high school students in the South Bronx to create and achieve their goals.

episodes.title: Irish Men's Sheds
episodes.description: John Evoy, founder of Irish Men’s Sheds, shares the importance of creating an organization that allows local men to come together as a collective of craftsmen with the purpose of giving back to their community.

episodes.title: Brighter Future Workshop, UK
episodes.description: Brighter Future Workshop refurbishes mobility equipment to make it more accessible for those with disabilities. Chairman Peter Cousens and co-founder Jackie Tittle share the positive impact of the organization in their community.

episodes.title: Akshaya Trust
episodes.description: Narayanan Krishnan of Madurai, India, uses his organization Akshaya Trust to combat hunger among the aging homeless population in his community.

episodes.title: Floating Doctors
episodes.description: Benjamin and Sky LaBrot bring healthcare to people in rural communities with their organization, Floating Doctors. Using a boat, free clinics and a crew of volunteers, Floating Doctors has helped thousands of people globally.

episodes.title: Row New York
episodes.description: Row New York brings together competitive rowing and academic support for girls from under-resourced schools across New York City. Founder Amanda Kraus describes the significance of the organization in the lives of its young members.

episodes.title: 4 Paws for Ability
episodes.description: Karen Sherk, founder of 4 Paws for Ability, helps children with disabilities receive their own personal service dogs.

episodes.title: Stepney Bank Stables
episodes.description: Susan Tron shares the story behind Stepney Bank Stables, the nonprofit she created to teach important life skills to disadvantaged youth through horseback riding.

episodes.title: The Happiness
episodes.description: De Vrolijkheid or “The Happiness,” brings joy to children staying in refugee centers across the Netherlands by using art as a means of communication.

episodes.title: Parkour Generations
episodes.description: Dan Edwardes, founder of Parkour Generations, uses parkour to inspire London’s inner city youth to physically challenge themselves and discover their true potential.

episodes.title: City of Angels Ballet
episodes.description: Mario Nugara uses his foundation, City of Angels Ballet, to give inner city youth in Los Angeles the opportunity to pursue ballet with free professional instruction.

episodes.title: Camden Sophisticated Sisters
episodes.description: TaWanda Jones offers structure, guidance, and a safe space for the young women of her New Jersey community with her program, the Camden Sophisticated Sisters Drill Team.

episodes.title: Naskarz
episodes.description: The NASKARZ program in Vancouver, Canada, helps young men leave behind a life of crime by offering guidance and teaching auto mechanic skills.

episodes.title: Hana Build (Ma Ka Hana Ka 'ike)
episodes.description: Rick Rutiz, founder of Ma Ka Hana Ka ‘Ike, teaches the youth of Hāna, Maui, important life skills that inspire them to give back to their community.

episodes.title: The Willy the Plumber Foundation
episodes.description: Karl Williams Winsness shares the moving experience that inspired him to start the Willy the Plumber scholarship. Through his support, Karl has enabled children of inmates to chart their own paths in pursuit of higher education.

episodes.title: The Missouri Star Quilting Company
episodes.description: The Doan family breathes life back into their small town of Hamilton, Missouri, by offering employment and a sense of community through their quilting business, The Missouri Star Quilting Company.

episodes.title: Continue Mission
episodes.description: Founders of Continue Mission, Laura Cantin and Josh Hansen, provide veterans with multiple programs, activities, and support groups as they return from combat and transition to civilian life.

episodes.title: ENACTUS
episodes.description: Sery Kouma Kone shares how support from ENACTUS enabled him to start his own non-profit to fight child slavery in the Ivory Coast. Founder of ENACTUS Alvin Rohrs shares his mission to use education to support emerging countries around the world.

episodes.title: Ronald McDonald House
episodes.description: The Ronald McDonald House provides free housing and food for families with children receiving critical treatment at nearby hospitals. Co-founders Francis and Fred Hill share how their story inspired McDonald’s to become the program’s sponsor.

episodes.title: Acres of Love
episodes.description: Acres of Love provides a permanent home and loving family for South African children orphaned by HIV/AIDS. Founder Gerda Audagnotti shares how Acres of Love has impacted the lives of hundreds of children across South Africa.

episodes.title: Ambulance Wish Foundation
episodes.description: Kees Veldboer shares the story behind Ambulance Wish, a non-profit he created to allow terminally ill patients to travel with their families across Europe for one final holiday.

episodes.title: Heart & Soul
episodes.description: Janna Lauer brings music and life to nursing homes and hospitals with her organization, Heart & Soul. Using a highly talented crew of volunteers, Heart & Soul performs music of all kinds to uplift people experiencing isolation and loneliness.

episodes.title: The Sparkle Effect
episodes.description: Sarah Cronk shares the inspiration behind The Sparkle Effect, a nationwide program that allows youth with disabilities the opportunity to participate in cheerleading at their high schools.

episodes.title: Streetwise Opera
episodes.description: Streetwise Opera uses opera as a tool to help encourage and inspire homeless individuals to move forward in life. Founder Matt Peacock shares what motivated him to use art as a means of support for those facing homelessness.

episodes.title: Conetoe Life Center
episodes.description: Founder Rev. Richard Joyner shares the inspiring story behind the Conetoe Family Life Center, the organization he created to provide multiple resources for his small community to pursue healthier lifestyles.

episodes.title: Bike & Build
episodes.description: Marc Bush organizes charity bike tours for young adults through his organization Bike & Build. Volunteers bike along the East Coast for weeks at a time and offer their service to multiple affordable housing organizations along the way.

episodes.title: A Sense of Home
episodes.description: A Sense of Home completely furnishes the new homes of youth who have aged out of the foster care system. Founders Melissa Goddard and Georgie Smith share the unique journey they took to make their nonprofit a reality.

episodes.title: Cambodian Children's Fund
episodes.description: Cambodian Children’s Fund provides life-changing education to empower at-risk youth in Phnom Penh, Cambodia. Founder Scott Neeson shares what inspired him to dedicate his life to educating impoverished communities in Cambodia.

4f383f98-6b31-4661-a832-e73a27a4d6ab.description: The Food Nanny is a reality show that helps bring families back to the dinner table.

episodes.title: Double Trouble
episodes.description: The Food Nanny Liz Edmunds is on a mission to rescue dinnertime, helping families fit the cooking and planning of meals into their lives. The Dickie family has a pair of rambunctious twins that need some help on their manners.

episodes.title: Chicken, Chicken
episodes.description: The Bates family struggles to make dinnertime a priority when schedules don’t line up for everyone to be there for dinner. The Food Nanny is to the rescue helping mom face her chicken fears and finding more consistency for the family meal times.

episodes.title: Hamburger Rut
episodes.description: The Willies family has found themselves in the habit of cooking hamburger for every meal: Tacos, Burgers, Spaghetti, and even dad’s famous Tater Tot Casserole. So The Food Nanny comes to help bring variety to their meals and save family dinner.

episodes.title: Money, Money, Money
episodes.description: The Parkin family cooks dinner on a budget and it's difficult for them to enjoy family dinnertime. The Food Nanny is to the rescue helping find a solution for them to still enjoy their old favorites and save money.

episodes.title: Fight the Good Fight
episodes.description: The Yorgusin family struggles to come together for dinner, but The Food Nanny has come to help.

episodes.title: Fed Up
episodes.description: A family of picky eaters has turned one mother into a short-order cook, making different meals for all of her family members. The Food Nanny has some ideas to help kids try new foods at dinner.

episodes.title: Home Sweet Bachelor Pad
episodes.description: Single dad takes on the challenge of taking his eating out habits and changing to make home-cooked meals for himself and his kids. The Food Nanny brings out her recipe book to help show dad how easy it can be.

episodes.title: Baby Steps to Dinner
episodes.description: After a terrible car accident, the household roles switch in the Levitt family. Dad becomes Mr. Mom and mom becomes the breadwinner. The Food Nanny helps him take baby steps to learn how easy cooking can be with her one-pot-wonder recipes.

episodes.title: Girls' Day Out
episodes.description: The Tanoka family has a habit of snacking all day. They have a hard time finding healthy options when time is so limited in the day. They call The Food Nanny, who is on a mission to help them find nutritious and easy alternatives.

episodes.title: Please Pass the Salt
episodes.description: Jenny runs a ballet studio at night and Blake works during the day, so their family dinners have fallen short. The Food Nanny helps them find a new balance between their careers and a chance to have dinner with their young family.

episodes.title: No-Tech Zone
episodes.description: When everyone is on electronics and in different places in the house, it makes it hard for dinner time to become a time for the Quiroz family to bond with each other. The Food Nanny helps them make dinner time a family activity.

episodes.title: No Regrets
episodes.description: The Peterson family are used to eating corn dogs at the ballpark three to four nights a week. The Food Nanny is to the rescue to help bring some variety and budget-friendly food to their meals.

episodes.title: Parker's Picky Palate
episodes.description: Corn, bread, and fries are some of the only things Parker eats. It makes it hard for mom and dad to cook a meal that they all like. The Food Nanny has come to conquer Parker’s food fears and help create a better meal plan for the Christensen family.

episodes.title: Spicing It Up
episodes.description: In the Roper house, dad likes a lot of spice in his food, but mom likes things bland. The Food Nanny is going to help them come to a middle ground on their food tastes and help spice up the conversations at dinnertime.

episodes.title: Dinner and a Song
episodes.description: With very different lifestyles and a job that doesn’t have set hours, it makes dinnertime a challenge at the Abernathy house. The Food Nanny has come to bring some home-cooked meals into this young family’s kitchen.

episodes.title: Downsize Me
episodes.description: The Nales don’t own a dining table because of the economic downturn and want to start changing their meals to a healthy alternative. The Food Nanny steps in to help them find meals and space to eat healthy on a budget.

episodes.title: La Vita Vera
episodes.description: The Food Nanny visits a generations-old New York grocery store where they make mozzarella cheese using a traditional family recipe. Liz gets to go behind the scenes to make their famous eggplant parmigiano.

episodes.title: Give Mom a Break
episodes.description: When mom and dad grew up in Germany and the kids grew up in the U.S., dinnertime comes with some cultural differences. The Food Nanny helps the Kell family find meals that everyone will love.

episodes.title: Running from Ramen
episodes.description: Scott Manning and his five college roommates call on The Food Nanny to help them find meals that are delicious, budget-friendly, and will help them find time to spend together during their busy schedules.

episodes.title: Making Memories
episodes.description: Spring lost her husband a couple years ago and has found it hard to make meal time a priority for her and her toddler. The Food Nanny helps support and bring some hope to this window through cooking and dinnertime.

episodes.title: Holy Cannoli
episodes.description: The Food Nanny visits Ferarra, a traditional Italian restaurant in New York City. She bakes cannoli and gnocchi and talks with the owner, Ernest, about the importance of La Vita Vera, or "the true life" through dinnertime with family.

episodes.title: Rockin' with the Nanny
episodes.description: The Food Nanny helps America’s Got Talent semi-finalists and starving college students John and Cruise Russo make time for dinner. Performing with their band, Reverse Order, and going to college limits both their time and money for dinnertime.

episodes.title: Four Jobs and a Baby
episodes.description: When the New York fast-paced lifestyle crashes on family dinnertime, The Food Nanny helps the Chappells make mealtime more of priority.

episodes.title: G'pop's Surprise
episodes.description: In search of both a signature family dish to bring to Thanksgiving dinner and a way to stop their take-out and TV binge, The Food Nanny helps the Moores make dinner a family event.

episodes.title: Oh Dinner, Where Art Thou?
episodes.description: Utah’s mother of the year can seem to keep up with everything but family dinner time. The Food Nanny brings a love of cooking back into the Dunn family kitchen.

episodes.title: Slice of Life
episodes.description: The Beckstrands go through loaves and loaves of bread every week, but mom can’t quite figure out how to successfully make homemade bread. The Food Nanny shares her grandmother's bread-making traditions and helps the Beckstrands make flawless bread.

episodes.title: Dog Gone Dinner
episodes.description: When diet restrictions make limit dinner options, the Beacom family struggles to find something everyone likes and mom enjoys cooking. The Food Nanny helps rescue dinnertime.

episodes.title: Joie de Vivre
episodes.description: French cook Jean Louis and restaurant owner in Park City, Utah, shows The Food Nanny how to cook coq au vin and shares his experience with La Vita Vera.

episodes.title: Fire's Burning but Dinner's Cold
episodes.description: With a captain with special dietary needs and when a call might come in at any minute, it is hard for these firefighters to have an actual dinnertime. The Food Nanny comes to help.

episodes.title: 10-Minute Meal
episodes.description: When an old friend needs help putting more veggies on the table and putting dinner on the table in ten minutes, the Food Nanny comes to the rescue.

episodes.title: Danish Delights
episodes.description: The Food Nanny takes a trip to a Danish town in Solvang, California. She learns how to make aebleskiver, frikadeller, chocolate, and learns the importance of hyggelig.

episodes.title: The Blind Shall Lead
episodes.description: The Food Nanny travels to Las Vegas to help patrons of the Blind Center of Nevada conquer cooking without their eyesight and share the love of La Vita Vera once again.

episodes.title: Taming the Grill
episodes.description: At The Dream Center in Los Angeles, California, The Food Nanny learns about the program they have to help homeless people and helps others fulfill their dreams of cooking.

episodes.title: Flipping over Filippi's
episodes.description: The Food Nanny cooks some easy Italian meals with Danny Mocceri at Fillippi’s Pizza Grotto in San Diego’s Little Italy and learns more about La Vita Vera.

episodes.title: In Search of La Vita Vera
episodes.description: The Food Nanny visits the Parolini family in Lucca, Italy. She relives the experience that first taught her the importance of la vita vera.

episodes.title: Florence Fried Chicken
episodes.description: The Food Nanny helps Rafaela cook fried chicken, while also learning how to make some Italian classics herself, like gelato and pepper mushroom pasta.

episodes.title: Greek Goodness
episodes.description: The Food Nanny visits Athens, Greece to learn how to make coriatiki and yemista from a local chef.

episodes.title: Home on the Range
episodes.description: On the Rockin’ R Ranch in Antimony Utah, The Food Nanny learns how to make rolls, shredded pork, apple pie, and more in a dutch oven.

episodes.title: Dinner Is Served
episodes.description: The Food Nanny helps Olympians Kerri Walsh and Casey Jennings find a way to bring a piece of home with them on the road.

episodes.title: Turkish Delight
episodes.description: The Food Nanny travels to Turkey to make Turkish slow-cooked casserole, güveç, and homemade ekmek, with her friend Kiya.

episodes.title: Tour of Italy
episodes.description: The Food Nanny takes a tour of Italy, visiting Pisa, Florence, Tuscany, and Venice to taste black ink squid pasta, Italian chocolate, and more.

episodes.title: Mediterranean Cruise
episodes.description: The Food Nanny joins master chef David Reihona aboard a Royal Caribbean cruise ship, sailing the Mediterranean coast, to learn all about la vita vera far from home.

episodes.title: Rock 'n' Mojo
episodes.description: Brandon Campbell, bassist for Neon Trees, finds his family struggling to make dinner a priority and asks The Food Nanny for help.

episodes.title: London Calling
episodes.description: The Food Nanny visits London to help the Harper family, and to taste London's delicacies, like fish and chips.

episodes.title: Kitchen Idol
episodes.description: American Idol top five finalist, Brooke White, and her husband, Dave, struggle to find time for family dinner when they are working so hard to make her music career a success.

episodes.title: The Spirit of Aloha
episodes.description: The Food Nanny visits The North Shore in Oahu, Hawaii to experience the food and lifestyle. She makes stops at Matsumoto’s Shaved Ice, Tita’s Grill, The Dole Plantation, and Giovanni’s Shrimp Truck.

episodes.title: Catch a Wave
episodes.description: The Food Nanny helps the Walkers prepare a Hawaiian Luau, experiences the taro fields, tries surfing, and learns more about Hawaiian culture.

8e989562-a610-427c-ba89-f0e358a7385b.description: In-depth roundtable discussions on the Old Testament.

episodes.title: The Old Testament: An Introduction and Overview
episodes.description: Religious scholars provide an introduction and overview of the Old Testament. With Andrew C. Skinner, Ray Huntington, Terry B. Ball, and Michael Rhodes.

episodes.title: Gen. 1: The Creation
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Genesis chapter 1 which details God’s process of creating the Earth culminating with the creation of mankind in God’s image. With Andrew C. Skinner, Ray Huntington, Terry B. Ball, and Michael Rhodes.

episodes.title: Gen. 2-3: Adam and Eve in the Garden of Eden
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Adam and Eve in the Garden of Eden and their actions and decision that led to them leaving the garden as described in Genesis chapters 2 and 3. With Andrew C. Skinner, Ray Huntington, Terry B. Ball, and Michael Rhodes.

episodes.title: Gen. 4-6: The Fall; The Patriarchs
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Genesis chapters 4 through 6 which detail the conflict between Cain and Abel as well as the line of righteous patriarchs from Adam to Noah. With Andrew C. Skinner, D. Kelly Ogden, Clyde J. Williams, and Ray Huntington.

episodes.title: Gen. 9-16: Noah; Abraham and the Covenant
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the covenants God made with Enoch, Noah, and Abraham as described in Genesis chapters 9 through 16. With Andrew C. Skinner, D. Kelly Ogden, Clyde J. Williams, and Ray Huntington.

episodes.title: Abraham: A Man of Faith and Righteousness
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Genesis chapter 17 through 22 which detail the differences between Abraham’s sons Ishmael and Isaac and their parts in the Abrahamic covenant. With Andrew C. Skinner, D. Kelly Ogden, Clyde J. Williams, and Ray Huntington.

episodes.title: Gen. 23-30: The Birthright
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the birthright conflict between Isaac and Rebekah’s twins Esau and Jacob as described in Genesis chapters 23 through 30. With Andrew C. Skinner, D. Kelly Ogden, Clyde J. Williams, and Ray Huntington.

episodes.title: Gen. 29-37: Jacob and His Family
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Jacob’s life in Genesis chapters 29 through 37 from marrying Leah and Rachel, reuniting with Esau, his name changing to Israel, to his children. With Andrew C. Skinner, Victor Ludlow, Clyde J. Williams, and Michael Rhodes.

episodes.title: Gen. 37-50: Joseph
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Genesis chapters 37 through 50 which detail Joseph’s journey from his brothers selling him into slavery to rising to second in command of Egypt. With Andrew C. Skinner, Victor Ludlow, Clyde J. Williams, and Michael Rhodes.

episodes.title: Gen. 49 - Ex. 10: The Death of Jacob; Moses
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the death of Jacob, the trials of the Israelites, and the life of Moses at the end of Genesis and Exodus chapters 1 through 10. With Andrew C. Skinner, Victor Ludlow, Clyde J. Williams, and Michael Rhodes.

episodes.title: Ex. 11-18: The Passover and the Exodus
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Exodus chapters 11 through 18 which detail Moses’ leading the Israelites out of Egypt, through the Red Sea, and in the wilderness. With Andrew C. Skinner, Victor Ludlow, Clyde J. Williams, and Michael Rhodes.

episodes.title: Ex. 20: The Ten Commandments
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the Ten Commandments that were received by Moses for the Israelites in the wilderness as described in Exodus chapter 20. With Victor L. Ludlow, Paul Y. Hoskisson, S. Kent Brown, and Richard Draper.

episodes.title: Ex. 21-24 & 31-35: The Law of Moses
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the law of Moses as found in Exodus chapters 21 through 24 and 31 through 35 which provide guidance in spiritual and temporal matters. With Victor L. Ludlow, Paul Y. Hoskisson, S. Kent Brown, and Richard Draper.

episodes.title: The House of the Lord in the Wilderness
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the details of the tabernacle that is carried as the Israelites journey in the wilderness in Exodus chapters 25 through 30 and 35 through 40. With Victor L. Ludlow, Paul Y. Hoskisson, S. Kent Brown, and Richard Draper.

episodes.title: Lev. 1-27: The Book of Leviticus
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the Book of Leviticus which provides instructions for the Levites, the priesthood holders, on how to administer sacrifices and ordinances. With Victor L. Ludlow, Paul Y. Hoskisson, S. Kent Brown, and Richard Draper.

episodes.title: Num. 1-7: Lessons in the Wilderness--Part 1
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the census, callings, and preparation of the Israelites that are accomplished in Numbers chapters 1 through 7. With Andrew C. Skinner, Victor L. Ludlow, Richard Draper, and Dana Pike.

episodes.title: Num. 8-21: Lessons in the Wilderness--Part 2
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Numbers chapters 8 through 21 which detail the trials and murmurings of the Israelites as they journey in the wilderness. With Andrew C. Skinner, Victor L. Ludlow, Richard Draper, and Dana Pike.

episodes.title: Num. 21-36: Lessons in the Wilderness--Part 3
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the Israelite journey in the wilderness as they reach the land of Moab and the acts of the prophet Balaam as found in Numbers chapters 21 through 36. With Andrew C. Skinner, Victor L. Ludlow, Richard Draper, and Dana Pike.

episodes.title: Deut. 1-10: Final Sermons of Moses--Part 1
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the final sermons and warnings of Moses to the children of Israel as found in Deuteronomy chapters 1 through 10. With Andrew C. Skinner, Victor L. Ludlow, Richard Draper, and Dana Pike.

episodes.title: Deut. 11-34: Final Sermons of Moses--Part 2
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Moses’ final sermons to the children of Israel that emphasize covenants and worship of the one God as found in Deuteronomy chapters 11 through 34. With Andrew C. Skinner, Victor L. Ludlow, Richard Draper, and Dana Pike.

episodes.title: Josh. 1-24: Entry into the Promised Land
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the Book of Joshua which details the change of leadership from Moses to Joshua and the Israelites arrival to the promised land. With Dana Pike, Paul Hoskisson, Todd Parker, and Gaye Strathearn.

episodes.title: Judg. 1-12: Judges--Part 1
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the Lord appointing judges to rule over the children of Israel after they worship false gods as described in Judges chapters 1 through 12. With Dana Pike, Paul Hoskisson, Todd Parker, and Gaye Strathearn.

episodes.title: Judg. 13-Ruth 4: Judges--Part 2
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the different acts of Gideon, Jephthah, Samson, and Ruth and Naomi as described in Judges chapters 13 through 21 and Ruth chapters 1 through 4. With Dana Pike, Paul Hoskisson, Todd Parker, and Gaye Strathearn.

episodes.title: 1 Sam. 1-15: Samuel and Saul
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss 1 Samuel chapters 1 through 15 which detail Hannah’s prayer for a son and promise to give him to the Lord, resulting in Samuel the prophet. With Andrew Skinner, Terry Ball, Keith Wilson, and Ray Huntington.

episodes.title: 1 Sam. 16-31: Saul and David
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the Israelite demand for a king leading to the promising beginnings and downfalls of kings Saul and David as described in 1 Samuel chapters 16 through 31. With Andrew Skinner, Terry Ball, Keith Wilson, and Ray Huntington.

episodes.title: 1 Sam. 18-2 Sam. 5: The Fall of King David
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss David’s popularity with the people and his relationships with King Saul and Saul’s son Jonathan as found 1 Samuel chapters 18-31 and 2 Samuel chapters 1-5. With Andrew Skinner, Terry Ball, Keith Wilson, and Ray Huntington.

episodes.title: 2 Sam. 6-12: David's Kingship and Decline
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss 2 Samuel chapters 6 through 12 which detail David’s rise, fall, and return to humility and repentance as king in Israel. With Paul Hoskisson, D. Kelly Ogden, Eric Huntsman, and Michael Rhodes.

episodes.title: The Price of Sin—Tragedy in the House of David
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the difficulties in the house of King David including his sons’ sins of incest, infidelity, and murder as found in 2 Samuel chapters 13 through 24. With Paul Hoskisson, D. Kelly Ogden, Eric Huntsman, and Michael Rhodes.

episodes.title: 1 Kgs. 1-11: Solomon
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss 1 Kings chapters 1 through 11 which details the throne passing from David to Solomon and the conflicts that arise after that transition. With Paul Hoskisson, D. Kelly Ogden, Eric Huntsman, and Michael Rhodes.

episodes.title: The Psalms--Part 1
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the different authors of the book of Psalms and the examples of poetry displayed and special purposes provided in them. With Paul Hoskisson, D. Kelly Ogden, Eric Huntsman, and Michael Rhodes.

episodes.title: The Psalms--Part 2: Messianic Psalms
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the Messianic Psalms scattered throughout the book of Psalms and how interpretations have varied between different faiths. With Paul Hoskisson, D. Kelly Ogden, Eric Huntsman, and Michael Rhodes.

episodes.title: Prov. 1-Eccl. 12: Proverbs and Ecclesiastes
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the wisdom literature found in the books of Proverbs and Ecclesiastes which were not written by prophets. With Terry Ball, Richard Draper, Eric Huntsman, and Ray Huntington.

episodes.title: Job 1-42: The Book of Job
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the book of Job and the lessons and parallels to our lives that are available to us. With Terry Ball, Richard Draper, Eric Huntsman, and Ray Huntington.

episodes.title: 1 Kgs. 12-16: A Kingdom Divided Against Itself
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the division of the Israelites into the Kingdom of Judah and the Kingdom of Israel as found in 1 Kings chapters 12 through 16. With Terry Ball, Richard Draper, Eric Huntsman, and Ray Huntington.

episodes.title: 1 Kgs. 17-22: The Ministry of Elijah
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss 1 Kings chapters 17 through 22 which detail the ministry of Elijah and the miracles and wonders and sealing powers he facilitated among the Israelites. With Terry Ball, Richard Draper, Eric Huntsman, and Ray Huntington.

episodes.title: 2 Kgs. 1-4: The Ministry of Elisha
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss 2 Kings chapters 1 through 4 which tell of the prophetic mantle being passed from Elijah to Elisha. With Dana Pike, D. Kelly Ogden, Thomas Wayment, and Keith Wilson.

episodes.title: 2 Kgs. 4-9: The Ministry of Elisha
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss miracles the prophet Elisha performed in 2 Kings chapters 4 through 9 including promising a child to a barren woman, raising the dead, and healing leprosy. With Dana Pike, D. Kelly Ogden, Thomas Wayment, and Keith Wilson.

episodes.title: Amos 1-9: The Book of Amos
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the book of Amos which details Amos' calling from God to prophesy and preach in the Kingdom of Judah. With Dana Pike, D. Kelly Ogden, Thomas Wayment, and Keith Wilson.

episodes.title: Jonah 1-4: The Book of Jonah
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Jonah’s prophetic calling and his attempts to run from it in order to save himself from the hands of the Assyrians as described in the book of Jonah. With Dana Pike, D. Kelly Ogden, Thomas Wayment, and Keith Wilson.

episodes.title: Hosea 1-14: The Book of Hosea
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the book of Hosea which details the marriage of Hosea and the scattering and gathering of his family and how it parallels God and the Israelites. With Terry Ball, Victor Ludlow, Richard Draper, and Keith Wilson.

episodes.title: Micah 1-7 & Joel 1-3: The Books of Micah and Joel
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the prophecies about and for the Israelites that are still applicable in the latter days as found in the books of Micah and Joel. With Terry Ball, Victor Ludlow, Richard Draper, and Keith Wilson.

episodes.title: Fall of N. Kingdom and Preservation of S. Kingdom
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss 2 Kings chapters 14 through 20 which detail the political strife that leads to the fall of the Northern Kingdom of Israel and the lost ten tribes of Israel. With Terry Ball, Victor Ludlow, Richard Draper, and Keith Wilson.

episodes.title: Isa. 1-6: Great Are the Words of Isaiah--Part 1
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the life and prophetic calling of Isaiah and his master of symbolic poetry in teaching gospel principles and prophecies in Isaiah chapters 1 through 6. With Terry Ball, Victor Ludlow, Richard Draper, and Keith Wilson.

episodes.title: Isa. 7-12: Great Are the Words of Isaiah--Part 2
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Isaiah chapters 7 through 12 which provide Isaiah’s Messianic prophecies amidst politic conflict and destruction that abound in the land. With Terry Ball, Victor Ludlow, D. Kelly Ogden, and Terrence Szink.

episodes.title: Isa. 13-23: Great Are the Words of Isaiah--Part 3
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Isaiah chapters 13 through 23 which prophecy the destruction of Babylon, Moab, Damascus, Egypt, and Jerusalem and the gathering of Israel in the last days. With Terry Ball, Victor Ludlow, D. Kelly Ogden, and Terrence Szink.

episodes.title: Isa. 24-35: Great Are the Words of Isaiah--Part 4
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the prophecies regarding the Second Coming and Christ’s reign during the Millennium as described in Isaiah chapters 24 through 35. With Terry Ball, Victor Ludlow, D. Kelly Ogden, and Terrence Szink.

episodes.title: Isa. 36-44: Great Are the Words of Isaiah--Part 5
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Isaiah chapters 36 through 44 which detail Isaiah’s counsel to Hezekiah, the Lord protecting Judah, and Hezekiah’s life extending 15 more years. With Terry Ball, Victor Ludlow, D. Kelly Ogden, and Terrence Szink.

episodes.title: Isa. 45-52: Great Are the Words of Isaiah--Part 6
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the role of Jehovah as the Savior, the destruction of Babylon, and Zion in the last days as described in Isaiah chapters 45 through 52. With Terry Ball, Victor Ludlow, Clyde Williams, and Michael Rhodes.

episodes.title: Isa. 52-62: Great Are the Words of Isaiah--Part 7
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the covenants to be established in the latter days and the lessons available in temples to prepare for the Second Coming in Isaiah chapters 52 through 62. With Terry Ball, Victor Ludlow, Clyde Williams, and Michael Rhodes.

episodes.title: Judah's Return to Wickedness
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Isaiah chapters 63 through 66 which tell of Christ’s Millennial reign and 2 Kings chapters 21 through 25 which detail the wicked acts of King Manasseh. With Terry Ball, Victor Ludlow, Clyde Williams, and Michael Rhodes.

episodes.title: The Books of Nahum, Zephaniah, and Habakkuk
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the books of Nahum, Zephaniah, and Habakkuk which detail the destruction of many lands and prophecy of the Second Coming of Christ. With Ray Huntington, Dana Pike, David Whitchurch, and D. Kelly Ogden.

episodes.title: Jer. 1-17: The Prophet Jeremiah--Part 1
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the hesitancy Jeremiah expressed after his prophetic calling and his preaching as described in Jeremiah chapters 1 through 17. With Ray Huntington, Dana Pike, David Whitchurch, and D. Kelly Ogden.

episodes.title: Jer. 18-29: The Prophet Jeremiah--Part 2
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Jeremiah chapters 18 through 29 which detail the struggles and rejection Jeremiah experiences as he preaches repentance to the children of Israel. With Ray Huntington, Dana Pike, David Whitchurch, and D. Kelly Ogden.

episodes.title: Jer. 29-42: The Prophet Jeremiah--Part 3
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the oncoming captivity of the Jews and the scattering and gathering of Israel as described in Jeremiah chapters 29 through 42. With Ray Huntington, Dana Pike, David Whitchurch, and D. Kelly Ogden.

episodes.title: Ezek. 1-11: The Prophet Ezekiel--Part 1
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Ezekiel chapters 1 through 11 which detail Ezekiel’s vision and prophetic calling and his preaching to the Israelites in captivity. With Andrew Skinner, Victor Ludlow, Dana Pike, and Richard Draper.

episodes.title: Ezek. 12-33: The Prophet Ezekiel--Part 2
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Ezekiel’s use of prophetic reenactments to preach to the Israelites in captivity and call them to repentance as described in Ezekiel chapters 12 through 33. With Andrew Skinner, Victor Ludlow, Dana Pike, and Richard Draper.

episodes.title: Ezek. 33-48: The Prophet Ezekiel--Part 3
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Ezekiel chapters 33 through 48 which detail the fulfilling of Ezekiel’s prophecies regarding the destruction of Jerusalem and the doctrine of repentance. With Andrew Skinner, Victor Ludlow, Dana Pike, and Richard Draper.

episodes.title: Dan. 1-12: The Book of Daniel
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the example of wisdom and understanding of Daniel as he lives in Babylon under the reign of Nebuchadnezzar as found in the book of Daniel. With Andrew Skinner, Victor Ludlow, Dana Pike, and Richard Draper.

episodes.title: Ezra 1-6: The Return of Exiles
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Ezra chapters 1 through 6 which detail the Israelite return to Jerusalem after King Cyrus of Persia overtakes Babylon. With Dana Pike, Eric Huntsman, Kent Brown, and David Whitchurch.

episodes.title: Hag. 1-2: The Book of Haggai
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the command to rebuild the temple and the delayed obedience of the Jews after their return to Jerusalem in the book of Haggai. With Dana Pike, Eric Huntsman, Kent Brown, and David Whitchurch.

episodes.title: Zech. 1-8: The Visions of Zechariah
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the interpretations and applications of the eight visions of Zechariah as found Zechariah chapters 1 through 8. With Dana Pike, Eric Huntsman, Kent Brown, and David Whitchurch.

episodes.title: Zech. 9-14: The Prophet Zechariah
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Zechariah chapters 9 through 14 which detail Zechariah’s Messianic and latter-day revelations he delivered to Jerusalem. With Dana Pike, Eric Huntsman, Kent Brown, and David Whitchurch.

episodes.title: Esth. 1-10: The Book of Esther
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Esther’s faith, courage, and example as described in the book of Esther where she risks her life to plead for the lives of the Jews in the Persian kingdom. With Dana Pike, D. Kelly Ogden, Kent Brown, and Gaye Strathearn.

episodes.title: Mal. 1-4: The Book of Malachi
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the preaching of Malachi to Jerusalem on the responsibilities they hold as God’s chosen people as found in Malachi chapters 1 through 4. With Dana Pike, D. Kelly Ogden, Kent Brown, and Gaye Strathearn.

episodes.title: Mal. 4 & Ezra 7-10: Renewing the Covenant
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Elijah’s role in preparing for Christ’s second coming in Malachi chapter 4 and Ezra’s work among the Israelites in Jerusalem in Ezra chapters 7 through 10. With Dana Pike, D. Kelly Ogden, Kent Brown, and Gaye Strathearn.

episodes.title: Neh. 1-13: The Book of Nehemiah
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the book of Nehemiah which details King Artaxerxes trust in Nehemiah as a cupbearer and to rebuild the walls surrounding the city of Jerusalem. With Dana Pike, D. Kelly Ogden, Kent Brown, and Gaye Strathearn.

episodes.title: Between the Testaments
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the historical events and religious writings that document the times and people between the Old and New Testaments. With Dana Pike, D. Kelly Ogden, Kent Brown, and Gaye Strathearn.

a5d5a631-d2b5-48e6-a0e9-069d50a5524b.description: Journalist Todd Hansen travels across the US to collect life-changing stories from everyday people.

episodes.title: The Trek Begins
episodes.description: The spin of a pen sends Todd Hansen knocking on strangers' doors, where he finds amazing stories from everyday people like the Bear family, Elaine and Doug Alder, and Floyd Hunt.

episodes.title: Excited about Nothing
episodes.description: Todd braves single-digit temperatures in Colorado to find amazing stories from Cecil Gardner and the Hogan family and even his own private rap concert with the Cunninghams.

episodes.title: Yesterday I Was In Jail
episodes.description: Todd ends up at the home of Troy Riley, who was in jail just a few hours earlier. Todd hears the inspiring story of Jamie Pluta. He is invited into the Salway home where Brandi runs a cookie business.

episodes.title: It's My Country
episodes.description: Todd meets Ed Pacha, a WWII veteran who tells his amazing story, and the Killen family opens up about their life. Todd meets a Floridian glass harp player.

episodes.title: A Tragic Twist
episodes.description: Todd Hansen heads to Tooele, Utah, where he meets a rapper named Michael Espinoza. Todd also meets Clar Hansen, a prayerful mechanic. A Vietnam War veteran named Jay Jeppesen shows off his miniature train set.

episodes.title: Every Day Is for Them
episodes.description: Todd goes to Searcy, Arkansas and meets Bindi Barnett, an immigrant mother from India who has overcome incredible odds to keep her children safe. Todd heads to Beebe and interviews Jerry Greer, a trucker who experienced a health scare.

episodes.title: Losing a Loved One
episodes.description: Todd meets Vicki Darais, who’s personal tragedy inspired her to be a physical therapist to help others. He also talks to Aiken, Minnesota native Michele Piispanen and her health struggles.

episodes.title: The Big Apple
episodes.description: Todd travels to Ohio and meets widower Chuck LaPrad, who tells the love story of he and his wife, Jean, and their 54 years of marriage. Bob Placier of Chillicothe, Ohio talks about his model airplane hobby.

episodes.title: Olympic Dreams
episodes.description: Todd Hansen trudges through the Utah snow to find stories, like aviator Dave Mueller. He discusses how he handles the trauma of a plane crash through therapeutic painting. Todd also meets Tanisha Jackson and Jeremy Hansen, survivors of gang violence.

episodes.title: A Rude Awakening
episodes.description: Todd Hansen goes to Auburn, California and interviews Allen Cassidy, a friendly do-gooder for the less fortunate in the neighborhood. Claudia Castro of Roseville shares how she stays positive when times get tough.

episodes.title: Extra Special Day
episodes.description: Todd interviews returned missionaries and their experience with coming home. Cherice and Rick Foster share about their son Ryan, Paulina and Eric Smith talk about their love story, and Kyle Norton talks about his unique family.

episodes.title: Light Where There Was No Light
episodes.description: Todd Hansen goes to Ogden and meets Josh Hurst on the street. Josh had a near-death experience that left him disabled, but recovered miraculously with the help of his mother. Ashlee Egbert tells about her recovery after abuse and drug addiction.

episodes.title: I Miss Him Every Day
episodes.description: Todd meets an artist named Jonathan Kort in Neotsu, Oregon, who speaks about his mental health. In Lincoln City, Todd interviews Loretta Glaze about keeping faith in times of struggle.

episodes.title: Culture Shock
episodes.description: Host Todd Hansen visits Herriman, Utah to hear the story of Dave Johnston, an Air Force veteran with a passion for genealogy. In Draper, Jennie Bethers tells of her years as a former gymnast and TV commercial star.

episodes.title: Be Good. Be Smart. Be Careful.
episodes.description: In the small town of Carlisle, Pennsylvania, Todd meets Sharon Carey, a single mother who provides hope to her family despite ongoing health issues. Over in Gettysburg, Carolyn Mintmier speaks about her troubled past and the power of gratitude.

episodes.title: Quest for a Story
episodes.description: In the quiet town of Lebanon, Connecticut, host Todd Hansen meets local resident Cheryl Wilhelm and learns about her journey to find joy in life despite troubled relationships.

episodes.title: The "Perfect" Family
episodes.description: In Payson, Utah, host Todd Hansen hears from Ryan Deems, a recovering addict who discovered how puppetry helped him with his recovery.

episodes.title: Protecting Strangers
episodes.description: Through quiet towns in rural Washington, host Todd Hansen meets Tom Barkholz and learns of his rocky journey to fatherhood.

episodes.title: A Better Life
episodes.description: In Saratoga Springs, Utah, Todd hears stories from Connie Server about her days traveling through Ellis Island in the early 20th century.

episodes.title: A Marvelous Experience

episodes.title: The Random Virtuoso
episodes.description: In the neighborhoods of Salt Lake City, host Todd Hansen hears stories from Nick Beddoes about his experience with addiction and from Erich Graf about his time as a flutist in the Utah Symphony.

episodes.title: Tough Love
episodes.description: On the Great Plains of South Dakota, Todd interviews Slim McNaught and learns of his experiences as a leatherworker and his passion for cowboy poetry.
