episodes.description: Pumpkin carving, joke-telling, and foreign foods send the competitors into a frenzy. Troy meets a relative nicknamed Wonder Woman while Michael finds a like-minded relative. One team has a target on their backs approaching the finale.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: A sudden rule change makes navigation even harder. Michael meets his first maternal relative and sees a picture of his mother for the first time. Troy finally finds an emotional answer to his biggest family mystery.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: Teams Black and Red head to California while Teams Green and Blue head to South Carolina to face off in an obstacle course challenge. Rebecca finds a family member she has been waiting for since she was five years old.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: The competition intensifies as Team Black receives immunity and the remaining teams compete for first place. Nicole meets her first relative in the race. Michael meets a life-changing family member.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: With only three teams remaining, the pressure to navigate well is on. John finds out that he is the missing link to a line his relatives have been searching for. Relative Race history is made when two teams experience an unexpected twist.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: After nine tough days of travel, challenges, and new family members, the three remaining teams return to Washington D.C. to compete in a final challenge to determine who takes home the grand prize of $50,000.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Four new teams begin a new race with an athletic challenge. Team Black trains like ninjas, Paris does some farm work, and Tiffany and Josh get some army experience. Michael gets some emotional answers he never expected.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: The teams compete in a water balloon challenge. Team Black learns about their grandfather from an unexpected source, Josh learns his family name, and Preshious connects with a new family member who answers her questions.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: One team discusses going home after all the teams struggle with a difficult challenge. Preshious gets a birthday surprise from her new family. Jerica and Joe try glass blowing with their relatives.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Emotions run high as one team is eliminated and another team gets sick and may not be able to continue. The challenge requires them to work on their impressions. Preshious learns more about her father’s side of the family.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: Team Black narrowly avoids disaster and another team meets a brother for the very first time. Michael tours a submarine with his newfound relative. Paris helps his relatives find family members of their own.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: The teams are tested on their lip-reading skills. Team Red discovers a military connection while Team Black goes water tubing and Team Green sees a cherished family photo for the very first time.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: All of the teams test their trivia and archery skills in order to find more relatives and earn immunity. Team Black goes camping with their relatives. Preshious is surprised with a huge family reunion. Michael gets some closure.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: Even with immunity, Team Black faces pressure as they race to earn a coveted prize. Austen connects with a relative who’s closer than expected. Team Green goes to the batting cages with their new relative.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: Preshious gets the answers she’s been searching for from her most important relative yet and two teams face elimination. Joe and Jerica go mountain biking with their new family. Michael and Austen go ax throwing.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: The final two teams face off in Philadelphia in an epic scavenger hunt, racing to solve riddles, earn the $50,000 prize, and be crowned the champion of Relative Race.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Four new teams take off from St. Louis with a startling twist at the starting line. Chonta discovers her Southern roots. Marcus learns Arkansas is a state and takes part in a family dance-off.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: Teams Red and Blue battle heavy rain and compete head-to-head in a building block challenge. Kaley and Kristin go back to driving school with their relative. Demetrius has an emotional meeting with his first paternal relative.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: All the teams must “smell” their way to victory competing in a blindfolded challenge. Maria’s life is changed forever. Kaley and Kristin connect with their family at a recording studio. Marcus meets his mom’s brother for the first time.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Team Green gets a geography lesson. All teams carefully balance their way through a challenge. Demetrius discovers another relative on his dad’s side and Maria attends a special surprise birthday party.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: The teams show off their singing abilities. Marcus meets the person who linked him to his father. Elizabeth discovers her Dad’s side of the family. Team Black finds out twins run in their family.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: With immunity on the line, a “hamster-like” challenge has the teams rolling in all directions. Chonta is surprised by an emotional cousin. Team Red plays hockey, Team Green camps and learns to wakeboard, and Team Black learns about baseball.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: The teams display their art skills in a challenge. Elizabeth's emotions are tested with a close relative. The twins continue their journey and meet a key relative in the search for their father. Marcus connects with his father's side of the family.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: The teams are faced with a marble challenge and their teamwork is tested. Keith and Marcus visit Las Vegas for the first time. Elizabeth meets a close relative on her mother's side. Maria gets overwhelmed by the pressure of the competition.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: An audible memory challenge stumps the teams. Demetrius meets a key paternal relative in Chicago. Marcus and his Dad share a heartwarming discovery. A trip to Day 10 is on the line for two teams with two strikes!

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: After nine days on the road, the remaining teams face off in the desert of Tucson, Arizona for the $50,000 prize. They are challenged in cowboy-themed skills, like quick-draw gun duels, rock climbing, corn shucking, and a cattle roundup.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: The teams begin the race by meeting at the Virginia International Raceway and must work together as a pit crew. Raymond and DeShae meet their first biological relative, and Anitra gets closer to finding her parents. JD receives difficult news.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: A costly penalty puts three teams at a complete standstill on the road. A medieval challenge launches the teams into a fierce battle. Anitra finally discovers her family name. Raymond gets some important answers he’s been seeking about his mother.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: The challenge requires them to decipher baby talk. Jenn learns more about her grandfather. Raymond gets more answers, DeShae learns her family name, and Anitra learns about her adoption story.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: A physical challenge pushes all the teams to their limits, and one team over the edge! Ray meets an important relative with connections to his mother. JD discovers his closest relative yet. Deshaye takes a huge step in finding her parents.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: After a slacklining challenge, Team Green gets a riverboat tour with their new family. Anitra gets answers about her parents. Ray learns all about his mother’s extraordinary legacy.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: A surprise envelope changes the game for all four teams! A movie theater, popcorn, and emojis mix for a hilarious and competitive challenge. JD meets a campsite full of relatives! Deshaye meets a name she's wondered about her whole life.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: With immunity in hand, Team Blue plays a new game. The teams test out their acting skills in a charades challenge. Anitra meets a close connection to her father. DeShae and Raymond both finally get the tearful reunions they've been waiting for.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: The teams are challenged to see how much they think alike. Despite being out of the race, JD meets one final relative who changes his life. DeShae catches up with a long-awaited relative. Anitra learns about the paratroopers in her family.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: A unique challenge puts the three remaining teams' smarts and stomachs to the ultimate test. Raymond meets close family and gets the answer to who his father is. Anitra's journey comes to a close with an emotional reunion.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: After nine days on the road filled with meeting new family, two teams suit back up in their racing gear. Going head-to-head in a series of racing challenges at the world's largest indoor speedway, one team will win the $50,000 grand prize.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Four new teams compete to find relatives and a chance to win $50,000. For the first time, contestants can use a GPS unit, but there's a catch. Kacey meets her first biological relatives. The twins get key information about their mother.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: A life-size puzzle has the teams scrambling to work together. Monika learns more about her mom and what happened when she was adopted. Elizabeth makes a discovery that launches a quest to find three siblings.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Team Green chooses one team to take a lofty penalty. Teams chip and putt their way through a tedious golf challenge. Monika finds out just how big her family is. The twins find a relative who has been searching for them for 20 years.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: A basketball-inspired challenge leaves one team shooting long-distance air balls. Kacey's musical roots hit a high note with a close family member. Devin comes closer to narrowing down who his father may be.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: The feud between Teams Green and Black has Kacey breaking out the war paint. The teams struggle to find balance in a difficult tandem challenge. Monika learns she was missed by her biological family. The twins learn about their mom.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: Immunity is on the line as the teams race for first place. Monika meets an important relative from her mother's side. Kacey reads a letter her sibling wrote for her 20 years ago. Liz's life is transformed forever with the surprise of her life.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: Team Red's immunity prize causes friction among the teams. Monika helps bridge a gap on her mother's side of the family. Liz visits her grandmother’s grave, and Devin meets a special relative with answers about his biological father.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: Joe and Anthony meet a relative with important answers about who their mother is and why they were put up for adoption. Sean finds a connection with his biological father, who served in the military. Liz completes her family tree.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: Sean discovers a relative with connections to his dad who died in the military. The twins finally meet the one person they've been desperately searching for their entire lives. But with strikes on the line, one team will say goodbye to the race.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: The season culminates in the Rocky Mountains with a bevy of challenges that push the teams to fight to the end for the championship title and the grand prize of $50,000. And a surprise ending shows just how much the teams care about each other.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Four teams set out from Nashville, Tennessee in search of family connections. JT discovers his occupation might run in his family while Stephen meets an uncle with heavy answers to his past and a mysterious name that he must find.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: A first-place victory allows Team Green to dish out a costly penalty to another team. The twins find someone who’s been searching for them for 25 years and learn devastating news. Stephen sees an old photo with five men, one of which is his father.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Team Black battles snow and altitude sickness on the road. An oversized bowling challenge has the teams crushing pins and the competition. Jarrell learns his mother's identity and where she came from.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Team Green’s string of 1st place victories becomes a concerning pattern for the other teams. JT adds to his total of biological brothers and learns about his father. Stephen learns he was never forgotten and is given a photo he lost as a child.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: A difficult challenge has the teams scooping and hooping their way against the clock. Jarrell meets the person who fostered his mother when he was an infant. JT learns devastating news about his family’s past.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: A sudoku-type challenge has the teams counting and second-guessing their math skills. After getting lost, Stephen and Susan have a multi-layered family surprise. The twins learn more about their father through a close connection.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: Team Black makes a critical navigation mistake that could cost them. Stephen meets another family member with information about a second sister. And Jarrell makes a surprise entrance for a Mother's Day celebration.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: The lineup for a Day 10 showdown begins to take shape. Team Red uses their golden ticket to meet one more relative. Kaleigh finds surprising information about her Italian roots. The twins and Stephen discover long-lost sisters.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: Stephen receives a warm welcome into a new family. The twins use their golden ticket to finish the quest to find their biological father. JT completes his journey with a surprise-filled visit with another brother. The showdown for Day 10 is set.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: Two teams raced through a 9-day road trip, meeting their biological family along the way. Now, in Prescott, Arizona, they compete in food-themed challenges for the grand prize of $50,000 and the title of Relative Race Champions.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: The teams kick off the season by giving service to a local family. Tiffani finally learns her last name, Layton learns more details about her father, and Angie learns the truth about her mother.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description:
Angie learns about her roots in Pennsylvania, 
while Tiffani connects with her family through 
pictures. Rachelle learns more about her 
father and discovers that dancing is in her 
DNA.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description:
Kyle gets surprised with a relative he never 
expected. Rachelle solves another mystery in 
the search for her father and Angie learns a 
heartbreaking story.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Layton meets her first relative from her mother's side. Tiffani finds a name on her family tree that leaves her speechless.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description:
Team Red keeps the kindness going. Tiffani 
receives a family heirloom and hears about 
her father’s life from someone very special. 
Karim makes an unexpected acquaintance.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description:
Food starts flying during a messy challenge. 
Angie meets someone who has been waiting 
for her. Layton makes a surprise entrance to a 
birthday party that will change her life forever.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description:
The three remaining teams compete in a 
baseball challenge that puts their throwing 
skills to the test. Rachelle adds another sibling 
to her growing family tree and Jose learns 
about his deep cultural roots.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description:
Tiffani meets a relative with connections on 
both sides of her family. Kyle boards a train 
car to find a family member he never knew 
existed.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: Team Red gives a penalty. Kyle and Layton take a risky shortcut. Tiffani discovers family is closer than she thought. Rachelle receives a letter with life-changing answers.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: The final two teams face off in an amusement park in Alabama for a chance to win the $50,000 prize and the title of Relative Race Champions.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Four teams' journey of a lifetime starts in North Carolina. But before the race begins, one team receives some shocking news.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: The photo subject for the day spurs intense competition and strikes a personal chord for Scott and Hannah (Team Green). Jamie and Jansen (Team Black) discover that their long-lost family are closer than they imagined.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Shawn and Curtis (Team Blue) are shocked to learn Shawn's father is still alive. Jamie (Team Black) finds someone he’s been searching his entire life for. A photo saves a team from a strike.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Day 4 starts with big surprises for Teams Red, Blue and Black. Team Red picks up a unique passenger while Team Green reflects on how blessed they are. Alex meets his closest relative yet and the Photo Challenge proves to be the difference.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: Alex celebrates his sister’s birthday with a heartfelt song. Teams Red, Green and Blue all find close connections waiting for them. Jamie from Team Black has a life-changing discovery.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: The morning starts with a surprise relative for Alex. Team Photos are filled with patriotic pride while all the teams get excited for their challenge.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: Immunity is on the line and the teams push themselves to the limit. Jaime from Team Red has perhaps his most important family member waiting for him back at home in Brooklyn.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: Team Red navigates New York City traffic. Jansen introduces his dad to an entirely new meaning for "the smell of victory." Team Green gets an unexpected and emotional phone call.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: Team Red gets caught up in NYC freeway traffic so they resort to surface streets to save them from a fatal strike. Team Black gets surprised with a family reunion.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: The three remaining teams face extreme weather in upstate New York as they face the waters of Lake George. A surprising twist adds an additional member to each team for the final showdown.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Four teams kick off Season 11 with a heavy equipment challenge. Team Red's Thaddeus gets a huge surprise a the first door he knocks on. Nolin from Team Green learns key information about his adoption.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: A remote control challenge has the teams flying high for points. Thadeuss discovers that his love for art runs throughout his biological family. Carolen meets a cousin with heartbreaking news. Nolin meets two brothers with amazing stories.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Thaddeus sees a picture of his birth mother for the first time. Tia meets a sister. Jon experiences a flood of emotions after meeting a brother.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Tia and Carolen (Team Black) have a major setback. Nolin meets his birth father. Kentrelle opens his heart as two new family members welcome him with open arms.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: Emotions run high as the race reaches the halfway point. Carolen meets a sister with knowledge about their family. Nolin learns the truth about the circumstances surrounding his adoption.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: Tia (Team Black) sees pictures of her mother for the first time. Kentrelle (Team Blue) struggles with new information about his birth mother. Thaddeus (Team Red) is surprised when he meets a special relative.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: Jon (Team Blue) meets a relative he's been waiting to meet his whole life. Nolin (Team Green) discovers more siblings. Tia (Team Black) finds out about her long-lost brother.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: Thaddeus (Team Red) returns to his hometown to find a deep connection. Nolin (Team Green) seems to meet his twin. Carolen (Team Black) meets her father while Kantrelle (Team Blue) finds out how much he has in common with his birth mom.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: Tia (Team Black) meets a long lost sister while Jon (Team Blue) adds a third brother to his list of family. Nolin (Team Green) has an emotional moment when he finally meets his mother and Thaddeus (Team Red) meets his mother at a hospital.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: In the season finale, three teams suit up for the ultimate challenge at a fire fighter training facility. Things get hot as teams compete to put out a blaze as the teams compete to conduct a rescue in a three story building to win the grand prize.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: A new season kicks off with four new teams embarking on the journey of a lifetime. Tears flow for Team Blue as they get answers to questions they’ve had their whole lives. Team Red discovers that one of their talents is a family trait.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: On day two, the teams complete a challenge that leaves them hanging. Teams Green and Red both receive devastating news.Teams Black and Blue discover family secrets and stories.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: On day three, the teams struggle to complete their most difficult challenge so far. Teams Blue and Red each meet an unexpected family member, while Team Black recognizes immediately who’s waiting at the door.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: On day four, the teams continue their quest to solve family mysteries. Teams Black and Red receive bittersweet news, while Teams Green and Blue are amazed to see striking resemblances in their newfound families.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: The teams complete a big picture for day five’s challenge. Teams Red and Green feel more part of their families’ background, while Teams Blue and Black feel their family circle expand around them.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: Day six brings new challenges and new family meetings. Team Black celebrates a big birthday with an incredible surprise, Team Red gets challenging news, and Teams Green and Blue connect with new cousins.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: Things keep popping for the teams on day seven. Despite winning the benefit the day before, Team Blue is delayed due to an injury. Teams Green and Red learn more about their parents from cousins. Team Black instantly recognizes their new family.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: The teams are plunging forward as they head into day eight. Teams Blue and Black have emotional connections with people they knew before while Teams Green and Red get surprised by more than they ever dreamed.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: On day nine, the teams stick together in hopes of reaching day 10. Teams Green, Black and Blue all receive the final piece of their family puzzles, while Team Red learns more about their impressive family legacy.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: On the final day of Relative Race, all four teams get a special surprise that bring them even closer. At the Forge Adventure Park outside Chicago, three teams will have to compete in three challenges to see who will take home the grand prize.

episodes.title: Family
episodes.description: Host Dan Debenham, Season 3 alum Rebecca, and Season 6 alumni JD and Jenn light the world through a special visit at a care facility.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Season 13 kicks off medieval-style in Nashville, Tennessee with new faces, new cars, and new rules. Abe (Team Blue) and Ashlee (Team Black) both meet their brothers, but Abe gets devastating news.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: Fueled by yesterday’s defeat, Team Green fights to get back in the competition. Team Red and Team Blue go head-to-head in Deerfield, Illinois. Ashlee (Team Black) discovers an uncanny resemblance to her grandmother.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Team Green gives the other teams a penalty as Team Red struggles to stay in the race. Team Black meets an extra special relative. Jo (Team Green) meets her grandfather and Justin (Team Red) meets his sister who gives him disappointing news.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Teams Green and Red work to communicate better. All teams play chicken with a new set of challenges. Ashlee (Team Black) and Jo (Team Green) meet family members that have been waiting for them their whole lives.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: The halfway point finds Team Blue with a crucial advantage over the other teams. Justin finds a close relative, Ashlee finds more information about her mother, and both Jo and Eric find siblings.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: Teams Green and Black get freaked out at the challenge. Justin finds a first cousin and Ashlee discovers a niece. Eric has multiple life-changing moments, including learning his father's name.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: Jo has a surprise birthday party! Day 7's challenge is out of this world. Abe meets his first relative from his mother's side of the family. Jo and Justin both find new siblings. Ashlee and Brennan meet cousins who share home videos.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: James receives a letter he never expected while Team Blue is excited to head into Manhattan. Today's challenge is the toughest one yet. Jo, Justin, and Ashlee all meet new sisters. Abe and Eric race to a Manhattan rooftop to meet Eric's cousin.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: All the Teams are anxious to find out who will be heading to Day 10. Ashlee reads the final passages of her mom’s journal. The day ends with a big surprise!

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: On the final day of Relative Race, each team is looking to secure the grand prize. Team Red has renewed strength after finding out they made it to Day 10. After a series of medieval-themed challenges, Dan reveals the winner of Season 13.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Dan welcomes the new teams to a new season of Relative Race at Pangaea Studios in Atlanta, Georgia. After a game of "Guess That Movie Line" the teams get on the road, ready to start their journeys of meeting new family members.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: Team Black is blocked by a bridge, and three teams have to collect 'city selfies.' Teams then must complete feats of smarts and strength before meeting long lost relatives.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Our teams start this episode with a tough challenge that leaves them in a pickle. If they succeed, they will be rewarded with a special surprise. One competitor finally fulfills their dream of meeting their long lost father.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: One contestant bids bittersweet farewell to a their relative. Then, the teams must play golf, but with a twist that is anything but par for the course.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: Team Blue gets a flying lesson. Today's challenge has teams smashing down doors. Johnny meets his first relative, and another contestant meets two relatives.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: Families share tearful goodbyes before teams continue their journey. Contestants must '"work the red carpet" before they can meet more family members. A new team takes the lead.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: As the teams prepare to embark on Day 7, Laura Jean has a surprise for her relatives that will change their lives. Due to health concerns, Team Black has to make a difficult decision. Team Red gets devastating news.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: As the race nears its end, each team is hungry for the number one position. Despite winning an advantage, Team Blue gets lost finding their relative. Team Red turns the tables and answers questions for their relative.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: The teams prepare for their last day of traveling and reflect on the relatives they've met. Teams blue and green meet maternal relatives. Team Red meets the last relative they were looking for.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: In a thrilling conclusion to this cinematic season, Teams Blue, Green, and Red compete in movie-set challenges to determine the ultimate winner. Filled with movie magic, explosive endings, and a surprise reunion, this finale is a showstopper.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Season 15 begins with a bang as the new teams complete their first challenge on the USS New Jersey. The rules of the race have changed once again, keeping the contestants on their toes as they meet new family members for the first time.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: Jen and Leland (Team Green) make a special stop with Jen's father before hitting the road. Team Red seeks to keep their lead intact but struggles with the challenge. David and Dan both meet very special relatives.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Fresh off their Day 2 victory, Gabby from Team Black has a full-circle moment with her relatives. Dan from Team Red meets someone he's been searching decades for.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Team Red’s Kayli meets a crucial member of her family. Team Black’s David meets a nephew who notices a family resemblance, while Teams Green and Blue meet relatives they didn’t know existed.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: A health scare jeopardizes a team’s ability to continue in the race. Joanie and Dan learn more about their family origins from their relatives. David receives the answers he's been searching for.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: In a Relative Race first, a new contestant joins a team mid-race. Each team feels the pressure to complete the challenge despite tricky penalties. Dan finds a special relative who reveals important information about his father.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: Teams Black and Red set out with two strikes and a burning determination to avoid a third. Team Green dusts off their history knowledge while Team Blue learns more about their family's military service. Team Red has its most emotional meeting yet.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: Nearing the end of the race, Teams Blue and Green are fighting for first place. Team Red receives a precious gift from Kayli's father. Team Green meets the last piece of her paternal family tree, while Team Black meets more of David's family.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: Following a whirlwind day of challenges and travels, Team Red finishes their journey with a full-circle moment. Teams Green and Blue meet long awaited relatives and David from Team Black receives a special gift.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: Team Black receives a heartwarming surprise. After driving tanks through an obstacle course, the race comes down to two teams vying for the $50,000 grand prize.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Season 16 launches with success as all four teams start the race off in Alabama with the challenge "Launch it Like it's Hot!" Team Black receives some shocking news that leaves them with more questions than answers.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: After a penalty from the winners, Team Black gets stuck in traffic. Jerry uncovers mysteries about his siblings. Team Red makes a TikTok with their new relative.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Team Green connects with a niece and learns some devastating news. Team Black connects with relatives at the skating rink. The winners are faced with a decision of which team to give their award to.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: A hairstyling competition goes awry for Team Green who enjoy a joyful reunion with their new relative. Meanwhile, Jerry from Team Blue is proud to learn he shares a military legacy with his grandfather.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: Andrae’a from Team Red is counting on her husband’s experience as a locomotive engineer to give her team an edge in the challenge. Team Black shares an emotional reunion with a relative who had long prayed for the chance to see Sadie again.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: When just one second separates first from second place, the tension is high, but emotions run even higher when Jerry reveals which relative he met. Candis, from Team Red, is moved to tears upon learning of the passing of her biological grandmother.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: Team Blue swaps roles with their family member, sharing all they’ve learned about their loved ones. Meanwhile, Team Green’s Hillary forms a deep connection as she learns about her mother through the stories of a long-lost relative.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: Team Red’s Candis finally sees a photo of her birth mother. Jerry from Team Blue meets his first paternal relative, and Hilary gets a heartfelt surprise gift from her newly found family.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: It’s the final chance for the Relative Race teams to meet family members, and emotions are at an all-time high. Sadie and Candis both find themselves deeply moved as their journeys lead to powerful moments of connection and compassion.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: On Day 10, teams compete for $50,000 through space-themed challenges, facing moon-walking simulators, tackling space trivia, and navigating demanding spaceship courses.

episodes.title: He Was the First to Hold Me
episodes.description: Sadie meets Devin and Robin, her biological grandparents, and finds more about the day she was born.

episodes.title: I Finally Met My Father
episodes.description: After meeting multiple relatives, Candis meets the one she’s waited her whole life for: her father.

episodes.title: I Met My Mother for the First Time
episodes.description: Sadie and her adoptive brother Jake finally meet Aunya, Sadie’s birth mother, in an emotional reunion.

episodes.title: My Father Would Have Kept Me
episodes.description: After decades without knowing the identity of his father, Jerry meets Bruce, his biological dad, who had no idea Jerry was his son until recently.

episodes.title: Why Did You Let Me Go?
episodes.description: Hillary meets her birth father in an emotional reunion and learns why she was put up for adoption.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Season 17 launches with a treasure hunt deep in the caverns of Luray, Virginia. As the contestants start their road trips across the country in search of family and $50,000, they reflect on what a newfound family would mean to them.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: Team Red makes their first misstep, while Team Green dodges a mystery penalty. Jeremy finds a relative that looks familiar.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Reeling from the previous day, Jeremy finds hope in his newest relative. Matt meets a relative he never thought existed. Team Green manages to stay on top of the latest challenge, giving the other teams something to buzz about.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Team Black falters in the latest challenge, but regains momentum when teammate Nikia realizes the competition is far more personal than just supporting Meyet.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: Information about his father brings Matt to a relative that holds the key to his own past. The latest challenge tests all four teams’ bonds and forces Sean to reevaluate his goals.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: Meyet discovers a unique connection to Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Sean learns why he was unable to find his father. After decades, Jeremy finally finds the person he’s been searching for.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: Matt makes a connection that will change his life forever. Meyet’s accuracy in the throwing challenge and Nikia’s precision in the blade-swinging challenge may not be enough to lift them to victory.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: Matt attends a family event for the first time. Meyet and Sean find relatives they’ve spent decades searching for. Team Green attempts to secure the prize money in today’s challenge.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: Sean finds a relative who has traveled thousands of miles just to meet him. Meyet experiences her most special meeting on the race. The Red Team pushes themselves in their most difficult challenge yet.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: As the competition wraps up, the teams gather at Natural Bridge Caverns in San Antonio, Texas to reflect on their journeys. Then, the race for $50,000 culminates in a series of challenges that will decide everything.

0aea4804-47dc-470f-b80a-35c8f23d0f27.description: Three young sleuths work together to unveil secrets and strange things going on in their small town.

episodes.title: Granite Flats Trailer
episodes.description: Watch the trailer for Granite Flats.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.description: Arthur Milligan and his mother move to Granite Flats, Colorado where they hope to find peace and quiet in the midst of the Cold War.  An explosion rocks the town as well as the local army base.

episodes.title: Empty Box
episodes.description: Granite Flats is in a panic in the aftermath of the explosion. Arthur and his new friends won't be left out of the action; a covert meeting and a few far-fetched theories have the trio embarking on an investigative journey.

episodes.title: A Secret to the Heart Nearest
episodes.description: Two investigations into the mysterious happenings in Granite Flats ensue—one by Chief Sanders and the military police and the other by Arthur and his cohorts—and each has varying degrees of success.

episodes.title: Talking
episodes.description: Beth tries to connect with her son, Arthur, who has built a metal detector with his friends to help them investigate the mysteries in Granite Flats. A big city reporter begins asking questions around town.

episodes.title: Bonds
episodes.description: Friendships are tested after a failed class project; Beth investigates Frank's strange behavior and John struggles to balance his family life with his duties as police chief.

episodes.title: Reassembly
episodes.description: Madeline, Arthur, and Timmy seek out new mysteries to solve and Chief Sanders uncovers something huge with the help of some mysterious newcomers.

episodes.title: The Wrong Man
episodes.description: Frank asks for Beth's help to prove his sanity, Hershel receives visitors while incarcerated, and Arthur and his friends try to salvage their science fair project.

episodes.title: Something Dangerous
episodes.description: Chief Sanders calls in a favor as he attempts to prove Hershel's innocence and have him released from jail. After the science fair, Arthur, Timmy, and Madeline solve yet another mystery in Granite Flats.

episodes.title: The Making of Granite Flats
episodes.description: Catch a behind-the-scenes glimpse of BYUtv's first scripted drama.

episodes.title: Children of Darkness, Children of Light
episodes.description: Chief Sanders and Agent Scott investigate citizens whose loyalties are questionable. The young detectives are still curious about the coded message they found. At the hospital, experiments reveal a patient's past.

episodes.title: Boundaries
episodes.description: The three sleuths argue about getting involved with the FBI's investigation. Beth is concerned about Frank and the experiments at the hospital. Wallace is caught in the middle when Regina and Hershel argue about what's best for the boy.

episodes.title: From Whose Bourn No Traveler Returns
episodes.description: Timmy, Arthur, and Madeline make a dangerous and significant discovery, right under the nose of the FBI. While they investigate, Granite Flats is in an uproar—chaos breaks out at the hospital and Chief Sanders pursues Slim.

episodes.title: Also Be the Consolation
episodes.description: The town is in mourning the loss of a friend. Regina is grieving and reliving her memories, John can't seem to live with himself, and even Hershel struggles to deal with the tragedy.

episodes.title: Put Away Childish Things
episodes.description: The kids' new English teacher (Christopher Lloyd) has a way of making Hamlet applicable to life in Granite Flats. Some citizens are unsettled when a CIA agent arrives (Cary Elwes). Arthur takes his detective work to a new level.

episodes.title: The Stories We Tell....
episodes.description: Mr. Hugh Ashmeade (Cary Elwes) stirs up confusion and danger when he meddles in the Andrews’ personal and professional lives and Chief Sanders recruits a new deputy with somewhat surprising results.

episodes.title: Cor Unum, Corambis
episodes.description: Arthur continues his investigation alone because Tim and Madeline seem distracted. Professor Hargraves (Christopher Lloyd) counsels Timmy on romance. Hershel becomes the bait in a dangerous trap.

episodes.title: Project Madman
episodes.description: Beth, Whittison, and the Andrews turn the tables on Ashmeade and get to the bottom of what he’s been planning. Timmy and Madeline find what everyone has been pursuing, leading Madeline to question her adoption story.

episodes.title: Behind the Scenes of Granite Flats
episodes.description: Get a behind-the-scenes look at how Granite Flats is produced.

episodes.title: Our Rendezvous Is Fitly Appointed
episodes.description: Granite Flats is rocked after the death of one of the town's most beloved citizens. Two new faces show up in town: Arthur's Aunt Alice (Parker Posey) and Madeline's Uncle Scottie (George Newbern). A new mystery needs to be solved.

episodes.title: The Converging Objects of the Universe Perpetually Flow
episodes.description: Ezekiel gets one step closer to discovering the identity of The Plumber. Alice settles into Granite Flats. Trust issues arise between the Andrews. Scottie takes a new case from an unlikely client.

episodes.title: Mortised in Granite
episodes.description: Lieutenant Frank Quincy disappears from the hospital. Chief Sanders and Hershel take matters into their own hands. Aunt Alice has a prophetic dream.

episodes.title: Form and Union and Plan
episodes.description: The Andrews try to get answers from Frank Quincy. John enlists his wife's help in the investigation and she discovers a major piece to the puzzle. Frank enlists the help of the kid detectives.

episodes.title: The Threads That Were Spun Are Gathered
episodes.description: The Andrews have Professor Hargraves over for dinner, but with an ulterior motive. The kid detectives are back together for a common cause. Agent Ezekiel Scott’s interrogation does not go quite as planned.

episodes.title: Some Intricate Purpose
episodes.description: Chief Sanders and Agent Scott disagree about the identity of The Plumber. Wallace’s mother comes to town and shakes things up. Susan desperately clings to Madeline after hearing her true feelings.

episodes.title: The Terrible Doubt of Appearances
episodes.description: Agent Scott questions Professor Hargraves for his suspicious behavior and refuses to believe his story. The kids suspect that something is up when Professor Hargraves fails to come to class. They team up with Mrs. Andrews to solve Frank’s case.

episodes.title: All Truths Wait in All Things
episodes.description: Doctor Andrews unlocks Lieutenant Quincy’s memories, including the truth about Beth’s fate. Regina and Hershel come to an agreement. The kid sleuths dig up secrets and Whittison must face his troubling past.

episodes.title: On Set with the Cast of Granite Flats
episodes.description: As Season 3 begins, meet some of the cast members of Granite Flats, and find out how they develop their characters and relate to one another.
