episodes.title: Introduction and Historic Overview
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the title page and revelations found in the Doctrine and Covenants, as well as the people involved in creating, preserving, and arranging it. With Matthew Richardson, Richard Cowan, Susan Easton Black, and Andrew Skinner.

episodes.title: D&C 1: A Voice of Warning
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the preface of the Doctrine and Covenants. Section 1 invites members of the Church of Jesus Christ to listen to and obey the voice of the Lord. With Andrew Skinner, Matthew Richardson, Richard Cowan, and Susan Easton Black.

episodes.title: D&C 2: Promises Made to the Fathers
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the Spirit of Elijah, the importance of families, and the power of the priesthood found in Doctrine and Covenants section 2. With Matthew Richardson, Richard Cowan, Susan Easton Black, and Andrew Skinner.

episodes.title: D&C 3 & 10: The Lost Manuscript
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 3 and 10 which details how the translation of the Book of Mormon is disrupted when Martin Harris loses the first 116 pages. With Guy Dorius, Mary Jane Woodger, Craig Ostler, Brent Top.

episodes.title: D&C 5 & 17: Witnesses of the Book of Mormon
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 5 and 17 and the witnesses to the gold plates. They provide context to the Book of Mormon but the Spirit brings conversion. With Brent Top, Guy Dorius, Mary Jane Woodger, and Craig Ostler.

episodes.title: D&C 6 & 8-9: The Spirit of Revelation
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 6, 8, and 9 where Oliver Cowdery desires a witness and confirmation of his personal revelation and is given gifts of spirit. With Brent Top, Guy Dorius, Mary Jane Woodger, and Craig Ostler.

episodes.title: D&C 7 & 13: John the Revelator & John the Baptist
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 7 and 13. Joseph Smith and Oliver Cowdery ask about John’s power over death and receive the Aaronic Priesthood. With Matthew Richardson, John Livingston, Steven Harper, and Guy Dorius.

episodes.title: D&C 4, 11-12 & 14-16: Qualifications for Service
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 4, 11, 12, 14, and 16 where Joseph Smith received revelations relevant to full-time missionaries and members today. With Matthew Richardson, John Livingston, Steven Harper, and Guy Dorius.

episodes.title: D&C 18-19: The Worth of Souls
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 18 and 19 and the revelation regarding calling twelve apostles in the latter days and the responsibility therein. With Matthew Richardson, John Livingston, Steven Harper, and Guy Dorius.

episodes.title: D&C 20-22: The Organization of the Church
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the organizational instruction for the roles and responsibilities of priesthood offices found in Doctrine and Covenants sections 20 through 22. With Susan Easton Black, Craig Manscill, Mary Jane Woodger, and Craig Ostler.

episodes.title: D&C 23-24 & 26: The Cause of Zion
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the revelations found in Doctrine and Covenants sections 23, 24, and 26 that provide instruction and support for the Saints through persecution. With Susan Easton Black, Craig Manscill, Mary Jane Woodger, and Craig Ostler.

episodes.title: D&C 25: An Elect Lady
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants section 25. The only section written to a woman, Emma Smith, is applicable to all members of the Church. With Susan Easton Black, Craig Manscill, Mary Jane Woodger, and Craig Ostler.

episodes.title: D&C 27-28: Take Upon You My Whole Armor
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 27 and 28 where the Saints receive direction on the sacrament and discernment between revelation and deceit. With Andrew Skinner, Matthew Richardson, Randy Bott, and Alexander Baugh.

episodes.title: D&C 29: Prepare for the Days to Come
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants section 29 which teaches that Jesus Christ will gather his people, forgive them, and serve as advocate at the judgment day. Andrew Skinner, Matthew Richardson, Randy Bott, and Alexander Baugh.

episodes.title: D&C 30-35: Calls to Preach the Gospel
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 30 through 35 where several individuals receive direct callings and instructions to preach the gospel. With Andrew Skinner, Matthew Richardson, Randy Bott, and Alexander Baugh.

episodes.title: D&C 36-40: Heeding the Lord's Call
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 36 through 40 where the Saints of the early restored Church are commanded to urgently move to Ohio. With Matthew Richardson, Richard Cowan, Randy Bott, Steven and Harper.

episodes.title: D&C 41-42: The Law of the Church
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the law of the Church found in Doctrine and Covenants sections 41 and 42 and the importance of calling, sustaining, and preaching the gospel. With Matthew Richardson, Richard Cowan, Randy Bott, Steven and Harper.

episodes.title: D&C 43-45: The Great Day of the Lord
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 43, 44, and 45. The Saints learn the importance of being endowed with power to prepare for the second coming of Christ. With Matthew Richardson, Richard Cowan, Randy Bott, and Steven Harper.

episodes.title: D&C 46-49: To Every Man Is Given a Gift
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss spiritual gifts as found in Doctrine and Covenants sections 46 through 49 as well as the importance of stewardship and recording history. With Brent Top, Dean Garrett, Alexander Baugh, and Mary Jane Woodger.

episodes.title: D&C 50-56: Called to Forsake the World
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 50 through 56 which teach discernment between good and evil spirits and the law of consecration. With Brent Top, Dean Garrett, Alexander Baugh, and Mary Jane Woodger.

episodes.title: D&C 57-59: Laying the Foundation of Zion
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 57 through 59 where the Saints of the early restored Church travel to Missouri to establish Zion. Brent Top, H. Dean Garrett, Alexander Baugh, and Mary Jane Woodger.

episodes.title: D&C 60-62: A Commission to Testify
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 60 through 62 where missionaries experience rejection and trials and are instructed on how to proceed with good cheer. With Susan Easton Black, Craig Manscill, Randy Bott, and Steven Harper.

episodes.title: D&C 63-65: The Lord Requireth the Heart
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss found in Doctrine and Covenants sections 63 through 65. The Lord’s anger is kindled by sign seekers and the Saints are commanded to forgive each other. With Susan Easton Black, Craig Manscill, Steven Harper, and Randy Bott.

episodes.title: D&C 66-68: The Everlasting Covenant
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 66 through 68 and the specific guidance given to several individuals regarding callings, blessings, and promises. With Susan Easton Black, Craig Manscill, Steven Harper, and Randy Bott.

episodes.title: D&C 69-75: An Account of Their Stewardship
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 69 through 75 where the Lord provides instruction on stewardship and progression in His Church. With Matthew Richardson, Richard Cowan, John Livingstone, and Lawrence Flake.

episodes.title: D&C 76: The Vision--Part 1
episodes.description: Part one of two of religious scholars discussing Doctrine and Covenants section 76. Joseph Smith and Sidney Rigdon receive a revolutionary vision of the spirit world. With Matthew Richardson, Richard Cowan, John Livingston, and Lawrence Flake.

episodes.title: D&C 76: The Vision--Part 2
episodes.description: Part two of religious scholars discussing Doctrine and Covenants section 76. Outlines of those who will reside in the three glories of the kingdom of God are presented. With Matthew Richardson, Richard Cowan, John Livingston, and Lawrence Flake.

episodes.title: D&C 77-79: A Covenant That Cannot Be Broken
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss preparing for the second coming of Jesus Christ and the United Order as found in Doctrine and Covenants sections 77 through 79. With Matthew Richardson, Craig Manscill, Randy Bott, and Richard Cowan.

episodes.title: D&C 80-83: Keys of the Kingdom
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the responsibilities of the First Presidency and the law of consecration as described in Doctrine and Covenants sections 80 through 83. With Matthew Richardson, Craig Manscill, Randy Bott, and Richard Cowan.

episodes.title: D&C 84-87: Oath and Covenant of the Priesthood
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 84 through 87 where the lineage and authority of the priesthood is outlined and responsibilities are expounded. With Matthew Richardson, Craig Manscill, Randy Bott, and Richard Cowan.

episodes.title: D&C 88-89: Prepare and Sanctify Yourselves
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss how to sanctify ourselves, progress, comprehend the laws of God, and the Word of Wisdom in Doctrine and Covenants sections 88 and 89. With Guy Dorius, Jerry Perkins, Steve Harper, and Craig Ostler.

episodes.title: D&C 90-93: Light and Truth
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 90 through 93 which teaches how to progress grace for grace as Jesus Christ did in mortality. With Guy Dorius, Jerry Perkins, Steve Harper, and Craig Ostler.

episodes.title: D&C 94-97: A House of God
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the sacrifices and blessings that came from obeying the Lord’s command to build temples as found in Doctrine and Covenants sections 94 through 97. With Guy Dorius, Jerry Perkins, Steve Harper, and Craig Ostler.

episodes.title: D&C 98-100: I Will Prove You in All Things
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 98 through 100 which provides guidance and comfort to the Saints who experience persecution and trials. With Matthew Richardson, Dean Garrett, John Livingston, and Craig Manscill.

episodes.title: D&C 101, 103 & 105: Chastened and Tried
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the continued persecution and chastisement the Saints endure and Zion’s Camp in Doctrine and Covenants sections 101, 103, and 105. With Matthew Richardson, Dean Garrett, John Livingston, and Craig Manscill.

episodes.title: D&C 102, 104 & 106: Inasmuch as They Are Faithful
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 102, 104, and 106 which provide instruction on the organization of the high council and the law of consecration. With Matthew Richardson, Dean Garrett, John Livingston, and Craig Manscill.

episodes.title: D&C 107: Quorums and the Priesthood
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the responsibilities of the offices of the Melchizedek and Aaronic Priesthoods outlined in the first half of Doctrine and Covenants section 107. With Andrew Skinner, Susan Easton Black, Richard Cowan, and Mary Jane Woodger.

episodes.title: D&C 107-109: Let Every Man Learn His Duty
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the clarification on priesthood offices found in Doctrine and Covenants sections 107-109. With Andrew Skinner, Susan Easton Black, Richard Cowan, and Mary Jane Woodger.

episodes.title: D&C 109-110: A Place of Holiness
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the dedicatory prayer of the Kirtland temple and the appearance of Jehovah and ancient prophets in Doctrine and Covenants sections 109 and 110. With Andrew Skinner, Susan Easton Black, Richard Cowan, and Mary Jane Woodger.

episodes.title: D&C 111-113: More Treasures Than One
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss treasure, the Apostles’ faith, questions from reading Isaiah, and the Lord’s guidance presented in Doctrine and Covenants sections 111 through 113. With Matthew Richardson, Alexander Baugh, Jerry Perkins, and Craig Ostler.

episodes.title: D&C 114-116: The Stakes of Zion
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 114 through 116 where the Lord gives instruction on the continued organization and growth of the Church in Missouri. With Matthew Richardson, Alexander Baugh, Jerry Perkins, and Craig Ostler.

episodes.title: D&C 117-120: I Will Provide
episodes.description: Religious Scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 117 through 120 and the direction on callings for the quorum of the Twelve Apostles and clarification on tithes. With Matthew Richardson, Alexander Baugh, Jerry Perkins, and Craig Ostler.

episodes.title: D&C 121: Peace Be Unto Thy Soul
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Joseph Smith’s prayer for mercy while in Liberty Jail and the Lord’s comfort and encouragement found in Doctrine and Covenants section 121. With Susan Easton Black, Craig Ostler, John Livingstone, and Lawrence Flake.

episodes.title: D&C 122-123: Art Thou Greater Than He?
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the Liberty Jail epistles in Doctrine and Covenants sections 122-123 which show the Lord’s understanding of and compassion for our suffering. With Susan Easton Black, Craig Ostler, John Livingstone, and Lawrence Flake.

episodes.title: D&C 124: The City of Nauvoo
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants section 124 which details instructions for continued progress as the Church headquarters is now in Nauvoo, Illinois. With Susan Easton Black, Craig Ostler, John Livingstone, and Lawrence Flake.

episodes.title: D&C 125-128: Baptisms for the Dead
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the will of the Lord pertaining to stakes of Zion, Brigham Young, and baptisms of the dead as found in Doctrine and Covenants sections 125 through 128. With Susan Easton Black, Dean Garrett, Randy Bott, and Guy Dorius.

episodes.title: D&C 129-131: The Order of Heaven
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 129 through 131 which outline how to discern between angels and spirits and the importance of obedience to God’s laws. With Susan Easton Black, Dean Garrett, Randy Bott, and Guy Dorius.

episodes.title: D&C 132-133: A New and Everlasting Covenant
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the law of celestial marriage and preparing for Christ’s Second Coming as explained in Doctrine and Covenants sections 132 and 133. With Susan Easton Black, Dean Garrett, Randy Bott, and Guy Dorius.

episodes.title: D&C 134: Governments Were Instituted of God
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants section 134 which outlines the importance and support of government as an encouragement of the agency of man. With Andrew Skinner, Lawrence Flake, Steven Harper, and Mary Jane Woodger.

episodes.title: D&C 135-136: The Martyrdom
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the martyrdoms of Joseph and Hyrum Smith in Doctrine and Covenants section 135 and the will of the Lord given to Brigham Young in section 136. With Andrew Skinner, Lawrence Flake, Steven Harper, and Mary Jane Woodger.

episodes.title: D&C 137-138: Heirs of the Kingdom
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the redemption of the dead and progression in the spirit world as found in Doctrine and Covenants sections 137 and 138. With Andrew Skinner, Lawrence Flake, Steven Harper, and Mary Jane Woodger.

episodes.title: Section 138 & Official Declarations: Continuing Revelation
episodes.description: Religious scholars finish discussing the spirit world in Doctrine and Covenants section 138 and examine revelations on polygamy and priesthood in the Official Declarations. With Andrew Skinner, Lawrence Flake, Steven Harper, and Mary Jane Woodger.

fc6321bc-0cbf-431c-8e62-0953c16a164b.description: Courageous kids tell the difficult stories of their own lives.

episodes.title: Two Worlds
episodes.description: Joseph Nelson learns to accept and enjoy his uniqueness. He gains perspective and shows generosity when he talks about a boy his older brother taught while serving a Church mission who has gone through many struggles in his life.

episodes.title: Stealing Home
episodes.description: Kellen talks about his father’s alcoholism and his parents’ divorce and how sports and his friends have helped him navigate these difficult situations and his depression.

episodes.title: One America
episodes.description: As a young Muslim growing up in the United States, Prottush experiences a lot of prejudice and it has affected his self-confidence and how he sees the world and his future. He shares his passion for music and the escape and peace it provides.

episodes.title: Brother Sister
episodes.description: Brother and sister Zoriah and Veda express gratitude for their dad after their mother left them. They then process the sudden death of their mother and realize how it has affected their daily lives.

episodes.title: Dreaming of America
episodes.description: After immigrating to the United States at age 11, Christian dreams of playing in the NBA while accepting that his dad will never leave Mexico to join him and his mom.

episodes.title: The Phoenix
episodes.description: After his parents divorced, Simon started a downward spiral and became addicted to drugs. He now travels the world and works to make lives and communities better.

episodes.title: Brotherhood
episodes.description: Simon, Zeke, and Eli are three brothers who want to rebuild their relationship after the addiction struggles of Zeke and Simon. They talk about the loss of the unity of their family and their desire to be a close family again.

episodes.title: Princess
episodes.description: Haley talks about losing her best friend really young and the anxiety she feels about getting into college. She also reflects on her personal health issues that will affect her for the rest of her life.

episodes.title: Touche
episodes.description: With dreams of being an Olympic fencer, Toby struggles to keep up with his schoolwork and sports demand. He opens up about the pressure he feels from his parents and friends.

episodes.title: Tabloid Scandal
episodes.description: Gennette opens up about the struggles she’s had with academics, drinking, depression, and a tabloid scandal. Despite her struggles, she can see the blessings in disguise that she has been given in her life.

episodes.title: Dreamcatcher
episodes.description: After years of struggling with addiction and a strained relationship with his father, Emilio talks about his recovery. The relationships with his mom and dad have improved as he has matured and healed.

episodes.title: Girl in the Mirror
episodes.description: After years of comparing herself to others and striving for physical perfection, Jade is diagnosed with Body Dysmorphic Disorder. The group discusses how they can help her feel valued and secure for who she is.

9a114994-a252-466b-881d-588c03e9ee70.description: Painter Eric Dowdle captures the people and spirit of the places he visits in his art.

episodes.title: Plymouth, MA
episodes.description: Artist Eric Dowdle explores Plymouth, Massachusetts, to inspire his painting. From The Mayflower to the cranberry bogs, Eric engages with the locals to learn what makes the city tick.

episodes.title: Portland, OR
episodes.description: To inspire his painting, artist Eric Dowdle discovers what makes up Portland, Oregon culture. He visits the world’s smallest park according to Guinness World Records and a wedding at Voodoo Doughnuts.

episodes.title: Solvang, CA
episodes.description: In Solvang, California, artist Eric Dowdle visits Danish bakeries, Ingeborg’s chocolate shop, and the Hans Christen Andersen Museum.

episodes.title: New Orleans, LA
episodes.description: To get a taste of New Orleans, Louisiana, artist Eric Dowdle joins locals in the Mardi Gras Parades, the ghost stories of Lafayette Cemetery, and a tour across the Bayou.

episodes.title: Vancouver, BC
episodes.description: Artist Eric Dowdle explores Vancouver, British Columbia, to inspire his painting. From curling to sushi making, Eric engages with the locals to learn what makes the city tick.

episodes.title: Cancún, Mexico
episodes.description: To inspire his painting, artist Eric Dowdle discovers what makes up Cancun, Mexico culture. He visits Mayan ruins and parties with the locals at Coco Bongo.

episodes.title: Black Hills, SD & Mount Rushmore
episodes.description: In Black Hills, South Dakota, artist Eric Dowdle visits Mount Rushmore, explores Big Thunder Gold Mine, and rides the Black Hills Central Railroad.

episodes.title: Charleston, SC
episodes.description: To get a taste of Charleston, South Carolina, artist Eric Dowdle eats the classic shrimp and grits and explores the mystery of The Hunley.

episodes.title: Chattanooga, TN
episodes.description: Artist Eric Dowdle explores Chattanooga, Tennasee, to inspire his painting. From revitalization efforts to moonpies, Eric engages with the locals to learn what makes the city tick.

episodes.title: Baltimore, MD
episodes.description: To inspire his painting, artist Eric Dowdle discovers what makes up Baltimore, Maryland culture. He visits the place where The Star Spangled Banner was written and the American Visionary Art Museum.

episodes.title: San Antonio, TX
episodes.description: In San Antonio, Texas, artist Eric Dowdle visits The Alamo, Barney’s Toilet Seat Museum, and a real cowboy shooting experience.

episodes.title: North Shore, HI
episodes.description: To get a taste of North Shore, Hawaii, artist Eric Dowdle eats from Giovanni’s Shrimp Shack, snorkeling, and visits the Polynesian Cultural Center.

episodes.title: St. Thomas, US Virgin Islands
episodes.description: Artist Eric Dowdle explores St. Thomas in the U.S. Virgin Islands, to inspire his painting. From stilt dancing to buried treasure, Eric engages with the locals to learn what makes the city tick.

episodes.title: Memphis
episodes.description: Artist Eric Dowdle explores Memphis, Tennessee, to inspire his painting. From Elvis to fried chicken, Eric engages with the locals to learn what makes the city tick.

episodes.title: Rome
episodes.description: To inspire his painting, artist Eric Dowdle discovers what makes up Rome, Italy culture. He visits The Colosseum and learns how to make gelato.

episodes.title: Jackson Hole
episodes.description: Artist Eric Dowdle explores Jackson Hole, Wyoming, to inspire his painting. From dog mushing to natural hot springs, Eric engages with the locals to learn what makes the city tick.

episodes.title: Bristol
episodes.description: In Bristol, England, artist Eric Dowdle plays croquet, visits Thornbury Castle, and learns about the ingenuity of Isambard Brunel.

episodes.title: Chicago
episodes.description: To get a taste of Chicago, Illinois, artist Eric Dowdle eats a Chicago style hot dog, learns to make deep-dish pizza, and explores Millenium Park.

episodes.title: Amsterdam
episodes.description: To inspire his painting, artist Eric Dowdle discovers what makes up Amsterdam, Netherlands culture. He carves traditional clogs and makes Dutch stroopwafels.

episodes.title: St Augustine
episodes.description: In St. Augustine, Florida, artist Eric Dowdle searches for the fountain of youth, completes militia training, and visits an alligator farm.

episodes.title: Park City
episodes.description: To get a taste of Park City, Utah, artist Eric Dowdle bobsleds down an olympic track and flies in a hot air balloon.

episodes.title: Los Angeles
episodes.description: Artist Eric Dowdle explores Los Angeles, California, to inspire his painting. From surfing to letterpressing, Eric engages with the locals to learn what makes L.A. tick.

episodes.title: Winston-Salem
episodes.description: To inspire his painting, artist Eric Dowdle discovers what makes up Winston-Salem, North Carolina culture. He tries frog leg hushpuppies and visits Andy Griffith’s hometown.

episodes.title: Bermuda
episodes.description: Artist Eric Dowdle explores Bermuda to inspire his painting. From the Bermuda Triangle to cathedral ruins, Eric engages with the locals to learn what makes the city tick.

episodes.title: Prince Edward Island
episodes.description: To get a taste of Prince Edward Island, Canada, artist Eric Dowdle visits the Anne of Green Gables house and Canada’s Smallest Library.

episodes.title: Seattle
episodes.description: In Seattle, Washington, artist Eric Dowdle visits the Space Needle, makes farm fresh ice cream, and learns about glass blowing.

episodes.title: Hong Kong
episodes.description: Artist Eric Dowdle explores Hong Kong, China, to inspire his painting. From pandas to the Cantonese Opera, Eric engages with the locals to learn what makes the city tick.

episodes.title: Niagara Falls
episodes.description: Artist Eric Dowdle explores Niagara Falls to inspire his painting. From the spiciest chicken wings to daredevil experiences, Eric engages with the locals to learn what makes the city tick.

episodes.title: Puerto Vallarta
episodes.description: To inspire his painting, artist Eric Dowdle discovers what makes up Puerto Vallarta, Mexico culture. He visits Manuel Lepe’s paintings and plays music with a Mariachi band.

episodes.title: Mackinac Island
episodes.description: To inspire his painting, artist Eric Dowdle discovers what makes up Mackinac Island, Michigan culture. He learns about the American Fur Trade and more about why the city chose to put a ban on motor vehicles.

episodes.title: Sydney
episodes.description: In Sydney, Australia, artist Eric Dowdle visits the Opera House, learns about astronomy, and meets kangaroos and koalas.

episodes.title: Marthas Vineyard
episodes.description: To inspire his painting, artist Eric Dowdle discovers what makes up Martha’s Vineyard culture. He visits the bridge from the movie Jaws and explores the rows of uniquely crafted and colored houses.

episodes.title: Kenya
episodes.description: In Kenya, Africa, artist Eric Dowdle attends his adopted son, Bensons, wedding, goes on an African safari, and spends time with the Maasai people.

fcfe68c3-2143-4a42-aa5d-dab225e001d1.description: Discover what all your favorite Relative Race teams have been up to since their seasons ended.

episodes.title: Hoyt and Williams
episodes.description: Rebecca Hoyt from Season 3 shares her story of life after the show. She’s now an employee of Relative Race and works to help others discover family. Mike Brown and Austen Williams of Season 4 share how the family they met changed their lives.

episodes.title: Brown and Barnes
episodes.description: Brooke and Anthony Brown from Season 1 reveal the heartwarming way they’ve spent their winnings. J.D. and Jenn Barnes of Season 6 share how their family has grown by over 100 members since finishing Relative Race.

episodes.title: Harper and Williams
episodes.description: Kayla and Duly Williams from Season 2 share what finding family has meant to their kids. Jamie and Morgan Harper of Season 3 reveal exciting updates about their lives and careers.

episodes.title: Louis and Anderson
episodes.description: Paul and Anitra Louis from Season 6 introduce Anitra’s biological family to her adopted family in an emotional meeting. Paris and Preshious Anderson from Season 4 say that the family they've met plays an important role in their lives today.

episodes.title: Henline and Anderson
episodes.description: Relative Race Season 4 sibling team Joe and Jerica Henline reveal their new family connections. The father-and-son team of Season 3, Michael and Dylan Anderson, share how meeting family has changed their lives for the better.

episodes.title: Pardon and Engberg
episodes.description: Chris and DeShae Pardon of Relative Race Season 6 share how DeShae’s family is impacting her life today. Plus, learn how Doug and Margo Engberg of Season 1 keep family relationships stronger than ever while building their booming cupcake business.

episodes.title: Breedlove and Campbell
episodes.description: Marcus and Keith Breedlove from Relative Race Season 5 have new family members providing ongoing love and support to them. Ray and Nicole Campbell of Season 6 and their connection with Ray’s brother has flourished.

episodes.title: Clifton and Hitt
episodes.description: Maria and Elizabeth Clifton from Season 5 have kept in contact with their newfound parents and siblings. Troy and Nicole Hitt from Season 3 share how they’ve adopted a completely new way of life since Relative Race.

2f11a156-dfaa-454c-a104-60165b2a5625.description: Everyday people are surprised with fun, fast, and sometimes furious acts of kindness.

episodes.title: Dream Driveway
episodes.description: Watch Random Acts ease one of the burdens of a young mother dealing with chronic pain.

episodes.title: Missed Christmas
episodes.description: Random Acts pulls off a surprise Christmas for a family who spent the holiday in the ICU.

episodes.title: Magic Movers
episodes.description: Random Acts plans a bit of home moving magic for a new mom whose husband is deployed overseas.

episodes.title: Studio C-prise
episodes.description: The Studio C cast surprises a family dealing with cancer, and BYU Vocal Point singers pose as maintenance workers.

episodes.title: Music and the Random Act
episodes.description: Watch Random Acts make Shelby's dream of playing with the Orchestra at Temple Square come true.

episodes.title: Ninja Makeover
episodes.description: Random Acts makes a dream bedroom makeover happen for Theo... all while he is asleep in the room!

episodes.title: Here We Vow Again
episodes.description: Determined to make memories while he still can, John surprises his wife, Jane, with a vow renewal.

episodes.title: Quilting Life Back Together
episodes.description: After a house fire, the Suyak family needs a boost to "quilt" their life back together.

episodes.title: Illusion Reunion
episodes.description: The Random Acts team reunites Janis with family during a magic show illusion.

episodes.title: Wheelin' Forward
episodes.description: Random Acts surprises Rebecca and Mo with proper wheelchair transportation.

episodes.title: Backyard Blitz
episodes.description: The Random Acts team transforms the Keller family's backyard for their son with special needs.

episodes.title: Copter Kindness
episodes.description: Random Acts gives Steffan the aerial experience of a lifetime before he loses his eyesight.

episodes.title: Unforeseena Ballerina
episodes.description: Emmalene, who has cerebral palsy, brings her dreams to the ballet stage with help from Random Acts.

episodes.title: Goalden Ticket
episodes.description: Gary Staples has dedicated his life to service, so Random Acts and Real Salt Lake surprise him.

episodes.title: Sleep Her Agent
episodes.description: Janet cares full-time for her sons with special needs. so Random Acts gives her a dream bedroom.

episodes.title: Ball Dressed Up
episodes.description: Random Acts creates a Regency ball to honor Ciera, a young woman with a devastating illness.

episodes.title: Love of My Light
episodes.description: Chloe's husband donated a kidney to save her life. Random Acts surprised the couple with a concert.

episodes.title: Ivory-One Loves You
episodes.description: Music teacher Weston gave up his piano, so Random Acts gives him a new one for his birthday.

episodes.title: House Swarming Party
episodes.description: Random Acts turns the Gossards' basement into a living space for their eight foster children.

episodes.title: Four the Love
episodes.description: Random Acts throws the ultimate baby shower for a couple expecting quadruplets.

episodes.title: ConGRADulations
episodes.description: See how Random Acts surprises Savannah with a once in a lifetime celebration!

episodes.title: Over-Hauliday
episodes.description: Random Acts surprises Ryan, a paraplegic, with a gift that gets him and his family outside!

episodes.title: That's a Rap
episodes.description: See how Random Acts surprises this beloved, dedicated, and deserving 3rd grade teacher!

episodes.title: Grand Cameo
episodes.description: See how Random Acts surprises Kiarra after she loses her hand in a shop class accident.

episodes.title: Let's Make A Smile
episodes.description: See how Random Acts makes Brinley, a survivor of serious health issues, the star of her own show!

episodes.title: Wyatt's World
episodes.description: See how Random Acts gives Wyatt, who has a brain disability, his own world right in his bedroom!

episodes.title: Make Yourself A Home
episodes.description: This single mom has no idea what's in store for her when she helps a friend move into an apartment.

episodes.title: Saved By Service
episodes.description: A young accident survivor meets her rescuer for the first time while attending a Utah Jazz game.

episodes.title: Yard In The Cards
episodes.description: Random Acts transforms a backyard into a safe haven.

episodes.title: May The Horse Be With You
episodes.description: Random Acts teams up with Hoofbeats to Healing to give this animal-loving girl a big surprise!

episodes.title: Love Is in the Air
episodes.description: Will, Emilie, and Jenna team up with a local balloonist to make a bucket list dream of riding in a hot air balloon come true for Julie, a women who recently lost her husband to cancer; Will solicits the help of strangers to propose to Emilie.

episodes.title: Serving Service
episodes.description: Will, Emilie, Mason, and Melanie spend the day as street performers to raise money as a mega tip to give Laura, a waitress in Seattle who is constantly doing random acts of kindness for those around her; Will and Melanie pop balloons to inspire good.

episodes.title: The Commander
episodes.description: Will and Emilie team up with a recording studio to surprise Carl, a service-oriented man with Down syndrome, with an opportunity to meet one of his favorite musicians: Alex Boyé; The hosts do random acts at the movie theater and grocery store.

episodes.title: Racing to Restore
episodes.description: Will, Emilie, and Mason work together to restore an old Camaro and prepare a race track experience for Clint, a man who has recently lost his father and brother to accident and illness. Emilie and Will find good Samaritans at the state fair.

episodes.title: Make or Bake
episodes.description: Brooklyn is 14 years old and can only eat 20 foods, so Emilie, Jenna, Will, and returning host Lisa Valentine Clark work to create a baking competition surprise. Emilie, Will and Mason give people a fishy opportunity at Waterfront park in Seattle.

episodes.title: Random Tracks of Kindness
episodes.description: David is a double amputee confined to his electric wheelchair and the routes of public transportation, so Will and Emilie plan a road trip for him with a surprise at each stop. Mason partakes in cosplay as a Viking at Fan X.

episodes.title: Best Friends Fur-ever
episodes.description: Eight-year-old Ali has been battling cancer for several years. Will and Emilie surprise Ali and her best-friend Bentlie at school with the news that they are getting on a plane and going on an adventure. Will and Jenna give fortunes in San Diego.

episodes.title: The Great Indoors
episodes.description: Jeff and Debbie Strong have adopted 15 children, many with disabilities or terminal conditions. They’ve given a home to so many, so Will and Melanie give the kids who can’t easily go outside a place to play inside. Jenna and Emilie ride a trolley.

episodes.title: Snow Far Snow Good
episodes.description: Katie has a syndrome causing her to be born without ears and cheekbones. Jenna and Emilie surprise her at work with a day off and a trip into the mountains to go dog sledding. Will and Melanie reward kind people at a Seattle bookstore.

episodes.title: From Random With Love
episodes.description: Will, Melanie, and Jenna surprise William, a 12-year-old boy with Spina Bifida, with a superhero experience at a “secret facility” where he films a fake movie trailer. Will and Emilie team up with author Camron Wright to celebrate kindness.

episodes.title: The Thrift Gift
episodes.description: Will and Emilie surprise Mary, a thrift-store owner whose goal is to provide for and serve the nearby homeless population. Mary is surprised with a scuba diving adventure. Mason and Emilie help strangers virtually shop for their groceries.

episodes.title: Cooking Up Kindness
episodes.description: Cindy is a baker who spreads her love via thousands of desserts to those in need of a pick-me-up. Will and Jenna surprise her with a dream-come-true kitchen remodel. Will and Emilie chauffeur unsuspecting airport travelers.

episodes.title: Sky Thriving
episodes.description: Savannah is a happy and charitable teenager who was recently diagnosed with a rare life-shortening disease. Emilie and Will step in to help her check skydiving off her bucket list. Lisa and Will enlist the help of kids at a mini golf course.

episodes.title: Soaring Surprise
episodes.description: Chris Miller is a high school social worker and wrestling coach whose sole mission is to help students in need. Emilie and Jenna surprise Chris with a stunt plane experience of a lifetime. The hosts descend on unsuspecting cars at a gas station.

episodes.title: We've Got Your Back(yard)
episodes.description: Mindi Holmgren lost her husband in a tragic accident, putting their plans to finish the backyard on hold. Will and Melanie call in some old friends to make the backyard dream a reality. Will and Emilie go biking in San Diego.

episodes.title: National Treasures
episodes.description: Edie Swan has a rare and painful condition called Chiari malformation. Emilie, Will, and Mason work together to make a special trip to Arches National Park possible. The hosts take over a toll booth.

episodes.title: Passion for Fashion
episodes.description: Lilly is dealing with the recent death of her father, but despite this tragedy she still dreams of becoming a fashion designer. Emilie, Mason, and Lisa work together to put on a fashion show. Emilie and Jenna surprise kids at the zoo.

episodes.title: Sail-ebration
episodes.description: Dani Bates and her two daughters lost their husband and father to suicide. Will distracts Dani with a surprise sailing trip while Jenna works on a quilting miracle. Emilie and Will start water fights in a park.

episodes.title: A Lotta Piñata
episodes.description: Aleisha McDaniel constantly does random acts of kindness in her daily life, including secretly giving away piñatas. Will and Jenna help Aleisha with a giant piñata surprise. Will, Emilie, and Mason add an unconventional experience to a haunted house.

episodes.title: Space for Love
episodes.description: Lisa Love is an elementary school teacher who has changed the lives of her students through her love of space. Will and Jenna fulfill Lisa’s dream of going to Space Camp. Will, Emilie, and Mason give random people the chance to play Apple Blasters.

episodes.title: Jars of Joy
episodes.description: Emily is a passionate elementary school teacher. In the spirit of Jason F. Wright’s book “Christmas Jars,” her entire school comes together to give her a mega Christmas surprise. The hosts surprise people with a giant talking Christmas Jar.

episodes.title: Random Kayacts
episodes.description: Will and Emilie surprise the Serna family with a camping and kayaking adventure on the Colorado River. Will and Emilie have fun with tents at Scheels.

episodes.title: Free Run Fun
episodes.description: Trey Montgomery is figuring out his new normal after the tragic loss of his father. Trey loves the training discipline of parkour, so Will and Jenna give Trey the parkour surprise of a lifetime. Will, Jenna, and Mason throw a dozen birthday parties.

episodes.title: Underwater Sea-Prise
episodes.description: After losing her husband, Brad, to cancer, Robin Smith is staying strong for her children. Will and Emilie send Robin to Catalina Island where several more surprises await her. Will and Jenna search for buried treasure at the aquarium.

episodes.title: Woodn’t Believe Your Eyes
episodes.description: Jesse Wright has endured a life of struggle and pain, starting with a debilitating accident when he was 17 years old. Will and Emilie help give Jesse and his kids their very own rooms. Will, Jenna, and Mason help with annoying little odd jobs.

episodes.title: Snow Day Like Today
episodes.description: Year after year Zoie never gets to play in the snow, so Will and Emilie bring “winter” to Zoie’s backyard a bit early to accommodate her medical condition. Will and Emilie convince grocery shoppers to help them ring a bell for donations.

episodes.title: Acrobatic Affection
episodes.description: Annalise is the victim of severe bullying. To help her know she is loved, Emilie and Jenna arrange a dream-come-true performance where Annalise becomes the star. Mason and Emilie transform from caterpillar to butterfly in response to kindness.

episodes.title: Blue Sky Memory
episodes.description: Maddi and Sammi are two sisters who were in a terrible car accident that took the life of their best friend. Will and Emilie surprise them with a healing adventure. Will, Emilie, and Mason have fun with balloons and kind strangers in a mall.

episodes.title: Hush-Hush Hawaii
episodes.description: Kimberly always puts others first, which is why Will and Jenna decide to give her a day off that includes pampering and a party that she’ll never forget. Will and Emilie take to the road to show gratitude to frontline professionals.

episodes.title: Around the World in Addie Days
episodes.description: Addison is an amazing young woman who suffers from a rare disease that will eventually take her vision. Will and Emilie take Addison on a virtual world tour with surprises along the way. Will and Mason have photographic fun with kind strangers.

episodes.title: Dolphinitely Seaprising
episodes.description: Annalisa was born with a string of health challenges, and yet she’s happy, positive, and constantly serving others. Will and Emilie setup a day of surprises including a trip to Florida and working as a dolphin trainer; Emilie helps dunk Will.

episodes.title: Welcome Holmes
episodes.description: Aimee Holmes is a kind, selfless, and empathetic wife and mother. Will and Emilie surprise Aimee with a baking class so she can unknowingly make dinner for her family, and a surprise guest; Will and Mason surprise kids at their lemonade stands.

episodes.title: That's So School
episodes.description: Anna Jeffrey is visually impaired. She’s also a wife, mother, teacher, and community leader. Will and Jenna install some helpful updates in Anna’s home including a big red surprise in the backyard; Emilie seeks help to load a lot into her little car.

episodes.title: A Knight To Remember
episodes.description: Damien has Muscular Dystrophy and has lost his ability to walk. Will and Emilie surprise Damien with his first time on an airplane so he can have an ice-cold experience in Las Vegas; Will and Mason shave ice and share it.

episodes.title: Searching For Surprises
episodes.description: Denise Watts was killed in a terrible car accident. Will and Emilie surprise her husband and kids with a scavenger hunt. Everything culminates into big birthday celebration for Denise; Emilie and Mason reward kind people who help them solve clues.

episodes.title: The Cinderella Project
episodes.description: Angela Miller helps young women get access to prom dresses with The Cinderella Project. Will and Emilie enlist Angela’s help to design a ball for a very deserving person; Emilie and Mason convince random mall shoppers to help Emilie pick a dress.

episodes.title: Zoo-mongous Surprise
episodes.description: Esther loves to dance, but she has a rare disease that is slowly taking away her ability to use one of her legs. So, Will and Mason setup a dancing surprise with her favorite TikTok Celebrity; Will and Jenna ask for help in choosing animal costumes.

episodes.title: Ready, Set, Snow!
episodes.description: The Rasmussen family were evacuated from their home early Christmas morning, minutes before a bomb exploded, so Will and Jenna give this wonderful family a Christmas redo; Will and Mason decorate front yards to celebrate Secret Santas of the world.

episodes.title: Hawaiian Hijinks
episodes.description: Christie Rasmussen does random acts of kindness every single day of her life. Because of her constant service she’s never been a vacation with just her husband Brian. Will, Jenna, and Mason surprise Christie and Brian with a tropical vacation.

episodes.title: Love and Lederhosen
episodes.description: Ricky and Lexi met and fell in love while both receiving cancer treatment. Because Ricky was born in Germany, Emilie and Mason surprise them both with a Bavarian dinner full of family and friends, with dessert becoming another surprise entirely.

episodes.title: Diving and Thriving
episodes.description: When Nate Ogden became a quadriplegic, he refused to give up on his huge underwater dream. Will, Emilie, and Mason work with a specialized organization to make Nate's dream a reality. Emilie and Mason set up a spa surprise right outside an elevator.

episodes.title: One Stop Holiday Shop
episodes.description: Cheryl Smith, founding member of the Autism Council of Utah, gets a holiday surprise. Having missed almost all family activities because of the care her autistic son Carson requires, she gets to catch up on much-needed grandkid time.

episodes.title: Duvet is the Day
episodes.description: Lucy Blaylock has been making blankets for children all over the world to help them through hard times. Overwhelmed with orders, Will and Emilie put together a team to help Lucy fulfill her orders and to give her a surprise trip she’s always wanted.

episodes.title: Bag Pipe-Dream
episodes.description: Kari Craig is known for her dependable good mood and willingness to help anyone in need, especially in her work as a medical professional. The hosts surprise Kari with a trip to a local Scottish festival and more to celebrate her heritage.

episodes.title: A Room of His Own
episodes.description: The Kendall family works hard through many sleepless nights to care for their son with special needs and still manage to be active and beloved members of their community. The hosts facilitate a major surprise for them to make their lives easier.

episodes.title: Snappy Memories
episodes.description: The Spindle family is known for being selfless and giving, even after they lost everything--including their family photos--in a wildfire. The Random Acts team sets up a photo shoot to help the Spindles recapture their favorite memories.

episodes.title: Peak-ing Amazing
episodes.description: After losing her dad in a tragic rock climbing accident, Winter has turned her grief into helping and lifting others and continuing climbing. The hosts surprise Winter with a trip that will honor her father and continue his legacy.

episodes.title: Lemon-Aid Stand
episodes.description: Ever since she lost a teacher to cancer, Savannah has been organizing an annual lemonade stand that has grown to involve her whole community and has raised thousands of dollars. The hosts surprise her with a country music trip of her dreams.

episodes.title: Italian Sopresa
episodes.description: Katie is constantly serving others despite the challenges she faces with Spina Bifida and after losing her adopted mom. Her friends come together with the Random Acts team to give her the birthday celebration she deserves.

episodes.title: Turtally Amazing
episodes.description: Despite being born with brittle bone disease, Hadley is a constant source of joy for all those around her. Since she loves swimming and sea turtles, the Random Acts team surprise Hadley with an up close and personal turtle experience.

episodes.title: Lighting Their World
episodes.description: Jessica Rigsby is seven years into a five-year cancer diagnosis and is trying to have lots of happy family memories while she still can. The hosts plan a Christmas surprise that involves a very bright surprise; Emilie and Mason vend kindness.

episodes.title: Arizona to Denmark
episodes.description: Will arrives at Camp Grace in Arizona to surprise camp director Jennifer Brimhall with a life-changing trip to Denmark, where Jennifer's ancestors lived before emigrating to America.

episodes.title: Kindness Begins With Kim
episodes.description: Kim Fields is a campus supervisor at Taft Union High School where he’s impacted thousands of students. The hosts plan a huge pep rally in his honor, with a final NFL related surprise.

episodes.title: Life's a Circus
episodes.description: Carilee Card is an exceptional woman who suffers from serious health issues due to the long-term effects of having anorexia. She loves doing acrobatics, so Will and JiWon head to Vegas to plan a circus surprise.

episodes.title: Giving Back to Brenda
episodes.description: Brenda Hughes feeds her community through her organization, the Giving Back Foundation. The Random Acts team surprises Brenda with a trip to Paris, the place she feels an emotional connection to.

episodes.title: In For A Penny
episodes.description: Penny and Lee Larson have fostered over 65 children despite Penny's ongoing medical struggles. Will, Jenna, and Charan join Heart 2 Home to surprise the family with a much-needed home renovation that allows Penny to better care for the kids.

episodes.title: Emily in NYC
episodes.description: Emily Traveller became paralyzed from the shoulders down in 2022, stalling her dreams of being a fashion designer. The hosts team up with Runway of Dreams to give Emily a NYC Fashion Week experience to remind her that her goals are still possible.

episodes.title: Double the Fun
episodes.description: Joy and Diana nominated each other for a Random Act, so Jenna and Charan decide that two surprises are better than one. The women decorate each other's houses. Joy and Diana also love The Chosen TV show, so the hosts get them a special VIP tour.

episodes.title: Missy on the Move
episodes.description: Missy, a 17-year-old with spina bifida loves the theater and performing. The hosts plan a surprise that allows Missy to be a reporter for a day. She also receives a much-needed gift from Compassion Mobility.

episodes.title: The Helpers
episodes.description: Despite spending much of her time in hospitals due to a life-threatening heart condition, 12-year-old Abigail helped to start a service-minded club called The Helpers. Will and Jenna help the club to set up a carnival to raise money for Make-A-Wish.

episodes.title: Angels of Kindness
episodes.description: Will and Jenna team up with Kristiny to select Angels to surprise in her hometown of Havre, Montana. In the end the final Christmas-themed surprise is for Kristiny, the biggest angel of them all; Emilie, and Charan set up a kindness vending machine.

episodes.title: Easter Special 2026
episodes.description: Random Acts helps Kim recognize local heroes who are making a difference in her Tennessee community. Meanwhile, the community secretly prepares to share their appreciation for Kim with a surprise Easter festival and a surprise guest.

episodes.title: Random Acts Light the World Special 2025
episodes.description: This Christmas, the Random Acts team travels to Texas to surprise Ralphie, a generous soul who dedicates her time to celebrating local heroes, with a Santa’s workshop of her own, so she can continue spreading Christmas kindness.

6ef10280-3ab2-42f0-9431-8c3ff800d794.description: Chef Brad equips you with the know-how and appetite for healthy meals.

episodes.title: Quinoa
episodes.description: Chef Brad makes a variety of recipes using the South American supergrain quinoa. He fuses black quinoa  with whole grain bread, red quinoa with a breakfast salad, and white quinoa with meatloaf.

episodes.title: Kamut

episodes.title: Teff

episodes.title: Barley

episodes.title: Millet

episodes.title: Popcorn

episodes.title: Farro

episodes.title: Rice

episodes.title: Oats

episodes.title: Christmas/New Year's Special

episodes.title: Quinoa and Edamame Beans
episodes.description: Chef Brad makes a variety of recipes using edamame beans and white quinoa, including cookies, chicken soup, and cornbread.

episodes.title: White Wheat and Cranberry Beans
episodes.description: Chef Brad makes a variety of recipes using hard white wheat and cranberry beans, including hamburger buns, pulled pork, baked beans, and pineapple salsa.

episodes.title: Farro and Cannellini Beans
episodes.description: Chef Brad makes a variety of recipes using cannellini beans and farro, including tortillas, potato Chile Verde stew, and papaya salad.

episodes.title: Millet and Black-Eyed Peas
episodes.description: Chef Brad makes a variety of recipes using black-eyed peas and millet, including a Caribbean dish, stuffed tomatoes and soup.

episodes.title: Spelt and Great Northern Beans
episodes.description: Chef Brad makes a variety of recipes using great northern beans and spelt, including chipotle apple cake, stuffed pancakes, and a breakfast salad.

episodes.title: Rice and Colorado River Beans
episodes.description: Chef Brad makes a variety of recipes using brown rice and Colorado river beans, including oriental chicken salad, Chinese scallion bread, and stir fry.

episodes.title: Kamut and Lentil
episodes.description: Chef Brad makes a variety of recipes using kamut and lentils, including breakfast cereal, Caesar salad, and soup.

episodes.title: Barley and Fava Beans
episodes.description: Chef Brad makes a variety of recipes using fava beans and barley, including spinach sandwiches on homemade bread and a salad.

episodes.title: Teff and Small Red Beans
episodes.description: Chef Brad makes a variety of recipes using small red beans and teff, including relish, potato pie, and non-fried fried ice cream.

episodes.title: Amaranth and Butter Beans
episodes.description: Chef Brad makes a variety of recipes using butter beans and amaranth, including breaded pork tenderloin, Waldorf salad, and mac and cheese.

episodes.title: Oat Groats and Kidney Beans
episodes.description: Chef Brad makes a variety of recipes using kidney beans and oat groats, including bean dip, kalamata flat bread, fall stew, and pasta salad.

episodes.title: Black Quinoa
episodes.description: Chef Brad makes a variety of recipes using black quinoa, including east coast crab cakes, banana bread, and a pasta salad.

episodes.title: Spelt
episodes.description: Chef Brad makes a variety of recipes using spelt. He fuses spelt with chocolate cupcakes, potato rosemary biscuits, and stuffed cantaloupe.

episodes.title: Freekeh
episodes.description: Chef Brad makes a variety of recipes using freekeh. He fuses freekeh with blender pancakes, hot cereal, and muffins.

episodes.title: Black Barley
episodes.description: Chef Brad makes a variety of recipes using black barley, including Thai style pudding, fried rice, and a cabbage salad.

episodes.title: Red Quinoa
episodes.description: Chef Brad makes a variety of recipes using red quinoa, including a breakfast frittata, stuffed peppers, and stuffed croissant sandwiches.

episodes.title: Flax and Chia Seed
episodes.description: Chef Brad makes a variety of recipes using flax and chia seeds. He fuses these seeds with roasted garlic mashed potatoes, pot roast, and bread.

episodes.title: Amaranth
episodes.description: Chef Brad makes a variety of recipes using amaranth. He fuses amaranth with protein bars, granola, and oatmeal cookies.

episodes.title: Kamut
