episodes.title: Brown Rice
episodes.description: Chef Brad makes a variety of recipes using brown rice, including cheesy olive bread and meatballs with a roasted garlic tomato sauce.

episodes.title: Sprouted Barley
episodes.description: Chef Brad makes a variety of recipes using sprouted barley, including pancakes, fruit salad, flatbread, and barbecued ribs.

episodes.title: Kaniwa
episodes.description: Chef Brad makes a variety of recipes using kaniwa. Chef Brad fuses kaniwa with a fruit salad, waffles, and omelets.

episodes.title: Hard Red Wheat
episodes.description: Chef Brad makes a variety of recipes using hard red wheat, including cracked wheat feather bread, sourdough artisan bread, rotisserie chicken, and potatoes.

episodes.title: Sorghum Gluten-Free Recipes
episodes.description: Chef Brad makes a variety of recipes using gluten-free sorghum. He fuses sorghum with double baked biscotti, chili, and a salad.

088bf338-e026-4dc0-8483-be34a5bf9bc8.description: Meet the independent makers who are reinventing what it means to be an artist.

episodes.title: Jake Parker
episodes.description: Hosts Austin Craig and Jordan Petersen sit down with cartoonist Jake Parker to learn what inspires him to create and how he’s using artistic collaboration to connect with his community.

episodes.title: Shaun "Shonduras" McBride
episodes.description: Austin and Jordan meet social media star Shonduras and discover what motivates him as a creator. The hosts challenge Shonduras to step out of his comfort zone and create an inspirational mural.

episodes.title: Eric Mesplé
episodes.description: Eric Mesplé combines computer science and sculpture as he creates innovative and interactive works of art. Austin and Jordan peek behind the curtain to see how Eric Mesplé brings his creations to life.

episodes.title: Michelle Osorio
episodes.description: Austin and Jordan meet virtual storyteller Michelle Osorio and learn how virtual reality and 360-degree video are changing the way artists create.

episodes.title: Aisha Fukushima
episodes.description: Musician Aisha Fukushima combines her activism and talent as a rapper into raptivism, inspiring people around the world to give back to their communities and engage in pressing social issues.

episodes.title: Kirby Ferguson
episodes.description: Independent filmmaker Kirby Ferguson teaches Austin and Jordan how to explore new ways of thinking as they create a video essay.

episodes.title: Benjamin Von Wong
episodes.description: Hosts Austin Craig and Jordan Petersen meet Benjamin von Wong, an emerging visual engineer who uses his photography to bring awareness to important social issues.

episodes.title: Patrick Rochon
episodes.description: Artist Patrick Rochon introduces Austin and Jordan to light painting, a type of photography that uses long exposure cameras and multicolored lights to create innovative works of art.

episodes.title: Mindy Gledhill & Trisha Zemp: Part 1
episodes.description: Hosts Austin Craig and Jordan Petersen unite singer-songwriter Mindy Gledhill and stop-motion animator Trisha Zemp to create a one-of-a-kind music video.

episodes.title: Mindy Gledhill & Trisha Zemp: Part 2
episodes.description: Hosts Austin Craig and Jordan Peterson, singer-songwriter Mindy Gledhill and animator Trisha Zemp work to finish Mindy’s stop-motion music video before their deadline.

eff182e5-5b17-41bb-90b2-9daac5cad3d3.description: Faculty members from the BYU Religious Education department discuss Acts through Revelation.

episodes.title: Luke 24 & Acts 1: "Behold My Hands and My Feet"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the apostles continuing Christ’s church after His ascension as described in Luke chapter 24 and Acts chapter 1. With Andrew Skinner, Jeffrey Marsh, Robert Millet, and Camille Fronk.

episodes.title: Acts 1-2: "Ordained to Be a Witness"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Acts chapters 1 and 2 which detail Jesus Christ’s 40-day ministry after His resurrection, the leadership in the apostles, and the day of Pentecost. With Andrew Skinner, Jeffrey Marsh, Robert Millet, and Camille Fronk.

episodes.title: Acts 3-5: "There Is None Other Name"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Peter and John healing and preaching outside the temple and their arrest by and testimonies to the Pharisees as described in Acts chapters 3 through 5. With Andrew Skinner, Jeffrey Marsh, Robert Millet, and Camille Fronk.

episodes.title: Acts 6-8: "I See The Heavens Opened"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Acts chapters 6 through 8 which detail the further organizing of the Church, rejection of Stephen’s testimony, and Saul persecuting the Church. With Robert Millet, Ray Huntington, Robert J. Matthews, and Jeffrey Marsh.

episodes.title: Acts 9-10: "Why Persecutest Thou Me?"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the conversions and callings of Saul and Cornelius which opens the door for more to be converted to Christ’s Church in Acts chapters 9 and 10. With Robert Millet, Ray Huntington, Robert J. Matthews, and Jeffrey Marsh.

episodes.title: Acts 10-13: "God Is No Respecter of Persons"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Acts chapters 10 through 13 which detail the teaching of the Gospel to the Gentiles, the martyrdom of James, and Saul’s name change to Paul. With Robert Millet, Ray Huntington, Robert J. Matthews, and Jeffrey Marsh.

episodes.title: Acts 14-16 & Gal. 2: "Continue in the Faith"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Acts chapters 14 through 16 which detail Paul and Barnabas’ mission to preach unto the Gentiles and organize Christ’s Church among them. With Robert Millet, Ray Huntington, Robert J. Matthews, and Jeffrey Marsh.

episodes.title: Acts 16-18 & 1 Thes. 1: "Him Declare I unto You"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Acts chapters 16 through 18 which detail Paul and Silas’ preaching in Macedonia, Thessalonica, Berea, and Athens including the baptism of Lydia. With Robert J. Matthews, Ray Huntington, Rex Reeve, and Thomas A. Wayment.

episodes.title: Acts 18-20 & 1 Cor. 1-2, 12: "In the Power of God"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Acts chapters 18 through 20 which teach importance of proper authority and 1 Corinthians chapters 1,2, and 12 which provide Paul’s corrective words. With Robert J. Matthews, Ray Huntington, Rex Reeve, and Thomas A. Wayment.

episodes.title: 1 Cor. 15 & 2 Cor. 11-12: "O Death, Where Is Thy Sting?"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Paul’s epistolary sermons about resurrection and the gospel of Christ as found in 1 Corinthians chapter 15 and 2 Corinthians chapters 11 and 12. With Robert J. Matthews, Ray Huntington, Rex Reeve, and Thomas A. Wayment.

episodes.title: Gal. 1-2: "But by the Revelation of Jesus Christ"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Galatians chapters 1 and 2 which detail Paul’s teaching among the Gentiles about the true gospel and his condemnation of false gospels. With Daniel Judd, David M. Whitchurch, S. Kent Brown, and Gaye Strathearn.

episodes.title: Gal. 3-6: "Ye Are All One in Christ Jesus"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Paul’s teachings about Christ’s law and covenants superseding the law of Moses as described in Galatians chapters 3 through 6. With Daniel Judd, David M. Whitchurch, S. Kent Brown, and Gaye Strathearn.

episodes.title: Only by His Grace: Gal. 3 & Rom. 1-3
episodes.description: Religious scholars review Paul’s preaching Christ’s law in Galatians chapter 3 and discuss Paul’s teaching Christ’s gospel of salvation in Romans chapters 1 through 3. With Andrew Skinner, Camille Fronk, Robert Millet, and Richard Draper.

episodes.title: Rom. 4-7: "Justified of Faith and Works"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Romans chapters 4 through 7 which detail Paul using the example of Abraham to teach how we are justified and sanctified through Christ’s Atonement. With Andrew Skinner, Camille Fronk, Robert Millet, and Richard Draper.

episodes.title: Rom. 8-12: "Joint-heirs with Christ"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Paul’s teaching of how we become joint heirs with Christ in the kingdom of God as well as the law of election as found in Romans chapters 8 through 12. With Andrew Skinner, Camille Fronk, Robert Millet, and Richard Draper.

episodes.title: Acts 21-28: "A Minister and a Witness"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Acts chapters 21 through 28 which detail Paul’s journey to Jerusalem, the persecution and difficulties he faces, and his journey to Rome. With Robert L. Millett, D. Kelly Ogden, Ray L. Huntington, and Robert Matthews.

episodes.title: Philemon, Colossians & Philippians: "Ye Are Risen with Him"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Paul’s epistles to Philemon, the Colossians, and the Philippians which tell of changed lives because of the gospel of Jesus Christ. With Robert L. Millett, D. Kelly Ogden, Ray L. Huntington, and Robert Matthews.

episodes.title: Ephesians: "The Whole Armor of God"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Paul’s epistles to the Ephesians which prophecy of the restoration of the gospel in the latter days and the importance of baptism and families. With Robert L. Millett, D. Kelly Ogden, Ray L. Huntington, and Robert Matthews.

episodes.title: 1 & 2 Timothy & Titus: "An Example of the Believers"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss 1 and 2 Timothy and Titus which detail Paul’s counsel to teach only true doctrine and the responsibilities of priesthood offices. With Robert L. Millett, D. Kelly Ogden, Ray L. Huntington, and Robert Matthews.

episodes.title: 1 Tim. 2 & 1 Cor. 7 & 11: Render Due Benevolence
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Paul’s guidance on behavior and learning to new converts as found in 1 Timothy chapter 2 and 1 Corinthians chapters 7 and 11. With Robert Matthews, Camille Fronk, Richard D. Draper, and Thomas A. Wayment.

episodes.title: Heb. 1-3: "Crowned with Glory and Honor"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Hebrews chapters 1 through 3 which detail Paul’s testimony of Jesus Christ and His role as the Only Begotten Son and Redeemer. With Robert Matthews, Camille Fronk, Richard D. Draper, and Thomas A. Wayment.

episodes.title: Heb. 3-5 & 7: The Order of Melchizedek
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Hebrews chapters 3, 4, 5, and 7 which detail Christ’s example of priesthood authority after the order of Melchizedek. With Robert Matthews, Camille Fronk, Richard D. Draper, and Thomas A. Wayment.

episodes.title: Heb. 8-10, 12-13: "A More Excellent Ministry"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the new law and covenant brought by Jesus Christ as described in Hebrews chapters 8, 9, 10, 12, and 13. With Robert Matthews, David M. Whitchurch, D. Kelly Ogden, and Keith J. Wilson.

episodes.title: James 1; 3-5: "Be Ye Doers of the Word"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss James chapters 1 and 3 through 5 which detail the importance of gospel wisdom while in the world and how to obtain it. With Robert Matthews, David M. Whitchurch, D. Kelly Ogden, and Keith J. Wilson.

episodes.title: Heb. 11; James 2: "Faith without Works"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the power of faith and the importance of partnering faith with action as discussed in Hebrews chapter 11 and James chapter 2. With Robert Matthews, David M. Whitchurch, D. Kelly Ogden, and Keith J. Wilson.

episodes.title: 1 Pet. 1-2: "The Trial of Your Faith"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss 1 Peter chapters 1 and 2 which detail Peter’s teachings regarding faith, salvation, and Christ as the chief cornerstone. With Robert Matthews, Camille Fronk, Victor L. Ludlow, and W. Jeffrey Marsh.

episodes.title: 2 Peter: "Partakers of the Divine Nature"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Peter’s teaching on preparing for the Second Coming and making our calling and election sure as described in the Second Epistle General of Peter. With Robert Matthews, Camille Fronk, Victor L. Ludlow, and W. Jeffrey Marsh.

episodes.title: 1 John: "What Manner of Love"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the general epistles of John which teach of the crucial reality of Christ in the flesh and as our Savior. With Robert Matthews, Camille Fronk, Victor L. Ludlow, and W. Jeffrey Marsh.

episodes.title: Jude: "Remember Ye the Words"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Jude’s teachings of the Godhead, principles of the first estate, and the Second Coming as described in the General Epistle of Jude. With Andrew Skinner, Victor Ludlow, Richard Draper, and Kent Brown.

episodes.title: Rev. 1-3: The Words of This Prophecy
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the revelation of Jesus Christ and the visions of John of the last days that begin in Revelation chapters 1 through 3. With Andrew Skinner, Victor Ludlow, Richard Draper, and Kent Brown.

episodes.title: Rev. 1-3: "Alpha and Omega"
episodes.description: Religious scholars continue to discuss Revelation chapters 1 through 3 which detail John’s vision of the Risen Lord in the last days and details of eternal life. With Andrew Skinner, Victor Ludlow, Richard Draper, and Kent Brown.

episodes.title: Rev. 4-6: "A Sea of Glass"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the meaning of symbolic images described in Revelation chapters 4 through 6 and how these images are meant to arouse curiosity in readers. With Joseph McConkie, Victor Ludlow, Jeffrey Marsh, and Richard Draper.

episodes.title: Rev. 6-13: "Before the Throne of God"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the symbolism of the many seals and the meaning for the last days that are described in Revelation chapters 6 through 13. With Joseph McConkie, Victor Ludlow, Jeffrey Marsh, and Richard Draper.

episodes.title: Rev. 19-22: "King of Kings, and Lord of Lords"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Revelation chapters 19 through 22 which detail the events that will lead to the Second Coming of Jesus Christ and details of the Millennium. With Joseph McConkie, Victor Ludlow, Jeffrey Marsh, and Richard Draper.

8a9a1113-59d4-4f33-9cb0-c46c366804cc.description: No script? No problem! Comedians use teamwork and imagination to create musicals on the spot.

episodes.title: Lipstick Time
episodes.description: The Show Offs team up with guests Lucas Grabeel and Tom Quinn to create a hilarious golden-age musical right on the spot.

episodes.title: Where Art Thou?
episodes.description: The Show Offs team up with James “Murr” Murray (Impractical Jokers) and Shaun Johnson (The Johnson Files) to create an outstanding Shakespearean comedy. Watch as Murr becomes host Casey Jost's puppet and must do and say whatever he tells him to.

episodes.title: Never Happy Again
episodes.description: The Show Offs create a contemporary musical on the spot with Shaun Johnson and Kelly Lohman. When Carl (Jake Van Wagoner) falls in love with a stranger in the park (Lisa Valentine Clark), he'll go to any lengths to find her again.

episodes.title: The Handbiters
episodes.description: The Show Offs join forces with Kirby Heyborne (BYUtv's Making Good). Watch as they create a classic film-noir plot while host Casey Jost makes the cast speak in different accents, sing songs, and even perform a dance number.

episodes.title: The First Pizza Delivery Boy
episodes.description: Special guest Alex Boyé joins the Show Offs in a modern-day musical. The cast creates an exciting adventure chronicling a pizza-delivery boy’s journey from Italy to America. Tom Quinn also guest stars.

episodes.title: Doctor Space
episodes.description: Along with special guests Corbin Bleu (High School Musical) and Jake Suazo, the Show Offs create a science fiction musical where Bleu and Hailey Smith ace off against the dark leader of the galaxy (Suazo) and his bumbling son (Jake Van Wagoner).

episodes.title: The Grass is Always Greener
episodes.description: The Show Offs go contemporary with this version of a Broadway musical. Joined by guests Adam Johnson and Sarah Cornell, the cast launches into a long history between two best friends turned enemies.

episodes.title: Forgotten Boots
episodes.description: The Show Offs and guests Kelly Lohman and Will Rubio (Random Acts) improvise a very British comedy. As the lord and lady of Thunderbird Manor challenge each other to an opposite day where they each have to take over the other's household duties.

episodes.title: No Veggies in Sight
episodes.description: The Show Offs perform a Golden Age musical with guests Adam Johnson and Jake Suazo. A movie star and his manager ask a hot dog vendor to point them in the direction of available women they can meet.

episodes.title: No Service in Knownstown
episodes.description: The Show Offs and guests Tom Quinn and Sarah Cornell improvise a Spaghetti Western. An evil cattle baron vows to take over the town, but two people stand in his way. Saddle up with the Show Offs as they showdown at sundown in this episode.

episodes.title: Shenanigans in the Castle
episodes.description: The Show Offs take on the fantasy genre with special guests Kelly Stables (Superstore, The Exes) and Will Rubio (Random Acts). Jake is an evil wizard that has released a terrible dragon to terrorize the land.

episodes.title: Midnight Sunrise
episodes.description: Ice-dancing rock stars, a kidney transplant, and the chance of a lifetime: NSYNC's Joey Fatone joins the Show Offs for a wildly original rock opera adventure. Jack Suazo also guest stars.

episodes.title: Cheery Days
episodes.description: The Show Offs and guests Shaun Johnson and Will Rubio improvise a Golden Age musical in which two swindlers have a change of heart after trying to replace authentic cheer with artificial joy. Turns out you can't buy happiness!

episodes.title: I Love Sandwiches
episodes.description: Join the sandwich revolution! In this completely improvised rock opera, Lazy Sue has her mind blown when she tries a new type of sandwich. PB and J, this is your day! Jake Suazo and Shaun Johnson guest star with the Show Offs.

episodes.title: Galaxy Next Door
episodes.description: Darius's space wife threatens to banish him to a faraway galaxy unless he can travel to earth and retrieve an ottoman. It's the sci-fi musical of the century, starring the Show Offs and special guests Carrie McCrossen and Sarah Cornell.

episodes.title: Toucheth Me Not
episodes.description: A beautiful queen fleeth to Italy to escape her suitors. Shakespearean plights and poisonous snake bites reveal true intentions and secret loves. With guest stars Tom Quinn and Sarah Cornell.

episodes.title: High School Planes
episodes.description: In this modern Broadway musical, Persephone makes new friends in Mrs. Willis' art class after sharing her incredible model airplanes. Get ready for High School Musical, the improv way! Lauren Pritchard and Sarah Cornell guest star.

episodes.title: Starvation Planet
episodes.description: In a galaxy far from Earth, an admiral and his trusty robot seek the help of a daring chef to save their starving planet. Shaun Johnson and John Rhys-Davies (The Lord of the Rings trilogy, Raiders of the Lost Ark) guest star.

episodes.title: All in a Row
episodes.description: Get your spurs, 'cuz this improv Western is rarin' to go. Peter steals a prize duck in hopes of impressing Eliza, but Wolfmeister Malone strikes first. Kelly Lohman and Jake Suazo join the Show Offs as special guests.

episodes.title: It's Raining Fur
episodes.description: To stop a small-town realtor from selling to a new couple, Trevor and Penelope hatch a plan involving flying cats and lonely llamas. This hilarious Broadway-style improv will have you laughing till you cry. Kelly Lohman and Jordan Coleman guest star.

episodes.title: Hungry for Something
episodes.description: Guitars, drums, and bass feed the soul in this improv rock opera. Kaylee must choose between Ricky the jock or Kyle, the mysterious new kid. What is she to do? Shaun Johnson and Will Rubio (Random Acts) guest star with the Show Offs.

episodes.title: Mistletoe Miracle
episodes.description: Will Forte (SNL, The Last Man on Earth) guest stars. In this never-before-seen musical, Barnaby is worried about providing for his large family, especially after an impulsive Christmas shopping spree. Matt Cook also guests stars.

episodes.title: Desserts in the Wind
episodes.description: Will Rubio (Random Acts) and Carrie McCrossen guest star. When a pudding bar at a wedding turns up some cynical characters, even the bride and groom wonder if love can save the day. It's improv comedy at its most delicious!

episodes.title: The Rose and the Buffoon
episodes.description: As this fairy tale goes, an elf in love with a human is desperate to save his forest and win his true love. Tom Quinn and Abel Arias guest star in this hilarious improv romance.

episodes.title: Pride and Reptiles
episodes.description: In this improv Regency masterpiece, warring nobles seek to control the newly imported alligator population. Prepare for delightful intrigue perfect for fans of Pride and Prejudice or Downton Abbey. Lea Thompson (Back to the Future)  guest stars.

episodes.title: Dumpster Diving for Love
episodes.description: In cold New York City, Brandeen is a lonely pet shop owner who considers selling her shop after she unexpectedly falls in love. Tom Quinn and Lauren Pritchard guest star in this never-before-seen rom-com.

episodes.title: Don't Laugh at My Pain
episodes.description: Barnum hesitates to take over his father's business, but when he discovers that he has a sister he never knew about, he heads out to find her so they can run the business together. Don Lake and Tom Quinn guest star in this hilarious Broadway musical.

episodes.title: Evergreen Manor
episodes.description: Nancy's true love has finally come home from the circus, but Nancy's father is opposed to the match. Jake Suazo and Kelly Lohman guest star in this improv Regency romance.

episodes.title: The Third Eclipse
episodes.description: Join the Show Offs and guest stars Aliza Pearl and Jake Suazo on a boisterous improv musical. A centaur must prevent an eclipse from happening.

episodes.title: Flight of the Trucks
episodes.description: Matt Cook and Lauren Pritchard guest star in a fantastical, musical improv comedy. Bethany is an aspiring witch who must defeat a swarm of magical trucks that wield wheels of fire.

episodes.title: Beyond Chairs
episodes.description: Two accountants, tired of their pencil-pushing lives, steal sailor uniforms and make their getaway. The Show Offs are joined by guest stars Jake Suazo and Lauren Pritchard to produce this on-the-spot Golden Age musical.

episodes.title: Edge of the World
episodes.description: Weary space travelers must search for fuel to escape their current planet. Together, they must outsmart Crazy John, a man with an odd dual personality, to make their getaway plans a reality. With guest stars Aliza Pearl and Kelly Lohman.

06254a9a-bcd9-4fe5-b0cb-5193905e7d8b.description: Roundtable in-depth discussions on The Book of Mormon: Another Testament of Jesus Christ.

episodes.title: Joseph Smith-History
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the events leading to the coming forth of the Book of Mormon including celestial visitations and the calling of Joseph Smith as prophet, seer, and revelator. With Andrew H. Hedges, Kent Jackson, Keith Wilson, Steven Harper.

episodes.title: Testimony of the Witnesses and General Church History
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the efforts of Joseph Smith to translate, print, and bind the Book of Mormon as well as the testimony of the witnesses to the plates. With Andrew H. Hedges, Kent P. Jackson, Keith J. Wilson, and Steven C. Harper.

episodes.title: The Structure of the Book of Mormon
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss and explain the structure, chronology, and writing styles of the Book of Mormon. With Andrew H. Hedges, Keith J. Wilson, Todd B. Parker, and Steven C. Harper.

episodes.title: The Divine Purposes of the Book of Mormon--Part 1
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the title page, written by Moroni, as well as the many authors that contributed to the Book of Mormon. With Daniel K. Judd, Clyde J. Williams, Frank F. Judd, and Stan A. Johnson.

episodes.title: The Divine Purposes of the Book of Mormon--Part 2
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the divine purposes of the Book of Mormon to testify of Jesus Christ and the claim that it is the most correct book on the Earth. With Daniel K. Judd, Clyde J. Williams, Frank F. Judd, and Stan A. Johnson.

episodes.title: 1 Nephi 1-2
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the Prophet Lehi and his family’s obedience to flee Jerusalem to the promised as written by Nephi, Lehi’s son, in 1 Nephi chapters 1-2. With Terry B. Ball, Clyde J. Williams, Gaye Strathearn, and Paul Y. Hoskisson.

episodes.title: 1 Nephi 3-7
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Lehi’s sons’ errands to Jerusalem to retrieve the brass plates and the family of Ishmael as ordered by the Lord in 1 Nephi chapters 3-7. With Terry B. Ball, Paul Y. Hoskisson, Clyde J. Williams, and Gaye Strathearn.

episodes.title: 1 Nephi 8-10
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Lehi’s vision of the tree of life in 1 Nephi chapters 8-10. With Terri B. Ball, Gaye Strathearn, Paul Y. Hoskisson, and Clyde J. Williams.

episodes.title: 1 Nephi 11-12
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Nephi’s vision of the tree of life in 1 Nephi chapters 11 and 12.

episodes.title: 1 Nephi 13-15
episodes.description: Religious scholars continue discussing Nephi’s vision in 1 Nephi chapters 13-15 and applying the symbolism in the latter days. With Daniel K. Judd, Kith J. Wilson, Camille Fronk Olson, and Dana M. Pike.

episodes.title: 1 Nephi 16-18
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss 1 Nephi chapters 16-18 which detail the preparations Lehi’s family took for their journey to the promised land. With Daniel K. Judd, Kith J. Wilson, Camille Fronk Olson, and Dana M. Pike.

episodes.title: 1 Nephi 19-22
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Nephi’s work of recording in the small plates and the scattering of Israel as found in 1 Nephi chapters 19-22. With Robert L. Millet, Thomas A. Wayment, Victor L. Ludlow, and Stanley A. Johnson.

episodes.title: 2 Nephi 1, 3
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss 2 Nephi chapters 1 and 3 which detail the scattering of Israel, Nephi’s contentions with his brothers, and Lehi’s teaching his son Joseph. With Robert L. Millet, Thomas A. Wayment, Victor L. Ludlow, and Stanley A. Johnson.

episodes.title: 2 Nephi 2
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss how redemption is provided by the Holy Messiah as taught to Jacob, Lehi’s firstborn in the wilderness, in 2 Nephi chapter 2. With Robert L. Millet, Thomas A. Wayment, Victor L. Ludlow, and Stanley A. Johnson.

episodes.title: 2 Nephi 4-5
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss 2 Nephi chapters 4 and 5 which describe the blessings Lehi gives to his posterity before his death and Nephi’s psalm. With Paul Y. Hoskisson, Eric D. Huntsman, Victor L. Ludlow, and Stanley A. Johnson.

episodes.title: 2 Nephi 6-8, 10
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Jacob teaching the words of Isaiah and the history of the Jews in 2 Nephi chapters 6, 7, 8, and 10. With Paul Y. Hoskisson, Victor L. Ludlow, Stanley A. Johnson, and Eric D. Huntsman.

episodes.title: 2 Nephi 9
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss 2 Nephi chapter 9 which provides Jacob’s teaching of Isaiah’s words concerning the Atonement and the gathering of Israel. With Paul Y. Hoskisson, Stanley A. Johnson, Eric D. Huntsman, and Victor L. Ludlow.

episodes.title: 2 Nephi 11-16
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the Isaiah chapters found in 2 Nephi chapters 11 through 16 and the principles of covenants associated with the Atonement. With Victor L. Ludlow, Dana M. Pike, Terry B. Ball, and Kerry Muhlestein.

episodes.title: 2 Nephi 17-24
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the Isaiah chapters found in 2 Nephi chapters 17 through 24 which detail the prophecies of the coming and purposes of Jesus Christ. With Victor L. Ludlow, Dana M. Pike, Terry B. Ball, and Kerry Muhlestein.

episodes.title: 2 Nephi 25-27
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss 2 Nephi chapters 25 through 27 and Nephi’s expounding on the words of Isaiah and how we can apply them to our lives in the latter days. With Victor L. Ludlow, Kerry Muhlestein, Dana M. Pike, and Terry B. Ball.

episodes.title: 2 Nephi 28-30
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss false churches and the denial of miracles and modern revelation in the last days as found in 2 Nephi chapters 28 through 30. With Gaye Strathearn, Keith J. Wilson, Michael Rhodes, and Stanley A. Johnson.

episodes.title: 2 Nephi 31-33
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss 2 Nephi chapters 31 through 33 which provide Nephi’s testimony on baptism, prayer, the Holy Ghost, and Jesus Christ. With Gaye Strathearn, Keith J. Wilson, Michael Rhodes, and Stanley A. Johnson.

episodes.title: Jacob 1-3, 7
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Jacob’s taking the mantle from Nephi of keeping a record and his teaching to reject pride and immorality in Jacob chapters 1, 2, 3, and 7. With Gaye Strathearn, Keith J. Wilson, Michael Rhodes, and Stanley A. Johnson.

episodes.title: Jacob 4-6
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the allegory of the olive tree and how it applies to the ancient Israelites and to us today as found in Jacob chapters 4 through 6. With Victor L. Ludlow, Charles Swift, Frank Judd, and Jared Ludlow.

episodes.title: Enos; Jarom; Omni
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the books of Enos, Jarom and Omni which demonstrate the importance of record keeping, repentance, and obedience. With Victor L. Ludlow, Charles Swift, Frank Judd, and Jared Ludlow.

episodes.title: Words of Mormon; Mosiah 1-2
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Mormon’s work of abridgment and the reign and teaching of King Benjamin as described in the Words of Mormon and the Book of Mosiah chapters 1 and 2. With Victor L. Ludlow, Charles Swift, Jared Ludlow, and Frank Judd.

episodes.title: Mosiah 3-6
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the Atonement of Jesus Christ as taught by King Benjamin and his work to organize and record the names of his people in Mosiah chapters 4-6. With Clyde Williams, Andrew C. Skinner, Eric D. Huntsman, and Terrence L. Szink.

episodes.title: Mosiah 7-13
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the contention between the Nephites and Lamanites and the lives of Ammon, Zeniff, Laman, Noah and Abinadi in Mosiah chapters 7-13. With Clyde Williams, Andrew C. Skinner, Eric D. Huntsman, and Terrence L. Szink.

episodes.title: Mosiah 18-24
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Alma’s authority as a prophet and the conflict between the people of King Noah and King Limhi as described in Mosiah chapters 18 through 24. With Clyde Williams, Andrew C. Skinner, Eric D. Huntsman, and Terrence L. Szink.

episodes.title: Mosiah 14-17
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Mosiah chapters 14 through 17 which provide Abinadi’s sermon to King Noah which taught of Jesus Christ being the Messiah as taught by Isaiah. With Robert L. Millet, D. Kelly Ogden, Todd B. Parker, and Brian M. Hauglid.

episodes.title: Mosiah 25-28
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss organizing the Church of God and the importance of belief in order to understand as taught in Mosiah chapters 25 through 28. With Robert L. Millet, D. Kelly Ogden, Todd B. Parker, and Brian M. Hauglid.

episodes.title: Mosiah 29
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Alma the Younger’s change of heart and purpose and Mosiah changing the government from kings to judges as described in Mosiah chapter 29. With Robert L. Millet, D. Kelly Ogden, Todd B. Parker, and Brian M. Hauglid.

episodes.title: Alma 1-4
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Alma chapter 1 through 4 which detail Nehor’s false teaching and the conflicts spread throughout the land politically and spiritually. With Terry B. Ball, Thomas Wayment, David M. Whitchurch, and Dana M. Pike.

episodes.title: Alma 5-7
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Alma the Younger’s preaching the gospel and organizing the Church in the lands of Zarahemla and Gideon as detailed in Alma chapters 5 through 7. With Terry B. Ball, Dana M. Pike, David M. Whitchurch, and Thomas Wayment.

episodes.title: Alma 8-12
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the continued preaching of Alma the Younger in Alma chapters 8 through 12 where he sees varied results from Melek, Ammonihah, Zeezrom, and others. With Terry B. Ball, David M. Whitchurch, and Thomas Wayment, Dana M. Pike.

episodes.title: Alma 13-16
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Alma chapters 13 through 16 which detail Alma and Amulek being sent to prison but after a miraculous act of God were able to walk out. With Paul Y. Hoskisson, Camille Fronk Olson, Eric D. Huntsman, Clyde J. Williams.

episodes.title: Alma 17-21
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the sons of Mosiah preaching to the Lamanites in the land of Nephi as found in Alma chapters 17 through 21. With Paul Y. Hoskisson, Eric D. Huntsman, Clyde J. Williams, and Camille Fronk Olson.

episodes.title: Alma 20-24
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Alma chapters 20 through 24 which detail Ammon delivering his brothers from prison to continue missionary work to King Lamoni’s people. With Paul Y. Hoskisson, Clyde J. Williams, Camille Fronk Olson, and Eric D. Huntsman.

episodes.title: Alma 25-29
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the ongoing preaching of the sons of Mosiah despite Lamanite aggressions and their return to the land of Nephi in Alma chapters 25 through 29. With Clyde J. Williams, Gaye Strathearn, Charles Swift, and Keith J. Wilson.

episodes.title: Alma 30
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the lies of Korihor, the anti-Christ, compared against the truth that Alma preaches as found in Alma chapter 30. With Clyde J. Williams, Gaye Strathearn, Charles Swift, and Keith J. Wilson.

episodes.title: Alma 31-32
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Alma chapters 31 and 32 which detail Alma’s efforts to humble the apostate Zoramites who were prideful and prayed on a Rameumptom. With Clyde J. Williams, Keith J. Wilson, Gaye Strathearn, and Charles Swift.

episodes.title: Alma 33-35
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Alma’s continued preaching to the Zoramites about mercy and salvation provided by Christ as found in Alma chapters 33 through 35. With Victor L. Ludlow, Stanley A. Johnson, Terry B. Ball, and Terrence L. Szink.

episodes.title: Alma 36-37
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Alma chapters 36 and 37 which detail Alma’s teaching to his son Helaman who, as Alma, went through a conversion process and will be a prophet. With Victor L. Ludlow, Stanley A. Johnson, Terry B. Ball, and Terrence L. Szink.

episodes.title: Alma 38-39
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Alma chapters 38 and 39 which provide Alma’s commandments, blessings, and callings to his sons Shiblon and Corianton. With Victor L. Ludlow, Stanley A. Johnson, Terry B. Ball, and Terrence L. Szink.

episodes.title: Alma 40-41
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Alma’s continued teaching to his son Corianton concerning the resurrection and judgment of all men in Alma chapters 40 and 41. With Robert L. Millet, Todd B. Parker, and Brian M. Hauglid.

episodes.title: Alma 42
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Alma chapter 42 which details how Alma teaches God’s plan of redemption to his son Corianton who has struggled with overcoming the natural man. With Robert L. Millet, Todd B. Parker, and Brian M. Hauglid.

episodes.title: Alma 43-50
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the war chapters found in Alma chapters 43 through 50 and the spiritual lessons available to us in these chapters and the example of Captain Moroni. With Robert L. Millet, Todd B. Parker, and Brian M. Hauglid.

episodes.title: Alma 51-63
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the wars described in Alma chapters 51-63 including Captain Moroni and the stripling warriors and epistles between Pahoran and Moroni. With Clyde J. Williams, Keith J. Wilson, Jared Ludlow, and D. Kelly Ogden.

episodes.title: Helaman 1-6
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the contention and conflicts that existed among the Nephites as found in Helaman chapters 1 through 6. With Clyde J. Williams, Keith J. Wilson, Jared Ludlow, and D. Kelly Ogden.

episodes.title: Helaman 7-12
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the preaching of Nephi, the son of Helaman, and the discouragement he encounters as many reject his words as found in Helaman chapters 7 through 12. With Clyde J. Williams, Keith J. Wilson, Jared W. Ludlow, and D. Kelly Ogd

episodes.title: Helaman 13-16
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the preaching of Samuel the Lamanite and the persecution and rejection he experienced as described in Helaman chapters 13 through 16. With Paul Y. Hoskisson, Michael Rhodes, Thomas A. Wayment, and Todd B. Parker.

episodes.title: 3 Nephi 1-4
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the Lamanite and Nephite people after Samuel the Lamanite’s prophecies in 3 Nephi chapters 1-4 including them fighting the Gadianton robbers. With Paul Y. Hoskisson, Thomas A. Wayment, Todd B. Parker, and Michael Rhodes.

episodes.title: 3 Nephi 5-9
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss 3 Nephi chapters 5-9 which detail the Nephite repentance cycle and the destruction attesting Christ’s crucifixion and precedes His coming. With Paul Y. Hoskisson, Todd B. Parker, Michael Rhodes, and Thomas A. Wayment.

episodes.title: 3 Nephi 10-11
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the voice of Christ heard after many hours of silence and His appearance among the Nephites as described in 3 Nephi chapters 10 and 11. With D. Kelly Ogden, David M. Whitchurch, Thomas A. Wayment, and Gaye Strathearn.

episodes.title: 3 Nephi 12
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss 3 Nephi chapter 12 which details Christ’s sermon to the Nephites on the Beatitudes, similar to the Sermon on the Mount in the New Testament. With D. Kelly Ogden, David M. Whitchurch, Thomas A. Wayment, and Gaye Strathearn.

episodes.title: 3 Nephi 13-14
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Jesus teaching the Nephites on prayer and striving for perfection as described in 3 Nephi chapter 13 and 14. With D. Kelly Ogden, David M. Whitchurch, Thomas A. Wayment, and Gaye Strathearn.

episodes.title: 3 Nephi 15, 17
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss 3 Nephi chapters 15 and 17 which details Jesus’s fulfillment of the law of Moses, teaching things that cannot be written, and blessing the sick. With Gaye Strathearn, Robert L. Millet, Camille Fronk Olsen, and Dan Belnap.

episodes.title: 3 Nephi 18-19
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Jesus introducing the sacrament to the Nephites and provide an example and instruction on prayer as described in 3 Nephi chapters 18 and 19. With Gaye Strathearn, Robert L. Millet, Camille Fronk Olsen, and Dan Belnap.

episodes.title: 3 Nephi 16, 20-22
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss 3 Nephi chapters 16 and 20 through 22 which detail Jesus teaching the Nephites about gathering His lost sheep and establishing Zion. With Gaye Strathearn, Robert L. Millet, Camille Fronk Olsen, and Dan Belnap.

episodes.title: 3 Nephi 23-26
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Jesus quoting and expounding on the words of Isaiah and Malachi as he teaches the Nephites about the last days in 3 Nephi chapters 23 through 26. With Robert L. Millet, Todd B. Parker, Kerry Muhlestein, and Dan Belnap.

episodes.title: 3 Nephi 27-30
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Christ naming and organizing His church and gospel with the Nephites and the righteous desires of the 12 disciples in 3 Nephi chapters 27 through 30. With Robert L. Millet, Todd B. Parker, Kerry Muhlestein, and Dan Belnap.

episodes.title: 4 Nephi
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss 4 Nephi which details the 200 years of peace and prosperity between the Nephites and Lamanites as all were converted after Christ’s appearance. With Robert L. Millet, Todd B. Parker, Kerry Muhlestein, and Dan Belnap.

episodes.title: Mormon 1-6
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Mormon the prophet and his accomplishments and challenges as a military leader and prophet as described in Mormon chapters 1 through 6. With Keith J. Wilson, Andrew C. Skinner, David M. Whitchurch, and Stanley A. Johnson.

episodes.title: Mormon 7-9
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Mormon chapters 7 through 9 which provide Mormon’s invitation to the remnant of the Lamanites in the latter days to believe in Christ. With Keith J. Wilson, Andrew C. Skinner, David M. Whitchurch, and Stanley A. Johnson.

episodes.title: Ether 1-6
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the Jaredites journey to the promised land including the brother of Jared seeing the finger of the Lord in Ether chapters 1 through 6. With Keith J. Wilson, Andrew C. Skinner, David M. Whitchurch, and Stanley A. Johnson.

episodes.title: Ether 7-11
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Ether chapters 7 through 11 which detail the journey of the Jaredites to the promised land and the dissension that arose among them. With Andrew C. Skinner, Terry B. Ball, Jared Ludlow, and Terrence L. Szink.

episodes.title: Ether 12-15
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the dissension of the Jaredite people that led to loss of faith, war, and their utter destruction as described in Ether chapters 12 through 15. With Andrew C. Skinner, Terry B. Ball, Jared Ludlow, and Terrence L. Szink.

episodes.title: Moroni 1-6
episodes.description: Religious scholars continue discussing the end of the Jaredites and the instructions Moroni provides in church administration as found in Moroni chapters 1 through 6. With Andrew C. Skinner, Jared Ludlow, Terry B. Ball, and Terrence L. Szink.

episodes.title: Moroni 7
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Moroni chapter 7 which provides Moroni’s invitation to live the gospel with pure intent and his teaching on the Spirit of Christ. With Stanley A. Johnson, Thomas A Wayment, Camille Fronk Olson, and Michael Rhodes.

episodes.title: Moroni 8-10
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss principles of baptism, the importance of laboring diligently, and Moroni’s promise of truth as found in Moroni chapters 8 through 10. With Stanley A. Johnson, Thomas A Wayment, Camille Fronk Olson, and Michael Rhodes.

27f117d6-af30-494f-a5d7-c4cf9dfe48c1.description: Join us for an all-new cooking game show where two families compete to see whose Dinner Takes All!

episodes.description: The Horlacher family cooks Hawaiian food and the Mills family makes comfort food in this combined cooking competition and game show. Tensions rise while they work to complete meals and play games to earn points to win $10,000.

episodes.description: In this mixed game show and food competition, the Smith family prepares tortilla soup and the Ortega family makes marsala chicken. The time sensitive cooking is disrupted to play games that earn the teams points in hopes of winning $10,000.

episodes.title: Peterson Family vs. Patmides Family
episodes.description: The Peterson family makes Mahalo burgers and the Patmides family prepares fasolakia in hopes of winning $10,000 in this blended cooking competition and game show. They play games that disrupt their cooking processes as they work against the clock.

episodes.title: Lee Family vs. Yen Family

episodes.description: In this fused game show and cooking competition, the Wanless family makes surf and turf tacos and the Best Family prepares flank steak. The teams’ progress is disrupted with games that give them a chance to rack up points in hopes of winning $10,000.

episodes.title: McLean Family vs. Marshall Family
episodes.description: The McLean family makes their award-winning turkey chili and the Marshall family creates sweet and sour meatballs in this melded cooking competition and game show. The families play games to rack up points as they rush to finish in hopes of $10,000.

episodes.title: Cardwell Family vs. Worthen Family
episodes.description: Hoping to win $10,000 in this combined game show and cooking show, the Caldwell family creates spaghetti pizza and the Worthen family prepares cinnamon chili pork. The teams keep spirits up as they cook their meals and play games to earn points.

episodes.title: Junca Family vs. Uberty Family
episodes.description: The Junca and Uberty families compete by creating meals and play games in hopes of winning $10,000. The Junca family prepares traditional Uruguayan churrasco while the Uberty family makes a three-cheese lobster mac and cheese.

episodes.title: Carter Family vs. Jashinsky Family
episodes.description: The Carter family creates Cajun-inspired dishes and the Jashinsky family makes Italian-influenced food in this fused cooking competition and game show to win $10,000. The teams race to finish every recipe and are interrupted by games to earn points.

episodes.title: Luu Family vs. Tresner Family
episodes.description: The Luu family creates Vietnamese orange duck and the Tresner family prepares Italian chicken parmesan pasta in hopes to win $10,000 in this blended game show and cooking competition. The teams’ hurried cooking progress is interrupted to play games.

episodes.title: Garcia Family vs. Frost Family
episodes.description: In this blended game show and cooking competition, the Garcia family creates Chinese-Mexican dishes and the Frost family prepares European inspired cuisine in hopes of winning $10,000. Stress starts boiling as they battle in games to earn points.

episodes.title: Sisa-At Family vs. Daniel Family
episodes.description: The Sisa-At family creates traditional Thai cuisine and the Daniel family prepares Mexican inspired dishes in this mixed cooking contest and game show to win $10,000. The teams rush against time in cooking and playing games to earn the most points.

episodes.title: Peterson Family vs. Fonotisatele Family
episodes.description: In this blended cooking and game show, the Peterson family makes pot roast beef and the Fonotisatele family prepares roasted chicken in hopes of winning $10,000. The cooking progress is disrupted as teams go head-to-head in games to earn points.

episodes.title: Ofahengaue Family vs. Trout Family
episodes.description: The Ofahengaue family prepares Hawaiian style fare and the Trout family makes Mexican inspired cuisine in this combined cooking competition and game show to win $10,000. Meal progress is disrupted to play games to earn points along the way.

episodes.title: Leonidas Family vs. Hubsmith Family
episodes.description: The Leonida family prepares traditional Tanzania cuisine and the Hubsmith family creates Italian inspired dishes in a game show cooking competition to win $10,000. Cooking is disrupted for games to earn points as they race against the clock.

episodes.title: Kimsey Family vs. Gressman Family
episodes.description: In a mixed cooking competition and game show, the Kimsey family prepares ginger glazed king salmon and the Gressman family makes quiche Lorraine. As they rush to complete the meals, they are interrupted to play games in hopes of winning $10,000.

episodes.title: Lewis Family vs. Santos Family
episodes.description: The Lewis family creates herb and spice tri-tip steak and the Santos family prepares Ecuadorian shrimp ceviche in this combined cooking competition and game show to win $10,000. The hurried progress is disrupted by games to earn points.

episodes.title: Jensen Family vs. Brox Family
episodes.description: The Jensen family creates Cajun-spiced bacon burgers and the Brox family prepares specialty fried chicken in this blended cooking competition and game show to win $10,000. Kitchen mistakes are made and games are played so the teams can earn points.

episodes.title: Hanamaika'i Family vs. Lloyd Family
episodes.description: In this mixed cooking competition and game show, the Hanamaika’i family prepares traditional southwestern cuisine and the Lloyd family creates Italian inspired dishes for $10,000. The teams participate in games as they rush to finish each plate.

episodes.title: Hunt Family vs. Wilkins Family
episodes.description: The Hunt family creates Mexican-inspired dishes and the Wilkins family prepares traditional Swiss cuisine in this blended cooking competition and game show for $10,000. While hurrying to complete the meals, the teams battle in games to earn points.

episodes.title: Reese Family vs. Campos Family
episodes.description: In this combined cooking competition and game show, the Reese family makes a seafood risotto and the Campos family prepares bistec encebollado in hopes of $10,000. Cooking progress is slowed as teammates go head-to-head to play games for points.

episodes.title: Hansen Family vs. Sorensen Family
episodes.description: The Hanson family makes chicken piccata and the Sorensen family prepares chili casserole in this combined game show and cooking competition in hopes of winning $10,000. While racing against the clock to finish the food, they play games for points.

8ceeec0b-9bba-49fe-b15d-fc1c966303c5.description: Aspiring musician Holly dreams big while making her small town a better place.

episodes.title: The Show Starter
episodes.description: Holly organizes an open mic night in an attempt to save her grandma’s cafe. Heather disguises herself to try out for the boys baseball team.

episodes.title: The Churlish Cheerleader
episodes.description: Amy tries out for cheerleading and Holly struggles to stay connected with her. Robby angers a bull trying to do a viral internet challenge and things spiral out of control.

episodes.title: The Savvy Sleuth
episodes.description: Collinsville is heartbroken when they find their prize-winning cucumber destroyed. The town rushes to find the culprit, but Holly investigates with her friends to get to the bottom of the mystery. Heather trains in arm wrestling.

episodes.title: The Pickle Princess
episodes.description: Holly worries about entering in the Collinsville Pageant once she discovers that she has some competition. Robert makes a car for Heather to drive in the Collinsville derby, but she’s embarrassed for people to see it.

episodes.title: The Chicken Cooper
episodes.description: Holly and Robby build a chicken coop for Farmer Dodge after Robby was responsible for destroying his prize-winning cucumber. Heather goes shopping with her mother and their styles clash.

episodes.title: The Rabble Rouser
episodes.description: Holly, Piper, and Amy discover that the creek is being polluted by the local pickle factory and decide to take matters into their own hands. Robby is taught a lesson about his self worth when he tears his ACL and can’t play football.

episodes.title: The Birthday Basher
episodes.description: Holly and Piper schedule birthday parties on the same day, causing contention in their friendship. Heather and Levi need to find their own way to a wrestling match, but they make a bigger problem in the process.

episodes.title: The Freckled Fugitive
episodes.description: Holly takes a bus to Chicago with Tyler to escape the mess she made because of her birthday party. Heather and Robby hide the wreckage of a broken urn.

episodes.title: The Mad Muralist
episodes.description: The Collinsville mural needs volunteers, but Holly’s jealousy of Piper’s friendship with Amy gets in the way. Robby and Lyla consider the future of their relationship and make plans.

episodes.title: The Crushing Criminal
episodes.description: Piper’s family is at risk of moving out of Collinsville; Holly takes matters in her own hands. Heather thinks her parents’ marriage is on edge and tries to reignite their love.

episodes.title: A Whole New Holly
episodes.description: Holly auditions for the town musical but needs to prove herself as a performer. Robby makes a mistake that changes his relationship with Lyla forever, but he has a plan to fix it.

episodes.title: The Thwarted Thespian
episodes.description: Holly struggles to balance school and her role in the musical, and hits a breaking point. Heather is perplexed by a mysterious girl at school, but giving her a chance leads to an unexpected friendship.

episodes.title: The Salty Songstress
episodes.description: Holly confronts Savannah for spreading lies about her and losing her spot in the musical. Heather asks her dad about a mysterious grandpa.

episodes.title: The Cranky Camper
episodes.description: The Hobbies go camping to get away from devices and and each of the kids’ personal drama. Piper works with her mom’s yard work business but she runs into an unexpected employer.

episodes.title: The Puzzled Peacemaker
episodes.description: Lyla makes a tweet that sparks controversy and Piper has a heart to heart with her about cultural appropriation. Robbie is inducted into the Association of Batting Cages and celebrates his masculinity.

episodes.title: The Night-Crawling Newbie
episodes.description: Holly, Piper, and Amy get invited to a party past curfew so they enlist the help of Robbie. Heather has a sleepover and gets convinced that ghosts are real.

episodes.title: The Perplexed Pioneer
episodes.description: Piper’s mom gets a new job that means the Parishs are moving. Robbie is chosen as team captain of the football team but he might need to give up immature pranks to be a leader.

episodes.title: The Dauntless Daughter
episodes.description: Holly isn’t allowed to have boys in her room and she struggles to make sense of it with her parents. Amy stands up against inequality she finds in the science fair.

episodes.title: The Hesitant Heroine
episodes.description: Holly and Oscar score a gig opening for a big musician named Gwen Taylor, but Holly gets in her head. Amy teams up with Robbie to present for the science fair. Her anxiety and feelings of incompetency set her back from having faith in her project.

episodes.title: The Selfless Starlet
episodes.description: Oscar and Holly need to work with a company that has unjust labor practices but Holly is conflicted about representing a company she doesn’t believe in. Heather tracks down her long-lost grandfather and tries out beekeeping to meet him.

episodes.title: The Jam Jam
episodes.description: The father of the Hobbie family, Robert, gets injured in a car accident and his recovery will be an expensive process. Holly hosts an open mic night to raise donations and Robbie and Heather are unexpectedly roped into the world of jam making.

episodes.title: The Shortsighted Scholar
episodes.description: Holly falls behind in her schoolwork because of the drama happening in her family; she must either read Little Women in one day or attend summer school. Heather panics over her baseball career and tries her hand at wrestling instead.

episodes.title: The Posing Performer
episodes.description: Piper helps Holly to put more effort into Holly’s social media platforms, but ends up sacrificing authenticity for maintaining the perfect image. Robbie’s new job isn’t what he expected, and his first paycheck is even worse.

episodes.title: The Grandpa Grenade
episodes.description: Holly wrestles with the internal struggle of whether or not she should accept her estranged grandfather. Heather loses her brand new baseball mitt and tries to earn money to replace it by selling candy at school.

episodes.title: The Bumbling Bossgirl
episodes.description: Holly listens to too many opinions for her music video and loses her say in the project. Robbie has troubles writing for the newspaper and discovers that the problem is deeper than he thought and he may have dysgraphia.

episodes.title: The Slimy Sensation
episodes.description: Holly tries to grow her social media following with the help of Piper. Holly gets caught up in the influencer lifestyle and starts to lose time to do what she loves most. Amy conducts an experiment to see if gum improves memory.

episodes.title: The Horrible Hero
episodes.description: Heather is determined to discover the role of women in the history of Collinsville for a group project. Piper is commissioned by Holly to help with a pie fundraiser, but Piper still resents Holly.

episodes.title: The Fairweather Friend
episodes.description: Amy scrambles to find a date to the dance, but a huge storm derails her plans. Heather suspects that Robbie may be doing drugs, so she teams up with Lyla to investigate.

episodes.title: The Careening Counselor
episodes.description: Piper chooses between being a camp counselor with her friends and going to Paris with her mom. Robbie has a big job opportunity, but Heather comes up with a plan to make him stay home for the summer.

episodes.title: The Difficult Decision
episodes.description: Holly learns of a songwriting opportunity in Nashville. Grandma Hobbie plans to get married in a hasty town hall ceremony but the Hobbies decide to throw her a bigger celebration. Heather is trusted with a crucial part of wedding planning.

episodes.title: The Struggling Songwriter
episodes.description: Holly and Amy are disappointed to be separated during summer vacation. Holly starts a songwriting camp in Nashville. Amy works as a camp counselor and learns teamwork.

episodes.title: The Song Circle Surprise
episodes.description: Holly meets a big pop star. Robbie struggles with his food truck without the help of his mom.

episodes.title: The Bestie Bonfire
episodes.description: Amy struggles to keep a secret from Savannah. Heather gets roped into dance auditions, but then realizes she has some talent.

episodes.title: The Aspiring Ally
episodes.description: Justin opens Holly’s eyes to how others see him. Robbie recreates his first date with Lyla to put off an important conversation.

episodes.title: The Reticent Rulemaker
episodes.description: Oscar gets jealous when Holly starts writing songs with Justin. Heather hides her new dance hobby from her dad.

episodes.title: The Anxious Achiever
episodes.description: Justin helps Amy come to terms with her anxiety diagnosis. Heather learns to compromise when her field trip gets canceled.

episodes.title: The Collinsville Conspiracist
episodes.description: Holly grows suspicious of Justin. Robby makes a big decision about his relationship with Lyla.

episodes.title: The Defiant Dancer
episodes.description: Holly learns about Amy and Justin’s secret. Heather is uncomfortable with aspects of her dance competition and learns to stand up for what she believes in.

episodes.title: The Cowering Confidant
episodes.description: Robert is hesitant to open his barbeque restaurant and needs a confidence boost. Justin plans a spontaneous trip with Amy.

episodes.title: The Friendship Fiasco
episodes.description: Holly and Amy’s friendship is tested when Justin leaves unexpectedly. Heather gets to the bottom of a rumor that could be devastating to her friends.

episodes.title: The Accidental Activist
episodes.description: Heather is dress coded for wearing a tank top and speaks up about the injustice on the internet. Lyla and Robbie argue over weighty real estate decisions, and Robbie makes a hasty purchase.

episodes.title: The Defensive Driver
episodes.description: Holly feels a new sense of independence when she gets her driver’s license, but learns that with more independence comes even more responsibility. Heather finds herself excluded when she joins the boy’s football team.

episodes.title: The Engrossed Essayist
episodes.description: Amy struggles to write her college essay. She decides to install wheelchair ramps around town for a better essay, but Holly and Savannah think the ramps are going overboard. Heather juggles dance and rugby and realizes that she can’t keep both.

episodes.title: The Vexed Volunteer
episodes.description: Shortly after her breakup with Oscar, Holly discovers that he’s deleted all of their pictures online. She’s forced to work with him at the pickle festival and suspects he’s already dating again. Heather worries she’s becoming a third wheel.

episodes.title: The Big City Belter
episodes.description: Holly gets an audition at NYU, but is blind sighted with a music theory test that she’s unprepared for. Robbie is faced with a decision between his own gain and treating his employees right.

episodes.title: The Vegan Veteran
episodes.description: Amy’s anxiety grows when she watches a documentary about climate change. She realizes that it goes too far when she protests a BBQ fundraiser organized by her friends. Heather gets hurt during rugby and learns to prioritize her health.

episodes.title: The Adamant Athlete
episodes.description: Heather discovers that her school gives 90% of its sports funding towards boys’ teams and decides to take a stand. Holly finds a gig for her band, but Amy and Savannah aren’t as enthusiastic.

episodes.title: The Disappointed Dreamer
episodes.description: Holly finds that teaching music at the Children’s Club is more difficult than she thought. Heather rushes to build the crib for the new baby so she could join her friends at the movies.

episodes.title: The Panicky Promgoer
episodes.description: Holly gets overwhelmed with post-grad plans and lets the stress interrupt her senior prom. Amy avoids going to prom to prepare for an important interview when she knows how much it means to Savannah.

episodes.title: A New Beginning
episodes.description: With the loss of her dream job, Holly searches for her calling that will satisfy her passions in life. She’s conflicted when it comes to songwriting and philanthropy. The Hobbie family prepares for the new baby.

9f1b4114-1c06-48ab-8957-a6748ee14a24.description: Legends introduces prolific BYU athletes and coaches.

episodes.title: Vai Sikahema
episodes.description: Host Curt Doussett sits down with former BYU Football running back and return specialist Vai Sikahema and learns how his humble beginnings inspired his career as a professional football player.

episodes.title: Erin Thorn
episodes.description: Host Curt Doussett meets former BYU Women’s running guard Erin Thorn and learns how her experiences at BYU inspired her to play basketball professionally.

episodes.title: Tiffany Lott-Hogan
episodes.description: Olympian Tiffany Lott-Hogan shares how her experiences at the 2004 Athens Olympics shifted her perspective as a track and field athlete.

episodes.title: Tom Holmoe
episodes.description: BYU Athletic Director Tom Holmoe shares how his time playing for the San Francisco 49ers motivated him to return to his alma mater to mentor student athletes.

episodes.title: Ty Detmer
episodes.description: Heisman Trophy winner Ty Detmer shares how his experiences as a quarterback for BYU prepared him for his time in the NFL and for his career as a football coach.

episodes.title: Shauna Rohbock
episodes.description: Olympic bobsledder Shauna Rohbock sits down with Curt to discuss how her time as a BYU track star and soccer player led her to compete in the 2006 Winter Olympics.

episodes.title: Mike Schlappi
episodes.description: Mike Schlappi shares how his paralysis motivated him to become a successful Paralympian and motivational speaker.

episodes.title: Lavell Edwards
episodes.description: Host Curt Doussett sits down with legendary BYU Football coach LaVell Edwards and learns how Edwards created a lasting legacy after his 29 seasons as head coach for the Cougars.

episodes.title: Chad Lewis
episodes.description: Lewis may have been coaxed into his first BYU football tryout, but after joining the team his successes kept piling up.

episodes.title: Michele Fellows Lewis
episodes.description: Former BYU Volleyball star Michele Fellows Lewis describes her experience helping BYU to the 1993 Final Four and shares how her time on the court prepared her to be a mother.

episodes.title: Aleisha Cramer Rose
episodes.description: BYU Hall of Fame inductee Aleisha Cramer Rose talks about how she balanced playing for both the US Women’s National Soccer Team and BYU Women’s Soccer Team.

episodes.title: Ed Eyestone
episodes.description: Olympic marathoner Ed Eyestone shares his journey from cross country star to head coach of BYU Men’s Cross Country team.

episodes.title: Brandon Doman
episodes.description: Heisman Trophy winner Brandon Doman describes how he overcame his insecurities to become a star quarterback for the BYU Cougars.

episodes.title: Wally Joyner
episodes.description: Former MLB First Baseman Wally Joyner sits with host Curt Doussett to discuss his baseball career as he recounts his days as an underdog at BYU to his time playing professional baseball.

episodes.title: Jennifer Rockwood
episodes.description: Head coach for BYU Women’s Soccer Jennifer Rockwood shares how she led the team from club status to NCAA Division 1 champions.

episodes.title: Elaine Michaelis
episodes.description: Host Curt Doussett sits with BYU Legend Elaine Michaelis and learns how she made history as she paved the way for women's collegiate athletics across the nation.

episodes.title: Travis Hansen
episodes.description: Former BYU basketball star and shooting guard for the Atlanta Hawks Travis Hansen talks about his exciting career and the experiences that inspired him to devote his time to philanthropy.

episodes.title: Jason Buck
episodes.description: Super Bowl champion Jason Buck shares his inspirational story of coming from humble beginnings to life as a professional football player.

6f62558b-fc6f-49c5-b8c6-2473785a5b44.description: This reality series uncovers the hidden identities in family pasts.

episodes.title: Lumina
episodes.description: Raised mostly by a surrogate family, Boston artist Lumina Gershfield is compelled to find out all that she can about her biological family.

episodes.title: Durrell
episodes.description: As an African American with a southern heritage, Durrell assumed his great-grandfather was a farmhand, but an old photo reveals a different story.

episodes.title: Katie
episodes.description: Katie’s great grandmother is said to have died of leukemia. After having her own share of health problems, Katie wants to know if her great grandmother's health problems are genetic or not.

episodes.title: Maile
episodes.description: Maile wants to learn more about her ancestor that was sent to an island off of Hawaii, Kalaupapa, because she was diagnosed as a leper. Maile wants to learn what life was like for her, isolated from her children and family.

episodes.title: John
episodes.description: John wants to learn where he got his name from and the type of person his great grandpa was. He visits Andersonville Prison, Palmetto Agricultural Museum, and Palmetto’s Yellow Fever Cemetery.

episodes.title: Deanna
episodes.description: Deanna’s great grandparents died in a house fire. Deanna wants to learn the truth about what happened and what her great grandparents' lives were like immigrating from Italy to St. Louis.

episodes.title: Danielle
episodes.description: Danielle learns that her great-grandfather was an inventor, so she looks into more of her ancestry.

episodes.title: James
episodes.description: Gown designer James Walker investigates the truth behind the family legend of an Indian princess ancestor who immigrated to Utah in the early 1900s.

episodes.title: Andrea
episodes.description: Andrea is looking for the motivation to live a healthier life and looks to her great-grandmother who immigrated to the United States. She learns what her life was like and what drove her great grandmother to leave her home in Ireland.

episodes.title: Gloria
episodes.description: Gloria sets out to uncover any positive attributes for which her ancestor can be remembered.

episodes.title: Boyd
episodes.description: Boyd wants to discover if his lineage traces back to Hawaiian royalty. He visits Iao Valley and Kauai Historical Society to find his answers.

episodes.title: Vicki
episodes.description: Vicki Biss believes she is part American Indian and travels to Shiloh, Tennessee, to discover the surprising truth behind the legend.

episodes.title: Lakia
episodes.description: After spending her childhood in foster care, Lakia Holmes looks to make a connection with her family through her great-grandmother.

episodes.title: Xander & Carrie
episodes.description: After their twins contract a genetic disease, Xander and Carrie search their history for traces of HLH and want to learn about the blood donor that saved their children’s lives.

episodes.title: Kerry
episodes.description: Kerry learns about his father's relationship with his own parents and wonders if history is repeating with Kerry and his son.

episodes.title: Emily
episodes.description: Emily goes on a journey to trust the feelings and impressions she has about her ancestors. She visits Marysburg Cemetery and Cambridge, Massachusetts to kindle a connection to her ancestors.

episodes.title: Do Your Own Generations Project
episodes.description: Learn how to do your own generations project by connecting with your ancestors in a way that makes a difference in your life right now.

episodes.title: Pj & Heidi
episodes.description: PJ seeks to rekindle a relationship with her sister Heidi after they grew through finding the good stories in their family history. They visit Germantown, New York and Canada.

episodes.title: Tara
episodes.description: After going through the trauma of contracting meningitis, Tara is looking for strength by learning about her Muslim ancestors and their life during the Indo-Pakistani War.

episodes.title: Will
episodes.description: Will wants to learn if he should pursue his love for acting or settle down and have a family. He looks to his great-grandfather who lived his life as one of the first forest rangers in St George, Utah.

episodes.title: Nick
episodes.description: Nick wants to discover why his French Canadian grandmother turned against her heritage and followed the Greek tradition. Along the way, he learns about French Canadian cuisine.

episodes.title: Rachel
episodes.description: Rachel looks to her ancestors to find a purpose and learn about the truth to botany rumors in history. She learns about the Salem Witch Trials and Tulip Mania.

episodes.title: Ty
episodes.description: Ty wants to learn about his German heritage and knows he will have to come to terms with some tough history.

episodes.title: Sam
episodes.description: An undertaker learns about his African-American ancestors by investigating their deaths.

episodes.title: Sean
episodes.description: Sean learns about his great-grandfather's life during World War I to see if following the call is worth all the heartache. He visits Plymouth Plantation and Boston.

episodes.title: Ed
episodes.description: Ed was adopted, but always believed he had a connection to the Native American culture. He goes in search for a possible Native American heritage and to understand some of his other cultural roots.

episodes.title: Matthew
episodes.description: Matthew seeks closure after his brother's death by walking in the shoes of his ancestors who fought in wars and grieved the loss of loved ones.

episodes.title: Where Are They Now?
episodes.description: Emily, Tara, Rachel, and Sean share how the Generations Project has changed their lives after a year has passed.

episodes.title: Graham
episodes.description: Olympic snowboarder Graham Watanabe wants to learn what it takes to make sacrifices and learns about his Asian ancestry.

episodes.title: Rachel
episodes.description: Rachel has always sought validation from outside sources ever since her dad died. She looks to her ancestry to find the strength to be true to who she is and learns that her great-grandma sang in the first women’s quartet in Las Vegas.

episodes.title: Roi
episodes.description: Roi hopes that by exploring his family history, he will be able to deal with racial persecution. He visits Surrey County Historical Society and helps heal the lives hurt by the 2011 Joplin Tornado.

episodes.title: Amber
episodes.description: Amber helps her daughter, Deseree, discover her African American heritage and self-acceptance. They visit Washington D.C. and Orange, Virginia.

episodes.title: Raquel
episodes.description: Raquel needs her ancestors’ advice on how to choose between a family and career. She visits Madrid, Spain and learns about her biological ancestors who lived during the Spanish Civil War.

episodes.title: Nancy
episodes.description: Nancy is a full-time caregiver for her husband and wants to be self-empowered and follow her own dreams. She learns about her grandparents and visits New York.

episodes.title: David
episodes.description: David says his family has this innate desire to succeed at all costs and wants to learn if his immigrant grandfather really did leave a child behind in Jamaica and lied about his race to succeed.

episodes.title: Jill
episodes.description: Jill wants to learn to let go of the resentment she had for her negligent father by learning about his life and why he might have made the choice he did.

episodes.title: Eli
episodes.description: Eli is an Iraq veteran who founded Turtle Women Rising. She wants to find peace and learn about her Yaqui history.

episodes.title: Natalie
episodes.description: After the tragedy of losing her youngest son, Natalie wants to learn about her heritage and find strength to be the mother her other three children need.

794275e1-3c23-493f-a27c-90304813c7cb.description: Witness sportsmanship at its finest as the best young athletes compete in different events.

episodes.title: Diving
episodes.description: Ten teen athletes compete for the title of All-Round Champion. Michael coaches the athletes in diving with the help of Laura Wilkinson, an Olympic gold medalist. They overcome their fears of heights with each new jump.

episodes.title: Gymnastics
episodes.description: Sydney coaches the young athletes in gymnastics with the help of Olympic medalist and four-time World Champion Alicia Sacramone Quinn. The athletes have both their stamina and anxieties tested as they strive to learn the essentials of gymnastics.

episodes.title: Equestrian
episodes.description: Fenella coaches the other young athletes in equestrian riding as they conquer nerves and fears of horses. Olympic equestrian Jessica Phoenix helps coach and inspire the athletes as they learn to connect to their horses in order to perform better.

episodes.title: Golf
episodes.description: Haven mentors the other teen athletes in the art of golf alongside US Women’s Open Champion Brittany Lang. Michael pushes through an injury while Fenella struggles to pick up the golfing technique.

episodes.title: Skateboarding
episodes.description: Cayde coaches the other young athletes on skateboarding. After practicing balance with flyboarding, the athletes learn tricks and confidence from Cayde and Professional skateboarder CB Burnside. The athletes struggle with falling and hesitation.

episodes.title: Swimming
episodes.description: Jasmine teaches the athletes the fundamentals of swimming alongside 12-time Olympic Medalist Natalie Coughlin. The competition begins to test the athletes like never before as they learn how swimming is more physically demanding than it appears.

episodes.title: BMX Racing
episodes.description: Olympian Donny Robinson and Marshall prepare the teen athletes for victory on the BMX track, gaining them more points towards ultimate success and the title of All-Round Champion. To do so, they must conquer their fears and race to the finish line.

episodes.title: Wakeboarding
episodes.description: Daniel coaches the other young athletes in wakeboarding. The athletes learn balance and how to perform tricks. Twelve-time world champion Darin Shapiro trains and inspires the athletes as their skills and confidence improve.

episodes.title: Kart Racing
episodes.description: NASCAR Winston Cup champion Rusty Wallace helps Faith coach the athletes in the high-speed art of go-kart racing. Adrenaline and stakes run high as the athletes learn the importance of staying focused while competing in this extreme sport.

episodes.title: Kayaking
episodes.description: It’s a sentimental last week as Brodie and World Champion Nick Troutman train the teen athletes in kayaking. While bracing the fast-paced current of the river, the athletes also cherish their last moments with their new friends and mentors.

episodes.title: Arcathlon
episodes.description: It’s anyone’s game as the athletes compete in their final competition, the first-ever Arcathlon. Through a series of track and field events, the competitors give it their all for a last chance to be titled this season’s All-Round Champion.

episodes.title: Freestyle Skiing
episodes.description: Ten elite athletes representing different sports have gathered to compete in the ultimate sports competition. Gage and Olympic champion Jennifer Heil teach freestyle skiing.

episodes.title: Figure Skating
episodes.description: Caiyla and Olympic gold medalist Jaime Salé show the athletes the basics of figure skating. They start with rollerblading to practice balance.

episodes.title: Dog Mushing
episodes.description: Ellyn and 3-time Iditarod champion Mitch Seavey show the athletes the ropes of dog mushing. Each athlete is given time to bond with their lead dogs promoting unity, focus, and communication.

episodes.title: Cross Country Skiing
episodes.description: The athletes learn the grace, balance, and patience required for cross-country skiing from their coaches Evan and Olympic gold medalist Beckie Scott.

episodes.title: Luge
episodes.description: Caitlyn and world champion Erin Hamlin teach Luge. The athletes struggle with steering but learn to practice their patience and persistence.

episodes.title: Snowboarding
episodes.description: The athletes learn about the creativity required for snowboarding and decorate their own helmets. They learn tips and tricks from the best of the best, Tristan and X-Games Champion Max Parrot.

episodes.title: Ice Climbing
episodes.description: The athletes overcome their fear of heights and work on connecting with nature as they master ice climbing. Sloane and North American Champion Gordan McArthur help the team feel brave enough to make the climb.

episodes.title: Speed Skating
episodes.description: Speed skating is particularly challenging for the team but they get help from Adam and Olympic champion Derek Parra. They warm up with roller skating and learn to work on posture, speed, and committing to every turn.

episodes.title: Curling
episodes.description: Rajan and Olympic champion Kaitlyn Lawes coach the athletes in curling. They sharpen their balance, form, and concentration.

episodes.title: Arcathlon (Winter) Part 1
episodes.description: The young athletes compete for the title of All-Round Champion. They compete in snow volleyball, shoe ski slalom, and they get a lesson in skeleton by world champion Noelle Pikus-Pace.

episodes.title: Arcathlon (Winter) Part 2
