episodes.description: The athletes compete their hardest in the ARCathlon for the title of All-Round Champion. They compete in fat bike racing, a hockey shootout, and snowshoe archery.

episodes.title: Pole Vault
episodes.description: Ten elite athletes representing different sports have gathered to compete in the ultimate sports competition.  Pole Vault is revealed as the first sport and Lacee must train her fellow athletes for the first competition in only three days.

episodes.title: Sport Climbing
episodes.description: The young athletes learn how to sport climb. Sienna and three-time world champion Sean McColl teach the athletes how to boulder, fall, and climb safely.

episodes.title: Inline Racing
episodes.description: Chandra and Olympian Jordan Belchos help the young athletes stay on their feet as they learn inline racing. The athletes compete in the longest race in ARC history.

episodes.title: Soccer
episodes.description: The young athletes train in soccer, and Emanuel must get them competition ready in three days. Four-time MLS Cup Champion and League MVP Dwane De Rosario helps the athletes with ball control, footwork, passing, touches, and scoring.

episodes.title: Tennis
episodes.description: Gabi teaches the athletes tennis. Olympian and twelve-time Grand Slam Champion Daniel Nestor helps them understand the mental toughness and technique needed to win.

episodes.title: Track Cycling
episodes.description: Aaron coaches track cycling alongside Curt Harnett, Olympic medalist and Pan Am games champion. Controversy ensues when a competitor doesn’t play fair.

episodes.title: Boxing
episodes.description: Sierra and two-time Pan Am Games champion Mandy Bujold train the athletes in boxing. With two gold medals on the line, the athletes fight to make it to the podium.

episodes.title: Dance
episodes.description: Phoebe teaches the athletes that dancing takes just as much agility, technique, and skill as any other sport. With the help of choreographer Amanda Cleghorn, she gets the athletes competition-ready in just three days.

episodes.title: Trampoline
episodes.description: Jai and Olympic medalist Rosie MacLennan teach the athletes tricks and flips to help them succeed in trampolining. The prank war heats up again.

episodes.title: Gymnastics
episodes.description: Carter and Olympian Kyle Shewfelt coach the young athletes in gymnastics and focus on proper technique to succeed. An advantage helps Sierra achieve her goal.

episodes.title: Arcathlon
episodes.description: It's time for the Arcathalon and its anyone's game. Each of the athletes compete in four events that will help them earn more points to contribute to their current score. The All-Round Champion is crowned.

episodes.title: Alpine Skiing
episodes.description: Ten elite athletes representing both summer and winter sports are competing in the ultimate sports competition. Alpine Skiing is revealed as the first sport and Rebecca must train her fellow athletes for the first competition in only three days.

episodes.title: Fencing
episodes.description: It’s Fencing and Jabreel is the Sport Leader. With Épée in hand, it gets intense and grueling; especially for Chace who walks out mid-training. The Sport Star has fun with Noah. Jabreel disses Perdita. A history making podium.

episodes.title: Powerlifting
episodes.description: It's Damiyah's sport - Powerlifting. When it comes to training, the athletes are put to various tests that could prove rewarding. The bus breaks down and the athletes are up for a true test of strength. Can Claire three-peat for another medal?

episodes.title: Boarder Cross
episodes.description: Chace’s confidence in winter sports returns while Rebecca has a tough time with her prosthetic and seeks the advice of a Boardercross Paralympian. Damiyah is determined to stay upright. The Competition is wild leading to another historic Podium.

episodes.title: Snowkiting
episodes.description: It’s Snowkiting and Claire is riding a hot streak. Elle is getting frustrated while Rebecca gets the sense that something is wrong and both are determined to fix it. The Competition proves tough and Nathanaël has an epic meltdown.

episodes.title: Karate
episodes.description: It's Karate and while Noah has fun remembering the names of the moves, Claire bleeds and Nathanaël goes down hard. The athletes are in for a few surprises before the Competition. The gold medal is decided with one second remaining in the match.

episodes.title: Artistic Swimming
episodes.description: It's Artistic Swimming... Jabreel struggles, Rebecca faces another decision with regards to her prosthetic and Sabrina excels as coach. A shocking announcement is made just before Competition. Another, even bigger shocker comes at Podium.

episodes.title: Hockey
episodes.description: It's Hockey... Elle receives stunning news and an early injury while Nathanaël seems to finally be making progress in a winter sport. Claire shares a cause close to her heart. A close competition leads to heartbreak at the Podium.

episodes.title: Ninja
episodes.description: The athletes quickly realize that Ninja looks easy but is physically and emotionally draining. Chace struggles, Claire is desperate for the podium and Damiyah makes a phone call that could affect the competition, which takes place in the dark.

episodes.title: Hurdles
episodes.description: It’s Hurdles and Liesel has yet to podium and knows its now or never for a medal. Rebecca debates which prosthetic to use during the final week. Chace’s diminutive statue affects his performance and confidence. Surprises abound at the podium.

episodes.title: Arcathlon
episodes.description: The Arcathlon is back, this time – Highland Games style! The contest continues with the most physically and mentally demanding events ever in the history of ARC with significant points up for grabs. The Greatest All-Round Champion ever is crowned.

episodes.title: Track
episodes.description: As the athletes are about to leave behind family and friends for nine weeks, they are surprised by an epic skydiving opportunity. One of the athletes experiences regret. Track is revealed as the first sport and Samantha must train her fellow athletes

episodes.title: Rowing
episodes.description: This week's sport is Rowing and Dominic is the Sport Leader.  Tempers flare during training as Maggie and Brayden can’t find a rhythm.  Momo has a meltdown trying to adapt while Lily demonstrates empathy even though it could affect her results.

episodes.title: Wheelchair Boxing
episodes.description: Lily, former All-Round Champion Sierra, and former WBC amateur national lightweight champion Leo Sammarelli coach the para-athletes in adaptive boxing. They focus on angles, combinations, and the importance of adapting.

episodes.title: Swimming
episodes.description: It's Swimming. Things do not start out well for Maggie. Jackson causes a minor emergency which some athletes view as an opportunity. Brad instantly gloats, Dominic can’t seem to float and the competition is going to need a bigger boat!

episodes.title: Sledge Hockey
episodes.description: It’s Sledge Hockey and Jackson is riding a hot streak.  Training proves hard on Gurnoor, leading to mental stress. Momo needs points and a little extra effort to succeed.  Dominic’s frustration continues.  History is made at the Podium

episodes.title: Climbing
episodes.description: It's Climbing. Jackson aims for a sixth straight podium appearance; Momo is inspired by the Sport Star and Lily adapts to an unusual technique.  Brayden takes a moment to inspire his fellow athletes. A pinky promise impacts the podium ceremony.

episodes.title: Wheelchair Basketball
episodes.description: It's Wheelchair Basketball... An advantage is on the line and tensions run high between the athletes.  Sam is still seething from last week’s results.  Lily is hoping to three-peat for a medal and a surprise at the podium proves to be a game-changer.

episodes.title: Sailing
episodes.description: Sailing is revealed as the featured sport and a homesick Bradley is the Sport Leader. Momo is super focused but is forced into a dangerous situation. Maggie’s adaptation proves beneficial. Jackson aims for a return to podium from a two-week hiatus.

episodes.title: Goalball
episodes.description: It’s Goalball and Dominic is noticeably absent as he deals with a family issue.  The athletes are immediately put to the test as they are forced to train without seeing.  The Competition makes the athletes happy, but surprises abound at the podium.

episodes.title: Arcathlon
episodes.description: With a tie atop the Leaderboard, The Arcathlon is back!  The contest continues with the most physically and mentally demanding events ever in the history of ARC with significant points up for grabs. The first-ever Para All-Round Champion is crowned.

episodes.title: Arcathlon
episodes.description: Eleven elite athletes meet for the first time, face fears, master new skills and pounce for points in season six's thrilling premiere. With an Arcathlon kickoff to a “game changing” season, it's a heart-pounding battle for supremacy.

episodes.title: Canoe Sprint
episodes.description: The canoe sprint is the first sport and Mischa takes charge as Sport Leader. Perdita announces that, for the first time ever, the athletes will compete in pairs throughout the season. The difficult water sport results in a historic podium.

episodes.title: Beach Volleyball
episodes.description: The sport is Beach Volleyball and Ariana is Sport Leader. Wil and Deliya are teammates again and must work on communicating. Michael comes back from a rough week in the canoe to dominate on the sand. Elli fights some homesickness, losing focus.

episodes.title: Pickleball
episodes.description: It's pickleball and Sport Leader Wil teaches the athletes how to have fun. Mischa misses a day of practice due to sickness. Michael wins the advantage and has the choice to change his teammate which could impact the whole leaderboard.

episodes.title: Cricket
episodes.description: Rohan takes on the role of Sport Leader to teach cricket. Mischa battles a shoulder injury and Emily feels some frustration about her spot on the leaderboard. Lexie overcomes a big fear and receives a shoutout. Michael sets a new record.

episodes.title: Cheer
episodes.description: It's Cheer and Elli is Sport Leader, joined by Guinness World Record holder Angel Rice. The tension is higher than ever at the halfway point of the season. Lexie works through a concussion. In the end, the gold medal is decided by a single point.

episodes.title: MMA
episodes.description: It's MMA, making Braden the Sport Leader. Lexie cannot train or compete due to her concussion, leaving Emily to choose a new opponent. Perdita gives an extra shoutout to a special corner partner. Braden gets injured while teaching the athletes.

episodes.title: Sync Diving
episodes.description: This week it's Synchronized Diving and Lexie is the Sport Leader! All of the athletes struggle to jump off the high diving platforms. Perdita faces a fear of her own. Wil and Rohan make a last-minute decision that impacts the podium results.

episodes.title: Breaking
episodes.description: It's Breaking and Emily is the Sport Leader. Braden's past experience in the sport helps his team excel. Ariana and Lexie are disappointed by the standings. Tensions rise when one athlete refuses to vote for a shoutout, but receives one themself.

episodes.title: Teqball
episodes.description: It's Teqball and Michael is Sport Leader. The athletes struggle with learning such a unique sport. Wil loses positivity. Lexie and Braden redeem themselves from Beach Volleyball. The leaderboard stays close nearing the end of the competition.

episodes.title: Roller Derby
episodes.description: This week's sport is Roller Derby and Deliya takes charge as Sport Leader. Lexie faces more injuries playing the contact sport. Emily faces a disadvantage during the final competition. The underdog team tilts the leaderboard significantly.

episodes.title: Ice Dancing
episodes.description: Ice Dance is the last sport and Woolf is the Sport Leader. It's an emotional week as everyone prepares to compete for the belt and say goodbye. The athletes are shocked to learn they will have one more chance to earn points in another Arcathlon.

episodes.title: Finale
episodes.description: To end a season of game changers, the athletes compete in an Arcathlon for the second time--and they compete in pairs! With a close leaderboard, it's anyone's game and tensions are high. The winner is crowned, taking the belt by just 3 points!

20c69298-10cb-4e00-a5a2-625ce95bab81.description: Real help for real families, from technology and communication to faith and finances.

episodes.title: Fatherhood and Hard Work
episodes.description: Suit up with the a father/daughter duo that bonds over beekeeping. Then mosey on down to the Heartland with a cow-milking couple that teach their four children the value of hard work.

episodes.title: Health and Teamwork
episodes.description: Meet the Anderson-Kossens, who strengthen their family through healthy living and daily fitness. Then meet the Burns family to explore how they turn their nine-member family into a true team.

episodes.title: Individuality and Accountability
episodes.description: The Forsyths love to hike and have learned about individuality along the way. The Rosales family is working through the tough topic of substance abuse with positivity and good choices.

episodes.title: Positivity and Service
episodes.description: Learn how grilled cheese and resilience strengthened the Samuel family. The Von Niederhausern family found a big way to come together by looking outside of themselves and doing service for others.

episodes.title: Confidence & Setting Goals
episodes.description: The Chipman family young women have learned the value of self-worth. The Bills family has captured the importance of goal-setting as a father and his two sons train for competitive Spartan racing.

episodes.title: Music & Play
episodes.description: All four children in the Spencer family play the violin. The Keslers have a yearly gathering with their huge extended family, where they are all so busy playing, they forget to even look at their phones.

episodes.title: Anti-entitlement & Mindfulness
episodes.description: The Andrus parents teach their six children anti-entitlement by expanding their bubble and helping them serve in the community. The Kepas family practices yoga as a form of mindfulness and meditation to improve the spirit in their home.

episodes.title: Wholesome Recreation & Personal Relationships
episodes.description: The surfing Baltzer family knows participating in wholesome recreation as a family brings them closer together. Mark and Kelly Jensen explain why putting marriage first helps them be better parents and a stronger family.

episodes.title: Finance & Grandparents
episodes.description: The Anderson parents teach their children the value of a dollar by putting them to work in their businesses. The Orton grandma spends time with her grandchildren every day after school and even conducts a choir made up of her granddaughters.

episodes.title: Peace & Preparation
episodes.description: The Meredith family shares an emergency preparedness approach. Relationship coach Dr. Matt Townsend teaches emotional resilience. Parenting expert Ralphie Jacobs advises a more peaceful home. The Cutler family sees calm in the chaos of lively kids.

episodes.title: Fun & Finance
episodes.description: The Paige family raises money-savvy kids. Financial counselor Amanda Christensen makes finances approachable. Family therapist David Koszlowski shares a business model for family. The Gundersons make purposeful decisions toward a fun family journey.

episodes.title: The Value of Grandparents & Keeping Family Culture Alive
episodes.description: Elaine and Stephen Dalton discuss grandparents' roles. The Havells share the impact of grandparents keeping family close. Plus, the Cooks honor Hawaiian and Filipino heritage, and co-hosts Yahosh and Natalie connect with their own family cultures.

episodes.title: Building a Tech-Positive Home & Raising Kids with Healthy Habits
episodes.description: Technology editor Amy Iverson advises on technology navigation. The Jones family shows how tech-positivity helps balance kids' use. Plus, the Kanos' focus on family fitness leads to healthy habits, and dietitian Miki Eberhardt gives nutrition advice.

episodes.title: How to Raise Curious Kids & The Power of Positivity
episodes.description: Author Gretchen Rubin puts positive mindsets to work. The Huntingtons learn positivity as they travel across the globe. Musician Peter Breinholt shares how wonder shaped his career. The Wrights invite curiosity by encouraging personal discovery.

episodes.title: Helping Kids Find Their Passion & The Nature Connection
episodes.description: Brad Wilcox shares ways to help kids find their purpose. The Beaches encourage their children to discover their passions. Matt Galland makes the outdoors part of family life. The Ockeys take time in nature to grow closer free from distractions.

episodes.title: The Family Narrative & Living with Loss
episodes.description: Nate and Vanessa Quigley keep family memories alive. The Websters get their children excited about ancestry. Counselor Emilio Parga explains how to talk to those who are grieving. The Poulsens find ways to remember family members who have passed.

episodes.title: The Food Connection & Raising an Introverted Child
episodes.description: The Six Sisters share insights for making food a family connector. The Richardsons use cooking to grow more connected. Author Brenda Knowles discusses raising a quiet child. The Funks blend personalities and set a pace to stay close.

episodes.title: The Sound of Service & The Strong Single Parent
episodes.description: Elaine Bradley discusses the power music has to bless lives. The Mellecios serve others through music. Cindy Cloninger and Julie Burraston share ways to support single-parent families. The Davenports rise to the challenge of single parenthood.

episodes.title: Raising Selfless Kids & The Power of Rituals
episodes.description: Hank Smith and Kristen Duke discuss raising big-hearted teens. The Parkinsons weave giving into living by expanding their talents. Heather Johnson discusses the impact of intentional family routines. The Packers keep their lives simple by design.

episodes.title: Unstructured Play & Raising Independent Kids
episodes.description: The Kings experiment with the art of unstructured play. The Sammis family sets a goal to raise kids who can stand on their own. Shaun Johnson encourages more fun in family life. Tim Thayne provides insights on launching older teens into adulthood.

episodes.title: Minimalistic Family Life & The Teenage Phase
episodes.description: The Anderson family chooses a minimalist lifestyle and finds more peace; organizer Tracy McCubbin resolves common "clutter blocks". The Coggins family enjoys relationships with their teenagers; David Butler points out the unique traits of teens.

episodes.title: Balanced Busyness & Meaningful Gatherings
episodes.description: The Hughes family gets together better, even for made-up holidays; a BYU professor tells the formula for designing experiences people will remember. The super-busy Blackmer family stays on time and in sync. Susie Salinas advances household systems.

episodes.title: Strengthening Talents & An Attitude of Adventure
episodes.description: A spirit of adventure starts at home. The Family Rules hosts go outside their comfort zone with in-studio adventures; the Thomas family gets out-and-about. The Fredericks spot their kids' talents; Stephen Jones identifies gifts versus talents.

episodes.title: Hard Work at Home & In-Laws in Action
episodes.description: The Bain and Tan families prove the in-laws are not always outlaws; famous football players, Matt Bushman and Chad Lewis get personal about being in-laws. Author Greg McKeown on finding more joy in daily work; the Sorensen’s raise hard working kids.

episodes.title: The Happy Empty Nest & The Big Beautiful Family
episodes.description: Dr. Jennifer Finlayson-Fife addresses the unique challenges of empty-nest couples; the Cramers tell their experience.  Family researcher Heather Johnson on the changing nature of the American family; the Bairds manage a modern family of ten.

episodes.title: Calling on the Village & The Blended Family
episodes.description: The Ashbys build a support system and never feel alone; Sister Aburto from the LDS Church points to the Savior’s example for Christians and community. The Kights have a successful blended family; Tony Overbay shares four pillars of communication.

episodes.title: Honoring Roots & The Mother-Son Bond
episodes.description: Former BYU basketball player Yoeli Childs and Kara Childs get personal about their mother-son bond; Lindsey Wells makes efforts as a "boy mom". The Lotulelei family honors roots; Dr. Matt Townsend offers three questions to define your family legacy.

episodes.title: Raising Kids with Grit & The Engaged Dad
episodes.description: Surfer Bethany Hamilton reveals more of her story and how to live with grit, grace and faith; the Phipps raise with grit with the “farm approach”. One ritual helps Fernando Seminario be an engaged dad; Anthony Sweat offers insights on fatherhood.

episodes.title: Strong Sibling Bonds & The Nature Connection
episodes.description: The Anderson family offers ways for siblings to get along better; a brother bond makes musicians Ben and Chad Truman successful.  Getting outside everyday makes the Sutherland family happier; Dr. Patti Freeman declares that recreation is God-given.

6c0a0177-c4c1-4dfc-8f93-d0370934b4a7.description: A selective mute finds her voice as she navigates her teenage years with her friends and family.

episodes.title: Mum's the Word
episodes.description: Amelia is worried about finding the right look for her dance recital. Thankfully, she has Cleo in her corner.

episodes.title: Field Trippin'
episodes.description: Amelia decides to forge a permission slip so she can go on a field trip with her classmates but has to face the consequences when she feels sick.

episodes.title: She Lives in Us
episodes.description: Amelia tries to continue the birthday traditions that her late mother started with Nathan. Victoria offers to tutor Vikram.

episodes.title: Learning by Heart
episodes.description: Amelia struggles to communicate with her first crush, as Tony fights to stop Amelia being streamlined.

episodes.title: Just the Two of Us?
episodes.description: Amelia has her first American sleepover at Declynn’s. Their friendship progresses when they go on an adventure back to Amelia’s to retrieve her forgotten head wrap.

episodes.title: Out of Bounds
episodes.description: Amelia must stand up for herself when she’s pressured to join the soccer team. Cleo realizes her youngest, Charlie, is not so little anymore.

episodes.title: Best Friends Forever?
episodes.description: Amelia’s best friend and her godmother come to visit from England, but they don’t get along like they thought they would. Cleo tries to bridge the divide between their family and their English friends.

episodes.title: Four’s Company
episodes.description: Amelia learns to set boundaries when Nathan takes over the movie she’s making with her friends. Nick overstays his welcome at Roger’s house.

episodes.title: Sole to Soul
episodes.description: Amelia wins a songwriting competition, but is terrified to perform the song in front of people. When Nick switches sponsors for more money, Nathan worries his cousin is a sell-out.

episodes.title: Joy
episodes.description: Amelia decides to push herself to speak, but learns her trauma runs deeper than she thought. Through his driving lessons, Nathan must deal with his unresolved feelings around his mother’s death.

826a1f29-3daf-4ac4-baaf-fbfffbeb23df.description: Jeff tests families with homemade games for the chance to win cash prizes or junk from his garage!

episodes.title: Feeling the Beat
episodes.description: Host Jeff Rogers challenges the Smith family to a game of Kitchen Charades, Sock Shuffleboard, and Shadow Guessing for a chance to win cash and prizes. Family friends surprise the Smiths with a life-changing prize.

episodes.title: Field of Jeans
episodes.description: Host Jeff Rogers challenges the Sype family to a series of guessing games and friendly family competition for a chance to win cash and prizes.

episodes.title: Camp Tamburello
episodes.description: Host Jeff Rogers challenges the Tamburello family to a game of Micro Money Maker, Taste Buds, Stairway Bowling, and Recycler Toss to win cash and prizes.

episodes.title: Dressed for Success
episodes.description: Host Jeff Rogers challenges the Santos family to a game of kitchen addition, Coat Rack of Cash, Santos Sandwich Making Company, and Jeff’s Super-Duper Shuffle Game to win cash and prizes.

episodes.title: Sock It To Me
episodes.description: Host Jeff Rogers challenges the Sanders family to a game of Channel Champs, Paper Towel Payout, Takeaway, Tabletop Drop, and Hallway “Sweep” Stakes to win cash and prizes.

episodes.title: You Gotta Have Faith
episodes.description: Host Jeff Rogers challenges the Plescia family to a game of Toilet Paper Treasure Hunt, Refrigerator Recall, Gift Card Counter, and Weigh it and Pay it to win cash and prizes.

episodes.title: Yours, Mine, and Towers!
episodes.description: Host Jeff Rogers challenges the Crother family to a game of Lucky Laundry, Now You See It, Pillow Tower, and Mini Golf Money Maker to win cash and prizes.

episodes.title: Floor of Lava!
episodes.description: Host Jeff Rogers challenges the Smith family to a game of Hide and Seek, Cereal Train to Treasure, Stuffed Animal Instincts, and Floor of Lava to win cash and prizes.

episodes.title: Humpty Dumpty's Revenge
episodes.description: Host Jeff Rogers challenges the Nollman family to a game of License Plate Lottery, Kitchen Magician, Picture Payday, House of Cards, and Humpty Dumpty to win cash and prizes.

episodes.title: The Family Who YouTubes Together
episodes.description: Host Jeff Rogers challenges the Riaz family to a game of Food Pyramid, Selective Memory, Lucky Call, Suck it Up, and Flip N’ Flyin’ Cereal to win cash and prizes.

3ec2235c-58a5-444d-a2ec-1a0838975737.description: Todd Hansen and his co-host, Bela Erekson, find stories as they explore fun and inspiring trends.

episodes.title: Printing Your Future
episodes.description: Hosts Todd Hansen and Bela Erekson dive into the world of 3-D printing and learn from the Huff family how they have used 3-D printers to make toys and prosthetic limbs for those in need.

episodes.title: Tiny Cameras, Huge Stories
episodes.description: Hosts Todd Hansen and Bela Erekson learn more about innovative filmmaking technologies like tiny cameras and drones that allow filmmakers to tell exciting new stories like never before.

episodes.title: The Wizardly World of Sports
episodes.description: Todd and Bela are introduced to the fantastic world of competitive quidditch and learn how its players have fostered a community full of lifelong friendships.

episodes.title: The Hungry Games
episodes.description: Hosts Todd Hansen and Bela Erekson discover how board games and good eats have been combined to create unforgettable community experiences with the emergence of board game cafes.

episodes.title: Minimize to Maximize
episodes.description: Todd and Bela learn all about the minimalist lifestyle as they meet multiple adventurous families who live in school buses-turned-houses called skoolies.

episodes.title: Cosplay and the Hero Within
episodes.description: Todd and Bela explore how cosplay allows people to express themselves and break out of their comfort zones by dressing as their favorite characters.

episodes.title: Food Truck Fight
episodes.description: The Nielson family give hosts Todd Hansen and Bela Erekson a delicious behind-the-scenes look at what it takes to run a food truck.

episodes.title: The Ninja Next Door
episodes.description: Todd and Bela discover the world of ninja sports and learn how family is foundational to each ninja athlete’s success.

85dd6a3c-b04d-468f-8efc-b33e6afea0ce.description: Welcome Home helps families in transition by turning their brand-new house into a home.

episodes.title: Four Kids, One Inflatable Mattress
episodes.description: Mary and her four children have finally moved out of a shelter into a small house, but they only have one inflatable mattress to sleep on. Rob, Trager, and a team of designers help make Mary's house a home.

episodes.title: Katlyn's Journey Home
episodes.description: Katlyn is finally getting back on her feet and has moved out of a homeless shelter into a new home. Rob, Trager, and a team of designers furnish the house to give Katlyn and her son, Gio the fresh start they need.

episodes.title: Mom Gets Much Needed Rest
episodes.description: Raina was living in an unhealthy environment when she left with her five children, and they all ended up in a shelter. She worked tirelessly to save up for a house, and now the family is finally safe. Treger, Rob, and volunteers help fill the house w

episodes.title: A Veteran Finds Hope
episodes.description: When he found out he was going to be a father, veteran Sterling turned his life around. Currently, he sleeps on the floor so that his son can have a bed. Rob, Treger, and the team help this deserving father have a fresh start.

episodes.title: A Medical Crisis Changes Everything
episodes.description: Sonya was about to buy a house when a medical crisis struck. After living in abandoned houses and apartments, Sonya and her kids finally have a permanent living space but need Trager and Rob's help to make it a home.

episodes.title: The Family That Sticks Together
episodes.description: After facing multiple traumas and struggling to raise five children on her own, Marinna lost her job, and subsequently their home. The whole family bounced between shelters, but finally Marinna and her kids have a roof over their head.

episodes.title: A Double Dose of Kindness
episodes.description: After years of addiction and homelessness, Luke has finally turned his life around and is in his first apartment.  But when Treger and Rob offer their help to furnish his place, he'd rather pay it forward.

episodes.title: Just the Three of Us
episodes.description: Joe and Tiffany have made enormous progress in their battles with addiction and have been able to rent a home for their small family. Treger and Rob help furnish their home and celebrate Joe and Tiffany’s progress.

episodes.title: A Supermom and Two Superheroes
episodes.description: Quiana and her two young sons lived in shelters across three different states trying to make ends meet. Treger and Rob help furnish the family's new townhome and give the family a fresh start.

episodes.title: It Could Happen To You
episodes.description: Shaqueena experienced sudden trauma and loss that left her and her four kids homeless. After a lot of hard work, the family is back on their feet. Treger and Rob help furnish the apartment and make it feel like home.

episodes.title: Helping Hands
episodes.description: Three families from Detroit are featured in this special episode: Katlyn and Gio get help furnishing their house; Sonya and her kids experience homelessness after a medical crisis strikes; a young man pays it forward to another family in need.

episodes.title: Family First
episodes.description: Stacy and her family are finally back on their feet after leaving a troubling situation and living in numerous homeless shelters. Rob and Treger furnish their new home and help them find a fresh start.

episodes.title: We are Family
episodes.description: After experiencing the loss of loved ones, the Preyer family came together only to face a dangerous living situation. Alicia and her children escaped with what they could and moved into a shelter until they could get back on their feet.

episodes.title: Back on Track
episodes.description: Laura has overcome addiction and moved out of a homeless shelter with her daughter, Julia, into a new apartment.

episodes.title: People in Need
episodes.description: The Hardins have a brighter future after tragic events left them homeless; Joe, Tiffany, and their son are moving into their first home together; Raina has finally saved enough to find a permanent place for her family.

episodes.title: And Baby Makes Two
episodes.description: After surviving years of neglect and homelessness, Symone was determined to pave a new path for herself and her toddler.

episodes.title: Forever Family of Love
episodes.description: Zockie was going through a rough patch when she found out her niece and nephew needed a new living situation. After living in their car for years, Zockie finally saved enough to rent a home.

episodes.title: A Home Fit for Mermaids
episodes.description: After twenty-six moves in and out of homeless shelters, Vanessa and her two daughters have found a stable home. Rob and Treger give this family the fresh start they have been looking for.

episodes.title: Three Stories of Hope
episodes.description: After serving in the Marines, Sterling found himself homeless but turned his life around for his son; Laura and her daughter are finally leaving a shelter; Stacy has saved enough to move her kids from the shelter to a townhome.

episodes.title: From Homelessness to HomeOWNers
episodes.description: After battling addiction and homelessness, Marcay and Christopher have worked hard to start fresh and purchase a townhome for them and their two kids. Treger and Rob step in to furnish the house and make it a home.

episodes.title: Mother and Daughter, Best Friends
episodes.description: Leslie and her daughter, Nicole, escaped an abusive situation and ended up homeless. Leslie has finally saved up enough for a two bedroom apartment. Treger and Rob help make the apartment the safe space Leslie and Nicole need.

episodes.title: A Tale of Two Strangers
episodes.description: Though they don't know each other, Harold and Anthony have two things in common: they both have moved out of shelters and are starting fresh in the same apartment complex. Treger and Rob help them furnish their apartments.

episodes.title: A Mother's Love
episodes.description: When Mary escaped a troubled past with her special needs daughter, she left everything behind. Finally, Mary is back on her feet with a roof over their heads but needs extra help furnishing her house.

episodes.title: Mom Gets a Much Needed Break
episodes.description: Aidee grew up in the foster care system and fled a dangerous living environment when she was only a teen. After struggling for years to get on her feet, she and her three kids finally have an apartment.

episodes.title: Hope for the Future
episodes.description: Three stories from San Diego and Detroit showcase Treger and Rob's continued mission to help families coming out of homelessness.

e6f41593-6c3c-4618-ba10-5057334a361b.description: Embark on a spiritual journey around the world with Justyna Hrabska.

episodes.title: What is "Holy"?
episodes.description: We introduce Justyna Hrabska and preview the nine "holy" adventures in the series.

episodes.title: The Center of the Center
episodes.description: Discover the complex and longtime significance of the circle and its "center" in Sicily. Find out what the "center of the center" is for Sicilians and learn about the short but inspirational life of Santa Lucia.

episodes.title: The Stone of Jacob
episodes.description: Discover the story of a sacred stone and its significance to the kings and queens of England.

episodes.title: Sacred Trail
episodes.description: Discover the stories and sacred Wyoming trail of the Martin and Willie handcart companies.

episodes.title: The Tsodilo Hills of Botswana
episodes.description: Travel to the Kalahari Desert to learn about the oldest "holy" site on Earth.

episodes.title: Holy Mathematics
episodes.description: Discover how several mathematical principles sprang from deep spiritual roots in India.

episodes.title: Sacred Landscapes
episodes.description: Learn about the American West landforms that are sacred to the Lakota Sioux.

episodes.title: Remembering, Part One: Yad Vashem
episodes.description: Explore Yad Vashem, the World Holocaust Remembrance Center in Jerusalem.

episodes.title: Remembering, Part Two: Joseph and Rebecca
episodes.description: Explore the recovery of the post-WWII Jewish community in Poland, Justyna's homeland.

episodes.title: Wise Men from the East
episodes.description: Discover the legacy of the Wise Men at the great cathedral of Cologne in Germany.

2c539596-a061-46cd-9c32-01fdfef7f6ba.description: While racing through the wilderness, two competing families learn to heal and forgive.

episodes.title: Down to the Wire!
episodes.description: Colin O’Brady hosts the Cajuste and Daynes families in a down-to-the-wire 13-mile survival race. Who will survive family differences, injuries, and wild weather and claim the $10,000 prize?

episodes.title: Time to Prove the Bullies Wrong
episodes.description: Colin O’Brady challenges the Gould and Hopkins families to survive three days in the wild. The families will have to rappel cliffs and summit a 10,000-foot. Will either family manage to beat the elements and claim the $10,000?

episodes.title: I am a Hunter not Gatherer!
episodes.description: Colin O’Brady challenges the Blasingames and Elliotts to race through the wilderness, climbing peaks and kayaking deep waters in scorching temperatures. Which family will overcome the struggles of family and terrain to claim the $10,000 prize?

episodes.title: Dad Down! But Who?
episodes.description: Colin O’Brady challenges the Jones and Williams to a three-day wilderness race, including a plunge in an in alpine lake and a journey through a 10,500-foot high mountain pass. Which family will tackle nature’s formidable test and claim the prize?

episodes.title: Who Will Stumble?
episodes.description: Colin O’Brady challenges the Millers and Thompsons to a three-day race along lava rock, across the desert in all-terrain vehicles, and up a treacherous climb to a 7000-foot peak. It’s a race where every step counts. Who will be the first to stumble?

episodes.title: Mayday! Dad Down!
episodes.description: Colin O’Brady challenges the Garceses and Koenigs to a three-day race over land, through water, and through the air as someone takes a helicopter to safety. Can the Garces boys or the Koenig girls power their family to the $10,000 prize?

episodes.title: Put the Pedal to the Metal!
episodes.description: Colin O’Brady challenges the Dixons and Purefoys to survive three wild days as they scramble over treacherous lava, through a windswept desert, and up a 7,000-foot rocky peak. Which family will take home $10,000?

episodes.title: Will Sisterhood Survive the Wild?
episodes.description: Colin O’Brady tasks the Escobedos and Richardsons to survive three days traversing the vast a desolate land by foot, paddle, and ATVs. Which set of sisters will find common ground in the tough terrain and help their family claim the $10,000 prize?

episodes.title: All or Nothing!
episodes.description: Colin hosts the Laudenslaugers and Thompsons over a three-day expedition as they travel by horse and foot through the most isolated mountains in the country. What kind of conditions can take out an entire family? These ones! Who will claim the prize?

episodes.title: The GPS of Figuring Out Family
episodes.description: Colin O’Brady challenges the Boyers and Espinosas to a three-day race through swampland, raging rapids, and alpine lakes. Who will let their family dynamic slow them down, and who will work together to win the $10,000 prize?

episodes.title: A Fight to the Finish
episodes.description: Colin O’Brady hosts the Lutz-Carrillos and Serratos on a three-day expedition that will see them raft, rappel and climb across Moab’s tough terrain. Who will learn to put family differences aside, finish first and claim the $10,000 prize?

episodes.title: Daughter Strong
episodes.description: Colin O’Brady hosts the Taylors and Yuens in a three-day adventure on foot and all-terrain vehicles through steep elevation gains and a labyrinth of rocky landscapes. Who will pass this daunting task and claim the $10,000?

episodes.title: Battle of the South
episodes.description: Colin O’Brady hosts the Majettes and the Smiths on a three-day adventure as they tackle breathtaking climbs through thick woods and snow-covered mountains.  Who can withstand the elements and claim the $10,000 prize?

episodes.title: First to Fly the Flag!
episodes.description: Colin O’Brady hosts the Jones and Renterias on a wild adventure as they make daunting assents, daring rappels, and exhausting rafting journeys. Which family will be the first to raise their flag, in this fight to the finish and claim the $10,000?

episodes.title: Climb to Survive
episodes.description: Colin O’Brady hosts the Moore and McFann families as they scale new heights through the windswept high desert.  In a treacherous land where one misstep step could be their last, which family will climb to the top and claim the $10,000 prize?

episodes.title: Overcoming Obstacles
episodes.description: Colin O’Brady hosts the Harkrider and Pace families in a trek full of climbs, rappels, and rallying jeeps across the dusty landscape. Who will overcome pain and personal injury to claim the $10,000 prize?

episodes.title: Pushed to the Brink!
episodes.description: Colin O’Brady hosts the Armes and Hills in a tough trek across land, water, and over terrifying cliffs. Which family will handle the unexpected personal challenges and natural elements on the journey to claim the $10.000 prize?

episodes.title: It’s Snow Time in the Wild!
episodes.description: Colin O’Brady hosts the Kraus and the Reochs on a three-day outing as they brave frozen lakes, dense forests and snow-covered mountains. Who will withstand the heat of battle to claim the cold $10,000 prize?

episodes.title: Florida Fighters
episodes.description: Colin O’Brady hosts the Adams and the Carach families as they trek through towering monoliths in the cold desert. These Florida families are way out of their element but will hope they can learn their lessons and claim the $10,000.

episodes.title: The Ups and Downs
episodes.description: The Burrell family from South Carolina and the deVries family from Texas set out on a three-day, 16-mile race across some of the most rugged terrain in America. Hosted by Colin O'Brady, this is a thrilling race against time for $10,000!

episodes.title: Sinking Sands
episodes.description: The Bowling and Tran families compete in a four-day adventure race. The Bowling family wants to develop closer bonds and the Tran family hopes to reconnect after the oldest son moved out for college.

episodes.title: Leap of Faith
episodes.description: The Albert and Cook families participate in a four-day competition in Baja, Mexico. The Alberts work on their leadership and trust skills while the Cooks strive to prove their positive attitudes and endurance.

episodes.title: Towering Dunes
episodes.description: The Yoffee family strives to improve communication while the Phillips family works on rebuilding trust in each other in this adventure competition. The families race through water and rough terrain to be the first to the finish line.

episodes.title: Sharks in the Water!
episodes.description: The Raymond family hopes to deepen their connection while the Trop family works to overcome personal challenges.

episodes.title: Making Up For Lost Time
episodes.description: The Scott and Robbins families compete in an adventure race and challenges. The Scott family wants to reconnect after struggles with addiction while the Robbins family strives to get back to their adventurous roots.

episodes.title: A Daughter in Distress
episodes.description: The Newbold family works toward building deeper bonds with each other while the Muse family endeavors to improve their communication.

episodes.title: Changing Dynamics
episodes.description: In this four-day adventure competition, the Pettit family rebuilds connections after a brother moved out, while the White family establishes stronger relationships before a sister leaves for college.

episodes.title: The Long Road
episodes.description: Colin O’Brady hosts the Horne and Leung families as they set off into the Baja wilderness for a four-day race. As the Leungs strive to strengthen their relationship, the Hornes try to control their competitive spirit.

episodes.title: A Sea Of Sharks!
episodes.description: Colin O’Brady hosts the Prendergast and the Wakens on a four-day backcountry adventure, where the individual families must learn to trust each other.

episodes.title: Paddles Away!
episodes.description: Colin O’Brady hosts the Desuasido and Pears families on a four-day journey through the diverse untamable wilds of Mexico. These families need to learn how to come together, but in a sea of doubts, who can set the right course and claim the prize?

54702628-fc8b-48a4-a626-cd7cc5230e21.description: A probationary angel is sent to Earth and teams up with an ex-cop to help people.

episodes.title: Highway to Heaven (Part 1)
episodes.description: Jonathan Smith is an angel on a mission from God; accompanied by ex-cop Mark Gordon, whose troubled life Jonathan once helped turn around, the two travel the country guiding the lost and suffering back toward the Highway to Heaven.

episodes.title: Highway to Heaven (Part 2)
episodes.description: Jonathan Smith is an angel on a mission from God; accompanied by ex-cop Mark Gordon, whose troubled life Jonathan once helped turn around, the two travel the country guiding the lost and suffering back toward the Highway to Heaven.

episodes.title: To Touch the Moon
episodes.description: Jonathan counsels a young runaway and a widow with a terminally ill son.

episodes.title: Song of the Wild West
episodes.description: A country singer's arrival in a Western town inspires a man to let his daughter pursue music.

episodes.title: One Fresh Batch of Lemonade (Part 1)
episodes.description: A high school student almost gives up on life after losing both legs in a motorcycle accident.

episodes.title: One Fresh Batch of Lemonade (Part 2)
episodes.description: A high-school student who lost his legs in an accident regains his will to live.

episodes.title: A Divine Madness
episodes.description: A greedy son wants to institutionalize his eccentric father, a construction tycoon.

episodes.title: Catch a Falling Star
episodes.description: An actor hires Jonathan and Mark to look after his estranged children.

episodes.title: Help Wanted: Angel
episodes.description: On a film set, Jonathan meets another angel, and Mark falls for an actress.

episodes.title: Dust Child
episodes.description: A Vietnam veteran causes problems when he brings home his Amerasian daughter.

episodes.title: Hotel of Dreams
episodes.description: Mark and Jonathan work as hotel bellhops to help a millionaire's son find meaning in his life.

episodes.title: Another Song for Christmas
episodes.description: Car salesman Honest Eddy plans an expansion, which threatens a local orphanage at Christmas.

episodes.title: One Winged Angels
episodes.description: Jonathan cannot reunite a couple because he has fallen for the woman.

episodes.title: Going Home, Going Home
episodes.description: Jonathan and Mark journey back in time to save Mark's grandfather's farm from repossession.

episodes.title: As Difficult As ABC
episodes.description: A college basketball star must face his illiteracy when a heart condition denies him a scholarship.

episodes.title: A Child of God
episodes.description: A dying woman tries to reconcile with her stern father for the sake of her illegitimate daughter.

episodes.title: A Match Made in Heaven
episodes.description: Jonathan's guidance helps the romance of a quadriplegic lawyer and Mark's cousin.

episodes.title: The Banker and the Bum
episodes.description: Jonathan arranges an exchange between a pitiless millionaire and a kind vagrant.

episodes.title: The Brightest Star
episodes.description: An 11-year-old actress manipulates parents and co-workers.

episodes.title: An Investment in Caring
episodes.description: A widow will lose her home to corporate developers unless neighbors will help.

episodes.title: The Right Thing
episodes.description: A widower pines away in a rest home, until his grandson and Jonathan give him jogging shoes.

episodes.title: Thoroughbreds (Part1)
episodes.description: Jonathan and Mark play Cupid for a rancher's son and a horse trainer's daughter.

episodes.title: Thoroughbreds (Part 2)
episodes.description: Learning she has cancer, Lizzy tells Garth their elopement was a mistake.

episodes.title: A Song For Jason (Part 1)
episodes.description: As counselors at a camp for youths with cancer, Jonathan and Mark help a teenage ex-athlete.

episodes.title: A Song For Jason (Part 2)
episodes.description: While most of the campers find contentment, Jonathan encourages Jason's reluctant father to join in.

episodes.title: Bless the Boys in Blue
episodes.description: Guilt plagues a policeman who shot a teenager brandishing an empty gun.

episodes.title: Cindy
episodes.description: Jonathan performs a miracle for the hard-working daughter of a struggling theatrical agent.

episodes.title: The Devil and Jonathan Smith
episodes.description: Jonathan enlists the help of a con man when Mark is tricked into selling his soul to Satan.

episodes.title: Birds of a Feather
episodes.description: Jonathan alerts the citizens of a small coastal town to the pollution dangers of a nearby factory. With Victor French.

episodes.title: Popcorn, Peanuts, and Cracker Jacks
episodes.description: When Jonathan is called away, Mark visits his former partner and uncovers a family secret.

episodes.title: The Smile in the Third Row
episodes.description: An actor believes he saw God sitting in the third row, next to Jonathan.

episodes.title: The Monster (Part 1)
episodes.description: Jonathan plays matchmaker for a lonely blind woman and a reclusive sculptor, labeled a monster by townspeople.

episodes.title: The Monster (Part 2)
episodes.description: Scotty faces prejudice when he defends a disfigured artist on an assault charge.

episodes.title: The Good Doctor
episodes.description: Football-gear managers Jonathan and Mark discover a star player's injury has resulted in drug dependency.

episodes.title: Alone
episodes.description: Jonathan places a homeless, mentally impaired teen with a wealthy, but troubled, family.

episodes.title: Close Encounters of the Heavenly Kind
episodes.description: To help a UFO watcher keep custody of his grandson, Jonathan and Mark convince the boy they are aliens.

episodes.title: Keep Smiling
episodes.description: Jonathan courts an elderly woman who was his wife when he was mortal.

episodes.title: The Last Assignment
episodes.description: Jonathan and Mark attempt to help a misguided angel who has been trying to earn his wings for 200 years.

episodes.title: To Bind the Wounds
episodes.description: Jonathan and Mark help the father of a deceased Vietnam veteran honor his son in a memorial service.

episodes.title: Heaven on Earth
episodes.description: When Mark blames himself for a girl's death, Jonathan gives him special powers to undo past actions.

episodes.title: Summit
episodes.description: Jonathan tries to reunite a Soviet emigre and her long-lost son.

episodes.title: Sail Away
episodes.description: Jonathan and Mark help an aging novelist rediscover his writing talent by reliving a beautiful teenage romance.

episodes.title: Friends
episodes.description: As teachers, Jonathan and Mark motivate an overweight outcast and unscholarly athlete.

episodes.title: For the Love of Larry
episodes.description: A clever dog seeks help when his owners are in a serious accident.

episodes.title: Another Kind of War, Another Kind of Peace
episodes.description: The father of a dead veteran rebels when his son's Vietnamese family tries to immigrate.

episodes.title: That's Our Dad
episodes.description: Two orphans face coldheartedness when they ask their favorite children's TV host to adopt them.

episodes.title: Love at Second Sight
episodes.description: Jonathan and Mark pose as recreation directors to help an angel on a difficult assignment.

episodes.title: Love and Marriage (Part 1)
episodes.description: Jonathan helps members of a feuding family to see what life would have been like without their loved ones.

episodes.title: Love and Marriage (Part 2)
episodes.description: Jonathan and Mark maneuver to keep a bride and groom on the way to the altar.

episodes.title: Code Name: Freak
episodes.description: Jonathan and Mark help a college student cope with a selfish roommate.

episodes.title: Man to Man
episodes.description: Jonathan and Mark cause a dying tycoon and his only son to come to know each other.

episodes.title: Jonathan Smith Goes to Washington
episodes.description: A U.S. senator opposes Jonathan and Mark's efforts to pass legislation to save a little girl's life.

episodes.title: Oh Lucky Man
episodes.description: Mark and Jonathan become the target of con artists after Mark wins $5 million.

episodes.title: Basinger's New York
episodes.description: Jonathan, Mark and a weary New York columnist share a cab and seek the spirit of Christmas.

episodes.title: All That Glitters
episodes.description: A small-time crook finds a briefcase containing $1 million and then needs help fending off the two hoods who "lost" the money.

episodes.title: A Song of Songs
episodes.description: After suffering a heart attack, a blind pianist turns to Mark and Jonathan to help him start a new life.

episodes.title: A Night to Remember
episodes.description: Jonathan and Mark, posing as high-school teachers, help a diverse group of students deal with the trauma of the upcoming senior prom.

episodes.title: A Mother and A Daughter
episodes.description: Fearing success may end Jonathan's stay on Earth, Mark hampers efforts to reconcile a mother and daughter.

episodes.title: Normal People
episodes.description: Controversy and misunderstanding split a neighborhood when a halfway house for mental patients opens.

episodes.title: A Father's Faith
episodes.description: Parents of a comatose boy try to comfort their daughter, who feels responsible.

episodes.title: Ghost Rider
episodes.description: Jonathan and Mark help a lonely writer meet a secret agent murdered in 1968.

episodes.title: Gift of Life
episodes.description: A businessman's dirty dealings get him "killed," but Jonathan and Mark arrange a second chance at life for him.

episodes.title: Man's Best Friend (Part 1)
episodes.description: A lost dog becomes the link between an orphan and a married couple who are unable to have children.

episodes.title: Man's Best Friend (Part 2)
episodes.description: After experiencing a devastating blow to their plans to have a family, Paul and Michele realize the child they want is already in their lives.

episodes.title: Fight for Your Life
episodes.description: A young prizefighter puts his career on the line and learns the unsavory truth about his manager-brother.

episodes.title: The People Next Door
episodes.description: Jonathan and Mark help a black family relocate to an exclusive neighborhood.

episodes.title: Playing for Keeps
episodes.description: A vaudevillian gets a second chance at success and reconciliation with his egotistic son.

episodes.title: Amazing Man
episodes.description: Jonathan helps a boy who escapes into a fantasy world following the tragic death of his father.

episodes.title: All the Colors of the Heart
episodes.description: A counselor at a camp for the blind enlists Jonathan to prevent the suicide of a man losing his sight.

episodes.title: Why Punish the Children?
episodes.description: Jonathan and Mark clash with a warden over reforms that would unite female inmates with their children.

episodes.title: A Dream of Wild Horses
episodes.description: An aging rancher feels helpless to prevent the killing of wild horses.

episodes.title: In With the 'In' Crowd
episodes.description: Posing as police drug-counselors, Jonathan and Mark meet with faculty resistance where a student died of an overdose.

episodes.title: With Love, the Claus
episodes.description: Santa Claus goes on trial for protesting a department store's promotion of toy weapons during Christmas.

episodes.title: A Mother's Love
episodes.description: Jonathan tries to persuade an unmarried schoolteacher to adopt four orphaned brothers.

episodes.title: Country Doctor
episodes.description: A country doctor's dedication to his community's medical needs nearly ruins him physically and financially. With Renee Jones.

episodes.title: Time in a Bottle
episodes.description: A zealous district attorney tries for a felony conviction of a vagrant accused of stealing a bottle of wine.

episodes.title: We Have Forever (Part 1)
episodes.description: Jonathan must deal with the anger and frustration of losing his supernatural powers after he rejects an assignment from God.

episodes.title: We Have Forever (Part 2)
episodes.description: Jonathan, now mortal, has trouble finding a job, and Jennifer doesn't share his wish for a long-term relationship.

episodes.title: Aloha
episodes.description: Jonathan and Mark help a former dancer overcome her bitterness at being disabled.

episodes.title: A Dolphin Song for Lee (Part 1)
episodes.description: Mark helps raise money for an aspiring marine biologist's cancer surgery.

episodes.title: A Dolphin Song for Lee (Part 2)
episodes.description: Jonathan and Mark convince teenage Lee to lobby in the state senate for broader environmental protection.

episodes.title: Heaven Nose, Mister Smith
episodes.description: Mistakenly reincarnated, a tycoon tries to end his son's middle-class marriage.

episodes.title: The Whole Nine Yards
episodes.description: Jonathan intermediates for a football coach whose win-at-all-costs attitude has alienated his son.

episodes.title: Whose Trash Is It Anyway?
episodes.description: Jonathan and Mark help a mayoral candidate whose opponent wages a dirty campaign.

episodes.title: Hello and Farewell (Part 1)
episodes.description: A former Vietnam nurse suffers from post-traumatic stress disorder; a teenage boy learns he's adopted.

episodes.title: Hello and Farewell (Part 2)
episodes.description: An adopted boy meets his biological mother who is a Vietnam veteran suffering from traumatic flashbacks of the war.

episodes.title: The Silent Ball
episodes.description: A church council rules all teachers in a parochial school must follow and teach Christianity.

episodes.title: The Reunion
episodes.description: At Mark's high-school reunion, Jonathan helps a prom queen and a film star deal with faded glory.

episodes.title: Goodbye, Mr. Zelinka
episodes.description: Jonathan and Mark help students protest the mandatory retirement of a favorite teacher.

episodes.title: Choices
episodes.description: Private detectives Mark and Jonathan help a Vietnamese couple locate sons adopted and raised by an American family.

episodes.title: The Inner Limits
episodes.description: After years of taking care of a disabled brother, a man yearns to start a life for himself.

episodes.title: It's a Dog's Life
episodes.description: Thinking Jonathan has turned into a dog, Mark embarks alone to unite a young runaway with his family.

episodes.title: Merry Christmas From Grandpa
episodes.description: On Christmas Eve, Jonathan allows three powerful people to foresee the consequences of their actions.

2e28d651-f305-45b0-9276-abf6614a7234.description: Two families try to bridge the generation gap by testing their knowledge of historical events.

episodes.title: Sanchez vs. Perkey
episodes.description: The Sanchez family faces off with the Perkey family in a generational battle of skill and wit, with a $10,000 prize up for grabs.

episodes.title: Wood vs Finn
episodes.description: A photographer mother of 4, a closet-raiding teen and a sheepish grandma take on an alpine-loving mom, a skiing teen, and a coaching grandpa. The Wood family and Finn family compete for the $10,000 prize.

episodes.title: Pence vs Rubio
episodes.description: It's a special BYUtv celebrity edition as Studio C’s own Tori Pence and her family battle it out against Random Acts’ Will Rubio and the Rubio family for their charities.

episodes.title: Webb vs Bullock
episodes.description: The Webb family takes on the Bullock family. The teams must answer questions about classic TV shows for a chance to win $10,000.

episodes.title: Bates vs Witt
episodes.description: The Bates family has an adventurous dad, a theater loving teen, and a singing grandma. The Witt family has a sporty dad, an aspiring crew member teen, and an ultra-competitive grandpa. They face off in an all out generational battle of skill and wit.

episodes.title: Warner vs Maggio
episodes.description: The Warner family and the Maggio family face off in a generational battle of wit and skill.

episodes.title: Folau vs Goodman
episodes.description: The Folau family has a college soccer player, a veteran commercial pilot, and a Polynesian dance instructor. The Goodman family is made up of a hairdresser, a high school radio DJ, and a seasoned foodie. Watch them compete for the $10,000 prize!

episodes.title: Moser vs Alldredge
episodes.description: The Moser family faces off against the Alldredge family in a challenge of What’s That Noise? and a game called Dance Through the Ages.

episodes.title: Bean vs Jenson
episodes.description: The Bean family has a comedian, a child of the 80s, and a racquetball playing grandpa. They face off against the Jenson family with a devoted scrapbooker, a flexible author, and a retired multilingual teacher.

episodes.title: Talbert vs Osmond
episodes.description: The Talbert family has a marathon-running mother, a teenage Just Bieber fan, and a world-traveling grandma. They take on the Osmonds, which have a bubbly mom, a lunch-loving kid, and great uncle. Who will win the $10,000 prize?

episodes.title: Hintze vs Weir
episodes.description: The Hintze family has a hippo-loving kid, a nurse and a grandma of 30. The Weir family has a dressy teen and his sock-loving family. They challenge each other to games like Flyover, Fan Armies, and Couch Potato.

episodes.title: Bailey vs Freeze
episodes.description: The pitch-perfect Bailey family takes on the athletic Freeze family in games like Here’s The Pitch, Movie Guy, and Time Traveler.

episodes.title: Marziale vs Demke
episodes.description: The Marziale family and the Demke family play Stanley Streamer; the parents get recruited in the Fan Armies; and the grandparents get a visit from the Time Traveler.

episodes.title: Angilau vs Duke
episodes.description: The Angilau family and the Duke family play All Dressed Up; the parents take a call from The Movie Guy; The grandparents play Spoiler Alert and the teens have a show down with the Showstopper.

episodes.title: Ramage vs Greeff
episodes.description: The athletic Ramage family plays the thrifty Greeff family in games such as Smack-A-Fact, Hot Off The Press, and Inseparable.

episodes.title: Killpack vs Wight
episodes.description: The Killpack family goes head to head with the Wight family. The teens play a game of Unboxing; the parents play Spoiler Alert; both families play Dancing Through the Ages.

episodes.title: Gwilliam vs Merrill
episodes.description: The Disney-loving Gwilliam family competes with the academic Merrill family in games like Inseparable, Substitute Suzie, Re-enaction Star, and the Timeline Challenge.

episodes.title: Taylor vs Richards
episodes.description: The fashionable Taylor family and the spirited Richards family go head to head in challenges like Tag Me In That, Throwback Thursday, Here’s The Pitch, and Spoiler Alert.

episodes.title: Gardner vs Kener
episodes.description: The Gardner family challenges the Kener family in the games Ball of Ages, Re-enaction Star, and Feelin’ It; the parents go back in time with our Time Traveler; the teens take a swing at Here’s The Pitch.

episodes.title: Otsuji vs. Echavarria
episodes.description: The Otsuji family has a former sushi chef, an overly confident teen, and a retired teacher. The Echavarria family has a world-traveling mom, a teen soccer player, and a skydiving grandmother. They go head to head in games to test their knowledge.

episodes.title: Robertson vs Bevan
episodes.description: The Robertson family competes against the Bevan family. The grandparents take flight in a game of Flyover; the teens play Make This Work.

episodes.title: Free vs Wixom
episodes.description: The fun-loving Free family and the acrobatic Wixom family face off in challenges like Smack-A-Fact and Throwback Thursday; the grandparents meet the Couch Potato; the teens take flight with Flyover.

episodes.title: Broshinsky vs. Clegg
episodes.description: The brainy Broshinsky family plays the competitive Clegg family in games like The Movie Guy and What’s That Noise. Who will win the $10,000 prize?

episodes.title: Marriott vs Kawai
episodes.description: On this special Christmas episode, the Marriott family and the Kawai family play holiday-themed games like Zoom Zoom, Unboxing, and Spoiler Alert.

b1bb0017-2884-41f0-8924-febe874bebb2.description: Come study the words of the great prophet Isaiah with religious scholars.

episodes.title: Isaiah 6
episodes.description: Religious scholars introduce the book of Isaiah and discuss Isaiah’s character, history, writing and prophesying styles and calling as found in chapter 6 in the book of Isaiah. With Richard Draper, Robert Millet, Ann Madsen, and Victor Ludlow.

episodes.title: Isaiah 1-2 S
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Isaiah chapters 1 and 2 which detail Isaiah’s prophetic teaching to Israel about repenting from their apostate state and remembering their covenants. With Richard Draper, Robert Millet, Ann Madsen, and Victor Ludlow.

episodes.title: Isaiah 3-5
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the pride and disobedience that is abundant among the children of Israel and the parable of the vineyard as described in Isaiah chapters 3 through 5. With Richard Draper, Robert Millet, Ann Madsen, and Victor Ludlow.

episodes.title: Isaiah 7 - 8
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Isaiah chapters 7 and 8 which detail Syria and Israel waging war against Judah and the Messianic sign given to King Ahaz. With Victor Ludlow, Terry Szink, Ann Madsen, and Ray Huntington.

episodes.title: Isaiah 9 - 11
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the Messianic prophecy listing many names of Christ and parallel of the destruction of Assyria as described in Isaiah chapters 9 through 11. With Victor Ludlow, Terry Szink, Ann Madsen, and Ray Huntington.

episodes.title: Isaiah 12 - 14
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Isaiah chapters 12 through 14 which detail the destruction of Babylon as a parallel to the Second Coming as well as the Millennium that will follow. With Victor Ludlow, Terry Szink, Ann Madsen, and Ray Huntington.

episodes.title: Isaiah 15 - 17
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the condemnation of the lands of Moab and Damascus as well as the scattering of Israel as described in Isaiah chapters 15 through 17. With Terry Ball, Terry Szink, Michael Rhodes, and Ray Huntington.

episodes.title: Isaiah 18 - 20
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Isaiah chapters 18 through 20 which detail the prophecy of the destruction and later restoration of the land of Egypt. With Terry Ball, Terry Szink, Michael Rhodes, and Ray Huntington.

episodes.title: Isaiah 21 - 23
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss prophecies of destruction of many nations and of the captivity of the people of Jerusalem as illustrated in Isaiah chapters 21 through 23. With Terry Ball, Terry Szink, Michael Rhodes, and Ray Huntington.

episodes.title: Isaiah 24 - 26
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Isaiah chapters 24 through 26 which detail the earth’s state of apostasy before Christ’s Second Coming and the promise of resurrection for all. With Richard Draper, Paul Hoskisson, Michael Rhodes, and Ray Huntington.

episodes.title: Isaiah 27 - 28
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the chastening and gathering of Israel in the last days and the pride that caused the ten tribes to be lost as found in Isaiah chapters 27 and 28. With Richard Draper, Paul Hoskisson, Michael Rhodes, and Ray Huntington.

episodes.title: Isaiah 29
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Isaiah chapter 29 which prophesies the coming of the Book of Mormon and the restoration of the gospel after the apostasy. With Richard Draper, Paul Hoskisson, Michael Rhodes, and Ray Huntington.

episodes.title: Isaiah 30 - 31
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the chastisement and teaching Israel received from the Lord when they made an alliance with Egypt as described in Isaiah chapters 30 and 31. With Terry Ball, Jeff Chadwick, Michael Rhodes, and Ann Madsen.

episodes.title: Isaiah 32 - 33
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Isaiah chapters 32 and 33 which detail Christ’s reign as king, judge and lawgiver after His Second Coming and the types of Christ that exist in the scriptures. With Terry Ball, Jeff Chadwick, Michael Rhodes, and Ann Madsen.

episodes.title: Isaiah 34 - 35
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the destruction and judgment preceding the Second Coming of Jesus Christ and the redemption that will come after it as described in Isaiah chapters 34 and 35. With Terry Ball, Jeff Chadwick, Michael Rhodes, and Ann Madsen.

episodes.title: Isaiah 36 - 37
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Isaiah chapters 36 and 37 which details King Hezekiah’s conflict with Assyria and Isaiah’s prophecies the defeat of Assyria. With Paul Hoskisson, Jeff Chadwick, Ray Huntington, and Ann Madsen.

episodes.title: Isaiah 38 - 39
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Hezekiah’s life being lengthened due to his righteousness and faith and Isaiah’s prophecies regarding Babylon as described in Isaiah chapters 38 and 39. With Paul Hoskisson, Jeff Chadwick, Ray Huntington, and Ann Madsen.

episodes.title: Isaiah 40 - 41
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Isaiah chapters 40 and 41 where Isaiah speaks about the Messiah and how we need to prepare the way for His coming and how He will care for us. With Paul Hoskisson, Jeff Chadwick, Ray Huntington, and Ann Madsen.

episodes.title: Isaiah 42 - 43
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the servant songs found in Isaiah chapters 42 and 43 which describe the judgment of to the Gentiles and the power of the Savior. With Andrew Skinner, Richard Draper, Terry Ball, and Victor Ludlow.

episodes.title: Isaiah 44 - 45
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the Lord’s power to pour our blessings and His condemnation of idolatry and the prophecy of Cyrus ending Israel’s captivity in Isaiah chapters 44 and 45. With Andrew Skinner, Richard Draper, Terry Ball, and Victor Ludlow.

episodes.title: Isaiah 46 - 48
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Isaiah chapters 46 through 48 which detail the fall of Babylon and how idols are nothing as compared with the Lord, who can do all things. With Andrew Skinner, Richard Draper, Terry Ball, and Victor Ludlow.

episodes.title: Isaiah 49 - 51
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the elements of covenants and the relationship between Christ and His church as described in Isaiah chapters 49 through 51. With Victor Ludlow, Jeff Chadwick, Richard Draper, and Paul Hoskisson.

episodes.title: Isaiah 52 - 53
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the prophecies of redemption in the last days in Isaiah chapters 52 and 53 which are referenced in the Book of Mormon and the Doctrine and Covenants. With Victor Ludlow, Jeff Chadwick, Richard Draper, and Paul Hoskisson.

episodes.title: Seek Ye The Lord: Isa. 54-55
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Isaiah chapters 54 and 55 which detail the stakes of Zion that will be established in the last days to gather the lost tribes of Israel. With Victor Ludlow, Jeff Chadwick, Richard Draper, and Paul Hoskisson.

episodes.title: Isaiah 56 - 57
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss how all who keep the commandments are welcome to join Israel regardless of personal or family history as taught in Isaiah chapters 56 and 57. With Terry Ball, Victor Ludlow, Terry Szink, and Ray Huntington.

episodes.title: Isaiah 58 - 59
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Isaiah chapters 58 and 59 which detail the proper way to fast and keep the Sabbath day as well as why Israel is separated from God and how they will return. With Terry Ball, Victor Ludlow, Terry Szink, and Ray Huntington.

episodes.title: Isaiah 60 - 61
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss who is considered part of the House of Israel in the last days and Christ’s millennial reign as described in Isaiah chapters 60 and 61. With Terry Ball, Victor Ludlow, Terry Szink, and Ray Huntington.

episodes.title: Isaiah 62 - 64
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Isaiah chapters 62 through 64 which teach of the gathering of Israel using the metaphor of marriage and of the Second Coming as a day of vengeance. With Richard Draper, Jeff Chadwick, Victor Ludlow, and Andrew Skinner.

episodes.title: Isaiah 65 - 66
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the rejection of Ancient Israel and the rise of the great nation of Israel at the Second Coming of Christ as described in Isaiah chapters 65 and 66. With Richard Draper, Jeff Chadwick, Victor Ludlow, and Andrew Skinner.

episodes.title: My Soul Delighteth In His Words
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the Isaiah chapters in the Book of Mormon and the topics of covenants, the last days, and the Messiah that are covered in them. With Richard Draper, Jeff Chadwick, Victor Ludlow, and Andrew Skinner.

e1ae5313-4a4c-4ea1-84bd-89e0fedc26f4.description: Religious professors discuss the mortal life, mission, and teachings of the Savior.

episodes.title: The Gospels and Their Significance
episodes.description: Religious scholars introduce the four Gospels in the New Testament and the focus their ongoing discussion will have on the Savior and the everlasting covenant. With Andrew Skinner, Brent L. Top, Camille Fronk, and Paul Hoskisson.

episodes.title: The Foreordained Redeemer
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the premortal world and the first-born obligation that Christ fulfilled in His mission on Earth as well as the ancient prophets foretelling His coming. With Andrew Skinner, Brent L. Top, Camille Fronk, and Paul Hoskisson.

episodes.title: The Jewish Messianic Expectation
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the events of the ancient world before the coming of Christ and the expectations the Jews had of the Messiah. With Andrew Skinner, Brent L. Top, Camille Fronk, and Paul Hoskisson.

episodes.title: The Birth of Jesus
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the circumstances and faith of Mary and Joseph when they received the news that Mary would birth the promised Messiah, Jesus Christ. With Brent L. Top, David Whitchurch, D. Kelly Ogden, and Jeffrey Marsh.

episodes.title: The Childhood of Jesus
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the few events that are described of Jesus Christ’s childhood including his fleeing to Egypt with Joseph and Mary and his visits to the temple. With Brent L. Top, David Whitchurch, D. Kelly Ogden, and Jeffrey Marsh.

episodes.title: The Baptism of Jesus
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss John the Baptist’s role as prophet and forerunner of Christ as well as the significance of Christ’s baptism as an example and following doctrinal law. With Brent L. Top, David Whitchurch, D. Kelly Ogden, and Jeffrey Marsh.

episodes.title: Christ's Early Ministry
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the miracles and actions of Jesus in his early ministry including making wine from water and cleansing the temple. With Brent L. Top, David Whitchurch, D. Kelly Ogden, and Jeffrey Marsh.

episodes.title: Woman at the Well
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Jesus’ journey to Galilee through Samaria where He meets and speaks with the woman at the well despite that Jews avoid the area and people. With Andrew Skinner, Paul Hoskisson, Brent L. Top, and Camille Fronk.

episodes.title: Rejection at Nazareth
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Jesus proclaiming that He fulfilled Isaiah’s prophecy about the Messiah when He is reading from the Torah in a synagogue in Nazareth. With Andrew Skinner, Paul Hoskisson, Brent L. Top, and Camille Fronk.

episodes.title: The Calling of the Twelve
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the criticism Jesus received for dining with sinners and details of the men Jesus calls to be His apostles. With Andrew Skinner, Paul Hoskisson, Brent L. Top, and Camille Fronk.

episodes.title: The Beatitudes
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the beatitudes outlined in Jesus Christ’s Sermon on the Mount. With Brent L. Top, Camille Fronk, Ray Huntington, and David Whitchurch.

episodes.title: Sermon on the Mount
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the Sermon on the Mount and the direction to be perfect even as Christ is perfect as well as instructions on judging righteously. With Brent L. Top, Camille Fronk, Ray Huntington, and David Whitchurch.

episodes.title: Why Parables?
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Jesus’ use of parables to teach eternal truths in His ministry as a way to have timely and expansive reaches to His disciples. With Brent L. Top, Camille Fronk, Ray Huntington, and David Whitchurch.

episodes.title: "Thy Faith Hath Made Thee Whole"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Jesus’ ministry in Capernaum where He heals a woman with an issue of blood when she touches His clothes and raises a young girl from the dead. With Brent Top, Ray Huntington, David Whitchurch, and Camille Fronk.

episodes.title: Feeding The Multitude
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the imprisonment and beheading of John the Baptist, the miracle of feeding the five thousand, and Jesus walking on water. With Brent Top, Jeffrey Marsh, Ray Huntington, and Kelly Ogden.

episodes.title: The Bread of Life
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Jesus’ teachings on committing to the new gospel, that He is the bread of life, and how He has fulfilled the law of Moses. With Brent Top, Jeffrey Marsh, Ray Huntington, and Kelly Ogden.

episodes.title: The Rock of Our Salvation
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Jesus calling Peter to be the rock of His church and teaching about priesthood authority and ordinances. With Brent Top, Jeffrey Marsh, Ray Huntington, and Kelly Ogden.

episodes.title: The Mount of Transfiguration
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the events and lessons that occurred when Jesus brough Peter, James, and John to the Mount of Transfiguration and its importance in our day. With Brent Top, Jeffrey Marsh, Ray Huntington, and Kelly Ogden.

episodes.title: The Feast of the Tabernacles
