episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss when Jesus attends the Feast of the Tabernacles, as required by law, and the persecution He begins to experience that lasts until His crucifixion. With Brent Top, S. Kent Brown, David Whitchurch, and Jeffrey Marsh.

episodes.title: Light of the World
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the lessons we can learn from Jesus’ treatment of the woman caught in adultery and how He deals with her accusers. With Brent Top, S. Kent Brown, David Whitchurch, and Jeffrey Marsh.

episodes.title: The Good Shepherd
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the miracle where Jesus healed the blind man with clay and washing, how we can apply this miracle, and how He will always take care of His flock. With Brent Top, Jeffrey Marsh, Kent Brown, and David Whitchurch.

episodes.title: The Cost of Discipleship
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the doctrinal principles Jesus taught using many parables including the good Samaritan, the foolish rich man, and the unjust steward. With Andrew Skinner, Kent Brown, David Whitchurch, and Brent Top.

episodes.title: Lazarus, Come Forth
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the relationship Jesus had with Mary, Martha, and Lazarus and when He raised Lazarus from the dead after mourning with his sisters. With Brent Top, Jeffrey Marsh, Kent Brown, and David Whitchurch.

episodes.title: The Triumphal Entry
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Christ’s triumphant entry to Jerusalem that began the last week of His life and mortal ministry. With Camille Fronk, Keith Wilson, Paul Hoskisson, and Ray Huntington.

episodes.title: The Long Day of Debate
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the debate between Jesus and the Jewish leaders who questioned His authority. This provided us with many parables to learn from. With Camille Fronk, Keith Wilson, Paul Hoskisson, and Ray Huntington.

episodes.title: The Olivet Discourse
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the discourse Jesus provides on the Mount of Olives that answers questions of His apostles such as clarifying that He will come again and other lessons. With Camille Fronk, Keith Wilson, Paul Hoskisson, and Ray Huntington.

episodes.title: Preparations for the Last Supper
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Jesus’ preparation for the Last Supper during the Passover feast as well as Judas's actions of betrayal. With Andrew Skinner, Kent Brown, Ray Huntington, and Kelly Ogden.

episodes.title: The Last Supper
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the conversation, events, and lessons that occurred between Jesus and the twelve apostles in the upper room during the Last Supper. With Andrew Skinner, Kent Brown, Ray Huntington, and Kelly Ogden.

episodes.title: That They All May Be One
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Judas’ betrayal and the final lessons Jesus teaches to His apostles in preparation for His crucifixion and resurrection. With Andrew Skinner, Kent Brown, Ray Huntington, and Kelly Ogden.

episodes.title: Gethsemane
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the group journey to the garden of Gethsemane and the solitary prayer and suffering Jesus endured within the garden. With Andrew Skinner, Kent Brown, Ray Huntington, and Kelly Ogden.

episodes.title: The Arrest and Trial
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss Judas betraying Jesus with a kiss, Jesus healing one of His persecutors, and Peter’s motivations for defending and denying Christ. With Andrew Skinner, Kelly Ogden, David Whitchurch, and Gaye Strathearn.

episodes.title: The Crucifixion
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the trials Jesus endured and His journey to Golgotha, the place of His crucifixion. With Andrew Skinner, Kelly Ogden, David Whitchurch, and Gaye Strathearn.

episodes.title: The Resurrection
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the types and symbols from the Old Testament to Christ’s sacrifice as well as the details of the crucifixion and resurrection. With Andrew Skinner, Gaye Strathearn, Kelly Ogden, and David Whitchurch.

episodes.title: "What Think Ye of Christ?"
episodes.description: Religious scholars discuss the overall principles and lessons of Jesus Christ presented in the four gospels of Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John found in the New Testament. With Andrew Skinner, Kent Brown, David Whitchurch, and Brent Top.

edb9698a-da0d-4d40-85f0-34cca2c81239.description: Discover the faith-filled stories of amazing artists and their captivating works.

episodes.title: Brian Kershisnik / Paige Anderson
episodes.description: Painter and sculptor Brian Kershisnik reveals his sources of inspiration for his artwork. Paige Anderson describes how she balances creating art and being present with her family.

episodes.title: Zachary Proctor / Beth Krensky
episodes.description: Experience the works of Zachary Proctor and Beth Krensky. These two unique artists share their thoughts on what it takes to create art and identify their true source of inspiration.

episodes.title: Fidalis Buehler / Christine Armbruster
episodes.description: Fidalis Buehler's life has been a blending of cultures that he pulls on to paint works full of meaning. He uses his art to ask difficult questions. Christine Armbruster is a true people person and uses her strengths to photograph individuals.

episodes.title: Colby Sanford / Joe & Melinda Ostraff
episodes.description: Colby Sanford realized early on that Heavenly Father wanted him to do something that added positive value to his life. Joe and Melinda Ostraff are a married couple who share a studio and collaborate to create beautiful works of art together.

episodes.title: Emily McPhie / Cassandra Barney
episodes.description: Emily Mcphie is a painter who believes that her works are a way to express her spiritual identity. Cassandra Barney is a painter and costumer who considers her relationships with others to be the sustaining and creative voice behind her passion.

episodes.title: Fatima Ronquillo / Justin Wheatley
episodes.description: Fatima Ronquillo is a self-taught artist who is constantly working to explore her own identity through painting. Justin Wheatley is a painter who likes to find the “divine moments” in ordinary places and paints structures set in natural spaces.

episodes.title: Tony Abeyta / Del Curfman
episodes.description: Tony Abeyta believes that being a mentor is an important way to show gratitude to the people who gave him opportunities throughout his life. Del Curfman has been the recipient of Tony’s mentorship and hopes to bring art education to his tribe.

episodes.title: Ben Behunin / Wren Ross
episodes.description: Ben Behunin is a potter and writer. He created a beautiful home full of his art because he believes home should be a sanctuary. Wren Ross is a painter who also makes sketchbooks. It is clear to her that God works through art to connect with people.

episodes.title: Emilia Wing / David Habben
episodes.description: Emilia Wing paints aerial views of cities and wants her art to help people connect with place and with Christ in a deeper way that they haven’t before. David Habben is a graphic designer who believes that if you will ask, God will guide you in your w

episodes.title: Justin Taylor / Christian Bolt
episodes.description: Justin Taylor knows that God cares about visual things. He believes that people are divine, and he uses his art to explore humanity. Christian Bolt is a sculptor who strongly believes in inspiration.

episodes.title: Brittany Scott / Steve & Tonya Vistaunet
episodes.description: Brittany Scott is a figure painter who found that doubt and failure are a natural part of progression as she co-created with God. Steve and Tonya Vistaunet make art from the heart with a use of color that invokes the joy they felt called to foster.

episodes.title: Rebecca Klundt / J Kirk Richards
episodes.description: Rebecca Klundt's use of recycled materials reminds her of God's sometimes mysterious ability to create something beautiful from what we already have. J. Kirk Richards uses his artwork to ask God for help finding opportunities to serve others.

episodes.title: Nick Stephens / Linda Etherington
episodes.description: Nick Stephens experiments with color, geometry, texture, and pattern to explore how God’s work throughout the ages fits together. Linda Etherington depicts the holy moments that happen in the small and simple daily tasks that tie a family together.

episodes.title: Rob Chipman / Kathleen Peterson
episodes.description: Rob Chipman creates reduction woodblock prints that remind him that life is a layer upon layer process where mistakes make good mentors. Kathleen Peterson uses figure paintings to discover the light of Christ in individual souls.

episodes.title: Caitlin Connolly / Jorge Cocco Santángelo
episodes.description: Caitlin Connolly is a painter whose art explores the significance of womanhood as she uses painting as a medium to converse with God. Jorge Cocco Santángelo portrays sacred events through shapes and colors that visually capture spiritual feelings.

episodes.title: Emma Taylor / Nnamdi Okonkwo
episodes.description: Emma Taylor understands that no matter how many times she must paint over her mistakes, God sees every layer and accepts them all. Nnamdi Okonkwo seeks to touch as many lives in a positive way as possible through his sculptures.

episodes.title: David Troncoso / Shari Lyon
episodes.description: David Troncoso paints in the Renaissance style to explore what lies beyond our reality, asking questions about the spiritual. Shari Lyon works with hot wax and flame to create works of encaustic art that connect her with her divine femininity.

episodes.title: Eva Koleva Timothy / Liz Harris
episodes.description: Eva Koleva Timothy is a celebrated photographer who feels guided by the Savior as she creates a body of work about Him. Liz Harris communicates the divinity and humanity of her subjects through her portraits, capturing how they see the Lord.

episodes.title: Lyn Hovey / Melissa Kamba Boggs
episodes.description: Lyn Hovey is a master of stained glass whose expressive windows illustrate the threads God weaves through our lives. Melissa Kamba Boggs's gold leaf paintings symbolize divinity and self-worth, inviting viewers to see themselves as God does.

episodes.title: Bobby Martin / Joe Bennion
episodes.description: Bobby Martin's prints and drawings use old family photographs that remind him how God brought people into his life to nurture his faith. Joe Bennion crafts each of his pots to enhance the sacred experience of families sitting down together to eat.

episodes.title: Brooke Bowen / Walter Rane
episodes.description: Brooke Bowen explores spiritual questions as she creates, drawing closer to her Heavenly Parents while pondering and painting motherhood. Walter Rane illustrates scenes from scripture, but also feels the reality of Christ through abstract artwork.

episodes.title: James Rees / Gwyneth Thompson-Briggs
episodes.description: James Rees explores the unique burdens we carry every day through his monotypes. Gwyneth Thompson-Briggs portrays the saints of her Catholic faith through her oil paintings.

episodes.title: Annie Poon / Greg Olsen
episodes.description: Annie Poon draws inspiration from her faith and her experience with depression to create artwork that shares how she found spiritual healing. Greg Olsen seeks to capture the character of Christ, centering the Savior in his life and paintings.

episodes.title: Leroy Transfield / Rose Datoc Dall
episodes.description: Leroy Transfield expresses his faith through sculpture. Rose Datoc Dall uses her skills as a painter to depict scenes of the Savior.

episodes.title: Sarah Winegar / Ron Richmond
episodes.description: Sarah Winegar uses reduction woodcuts and relief paintings to articulate her feelings about the human experience. Ron Richmond paints to explore spiritual allegory and metaphor.

episodes.title: Sunny Taylor / Jack Baumgartner
episodes.description: Abstract painter Sunny Taylor learns that joy and sorrow are intertwined like bittersweet vines, and that there is beauty in experiencing both. Jack Baumgartner recognizes his divine identity as much through painting as he does through farming.

episodes.title: Lisa DeLong / James Madison
episodes.description: Lisa DeLong uses geometry to reflect the order of the universe through artistic traditions rooted in sacred beliefs. James Madison is a Tulalip carver who keeps his culture alive with every totem pole he carves.

episodes.title: Behnaz Karjoo / Justin Hackworth
episodes.description: Behnaz Karjoo creates illuminations of Islamic geometry that reflect God's love and unity. Justin Hackworth is a portrait photographer who finds that God enters his life through those who step into his studio to have their picture taken.

episodes.title: Abigale Palmer / Fernando Cidoncha
episodes.description: Abigale Palmer loves color and discovers that difficult experiences, though uncomfortable, help us learn to communicate with Heavenly Father. Fernando Cidoncha creates sculptures and paintings that connect faith communities to their higher power.

episodes.title: Tyler Swain / Noémie Pons
episodes.description: Tyler Swain paints often-overlooked subjects and realizes that God's beauty exists all around us. Multidisciplinary artist Noémie Pons learns to see how people are transformed when they connect with the divine.

episodes.title: Ryan Moffett / Liz Lemon Swindle
episodes.description: After contracting Multiple Sclerosis, Ryan Moffett rediscovers his faith by sculpting. Liz Lemon Swindle thinks her art days are behind her until she finds inspiration in The Chosen, and a new appreciation for the life of Christ.

episodes.title: Kat Elliott / Jenedy Paige
episodes.description: Kat Elliot depicts God’s mercy through sculpture, using discarded objects to create works of art. Jenedy Paige finds inspiration in the memory of her son, and gives new meaning to the Nativity and healing from loss.

episodes.title: Jeff Hein / Jeanette Kuvin Oren
episodes.description: Jeff Hein explains how his health problems led to his devotion to painting Christ. Jeanette Kuvin Oren creates a torah cover for scriptures that survived the Holocaust.

episodes.title: Nicole Woodbury / Joshua Meyer
episodes.description: Nicole Woodbury is a sculptor who sees God in the patterns of biology. She finds inspiration on her journey to motherhood. God's creations in the Torah leads Joshua Meyer examines his relationship to light in his “Eight Approaches'' piece.

episodes.title: Irina Bradley / Qashif Masud
episodes.description: Irina Bradley shares how a battle with cancer inspired her to pursue iconography. Qashif Masud is a craftsman and woodworker who connects with God and his family history through carved calligraphy.

episodes.title: Esther Hi'ilani Candari / Bruce Smith
episodes.description: Esther Hi’ilani Candari tells how she switched from sculpture to painting, and why she paints the female religious experience. Bruce Smith shares how he came to paint religious art with techniques from the Old Masters.

episodes.title: Michael Malm / Kichaa Man Chitrakar
episodes.description: Michael Malm encounters challenges while creating a painting for his church. Kichaa Man Chitrakar draws closer to his family through his artwork.

episodes.title: Nativity
episodes.description: Painter Rose Datoc explores the role of Mary as the mother of the Savior through her art.

episodes.title: Fiona Rew / Jeff Pugh
episodes.description: Fiona Rew shares how she has felt inadequate throughout her life. Her glasswork encompasses the beauty of the growth she has experienced. Jeff Pugh’s depression in his life lead to the realization that we are not alone. His art shows how God has save

episodes.title: Amber Eldredge / Santiago Michalek
episodes.description: Amber Eldredge shares how God creates beauty from ashes and how she seeks to do the same with her art. Santiago Michalek focuses on portraying horses and automobiles with exact detail and strength in his paintings, inspired by his grandfather.

episodes.title: Blair Barlow / Kwani Winder
episodes.description: Blair Barlow finds comfort from prayer, inspiration from Catholic art, and bravery from St. Joan of Arc. Kwani Winder connects her heritage as part of the Santa Clara Pueblo tribe with her religion and uses that connection to build God's kingdom.

episodes.title: David Sandum / Elise Wehle
episodes.description: David Sandum discusses how artists Edvard Munch and Vincent Van Gogh helped him through depression to create art of his own. Elise Wehle talks about the process that lead her to printmaking with plants and natural materials.

episodes.title: Emily Hawkins / Bruce Naigles
episodes.description: Emily Hawkins began making art when she became a mother and uses her work to express her feelings about her children and motherhood. Bruce Naigles uses sculpting to answer his questions about life, focusing on staying joyful despite hard times.

episodes.title: Elizabeth Sanchez / Tenzing Rigdol
episodes.description: Elizabeth Sanchez discusses how she finds personalities in her art and how her work helped her through depression. Tenzing Rigdol connects with his culture and his parents' culture through different artistic techniques.

episodes.title: Kristin Carver / Gary Ernest Smith
episodes.description: Kristin Alley Carver creates art to connect to a higher power and to balance her experience with motherhood. Gary Ernest Smith reflects on how his roots in farming and his time in the military influenced his art.

episodes.title: Valerie Atkisson / David Dibble
episodes.description: Valerie Atkisson uses her art to remember her family, both living and dead, as well as to cope with her chronic disease. David Dibble grew up on a farm and discusses how his childhood inspires the nature that he paints as an adult.

episodes.title: Dan Wilson / Kazuko Covington
episodes.description: Dan Wilson discusses how his paintings have uplifted and encouraged faith within his family and in those around him. Kazuko Convington shares her process of making quilts to show her faith to everyone around her, including her ancestors.

episodes.title: Negyem Adonoo / Richard Adusu
episodes.description: Negyem Adonoo believes in energetically expressing his faith in God and his obedience through his paintings. Richard Adusu discusses how art helped him through the darkest times of his life and allowed him to express himself.

episodes.title: Expressions of Jesus
episodes.description: In this special episode of Artful, ten artists share their unique expressions of Jesus. Through intimate looks inside their studios and artistic process, these artists share their visual and spiritual testimony of the Savior, His life, and His works.

episodes.title: Paige Payne / Yongsung Kim
episodes.description: Paige Payne creates a community around the art that helps her overcome mental health struggles. Yongsung Kim reflects on his difficult journey to becoming an artist and the peace that painting brings him.

episodes.title: Pia Soriano-Gatdula / Rogério Pedro
episodes.description: Pia Soriano’s faith and love of painting guided her to create iconography pieces. Rogério Pedro finds joy in sharing his love of painting with his family.

episodes.title: Robert Besana / Pamela Salinas
episodes.description: Painter and art instructor Robert Besana paints a commentary on an issue he is passionate about. Pamela Salinas celebrates science and religion through her handmade, nature centered artworks.

episodes.title: Julie Yuen Yim / Anthony Sweat
episodes.description: Julie Yuen Yim inspires others with her traditional Chinese style artwork representing Christ. Instead of choosing between a career in art and a career as a religion instructor, Anthony Sweat embraces both.

episodes.title: Farkhondeh Ahmadzadeh / Ki-Woong Park
episodes.description: Painter and calligrapher Farkhondeh Ahmadzadeh creates detailed Persian miniatures that capture the spiritual essence of Sufi poetry. Sculptor Ki-Woong Park works with stainless steel and glass to create delicate expressions of faith and Christ.

episodes.title: Rodrigo Andriàn / Veronika Bianchi
episodes.description: Rodrigo Andriàn shares the joy of creation with his students, inspiring a new generation of painters. Veronika Bianchi makes a pact with God to become an artist and blazes a trail forward.

episodes.title: Maxwell Boadi / Taiichi Aoba
episodes.description: Maxwell Boadi’s dreams for a better life are fulfilled through God. Taiichi Aoba takes a new direction in his work after he joins the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.

3387a2fd-369d-44c2-a518-66856a03d847.description: Join Wayne Brady as he mentors eight young comedians through 10 weeks of challenges.

episodes.title: And Then There Were 6
episodes.description: Emmy winner Wayne Brady kicks off his epic search for America’s first teen comedy sensation. Wayne chooses his final six to undergo a comedy boot camp based on the lessons learned throughout his iconic career.

episodes.title: Hooray for (North) Hollywood
episodes.description: The six teen comedians arrive at the Academy, where Wayne Brady has their work cut out for them. Their first challenge: learn guest mentor's Marcel Wilson's choreography and perform at a huge Hollywood birthday party.

episodes.title: Dane vs. Wayne
episodes.description: Wayne Brady and Jonathan Mangum head up two teams in an improv battle at ComedySportz for their very own “Whose Line is it Anyway?” experience. One teen must face off in an improvised rap battle against Wayne Brady himself.

episodes.title: Contagious Laughter Syndrome
episodes.description: Wayne Brady and Jonathan Mangum team up with friend and collaborator Joel McCrary (Baldric from BYUtv's Dwight in Shining Armor) to challenge the kids to develop three unique characters. The teens are thrown for a loop when they must improvise in cha

episodes.title: The Golden Rule of Improv
episodes.description: Special guest comedian Lauren Pritchard helps the kids discover their “superpowers,” and how to work as a team to make each other look good. They present their sketches at Second City.

episodes.title: Epic Rap Battles
episodes.description: The teens work with YouTube sensation Epic Lloyd (Epic Rap Battles of History) to write and perform their own raps for a music video. Some rise to the challenge while others struggle to find their voice.

episodes.title: Stand up For Yourself
episodes.description: Wayne Brady brings legendary stand-up comedian Sinbad to help the young comics shape their three-minute sets for a live audience at the iconic Improv comedy club. One cast member is eliminated.

episodes.title: Dance Fo' Yo Life!
episodes.description: B-boy Flo Master gives the young comics a dance lesson and a challenge to create their own viral dances. With another elimination looming, the teens must use their knowledge of content creation to win over the online community.

episodes.title: Making a Mochrie
episodes.description: Whose Line Is It, Anyway? star Colin Mocherie mentors the young comics as they face their biggest improv challenge yet. Two teens are eliminated, leaving only three into the finale.

episodes.title: The Final Showdown
episodes.description: The three finalists are put to the test in a one-of-a-kind performance at the acclaimed Upright Citizens Brigade theater in the heart of Los Angeles. The eliminated cast returns to help the finalists perform in their sketches for a packed house.

3df314de-615e-4b74-8d47-b2d3d5d0c71d.description: A collection of eye-opening documentaries that explores human history, science, and experience.

episodes.title: Legato Line
episodes.description: Reid Nibley, the composer of the hymn “I Know My Father Lives” and an accomplished concert pianist, overcomes his fear of performing and a rocky relationship with his mother to create the legacy that still stands.

episodes.title: The Heart of Texas
episodes.description: After the tragic death of their young daughter, Grover Norwood and his family choose forgiveness when they learn a close friend was responsible, inspiring a community through faith, compassion, and grace.

episodes.title: Breaking The Curse
episodes.description: The remarkable story of Becky Douglas and Padma Venkataraman, whose efforts help people affected by leprosy in India build businesses, gain dignity, and create better futures for their children.

episodes.title: A Bridge to China
episodes.description: A group of youth dancers, singers, and musicians from China tour the United States to share their culture. They perform at BYU Hawaii with the Mormon Tabernacle Choir.

episodes.title: Adrian Anantawan: Story Behind The Notes
episodes.description: One-handed violinist Adrian Anatawan shares his story and his love for music. He has performed with the Toronto Symphony and the Cutis Institute of Music.

episodes.title: The Kennedy Way
episodes.description: Ambassador and Secretary of the Treasury for the United States David Kennedy lived a life that was devoted to The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints. Friends and family share his story.

episodes.title: James Christensen
episodes.description: Fantastical artist James C. Christensen had to overcome family struggles and harsh criticism to achieve his dreams. Now he has painted for the Utah Shakespeare Festival and Governor Gary Herbert.

episodes.title: Soul of Kalaupapa: Voices in Exile
episodes.description: In Kalaupapa, Hawaii, leprosy survivors share their stories of what life was like being isolated from their families and building a community out of tragedy.

episodes.title: Wayne Quinton
episodes.description: Coming from very humble beginnings, Wayne Quinton invented kidney dialysis and many other inventions that saved thousands of lives. Some call him the original bioengineer.

episodes.title: Bill Child
episodes.description: President of RC Willey Bill Child shares his story of how he turned the biggest challenges of his life and turned them into success.

episodes.title: Honoring A Father's Dream
episodes.description: Milton Ochieng follows his father's dream to build the first health clinic in Iwala, Africa, by studying at Vanderbilt University Medical Center and Dartmouth University. He dreams to save the lives of many in his community.

episodes.title: Journey To Everest
episodes.description: A group of travelers dream of climbing Mount Everest. They encounter many struggles and tragedies along the way that may stop that dream from becoming a reality.

episodes.title: Africa Rising
episodes.description: Forty Ethiopian men and women use their skills to transform their community into a thriving society with tens of thousands of skilled workers.

episodes.title: A Song For Africa
episodes.description: Orphans in Uganda, Africa, are selected to join the Watoto Children’s Choir and perform on a tour across North America. Their song stands as a testament that music can overcome any tragedy.

episodes.title: Honeymoon In Kabul
episodes.description: Australian newlyweds Maggie Haertsch and Jean-Paul Bell bring medical aid and humor to a community in Afghanistan.

episodes.title: Caravan Of Books
episodes.description: Gellow, a camel in Kenya, Africa, transports books across the Semi Desert to bring stories to children and families in nomad communities.

episodes.title: Ordinary Life - Ben's Road to Glory
episodes.description: Ben Southern was born with down syndrome, but despite all the challenges, he has fought to compete in the Special Winter Olympics in figure skating for his country, New Zealand.

episodes.title: Ordinary Life - Journey of the Nz Wheelbacks
episodes.description: The New Zealand Wheel Blacks share their stories of being quadriplegic athletes and compete in the world wheelchair rugby championships.

6948a8d6-0725-4b13-90e6-f0d2e84cb242.description: Get a fresh take on topics that will improve your everyday life and relationships.

episodes.title: Start with Why with Simon Sinek
episodes.description: Author and rogue anthropologist, Simon Sinek discusses his philosophy of starting with a why or learning how to live everything with a purpose with our host Rebecca Cressman.

episodes.title: Families on the Home Front
episodes.description: Rebecca Cressman discusses families on the home front with individuals who are a part of the military community.

episodes.title: Bullying
episodes.description: Dr. Dorothy Espelage and Rebecca Cressman discuss bullying in schools through the stories of Jeff Johnston and Falcon Ridge Elementary.

episodes.title: Charitable Organizations
episodes.description: Rebecca Cressman and Jennifer Borget discuss charitable organizations and how individuals can make a difference in the world around them.

episodes.title: Helping Public Schools
episodes.description: Rebecca Cressman discusses how parents can help the children in public schools with the National PTA President, Chuck Saylors.

episodes.title: Mommy Blogging
episodes.description: Rebecca Cressman discusses mommy blogging with individuals who have experienced it firsthand.

episodes.title: The Jets
episodes.description: Rebecca Cressman discusses the rise of The Jets, an 80’s pop group, with the Wolfgramm family.

episodes.title: Inspiring Stories 2
episodes.description: Rebecca Cressman discusses inspiring stories of hope with Kevin Bardsley, Ginger Johnson, and Kelle Hampton.

episodes.title: Pornography--Start a Conversation
episodes.description: Rebecca Cressman discusses opening conversations about pornography with clinical psychologist Dr. Kirk Dougher and women who have experienced the effects of pornography in their lives.

episodes.title: Movie Night
episodes.description: Rebecca Cressman discusses new ideas on how to enjoy movie nights.

episodes.title: Collaborative Consumption
episodes.description: Rebecca Cressman discusses collaborative consumption with author and expert, Rachel Botsman.

episodes.title: 5 Love Languages
episodes.description: Rebecca Cressman discusses the five love languages with marriage and family therapist, Dr. Gary Chapman.

episodes.title: Slow Food Feast
episodes.description: Rebecca Cressman discusses slow food feasting with specialists in the food community and the slow food movement.

episodes.title: Inner Amazing-Breast Cancer
episodes.description: Rebecca Cressman discusses the inner amazing about breast cancer survival with personal style consultant, Darcy Howard.

episodes.title: Biz Kids
episodes.description: Rebecca Cressman discusses Biz Kids with producers and founders Jim Mckenna and Jeanine Glista.

episodes.title: Dare to Dream
episodes.description: Rebecca Cressman discusses daring to dream with Whitney Johnson from the Dare To Dream Blog.

episodes.title: Men Preventing Violence
episodes.description: Rebecca Cressman discusses men preventing violence with co-founder of A Call To Men, Ted Bunch.

episodes.title: Inspiring Stories 1
episodes.description: Rebecca Cressman discusses the inspiring stories of hope from Cami Walker, Kate Fletcher,Jason and Rachel Levitt, and Becky Douglas.

episodes.title: Momnificent
episodes.description: Rebecca Cressman discusses how to be momnificent with life coach Lori Radum.

episodes.title: The Life Story
episodes.description: Rebecca Cressman and Dan McAdams discuss the life story and how individuals use narratives to find their identities.

episodes.title: Food Awareness
episodes.description: Rebecca Cressman discusses food awareness with author Blake Spalding and mother Jen Kilstrom.

episodes.title: Edible Schoolyard with Alice Waters
episodes.description: Rebecca Cressman discusses the edible schoolyard with chef and food advocate, Alice Waters.

episodes.title: Chocolate
episodes.description: Rebecca Cressman and members of the Fresh Take staff explore fine chocolate with chocolate importer Nick Fapier.

episodes.title: True Men True Strength
episodes.description: Rebecca Cressman discusses true men and true strength with Curt Doussett. Together they recognize men who exemplify the ideals of this organization.

episodes.title: Inner Amazing-Self Esteem
episodes.description: Rebecca Cressman discusses the inner amazing of self-esteem with personal style consultant Darcy Howard.

1b3f15ec-42f3-4c69-bc78-c7c0700108bd.description: Follow the BYU football team throughout their season.

episodes.title: Fall Training Camp Begins (9-1-15)
episodes.description: The BYU football team arrives for fall training camp. Part 1 of 2.

episodes.title: Fall Training Camp Begins - Part 2 (9-1-15)
episodes.description: The BYU football team arrives for fall training camp. Part 2 of 2.

episodes.title: BYU Triumphs in Nebraska (9-8-15)
episodes.description: Follow the team off the field and get the emotional inside scoop on Taysom Hill's season-ending injury, and Tanner Mangum's game-winning pass.

episodes.title: BYU Gears Up for Boise State (9-15-15)
episodes.description: With an incredible win in its pocket and a new starting quarterback, the BYU football team is now up against rival Boise State.

episodes.title: BYU Tries to Extend Winning Streak in UCLA (9-22-15)
episodes.description: After a streak of exciting wins, the Cougars prepare for a showdown against tenth-ranked UCLA.

episodes.title: Cougars Rally after a Hard Loss (9-29-2015)
episodes.description: The Cougars turn the highs and lows of the rollercoaster season into learning opportunities.

episodes.title: The Bounce Back of BYU (10-6-2015)
episodes.description: Fueled by determination despite setbacks, the Cougars turn their attention to the UConn Huskies.

episodes.title: Homecoming Week (10-13-15)
episodes.description: The Cougars talk teamwork, commitment, and balance in preparation for their Homecoming win.

episodes.title: The Cougars Prep for the Bearcats (10-20-15)
episodes.description: See what a day in the life of a Cougar is like, and watch the team prepare to battle Cincinnati.

episodes.title: Crushing Home Victory (10-27-15)
episodes.description: With a home game against Wagner on the horizon, see how young players like Beau Hoge prepare to enter the contest.

episodes.title: Bye Week (11-3-15)
episodes.description: During their bye week, the Cougars stay focused but still make time for Halloween hijinks.

episodes.title: On the Road Again (11-10-15)
episodes.description: BYU ramps up the intensity of their workouts ahead of Friday's game against San Jose State.

episodes.title: Battle in Missouri (11-17-15)
episodes.description: Experience all the best action up close as the Cougars face off against the Missouri Tigers.

episodes.title: Senior Night (11-24-15)
episodes.description: It's the last home game of the season, and the Cougars play hard against Fresno State to remain undefeated at LaVell Edwards Stadium this year.

episodes.title: The Last Stretch (12-1-15)
episodes.description: Watch the Cougars celebrate Thanksgiving and take on rival Utah State this week.

episodes.title: Bowl Game against the Rivals (12-22-15)
episodes.description: News of Coach Mendenhall's departure breaks, and the team prepares for the bowl game in Las Vegas.

episodes.title: Bowl Game against the Rivals - Part 2 (12-22-15)
episodes.description: Join the team as they take on Utah at the Las Vegas Bowl and welcome Coach Kalani Sitake to BYU.

64f590d5-7c81-4a4d-b9fd-edb506def660.description: Prosthetics expert Derrick Campana offers hope and healing for animals and their human families.

episodes.title: Lightning
episodes.description: Lighting is a pony with deformed hooves who struggles to live life to the fullest. He needs Derrick's help to get back on his feet and improve his health and quality of life.

episodes.title: Avery
episodes.description: Derrick helps Waddles the duck regain mobility. Derrick then creates prosthetics that will help Avery get back on all four paws.

episodes.title: Turbo-Roo & Thor
episodes.description: Derrick helps two chihuahuas, Turbo Roo and Thor, get new sets of wheels to keep up with their loving family.

episodes.title: Ferdie
episodes.description: Derrick makes a special prosthetic for Ferdie, a goat who lost his back leg in an accident.

episodes.title: Bert
episodes.description: Derrick gets creative as he makes four new braces for Bert, a potbelly pig with a disorder that limits his walking abilities.

episodes.title: Pearl
episodes.description: Derrick gives Pearl, a rescue bulldog, some pawsitive reinforcements.

episodes.title: Elsa
episodes.description: Having no paws makes mobility difficult for Elsa the dog Derrick creates four prosthetics to help her walk with less struggle.

episodes.title: Gracie
episodes.description: Gracie already tried a prosthetic that failed her. Derrick works even harder to help her find her footing again.

episodes.title: Bear
episodes.description: Derrick helps three barnyard animals find new life through specialized prosthetics.

episodes.title: Yusi - Part 1
episodes.description: Derrick travels to the Barnyard Bhutan Animal Rescue to build a prosthetic for a horse named Yusi. Yusi lost her leg in a car accident, and if Derrick can't help her, she may not survive.

episodes.title: Yusi - Part 2
episodes.description: Derrick is in Bhutan to build a new leg for Yusi, a special horse who lost her leg in a car accident.

episodes.title: Toto
episodes.description: Derrick Campana makes prostheses for Toto’s sensitive front legs. He personalizes them to match her owner, Jorja.

episodes.title: Lacie
episodes.description: Derrick returns to see Lightning, the dwarf pony he helped in season one. He makes braces for another dwarf pony named Thunder and a mobility cart for a recently paralyzed dog named Lacey.

episodes.title: Aries
episodes.description: Derrick visits an animal sanctuary to help an Icelandic sheep named Aries and a cow named Lois. Aries gets a mobility cart and Lois gets braces for her front legs.

episodes.title: Shadow
episodes.description: Derrick goes to Los Angeles and hears the story of Shadow and her owner, Jamie. Shadow gets a mobility cart and finds the freedom and independence she needs.

episodes.title: Frida
episodes.description: After a tragic accident in Thailand, a dog named Frida learns how to walk with her new leg braces.

episodes.title: Zoey
episodes.description: A dog named Zoey gets a prosthetic leg just like her owner, Cindy. Zoey trains to be a therapy dog to encourage and comfort other amputees.

episodes.title: Trigger
episodes.description: Trigger is in urgent need of a prosthetic leg so he can stay healthy and strong. Derrick visits Ziggy’s Refuge Farm Sanctuary to help out a pig named Hope.

episodes.title: Menina
episodes.description: Derrick travels all the way to Hawaii to help Magical Creatures Sanctuary with a sheep named Menina and a dog named Hank. Menina finds independence with her leg braces.

episodes.title: Gaia
episodes.description: Derrick visits Aloha Animal Sanctuary and meets a sheep named Gaia. Gaia has overcome abuse and neglect, but she needs a prosthetic leg to keep up with her lamb, Felicio.

episodes.title: Hope
episodes.description: Derrick travels to Utah and makes a leg prosthesis for a goat named Hope. He mentors Hope’s owner, Gentry, throughout the prosthetic-making process.

episodes.title: Boots
episodes.description: Derrick travels to Mooresville, North Carolina to meet the Russell family and build a custom cart for their 11-month-old corgi, Boots, who was born with front limb deformities. Derrick and the Russell family are eager to see if Boots will accept the

episodes.title: Teo
episodes.description: A familiar face joins Derrick at the shop before he travels to San Diego, California to help a bouncy puppy named Teo. Derrick must come up with a new cart design so Teo’s owners, frontline workers Milton and Vannessa, can take him on beach trips.

episodes.title: Colby
episodes.description: Derrick travels to Long Beach, California to help the Wackerman-Nulty family and their new puppy, Colby. Colby was born with a front limb deformity called ectrodactyly. Derrick will try to make Colby a custom prosthetic to help get him on his feet.

episodes.title: Penny
episodes.description: Derrick helps out a dog named Rex who was born without his two front legs and needs a custom cart. Then he heads to Fort Worth, Texas to meet Penny who lost a leg in a traumatic car accident and without Derrick’s help may become paralyzed.

episodes.title: Debbie
episodes.description: Derrick travels to a farm hidden amongst the lights of Las Vegas to help an alpaca who was born with front limb deformities. Debbie’s legs will continue to break down unless Derrick can build custom braces to stabilize and correct her legs.

episodes.title: Penelopes
episodes.description: Derrick and Henry travel to Texas to help neighbors Monica and Robert with a cow and a dog, both named Penelope. Penelope the cow needs a boot to graze freely, while Penelope the dog has severe nerve damage and can’t control her back legs.

episodes.title: Marvel
episodes.description: Derrick helps a dog named Buddy Love, who has a front limb deformity and needs a cart to help him get around. Then Derrick heads to Minnesota to meet Marvel, who was born without her front paw and needs a prosthetic.

episodes.title: Gunner
episodes.description: Derrick travels to Savannah, Georgia to help a war hero and his service dog, Gunner. After losing his front paw to cancer, Gunner has not been able to perform his duties as a service dog. Derrick builds a prosthetic limb that will get Gunner walking

episodes.title: Bella
episodes.description: Derrick helps Bella, an older dog battling cancer. Derrick builds her a cart to help her stay active during these rough cancer treatments.

episodes.title: Indy
episodes.description: Derrick travels to North Carolina to help John and Brittany and their rescue dog, Indy, who lost his front leg in a car accident. When Derrick discovers Indy’s shoulder is severely underdeveloped and not suited for a prosthetic, he refuses to give up

episodes.title: Ski Pawtrol
episodes.description: Derrick heads to Colorado to build a custom prosthetic for Wesley, a two-year-old rescue dog born with a front limb deformity. Derrick hopes a new leg will help Wesley keep up with his adventurous family for years to come.

episodes.title: Raccoon-ing and Rolling
episodes.description: Derrick travels to Glendale, Kentucky to help out a cuddly raccoon named Boone, who needs a custom cart so he can freely move around his home at an animal sanctuary.

episodes.title: Mission: Im-paw-sible
episodes.description: Derrick visits a family in New Jersey to help two rescues: Angus, a cat with multiple amputations; and Lux, a dog who lost his front leg. Derrick's devices will help Lux and Angus keep up with their family.

episodes.title: Sweet Peaches
episodes.description: Derrick gives a dog named Watson the chance to walk with a full limb prosthesis. Derrick then heads to Connecticut to help Peaches the goat with a custom cart.

episodes.title: Marvelous Millie
episodes.description: In Lancaster, Pennsylvania, Derrick meets the Hicks family and builds a custom prosthesis for their dog, Millie, who was born with a front limb deformity.

episodes.title: Rolling in the Sheep
episodes.description: Derrick visits California to help a sheep named Timmy and his goat friend, Poppy. Timmy and Poppy share a stall and also share front leg mobility issues.

episodes.title: We Love Roo
episodes.description: Derrick helps a pup named Rosie who is missing a paw and needs a custom prosthetic. Then, Derrick travels to Los Angeles to meet a chihuahua named Roo, who was born with two legs and needs a custom cart to help her keep up with her best friend, Chase

episodes.title: A Moe-ment Like This
episodes.description: Derrick travels to Sheridan, Illinois to help a camel named Moe. Due to his collapsed legs, Moe has been confined to his stall for four years and unable to go outside. For the first time, Derrick builds a set of braces for a 1500 pound camel.

episodes.title: Kala Me Mine
episodes.description: Derrick helps a big dog named Bently with his back leg issues; Derrick then heads to Florida to help Ujwala and her foster dog Kala. Kala is a rescue from the streets of India who must learn to trust Derrick and the new prothesis.

episodes.title: Love & Elephants, Part One
episodes.description: Derrick and his wife, Kelly, travel to Thailand to visit Elephant Nature Park to help Mae Mai, an elephant with a painful dislocated knee. Derrick also helps a young bull elephant named Khun Dej who has an injured foot.

episodes.title: Love & Elephants, Part Two
episodes.description: Derrick and his wife, Kelly, travel to Thailand to visit Elephant Nature Park. Derrick works to improve the prosthetics he created for the elephants. He also fits two new front legs on a bull named Mr. Cow, giving him the ability to walk.

episodes.title: Love & Elephants, Part Three
episodes.description: Derrick and his wife, Kelly, travel to Thailand to visit Elephant Nature Park. Derrick fits Khun Dej and Mae Mai with improved prothesis, and watches Mae Mai step into her new freedom.

episodes.title: Sister, Sister
episodes.description: In Raleigh, North Carolina, host Derrick Campana helps Kaitlyn surprise her sister Kamryn by creating a full-limb prosthetic for Kamryn’s dog Amiri after he lost his leg in a golf cart accident.

episodes.title: The Karate Dog
episodes.description: Host Derrick Campana travels to California to meet Martin and Jesse Kove, stars of the “Cobra Kai” franchise, and help create a prosthetic limb for their 3-legged dog, Bubba.

episodes.title: Saving Amelia
episodes.description: Derrick travels to an animal sanctuary in Renton, Washington to build a brace for Amelia, a cow born with leg deformities. Derrick hopes that building Amelia a prosthetic leg will lengthen her life.

episodes.title: Two Peas in a Pod
episodes.description: Derrick travels to Ontario, Canada to meet best friends Winnie, a two-year-old dog, and Chip, a six-month-old sheep. Derrick builds them both a custom cart that will allow them to explore the farm together.

episodes.title: This Little Piggy Wants Wheels
episodes.description: In Deltona, Florida, Derrick brings hope to a mother and daughter as he crafts a custom cart for their potbelly pig named Valentine.

episodes.title: Super Cow
episodes.description: In Austin, Texas, Derrick faces his greatest challenge yet as he creates a custom lift to offer quadriplegic cow Champion a new sense of mobility.

episodes.title: Ready, Set, Hanabi!
episodes.description: Host Derrick Campana travels to Louisville, Kentucky to create prosthetic legs for Hanabi, a pit bull terrier born without front paws.

episodes.title: Story's Magic Leg
episodes.description: Derrick Travels to California to meet Story, a puppy found with a missing paw. her tender stump makes walking painful and puts pressure on her other limbs. Derrick hopes that a custom prosthetic will give her story a happy ending.

episodes.title: Boundless Birdie
episodes.description: Derrick revisits Chicago, Illinois to meet a 10-year old dog named Birdie, who has never walked with four legs. He's challenged with building a full limb prosthesis that Birdie will accept and use to prevent further injury to her front leg.

episodes.title: Derrick versus LA (Part 1)
episodes.description: Derrick travels to LA to host a pop-up workshop for animals in need. This proves to be one of the biggest challenges yet in Derrick's career as he builds more prosthetics in three days than he ever has before.

episodes.title: Derrick versus LA (Part 2)
episodes.description: Derrick races to finish building 13 unique devices in three days at his pop-up workshop in LA, leading to the single biggest night of his career at The Frida Project fundraiser where each dog he helped walks down the red carpet.

episodes.title: Tails
episodes.description: Host Derrick Campana lights the world by donating his time at an animal rescue shelter.

episodes.title: The Happiest Fox
episodes.description: At the Juniper Wildlife Refuge, Derrick helps Jessika Coker's fantastic fox named Fig. This internet-famous fox was born with a deformed leg, and his good leg has collapsed. If Fig doesn't get help soon, he'll become immobile.

episodes.title: Ollie, Ollie, Running free!
episodes.description: Derrick helps a family who struggled during COVID. The family's corgi, Ollie, was born with a deformed limb. Before building the young dog's prosthetic, Derrick has a special surprise for Ollie that involves getting wet.

episodes.title: Agatha, the G.O.A.T. Goat
episodes.description: Derrick meets his match with Agatha, a sassy two-legged goat. He builds Agatha a custom cart to take her from a handstand position back to something more comfortable. Derrick also helps a three legged cow named Mateo from Broken Shovels Farm Sanctuar

episodes.title: Ivy the Miracle Cow
episodes.description: Derrick helps Ivy, a miniature cow who was born with limb deformities in her front legs. Derrick builds two devices for Ivy: a brace and a lift. Both will hopefully help level out Ivy's shoulders and improve her mobility around the pasture.

episodes.title: Layka, An American Hero
episodes.description: Layka, the first dog to receive the Purple Heart since WWII, lost her leg while on a mission in Afghanistan. Upon returning to the US she was adopted by her handler, Julian. Now, years later, Derrick arrives to help regain some of Layka's mobility.

episodes.title: Loretta the Miniature Zebu
episodes.description: At the Lazy J Rescue Ranch in Humboldt, Iowa, Derrick helps a miniature zebu cow named Loretta regain mobility after an accident caused permanent damage to one of her front legs. Derrick also builds a prosthetic for a Doberman Pinscher named Holly.

episodes.title: Second Chances for Lenny
episodes.description: In New York City, Derrick helps Lenny, an energetic eight year old dog with three legs. Lenny's family, Cassidy and Scott, notice he's not the dog he used to be. Derrick hopes a custom made full limb prosthetic will give Lenny a new lease on life.

episodes.title: A Buddy for Jojo Tidd
episodes.description: Jojo Tidd was born without his left arm, and his Labrador puppy, Buddy, has a similar condition. Derrick builds a prosthetic for Buddy. The Tidds family shares its feelings about Lucky Fin, an organization that celebrates limb differences.

episodes.title: Miracle in Honduras (Part 1)
episodes.description: Derrick is in Honduras to assist Karen, Tonya, and Jimmy in finding homes for 200 dogs before their shelter closes. He works on mobility devices and posts about the animals on social media to help get as many dogs adopted as possible.

episodes.title: Miracle in Honduras (Part 2)
episodes.description: Derrick's family joins him in Honduras, where he is building mobility devices for several dogs, as well as using his social media presence to raise awareness for the 200 special needs animals searching for homes before the shelter closes.

episodes.title: A New Chance
episodes.description: Derrick goes to Kentucky to help Chance, a tripod therapy dog who helps patients at Shriners Hospital for Children. Chance is big and his joints are wearing down. Derrick has to bring all his skills to bear to keep Chance in good form for the future.

episodes.title: Scooter & Bella
episodes.description: Derrick visits Aimee’s Animal Sanctuary to help two disabled goats—Scooter, born paralyzed, and Bella, missing a leg. With help from Aimee and volunteer Collette, he hopes to get them out playing & grazing with the herd, finally free to roam together

episodes.title: Buddy the Chihuahua
episodes.description: Derrick visits Minnesota to help Buddy, a thirteen-year-old tripod Chihuahua. Buddy's parents are first responders who depend on his unconditional love to help them manage stress. Buddy's lost a leg, and they're hoping Derrick can help.

episodes.title: Saint Goes Marching In
episodes.description: Derrick travels to Houston to help Sydney with her dog, Saint, a red toy poodle missing a back paw. While there, he meets Sydney’s cousin Tracey, who has a dog named Joy. Joy has a partial front paw, and Derrick steps in to assist both dogs.

episodes.title: Loni's Leg Up
episodes.description: Derrick travels to PA, to Indraloka Sanctuary to meet Loni, a three-legged lamb who needs urgent help. As Loni grows, he risks losing mobility. Derrick steps in to help give Loni the freedom he needs and support the sanctuary’s mission of compassion.

episodes.title: Pop-Up in Sydney
episodes.description: Derrick is in Sydney, Australia to team up with Dr. Rhys Donovan, an osteopath, to create as many custom devices for the local population as he can.  He feels the pressure, working at break neck speed to get these animals the help they need.

episodes.title: Buster's New Kicks
episodes.description: On Derrick's final stop in Australia he pays a visit to an emu named Buster. Buster was rescued by Josh, Amber and their daughter Ashlee after his feet were burnt in a fire. Derrick's excited to build his first ever pair of emu shoes.

episodes.title: Atticus Finch's New Leg
episodes.description: Derrick travels to Australia’s outback to help a calf named Atticus and a lamb named Colette. For sanctuary owners Richard and Kym, these prosthetics are a way to give back to the animals that helped them through the 2019 bushfires.

episodes.title: The Wizard of Claws
episodes.description: Derrick travels to Bangalore, India, to help Vasi, a three-legged wild sloth bear that was rescued by a wildlife organization. They hope that Derrick can improve Vasi's quality of life, but this will be Derrick's first time working on a wild bear.

episodes.title: Frodo of the Backwater
episodes.description: In the season finale, Derrick is in India to help Frodo, a horse who lost the use of one leg. Rescued by Zoha at the Backwater Animal Sanctuary, Frodo now faces a critical moment— without a new prosthetic, he may become completely immobile.

9eede91d-2479-41e1-be2e-61c5f469fd95.description: Prominent Latter-day Saints share truths, testimonies, and life-changing experiences.

episodes.title: Carmen Rasmusen Herbert
episodes.description: 2003 American Idol contestant, Carmen Rasmusen Herbet shares how she rose to fame and how it impacted her life in relation to her family and the gospel.

episodes.title: Ed Sexton
episodes.description: Ed Sexton tells the story of why he became a dean at BYU Idaho and how the calling of an Area Seventy and a mission president shaped him as a person.

episodes.title: Meg Johnson
episodes.description: Meg Johnson is a quadriplegic motivational speaker. After a hiking accident, Meg looks for the tender mercies and how she can make her paralysis a happy trial.

episodes.title: Joel Bishop
episodes.description: Jacob from the Book of Mormon videos, better known as Joel Bishop, starts a new business called Rise To Your Challenge, encouraging and teaching others to overcome trials.

episodes.title: David Christensen
episodes.description: Author of Inner Victory, David A. Christensen came out of retirement to create a small business program the support service in Central America. He reflects on his early life and how it influenced his decisions.

episodes.title: Trina Boice
episodes.description: Podcaster, author, and movie reviewer, Trina Boice shares how stories have opened her up to many communities and opportunities to come closer to her family.

episodes.title: Sharla Goettl
episodes.description: Stake Young Women’s President, Sharla Goettl wrote a book called A Spiritual Resilience: Leading Our Youth to Go and Do to help parents set good examples for their youth.

episodes.title: Charlie Bird
episodes.description: Charlie Bird was the man behind the mask in the viral Cosmo videos and now is sharing the journey of sharing his sexual orientation in his new book Without the Mask: Coming Out and Coming Into God’s Light.

episodes.title: Keoni Kauwe
episodes.description: President of BYU-Hawaii, Keoni Kauwe discusses his research on Alheimer’s disease and how the church educational system has shaped his life as a college student and now an influential leader.

episodes.title: Neil and Corrine Stokoe
episodes.description: Neil and Corinne Stoko share the challenges and growth of battling pornography and the process of Corinne building her business Mint Arrow, sharing deals and blogging.

episodes.title: Tiffany Peterson
episodes.description: Tiffany Peterson talks about how God is her partner in her professional presenting business and in all of her sales relationships.

episodes.title: Jeff Wheeler
episodes.description: Jeff Wheeler shares how his younger years inspired his adult life of writing fantasy books and joining the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints.

episodes.title: Alan Reed
episodes.description: Alan Reed discusses how he grew into the family business, Reed’s Dairy, and how the experiences of working on a farm and in dairy production have blessed his life.

episodes.title: Janielle Christensen
episodes.description: Janielle Christensen shares the light of Christ through directing theater productions like BYU’s Living Legends and Young Ambassadors.

episodes.title: Randy Collier
episodes.description: Randy Collier shares how he found the church after falling off a building and what led him to do photography for the church.

episodes.title: Mark Kohler
episodes.description: Mark Kohler is a lawyer who focuses on helping small businesses and sharing how anyone can achieve the American Dream through his podcast, books, and YouTube channel.

episodes.title: Paul Wuthrich
episodes.description: Paul Wuthrich discusses his acting journey and the impact of religious roles like Joseph Smith in the 2021 film Witnesses.

episodes.title: Keith Erekson
episodes.description: Keith Erekson talks about the journey to becoming the director of the Church History Library and how to see from the eyes of a historian.

episodes.title: Alex & Julie Boye
episodes.description: Alex and Julie Boye share the challenges of growing a family with a traveling profession and the strength of motherhood through social media.

episodes.title: Emily Ann Adams
episodes.description: Emily Ann Adams lost a child, but she decided to channel her grief to highlight the universal suffering of all women and the hope behind it in her book There’s No Other Way?.

episodes.title: Steve Shallenberger
episodes.description: Steve Shallenberger shares the top three high performance habits and how to develop them to achieve success in both the business world and daily life.

episodes.title: John Gonzales
episodes.description: Retired CIA Officer John Gonzales shares how serving a mission in Mexico shaped his career and family life.

episodes.title: Johnny Hanna
episodes.description: Founder of Homie and Entrata, Jonny Hanna shares how he builds his startup businesses and family through values and relationships.

episodes.title: Jon and Bonnie Jeppson
episodes.description: Jon and Bonnie Jeppson host a podcast that shares their faith in their trials, such as kidney cancer, child loss, and a missing family member.

episodes.title: Morgan Jones
episodes.description: Morgan Jones shares the team effort that went into creating the All In Podcast and what it means to give your all to God.

episodes.title: Derral Eves
episodes.description: Derral Eves discusses his beginnings in YouTube marketing, working with Mr. Best and The Piano Guys, and now producing The Chosen.

episodes.title: Brigitte Madrian
episodes.description: Brigitte Madrian shares her journey to become the Dean at BYU’s Marriott School of Business and the sacrifices she made for her family.

episodes.title: Kate Lee
episodes.description: Kate Lee is a Deseret Book artist who struggled to overcome her self doubt and insecurities before finding success with art and a relationship with God.

episodes.title: Kirby Heyborne
episodes.description: Kirby Heyborne shares his journey as a LDS actor, audiobook recorder, and host of the service show Making Good.

episodes.title: Kathy Aiken
episodes.description: Kathy Aiken discusses how she opened doors for women in the sports reporting industry while also balancing a family.

episodes.title: Kate Holbrook
episodes.description: Managing Historian, Kate Holbrook shares the light of LDS women by researching their contribution to church history.

episodes.title: Christian Mawlam
episodes.description: Christian Mawlam is an immigrant from the UK who has overcome colon cancer and cultural differences to serve students at BYU Idaho in the communications department.

episodes.title: Grant and Si Foster
episodes.description: Grant and Si Foster spent the COVID pandemic quarantined as senior missionaries in Barcelona, Spain, but they still focused on sharing the gospel through missionary work and Si’s blog, A Bountiful Kitchen.

episodes.title: Kerry Muhlestein
episodes.description: Kerry Muhlestein is a professor in ancient scripture who desires to help more saints understand and love the Old Testament.

episodes.title: Truman Brothers
episodes.description: The Truman Brothers are advocating for more faith experience songs in Christian Pop and Rock music while balancing family and a flourishing music career.

episodes.title: Reid Moon
episodes.description: Reid Moon cherishes history by collecting early copies of the Book of Mormon, the original The Hobbit, and other rare books.

episodes.title: Dave McCann
episodes.description: Dave McCann started his sports announcing career with an early start, reporting for the Indy 500 and being the first ABC college reporter.

episodes.title: David Reichner
episodes.description: David Reichner is a professional basketball coach who leads the Tampa Bay Titans and always maintains a focus on serving Christ through others.

episodes.title: Clint Pulver
episodes.description: Clint Pulver combines motivational speaking and professional drumming to help workplaces become more Christlike.

episodes.title: Jason F. Wright
episodes.description: Author of Christmas Jars and Wednesday Letters, Jason F. Wright explains how validation can create the biggest impact.

episodes.title: Lisa Valentine Clark
episodes.description: Actress, radio show host, and sister of celebrities, Lisa Valentine Clark shares her experiences getting into the theater world, publishing a book, and the supportive nature of her relationship with her husband Chris who passed away from ALS disease.

episodes.title: Erin Willder
episodes.description: Erin Willder, a communications manager at BYU Continuing Education and founding member of LDS Publishing Media and the Arts, felt called to Utah. She supports EFY, FSY, and Online High School programs, helping members align career goals with faith.

episodes.title: David Weidman
episodes.description: David Weidman, managing director in the Church’s missionary department, reflects on how his mission in Japan shaped his life, influencing both his professional path and his service—including his current role and his calling as a mission president.

episodes.title: Taylor Ricks
episodes.description: Author, mother, and Utah Down Syndrome Foundation volunteer Taylor Ricks discovered a life of service—at home and in the workplace—through studying human psychology and partnering with God to write Everyday Disciples.

episodes.title: Tamara Uzelac Hall
episodes.description: Tamara found love for her seminary and institute career even after a trial of faith nearly led her to leave the Church. Now a mom, wife, author, podcaster, and Hebrew fan, she shares her passion for scripture and the powerful lessons it taught her.

episodes.title: Adam Sidwell
episodes.description: Transformers, I, Robot, and Pirates of the Caribbean are just a few of the blockbuster films Adam Sidwell has worked on. He got his start in BYU’s early animation program and now leads Future House Studios and wrote his own adventure series.

episodes.title: Kurt Francom
episodes.description: Driven by his passion for church leadership, Kurt Francom found success in his professional field by offering leadership training—particularly in church settings. He shares his insights on becoming a better leader through his podcast, Leading Saints.

episodes.title: Rob Eaton
episodes.description: Rob Eaton divides his time between academic and administrative roles at BYU-Idaho, seeking opportunities to represent student voices and raise awareness about the impact of mental health challenges.

episodes.title: Bill Elliott
episodes.description: Bill Elliott is Media Director for The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints where he works developing inspirational media content, documentaries, and short film series.

episodes.title: Brock Blake
episodes.description: Brock Blake is the CEO and co-founder of Lendio, the nation’s leading small business finance solutions provider.

episodes.title: Jen Allen
episodes.description: Jen Allen is a hometown girl who grew up in West Jordan, Utah and is Director of Events at FamilySearch.

episodes.title: Ganel-Lyn Condie & John Fossum
episodes.description: Ganel-Lyn Condie and John Fossum are the hosts of Talk of Him podcast.

episodes.title: Courtney Rich
episodes.description:
Courtney Rich is a baker and cake maker whose culinary masterpieces have garnered her
180,000 Instagram followers under the cakebycourtney account.

episodes.title: Brooke Romney
episodes.description: Brooke Romney is a writer, speaker, and educator. She has been published in The Washington Post, The Deseret News, Scary Mommy, and a host of other online publications.

episodes.title: Maria Eckersley
episodes.description: Maria Eckersley is a stay-at-home mom of six by day and a sleep-deprived graphic designer by night.

episodes.title: The Eaton Family
episodes.description: Emmy Eaton is a thriving journalist at age 9.

episodes.title: Ed & Wanda Willis
episodes.description: In between poverty, jail time, drug addiction, unemployment, the struggles of racism, and family strife, Ed Willis experienced brief flashes when the light of Christ touched his heart and inspired him to learn more about his Savior.

episodes.title: Roger & Brad Wilcox
episodes.description: Brothers Brad Wilcox and Roger Wilcox worked together on the book, “Blessed Are Ye: Using the Beatitudes to Understand Christ's Atonement and Grace."

episodes.title: Marshall & Michelle Moore
episodes.description: Marshall and Michelle Moore are the owners and co-directors of Zions Indie Film Fest in 2021, formerly the LDS Film Festival. With 45 years of combined film industry experience, they are extremely passionate about connecting filmmakers and audiences.

episodes.title: Dan Davis
episodes.description: Focused on inspiring people to discover their divine potential, Stiry--founded by Dan Davis--produces films about regular people doing extraordinary things for network tv, digital streaming services, and web-based video platforms.

episodes.title: Jennifer Nielsen
episodes.description: Jennifer A. Nielsen is the New York Times and USA Today bestselling author of more than 15 books for young readers; many have been published in 21 languages, two have been optioned for film, and several have been the recipients of multiple awards.

episodes.title: John Pearce
episodes.description: John Pearce and Eric Engebretsen, co-founders of Bloom, have a mission to improve people’s standard by creating 10,000 jobs abroad while providing easy access to diverse and qualified candidate for US businesses.

episodes.title: Daniel & Kathryn Blomberg
episodes.description: Daniel and Kathryn Blomberg are the co-founders of Blomberg Music Productions, a full-service music production company helping Christian musicians reach their potential.

episodes.title: Jenifer Greenwood
episodes.description: Jenifer Greenwood has worked for The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints for 27 years—writing, editing, strategizing, and, most important, listening, learning, and being grateful to see closeup the building up of the kingdom of God.

episodes.title: Chad Lewis
episodes.description: Chad Lewis played football for BYU and professionally for the Philadelphia Eagles, however an injury prevented him from continuing. Despite this he pressed on and became a BYU Athletic Director.

episodes.title: Cydni Rogers Tetro
episodes.description: Cydni Tetro, CEO of Brandless, is an innovator of experience, a growth leader, technologist, STEM advocate, author, and speaker. Cydni recently raised $118M, the largest fundraiser led by a woman in Silicon Slopes.

episodes.title: Steven Sharp Nelson
episodes.description: Steven Sharp Nelson is widely considered one of the most watched musicians in the world and a pioneer of “classicool music”

episodes.title: Amanda Taylor
episodes.description: Amanda Taylor is a lover of all things story, whether it be books, movies, theater - musical and otherwise - art, music, or people. She earned her bachelor's degree in English literature from the University of Utah, which only fueled her passion for

episodes.title: Levi Heperi
episodes.description: Levi Heperi is the director of intercultural strategy at Deseret Book, where he oversees the company’s DEI initiatives and develops the strategy to take Deseret Book to international markets.

episodes.title: Dana LeCheminant
episodes.description: Dana Lecheminant has been telling stories since she was old enough to know what stories were. After spending most of her childhood reading everything she could get her hands on, she began to write and tell her own stories.

episodes.title: Julie Rose
episodes.description: Julie Rose is a broadcast journalist, interviewer, and radio show host. She hosts “Top of Mind” on BYUradio. Her show features “smart, informative conversations and interviews that go beyond mere headlines and sound bites.”

episodes.title: Jade Koyle
episodes.description: Jade Koyle is President at Grand Teton Ancient Grains, a family-owned and operated farm, and mill committed to restoring ancient grains to the family dinner table.

episodes.title: President Kevin D. & Sister Sonja Staples
episodes.description: After facing various challenges and delays, Kevin and Sonja Staples have embarked on a unique journey to become mission leaders in the Utah St. George Mission for The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.

episodes.title: Jon Judkins
episodes.description: Utah Tech men’s basketball head coach Jon Judkins is the all-time winningest collegiate coach in the state of Utah.

episodes.title: Aubrey Grossen
episodes.description: Aubrey Grossen is the founder of ANYA (A New You Again) where she hosts conferences, events, retreats, memberships, and more to help moms with their mental health journey.

episodes.title: Eric O. Leavitt
episodes.description: Eric O. Leavitt, the Executive Chairman and CEO of Leavitt Group, a national insurance brokerage, has been named one of this year's distinguished honorees for the Utah Business CEO of the Year award.

episodes.title: Jordan Rushton
episodes.description: Jordan Rushton was selected as the third president of Dixie Technical College by the Utah Board of Higher Education on September 15, 2022, following his role as interim president since April 2022 and years of dedicated service since 2015.

episodes.title: Waldo Galan
episodes.description: Waldo Galan is the accomplished President of Waldo D. Galan and Associates, Inc. With extensive experience as an International Automotive Consultant.

episodes.title: Rex Davis
episodes.description: Rex Davis is Vice President at Educational Tours which provides custom group travel for preformed groups.

episodes.title: Geoff Steurer
episodes.description: Geoff Steurer is a licensed marriage and family therapist, relationship educator, and coach.

episodes.title: Alvin F. Meredith III & Jennifer Meredith (part 1)
episodes.description: Alvin F. Meredith III became the 18th president of Brigham Young University-Idaho on August 1, 2023. He was sustained as a General Authority Seventy on April 3, 2021, and continues to serve in that role today.

episodes.title: Alvin F. Meredith III & Jennifer Meredith (part 2)
episodes.description: Alvin F. Meredith III became the 18th president of Brigham Young University-Idaho on August 1, 2023. He was sustained as a General Authority Seventy on April 3, 2021, and continues to serve in that role today.

episodes.title: Will Pierce
episodes.description: After serving 8 years in the United States Marine Corps, Dr. Pierce began a career in the electrical industry. He owned a successful contracting business before transitioning into higher education.

episodes.title: Lili De Hoyos Anderson
episodes.description: Dr. Lili De Hoyos Anderson is a first-generation American.  Her mother is French, and her father is Mexican. Dr. Anderson attended BYU and graduated in Sociology.

episodes.title: Skyler Halford
episodes.description: Skyler Halford is a former BYU Basketball player who has become an expert basketball trainer and Doctor of Physical Therapy. Skylar shares his journey from a walk-on at Utah State, to a starter for BYU to his decision to forgo pro basketball.

episodes.title: Gale Sears
episodes.description: Gale Sears is the author of the bestselling The Silence of God, Letters in the Jade Dragon Box, Belonging to Heaven, and several other novels, including The Route, Christmas for a Dollar, Autumn Sky, Until the Dawn, and Upon the Mountains.

episodes.title: Jack R. Christianson
episodes.description: As a highly sought-after inspirational speaker and author, Dr. Jack R. Christianson has lectured and given seminars to organizations of all ages and types across the United States and Canada.

episodes.title: Jenalee Marshall
episodes.description: Jenalee Marshall is a seasoned graphic designer with a rich tapestry of experience. Her journey in the design world has taken her from her hometown in Utah to the picturesque landscapes of Italy, shaping her into the well-rounded person she is today.

episodes.title: Hal Boyd
episodes.description: Hal Boyd is editor of the Deseret News. He was an associate professor of Brigham Young University’s School of Family Life and previously worked as the opinion editor and enterprise reporter for the Deseret News.

episodes.title: Serena & David Essuman
episodes.description: David and Serena Essuman are entrepreneurs and social media influencers. David is an entrepreneur/investor and mentor who works in real estate investments, franchising, and e-commerce. Serena was born in Italy and moved to the Canary Islands.

episodes.title: T.C. Christensen
episodes.description: Cinematographer, film director, and writer, T.C. Christensen is best known for his work on IMAX films and true historical movies, including Escape from Germany, 17 Miracles, Ephraim's Rescue, The Fighting Preacher, and The Cokeville Miracle.

episodes.title: Ryan & Heather Munns
episodes.description: Ryan & Heather A. Munns serve as mission leaders in the France Paris Mission.

episodes.title: Cassandra Piket
episodes.description: Cassandra Piket is a remarkable interior designer whose life journey is a testament to resilience, faith, and dedication.

episodes.title: Christian Euvrard
episodes.description: Christian Euvrard is a former Director of the Paris Institute of Religion. He writes and edits biographies and books in French.

episodes.title: Will & Hannah Vincenzi
episodes.description: After meeting on their missions in France, Will and Hannah Vincenzi have dedicated their lives to faith and learning.

episodes.title: Frédéric Loisel
episodes.description: After 8 months of learning and personal transformation, including quitting smoking and drinking, Frédéric Loisel—a cellist—was baptized in August 1993. Through his work, Loisel reflects is passion for music on a daily basis.

episodes.title: Eves Otto
episodes.description: A dedicated member of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, Eves finds profound joy and guidance in the Gospel, which has significantly shaped her life and daily decisions.

episodes.title: Jean-Claude Vanaquer
episodes.description: Jean-Claude Vanaquer is a dedicated and dynamic individual, currently serving as the Institute Director for the Paris Institute. His commitment to teaching and mentoring young adults has been a cornerstone of his work.

episodes.title: Luana Frietas
episodes.description: Luana Freitas, originally from Macaé, Brazil, has a dynamic and culturally rich background. Growing up in the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints with her family, she shares a unique bond with her two 16-year-old adopted sisters.

episodes.title: Serge and Isabelle Gaston
episodes.description: Together, Serge and Isabelle embody a life of service, faith, and dedication. They have raised their children with the same values they cherish, finding joy and fulfillment in their roles as parents and grandparents.

episodes.title: Porter Ellett
episodes.description: Kansas City Chiefs Assistant Coach Porter Ellett shares how his wife Carly's support has helped him through his journey, the relationships he's built, and how he continues to strengthen the Church despite the long and demanding hours of coaching.

episodes.title: Chelsy Walker
episodes.description: Multi-media artist Chelsy Walker shares how, as a young mom, she discovered that motherhood and art could thrive together. She found her calling in nurturing healing, growth, and creativity—blending her roles into one meaningful purpose.

episodes.title: Jeremiah Morgan
episodes.description: Jeremiah Morgan, Missouri Attorney General and Seventy, converted to the Church at 16. He attended BYU Law, met his wife, and built a legal career—playing a key role in the approval and construction of the Kansas City Missouri Temple.

episodes.title: Lexi Rydalch
episodes.description: Lexi Rydalch, former All-American BYU basketball star, opens up about the difficult decision she faced—whether to chase a pro career in the WBA or follow her lifelong dream of becoming a mom and raising a family.

episodes.title: Pete Grigsby
episodes.description: From high school hoops to weather maps — former ABC meteorologist Pete Grigsby discovered his passion for science and broadcasting early on, but it was during a mission in Utah that he truly found his calling in weather reporting.

episodes.title: Lauren Felker
episodes.description: High school junior Lauren Felker finds balance between her demanding broadcasting and medical classes by attending early morning seminary—and cherishes the chance to represent her faith in her home state of Missouri.

episodes.title: Jonathan Cutler
episodes.description: Jonathan Cutler shares how his faith and work in therapeutic horseback riding have shaped his journey—building deep connections with veterans and individuals with special needs, and revealing how every step in life prepares us for the next.

episodes.title: Cindy McDavitt
episodes.description: Cindy McDavitt, a member of the Kansas City Interfaith Council, is passionate about connecting civic and religious leaders. She frequently collaborates with church leaders on local initiatives, including the Light the World Campaign.

episodes.title: Shane Smeed
episodes.description: Shane Smeed, the President of Park University in Missouri, shares his passion on how education connects people to love of God. He shares his love for young adults, and how he and his wife have been able to serve a lot in many different respects.

episodes.title: Jenet Erickson
