episodes.description: Dr. Jenet Jacob Erickson, a leading voice on motherhood and family, shares how her faith and research intersect. From BYU to national platforms, she offers heartfelt insights on why strong families shape lives—and why that work is sacred.

episodes.title: Charlene Farr & Wanda Mattox
episodes.description: Charlene Farr turned trials into testimony. At 87, she shares how a message of faith changed her life and inspired a legacy of service, storytelling, and connection across generations.

episodes.title: Kim Clark
episodes.description: Elder Kim B. Clark reflects on his path from Harvard to BYU–Idaho to Church leadership. His story highlights the power of faith, learning, and discipleship to transform lives.

episodes.title: Emily Peterson
episodes.description: Emily Peterson built Saranoni from love, grief, and hope. After her husband’s passing, she carried on their mission—bringing comfort to families worldwide through compassion and service.

episodes.title: BJ Allen
episodes.description: Dr. BJ Allen, marketing professor at Brigham Young University, and author of "The Compensating Power of Christ," discusses the power of Christ's Atonement to transform our human limits into divine possibilities.

episodes.title: John Fossum
episodes.description: John Fossum shares how Christ became his foundation through life’s challenges. His message of hope, drawn from personal experience and his book Spiritual Foundations, invites all to deepen their faith in uncertain times.

episodes.title: Shawn Stevens
episodes.description: Shawn Stevens left the spotlight to follow Christ. From TV fame to faith-driven sacrifice, his journey reveals how true peace comes from living with purpose—even when it means walking away from Hollywood.

episodes.title: Tom & Ali Durham
episodes.description: Tom and Ali Durham bring faith, family, and sci-fi together. The creative couple behind 95ers shares how their love of storytelling inspires uplifting projects—and a joy-filled life.

episodes.title: Hank Smith
episodes.description: Hank Smith, BYU professor, author, and co-founder of the Come, Follow Him podcast, shares how his journey led him to teaching, faith-filled storytelling, and a platform helping others engage more deeply with the scriptures.

episodes.title: Bruce Kusch
episodes.description: President Bruce C. Kusch reflects on nine years leading Ensign College and its transition from LDS Business College. He shares the story behind the name change, the school’s mission, and what it’s like directing a faith-centered college.

episodes.title: John Dye
episodes.description: John Dye works for Bonneville Distribution in premoting faith based material. With his skills in media, he is best known for his marketing and production talents. John is also known for speaking at faith based events about the ever growing media.

episodes.title: Lee Cummard
episodes.description: Lee Cummard, BYU women’s basketball head coach and former BYU player, shares his journey from being the sibling recruited to play college sports to competing professionally abroad, and how his education shaped his path to coaching women’s basketball.

episodes.title: Jonathan Wing
episodes.description: Jonathan Wing, a coordinator at FamilySearch, discusses his experiences with school and work, and reflects on growing up navigating multiple cultures.

episodes.title: Rod Gustafson
episodes.description: Rod Gustafson grew up in a family that loved television, sparking a passion that led him into broadcasting and movie rating, and eventually to the Church of Jesus Christ. He now works as a producer for BYUtv.

episodes.title: Roger Connors
episodes.description: Roger Connors, co-author of four New York Times and Wall Street Journal bestselling books on workplace accountability and culture change, and CEO of Human Performance Technologies, shares how joining the Church young shaped his path into leadership.

episodes.title: Devin Durrant
episodes.description: Devin Durrant shares his journey from the NBA to international basketball, real estate, serving as Texas Dallas Mission president, and the Sunday School General Presidency—reflecting on faith, leadership, and purpose along the way.

episodes.title: John Lewis
episodes.description: Join us as John Lewis discusses his journey from Mayor of Gilbert to Mission President in Cambodia. Now an Area Seventy, John shares insights on leadership, the explosive growth of the Church in Arizona, and the "Plan of Happiness" in Southeast Asia.

episodes.title: Cali Black
episodes.description: Join us as Cali Black discusses her journey from BYU educator to the creator of @ComeFollowMeStudy. Learn how her "One Minute Scripture Study" series and approachable teaching style are helping a new generation deeply root themselves in the Gospel.

episodes.title: Marc Lefevre
episodes.description: Join us for a conversation with Marc LeFevre, President of Outplacement Services at Careers Launch. Marc discusses the changing landscape of work, the power of professional branding, and how he uses his expertise to help people find new purpose.

episodes.title: Matt Riggs
episodes.description: Elder Matthew Riggs is an attorney who has shaped Arizona law and served as a Mission President, he shares how the Lord guided his career from driving a delivery truck to leading a major law firm and serving as an Area Seventy.

episodes.title: Jennifer Fenn
episodes.description: Join us as Arizona native Jennifer Fenn shares her experience serving as a missionary and coordinating FamilySearch at the Mesa Arizona Temple, offering a glimpse into the spirit and service visitors experience there.

episodes.title: Ryan Bingham
episodes.description: Ryan Bingham shares how lessons learned on the farm and during his mission in Chile helped shape his path in leadership, education, and business. Now a vice president at Honeywell, he reflects on his career journey through BYU–Idaho, BYU, and beyond.

episodes.title: Candice Copple
episodes.description: Candice Copple shares her journey from accounting to seminary education, local government, and public service, and how earning an MPA and President Nelson’s call to be a peacemaker shaped her leadership.

episodes.title: T.J. Packard
episodes.description: TJ Packard, CPA and partner at Packard, Appleby & Rogers P.C., shares how his upbringing in Arizona, years at BYU–Idaho, and mission in Brazil shaped his faith, career, and the relationships that helped lead him to where he is today.

episodes.title: Royce Bybee
episodes.description: Former BYU and Rick's College quarterback Royce Bybee shares the story of his conversion to the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints and his current calling as Director of the Mesa Temple Visitors' Center in Arizona.

episodes.title: Jordan Abrams
episodes.description: Jordan Abrams shares his story growing up in the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints in Idaho. Inspired by his family, he pursued this path and became an institute director for BYU Pathways in the southwest area.

episodes.title: Shima Baradaran Baughman
episodes.description: BYU Law professor Shima Baughman shares how her faith in Jesus Christ fuels her passion for criminal justice reform.

episodes.title: Ben Kjar
episodes.description: World Champion wrestler Ben Kjar describes the role of faith and resilience in his journey with Crouzon Syndrome.

episodes.title: Tanner Christensen
episodes.description: Director/Editor Tanner Christensen discusses the importance of faith in the film industry, and how he creates stories that testify of Christ.

episodes.title: Mary Richards
episodes.description: Church News reporter Mary Richards describes how she relies on the Savior to balance a career in journalism with raising five children.

episodes.title: Craig Manning
episodes.description: Sports psychologist and former D1 tennis coach Dr. Craig Manning describes how he elevates his faith through the same principles he teaches to high performance athletes.

episodes.title: Heather Nemelka
episodes.description: Heather Nemelka, CEO and founder of Elevare, discusses how faith in Christ allows women to embrace their full potential, even through family tragedy and career upheaval.

c2022552-b6b7-4763-91d5-493926290c5d.description: Comedian-musician Kirby Heyborne travels across the USA to volunteer anywhere, any way he can.

episodes.title: Old Skool Cafe
episodes.description: Kirby travels to San Francisco to join a restaurant run entirely by at-risk youth. From cooking and serving to entertaining, Kirby learns how to put together the perfect dinner, and how working at the cafe has changed many kids’ lives for the better.

episodes.title: Operation BBQ Relief
episodes.description: In the wake of Hurricane Florence, Kirby travels to Wilmington, North Carolina to join a team of BBQ pitmasters delivering hot meals to victims. Kirby helps prepare and deliver meals, and gets a firsthand look at the devastation.

episodes.title: Home Works of America
episodes.description: In South Carolina, Kirby helps a charity that rebuilds homes in disrepair. After gathering materials and packing the trailer full of gear, Kirby joins a team of volunteers to clear weeds, fill holes in the floor, and reconstruct a broken roof.

episodes.title: Muttville
episodes.description: In San Francisco, Kirby joins a group of dog-lovers that help senior dogs find new homes. Kirby learns that the world of senior pet care is sometimes messy. After falling in love with a pup named Sierra, Kirby works hard to find her a loving owner.

episodes.title: Reach 4 the Stars
episodes.description: In Palm Springs, Kirby joins an organization that flies a wheelchair accessible hot air balloon. Kirby learns how much hard work goes into inflating, flying, and packing up the balloon, and how lives can be changed with a ride in the sky.

episodes.title: Free Bikes 4 Kidz
episodes.description: In Madison, WI, Kirby joins a group giving free bikes to disadvantaged kids. While loading up a delivery of donated bikes, Kirby finds a special bike to give away. After a whole day of repair, Kirby’s ready to find the perfect match for his bike.

episodes.title: Veterans Oceans Adventures
episodes.description: Kirby travels to Miami to join a group giving veterans access to the ocean. Kirby gets his feet wet learning to be a buddy diver for disabled divers, joins the crew for an ocean dive, and learns how diving can be a healing experience for veterans.

episodes.title: Loving Thunder
episodes.description: Kirby travels to Albuquerque, New Mexico, and joins a therapeutic riding ranch. While Kirby has always loved horses, he learns quickly that it takes a lot of work to keep a riding ranch going. Kirby then gets a chance to work with some riders.

episodes.title: Raising Men Lawn Care Service
episodes.description: In Sanford, Florida, Kirby joins a nationwide group of kids mowing lawns for the elderly, people with disabilities, veterans, and single mothers. Kirby decides to take on the “50 Yard Challenge”, though he only has 3 days to do it.

episodes.title: Christmas Special
episodes.description: Kirby goes to the Utah State Prison to conduct an inmate orchestra as part of an inmate music school. With the help of a hardworking program leader and a personal hero, Kirby helps the band prepare a Christmas medley for the holiday recital.

episodes.title: The Bloc
episodes.description: In Chicago, Kirby joins The Bloc, a boxing club and mentor service. Kirby, training to be a coach, learns that through the discipline of boxing, the Bloc helps kids get their schoolwork as strong as their punches.

episodes.title: Island Dolphin Care
episodes.description: Kirby travels to Key Largo, Florida to join Island Dolphin Care, a dolphin therapy organization. After a long day preparing their food and their medicine, Kirby finally gets to meet the dolphins. On the last day, Kirby sees dolphin therapy in action.

episodes.title: Trenton Circus Squad
episodes.description: In Trenton, New Jersey, Kirby’s ready for a day at the circus. But he’s not just there to watch. Kirby works with the kids at the Trenton Circus Squad to prepare his circus skills in time for the final performance.

episodes.title: CoachArt
episodes.description: In Los Angeles, Kirby joins CoachArt, a group matching up kids in medical families with mentors. After trying out a few different mentoring options, Kirby finds just the right kids to mentor. Together, they create a creative surprise for their mom.

episodes.title: Wild West Wildlife
episodes.description: Kirby goes to Amarillo, Texas to join the Wild West Wildlife Rehabilitation Center. Kirby helps clean the badger pens, feed the owls, and give medicine to a vulture. After a hairy encounter with a possum, Kirby releases it back to the wild.

episodes.title: No Limits for Deaf Kids
episodes.description: In Hollywood, Kirby joins No Limits for Deaf Kids, a unique organization helping children with hearing loss and their families. Kirby sees a chance to write a play for the kids to perform at their graduation ceremony.

episodes.title: Cars that Care
episodes.description: In Salt Lake City, Kirby joins Cars that Care, a non-profit that collects donated cars, repairs them, and gives them away to mothers who need transport. Kirby learns how to repair a car, and makes his fair share of mistakes along the way.

episodes.title: GlamourGals
episodes.description: In New York, Kirby joins GlamourGals, a group organizing makeovers by young women for senior women. Kirby tries to throw the most glamourous party he can, organizing decorations and music, as well as learning the intricacies of nail polish.

episodes.title: Icing Smiles
episodes.description: Kirby travels to San Diego to join Icing Smiles, a group making special cakes for medical kids and their families. The plan is for a pretty big cake, so Kirby and the team have to work pretty quick to get it done in time.

episodes.title: Soul
episodes.description: In New Orleans, Kirby joins SOUL, a group replanting trees the city lost in Hurricane Katrina. Kirby learns firsthand what the devastation of Katrina did to New Orlean’s tree population, and how it is still felt years later.

episodes.title: Farm Rescue
episodes.description: In Minot, North Dakota, Kirby helps out a farmer recovering from an illness. He joins Farm Rescue, a group of farmers and agriculture professionals who plant and harvest crops at no cost for farmers who are ill, injured, or unable to work.

episodes.title: Trash Fishing
episodes.description: Kirby goes to Detroit to join Trash Fishing, a group of dedicated boat owners who compete against each other to take the most trash out of the city’s waterways. Kirby pits himself against the other teams to win the coveted “Most Trash” award.

episodes.title: Blind Grilling
episodes.description: Kirby travels to Springfield, Missouri, to join Blind Grilling, an organization that educates and provides accessible grilling kits for people with visual impairments. With a blindfold on, Kirby learns firsthand how hard it is to cook without sight.

episodes.title: Special Kneads
episodes.description: In Lawrenceville, Georgia, Kirby helps a bakery called Special Kneads and Treats with their grand re-opening. Kirby tries his best to keep up in a professional bakery kitchen and works alongside the team to bake enough cupcakes for the re-opening.

episodes.title: Art 4 New York
episodes.description: Kirby joins Art 4 New York, a group making personalized gift baskets for isolated seniors in elderly care and frontline workers. Kirby spends time with artists, photographers, and musicians, all working to make meaningful memories with their gifts.

episodes.title: Dream Adaptive
episodes.description: Kirby travels to Whitefish, Montana to partner with DREAM Adaptive Recreation, an organization which seeks to enhance the quality of life of individuals with disabilities by providing year round outdoor adaptive recreational opportunities.

episodes.title: Blessing Bike
episodes.description: Kirby joins The Blessing Bike in Boise, Idaho to provide access to passenger bikes to families with loved ones experiencing age, health or disability related barriers.

episodes.title: Gardopia Gardens
episodes.description: At Gardopia Gardens, Kirby digs deep into the world of urban gardening, bringing the cultivation of fresh vegetables to low income neighborhoods. Kirby learns about planting, fertilizing, and even faces one of his greatest fears––bees!

episodes.title: Jumping Dreams Double Dutch
episodes.description: Kirby travels to North Carolina to join Jumping Dreams, a nonprofit that uses competitive Double Dutch jump roping to teach kids about fitness, nutrition, and friendship.

episodes.title: Canes for Veterans Central Texas
episodes.description: Kirby heads to Copperas Cove, Texas where he tries his hand at carving Christmas trees into canes for wounded veterans. Despite his fear of power tools, Kirby puts his wood working skills to the test, hustling to finish a cane for a veteran in need.

episodes.title: Hoop.Camp
episodes.description: Kirby goes to Portland, Oregon to join Hoop.Camp, a volunteer-run basketball camp for athletes with developmental disabilities.

episodes.title: Urban Boatbuilders
episodes.description: In Minneapolis, Minnesota, Kirby works with Urban Boatbuilders to make a canoe in time for their graduation. Kirby learns about how the program teaches skills in the woodshop and in life.

episodes.title: The Other Side Academy
episodes.description: In Salt Lake City, Utah, Kirby works with The Other Side Academy, an organization that helps people turn their lives around. He joins the Academy’s moving company, and sees first-hand how a little elbow grease can go a long way.

episodes.title: Sleep in Heavenly Peace
episodes.description: In Lakeville, Minnesota, Kirby volunteers with Sleep in Heavenly Peace, which builds, assembles, and delivers bunk beds to families in need.

episodes.title: Little Wanderers
episodes.description: In New York City, Kirby joins Little Wanderers, an organization that helps sick and injured feral cats. Deep in the Big Apple, Kirby and the team work to find cats in need, get them medical attention, and help them on their way to a better life.

episodes.title: Gaining Ground Book Bus
episodes.description: Kirby heads to Tulsa, Oklahoma, to team up with the Gaining Ground Book Bus, a school bus converted into a free book delivery service. Kirby and a team of educators tour the city and deliver 3,000 books.

episodes.title: Memphis Rox
episodes.description: Kirby heads to Memphis Rox, a climbing and community center in Memphis. As he learns rock climbing, Kirby witnesses how the center is building up the Soulsville community, both on and off the climbing wall.

episodes.title: The Welcome to America Project
episodes.description: Kirby joins The Welcome to America Project, an organization dedicated to helping refugees thrive. As Kirby tracks down and delivers basic household items needed by the newly arrived families, he experiences what it really means to be a good neighbor.

episodes.title: Warfighter Made
episodes.description: Kirby travels to Temecula, California, to work with Warfighter Made, a nonprofit dedicated to putting wounded veterans behind the wheels of off-road vehicles to provide "adrenaline therapy".

episodes.title: The Roots of Music
episodes.description: Kirby joins The Roots of Music, a nonprofit empowering youth through music education, academic support, and mentorship. Kirby earns a spot in the Marching Crusaders, the organization's youth marching band, and prepares for his first big parade.

episodes.title: San Diego Chill
episodes.description: Kirby travels to San Diego to work with San Diego Chill, an organization that helps kids with disabilities learn how to play ice hockey. Kirby trains to be a goalie.

episodes.title: Mascot Miracles
episodes.description: Kirby travels to West Jordan, Utah, to work with Mascot Miracles Foundation, an organization that hosts events with mascots for kids with debilitating conditions.

episodes.title: Morgan's Wonderland
episodes.description: Kirby goes to San Antonio, Texas, to volunteer at Morgan’s Wonderland, the one and only “Ultra-Accessible Theme Park” for guests of all ages and abilities.

episodes.title: Saddles in Service
episodes.description: Kirby goes to Wyoming to help Saddles in Service to assist Veterans, Firefighters, Law Enforcement Officers, and First Responders the unique opportunity to explore their own healing alongside a rescue horse.

episodes.title: Life Rolls On
episodes.description: Kirby goes to San Diego to work with Life Rolls On, an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people living with various disabilities through adaptive surfing and skating.

episodes.title: Wrap Ukraine with Quilts
episodes.description: Kirby goes to Poland to work with Wrap Ukraine With Quilts, an organization that is dedicated to making and donating quilts to refugees from Ukraine.

episodes.title: Music Mends Minds
episodes.description: Kirby goes to Los Angeles to discover Music Mends Minds, an organization that creates musical support groups for people with Alzheimer’s, dementia, Parkinson’s, traumatic brain injury, PTSD, and other neurological disorders.

episodes.title: Helpful Hands and Hearts
episodes.description: Kirby travels to Littleton, North Carolina, to work with Helpful Hands and Hearts, a organization in the Lake Gaston and Roanake River Valley that helps everyday people deal with their challenging access and transportation circumstances.

episodes.title: SevaTruck Foundation
episodes.description: Kirby travels to Fairfax, Virginia, to work with SevaTruck Foundation, an organization committed to fighting hunger in communities by serving hot, nutritious meals to anyone in need.

episodes.title: Windy's Ranch and Rescue
episodes.description: In Overton, Nevada, Kirby goes hog wild in his efforts to help Windy's Ranch & Rescue save abandoned and mistreated pot-bellied pigs. Kirby learns how sweet pigs can be, and how rich they can make the lives of the people who care for them.

episodes.title: Carol
episodes.description: Host Kirby Heyborne uses JustServe.org to bring some holiday cheer to an old friend.

episodes.title: Pepperell Community Arts
episodes.description: Kirby heads to Pepperell, Massachusetts to join Pepperell Community Arts––an organization dedicated to an inclusive approach to youth theater, music, and dance. Channeling his inner thespian, Kirby takes on the daunting task of stage-managing a play.

episodes.title: River Discovery
episodes.description: Kirby heads to Idaho to join River Discovery, an organization that provides whitewater rafting adventures for cancer survivors. Kirby gets thrown into the deep end, trying to keep up with the demands and dangers associated with the extreme sport.

episodes.title: Hope Renovations
episodes.description: In North Carolina, Kirby joins an organization called Hope Renovations which empowers women to pursue careers in the construction trades. Donning his tool belt, Kirby sees firsthand how impactful it can be to give someone a new skill set.

episodes.title: Laughing Bear Bakery
episodes.description: Kirby travels to Laughing Bear Bakery, a bakery empowering ex-offenders with job opportunities. Rolling up his sleeves, Kirby bakes pies alongside those getting a second chance.

episodes.title: Need to Believe
episodes.description: Kirby finds the Need to Believe Foundation–an organization in California that trains kids with special needs in jiu-jitsu and other martial arts. With guidance from an ex-MMA fighter, Kirby helps the students prepare for their upcoming tournament.

episodes.title: Peace of Mind Dog Rescue
episodes.description: Kirby travels to California to help Peace of Mind Dog Rescue, an organization that assists senior citizens with caring for their dogs. As Kirby serves people in need, he learns just how big of an impact the dogs have on their owners' wellness.

episodes.title: Southside Blooms
episodes.description: Kirby volunteers at Southside Blooms, a farm-to-vase floral shop dedicated to creating jobs for at-risk youth in some of Chicago's toughest neighborhoods. Kirby sees firsthand how growing flowers can be surprisingly effective at growing communities.

episodes.title: Honor Flight
episodes.description: Kirby joins Honor Flight in Washington D.C., an organization dedicated to honoring veterans by taking them on trips to see the national monuments. Planning a surprise welcome home for the veterans will be one of Kirby's biggest challenges yet!

episodes.title: C.A.S.T. for Kids
episodes.description: Kirby joins C.A.S.T. for Kids in Texas, helping kids with special needs go fishing. As Kirby helps orchestrate the big fishing derby, he witnesses the joy that comes from celebrating accomplishments–a rare treat for some of the participants.

episodes.title: Free Guitars 4 Kids
episodes.description: Kirby travels to Austin, Texas to help Free Guitars 4 Kids–an organization striving to put guitars in the hands of kids, regardless of their financial situations. Kirby sees the joy that instruments can bring to young musicians.

episodes.title: RODS Heroes
episodes.description: In Armenia, Kirby celebrates the spirit of children with Down syndrome. Alongside RODS Heroes, he visits an orphanage filled with love, experiences traditional food and dance, and embraces a nation’s warmth in this unforgettable Making Good.

episodes.title: Nurturing Nations - Ghana
episodes.description: Kirby visits Ghana, where local hero Percy and Nurturing Nations rescue hundreds of children from slavery and hunger, offering safety, meals, and education. Welcomed as family, Kirby makes banku, learns dances, and invites a king to their ceremony.

episodes.title: The Contract

episodes.title: Reunion

episodes.title: Broken

episodes.description: Watch the trailer for season 6 of Malory Towers!

episodes.title: The First Day
episodes.description: In awe of Malory Towers, Darrell keeps her past at her old school a close secret. Always in the thick of it, Darrell has a hairy start at the train station and when odd sounds are heard in the dorm, learns about the ghost of Lady Jane Malory.

episodes.title: The New Girls
episodes.description: When Gwen leaves the school to learn about Darrell’s past, Darrell must try to stop her before it's too late. Meanwhile, not knowing where their dormmates are, the North Tower girls do all they can to cover when Matron comes for lights out.

episodes.title: The Trick
episodes.description: In an attempt to impress Alicia, Darrell unleashes a prank in Mam'zelle's class. Trick sweets sent by Alicia's brothers cause havoc in the school, and strange happenings continue when a mysterious red handprint appears in the dorm.

episodes.title: The Slap
episodes.description: On a scorching hot day at Malory Towers, Miss Potts lets the first form girls go down to the pool. Jealous of Darrell and Alicia's new friendship, Gwen takes the fun and games too far.

episodes.title: The Match
episodes.description: Darrell is up to play in the lacrosse game, but her excitement is short lived when she finds out they'll be playing against her old school. Darrell must face her past and overcome her temper if she wants to win the match.

episodes.title: The Midnight Feast
episodes.description: Alicia's family sends a bounty of food, and the girls are all set to have their first North Tower midnight feast. But when Matron wakes during the feast, all Darrell’s worst fears are realized. Will the girls escape?

episodes.title: The Open Day
episodes.description: On open day, Malory Towers bursts with energy and visiting families. But Darrell's joy is short lived when she finds out her half-term results. She is determined to keep them a secret from her parents.

episodes.title: The Push
episodes.description: After a confrontation with Darrell about her family, Sally is found hiding in pain. However, her injuries are far more serious than first thought. Fearing she is at fault, Darrell leaves the school to find a doctor.

episodes.title: The Letter
episodes.description: Darrell is itching to get to the bottom of Sally's relationship with her family, but when Sally goes missing, the first form rally together to comb the grounds. Darrell and Sally finally discover the real reason Sally was sent to Malory Towers.

episodes.title: The Dress
episodes.description: A beautiful dress arrives at Malory Towers: one of the girls is a debutante, destined to marry into aristocracy. When Darrell finds out who the mystery girl is, she's determined to prove the girl is a poor choice.

episodes.title: The Spider
episodes.description: Feeling guilty for lashing out at Mary-Lou, Darrell and Sally hatch a plan to give Mary-Lou the confidence she needs. But will the plan backfire and make Mary-Lou less courageous?

episodes.title: The Ghost
episodes.description: In the dead of night Mary-Lou faints when she sees a hooded figure in the dorm bathroom. Not wanting Mary-Lou's courage to be crushed, Darrell and Sally are determined to get to the bottom of the mystery.

episodes.title: The Last Day
episodes.description: May-Lou is devastated to find her courage pen smashed on the floor. When Darrell's shoes are found with ink on them, Darrell is the prime suspect, and the North Tower holds a class court.

episodes.title: The Head of Form
episodes.description: Darrell and her class return to Malory Towers. The first order of business: elect a new class leader. Gwen decides to take the new girl under her wing and become her best friend.

episodes.title: The Dunce's Cap
episodes.description: Alicia convinces Darrell to help her play a prank on their teachers with invisible chalk. Meanwhile, Mr. Parker becomes more strict. Mary-Lou finds her voice and stands up for herself.

episodes.title: The Stray
episodes.description: The girls' attempt to make Ellen feel more included but their efforts backfire. Miss Grayling has a secret that might put Malory Towers in danger.

episodes.title: The Auditions
episodes.description: In an attempt to impress her parents, Gwen auditions for the lead role in the upcoming school play. Darrell and Sally devise a plan to save the school.

episodes.title: The Caricatures
episodes.description: When Alicia’s birthday gift from her parents doesn’t arrive, she take it out on her teachers. Gwen becomes more tangled in her lies.

episodes.title: The Runaway
episodes.description: Ellen is stressed that she’ll lose her scholarship and stays up all night studying for an exam. Gwen gets her hands on Darrell’s diary and discovers Darrell's secret.

episodes.title: The Play
episodes.description: Darrell shows a potential investor around Malory Towers. Gwen is confronted with her lies when her mother visits.

episodes.title: The Measles
episodes.description: A teacher and Gwen are quarantined after finding out they have the measles. Darrell finds out disturbing news about the future of Malory Towers. Sally takes on extra responsibilities.

episodes.title: The Sneezing Trick
episodes.description: Alicia and Darrell pull a sneezing prank on their French teacher, which disappoints Sally. Someone has stolen important possessions from the girls.

episodes.title: The School Trip
episodes.description: Gwen resorts to drastic measures to hide what she’s stolen. Darrell and Sally find a clue that could finally lead them to Lady Jane Malory’s treasure.

episodes.title: The Quiz
episodes.description: Malory Towers competes with the local boys' school in a competition. Ellen suffers a panic attack when she is accused of Gwen's misdeeds.

episodes.title: The Heroine
episodes.description: The girls doubt Ellen’s innocence. Gwen attempts to get rid of the items she stole, endangering Mary-Lou in the process.

episodes.title: The Lost Treasure
episodes.description: Miss Grayling reveals disheartening news. In one last attempt to save the school, Darrell and Sally try to find Lady Jane’s lost treasure. Gwen’s secrets come to light.

episodes.title: The New Arrivals
episodes.description: The girls welcome Bill and her horse, Thunder, to Malory Towers, but Bill’s place in the third form is under threat when she is accused of spending too much time in the stables. Gwen’s father is offered the position as head of board at the school.

episodes.title: The Trials
episodes.description: Darrell scouts out players for the lacrosse team, and discovers that Gwen has some hidden talents. Mary-Lou discovers a skin condition that worries her. Matron must fill in for the biology teacher.

episodes.title: The Surprise Picnic
episodes.description: Darrell suggests a midnight feast in the stables, but they’re afraid of horse poachers. Mavis, a sixth former, is on the hunt for someone to accompany her on the piano for an important audition, and Irene might fit the bill.

episodes.title: The Accident
episodes.description: Bill struggles to balance her schoolwork with time spent at the stables with her horse, Thunder. Bill and Darrell need Thunder's help when someone at the school has a serious accident.

episodes.title: The New Headmistress
episodes.description: Miss Johnson enforces a list of tough new rules which get the better Darrell’s temper. An important lacrosse match is at stake when Darrell is given a particularly difficult punishment.

episodes.title: The Voice
episodes.description: Sally returns to a very different Malory Towers after her case of the mumps. The strict new rules keep Mavis and Irene from their audition, but the girls have a plan to cover for them and keep Miss Johnson at bay.

episodes.title: The Dance
episodes.description: Gwen goes a little overboard when she organizes a dance lesson with the Thackerton boys. Mary-Lou discovers a mysterious statue in the woods when Gwen asks her to break the rules to gather ivy.

episodes.title: The Sisters
episodes.description: Darrell’s sister Felicity visits to take an exam that will determine her acceptance at Malory Towers. Darrell wants to enjoy time with her sister but Miss Johnson's strict rules stand in the way.

episodes.title: The Hamper
episodes.description: Alicia sends a package for the girls filled with goodies and prank materials, plus a secret message. Darrell prepares for the lacrosse trial and sneaks in practice time.

episodes.title: The Peaches
episodes.description: With the third form on a trip to the circus, Darrell and Sally attempt to recover the confiscated peaches from Miss Johnson’s office, but they find more than they expected...

episodes.title: The Ride
episodes.description: Bill will stop at nothing when she discovers that her horse Thunder is sick with colic. Gwen is charged with keeping Bill away from the stables or else they will both be punished.

episodes.title: The Arrest
episodes.description: Ron shows Darrell and Sally a stash of art found in the stables, but where did it come from? Miss Johnson is caught off-guard when Miss Grayling arrives back at Malory Towers.

episodes.title: The Thief
episodes.description: With Darrell focused on clearing Ron’s name, Mary-Lou and Ellen uncover new information that changes everything they thought about the art thefts.

episodes.title: Christmas at Malory Towers
episodes.description: While stranded at Malory Towers for the Christmas holiday, Gwen receives some devastating news while Darrell, Mary Lou, Sally and Ellen solve a ghostly mystery.

episodes.title: The Rivers Sisters
episodes.description: After being selected as head of lower school, Darrell soon feels the demands of leadership when Felicity, her younger sister just starting at Malory Towers, gets into trouble.

episodes.title: The Doubloon
episodes.description: Darrell enlists the help of the first year students when facing her first challenge to her authority as head of lower school.

episodes.title: The Inter-Tower Match
episodes.description: Preparing for the inter-tower lacrosse match leads to disappointment for Darrell and Felicity. The rest of the team speculates why breakout star Clarissa is hesitant to play.

episodes.title: The Essay
episodes.description: Ruth lets her sister Connie take credit for her essay. The first forms try to evade Darrell while searching for treasure.

episodes.title: The Kiss
episodes.description: The first formers try to prank their teachers with Irene's help. Mademoiselle's reaction to the prank raises suspicions for Irene.

episodes.title: The Midnight Surprise
episodes.description: Alicia plans an outdoor midnight feast for her and Darrell. Felicity and June sneak out to search for a hidden room within Malory Towers.

episodes.title: The Speech
episodes.description: Darrell struggles to prepare a speech she is to give in front of the whole school. Sally and Bill organize a lacrosse match. Irene’s father delivers news Irene has not been looking forward to.

episodes.title: The Connie Affair
episodes.description: June makes some itching powder for a prank that gets out of hand. Connie blames June for the unfortunate things that keep happening to her, even though June insists she had nothing to do with them.

episodes.title: The Strong Heart
episodes.description: When Clarissa receives troubling news that her pony has been sold, she breaks the rules to rescue him. Irene and Mademoiselle Rougier make efforts to strengthen their relationship.

episodes.title: The Field Trip
episodes.description: Instead of going on a field trip, Gwen chooses to stay at school to care for Mr. Parker’s pregnant wife. June gives Darrell a scare by wandering off.

episodes.title: The Exam
episodes.description: Darrell and her classmates await their exam while Felicity and June continue to explore the secret room. Gwen pretends to have heart issues to get out of the exam, but then finds herself in a dangerous situation.

episodes.title: The Terrible Day
episodes.description: Ruth’s bullying of Connie reaches a new low when June is wrongly accused of playing pranks. Darrell encourages the lower form to find who is responsible and the whole class gets a lesson on accountability.

episodes.title: The Wedding Day
episodes.description: June and Darrell find themselves in danger when they leave the school to continue the search for the treasure in a cave during high tide. The rest of the school prepares for the wedding. Irene is given an important task by her father.

episodes.title: The Rivers Sisters Return
episodes.description: Felicity struggles to get out of Darrell's shadow in her second year at Malory Towers. Newcomer Jo struggles to follow the rules, getting Felicity caught in the crosshairs. Mary Lou debates how strict to be after becoming head of lower school.

episodes.title: The Monitor Strike
episodes.description: June leads the second form girls in a strike to protect Clarissa from Gwen's constant demands, resulting in a big change. When a pipe bursts, old memories resurface and a new friend is made. Archeological research is to begin at Malory Towers.

episodes.title: The Circus
episodes.description: Felicity and Jo meet a young acrobat girl and Jo promises to take Felicity to the circus. When Jo breaks the rules to fulfill her promise, Miss Grayling teaches her a lesson about friendship. Twins Ruth and Connie start to notice their differences.

episodes.title: The Beautiful Game
episodes.description: Clarissa goes undercover to prove that girls can play soccer just as good as boys. Darrell and Susan help Mr. Murray look for ancient symbols in the garden as they continue their archeology research.

episodes.title: The Pocket Money
episodes.description: Jo and Connie trick Felicity into helping them retrieve Jo's confiscated pocket money from Matron's safe. The Second Form girls protest Jo's rule-breaking.

episodes.title: The Fugitives
episodes.description: Afraid of being accused of stealing, Jo and Connie run away to the village. Darrell helps a worried Ruth search for her sister. When the girls return to Malory Towers, Jo's father learns about her misdeeds.

episodes.title: The Babysitter
episodes.description: Gwen has plans with Ron--until she gets stuck watching Mr. Parker's baby. Alicia recruits Felicity to the cross-country team, much to Darrell's dismay. When baby Kathleen goes missing, Gwen attempts to pass off the blame.

episodes.title: The Malory Oak
episodes.description: June pulls a daring stunt to save the beloved Malory Oak from being chopped down by Mr. Murray. The Second Form girls learn about chores and hard work. Jo trusts Felicity and Connie with a secret about her mother.

episodes.title: The Unexpected Visitor
episodes.description: Mrs. Heather appears suddenly to take Susan home. The Second Form girls start a prank war with Mam'zelle. Ruth and Clarissa find a way for Susan to stay at Malory Towers.

episodes.title: The Race
episodes.description: On the day of the big race, Felicity cracks under the pressure of Alicia's tough coaching. Matron goes on vacation to see her family. The new nurse, Nurse Jane, has her hands full right away when Darrell gets injured looking for Felicity.

episodes.title: The New Matron
episodes.description: As Nurse Jane adjusts to her new job at Malory Towers, Darrell adjusts to her new injury and missing lacrosse trials. During a nit breakout, Jo and the second formers prank Nurse Jane to get out of treatment.

episodes.title: The Maypole
episodes.description: Jo's mischief leads the second formers to take out the Maypole for the first time since the war. When Jo is named May Queen, she struggles to accept the traditions. Darrell's suspicion of Nurse Jane grows as more information is uncovered.

episodes.title: The Investigation
episodes.description: Darrell's suspicions are confirmed when she discovers that Nurse Jane isn't who she claims to be. Matron returns to Malory Towers early, prompting an unexpected reunion. June and Clarissa attempt to save the life of a lost donkey.

episodes.title: The Penalty
episodes.description: Ruth takes an exam that could mean skipping a form--meaning she would leave Connie and her friends behind. Jane and Clarissa rally the second formers to compete in a football tournament for prize money that could save George the donkey.

episodes.title: The Dream
episodes.description: Gwen is directing the school play and considers giving Jo a bigger role to take advantage of her father's donations. Felicity juggles rehearsing the play and helping Darrell rehabilitate her ankle. Susan and Ruth help Mr. Murray with his excavation.

episodes.title: The Birthday Surprise
episodes.description: Ruth and Connie celebrate a birthday together and Jo learns the joy of sharing and teamwork. A mysterious package containing a camera causes all sorts of mischief and hijinks. Mr. Murray seems to be hiding secrets about the excavation.

episodes.title: The Challenge
episodes.description: Darrell is nervous about racing against Alicia on her ankle until Jean encourages her. Susan and Ruth question Mr. Murray about the secrets he's been keeping. The obstacle course ends with teamwork, reconciliation, and a new Games Captain.

episodes.title: The Poison Pen
episodes.description: With the play coming up quickly, Gwen dials up the intensity during play rehearsals, causing Jo, Felicity, and the others to rebel. June and Connie help Jean with the backdrops.

episodes.title: The Last Letter
episodes.description: Gwen finds the girl behind the poison pen letters and learns a lesson about forgiveness and second chances. Susan and Ruth get some guidance from Mr. Parker that helps them find the ancient chamber.

episodes.title: The Chamber
episodes.description: As the girls make their final preparations for the play, Jo and Gwen connect over their family situations. Felicity feels the impact of stage fright. Ruth and Susan finally discover the ancient chamber as well as Mr. Murray's true colors.

episodes.title: The First Day of the Last Year
episodes.description: After a bustling first day back at school, best friends Darrell and Sally contend for Head Girl, while new girl Celeste arrives from France and quickly gets into trouble with Matron.

episodes.title: The Malory Times
episodes.description: Friendships are tested when Alicia, Jean, and Mary-Lou set out to make their mark on Malory Towers by restarting the school newsletter, the Malory Times. Jo and Susan try to fix Mr. Parker's new typewriter before he finds out they broke it.

episodes.title: Le Petit Paris
episodes.description: When Celeste discovers she must stay at school for the full term, Jo, Susan, and June plan a France-themed party to cheer her up. Mary-Lou shadows her teachers as she explores a potential career path.

episodes.title: The Band
episodes.description: Alicia prepares for her Oxford exam while Irene plays piano for Ron's band. June and Felicity receive a riddle that might lead them to the time capsule hidden at the school.

episodes.title: The Birthday
episodes.description: It's Celeste's birthday, and when she doesn't receive anything from her Maman, the Malory Tower girls spring into action, causing tension between Celeste and Jo. Sally suspects Matron may not be telling the truth when Matron ends up in danger.

episodes.title: The Nurse
episodes.description: Celeste lies about the fire as a way to see her mother. Matron confides in Sally, pushing Sally to make a decision about her future.

episodes.title: The Debate
episodes.description: Gwen fills in for Matron, resulting in disaster. June and Felicity start a pillow fight with Darrell and Alicia over some contested school rules. Darrell and Felicity have a sisterly talk.

episodes.title: The Ward
episodes.description: Matron Maher returns to Malory Towers, bringing her ward, Nancy, with her. Gwen attempts several strategies to persuade Matron to stay. Nancy helps the Third Form figure out more clues to the time capsule, unearthing another layer of mystery.

episodes.title: The Best Friend
episodes.description: Jo is reluctant to say goodbye to her best friend. Nancy, June, and Felicity search for clues about the time capsule, which leads them to Fred. Celeste is sent off with the promise of a pen pal.

episodes.title: The Photograph
episodes.description: Alicia and Irene discover who got accepted to Oxford. The Malory Towers time capsule is found with an important and timely message inside. Irene finds support in her band mate.

episodes.title: The Spelling Bee
episodes.description: Gwen’s plans to go to finishing school are thrown into chaos when an unexpected obstacle gets in her way. A spelling bee causes Darrell to doubt her future plans and strains her relationship with Felicity.

episodes.title: The Champions
episodes.description: When Clarissa's brother insults her, she challenges his team of boys to a lacrosse match. And Mr. Parker worries about Nancy when she is put in goal.

episodes.title: The Movie Star
episodes.description: Gwen plots for movie star, and Miss Grayling’s cousin, Lily Vernon to visit the school, unaware of their family feud. Meanwhile, Susan and Nancy devise a plan to get out of eating carrots.

episodes.title: The Riding Mistress
episodes.description: Bill’s mother puts Thunder up for sale, and Bill attempts a desperate ploy to foil her. The third formers prank Miss Vernon, but she brings in reinforcements.

episodes.title: The Scoop
episodes.description: Jean reveals uncomfortable truths about the Grayling family, shocking Lily and stirring up trouble. Meanwhile, Darrell and Alicia attempt the ultimate prank.

episodes.title: The Shoot
episodes.description: The girls make a film in an effort to prove Lily is a good teacher. But Lily has her own agenda, and at the peak of filming, things go terribly awry.

episodes.title: The Intruder
episodes.description: When Felicity and June are forced to stay in the san, Felicity sees a mysterious girl in uniform sneaking around the school.

episodes.title: The Abandoned Cottage
episodes.description: Smoke from an abandoned cottage leads Lily to an old, and dangerous, friend. Alicia takes on the challenge of helping Darrell relax and plans a midnight feast.

episodes.title: The Traitor
episodes.description: Gwen is furious with her father when he tells her she won't be going to finishing school. Meanwhile, a mysterious will throws the future of the school into doubt.

episodes.title: The Last Day of Malory Towers
episodes.description: Darrell seeks Jo’s and Felicity’s help to reveal Lily’s plans before Malory Towers is lost forever. Gwen learns Ron is leaving and is forced to confront her own future.

c473765d-575b-4b77-b3f6-6bf35c73b153.description: Backstage BYU takes you behind the scenes of your favorite BYU events.

episodes.title: BYU Broadcasting HD Truck/Carillon Bell Tower
episodes.description: A behind-the-scenes look at the HD truck used to broadcast live BYU football games and the history and sounds of the Centennial Carillon Bell Tower.

episodes.title: BYU Cheer Squad/Mormon Tabernacle Choir
episodes.description: The BYU cheer squad talks about the trust and dedication they have toward each other and the BYU Army ROTC demonstrate their upper body strength as well as their strength of character.

episodes.title: BYU Broadcasting Master Control/Dancesport
episodes.description: George Tate, manager of Broadcast Operations for BYU Broadcasting, talks about the 24-hour, 7-day-a-week responsibilities of Master Control and students working for BYU Arts and Production revealing the hidden duties that make shows run smoothly.

episodes.title: BYU Scene Shop
episodes.description: A glimpse into the scene shop that creates the sets for BYU productions in the Harris Fine Arts Center and the people responsible for organizing, making, and distributing concessions at the LaVell Edwards Stadium.

episodes.title: BYU Creamery/BYU Bowling Alley
episodes.description: The BYU basketball camera crew talks about their efforts to get the best shot of the games in the Marriott Center while the LaVell Edwards Stadium field painters show off their hand-painting skills.

episodes.title: BYU Planetarium
episodes.description: The Royden G. Derrick Planetarium provides opportunities to educate students and the public about the heavens while the BYU grounds crew works hard to keep campus beautiful and safe all year round.

episodes.title: BYU Photo Archives
episodes.description: A look into the preservation of photographs and film in the Special Collections and the creation of a new student film called Heaven Under a Table.

episodes.title: BYU Special Collections
episodes.description: The Special Collections archive brings many different types of artifacts to BYU like a first edition book of Mormon and James Stewart’s accordion while the work of the Carpenter Shop can be seen in every building on campus.

episodes.title: BYU Piano Technicians
episodes.description: Listen to tales of piano tuners as they make sure all 433 pianos at the Harris Fine Arts Center are ready to play every day and to the mechanics who ensure that all 625 campus vehicles run smoothly for all who depend on them.

episodes.title: BYU Homecoming Spectacular
episodes.description: A behind the scenes look at BYU’s Homecoming Spectacular by the art director and some of the performers and of the collections and education provided at the Monte L. Bean Museum.

episodes.title: BYU Paint Shop
episodes.description: Librarians at the Harold B. Lee Library talk about the circulation process of the over 4 million books in this library and students of puppetry show off their projects.

episodes.title: BYU Library
episodes.description: A look at the different departments in the Harold B. Lee Library and the changes made to address student needs and a behind-the-scenes glance of the Mormon Tabernacle Choir Christmas Concert.

eab1b749-4c69-483a-a8eb-7c60d8147d52.description: With help from his friends, teen genius Itch protects his community from a greedy corporation.

episodes.title: Elementary
episodes.description: Itch obtains an unusual rock and discovers it could be a new element. But when everyone at school gets sick, Itch wonders if the rock is to blame.

episodes.title: Chronic Boom Boy
episodes.description: Itch is unimpressed by suave new boy Tim, but he has bigger fish to fry when Flowerdew arranges to have the rock sent away for testing. Itch must get the rock back before it's too late.

episodes.title: Trust No One
episodes.description: Itch discovers he is being followed by some scary-looking biker dudes. Tim helps Itch out, and Cake tells Itch the rock must be destroyed.

episodes.title: Rock 'n' Roll
episodes.description: Itch decides to get rid of the rock but instead is waylaid at the school rock concert where Chloe is playing.

episodes.title: Escape
episodes.description: Lucy, Jack, and Tim take the rock to the local mining institute for further testing in a bid to save Cake.

episodes.title: Hi-Tech, Lo-Fi
episodes.description: Helpless and lost in a new city, Itch, Tim, and Lucy try to track down Flowerdew and the rock. In Seaburgh, Darcy has an encounter with a biker.

episodes.title: Road Trip
episodes.description: While government agents question Lucy and Jack stalls Itch's mum, Itch continues his journey by bus, unaware that Tim is also on board.

episodes.title: Friends and Enemies
episodes.description: Itch and Tim struggle to survive in the harsh outback after evading police. Back in Seaburgh, Lucy, Jack, and Chloe work to uncover the truth about Greencorp.

episodes.title: End Game
episodes.description: After surviving the night in the outback, Itch hatches a plan to evade the evil powers trying to get the rock. Meanwhile, his dad and Australian Intelligence work to track him down.

episodes.title: 376 Down
episodes.description: A weak and sickly Itch risks his life by venturing into the dangerous unknown to ensure the rock remains hidden forever as Greencorp and the authorities close in.

episodes.title: Back with a Bang
episodes.description: Following an explosion and poisoned fish in the bay, Itch and his friends fear Greencorp are to blame and investigate.

episodes.title: Big Brother
episodes.description: Itch and his family move into a secure seafront mansion following an attack, while Itch and Lucy discover the beach water is toxic.

episodes.title: Confrontations
episodes.description: Tim throws a party to win back the trust of his friends and they hatch a plan to find out more about Greencorp’s plans.

episodes.title: A Game
episodes.description: Itch and Darcy go on a heist to the local Country Club, while Chloe gets to know her new friend Bella.

episodes.title: Small Town Hackers
episodes.description: In an effort to stall the grand beach reopening Itch and Jack try to prove the water is toxic, while Tim and Chloe access Lannister’s hard drive and make a major discovery.

episodes.title: Stakeout
episodes.description: The gang go on separate missions following information from Lannister laptop, leading them to uncover a secret location.

episodes.title: The Enemy of My Enemy
episodes.description: Itch and Tim meet a mysterious contact who holds valuable information on Greencorp, while Lucy uncovers a major secret that puts the gang at risk.

episodes.title: Special Ops
episodes.description: Itch, Lucy and Tim find out Greencorp’s evil plans and discover it could lead to widespread destruction.

episodes.title: No Turning Back
episodes.description: Itch, Tim and Lucy find themselves trapped at the hands of Greencorp, while Darcy and Jack race against time to get the only thing that can save them.

episodes.title: Last Goodbye
episodes.description: When Greencorp’s evil plan is put into action, the entire town of Seaburgh is at risk of major devastation, leaving Itch and the gang to save it before it’s too late.

175de293-67eb-4dea-b5a3-f7e5054f3d03.description: Watch the BYU Cougars Football team as they battle their way through the Big 12.

episodes.title: BYU vs. San Diego State
episodes.description: Watch quarterback Marc Wilson and the BYU Cougars absolutely demolish the San Diego State Aztecs on their way to the claim of the 1979 WAC Championship.

episodes.title: BYU vs. SMU
episodes.description: Known as the "Miracle Bowl", the famous fourth quarter rally where BYU won a 46-45 victory.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Long Beach State
episodes.description: Watch the Dynamic duo of Jim McMahon and Steve Young, cruise to a season opening win over the 49ers of Long Beach State to open the 1981 BYU Football campaign.

episodes.title: Utah State vs. BYU
episodes.description: Watch BYU fight tooth and nail, behind QB Steve Young, to get its third straight win over Utah State and claim of the wagon wheel.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Hawaii
episodes.description: In a tight defensive battle in the Islands, BYU's defense comes up big with a fumble TD to seal the win over the Rainbow Warriors.

episodes.title: BYU vs. UCLA
episodes.description: BYU goes to the historic Rose Bowl, and squeaks by with a 37-35 win, behind the arm of Steve Young, and a great defensive stand to end the game.

episodes.title: USU vs. BYU
episodes.description: In an exciting back and forth game offensively, the Cougars beat out the Aggies 38-34, thanks to Steve Young and Robbie Bosco, to reclaim the wagon wheel in Provo.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Missouri
episodes.description: Watch the Cougars end the 1983 campaign, with a win over the Missouri Tigers in the Holiday Bowl in San Diego, finishing 11-1.

episodes.title: BYU vs Utah
episodes.description: BYU dominates Utah with Steve Young leading the team to a 55-7 victory at Cougar Stadium.

episodes.title: BYU vs Pittsburgh
episodes.description: BYU begins their National Championship run, with a historic upset victory over #3 Pittsburgh, behind first time starter Robbie Bosco.

episodes.title: Baylor vs BYU
episodes.description: Watch BYU dominate the Baylor Bears in their 1984 home opener in Provo, 47-13, behind another stellar performance from Robbie Bosco.

episodes.title: BYU vs Hawaii
episodes.description: BYU survives Hawaii 18-13, to keep their perfect record alive, thanks to a late go ahead TD from Robbie Bosco to Glen Koslowski.

episodes.title: BYU vs CSU
episodes.description: BYU opens up 1984 WAC conference play with an absolute drubbing of Colorado State, 52-9.

episodes.title: Wyoming vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU wins a thriller of a homecoming game over Wyoming, thanks to a late go ahead TD from Robbie Bosco to David Mills.

episodes.title: BYU vs Air Force
episodes.description: Perfection stays alive for the Cougars, as they beat Air Force 30-25, thanks to a late game sealing field goal from Lee Johnson.

episodes.title: BYU vs New Mexico
episodes.description: BYU comes into Albuquerque with a complete game shutout of the hapless Lobos, 48-0.

episodes.title: UTEP vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU continues its dominant 1984 season, sending the Miners packing with a 42-9 win in Provo.

episodes.title: San Diego State vs BYU
episodes.description: The Cougars continue to dominate, rolling over the San Diego State Aztecs 34-3 in Provo.

episodes.title: BYU vs Utah
episodes.description: Despite five turnovers, which gave Utah the ball on the BYU end of the field, the Cougars held the Utes to only seven points from those mistakes.

episodes.title: Utah St vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU closes the 1984 regular season, with a 38-13 win over Utah State, keeping the wagon wheel in Provo for another year.

episodes.title: BYU vs Michigan
episodes.description: BYU and Michigan squared off in what turned out to be a typical, thrilling Holiday Bowl.

episodes.title: Washington vs. BYU
episodes.description: BYU bounces back from the disappointing loss to UCLA last week, with a 31-3 shutting down of the visiting Washington Huskies.

episodes.title: Air Force vs. BYU
episodes.description: BYU comes up big at home with a 28-21 upset of No. 4 Air Force, behind a second-half surge from Robbie Bosco and the BYU offense.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Hawaii
episodes.description: BYU ends the 1985 regular season, with a resounding 26-6 win over Hawaii.

episodes.title: New Mexico vs. BYU
episodes.description: BYU survives an early season scare from New Mexico, with a 31-30 win, with two 4th quarter TD's from QB Steven Lindsley.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Air Force
episodes.description: BYU closes the 1986 regular season, with a 23-3 win over Air Force, thanks to a 20 point second quarter.

episodes.title: Air Force vs. BYU
episodes.description: Watch BYU Football down Air Force 24-13 in Provo, behind a stifling effort in the second half from the defense.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Colorado
episodes.description: Watch BYU end the 1988 season beating Colorado 20-17, in the Freedom Bowl, behind two 4th quarter field goals from kicker Jason Chaffetz.

episodes.title: Oregon vs. BYU
episodes.description: Watch BYU win an absolute shootout in Provo, against the Oregon Ducks 45-41, thanks to the great arm of quarterback Ty Detmer.

episodes.title: Utah vs. BYU
episodes.description: Watch BYU put an absolute drubbing of the Utes in Provo 70-31, with 49 unanswered points from the stout BYU offense in the first half.

episodes.title: Miami vs. BYU
episodes.description: Watch eventual Heisman winner Ty Detmer lead the Cougars against defending national champion and #1 ranked Miami, kicking off the 1991 season.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Wyoming
episodes.description: Watch the Cougars as they pull out a dominating victory over Wyoming 45-14 in Laramie. Wyoming ranks No. 25, putting the Cougars ahead of the game with this win.

episodes.title: Texas A&M vs. BYU
episodes.description: The Cougars and the Aggies head to Jack Murphy Stadium in San Diego, California to play in the 1990 Holiday bowl. The Aggies' rushing attack proved to be too much for the Cougars, racking up 353 yards and five touchdowns, handing BYU the 14-65 loss.

episodes.title: BYU vs. SDSU
episodes.description: The air attack was the story for this game. BYU's Ty Detmer threw for 599 yards and six touchdowns, while San Diego State's David Lowery threw for 569 yards and five touchdowns. Neither team could edge the other though, resulting in a 52-52 tie.

episodes.title: San Diego State vs. BYU
episodes.description: BYU came out slinging, as John Walsh threw for 380 yards and five touchdowns. San Diego State's running game was too much for the Cougs though, as Marshall Faulk racked up 299 yards and three touchdowns, handing BYU the 38-45 loss.

episodes.title: Penn State vs. BYU
episodes.description: After losing big to #10 Notre Dame, BYU bounces back with a massive win over #14 Penn State. Quarterback Ryan Hancock led the way with 220 yards and three touchdowns, beating Penn State 30-17.

episodes.title: Hawaii vs. BYU
episodes.description: Watch as the Cougars squeeze out a close win over The University of Hawaii 41-38 at Cougar Stadium.

episodes.title: BYU vs. SDSU
episodes.description: Watch as the Cougars clutch out a win against San Diego State 45-44 in an intense match at Jack Murphy Stadium.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Hawaii
episodes.description: BYU starts the 1994 season off strong with a win against Hawaii 13-12 in Honolulu.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Oklahoma
episodes.description: The Cougars end the 1994 season on a high note against Oklahoma with an overwhelming win 31-6.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Colorado State
episodes.description: On a muddy field in Ft. Collins, BYU pulls off a 28-21 victory over Colorado State.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Fresno State
episodes.description: BYU ends the 1995 season with a victory over Fresno State 45-28 at Bulldog Stadium.

episodes.title: Texas A&M vs. BYU
episodes.description: BYU fights hard for a 41-37 victory over Texas A&M in the Pigskin Classic.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Washington
episodes.description: The Huskies retain their home opener winning streak as they defeat BYU 17-29 in Washington.

episodes.title: New Mexico vs. BYU
episodes.description: BYU squeezes out a tight victory over New Mexico 17-14 in Provo.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Tulsa
episodes.description: Watch the BYU Cougars claim victory over University of Tulsa 55-30 in Oklahoma.

episodes.title: BYU vs. TCU
episodes.description: BYU takes a win 45-21 against TCU at Amon G. Carter Stadium in Texas.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Utah
episodes.description: Watch the Cougars overcome Utah in a 37-17 victory at Rice Stadium in Salt Lake City.

episodes.title: Wyoming vs. BYU
episodes.description: The Cougars take on the Wyoming Cowboys and win with a final score of 28 to 25.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Kansas St.
episodes.description: BYU and the Kansas State Wildcats travel to Dallas for a New Year's Day matchup in the 1997 Cotton Bowl.

episodes.title: Utah State vs. BYU
episodes.description: Paul Shoemaker leads the Cougars for a 42-35 victory over Utah State at Cougar Stadium.

episodes.title: BYU vs. New Mexico
episodes.description: The Lobos claim victory over BYU in a clutch game at New Mexico 28-38.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Alabama
episodes.description: BYU loses against Alabama in a close match at Tuscaloosa 31-38.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Arizona St
episodes.description: BYU claims an overwhelming victory against Arizona State in Provo 26-6.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Utah
episodes.description: Enjoy this historic game from the BYU-Utah Rivalry as the cougars scrape out a win 26-24.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Air Force
episodes.description: Matt Farmer leads the Falcons to victory in a 13-20 victory over the Cougars.

episodes.title: Colorado State vs. BYU
episodes.description: BYU defenders who led the Cougars to a 34-13 victory over Colorado State in the 1999 WAC.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Virginia
episodes.description: The Cougars overcome Virginia and claim victory in a tight game 38-35.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Syracuse
episodes.description: After getting off to a 42-7 first half lead, the Syracuse Orangemen went on to defeat BYU 42-14.

episodes.title: New Mexico vs. BYU
episodes.description: In the final home game for BYU head coach LaVell Edwards, the Cougars defeated New Mexico, 37-13.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Utah
episodes.description: In the final game of legendary coach LaVell Edwards' career the Cougars pulled off another come-from-behind miracle, defeating Utah, 34-27.

episodes.title: Utah vs. BYU
episodes.description: Luke Staley scored two touchdowns in just over two minutes apart to give the Cougars the 24-21 victory.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Mississippi St
episodes.description: BYU plays against Mississippi State.

episodes.title: Hawaii vs. BYU
episodes.description: BYU extends their current home win streak as they outlast the Warriors from Hawaii. Quarterback Bret Engemann threw for 226 yards and 21-46 passing and had one touchdown.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Air Force
episodes.description: Last year, Airforce was totally destroyed by the Cougars, so this year they came back with some heavy plays against the Cougars. The Cougars struggle to keep up on the road.

episodes.title: Syracuse vs. BYU
episodes.description: The BYU Cougar football team answered many questions regarding the ability of this year's team to match the success of the 2001 inaugural season for Gary Crowton, by defeating Syracuse 42-21.

episodes.title: Notre Dame vs. BYU
episodes.description: A few big offensive plays, a suffocating defense and tough special teams play were enough to hold off Notre Dame and keep coach Gary Crowton's perfect home opening record intact with a 20-17 victory.

episodes.title: USC vs. BYU
episodes.description: No.1 USC is a tough team for BYU to play. Heisman Trophy candidate Matt Leinart plays an amazing game with 22 of 35 passes completed for 236 yards and two touchdowns.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Boise St
episodes.description: John Beck and Todd Watkins are noted for amazing Cougar offense with season highs of 416 yards and 27 points.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Utah
episodes.description: BYU plays against Utah.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Cal
episodes.description: BYU plays a tough bowl game in front of a record crowd of 40,053 at Sam Boyd Stadium.

episodes.title: Tulsa vs. BYU
episodes.description: BYU's high-powered offense was back to form Saturday as six different Cougars found their way into the end zone, leading the team to its first win of the season, 49-24.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Boston College
episodes.description: Missed opportunities plagued BYU (1-2) as the Cougars dropped a 30-23 decision in double overtime.

episodes.title: Utah State vs. BYU

episodes.title: Laugh Out Loud
episodes.description: Laughter is the best type of medicine. Donald Davis shares his hilarious journey across the “Grand Canyon,” and Bil Lepp shares his comedic story of “Buck Dog.”

episodes.title: Strengthening Family
episodes.description: Sharing memories and stories give families strength. Donald Davis shares his heartwarming story “Red Scooter,” and Kim Weitkamp tells her tale of “Getting to Know Dad at 70.”

episodes.title: Surviving and Thriving
episodes.description: Stories not only share how to survive, but also how to thrive. Charlotte Blake Alston tells a story from Zimbabwe called “Python.” Kevin Kling shares his inspiring story of “The Three Phases of Prayer.”

episodes.title: Tall Tales and Fishy Stories
episodes.description: Tall tales give life to stories that are much bigger than reality. Bil Lepp shares his wild story “Mayhem Dressed as an Eight-Point Buck.” Kim Weitkamp tells her fishy story “Bony Fish.”

episodes.title: Making Sense
episodes.description: Stories help make sense of life’s trauma and problems. Donald Davis shares the story “Doobies.” Barbara McBride-Smith tells the story of “Pandora’s Box.” And Charlotte Blake Alston narrates the story of “The Lion’s Whiskers.”

episodes.title: Love and Marriage
episodes.description: Stories about love are more than just mushy-gushy. Kevin Kling tells a heartwarming story called “Love Story.” Barbara McBride-Smith shares the cute story “Chaucer Backwards.”

123d4a82-3d47-488e-beda-2496a5a1ff2c.description: Learn about the martyrs who brought the King James Bible into existence.

episodes.title: Yearning for the Word
episodes.description: William Tyndale, Martin Luther, and other Christian reformers endeavor to provide the Bible in common vernaculars. Their hopes for the support religious and political leaders are met with rejection, punishment, and turmoil.

episodes.title: Martyrs for a Book
episodes.description: Charges of heresy lead to imprisonment, excommunication, and martyrdoms as reformations of Christianity continue across Europe. King Henry VIII assumes more political and religious power as he strives to issue a male heir.

episodes.title: The King James Bible
episodes.description: William Tyndale’s work inspired further reformation even after his martyrdom. Much of his translation is found in the King James version of the Bible. Phrases and words created by Tyndale are part of today’s vernacular because of the Bible.

f7afe821-7d44-41fc-a22a-bec556873030.description: A well-to-do man leaves his life behind to live on the kindness of strangers around the world.

episodes.title: The Gift of Faith
episodes.description: Leon Logothetis starts a new journey from Alaska to Argentina depending entirely on the generosity of strangers for fuel, food, and lodging. He meets a man who, despite battling cancer, helps men struggling with addiction to get back on their feet.

episodes.title: The Gift of Community
episodes.description: Leon continues his journey through freezing Canada. He encounters people who help him dig his car out of the snow, let him stay in a lodge, and teach him curling. He also meets with a coordinator of an immigrant and refugee organization.

episodes.title: The Gift of Purpose
episodes.description: After getting help fixing his windshield wipers, Leon travels through Montana. He stays with people who have exotic pets before traveling through the woods and avoiding wild animals. He meets someone who followed her dream to help others.

episodes.title: The Gift of Home
episodes.description: Leon gets a fresh shave in Beaver, Utah, before visiting a cattle ranch in Cedar City. He drives through Las Vegas and stops in Tijuana, Mexico, and meets a man who helps those trying to immigrate to the United States.

episodes.title: The Gift of Food
episodes.description: When his travel plans are upended, Leon goes back to San Diego to make new plans for his trip to Argentina. He finally secures passage to Costa Rica with a layover in Houston, Texas, where he works with veterans who help hurricane victims.

episodes.title: The Gift of Shelter
episodes.description: Leon tries to avoid crocodiles and faces his fear of heights while ziplining in the jungles of Costa Rica. He then meets missionaries who refuse his gift of generosity so that a family in need can better their lives.

episodes.title: The Gift of Hope
episodes.description: Leon leaves his car behind as he travels to a village in Panama where there is no electricity and feels real connection with the people. He then goes to Panama City to board a container ship which will take him through the Panama Canal to Colombia.

episodes.title: The Gift of Winnie Love
episodes.description: Leon takes the risk of driving through dangerous territory in Colombia on his way to Quito, Ecuador. He speaks with a leader of Hari Krishna that helps lift his spirits after a difficult day on his trip. He then meets a woman who takes in stray dogs.

episodes.title: The Gift of Connection
episodes.description: Leon takes the risk of filming undercover at the border of Venezuela to share the story of a woman who has gone through a lot of hardships. He runs out of gas on his way to Lima, Peru where he meets a man who hosts many world travelers.

episodes.title: The Gift of Knowledge
episodes.description: While traveling through Peru, Leon sees the terrible conditions enslaved people endured on plantations. He also revisits the woman who built an orphanage where he worked 20 years ago which inspired his trips around the world.

episodes.title: The Gift of Travel
episodes.description: Leon leaves Peru and continues on to Bolivia where he encounters another world traveler. He visits the Uyuni Salt Flats and meets a young musician who moves him to tears.

episodes.title: The Gift of Friendship
episodes.description: Leon visits the Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid museum before leaving Bolivia to finally arrive in Argentina. He struggles to find someone who speaks English until he connects with a foreign student from Haiti.

episodes.title: The Gift of Kindness
episodes.description: As Leon reaches his final destination in southern Argentina, he reflects on his trip, the places and things he experienced, and the people who inspired him along the way.

71029013-dd12-40b7-920b-628c7949e9c0.description: Religious scholars investigate: who was Jesus then, and who is He now?

episodes.title: "Before Abraham Was": Premortal Savior
episodes.description: Latter-day Saint scholars discuss Jesus Christ's role in the war in Heaven before He came to Earth. They consider the contributions of The Logos Hymn and the story of the woman at the well.

episodes.title: "Knowest Thou The Condescension of God?": Birth and Childhood
episodes.description: While reconciling both Matthew and Luke’s versions of Christ’s birth, Latter-day Saint scholars discuss the religious and secular context surrounding the childhood of Jesus.

episodes.title: "If Thou Be The Son of God": Power and Authority
episodes.description: Jesus' ministry begins after he is baptized and tempted in the wilderness, and Latter-day Saint scholars explain the significance of these events by joining scholarship and the Bible.

episodes.title: "He Went Up Into A Mountain": Sermon on the Mount
episodes.description: Latter-day Saint scholars discuss the symbolism and significance behind Jesus’ miracles, including the marriage at Cana, healing the paralytic, the calming of the stormy sea, the feeding of the 5000, and the raising of Lazarus.

episodes.title: "I Have Trodden The Wine Press Alone": Atonement
episodes.description: In the last days of Christ’s life, he suffers the pains of Gethsemane and is betrayed by one of his beloved apostles. Latter-day Saint scholars describe the crucifixion of Jesus in a scriptural and contemporary context.

episodes.title: He Is Not Here; for He Is Risen: Resurrection
episodes.description: The resurrection follows Christ’s crucifixion, and Latter-day Saint scholars discuss the witnesses and effects of Jesus conquering death.

episodes.title: "Behold The Bridegroom Cometh": Second Coming
episodes.description: After Jesus’ ascension to Heaven, the world falls into an age of apostasy. Latter-day scholars converse about the Restoration and the scriptural references to Armageddon and the Millennium.
