episodes.description: BYU is 3-0 and No. 9 in the country. Jarom and Dave play Hot Take or Not on the Cougars' hot start, CBS Sports' Shehan Jeyarajah breaks down the Big 12 race, and BYU Volleyball's Kate Prior and Grace Fredrick preview a top-25 clash with Baylor.

episodes.title: Bye Week Breakdown: Big 12 Games That Matter & BYU vs Baylor Volleyball
episodes.description: BYU football's on a bye, so we break down the games that matter most. Berry Tramel previews a loaded Big 12 slate and the new CFP strength-of-conference metric. Plus, Alex Glover Jemison previews tonight's top 25 BYU-Baylor volleyball on FS1.

episodes.title: BYU Drops to No. 10; Trevor Matich Previews TCU
episodes.description: Spencer and Jarom react to BYU’s drop to No. 10 and preview the TCU game with ESPN’s Trevor Matich. Plus, they discuss five ranked Big 12 teams and women’s volleyball’s five-set win over No. 17 Baylor.

episodes.title: Could College GameDay Be Coming Back to Provo?
episodes.description: BYU heads to TCU with questions on the offensive line after Andrew Gentry's injury. Could College GameDay return to Provo? CFP projections, women's soccer and volleyball updates, Kyler Kasper, BYU women's golf guests, and Spencer's Big 12 Rankings.

episodes.title: BYU Sports Nation: BYU vs. TCU Preview & More
episodes.description: BYU Sports Nation previews No. 10 BYU at TCU with Jamie Plunkett and Hans Olsen, reveals the September Superlatives, and covers Jaxon Kohler’s eligibility update, Jakob Robinson’s new opportunity, and more.

episodes.title: BYU Prepares for Its Biggest Test Yet at TCU
episodes.description: No. 10 BYU is 3-0 and heads to TCU for its first Big 12 road game. We break down the Cougars’ biggest test yet, look at the new basketball roster, and hear from Walker Lyons and Faletau Satuala ahead of Saturday’s matchup.

episodes.title: Can No. 10 BYU Make a Statement at TCU?
episodes.description: No. 10 BYU heads to TCU! Roddy Jones previews the matchup, Emma Hamberlin and Sophie Sivulich talk BYU soccer vs. Kansas State, and the hosts share the Triple Option picks and Cougar sports headlines.

episodes.title: BYU Escapes TCU, Moves to No. 8
episodes.description: Trevor Matich joins Spencer Linton and Jarom Jordan to break down BYU's 17-10 win over TCU, injury concerns and the Iowa State matchup. Plus, BYU rises to No. 8 in the AP Poll, Big 12 Overreaction Monday and weekend highlights across Cougar sports.

episodes.title: BYU’s Biggest Questions Ahead of Iowa State
episodes.description: BYU Sports Nation previews Friday’s Iowa State matchup, including the latest on LJ Martin and Isaiah Glasker. Plus, BYU’s primetime ABC matchup with Notre Dame, the King of the 12 rankings, and Blaine Fowler’s takeaways from the TCU win.

episodes.title: BYU Sports Nation: Tre Alexander & Journee Tonga Preview Iowa State
episodes.description: Spencer Linton and Jarom Jordan preview No. 8 BYU’s matchup with Iowa State, discuss injuries to LJ Martin and Isaiah Glasker, welcome Tre Alexander and Journee Tonga, and reveal the latest Big 12 Power Rankings.

episodes.title: BYU Football Faces a Big Test Without LJ Martin
episodes.description: BYU Sports Nation previews Iowa State and what’s next for the Cougars without LJ Martin. Jaren Hall and Brady Poppinga join the show, plus AJ Dybantsa’s NBA debut, BYU Women’s Soccer and more.

episodes.title: Gameday: No. 8 BYU vs Iowa State
episodes.description: It’s gameday as No. 8 BYU hosts Iowa State! We play Over/Under on the key matchups, and Seneca Wallace previews the game, shares memories of “The Run,” and breaks down the Big 12. Plus, Deep Blue follows Kalani Sitake’s family trip to Tonga.

episodes.title: BYU's Top-10 Showdown: Notre Dame and College GameDay Await
episodes.description: Spencer Linton and Jarom Jordan recap BYU's win over Iowa State and preview No. 2 Notre Dame and College GameDay in Provo. Trevor Matich shares BYU's path to an upset, plus Big 12 Overreaction Monday.

episodes.title: Is Notre Dame BYU’s Biggest Game Ever?
episodes.description: Jarom Jordan and Dave McCann join David Nixon and Bear Bachmeier to preview BYU vs. Notre Dame, debate whether it’s the biggest game in BYU history, discuss injuries on both teams, and bring you the latest King of the Big 12 update.

episodes.title: BYU’s Path to an Upset vs. Notre Dame | BYUSN
episodes.description: Danny Kanell and Hans Olsen join Spencer Linton and Jarom Jordan to preview BYU’s top-10 showdown with Notre Dame, including the Cougars’ advantages, Bear Bachmeier’s role, and what an upset could mean.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Notre Dame: What’s at Stake?
episodes.description: Jason and Jarom preview Saturday’s top-10 showdown: No. 8 BYU vs. No. 2 Notre Dame. Stewart Mandel, Cade Uluave, and Legend Glasker discuss the matchup and BYU’s path to an upset. And No. 14 BYU volleyball takes a 10-match streak to Utah.

episodes.title: BYU’s Path to an Upset vs. No. 2 Notre Dame
episodes.description: BYU faces No. 2 Notre Dame. Shehan Jeyarajah breaks down the path to an upset, and Holly Rowe returns to Provo to talk storylines. Plus, the 24-team playoff debate, men’s hoops vs. Nebraska, and No. 22 women’s soccer vs. No. 8 Texas Tech.

episodes.title: BYU BEATS NOTRE DAME
episodes.description: BYU beats Notre Dame! Spencer and Jarom break down the historic win, what went right and wrong, and welcome ESPN analyst Trevor Matich to discuss BYU’s ranking and whether Bear should be a Heisman contender.

episodes.title: BYU Football Is No. 2… Now What?
episodes.description: BYU Sports Nation debates Bear Bachmeier’s Heisman potential, basketball’s preseason ranking, and volleyball’s national-title hopes. Plus, seven BYU sports are ranked in the Top 25 as the crew looks ahead to UCF and more.

episodes.title: BYU Sports Nation: Notre Dame Win, UCF Preview & Jaxon Kohler Update
episodes.description: Jarom Jordan and Jason Shepherd look back at BYU’s Notre Dame win, preview UCF and discuss Jaxon Kohler’s eligibility. Tim Fanning and Lee Cummard join from Big 12 Media Days to talk BYU Basketball.

episodes.title: Can BYU Make a Run to the College Football Playoff?
episodes.description: BYU is 6-0 and No. 2. How can BYU reach the College Football Playoff? Jarom Jordan and Jason Shepherd preview UCF, then talk hoops with Rob Wright III and Collin Chandler, and title hopes with cross-country stars Lexi Goff-Thompson and Karrie Baloga.

episodes.title: Does BYU Need a Statement Win at UCF?
episodes.description: No. 2 BYU heads to Orlando to face UCF. Does BYU need a statement win? FOX’s Connor Onion previews the Bounce House matchup and Bear’s rise. Plus, Kelli Jo Burgess and Lulu Po’uha preview volleyball’s 13-match streak and showdown with No. 8 ASU.

episodes.title: BYU Falls to UCF: What's Next for the Cougars' Playoff Hopes?
episodes.description: Spencer Linton and Jarom Jordan break down BYU's loss to UCF with ESPN's Trevor Matich and examine the Cougars' playoff hopes. Plus, Big 12 Overreaction Monday, men's hoops takeaways, and women's volleyball's top-10 win.

episodes.title: Big Deal or No Deal? BYU's ASU Matchup & Utah Kickoff
episodes.description: No. 8 BYU prepares for Arizona State as QB questions loom for the Sun Devils. An early kickoff for BYU-Utah, Raider Damuni on bouncing back from UCF, basketball insights from Bruce Branch III and Fran Fraschilla, & BYU volleyball's Big 12 title.

episodes.title: BYU’s College Football Playoff Hopes, Arizona State Preview & Paki Finau | BYU Sports Nation
episodes.description: Spencer Linton and Jason Shepherd discuss BYU’s playoff outlook and Arizona State matchup. Paki Finau and Blaine Fowler join the show, plus Big 12 power rankings, Halloween candy picks, and the latest BYU sports headlines.

episodes.title: What Does a BYU Bounceback vs. ASU Look Like?
episodes.description: No. 8 BYU Football looks to bounce back against Arizona State after losing to UCF. Kevin Young previews basketball, AJ Dybantsa makes his NBA debut, and BYU cross-country runners prepare for the Big 12 Championships.

episodes.title: Trick or Treat: It's Gameday Eve
episodes.description: It’s Halloween eve and gameday eve! We play Trick or Treat to preview BYU-Arizona State and the Big 12 chaos. FOX’s Connor Onion breaks down the matchup, and Rob Neilson and Claire Little Chambers preview volleyball’s rivalry match vs. Utah.

episodes.title: Rivalry on the Rise
episodes.description: Jarom Jordan and Spencer Linton recap BYU's win over Arizona State, preview the Utah rivalry with ESPN's Trevor Matich and discuss LJ Martin's impact. Plus, a look at the basketball opener against Ohio State and a winning weekend across BYU sports.

episodes.title: BYU Hoops Opens Strong vs Ohio State | CFP Predictions Before Utah
episodes.description: BYU hoops opens with a 94-83 win over Ohio State behind Rob Wright III’s 33 points. Plus, CFP ranking predictions before the top-10 Holy War at Utah, John Beck previews the rivalry, and Lee Cummard talks the women’s hoops opener.

episodes.title: BYU No. 9 in CFP Rankings, Utah Showdown Preview | BYU Sports Nation
episodes.description: BYU is No. 9 in the first CFP rankings. Spencer Linton and Jarom Jordan discuss the Cougars’ playoff path and Saturday’s Utah showdown with guests Hans Olsen and Walker Lyons, plus the latest BYU sports headlines.

episodes.title: Can BYU Beat Utah Without LJ Martin?
episodes.description: Saturday’s rivalry is near. Will LJ Martin play as No. 9 BYU faces No. 3 Utah? Spencer and Jarom break down the injury report and game keys. Safety Faletau Satuala joins the show, while Jen Rockwood reflects on her final regular-season home match.

episodes.title: 24 Hours to BYU vs. Utah: Dennis Pitta on the First Top 10 Rivalry Showdown
episodes.description: BYU and Utah kick off in 24 hours in the first top 10 showdown in rivalry history. Will LJ Martin play? Dennis Pitta shares keys to success and the 10 a.m. kickoff impact. Plus, this week’s Rootables and a Cougar sports weekend preview.

episodes.title: BYU's Playoff Path After the Utah Loss
episodes.description: Jarom Jordan and Spencer Linton break down BYU's loss to Utah and its College Football Playoff hopes with Trevor Matich. Plus, Delaney Gibb's triple-double, big basketball wins, and volleyball's winning streak.

episodes.title: Can BYU Stay in the Playoff Picture?
episodes.description: BYU previews Baylor after the loss to Utah and asks what the Cougars need to show to stay in the playoff race. Delaney Gibb joins after her triple-double, with Jayven Williams on BYU’s defense. Plus, the 24-team CFP, Queens, and women’s soccer.

episodes.title: BYU Sports Nation: CFP Rankings, Baylor Prep & Hoops
episodes.description: BYU lands at No. 10 in the CFP rankings as the Big 12 places six teams in the poll. Fesi Sitake previews Baylor, Blaine Fowler weighs in on BYU’s playoff hopes, and the show recaps BYU Hoops’ 98–82 win over Queens.

episodes.title: Can BYU Keep Its CFP Hopes Alive and Win Out?
episodes.description: Three games remain for BYU football—can the Cougars win out? Chase Roberts discusses the season and Legend Glasker. Plus, No. 14 BYU soccer is headed to the Big 12 title game, and tennis player Sage Bergeson previews the NCAA Individual Championship.

episodes.title: BYU vs. Baylor Preview: Shehan Jeyarajah, Justin Kirkland & Chelsea Peterson
episodes.description: BYU looks to bounce back against Baylor. Shehan Jeyarajah previews the matchup and BYU’s CFP path, Justin Kirkland shares the team’s mindset and a Christmas story comparison, and goalie Chelsea Peterson previews the Big 12 title game.

episodes.title: Did BYU Do Enough to Stay in the Top 10?
episodes.description: Jarom Jordan and Spencer Linton break down BYU's win over Baylor and its top 10 case. Trevor Matich weighs in on playoff hopes, plus running back concerns, the Big 12 race and women's soccer's conference title.

episodes.title: BYU’s CFP Debate, Defensive Keys and Soccer’s NCAA Tournament Draw
episodes.description: Can BYU stay in the CFP top 10? Spencer and Jarom weigh BYU against Texas Tech and Wake Forest, then talk with analyst David Nixon about the defense and LJ Martin. Plus, soccer players reflect on back-to-back Big 12 titles and their tournament draw.

episodes.title: BYU Holds at No. 10: CFP Picture & Kansas Preview
episodes.description: BYU holds at No. 10 in the CFP rankings. Stormy Buonantony previews the Kansas matchup, Sonny Makasini discusses BYU’s run game, and the show looks ahead to a basketball doubleheader.

episodes.title: BYU’s CFP Path: Win Out or Face Utah Again?
episodes.description: BYU Sports Nation previews No. 10 BYU football vs. Kansas and debates the Cougars' best path to the College Football Playoff. Greg Wrubell joins the show, and Collin Chandler looks back on his 20-point game and ahead to the Maui Invitational.

9364c58f-19cf-420f-9f40-786eeda02751.description: A performance event showcasing Latino cultures from across the world.

episodes.title: Night 1 (11-7-20)
episodes.description: This special virtual edition of Luz de las Naciones celebrates culture, faith, family, and hope through music, dance, and inspiring messages, including counsel from President Russell M. Nelson.

episodes.title: Night 2 (12-19-20)
episodes.description: This special Christmas edition of Luz de las Naciones celebrates the birth of Jesus Christ through traditional music, dance, scripture, and holiday customs from across the Spanish-speaking world.

bd6d4ab1-bc8d-4e0d-8d2b-9494be316b6b.description: Five daring explorers encounter remarkable mysteries, unparalleled danger and astounding secrets.

episodes.title: The Curse of Kirrin Island
episodes.description: George Barnard's life on the Dorset coast is turned upside down when she learns that her cousins are on their way from London to stay.

episodes.title: Peril on the Night Train
episodes.description: When Uncle Quentin's life's work is stolen from Kirrin Cottage, the Famous Five take the night train to Scotland and are drawn into a deadly game of espionage, theft, and deceit.

episodes.title: The Eye of the Sunrise
episodes.description: As the summer draws to a close, George sets in motion a new adventure, protecting a circus magician from an unscrupulous doctor who wishes to make use of his powers in the clinic.

episodes.title: Mystery at the Prospect Hotel
episodes.description: An old friend invites the Five to solve a murder. The twist? It hasn't happened yet.

episodes.title: Big Trouble on Billycock Hill
episodes.description: After a Spitfire plane crashes near Kirrin Cottage, the Five rescue an injured pilot with no memory. As danger closes in, they race to uncover his identity and the truth—before those hunting him strike first.

7940fbde-1f15-4a00-a6a3-66bde195bfa2.description: BYUtv Sports Nation's acclaimed documentary series features stories of hope, integrity, and perseverance from the Big 12 and beyond.

episodes.title: Michelle Spencer: Measuring a Life of Service
episodes.description: Sam Houston's motto is "The Measure of a Life is its Service" and Alum Michelle Spencer lives this everyday. Here is her journey in helping the community of Walker County in Huntsville, Texas by operating the local Boys and Girls Club.

episodes.title: Hayden Hawks: All Heart
episodes.description: Hayden Hawks is the embodiment of heart. After his baseball dreams fizzled out Hayden found a love of running that his led to him to not only a successful career as a professional ultra-marathon runner, but also as a loving husband, father, and man.

episodes.title: Arkansas: Blending of Culture
episodes.description: Arkansas takes pride in the diversity found on their campus. They strive to include people from all backgrounds in their mission to make the world a better place.

episodes.title: Joey Su'a: 54 Days
episodes.description: Joey Su'a has overcome the odds as a deaf athlete for the Arkansas Football team. After a scare with death the Su'a family used their faith in God to help Joey reach his goals and his full potential.

episodes.title: Brandon Burlsworth
episodes.description: The inspiring story of Arkansas legend Brandon Burlsworth. His journey of self belief led him to the highest heights of Arkansas Football. Though his life ended early Brandon's legacy continues on as his life has inspired many to reach their goals.

episodes.title: The Arkansas Mission
episodes.description: The University of Arkansas is striving to represent the State of Arkansas with pride. Highlighting character, accountability, and unity is apart of the mission undertaken by the Razorback faithful.

episodes.title: Folds of Honor
episodes.description: Kansas alumni Lieutenant Colonel Dan Rooney created the Folds of Honor Foundation as a way to assist families of fallen soldiers.

episodes.title: The Rock Chalk Roundball Classic
episodes.description: Brian Hanni is known by Kansas fan as the voice of the Jayhawks. However, his desire to serve others led him to create the Rock Chalk Roundball Classic, a charity alumni basketball game. This event has helped aid hundreds of children battling cancer.

episodes.title: The Miracle Workers of UC Health
episodes.description: Damar Hamlin's life threatening experience on January 2, 2023 shook the entire world. Thanks to the efforts of medical staff from UC Health, training staff from the Bills and Bengals, and the support of millions Damar Hamlin has made a full recovery.

episodes.title: TCU’s Fellowship of Christian Athletes
episodes.description: Learn about TCU’s Fellowship of Christian Athletes and how the program helps athletes in their walk with Christ.

episodes.title: TCU’s FCA Bible Study with Lindsey Middleton
episodes.description: BYU’s Track and Field Athlete Lindsey Middleton attends TCU’s FCA Bible Study and talks about religion while being an athlete.

episodes.title: Be the Change
episodes.description: Red Raider defensive lineman, Tony Bradford Jr., patrols the line of scrimmage and the streets of Lubbock. Bradford Jr. is an aspiring police officer who spends most of his downtime assisting local law enforcement during ride alongs and traffic stops

episodes.title: The Shepherd of Lubbock
episodes.description: Pastor Bobby Dagnel is a volunteer chaplain for the Texas Tech football team who found his path later in life. After a life-changing conversation with a former co-worker, he has now become a Shepherd for many student athletes and patrons.

episodes.title: Mariachi Los Matadores
episodes.description: Dr. Lauryn Salazar has blown the roof off of conventional musical studies at the collegiate level. She has turned her cultural anthem of Mariachi into a pathway for education and success for students in Texas and across the country.

episodes.title: Royal Legacy
episodes.description: Legendary Texas football coach, Darrell Royal, helped change the lives of countless players and fans within the Texas community during his career as head coach. After he retired, he set up the Darrell K. Royal Fund to help others.

episodes.title: Iowa’s Innovators
episodes.description: Innovation isn’t a buzzword, it’s the Iowa State way of life. Iowa State University has become one of the nation’s hubs in innovation, paving the way for the future one idea at a time while being fueled by the desire to make the world a better place.

episodes.title: Jack Trice: The Spirit of Ames
episodes.description: Jack Trice was the 1st African-American football player in the country in 1923. His legacy is still alive and well in Ames, IA 100 years after his untimely death due to injuries sustained in a football game.

episodes.title: The Cowboy Code
episodes.description: Oklahoma State President Kayse Shrum blazes a new trail as the first woman to lead a public research institution in the state of Oklahoma. As a native Oklahoman, President Shrum has seen and lived “the Cowboy Code” first-hand.

episodes.title: Dynasty of Dominance
episodes.description: The Oklahoma State wrestling program has produced Olympians, world champions, and more importantly, world-class men. Led by arguably the greatest American wrestler of all-time in John Smith, the Cowboy wrestling program has its grips on history.

episodes.title: Baylor's Purpose
episodes.description: Located in the heart of Texas, Baylor University has become a destination for students who want to live a higher law of life, one where they strive to be the best versions of themselves both spiritually and physically.

episodes.title: S. U. R. E
episodes.description: Dr. Saleha Khumawala is helping change business culture one person at a time. She is the head of The SURE™ program at the University of Houston, where she helps students and entrepreneurs through an innovative, experiential learning program.

episodes.title: The Dream
episodes.description: Walter Thane Baker had a dream to run in the Olympics.  After a work accident left metal in his knee, doctors told him to give up on his dream. He didn’t. And ended up winning 4 medals in 2 Olympiads.

episodes.title: Space U: Ever Upward
episodes.description: UCF was designed after JFK’s “Moonshot” speech as a pipeline for engineers to work at Cape Canaveral and aid the U.S efforts into space. Every year since 2017, UCF hosts a “Space Game” as tribute to the university's legacy and history with NASA.

episodes.title: For All Walks of Life
episodes.description: TCU’s Interfaith Initiative invites, welcomes and is a safe haven to all religions and students on campus. Rev. Todd Boling and Rev. Lea McCracken serve as Chaplains who champion each student’s individual journey of faith no matter what religion.

episodes.title: Proven
episodes.description: Throughout Kayleb Wagner’s life, he’s had to constantly prove himself. Despite being born with limb-differences, he excelled in sports, breaking records and stereotypes. This path also led Kayleb to Southern Illinois University.

episodes.title: City Futsal: A Mariel Family Legacy
episodes.description: In 2012, an immigrant family started a City Futsal league that changed the community and their family forever. Esteban and Manuel Mariel, twins, and graduates of SMU, along with their family, have created City Futsal as a safe space for fun.

episodes.title: Jacey Hupp: Be the Buffalo
episodes.description: Despite losing most of her vision in her right eye from a goat roping incident, Jacey Hupp excelled at every level in South Dakota rodeos. However, when a family tragedy shook her to the core, Jacey relied on her faith to keep riding forward.

episodes.title: Revival: the Bill Snyder Story
episodes.description: When Bill Snyder took over as the head coach of Kansas State football, the Wildcats were dubbed the worst team in the country. His emphasis on caring for the individual helped lead his team on one of the greatest turnarounds in college football.

episodes.title: Payton Washington: You Only Live Once
episodes.description: Before she became a national champion, Payton Washington overcame death and defied the odds of being able to live and walk again, let alone becoming the best in the country.

episodes.title: Be Golden
episodes.description: While playing for the Kansas City Chiefs, Robert Golden felt that his life was intended for something greater. He left the NFL and started Golden Charter Academy in his hometown of Fresno, California. The academy is helping others BE GOLDEN.

episodes.title: Trust Yourself
episodes.description: Taylor Roe is the most decorated athlete to come through the Oklahoma State T&F/X-Country program. Along the way to the pinnacle of her sport, Taylor overcame self-doubt and anxieties as she learned to trust herself and her instincts.

episodes.title: Bono Baseball: More Than a Game
episodes.description: Twin brothers Kyle and Ryan Bono are stitched together through their family’s bond with baseball. Their love of the sport has been passed down from their parents to them and now to their own kids. Bono Baseball is more than a game, it’s a way of life

episodes.title: Hayes Tough
episodes.description: Steve and Savanna Tate lost their son Hayes to cancer when he was just a toddler. In his honor, they set up the Hayes Tough Foundation to help ease the financial burdens of other families that are suffering from their own medical struggles.

episodes.title: Eric Weddle: Let’s Be Great Today!
episodes.description: During his time at the University of Utah and in the NFL, Eric Weddle exemplified his personal mantra of “Let’s be great today!” Weddle’s tenacity earned him success wherever he went, and now he’s teaching young men how to be great in his new role.

episodes.title: Utah - 3 Values
episodes.description: The University of Utah is dedicated to education, innovation, and community service, inspiring students to embrace challenges and contribute to society. The students, professors, and alumni are committed to being positive changemakers in the world.

episodes.title: Darrell Stuckey: Above and Beyond
episodes.description: After a successful career in the NFL, Darrell Stuckey has returned to the University of Kansas as a member of the coaching staff. Stuckey uses his faith and the lessons he learned growing up in adversity to help the next generation succeed.

episodes.title: Tony Achille: Until the end…
episodes.description: Ever since Tony Achille put on his skates for the first time he dreamt of playing division one hockey. Despite being diagnosed with cancer as a teenager, Tony worked harder than ever to pursue his dream and make it a reality.

episodes.title: Noah Guzman: No regrets
episodes.description: Noah Guzman worked his whole life to achieve his goal of playing football in college. After a freak injury threw all of his hard work into jeopardy, Noah turned to his faith and leaned on help from others to live with "no regrets."

episodes.title: Assane Diop
episodes.description: University of Colorado Men's Basketball forward Assane Diop's remarkable journey began in 2020 when he left his home in Dakar, Senegal to pursue his athletic and academic dreams in the United States.

episodes.title: Oscar Robertson: Leading the Way
episodes.description: An inspiring look back at remarkable faith and dedication of basketball legend Oscar Robertson—voted College Player of the Century in 2000 by the National Association of Basketball Coaches—from playing basketball with the University of Cincinnati.

episodes.title: Julius Thomas | Portland State
episodes.description: Portland State Basketball and Football alum and former NFL tight end Julius Thomas reveals the pivotal moments in his collegiate and professional athletic career that inspired his new career as a psychologist and mental health advocate.

episodes.title: Spencer Jones | Stanford
episodes.description: Stanford basketball alum Spencer Jones recalls the people and pivotal moments that led to his budding NBA career with the Denver Nuggets. Hear from his parents, former coaches, and Jones himself as he honors his past and looks forward to his future.

episodes.title: Lex Gillette | East Carolina
episodes.description: East Carolina University alum and Paralympian Lex Gillette shares his incredible story of how he lost his sight, then went on to become one of the most decorated totally blind long and triple jumper in US history.

episodes.title: Peggy Coppom | Colorado
episodes.description: 100-year-old Peggy Coppom has missed only a handful of University Colorado football games since 1966. Through her devotion, her friendship with Deion Sanders, and her faith, she’s become the cornerstone of the CU community.

episodes.title: Kevin Pittsnogle | West Virginia
episodes.description: When West Virginia University power forward/center Kevin Pittsnogle moved on from basketball, he struggled to find an identity outside of sports. Now, he’s made a difference in countless lives as a principal at North Middle School in Martinsburg, WV.

episodes.title: Amanda Beard | Arizona
episodes.description: Amanda Beard was 14 when she won her first Olympic gold medals. But success at such an early age came at a price. While attending college at the University of Arizona, Beard found the strength and support she needed to continue her Olympic journey.

episodes.title: Jordan Gross | Utah
episodes.description: Former Carolina Panther and Utah Ute Jordan Gross looks back on his successful football career and shares his current love of coaching high school football in his hometown of Fruitland, Idaho.

episodes.title: Spence Eccles | Utah
episodes.description: As one of the University of Utah’s most prominent alumni, Spence Eccles has dedicated countless hours making the state of Utah a better place. Now, Eccles reflects on the profound impact of his alma mater in shaping his faith, family, and character.

episodes.title: Carr Family | Iowa State
episodes.description: It began with Iowa State alum Nate Carr’s quest for Olympic gold. Now, Nate’s son, David, wrestles at his father’s alma mater with the same goal. Discover the inspiring story of one family’s journey of true greatness, on and off the mat.

episodes.title: Graham Harrell | Texas Tech
episodes.description: Texas Tech football legend Graham Harrell shares three miraculous experiences that reaffirmed his faith in God and brought his family even closer.

episodes.title: Dr James Cash Jr. | TCU
episodes.description: TCU basketball legend Dr. James Cash Jr. reflects on his transformative years playing for the Horned Frogs—a journey that changed hearts and minds and propelled his academic career to teaching at Harvard.

episodes.title: Rich Franklin | Cincinnati
episodes.description: University of Cincinnati alum Rich Franklin sees God’s hand guiding him throughout his life, from educator to three-time UFC middleweight champion and beyond.

episodes.title: Latavius Murray | UCF
episodes.description: After the tragic death of his best friend Jon Diaz, former UCF and NFL running back Latavius Murray commits to serving and inspiring youth in his hometown of Nedrow, NY by building the Jon Diaz Community Center.

episodes.title: Pickleball | Utah Tech
episodes.description: Utah Tech has quickly become the first dynasty in college pickleball, earning several national titles and a world championship in just a few short years.

episodes.title: Lance Briggs | Arizona
episodes.description: Arizona alum Lance Briggs’ childhood love of superheroes taught him to never give up, a lesson that pushed him through tremendous adversity into becoming an NFL Pro Bowler and one of the great linebackers of the modern era.

episodes.title: Zack Golditch | Colorado State
episodes.description: When a mass shooting shattered his community, Zack Golditch refused to give up football. His resilience inspired those around him, and after playing for Colorado State and the NFL, he continues serving others and giving back in meaningful ways.

episodes.title: Sydney Feager | TCU
episodes.description: After a horrific car accident left her unable to move, TCU equestrian Sydney Feager overcame impossible odds to walk, then ride, and finally, compete for her school.

episodes.title: Alli St. John | Iowa State
episodes.description: As a young girl, Alli St. John knew she wanted to wrestle competitively. Now, she blazes a new trail as Iowa State University's first-ever women's wrestling coach.

episodes.title: Chris Zorich | Notre Dame
episodes.description: Notre Dame football legend Chris Zorich shares his inspiring story of growing up in Chicago, playing for Notre Dame, his career in the NFL, and the incredible people who shaped his life—especially his mother.

episodes.title: Shaquill and Shaquem Griffin | UCF
episodes.description: Twin brothers Shaquill and Shaquem Griffin share their incredible story of how their unbreakable bond led them to play for both the UCF Knights and the Seattle Seahawks

episodes.title: Jalen Klemm | Arizona State
episodes.description: ASU offensive lineman Jalen Klemm’s future was bright, until a health scare no one saw coming threatened his life. Determined to overcome, Klemm relied on his faith and began the hard work of re-learning how to play football.

episodes.title: Garett Bolles | Utah
episodes.description: Former Ute and current Denver Broncos OT Garett Bolles knows what it's like to face the impossible. After a rough childhood, Bolles found his footing thanks to the right people who saw his potential for true greatness.

episodes.title: Jonathan Tchamwa Tchatchoua | Baylor
episodes.description: Former Baylor basketball power forward and current assistant coach Jonathan “Everyday Jon” Tchamwa Tchatchoua shares how a near-career-ending injury brought him closer to God.

episodes.title: Dan Fitzgerald | Kansas
episodes.description: University of Kansas baseball coach Dan Fitzgerald reveals how being the parent of a son with autism inspired him to provide opportunities for other families with autistic loved ones to enjoy watching baseball in a stadium.

episodes.title: Chris Brooks

episodes.description: Gone are the days of whimpy kickers at BYU. Just ask former kicker turned MMA fighter Andrew Mikkelsen.

episodes.title: Derwin Gray
episodes.description: Derwin Gray found his calling in life from an unlikely source.

episodes.title: Cade Fennegan
episodes.description: Cade Fennegan's path of playing against BYU led to a transfer to Provo.

episodes.title: Paige Moore
episodes.description: Paige Moore overcomes multiple concussions and tryout cuts to live out her dream as a BYU cheerleader.

episodes.title: Jernaro Gilford
episodes.description: Jernaro Gilford overcame getting kicked out of BYU to return not once, but twice as he continues to change young men's lives like his was in Provo as a player.

episodes.title: Houston Heimuli
episodes.description: Houston Heimuli seeks to continue his grandfather's legacy after a transfer from Stanford to BYU.

episodes.title: Elaine Michaelis
episodes.description: Much of what the highly successful women's sports at BYU are today can be traced back to the sacrifices and start up from Elaine Michaelis. Learn more about the legendary coach and administrator in this Deep Blue.

episodes.title: Evan Allen
episodes.description: A young BYU fan battles disease with help from the football team and the Make-a-Wish foundation to meet a special player.

episodes.title: Elijah Bryant
episodes.description: While winning an NBA Title and EuroLeague Championships in back-to-back seasons is great, overcoming distance in Atlanta and now in professional family life are what matter to former Cougar Elijah Bryant.

episodes.title: Rudi Williams
episodes.description: The road from Hamilton, Ontario to Provo has been a long one for Rudi Williams and one that he hopes was worth it and changes the future of his family.

episodes.title: Spencer Johnson
episodes.description: Spencer Johnson's determination to be a successful division one basketball player has taken him to four schools where he's found not only success but the ultimate teammate.

episodes.title: Jaxson Robinson
episodes.description: After stops at Texas A&M and Arkansas Jaxson Robinson has found a home at BYU.

episodes.title: Noah Waterman
episodes.description: Noah Waterman's goals revolve around his family -- a unit that has fluctuated in his life but ultimately is at the center of who and what he is.

episodes.title: Kaylee Smiler
episodes.description: Kaylee Smiler shares her Maori culture through basketball and dance.

episodes.title: Lauren Gustin
episodes.description: Lauren Gustin has overcome emotional challenges en route to becoming one of the best rebounders in the NCAA.

episodes.title: Kahil Fennell
episodes.description: Assistant coach Kahil Fennell finds his calling in life to help people through coaching.

episodes.title: Elease Rollins
episodes.description: Elease Rollins is an All-American for BYU on the beam, but as a freshman there was a question if she would ever compete for BYU.

episodes.title: Anyssa Alvarado
episodes.description: When Anyssa Alvorado's grandparents immigrated to the United States, they wanted a better life for their family. Alvorado is trying to make them proud as she is the first person in her family to go to college.

episodes.title: Ashley Hatch
episodes.description: Ashley Hatch had to make the difficult decision when she was young to abstain from playing club soccer on Sundays.  She credits this for her growth in the game to a US Women's National Team player and one of the top players in the NWSL.

episodes.title: Lindsey Hunter
episodes.description: While Lindsey Hunter was on death’s doorstep after a misdiagnosis of appendicitis, she vowed that if she survived, she would try to savor every moment of life from that time forward. Now, this BYU gymnast is painting a new picture on life.

episodes.title: Jackson Garrick
episodes.description: When Jackson Garrick was born, the doctors weren't sure that he was going to live. Jackson quickly showed his courage and will by defying the odds in the hospital, and now years later he's defying the odds on the hardwood.

episodes.title: Josue Dominguez
episodes.description: BYU swimmer Josue Dominguez reached a pinnacle of his sport that few athletes have at BYU; he represented his home country of the Dominican Republic in the 2020 Olympics, but his road to get there was anything but easy.

episodes.title: Sara Musselman
episodes.description: After her mother committed suicide, Sara Musselman found escape and solace in running.  Achieving success with her teammates and seeing an All-American goal accomplished through their support.

episodes.title: Annick Haczkiewicz
episodes.description: Family is central for Annick Haczkiewicz. She and her father bonded with her game of golf.  It is the passion for the game the brought them together, and helped push her through after he was no longer there to be her biggest fan.

episodes.title: Courtney Wayment
episodes.description: Courtney Wayment felt the call to become a steeplechaser. In the process of becoming a multiple time national champion, she learned to overcome hurdles by focusing on serving others helping them achieve their goals.

episodes.title: Aidan Robbins
episodes.description: Aidan Robbins took the long path to BYU, but being a Cougar was always meant to be.  Along that path he learned to value life and the relationships that come with it.

episodes.title: Porter Ellett
episodes.description: Sports is a passion for Porter Ellett.  Despite never playing football and losing an arm in a boyhood accident, Porter followed his passion to a Super Bowl Championship.

episodes.title: Kody Epps
episodes.description: Frustration led Kody Epps to the Transfer Portal, but wanting to leave a legacy brought him back to BYU.

episodes.title: Mike Hall
episodes.description: Mike Hall went from being a BYU Basketball player to being a father and then to being a mentor.  That path, including overcoming a tragic loss, allows him to bring love to those around him.

episodes.title: Hinckley Ropati
episodes.description: Hinckley Ropati suffered a season ending injury earlier this year, but it's not the first obstacle he's overcome. Overcoming doubt, grudges and loss have given him an unique outlook on obstacles.

episodes.title: Kedon Slovis
episodes.description: Early success in his college career had Kedon Slovis looking forward to a great career at USC and beyond. Multiple detours later he looks to see the fruition of that career at BYU.

episodes.title: Jay Hill
episodes.description: From the University of Utah to Weber State and now BYU, Jay Hill has had a partner standing by him in his wife Sara.  When it was her time to fight, Coach Hill was there to stand by her as she battled cancer.

episodes.title: Talmage Gunther
episodes.description: Talmage Gunther's dream was to play football a BYU on scholarship. When he was recruited to BYU he was told they didn't have a scholarship for him. He still came and battled to see his dream come true.

episodes.title: Eddie Heckard
episodes.description: The game of football was a way out for Eddie Heckard. It gave him a path to escape from tragedy and escape to a better life.

episodes.title: Kelly Poppinga
episodes.description: After time in the NFL, and other coaching stints, Kelly Poppinga is back home in Provo with the BYU Football team. Through life's ups and downs, he continues to do good, inspiring others, and loving those around him.

episodes.title: True Blue Hero: Kash
episodes.description: Kash’s busy life was abruptly put on hold when some strange symptoms led to the discovery of a tumor. As he and his family navigate cancer treatments they are feeling the love of their family and community.

episodes.title: Aly Khalifa
episodes.description: Aly Khalifa's sister Nesma inspired and supported him to play basketball.  Now the game has taken Aly from Egypt to Australia to Charlotte and now to BYU where he is finding success and support from family and his new teammates.

episodes.title: Heather Hamson
episodes.description: Having a mother and 2 older sisters who are BYU legends is something Heather Hamson is proud of.  Emerging from their shadows to make a name for herself hasn't alway been the easiest thing, but it's something she is doing.

episodes.title: Townsend Tripple
episodes.description: Faith and family has followed Townsend Tripple in all the places he grew up.  It then changed his path from wanting to be a pilot like his father, and growing into a basketball player and an aspiring engineer who wants to build planes.

episodes.title: Michael Davie
episodes.description: The words of a prophet inspired Michael Davie to complete his degree.  That inspiration and degree has taken him to the Olympics, a World Championship and now to BYU.  It's also allowed him to see miracles in his own life.

episodes.title: Jeff Chatman
episodes.description: Jeff Chatman knew he wanted to play basketball at a D1 school growing up.  He didn't know in doing so he would help break barriers at BYU, and put himself on a path that would see his life change.

episodes.title: Trevin Knell
episodes.description: Nerves are something that all athletes deal with, but Trevin Knell realized he was battling something more that nerves.  Then when an injury looked to derail his career, he found helping his teammates helped him.

episodes.title: Nate Austin
episodes.description: Nate Austin learned fundamental skills on and off the court in high school. Now his goal is to share those same fundamentals as a coach in hopes to help the next generation of players.

episodes.title: Cooper Vest
episodes.description: Cooper Vest came to BYU excited to be a part of BYU Baseball and ready to prove himself.  After sustaining two serious injuries, he found himself trying to prove to himself he could be victorious over the obstacles placed in his way.

episodes.title: Scott Park
episodes.description: After a family tragedy, Scott Park found refuge in BYU Women's Basketball. His fandom for the Cougar Women and their support of him helped give him hope moving forward.

episodes.title: Creed and Davin Thompson
episodes.description: Having lost their father to a terminal illness, Creed and Davin Thompson pushed each other and came together through competition.  Now both have reached lofty goals in athletics.

episodes.title: Connor Mantz and Clayton Young
episodes.description: From being teammates at BYU to being Team USA Teammates, the path for marathoners Conner Mantz and Clayton Young from Provo to Paris.

episodes.title: Lindsey Middleton
episodes.description: On the track, and in life Lindsey Middleton excels and overcomes hurdles.  She does so with an attitude of giving back to her team and those around her.

episodes.title: Tyler Batty
episodes.description: Tyler Batty has always had a goal to be an NFL Football player.  An accident one morning could have derailed that goal, but despite doctors telling him his football career was done Tyler wasn't going to be deterred.

episodes.title: Jake Retzlaff
episodes.description: After putting in the work on the field to see his dream of being a D1 QB come true, Jake Retzlaff saw that dream taken from him after just 3 days. He returned to put the work off the field and saw his dream fulfilled at BYU.

episodes.title: Connor Pay
episodes.description: Connor Pay looked up to his grandpa, but when he lost him to cancer he also lost his faith. It was a neighbor's love and interest in him that put him back on a path to find and rekindle his faith.

episodes.title: Ephraim Asiata
episodes.description: Ephraim Asiata wants to follow in his father's footsteps and play in the NFL, but a shooting not only took that away from him it left him fighting for his life. Despite an extended hospital stay, Ephraim's desire to play football helped pull him.

episodes.title: McKenzie Brothers
episodes.description: Twins and BYU Football players Marcus and Dominique McKenzie's time away from each other taught them how to forgive and be forgiven.

episodes.title: Kevin Gilbride
episodes.description: It took some time for Kevin Gilbride to come around to coaching, but he has embraced it. Now following in his father and grandfather's coaching footsteps, he looks to make an impact on the lives of his players.

episodes.title: Jake Eichorn
episodes.description: Jake Eichorn and his dad, David, have an unbreakable bond. When a health scare threatened David's life, a small town community and a coach's effort helped lift them and take care of them.

episodes.title: Gerry Bohanon
episodes.description: Life's path was never easy for Gerry Bohanon. It was his history of overcoming and the support of family that helped him overcome an injury after being told he'd never play football again.

episodes.title: Sione Po'uah
episodes.description: Sione Po'uah was in the midst of a successful NFL career when he felt the Lord was pulling him in a different direction.  That direction brought him back to Utah to serve as a church leader and coach the next generation of football players.

episodes.title: Patti Edwards
episodes.description: Patti Edwards is much more than just the wife of BYU Legendary Coach LaVell Edwards. She is her own person. She spearheaded a nationwide organization for coaches wives, and continues to serve her community to this day.

episodes.title: True Blue Hero: Tru Hunt
episodes.description: Each week the BYU Football team invites a fan to practice to be celebrated as True Blue Heroes. These fans are overcoming or fighting their own hurdles in life. This is the story of Tru Hunt, one of this year's True Blue Heroes.

episodes.title: Sam Vander Haar
episodes.description: Sam Vander Haar went from pursuing a career in Aussie Rules Football to pursuing an education and a career in American Football. To do so, Sam, his wife and his mom all bet on him. Now they are seeing that bet pay off at BYU.

episodes.title: Coach John Linehan
episodes.description: John Linehan has never forgotten where he came from.

episodes.title: Dallin Hall
episodes.description: Dallin Hall has a list of goals he looks at each night. One goal was to serve a mission, another is to play in the NBA. Despite being told making the NBA is unrealistic and going on a mission would be detrimental to his NBA goal, he hasn't stopped.

episodes.title: Dawson Baker
episodes.description: BYU Cougars guard Dawson Baker’s journey to BYU took him to a remote island in Micronesia and then to UC Irvine. Now playing as a Cougar, Baker has overcome a devastating foot injury and is now stronger than ever.

episodes.title: Egor Demin
episodes.description: As a basketball prodigy, Egor Demin left home at 15 to pursue his hoops career. In his journey he learned to lean on family, friend and God to help him.

episodes.title: Coach Tim Fanning
episodes.description: Being told he wasn't good enough to make his high school basketball team set BYU Assistant Coach Tim Fanning on a path to prove he was good enough. Good enough to make a team and to have a career in basketball. That drive has paid off.

episodes.title: Mawot Mag
episodes.description: BYU forward Mawot Mag’s path from Sudan to Australia to America was filled with danger and uncertainty. Hear from his family, coaches, and Mawot himself about his inspiring journey, resilience, and determination on and off the court.

episodes.title: Dave Rose
episodes.description: As BYU Men’s Basketball head coach from 2005 to 2019, Dave Rose created a culture of character. And for the last 15 years, Rose’s courageous battle with cancer continues to inspire others to live each day to its fullest.

episodes.title: Kanon Catchings
episodes.description: Four-star recruit Kanon Catchings continues his family tradition of playing collegiate and professional basketball, but Kanon didn’t rely on his family’s legacy to earn his spot as a forward for the Cougars.

episodes.title: Morgan Bevell
episodes.description: Former BYU Softball catcher Morgan Bevell launched Bevell's Advocate, a nonprofit dedicated to helping parents of special needs children access vital educational, financial, and medical resources to better support their families.

episodes.title: Richie Saunders
episodes.description: Richie Saunders grew up dreaming of BYU, attending games with his grandpa. That passion led him to create a personal creed that guides his journey both on and off the court, shaping the way he plays, lives, and represents BYU Basketball.

episodes.title: Guard Young
episodes.description: BYU Gymnastics has been a part of Coach Guard Young's life from a young age. .  He found success in competing at BYU, but also saw the cancellation of the Men's Gymnastics program which drove him away from Provo. But after an opportunity to come back

episodes.title: Ashton Riner-Lunt
episodes.description: Ashton Riner found purpose in javelin, but family helped her find peace—and joy as a new mother.

episodes.title: Adam Law
episodes.description: Growing up, Adam Law wanted to follow in the footsteps of his dad and grandpa and achieve Major League success. But when life threw Adam a curveball, he had to realize another path had been prepared for him to continue in baseball in a different way.

episodes.title: Lexy Halladay-Lowry
episodes.description: The belief of a coach in her and her team helped Lexi transform into a leader her senior year. That transformation continues to lead to success for her and her team.

episodes.title: Casey Clinger
episodes.description: Casey Clinger's goal was always to win a national championship with his BYU Cross Country team.  Along the path to achieving that goal, he has discovered and achieved other goals on his pursuit.

episodes.title: Bernardo Adam
episodes.description: After a disappointing experience in playing for his national team, Bernardo Adam found joy in playing Volleyball again, and a place that feels like home at BYU.

episodes.title: Halle Dixon
episodes.description: Halle Dixon was born to play soccer and from an early age her future in the sport looked bright. But a tumor on her spine threatened to take that future away, multiple times. Through faith and determination Halle is looking to make another comeback.

episodes.title: Kylie Webster
episodes.description: Doctors and the medical world put limitations on who and what Kylie Webster would be, but tell Kylie she can't do something and she'll prove you wrong. Her whole life has been about beating the odds and lifting those around her while she goes.

episodes.title: Will Ferrin
episodes.description: Recalling his early days playing high school football, to his incredible game-winning kick that landed an unforgettable victory for BYU over Utah in 2024, kicker Will Ferrin shares how the mental game is just as important as the physical one.

episodes.title: Logan Lutui
episodes.description: After three seasons at Weber State, defensive end Logan Lutui was prepared to pivot away from football. But when an opportunity at BYU presented itself, Lutui trusted in the Lord’s timing and became one of the Cougars’ standouts.

episodes.title: Isaiah Glasker
episodes.description: BYU linebacker Isaiah Glasker went for years not knowing the root of his health issues. But with the help of his trainer and the faith, love, and support of his family, he was able to get the medical help he needed to play without pain.

episodes.title: Keanu Tanuvasa
episodes.description: Defensive tackle Keanu Tanuvasa was already a standout player at the U of U. So why did he transfer to BYU? Hear the Tanuvasa family describe their son and brother’s journey, and from Keanu himself, about the path that led him to Cougar Nation.

episodes.title: Michael Davis
episodes.description: Getting knocked down is part of life. Michael Davis is familiar with getting knocked down, but his ability to get back up and to believe in himself is what drove him to success and the NFL.

episodes.title: Sione Moa
episodes.description: Faced with choosing between walking on at BYU or accepting a scholarship elsewhere, Sione Moa turned to God for guidance. Once he received his answer, his faith, hard work, and determination paved the way for success on and off the field.

episodes.title: Larry Echo Hawk
episodes.description: His faith journey began with football. Larry Echo Hawk, a BYU alum and former general authority of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, reflects on the pivotal teenage moments in Farmington, NM, that shaped his faith, character, and lifel

episodes.title: Sadie Mortensen- True Blue Hero
episodes.description: Young cancer survivor and True Blue Hero Sadie Mortensen wanted to hike all the way up Y Mountain even though she felt weak from treatments. Repeated hikes to the Y built Sadie’s strength and confidence and brought her family even closer.

episodes.title: Chris Hoke
episodes.description: Two-time Super Bowl Champion Chris Hoke has always anchored his life in faith—from serving a mission to playing at BYU, marrying his late wife Jaimee, and leading as a Stake President. Now, he and his children honor Jaimee’s legacy by serving others.

episodes.title: Remembering the Original Cougar Club
episodes.description: 60 years ago, a devastating accident took the lives of BYU football fans traveling to Provo for a game. But out of tragedy grew a legacy of faith and resilience.

episodes.title: Brandon Dunson
episodes.description: Basketball wansn't Brandon Dunson's first choice in what he wanted to do.  Once the BYU Assistant Coach realized it was his future he used his dad as his role model in how through basketball he could learn and teach life lessons to others.

episodes.title: Will Voight
episodes.description: Discover the real-life story of BYU Basketball Coach, Will Voigt

episodes.title: Tyler Mrus
episodes.description: From extreme weather at the University of Alaska Fairbanks to a devastating, nearly career-ending injury at the University of Idaho, Cougs forward Tyler Mrus knows what it takes to persevere through adversity and keep moving forward.

episodes.title: Xavion Staton
episodes.description: For Cougars’ center Xavion Staton, family is everything. Hear his inspiring story of the challenges he’s faced growing up and the accomplishments he’s earned, all with his family supporting him every step of the way.

episodes.title: Akash Sebastian
episodes.description: He’s analyzed for the Kings, Jazz, and Suns. Now BYU’s Director of Analytics & Strategy, Akash Sebastian and his family share his journey from an NBA dream to finding a home with the Cougs.

episodes.title: Dominique Diomande
episodes.description: After enduring one heartbreaking setback after another, Cougars forward Dominique Diomande relied on his faith and found peace, forgiveness, and a bright future.

episodes.title: AJ Dybantsa
episodes.description: The eyes of the world may be on the #1 NBA prospect, but at the end of the day, AJ Dybantsa is—and will always be—Ace and Chelsea’s son.

episodes.title: Jordan Brady
episodes.description: A Deep Blue profile of Jordan Brady, tracing his journey from determined basketball player to coach, overcoming setbacks, career disappointments, and adversity through hard work, faith, and resilience.

episodes.title: Keba Keita
episodes.description: A Deep Blue profile of Keba Keita, who left West Africa to pursue basketball, overcame homesickness and adversity, and used faith, hard work, and family motivation to achieve success at BYU.

episodes.title: Arielle Mackey Williams
episodes.description: Ari Mackey-Williams’ path to BYU hasn’t been easy. Moving from Ngati Porou, New Zealand at 18, she faced homesickness and two ACL tears. Through faith, family, and connection to her people, Ari has found strength to rise above every challenge.

episodes.title: Carmen Alder
episodes.description: Discover the real-life stories of BYU athletes, coaches, and fans in this powerful documentary series.

episodes.title: Shawn Olmstead
episodes.description: BYU Men’s Volleyball Coach Shawn Olmstead faces his toughest battles in brutal 100‑mile races, where a major health setback tested him; with his wife Farrah’s unwavering support and his faith in God, he pushes forward step by step to the finish.

episodes.title: Shari Skabelund
episodes.description: Teen tragedy didn’t define Shari Skabeland—it deepened her love for others. For nearly 40 years, the BYU Swimming head coach has built a legacy of faith, family, and world-class swimmers.

episodes.title: Kate Zimmerman
episodes.description: Kate Zimmerman shares her journey to becoming a BYU Cougarette. Hear about the sacrifices, hard work, and faith it took to earn a spot on the elite dance team and the determination required to stay there.

episodes.title: Krystie Solomon-Jensen
episodes.description: Krystie Solomon-Jensen is a runner at Brigham Young University. She shares her story of running at a young age, dealing with eating disorders, recovering from pregnancy, and ultimately pushing through trials to do what she loves.

episodes.title: Bruce Mitchell
episodes.description: Bruce Mitchell’s journey to LaVell Edwards Stadium is one of hard work, perseverance, faith, and trust in God’s timing. Hear from Bruce, Miller, and the family members who supported him through the highs and lows along the way.

episodes.title: Wes Johnson
episodes.description: A devastating diagnosis ended Wes Johnson’s dream of playing college football, but he found new purpose through coaching. Now, Wes helps lead BYU’s cornerbacks—including his brother, Evan—while inspiring others through his journey.

episodes.title: Cade Uluave
episodes.description: Growing up a BYU fan, Cade Uluave never imagined playing for the Cougars. After an accident threatened his football career, his faith brought hope and healing—and an unexpected chance to play for his favorite team.

episodes.title: LJ Martin
episodes.description: Big 12 Offensive Player of the Year LJ Martin, along with his family and coaches, share his story of overcoming self-doubt through perseverance, humility, and hard work.

episodes.title: Pops & Kalani
episodes.description: Coach Kalani Sitake and family journey to Tonga, where his support for the We Are One Foundation helps provide education, employment and infrastructure to create a brighter future for Tongans.

episodes.title: Skyler Mayne
episodes.description: He's a familiar face (literally) on the sidelines at football games. Get to know the man behind the mustache, Dr. Skyler Mayne, BYU football's Director of High Performance.

episodes.title: Andrew Gentry
episodes.description: Andrew Gentry always knew he wanted to serve a mission. That choice led him down an unexpected path, ultimately to BYU's O-line. Now, he sees how God guided him to the right place, the right team, at the right time.

episodes.title: 1976 Team
episodes.description: The Cougars' 1976 football team reunite to share the remarkable lessons taught by coach LaVell Edwards and replay the incredible season that put BYU in front of a national audience.
