6f69b223-3199-414c-b239-f22b7cc52b5c.description: Four clever students start their own detective agency, vlogging about their adventures.

episodes.title: The Case of the Curious New Girl / The Case of the Disappearing Deliveries
episodes.description: When Maudie solves a playground robbery on her first day at school, she and new friends Ezra, Ava and Kyle create The Inbestigators Detective Agency. Also, when Sophie's online parcels are delivered but never received, she hires the Inbestigators.

episodes.title: The Case of the Missing Solar System / The Case of the Distressed Dancer
episodes.description: Pixie is horrified when her space diorama goes missing and Miss Tan falsely accuses her of not doing her homework. Also, when his dance troupe's concert routine is sabotaged, Zac hires the Inbestigators to find out who at the academy is responsible.

episodes.title: The Case of the Sleepover Secret / The Case of the Big Mouth Challenge
episodes.description: Pixie is furious when something she privately told Ava is made public, so Maudie resolves to find out how Pixie's secret got out. Also, when Ben mounts a competition to see who can fit a large biscuit in their mouth like he can, Maudie is suspicious.

episodes.title: The Case of the Pestering Prank Caller / The Case of the Spoiled Sports Day
episodes.description: When a prank caller targets Ezra and his neighbors, Maudie believes the Inbestigators can track down who is making the mystery calls. Also, four clever students start their own detective agency, vlogging their adventures and becoming fast friends.

episodes.title: The Case of the Exciting Excursion / The Case of the Very Lost Notebook
episodes.description: Four clever students start their own detective agency, vlogging about their adventures and becoming fast friends in the process.

episodes.title: The Case of the Suspect Sprinkler / The Case of the Peculiar Pop Quiz
episodes.description: Four clever students start their own detective agency, vlogging about their adventures and becoming fast friends in the process.

episodes.title: The Case of the Science Sabotage / The Case of the Wrecked Rehearsal
episodes.description: Four clever students start their own detective agency, vlogging about their adventures and becoming fast friends in the process.

episodes.title: The Case of the Perplexing Painting / The Case of the Turtle Thief
episodes.description: Four clever students start their own detective agency, vlogging about their adventures and becoming fast friends in the process.

episodes.title: The Case of the Misplaced Mug / The Case of the Sad Little Sister
episodes.description: Four clever students start their own detective agency, vlogging about their adventures and becoming fast friends in the process.

episodes.title: The Case of the Disoriented Drone / The Case of the Baffling Birthday
episodes.description: Four clever students start their own detective agency, vlogging about their adventures and becoming fast friends in the process.

episodes.title: The Case of the Concert Catastrophe / The Case of the Soccer Saga
episodes.description: Maudie stashes a stack of tickets in a drawer for safekeeping, but somebody takes them; a so-so soccer player is suddenly a lot better than he used to be.

episodes.title: The Case of the Puzzling Pet Day; The Case of the Copy Cat
episodes.description: The animal shelter comes to school to film a commercial; at an event for future leaders, Ava is accused of stealing someone else's speech.

episodes.title: The Case of the Rosemary Riddle; The Case of the Robot Robbery
episodes.description: Ezra's nana cooks up a mystery at the market; a student's robot costume goes missing on Science and Technology Day.

episodes.title: The Case of the Vanishing Koalas; The Case of the Extremely Empty Freezer
episodes.description: The latest snack craze sparks a theft at school; the kids throw Mr. Barker a 1980s-themed birthday party, but they can't find the cake.

episodes.title: The Case of the Miraculous Mini Golfer/The Case of the Problematic Party
episodes.description: A miniature golfer's winning streak sounds too good to be true; the whole class is invited to a laser tag and pizza party for birthday boy Toby who winds up needing the Inbestigators' help.

episodes.title: The Case of the Lousy Lunch Orders; The Case of the Interrupting Intern
episodes.description: Ezra orders pizza but gets a salad roll instead, prompting the Inbestigators to find out who swapped the students' Treat Day lunches for healthier foods; the Inbestigators take on an intern.

episodes.title: The Case of the Freaky Frequency; The Case of the Tricky Trimathlon
episodes.description: Mrs. Maniaci's doorbell is broken, and nobody's car keys are working; Kyle and Ezra team up for an online math competition.

episodes.title: The Case of the Burgled Bags; The Case of the Distracted Detective
episodes.description: Four clever students start their own detective agency, vlogging about their adventures and becoming fast friends in the process.

episodes.title: The Case of the Fishy Fundraiser / The Case of the Incredible Fortune Teller
episodes.description: Someone sabotages a lemonade stand; at a school fundraiser, the fortune teller's predictions are eerily accurate.

episodes.title: The Case of the Unhappy Camper / The Case of the Triple Inbestigation
episodes.description: Someone slips Mr. McGillick's phone into a tub of rice; the Inbestigators shoot a commercial, but, first, they have to find Ezra's fish.

83ac4cd3-e1cc-40e1-a44a-a5ad4a5132ac.description: Laura Timmins leaves the hamlet of Lark Rise for a job in the market town of Candleford.

episodes.title: Season 1 Episode 1
episodes.description: Laura Timmins leaves the hamlet of Lark Rise for a job in the market town of Candleford.

episodes.title: Season 1 Episode 2
episodes.description: When her husband escapes from prison, postmistress Mrs. Macey fears a damaged reputation.

episodes.title: Season 1 Episode 3
episodes.description: Dorcas intercedes when a new maid drives a wedge between Old Amos and his son.

episodes.title: Season 1 Episode 4
episodes.description: Ruby and Pearl Pratt face scandal when their estranged father returns to town.

episodes.title: Season 1 Episode 5
episodes.description: The arrival of a new post office inspector causes problems for Dorcas.

episodes.title: Season 1 Episode 6
episodes.description: A homeless family takes advantage of Robert's charity, leaving their little daughter behind.

episodes.title: Season 1 Episode 7
episodes.description: The residents learn Susan Braby's husband has hit her. They rally around her until he is arrested.

episodes.title: Season 1 Episode 8
episodes.description: The arrival of a radical new teacher causes divisions in the community. Dorcas has a new admirer.

episodes.title: Season 1 Episode 9
episodes.description: Queenie finds an embroidered panel at a grave, and Caroline tries to prove she’s a changed woman after her stint in jail.

episodes.title: Season 1 Episode 10
episodes.description: Everyone gathers at the post office for Zillah’s birthday, and Dorcas is considering leaving Candleford.

episodes.title: Christmas
episodes.description: The series opens with a wonderfully captivating seasonal tale that unites the past and the present.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: A handsome stranger, James Dowland, rides into Candleford with a look of determination about him.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Dorcas sets out to defeat dashing property developer James Dowland in the parish council elections.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Dorcas and James Dowland clash when an accident happens on the path from Lark Rise to Candleford.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: Baby Annie stirs up emotions of days gone by and loves yet to be found.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: When Dorcas suddenly takes ill, Laura finds herself with more than one problem to solve.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: Robert completes his work on the stone panels for the town clock but loses his precious tools and, thus, his means of providing for his family.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: Laura grieves Fisher’s departure, so Dorcas sends her home to Lark Rise to visit her family.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: Alf is smitten with a milkmaid from a neighboring hamlet, but he is forced to date her in secret.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: As the Harvest Show comes around, Constable Patterson's wife comes down with a mysterious illness.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.description: A sudden storm reveals a secret romance but also makes the address on a letter indecipherable.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.description: James Dowland is confined to his hospital bed when his son arrives in Candleford.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: A handsome and ambitious young journalist arrives in Lark Rise with exciting news for the Timmins family.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: Daniel Parish returns to Candleford to try to win back Laura's affections.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Alf throws a party to celebrate good news. Laura intercepts a letter addressed to Alf from prison.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: When Alf is crowned "king of the mowers," he vows to bring in the harvest in record time.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: Dorcas is thrilled to be invited to meet mysterious recluse Mr. Reppington in the hotel gardens.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: Daniel learns that Old Peg Leg, a Crimean war veteran, has received no pension despite his war injuries.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: The locals are rehearsing for their annual production of St. George and the Dragon when they hear rumors that Sir Timothy has returned.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: Pearl receives a dressmaking commission but can't get the work done in time without Ruby.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: The Lark Rise school loses its teacher. Emma steps in and finds a talent she never knew she had.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: When Mrs. Mullins discovers that her daughter is pregnant, she thinks that Daniel is the father.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.description: Mischief Night is approaching, and the folks of Lark Rise and Candleford are excitedly planning tricks to play on their neighbors.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.description: When the postmaster at Inglestone tries to force Dorcas into selling up, she is faced with the heartbreaking prospect of losing her home.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Gabriel Cochrane, the once-wealthy owner of a large iron foundry, arrives in Candleford.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: Daniel's newspaper is launching a poetry competition, and Laura has hopes of taking home the trophy.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Thomas is happy to be organizing the church bazaar until Reverend Marley takes charge.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: The fair has come to town, and the locals are celebrating—Alf has been crowned King of the Fair, while Queenie has won a whole Berkshire pig!

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: Daniel plans a cricket match, but his finest batsman is a woman--and women aren't allowed to play.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: Gabriel has finally completed the machine which he hopes will restore his fortunes.

33233618-8085-4a6e-87e9-4ce5322bc0c6.description: Honey Bailey makes the heartbreaking decision to separate her children.

episodes.title: Four Walls and a Roof, Part 1
episodes.description: A young mother is forced to leave her children while she gets back on her feet.

episodes.title: Four Walls and a Roof, Part 2
episodes.description: The Bailey children adjust to living with their grandmother.

episodes.title: No Way of Telling
episodes.description: Honey finally lands a job, but it pays barely enough for her to survive.

episodes.title: A Family of Independent Needs
episodes.description: Honey is forced to realize her limitations when she is fired and is unable to find another job. Her boys try earning money in hopes of softening thei

episodes.title: My Dog, Pal
episodes.description: Hub and Fat are taking care of a dog that becomes an increasing annoyance to May--and dangerously raises the ire of her neighbors.

episodes.title: Something from Nothing
episodes.description: Honey finds a job in a Toronto garment factory but gets seriously ill and loses it.

episodes.title: Moonshine Struck
episodes.description: Honey meets the boys' gym teacher, Max Sutton, and a dashing but snobby police constable who shows considerable interest in her.

episodes.title: Train to Nowhere
episodes.description: After Max's play is rejected by a big radio show, Grace and Honey talk him into putting it on in New Bedford.

episodes.title: Aunt Grace's Wedding
episodes.description: Grace has been asked to attend a cousin's wedding, but May won't let her go.

episodes.title: No Place Like Home
episodes.description: Joe makes a surprise appearance in New Bedford and joins forces with Hub and Fat to make Honey's dream of having a home come true.

episodes.title: Chasing Rainbows
episodes.description: Hub and Fat want Violet to attend Honey's birthday as a special surprise, but May won't allow it. The boys try to raise enough money to bring Violet

episodes.title: Moving Mountains
episodes.description: Hub takes a newspaper route to supplement the Bring Violet Home Fund.

episodes.title: Back In My Arms Again
episodes.description: Frustrated with May's strong-arm tactics and control, Honey decides to take matters into her own hands.

episodes.title: Many Happy Returns
episodes.description: Shocked by Honey and Max's engagement and potential move to the States, May realizes that she needs Honey.

episodes.title: Never Sleep Three in a Bed
episodes.description: The Bailey-Suttons adjust to their new life and find a better place to live.

episodes.title: Agony Column
episodes.description: When Max has to attend a school board meeting, Grace gets on the air, disguising herself as New York psychologist Dr. Veronica Love.

episodes.title: Triple Trouble
episodes.description: Life gets interesting in New Bedford when old prospector Leo McGinty moves back with his rebellious granddaughter Maisey.

episodes.title: Summer Dreams, Summer Nightmares
episodes.description: Bob takes drastic measures to save the mine, resulting in an explosion that maims several workers.

episodes.title: The Champ
episodes.description: Uncle Joe returns to New Bedford promoting the World Wrestling Tour, but Del suspects that the tour may be a scam.

episodes.title: By Gosh, Or By Golly
episodes.description: Honey announces that she's expecting, and May tries to prove to the men that the mine is safe.

episodes.title: Careers
episodes.description: When Max plans Career Day at school, Hub is paired with the Silver Dome Mine and discovers a passion for the family business.

episodes.title: Radio Waves
episodes.description: As the new station manager, Grace is forced to replace Reverend Milo's Bible Hour with The Adventures of Sam Chang, but her decision sparks upheaval.

episodes.title: A Ghost of a Chance
episodes.description: Grace and Del watch the kids for the weekend. Fat, Hub, and Maisey spend their time plotting to photograph the ghost of Gap-Tooth Peggy.

episodes.title: A Meeting of the Clan
episodes.description: Cousin Jessie pays an unexpected visit when she gets word of May's heart condition.

episodes.title: All That Human Hearts Endure
episodes.description: May tries to keep the severity of her condition a secret, but after a serious heart attack, Dr. Barlow orders her to indefinite bed rest.

episodes.title: Smiling Through
episodes.description: Honey goes into labor after she accompanies May to the mine.

episodes.title: The Resurrection of May
episodes.description: The Baileys are in dire straits as the financial situation of the mine reaches new lows.

episodes.title: The Long Weekend
episodes.description: Three couples in the Bailey family evaluate their relationships.

episodes.title: The Forever Leap
episodes.description: Hub rebels against his goody-goody image by hanging out at the pool hall with some new friends.

episodes.title: My Beautiful Mom
episodes.description: When the prize for the Fall Fair gets broken, a photographer named Tucker comes to the rescue.

episodes.title: The Fever
episodes.description: Maisey has diagnosed 14-year-old Hub with "the fever."

episodes.title: The Crystal Skull
episodes.description: May inherits a supposedly psychic crystal skull from a lonely old man.

episodes.title: Public Enemies
episodes.description: Maisey discovers a secret that helps her understand why a shady newcomer to New Bedford has been watching her.

episodes.title: New Directions
episodes.description: May wants to move mining operations out to the Bass Lake property.

episodes.title: The Strap
episodes.description: Mr. Flett's son Pritchard begins to cause mischief around the school, provoking a controversy on the use of the strap.

episodes.title: Grace of Hollywood
episodes.description: Grace inspires Nathan Sparks, a would-be filmmaker traveling through New Bedford, to make a movie.

episodes.title: Marathon
episodes.description: Max and Honey enter a five-day dance marathon hoping to win the $200 prize.

episodes.title: A Mission for Honey
episodes.description: Honey takes in a woman who is traveling across Canada in search of her unemployed husband.

episodes.title: Life On Mars
episodes.description: Fat, Maisey, and Pritchard have a new fascination with comic-strip hero Buck Rogers.

episodes.title: All This and Heaven Too
episodes.description: Max and the boys visit Honey at the sanatorium, Toppy buys a house, and Grace spends a week alone at the cabin at Bass Lake.

episodes.title: It Don't Mean A Thing
episodes.description: Toppy and Grace open a performing arts school, but some women in the town think divorced Toppy is a bad role model.

episodes.title: A River Rages
episodes.description: Fat and Pritchard's curiosity about undiscovered silver in an abandoned mine puts the two boys in a life-threatening situation.

episodes.title: After Leo
episodes.description: Leo dies, leaving May to act as Maisey's guardian, but Maisey has different plans.

episodes.title: Faith Healer
episodes.description: Grace, Toppy, and Fat protect a runaway evangelist from her manager.

episodes.title: Remembrance Day
episodes.description: Alden Cramp refuses to unveil a statue commemorating the soldiers that died in the First World War.

episodes.title: The Shadow Boxer
episodes.description: Upon his return to New Bedford, Dell Sutton coaches Fat to become a better boxer.

episodes.title: Murmur Most Foul
episodes.description: A crossing of telephone lines reveals a potential plot to murder Callie Cramp.

episodes.title: The Wild Blue Yonder
episodes.description: Grace is chairing her twentieth class-reunion committee.

episodes.title: A Family Again
episodes.description: Honey is home after spending a year at the sanatorium, but New Bedford isn't at all how she left it.

episodes.title: A Formal Affair
episodes.description: Doris returns and teaches Hub how to be a member of high society so that he can accompany Laura to the winter ball in Toronto.

episodes.title: The Foolish Heart
episodes.description: Valentine's Day is approaching, and Max is directing this year's Valentine's Follies.

episodes.title: Coming of Age
episodes.description: Grace is swept off her feet in a matter of days by the wealthy Van Mainwairing.

episodes.title: Oh Happy Day
episodes.description: When Grace accepts Van's marriage proposal, there is more than one disappointed party.

episodes.title: The Trick Cyclist
episodes.description: When May has a stroke, each member of the family tries to work out who should take care of her.

episodes.title: New Girls In Town
episodes.description: Fat and Pritchard both fall for the new girl at school, sparking an instant rivalry.

episodes.title: The Spanish Prisoner
episodes.description: Grace helps Van and his friends plan a prank by pretending to be an exiled Spanish princess.

episodes.title: The Marriage of True Minds
episodes.description: The men in the Sutton household face problems with the women in their lives.

episodes.title: For God & Country
episodes.description: Callie uses information from Hub to help her husband win the mayoral race against Max.

episodes.title: Enter Eddie Jackson
episodes.description: Henry loses a game of chess for the first time and asks Eddie Jackson to help him get better.

episodes.title: The Summer Plague
episodes.description: Infantile paralysis slowly spreads through the region, jeopardizing the annual bass tournament.

episodes.title: Reconciliation
episodes.description: While Toppy struggles to pull off the annual Bell Award ceremony in New Bedford, the workers at the Silver Dome Mine begin to protest.

episodes.title: Cracked in the Mirror
episodes.description: Jim, Rebecca, and Grace are forced to realize that people they care about are not who they seem.

episodes.title: Secrets and Lies
episodes.description: May is hoping that the workers won't find out about the company's boding financial problems.

episodes.title: Pay Back
episodes.description: The Silver Dome Mine is still facing its financial crisis.

0676b43f-4ab9-4f11-8796-3c057672848a.description: Enlarge your soul with uplifting music from the world-renowned Tabernacle Choir at Temple Square.

episodes.title: We Need a Little Christmas featuring Angela Lansbury
episodes.description: British-American actress and singer Angela Lansbury joins The Tabernacle Choir at Temple Square in “We Need a Little Christmas”. Lansbury sings “We Need a Little Christmas,” “Not While I’m Around,” and many more . Plus, the story of Luke II.

episodes.title: A Christmas Celebration with Bryn Terfel
episodes.description: Guest artist Bryn Terfel with The Tabernacle Choir and Orchestra at Temple Square present “A Christmas Celebration”. Songs included “Away in the Manger,”, and “O, Come All Ye Faithful," and more.

episodes.title: Celebrate Christmas with Audra McDonald
episodes.description: Christmas is a time to celebrate and remember those who gave us life and love. But mostly, it's a time to raise our voices in songs of praise. Don’t miss the world renowned Tabernacle Choir at Temple Square and guest star Audra McDonald.

episodes.title: Christmas Light with Sissel
episodes.description: Norwegian-born singing sensation Sissel joined The Tabernacle Choir and Orchestra at Temple Square for their annual Christmas concerts in a performance described as “a match made in heaven.”

episodes.title: O Holy Night with Sandi Patty
episodes.description: Christmas is a time of year to gather together, to set cares aside and bask in the warmth and cheer of family and friends. Enjoy “O Holy Night,” with special guest Sandi Patty and the world renowned Tabernacle Choir at Temple Square.

episodes.title: Rejoice and Be Glad featuring the King Singers
episodes.description: Rejoice and Be Glad with the King’s Singers, The Tabernacle Choir and Orchestra at Temple Square as they present some of the most beloved Christmas songs in history. Join us for this inspiring performance.

episodes.title: A Tradition of Christmas
episodes.description: Joy to the World – “O, Come All Ye Faithful” – “Angels from the Realms of Glory” – “I Heard the Bells on Christmas Day” and more.

episodes.title: The Spirit of Christmas with Brian Stokes Mitchell
episodes.description: Join Broadway star Brian Stokes Mitchell for “The Spirit of Christmas”, with The Tabernacle Choir at Temple Square, as they celebrate the timeless message of peace on earth good will to men.

episodes.title: Carols Then and Now with Natalie Cole
episodes.description: Join internationally renowned recording artist Natalie Cole in “Carols Then and Now”, with The Tabernacle Choir at Temple Square, as they celebrate the enchanting music of Christmas.

episodes.title: Wondrous Christmas with David Archuleta
episodes.description: Join international singing sensation David Archuleta and the world-renowned Tabernacle Choir at Temple Square as they perform the enchantingly beautiful music of the season in, A Wondrous Christmas, a Music and the Spoken Word special program.

episodes.title: A Decade of Christmas
episodes.description: Celebrate the past decade of Christmas music on Temple Square with special guest artists Natalie Cole, Angela Lansbury, David Archuleta and many more, as they join the world renowned Tabernacle Choir at Temple Square, Orchestra at Temple Square.

episodes.title: The Spirit of Giving with Jane Seymour
episodes.description: Celebrate the holidays with The Tabernacle Choir at Temple Square and acclaimed actress Jayne Seymour in a beautiful Music & the Spoken Word Christmas program “The Spirit of Giving”.

episodes.title: A Magical Season with Nathan Gunn
episodes.description: Celebrate the holiday season with The Tabernacle Choir at Temple Square and acclaimed baritone Nathan Gunn, in a beautiful Music & the Spoken Word Christmas program “A Magical Season”.

episodes.title: Christmas in the Air with Tom Brokaw
episodes.description: Christmas in the Air, narrated by veteran newscaster Tom Brokaw, tells the heartwarming true story of Gail Halvorsen, the Berlin Candy Bomber.

episodes.title: Home for the Holidays with Alfie Boe
episodes.description: English tenor Alfie Boe joins The Tabernacle Choir at Temple Square for this masterful Christmas special “Home for the Holidays”. Boe sings songs of the season “Hark! The Hearld Angles Sing” – “Angels, From the Realms of Glory” and more.

episodes.title: Christmas Favorites Featuring Deborah Voigt
episodes.description: Deborah Voigt joins The Tabernacle Choir at Temple Square for this Christmas special. Recognized as one of the world’s most versatile dramatic sopranos and one of music’s most endearing personalities.

episodes.title: A Dickens Christmas featuring John Rhys-Davies
episodes.description: Music & the Spoken Word Christmas Special, A Dickens Christmas featuring John Rhys-Davies.

episodes.title: The Wonder of Christmas featuring Santino Fontana
episodes.description: The Tabernacle Choir at Temple Square joins with Broadway star Santino Fontana to sing joyfully of the magic of Christmas and the excitement of its traditions.

episodes.title: A Christmas to Remember featuring Laura Osnes
episodes.description: The Tabernacle Choir at Temple Square joins with Tony-nominated Broadway star, Laura Osnes. Also featuring narrator Martin Jarvis.

episodes.title: The Messiah Story
episodes.description: The Tabernacle Choir at Temple Square performs songs of hope, faith, and inspiration. Enjoy sacred hymns, both old and new; music from around the world; and uplifting selections from the American songbook.

episodes.title: O Come, Little Children featuring Rolando Villazon
episodes.description: The Tabernacle Choir at Temple Square performs songs of hope, faith, and inspiration. Enjoy sacred hymns, both old and new; music from around the world; and uplifting selections from the American songbook.

episodes.title: Christmas Organ Pipes
episodes.description: Choir Organist Rick Elliott’s fun, crazy original arrangements of seven favorite Christmas carols.

episodes.title: Blessing of Christmas featuring Hugh Bonneville
episodes.description: Tabernacle Choir & Orchestra at Temple Square present “Blessings of Christmas” with special guest Hugh Bonneville and Gabriel Trumpet Ensemble. Music includes “Joy to the World”, “Silent Night”, and “Sing!” based on Toccata from Organ Symphony no. 5.

episodes.title: A Merry Little Christmas featuring Sutton Foster
episodes.description: Tabernacle Choir and Orchestra at Temple Square present a Music & the Spoken Word special, “A Merry Little Christmas”, featuring Sutton Foster, with special guest Hugh Bonneville. Music includes “Christmas Time is Here”, “Unfold Ye Portals”, and more

episodes.title: Season of Light: Lea Salonga
episodes.description: Lea Salonga joins The Tabernacle Choir and Orchestra at Temple Square in singing cherished Christmas carols, hymns and holiday classics.

episodes.description: The Tabernacle Choir, Orchestra at Temple Square, and the Bells on Temple Square perform, directed by Mack Walberg, with special guests Kelli O’Hara, Richard Thomas, and the Gabriel Trumpet Ensemble for this special: Because of Christmas Day.

episodes.title: Christmas Day in the Morning
episodes.description: The Tabernacle Choir, Orchestra at Temple Square, and the Bells on Temple Square perform, directed by Mack Walberg, with special guests Kelli O’Hara, Richard Thomas, and the Gabriel Trumpet Ensemble for this special: Christmas Day in the Morning.

episodes.title: Joy, Christmas with the Tabernacle Choir - Michael Maliakel & Lesley Nicol
episodes.description: The Tabernacle Choir at Temple Square performs songs of hope, faith, and inspiration. Enjoy sacred hymns, both old and new; music from around the world; and uplifting selections from the American songbook.

episodes.title: This Holy Night featuring Megan Hilty and Neal McDonough
episodes.description: The Tabernacle Choir and Orchestra at Temple Square present a Music & the Spoken Word special, This Holy Night, featuring Megan Hilty & Neal McDonough.

episodes.title: Our Silent Night
episodes.description: "Silent Night" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "Holy moments are often created by the silent moments preceding them."

episodes.title: Depth of Gratitude
episodes.description: "Now Thank We All Our God" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "No life is free from hardship, but blessings can flow from the trials of life."

episodes.title: Christmas Blessings Never to be Forgotten
episodes.description: "Carol to the King" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "This Christmas season, may we each look for those who may feel alone."

episodes.title: Finding Christ in Christmas
episodes.description: "Sussex Carol" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "It is because of Him that Christmas truly is the most wonderful time of the year."

episodes.title: The Christmas Star
episodes.description: "’Tis Joy When Moon and Stars Above" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "Thanks be to God for the gift of His Son and for the Christmas star that pointed to Him."

episodes.title: Gathering Christmas
episodes.description: "Hallelujah, from Messiah" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "As we gather, we feel God’s love, because it’s His love, ultimately, that draws us together."

episodes.title: Waging Peace
episodes.description: "Come Ye Children of the Lord" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "As we work to wage peace in our own hearts we become better prepared to practice it in our homes."

episodes.title: True Wisdom
episodes.description: "Dearest Children, God Is Near You" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "As we seek and act on God’s wisdom, we discover that He will show us the way forward."

episodes.title: My Brother's Keeper
episodes.description: "With Songs of Praise" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "May we each, as a beloved hymn pleads, 'be [our] brother’s keeper.'”

episodes.title: Moments that Matter
episodes.description: "This Day Is a Good Day, Lord" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "Brought together, these millions of moments become the story of our lives."

episodes.title: The Accumulation of Our Decisions
episodes.description: "Guide Us, O Thou Great Jehovah" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "Day by day, decision by decision, we gradually become who we will be at the end of our lives."

episodes.title: His Eye Is On The Sparrow
episodes.description: "The Ash Grove" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "God is aware of our lives—and not only our lives, but the details of our lives."

episodes.title: Love Is a Verb
episodes.description: "What a Wonderful World" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "Love is both extended and received through our choices and actions."

episodes.title: Learning from Living
episodes.description: "For the Beauty of the Earth" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "As we look toward the future, let us also look to the past, seeking the wisdom of those who have lived before us."

episodes.title: Water the Roots
episodes.description: "When You Wish Upon a Star" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "Taking time today to nourish our spiritual roots ensures that we can stand strong tomorrow."

episodes.title: Becoming Brave
episodes.description: "I Think the World Is Glorious" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "As we work to become brave, we can be armed with faith that runs deep. Faith sustains bravery."

episodes.title: This Is Jesus
episodes.description: "Consider the Lilies" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "This is Jesus—the Son of God, the Savior of the world, the King of Kings."

episodes.title: Easter is Hope
episodes.description: "That Easter Day with Joy Was Bright" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "Because of Him, 'all that is unfair in life can be made right through the Atonement of Jesus Christ.'"

episodes.title: Remembering: An Anecdote
episodes.description: "Hornpipe, from Water Music" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "Choosing to remember God mutes our murmuring. Focusing on Him and acting on His promises points us forward."

episodes.title: The Joy We Share
episodes.description: "Amazing Grace" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "We were made to lift and bless one another—and when we do, true joy follows."

episodes.title: Inspiration from Heaven
episodes.description: "To God Be the Glory" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "They encourage us to move forward instead of anchoring us forever in the past."

episodes.title: Sit and Eat
episodes.description: "Great Is Thy Faithfulness" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "God’s love always—always—bids each of us welcome. And when we feel least worthy to enter, that may be the very moment He is inviting us to sit—and eat."

episodes.title: Love’s Currency
episodes.description: "Love Bless Our Home" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "We are surrounded by those who need our sacrifice, our time, and our care. These are the currency of love."

episodes.title: Songs of Hope
episodes.description: "My God Is So High" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "Through the music, the Spirit of God had simultaneously touched the hearts of a multitude."

episodes.title: Gently Raise the Sacred Strain
episodes.description: "Gently Raise the Sacred Strain" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. ""As the psalmist said, 'Cast thy burden upon the Lord, and he shall sustain thee. "As the psalmist said, 'Cast thy burden upon the Lord, and he shall sustain thee.'"

episodes.title: Friends at Last
episodes.description: "I Would Be True" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. “Come on, dear brother, since the war is past, for friends at first are friends again at last.”

episodes.title: Get Understanding
episodes.description: "This Is My Father’s World" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "True understanding helps the complex become simple."

episodes.title: Evidence of Hard Challenges
episodes.description: "Rejoice, The Lord is King" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "Some of life’s greatest lessons come from experiences we would never choose."

episodes.title: If Not You, Then Who
episodes.description: "Amazing Grace" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "At one time or another, we all are 'come … for such a time as this.'"

episodes.title: A More Perfect Union
episodes.description: "God Bless America" sung by the Tabernacle Choir.  We can help build a "more perfect union", a nation under God, indivisible, with liberty and justice for all.

episodes.title: #blessed
episodes.description: "Press Forward, Saints" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. God's blessings are an extention of His hand in our lives, guiding, supporting, and preparing us according to His will.

episodes.title: Dios de Amor
episodes.description: "Hymn of Praise" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "Dios de amor. God of love. His love is greater than all the sorrow and tragedy on this earth combined".

episodes.title: Eliminating Distractions
episodes.description: "I Surrender All" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "When we put God first, all other things fall into their proper place..." -Ezra Taft Benson.

episodes.title: Think A Sacred Song
episodes.description: "How Firm A Foundation" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "Some of the greatest sermons are preached by the singing of hymns.

episodes.title: Being Teachable
episodes.description: "Shenandoah" sung by the Tabernacle Choir at Temple Square. "A teachable spirit opens the door for lasting wisdom."

episodes.title: Another Perspective
episodes.description: "Over the Rainbow" from The Wizard of Oz, sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "A change in perspective can bring hope".

episodes.title: No Man Is an Island
episodes.description: "No Man Is an Island" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "We each have the power to choose, the power to serve, the power to influence. As John Donne reminded us, “No man is an island. [Each of us] is a piece of the continent, a part of the main.”

episodes.title: The Ordinary Life
episodes.description: "To the Endless Day!" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "Here is the power statement: Every extraordinary journey begins with an ordinary step.

episodes.title: Repairers of the Breach
episodes.description: "Sing!" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "When the walls of life give way, the bonds we share can hold us together."

episodes.title: Setbacks and Setups
episodes.description: "Come, Thou Fount of Every Blessing" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "Sometimes what looks like a setback really may be a setup for something greater."

episodes.title: The Lower Lights
episodes.description: "Standing on the Promises" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "The Lighthouse of God's love shines brightly, sending forth His mercy to all who will receive it."

episodes.title: Getting Past the Past
episodes.description: "One Person" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "When we make peace with the past, we make room for the future."

episodes.title: Spiritual Solutions
episodes.description: "I Surrender All" is sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "Indeed, when we turn to the Lord, we find that every problem ultimately has a perfect solution, and it is found in Him."

episodes.title: Embracing Happiness
episodes.description: "O Love That Will Not Let Me Go" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "Happiness can be found all around us, but we must choose to see it and then embrace it."

episodes.title: The Faith That Unites Us
episodes.description: "Praise the Lord! His Glories Show" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "Hope, peace, compassion and courage. These are among the strengths born of faith. And wherever they are found, there is common ground. Faith’s virtues truly can unite us."

episodes.title: The Heart's Condition
episodes.description: "There is Sunshine in My Soul Today" sung by the Tabernacle Choir on Temple Square. "We have the power to determine how we'll respond to difficult experiences."

episodes.title: Making the Most
episodes.description: "Redeemer of Israel" sung by the Tabernacle Choir on Temple Square. "When life gives you rain, choose to dance in it."

episodes.title: The Beauty of the Earth
episodes.description: "He's Got the Whole World in His Hands" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "As we take time to see and discover the gift of nature's beauty, we discover humility deep in our hearts, waiting to be uncovered."

episodes.title: To Teach and Let Go
episodes.description: "How Firm A Foundation" sung by the Tabernacle Choir. "His trust is evidence of His love. He knows that the most valuable learning comes through individual choice—responding to an invitation rather than being driven by compulsion."

episodes.title: Feast or Famine
episodes.description: On the second day of their journey to the planet Neptune, the misfit crew of the BZ-3 must work together to fix a food shortage and to stop a French killer robot.

episodes.title: The Sandwich Thief
episodes.description: When RJ’s sandwich mysteriously disappears, the entire crew must undergo lie detector tests to prove their innocence. Kashmere unplugs from social media and discovers the world around her.

episodes.title: Easiest Test in the World
episodes.description: A simple test among the crew leads Natalie and Stuart to a potentially life-threatening discovery. Quincy and Quentin's lemonade stand faces still competition from the robot chef.

episodes.title: The Harold Herald
episodes.description: Time is running out for the crew of the BZ-3 when an oxygen leak threatens to end their lives. Harold publishes a tabloid newspaper.

episodes.title: Final Meal
episodes.description: Stuart has found the ship's oxygen leak, but has trouble stopping it. The rest of the crew use their weaknesses as their strengths and overcome their differences.

episodes.title: Talent Show
episodes.description: Stuart tries fixing M.A.R.T.H.A. after she glitches. Suzy organize a talent show to bring everyone together. They learn that celebrating each other's talents is the true mark of a winner.

episodes.title: Truth Serum
episodes.description: Suzy finds an anonymous love letter. Natalie learns an important lesson: You don't win anything when you win a meaningless argument.

episodes.title: Rawhide
episodes.description: Phillipe 5000 goes on strike. Suzy and Sasha compete on a cooking show. RJ takes Quentin and Quincy camping and learns that sometimes the biggest thing you can give somebody is a bit of your time.

episodes.title: Yogurt Party
episodes.description: Quentin and Quincy learn the importance of keeping promises. Natalie regrets lying to her co-worker.

episodes.title: The Countdown
episodes.description: Sasha must return to Earth for medical attention. Stuart learns to finally act on his feelings for Natalie, despite his doubts and fears.

episodes.title: A Kind of Spark: Trailer
episodes.description: Watch the trailer for BYUtv's newest series.

episodes.title: Insider: A Kind of Spark
episodes.description: Go behind the scenes with BYUtv's new series, "A Kind of Spark".

episodes.title: The Spark
episodes.description: A field trip ignites Addie's (Lola Blue) desire to solve a centuries-old mystery: what happened to Lady Margaret Fraser? With the help of her older sisters Keedie (Georgia De Gidlow) and Nina (Caitlyn Hamilton), Addie begins her search for answers.

episodes.title: Juniper
episodes.description: Addie's older sister Nina gives her a makeover. Later, when Addie gives a speech in front of the town council, she is heartbroken to find that her new best friend Audrey (Eve Midgley), who promised to support her, doesn't show up to hear her speech.

episodes.title: The Witch List
episodes.description: Addie and Audrey's solidify their friendship when they go door to door to spread the word about the women who were wrongfully accused as witches. To heal the rift between her twin sisters, Addie plans a party for their upcoming birthday.

episodes.title: Sisters
episodes.description: The Darrow sisters and Nina's boyfriend, Frank, go to the city in Addie's search for answers about Maggie's disappearance. While at the University library, Addie discovers some devastating information about Maggie's sister, Elinor.

episodes.title: Party
episodes.description: Despite Mr. MacIntosh's strict rules about using the town hall and Miss Murphy's attempts to shut it down, Addie’s birthday party for Nina and Keedie is a success. But when Addie's bully Emily crashes the party, things take a downward turn.

episodes.title: Nicest Village
episodes.description: Keedie avoids her new friends out of fear they'll treat her differently if they know she has autism. Addie's fundraising campaign disrupts a beloved town event, which turns into the opportunity Miss Murphy needs to take control of the town council.

episodes.title: Sleepover
episodes.description: Addie's mom accidentally invites Jenna to Addie and Audrey's slumber party. Addie reads from Lady Margaret's diary about her attempt to rescue her servant, Beth. Jenna questions Keedie on the rift between her and Miss Murphy.

episodes.title: Something Wicked
episodes.description: Backstage drama threatens the school's production of Macbeth. Emily's jealousy reaches a breaking point and lashes out at Addie. Nina and Keedie must then rescue their little sister from the wrath of Miss Murphy.

episodes.title: Burnout
episodes.description: Both at low points following their confrontations with Miss Murphy, Addie and Keedie turn to each other for healing. Frank creates a much-needed diversion for Nina when he recruits her to help him find a lost turtle.

episodes.title: The Way I Am
episodes.description: Addie's fate at her school is decided. Audrey and Frank discover the amazing story of Lady Margaret's escape, inspiring Addie to make one final plea to the town for a memorial for young women wrongfully accused as witches.

episodes.title: What’s Next
episodes.description: Addie’s memorial brings her more attention than she anticipated. A new adventure awaits Addie when she discovers an abandoned bookstore. Keedie makes the connection between an old friend and an online troll.

episodes.title: Bonnie
episodes.description: Addie, Audrey, and Jenna work to reopen the village bookstore to keep Pamela Parks from selling it. Keedie joins Nina and Frank at the University Fair but leaves to visit Bonnie, who still has bad feelings about Juniper. Audrey has a choice to make.

episodes.title: Le Tour De Frank
episodes.description: Keedie comes to the rescue when costumes are needed for the history tour. Audrey accepts a job helping Miriam. Bonnie visits, hoping to see some change, but insists that Juniper is the same as ever. Addie receives unexpected recognition.

episodes.title: Shark Day
episodes.description: Audrey schedules a day off for Addie, hoping to find time to tell her about New York. Keedie and Nina watch the shop in Addie's absence and find evidence that someone has been breaking in. Jenna attempts to catch Jude's eye. Emily rights a wrong.

episodes.title: Choices
episodes.description: With the Founders’ Day dance approaching, Addie must find a story from Juniper’s past that the town can all be proud of. Bonnie lets Addie know that she has a story that fits the bill. Nina struggles with her options for college.

episodes.title: Codebreakers
episodes.description: The Darrow sisters' sleepover turns chaotic when Bonnie seeks to disrupt their perfect image. Addie uncovers a WWII code-breaking story linked to Verity Loveday, raising questions of truth and loyalty.

episodes.title: Miriam
episodes.description: Addie seeks confirmation of the Codebreakers story for the Founders’ Day event. Miriam's reluctance gives way to a touching revelation.

episodes.title: Juniper at War
episodes.description: The Founders’ Day dance takes Juniper back to 1944. Addie feels on top of the world but a well-meaning mistake threatens to undo all her good work.

episodes.title: Runaway
episodes.description: Panic ensues in Juniper as everyone searches for Addie and Bonnie. With the bookstore vandalized, Emily’s mom seeks an advantage.  Tensions rise between Bonnie's parents.

episodes.title: Safe
episodes.description: Do Good Books is up for sale and Bonnie is banned from Juniper. But when Addie and her friends find a final clue for the mysterious safe there might be a way to save the shop... and Bonnie too.

7b2b101c-cbb2-4e00-badf-75a14e2e3f39.description: Get an insider view on new programs, upcoming productions, and behind-the-scenes happenings.

episodes.title: Show Offs!
episodes.description: Casey Jost, host of Show Offs, lets viewers in on the secrets of improv comedy.  With no script, and only the help of the audience to frame a story, Show Offs definitely "shows off" the talent of the stars.

episodes.title: Battle of the Ages
episodes.description: With the help of David Hurwitz, executive producer, Peter Herschko, show runner, and JD Roberto, show host, see how Battle of the Ages entertains games show fans of all ages.

episodes.title: Dinner Takes All
episodes.description: Dinner Takes All host Kelsey Nixon, and Executive Producer Cleve Keller discuss how contestants use food and games to win big money on the show.

episodes.title: Dwight in Shining Armor Characters
episodes.description: Dwight in Shining Armor creators and executive producers Brian and LeeAnne Adams create many different charcters and plot points in a story of seemingly opposite worlds colliding.

episodes.title: Anatomy of a TV Fight
episodes.description: Hunter Nelson, property master, reveals what goes into the making of a Dwight in Shining Armor action sequence. Actor Gary Kaspar who plays Eberulf the Ogre, sets up the challenge of being a bad guy on the show.

episodes.title: Tricked: Behind the Scenes
episodes.description: Eric LeClerc from Tricked and BYUtv coordinating producer Jim Bell discuss the work involved in bringing viewers magic on screen, from locations and props, to insuring this hidden camera show runs smoothly.

episodes.title: Making Good: One-Take Promo
episodes.description: Kirby Heyborne and the Making Good crew take us on location in their production of a one-take show promo.

episodes.title: Battle of the Ages Game Creation
episodes.description: We take a look into all of the preparation that makes Battle of the Ages unique among game shows. From game design to props, months of preparation go into each episode of family fun.

episodes.title: Treasure Island 2020
episodes.description: See how a full fledged audio drama comes together at BYUradio.  Talented actors and crew create a new telling of the classic tale, Treasure Island.

episodes.title: Eric Leclerc on Magic
episodes.description: Eric Leclerc from Tricked shows and tells why magic is so special while he performs many different tricks.

episodes.title: Dwight in Shining Armor: Tovenars
episodes.description: The creators of Dwight in Shining Armor, LeeAnne and Brian Adams discuss the introduction of a new enemy, the Tovenars. They profile the character Sir Aldred.

episodes.title: Meet the Fixers
episodes.description: Interviews with the Fixers cast, Courtney Dober, Ariel Myren, Nick Apostolides, Kirin Stone, reveal what they think of each other and their amazing work.

episodes.title: Studio C's "The Grinch"
episodes.description: Studio C's Tanner Gillman pays tribute to his comic inspiration, Jim Cary, by playing the Grinch who stole Christmas.

episodes.title: Studio C Visual Effects
episodes.description: Get a look inside how Studio C Visual Effects get created. From changing backgrounds to making things disappear, effects specialists know how to make sketches shine.

episodes.title: Kristen Chenoweth and the Tabernacle Choir
episodes.description: Kristen Chenometh makes her love for music and the Christmas season clear through her music as she sings with the Tabernacle Choir at Temple Square.

episodes.title: A Christmas Jars Family
episodes.description: Meet the Birch family, specifically Cameron Birch who had a brain tumor at a young age. We learn the importance of the Christmas Jars giving example this young boy embraced.

episodes.title: The Nutcracker: 75 Years
episodes.description: Ballet West Artistic Director Adam Sklute discusses the history and wonder behind Willam Christensen's choroeography of The Nutcracker. Viewers see the sets, the dancers and the music behind it all.

episodes.title: All-Round Champion Production Challenge
episodes.description: All-Round Champion Executive Producer, Matt Hornburg, explains what the show is. Members of the production team talk about phases of production from casting to capturing the athletes' competition. The athletes share their hopes and fears.

episodes.title: Studio C - "Sir Humphery" pt 1
episodes.description: See the cast of Studio C step back in history to have their knowledge tested about medieval times, in preparation for shooting the sketch, "Sir Humphery."

episodes.title: Studio C - "Sir Humphery" pt 2
episodes.description: The cast of Studio C gets quizzed about medieval culture as they prepare for their sketch, "Sir Humphery."

episodes.title: Grace Notes
episodes.description: Elaine Brady, drummer for the band Neon Trees, hosts Grace Notes. She discusses how the show promotes music that inspires faith. Some of Elaine's Grace Notes guests also provide their insights.

episodes.title: Wizard of Paws
episodes.description: Wizard of Paws host Derek Campana, and Executive producer John Collin talk about what the show does for animals featured in the episodes and for the animals' owners. Both feel gratitude for the opportunity to be a part of Wizard of Paws.

episodes.title: Kirby Heyborne on Making Good
episodes.description: Host of BYUtv Insider, Scout Smith, interviews Kirby Heyborne, host of Making Good. Kirby shares his thoughts on the show and how it has affected the people he interacts with.

episodes.title: Family Rules
episodes.description: Family Rules offers viewers help in making happier families. Tyler Weston, Yahoos Bonner, and Natalie Riskas explain how families featured on the show demonstrate solid family strengthening principles. The Jensen's reflect on Family Rules' appearance

episodes.title: Studio C's "Prairie Housewives"
episodes.description: The women of the Studio C cast provide some insight on producing a sketch spoofing a popular housewife reality TV show.

episodes.title: Wayne Brady Interview
episodes.description: BYUtv Insider's Scout Smith, interviews Wayne Brady about the origins of his career, his interests and dreams, plus his views on comedy and his show, Comedy IQ.

episodes.title: Dwight In Shining Armor's Joel McCrary
episodes.description: Host of BYUtv Insider, Scout Smith, interviews Joel McCrary, who plays Baldric on Dwight in Shining Armor. Joel provides some insight about his character and shares his thoughts on the show.

episodes.title: Dwight In Shining Armor's Evan Hofer
episodes.description: Host of BYUtv Insider, Scout Smith, interviews Evan Hofer, who plays Chlodwig in Dwight in Shining Armor. Evan talks about his character and his thoughts on the show.

episodes.title: Dwight In Shining Armor's Danielle Bisutti
episodes.description: Host of BYUtv Insider, Scout Smith, interviews Danielle Bisutti, who plays Hexella on Dwight in Shining Armor. Danielle talks about her character and her thoughts about the show.

episodes.title: All-Round Champion Winter Sports
episodes.description: Winter sports come to All-Round Champion. Meet the athletes and hear from Ingrid Skaare, Series Creator, Lana Gorlitz, Story Producing Team Manager and Lucas Faganely, Challenge Producer for their thoughts on winter season production opportunities.

episodes.title: Dwight in Shining Armor’s Empowering Female Characters

0d044730-f73e-4d99-b8c2-fb209078c68b.description: A galactic villain learns it's never too late to become a better person, thanks to his new earth family.

episodes.title: Overstaying Your Welcome
episodes.description: Overlord overhears the Underwoods' plan to get rid of him and runs away. Flower tries to gather escaped animals from her Pet Rescue Party and Jim tries to salvage what Overlord has trashed.

episodes.title: Overthrowing the Underscores
episodes.description: Overlord takes on a school bully at Weaver's school but finds he's out of his element. Flower and Jim decide to run a three-legged race for charity, but Flower's competitive side takes over.

episodes.title: Undersized
episodes.description: Overlord creates a shrinking device that Jim accidentally sets off, shrinking both Weaver and Overlord. Flower accuses Willow of taking her makeup and makes her pay for it by working at the animal shelter.

episodes.title: Slime and Understanding
episodes.description: Overlord brings home an space slug to test Flower's claim that she loves all creatures. Weaver becomes a demanding director when he shoots Willow and Dayna's basketball video.

episodes.title: Into the Underbrush
episodes.description: Overlord crashes the Underwood's annual camping trip. R0-FL gets a nice day off and decides to lets loose in the Underwoods' home.

episodes.title: Game Over!
episodes.description: Overlord zaps the Underwoods to a void outside of time and space so he can watch a movie alone at home. The family must work together to escape or else be trapped forever!

episodes.title: 3 Easy Overpayments
episodes.description: Overlord goes to crazy lengths to buy a blender. Jim and Flower visit a new day spa.

episodes.title: Not Under My Roof!
episodes.description: Willow starts dating a boy and Overlord does not approve. Weaver is worried that Bebe has a crush on him and does everything he can to convince her not to fall in love with him.

episodes.title: 13 Going on Overlord
episodes.description: Weaver receives a DNA test kit for his birthday, only to have Overlord use it on himself. With the threat of Overlord's DNA being discovered, the family works together to keep his existence under wraps.

episodes.title: Undercover LARP
episodes.description: Overlord finds his place with a group of Live Action Role Players and rises to become their leader. Meanwhile, Flower and Jim won't allow Willow to use the car until she passes their own bizarre tests.

episodes.title: Overshooters
episodes.description: When Willow's girls' soccer team is overlooked, Overlord decides to coach...the boy's team. Flower takes it upon herself to help R0-FL follow her own interests independent of Overlord.

episodes.title: Overdue Update
episodes.description: After Jim accepts a system update on R0-FL, she becomes his assistant and stops at nothing to make sure he's relaxed at all times. Overlord, meanwhile, hires his nemesis Petey to be his assistant.

episodes.title: Overexposed
episodes.description: Overlord goes to extreme lengths to try and get in the Underwoods' family picture. Willow tries to impress the cool girls at school.

episodes.title: Family Over Frabjleplarm
episodes.description: Overlord is battling homesickness, so the Underwoods agree to celebrate his favorite holiday. However, the day ends with a cruel twist of fate.

episodes.title: Overpiece Theatre
episodes.description: Overlord helps Weaver with morning announcements and uses the opportunity to hypnotize the adults at school. Jim drags an unwilling Willow to "Bring Your Daughter to Work Day." Flower has trouble letting an adorable hedgehog go.

episodes.title: Overlock Holmes and the Undercooked Pie
episodes.description: Jim and Flower throw a dinner party to impress Jim's boss. When the dessert goes missing, Overlord becomes the prime suspect.

episodes.title: Do-over and Over and Over
episodes.description: The Underwoods all have terrible days, so Overlord offers them a shot at re-doing the day with a device he owns. They use it over and over hoping to perfect the day. What they don’t realize is that they are  pawns in Overlord’s game.

episodes.title: Under the Sea Land
episodes.description: Weaver is assigned to do a school project about a person he admires. When he chooses Flower, Overlord becomes jealous and tries to diminish her reputation. Willow feels left out when River gets along great with Jim.

episodes.title: One Year Over-versary
episodes.description: When Overlord enlists the family to look for an object he misplaced one year ago, he leads the Underwoods to recount the first day he arrived at their home.

episodes.title: Over The Moon
episodes.description: Overlord's carelessness puts the family in danger, leading to the ultimate test of his moral compass. Meanwhile, Willow tries to post the perfect verified social media post and Weaver attempts to finally put his stories on film.

1ad35a2e-b129-45fd-87bc-931cb349a93a.description: Looking for a change in life, George Mottershead and his family work together to build the first British zoo without bars.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Deeply affected by his war trauma and driven by his unique love of animals, George attempts to build his dream - a zoo without bars.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: George attempts to rescue two Himalayan black bears from a cave in Matlock, while Reverend Webb is intent on uncovering what the Mottersheads are up to.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: The family confront a barrage of hostility from the residents of Upton.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: When Adam the bear escapes, George is badly injured in the process of retrieving him. Dr Ford treats his injuries, but June is disturbed to learn how close her father was to death.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: After the devastating news that planning permission for the zoo has been denied, George ventures to London with Lady Katherine for one last throw of the dice.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: Everything hangs in the balance as the Mottersheads prepare for the appeal that will decide the fate of the zoo; but with tensions running high after the aviary is slashed, a hot-headed George proves more of a liability than an asset.

episodes.title: How I Got Here Season 1 Trailer
episodes.description: How I Got Here Season 1 Trailer

episodes.title: Zimbabwe: She Has Arrived
episodes.description: Fikile and her dad, Bangane, travel to his homeland in Zimbabwe for the first time. Bangane teaches Fikile the rich history of their family, and she gains a deeper appreciation for their Ndebele culture.

episodes.title: Italy: Making Peace and Pizza
episodes.description: Michael and his dad, John, travel to Italy together for the first time. Despite their sometimes rocky relationship, these two find themselves working together to explore the culture that has shaped each of them and may help them reconnect for good.

episodes.title: Zambia: Born for Greatness
episodes.description: Manasseh and his mom, Nelly, and return to Zambia to reconnect with family and tackle the unanswered questions in their own relationship. Manasseh gains a deeper appreciation of his Zambian heritage and makes peace with his own past.

episodes.title: Serbia: Two Rivers Intertwined
episodes.description: Aleksander returns to Serbia for the first time in almost 30 years, traveling with his son, Sebastian, to discover the places and people left behind during the Kosovo war. Sebastian searches for a better understanding of his heritage and his father.

episodes.title: Zimbabwe: Like Time Stood Still
episodes.description: Shaun travels back to Zimbabwe to face the land he loves and the political climate that forced him to leave. His daughter Shannon begins to embrace her personal identity as a bi-racial woman.

episodes.title: Slovakia: My Mom, the Mountain Goat
episodes.description: Simona returns to Slovakia, a country she left during a time of oppression, with her daughter, Vivian. Together they explore their Slovak heritage and Vivian learns about the sacrifices Simona made when she fled Slovakia over twenty years ago.

episodes.title: Ghana: That Name That You Live
episodes.description: Doris takes her daughter, Shetin, to Ghana to learn the truth behind her royal bloodline.

episodes.title: Chile: A Tree and Its Roots
episodes.description: Carolina travels to Chile with her mom, Ines, to uncover her heritage. Ines reveals the challenges she faced living under a dictatorship and introduces Carolina to the strong women in her family, giving her daughter insight into Ines’s fiery nature.

episodes.title: Israel: Young Man, Walking Up
episodes.description: Leo travels to Israel with his mom, Maya, to untangle his Israeli-Japanese heritage. On this adventure of a lifetime, Leo is ready to be thrown into a culture he’s had little connection with and is ready to watch his mom find herself as well.

episodes.title: Mexico: I Belong To This Land
episodes.description: Alma returns to Mexico with her daughter, Amanda to reunite with family and celebrate the life of a passed loved one.  Amanda will join her mother in their shared love of traditional food and dance and a journey through Mexico’s magical heritage.

episodes.title: Cuba: Forgive the Past
episodes.description: After an eleven-year estrangement, Jordan and his father, Adonis, have reconnected. Now, they’ll travel to Adonis’ home country of Cuba for Jordan to discover their family’s rich musical legacy and reunite with generations of relatives.

episodes.title: Korea: A Forever Sense of Self
episodes.description: Kaelyn knows little of her Korean heritage. Her grandfather, Hae Suk, moved to Canada as a young man and hasn’t shared much of his difficult past with his family. Together, they travel to South Korea so Hae Suk can share his story with Kaelyn.

episodes.title: France: Say Their Names
episodes.description: Twenty years ago, Philippe left his homeland in the South of France. Now, he and his daughter, Valentine, travel back to uncover the truth about their family & reconnect with the vibrant French culture.

episodes.title: Trinidad: That's the Love
episodes.description: Andy and his daughter Alexandria travel to Andy’s home country of Trinidad. As they visit with family and friends, Alexandria learns about her father’s complicated childhood and Andy tries to reconcile with his feelings toward his father.

episodes.title: Kosovo: The Cry of Man is Singing
episodes.description: As a young journalist, Naser witnessed the atrocities of the war in Kosovo, his home country. Now, his fifteen-year-old son, Ander, feels his father has unresolved pain around his experiences. Together, the two travel back to Kosovo.

episodes.title: Vietnam: Pearls of the Dragon
episodes.description: Amy’s father, Dan, escaped the Vietnam War when he was a young boy. Amy knows little about her dad’s past and wishes she could connect with him better. Together, they travel to Vietnam to explore the country and Dan’s history.

episodes.title: Romania: A Secret Departure
episodes.description: Aleck cherishes his Romanian roots but is unaware of his mom’s past. After secretly escaping communist rule, Gabriela doesn’t talk about her life in Romania. Now, ready to open up, she takes Aleck to Romania to seek closure and embrace his identity.

episodes.title: Northern Ireland: Waves of Trouble
episodes.description: Bill grew up in the epicenter of Northern Ireland’s bloody conflict. Sophie, Bill’s teenage daughter, grew up in Canada and doesn’t feel connected to her Irish roots. Ready to help her dad heal, Sophie travels back to Northern Ireland with Bill.

episodes.title: Vietnam: The Kite Flies Free
episodes.description: Hannah escaped Vietnam during the war, leaving most of her family behind. Decades later, her trauma has clouded memories of her past. Now her daughter, Kyana, is seeking answers about her identity. Together they travel to Vietnam to find answers.

episodes.title: Kenya: Home Is a Feeling
episodes.description: Jamila is Kenyan-Canadian & feels very disconnected from her culture. Recently reunited with her dad, Abdul, after years apart, she’ll travel to Kenya with him to uncover her Kenyan identity and strengthen their relationship.

episodes.title: Tonga: Tomorrow Is Never Promised
episodes.description: Harboring resentment towards his father, Pasi hopes that traveling with him to native Tonga will provide a way for the two to make peace with their turbulent past.

episodes.title: Japan: Unmasking The Past
episodes.description: Knowing little of her Japanese heritage, Lacey travels to Japan with her father to reconnect with the sights, sounds, and flavors of his childhood.

episodes.title: Latvia: Newfound Family
episodes.description: Twins Ashley and Anthony grapple with the unresolved pain of their mother’s decision to leave her homeland of Latvia.

episodes.title: Thailand: Mom’s Home Cooking
episodes.description: On a trip to Thailand, Tyler uncovers his mother Diane's vibrant past and her deep culinary roots, while exploring her private connection to Buddhism and bridging the emotional distance left by grief and loss.

episodes.title: Poland: Secrets Revealed
episodes.description: Tula was shocked to learn of her mother’s bleak childhood with food rationing and poor living conditions under communism in Świdnica, Poland. Now with Tula hungry to know everything about her mother’s life, the two of them travel to Poland together.

episodes.title: Philippines: Voice of Generations
episodes.description: Angelina meets her Filipino family for the first time and discovers the hidden grief her mother carried for decades.

episodes.title: Germany: Where Do I Belong?
episodes.description: Wracked with generational guilt over her great-grandparents’ Nazi ties, Sarah and her father journey to the former East Germany, where she finds hope in ways she never expected.

episodes.title: Greece: Home is Here
episodes.description: Georgia’s mother parted from her parents in Greece on bad terms at only sixteen years old. Now, Georgia is desperate to connect with her Greek heritage and to have a better relationship with her own mother.

310c4552-199f-4cc7-9ef3-4d2e252d9e58.description: A broadcast for Primary children, featuring music, activities, and messages.

episodes.title: Following Jesus
episodes.description: Join children around the world to learn about following Jesus. Joined by Sisters Susan H. Porter, Amy A. Wright, and Tracy Y. Browning of the Primary General Presidency, and President Dallin H. Oaks and his wife Sister Kristen Oaks.

episodes.title: Sharing the Love of Jesus with Others
episodes.description: Watch and listen to stories from children all around the world about how they share the love of Jesus. Joined by Sisters Susan H. Porter, Amy A. Wright, and Tracy Y. Browning of the Primary General Presidency, and Elder Jeffrey R. Holland.

episodes.title: Sharing Jesus's Love Through Service with Elder Bednar
episodes.description: Fun, engaging content made just for kids — with music, stories from children around the world, inspirational messages and a visit from Louie the Toucan.

episodes.title: Sharing Jesus's Love Through Service with Elder Kearon
episodes.description: Join Elder Patrick Kearon of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles, Sister Jennifer Kearon, and the Primary General Presidency to learn about sharing the love of Jesus through serving others.

episodes.title: Prophets Guide Us to Heavenly Father and Jesus Christ
episodes.description: Special messages for children by Elder Gerrit W. Gong of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles, Sister Susan Gong, and the Primary General Presidency.

episodes.title: The Family Is of God
episodes.description: The Family Is of God invites children and their families into warm, personal conversations about God's love, our divine worth, and the bonds that connect us. Through stories and real families, kids learn they belong to God's family.

episodes.title: Central Arkansas vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU opened the season with an 88–50 win over Central Arkansas behind Egor Demin’s 18 points and 11-assist debut. Strong defense, depth, and ball movement highlighted a promising start under coach Kevin Young.

episodes.title: UC Riverside vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU held off UC Riverside 86–80 behind Egor Demin’s 20 points, dominating the paint 48–14 but struggling with free throws and defense as a veteran Riverside team kept the game close.

episodes.title: Queens vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU beat Queens 99–55 to move to 3–0, led by Dawson Baker’s 22 points, strong bench scoring, and 25 assists. The Cougars showed depth, rebounding dominance, and balanced offense in a commanding win.

episodes.title: Idaho vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU beat Idaho 95–71 to move to 4–0, led by Traore’s 29 points, Saunders’ 26, and Demin’s 16. Defense sparked a second-half run with 19 forced turnovers and strong ball movement.

episodes.title: Fresno State vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU beat Fresno State 95–67 behind Trevor Knell’s 22-point, 10-rebound double-double, strong shooting, and balanced scoring, while improving defensively and building momentum for Big 12 play.

episodes.title: Flordia A&M vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU crushed Florida A&M 103–57 to finish nonconference 9–2, led by Kanon Catchings’ 21 points. Strong ball movement, rebounding dominance, and improved defense highlighted a complete team performance.

episodes.title: Arizona State vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU beat Arizona State by 20 in its Big 12 opener, led by Richie Saunders’ 30 points. Strong defense, rebounding, and ball movement powered a complete performance and statement win at home.

episodes.title: Texas Tech vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU lost 72–67 to Texas Tech, undone by poor shooting, missed free throws, and late execution errors as the Red Raiders closed strong behind Darian Williams.

episodes.title: Oklahoma State vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU beat Oklahoma State 85–69 to end a three-game skid, led by Trevor Knell, Dallin Hall, and Egor Demin. Strong ball movement, rebounding, and composure helped the Cougars close after a tight second half.

episodes.title: Cincinnati vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU beat Cincinnati 80–52 with a dominant second half, powered by Richie Saunders, Egor Demin, and strong shooting. The Cougars used depth, defense, and ball movement to even their Big 12 record.

episodes.title: Baylor vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU beat Baylor in overtime behind Kanon Catchings’ perfect 23-point night and strong play from Richie Saunders. The Cougars used balance, clutch defense, and execution to secure a key Big 12 win.

episodes.title: Arizona vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU lost 85–74 to Arizona after a late scoring drought, missing nine straight shots. Egor Demin led with 16 points, but poor shooting and Arizona’s balanced offense and defense proved too much.

episodes.title: Kansas State vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU beat Kansas State 80–65 with elite defense and depth, ending a six-game K-State streak. Richie Saunders had a double-double, while the bench delivered 41 points in a key Big 12 resume win.

episodes.title: Kansas vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU dominated No. 23 Kansas 91–57 with elite ball movement, defense, and shooting. Richie Saunders led a balanced attack as the Cougars recorded 24 assists and forced turnovers in a statement win.

episodes.title: West Virginia vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU beat West Virginia 77–56 with a 52-point second half, led by Richie Saunders’ spark and Fousseyni Traore’s inside dominance, showing depth and versatility despite limited three-point shooting.

episodes.title: Utah vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU beat Utah 85–74 with a strong second-half surge, using paint scoring and defense to overcome early struggles. Egor Demin and Richie Saunders led an intense rivalry win and eighth straight victory.

episodes.title: BYU vs Villanova
episodes.description: BYU beat Villanova 71–66 behind AJ Dybantsa’s debut and strong play from Saunders and Wright. Despite rebounding struggles and missed shots, physicality, defense, and clutch execution secured the win.

episodes.title: Delaware vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU rallied past Delaware 85–68 with a huge second half, led by Rob Wright’s near triple-double and 26 points each from Wright and Richie Saunders, as the Cougars used shooting and adjustments to pull away.

episodes.title: UC Riverside vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU crushed UC Riverside 100–53 behind AJ Dybantsa’s 26 points and strong shooting. Ball movement, defense, and 36 bench points fueled a dominant performance to move the Cougars to 9–1.

episodes.title: Pacific vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU beat Pacific 93–57 with a dominant second half, led by Saunders, Dybantsa, and Wright. Defense, steals, and transition sparked the surge, while the big three combined for 69 points in a complete win.

episodes.title: Abilene Christian vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU beat Abilene Christian 85–67 behind AJ Dybantsa’s 35 points and dominant free throw shooting. The Cougars overcame turnovers and physical play with defense and a big three that carried the scoring load.

episodes.title: Eastern Washington vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU beat Eastern Washington 109–81 behind AJ Dybantsa’s historic 33-10-10 triple-double. Strong offense, big three scoring, and second-half defensive adjustments powered a dominant finish.

episodes.title: Arizona State vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU crushed Arizona State 104–76 behind 81 points from Saunders, Wright, and Dybantsa. Fast break offense, strong defense, and elite shooting powered a dominant Big 12 home performance

episodes.title: TCU vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU beat TCU 76–70 with a second-half surge, led by AJ Dybantsa’s 25 points despite illness. The Cougars relied on rebounding, toughness, and big three scoring to overcome poor shooting and stay undefeated in Big 12 play.

episodes.title: Utah vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU beat Utah 91–78 behind AJ Dybantsa’s 43-point record night. A dominant second half, rebounding edge, and big three scoring powered a rivalry win despite Utah’s hot shooting.

episodes.title: Arizona vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU lost 86–83 to No. 1 Arizona after rallying from 19 down, with AJ Dybantsa scoring 24. A late comeback fell short as Arizona’s guard play and free throw advantage proved decisive

episodes.title: Houston vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU lost 77–66 to Houston despite AJ Dybantsa’s 28 points, undone by missed free throws, rebounding struggles, and only five bench points, as improved defense wasn’t enough late

episodes.title: Colorado vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU beat Colorado 90–86 in OT on Jimmer Fredette night, led by Rob Wright’s 39 points. AJ Dybantsa added all-around play, while the Cougars adjusted after Richie Saunders’ early injury to earn a key win.

episodes.title: Iowa State vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU beat No. 6 Iowa State 79–69 behind AJ Dybantsa’s 29-10-9 performance. Defense, rebounding, and paint dominance powered a statement Quad 1 win and one of the team’s most complete efforts.

episodes.title: UCF vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU lost 97–84 to UCF after allowing 14 threes and 56% shooting. AJ Dybantsa scored 29, but poor defense, low assist numbers, and Richie Saunders’ absence led to a one-sided Big 12 loss.

episodes.title: Texas Tech vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU beat No. 10 Texas Tech 82–76 with a strong second-half comeback. Rob Wright scored 27, AJ Dybantsa added 21, and the Cougars used rebounding, defense, and effort to secure a key top-10 win.
