3f064141-65f1-4f5f-9254-3a21b628ad1c.description: Six primary school students and their teacher narrate a comedic mockumentary about playground adventures with hijinks and imagination.

episodes.title: The Principal's Office
episodes.description: Rory is sent to the Principal's office.

episodes.title: The Dress Up Day
episodes.description: Battie dresses up as his own made-up superhero, Stretcho.

episodes.title: The Ya Ya
episodes.description: While Atticus' parents are away, his Ya-Ya (grandmother) looks after him.

episodes.title: The Monkey Bars
episodes.description: Tamara wants the monkey bars to herself, so she forbids Melanie from getting a turn. This triggers a dispute between them.

episodes.title: The Top of The Fireman's Pole
episodes.description: The kids must rescue Mrs. Gonsha from the playground.

episodes.title: The Lost and Found Box
episodes.description: The children discover their lost belongings.

episodes.title: The Milk Bar
episodes.description: Rory forgets his lunch and goes to the milk bar.

episodes.title: The Girls' Toilets
episodes.description: Melanie's friends stop speaking.

episodes.title: The Kiss Chasey Oval
episodes.description: Tamara tries to convince Battie to play a chase-and-kiss game that doesn't go as planned, so she tries a different approach.

episodes.title: The Thing in the Sand
episodes.description: Melanie thinks she discovered a possum's head in the sand.

episodes.title: The Band
episodes.description: Bored during a rainy little lunch, Atticus starts a band and makes Battie reluctantly join too.

episodes.title: The Beep Test
episodes.description: Tamara is excited about doing the beep test fitness assessment, but after she sprains her ankle she can't join in.

episodes.title: The Joke Competition
episodes.description: Atticus holds a joke telling competition.

episodes.title: The Old Climbing Tree
episodes.description: Debra Jo wants the old climbing tree chopped down.

episodes.title: The Oval
episodes.description: Rory wants other kids to play with him so devises an elaborate and confusing ball game on the oval.

episodes.title: The Pavlova
episodes.description: For the birthday party of Max and Elsa, Mrs. Gonsha makes a pavlova, which looks delicious.

episodes.title: The Germblock
episodes.description: Tamara accuses Melanie of not washing her hands, so Atticus and Debra-Jo investigate what happened.

episodes.title: The Grandparent's Day
episodes.description: Mrs. Gonsha asks Battie's grandfather to be the guest of honor at the Grandparent's Day celebration.

episodes.title: The Cake Stall
episodes.description: When Melanie decides to have a cake stall to raise money for homeless puppies, Atticus gets jealous and sets up a rival fundraiser.

episodes.title: The Walk-Athon
episodes.description: The children face the difficult task of finding the right partner to be their walking buddy for the walk-a-thon.

episodes.title: The Windy Day
episodes.description: Mrs. Gonsha insists the class comes inside and does yoga, much to Debra-Jo's horror.

episodes.title: The Body Bus
episodes.description: After the kids think they see a health van in the playground, Debra-Jo becomes anxious that she has head lice.

episodes.title: The Election
episodes.description:
When Rory announces that he wants to be the Prime-Minister, Mrs Gonsha
suggests they have their own election and that everyone run a campaign.

episodes.title: The Corridor Outside 6 E
episodes.description: When the weird twins suddenly leave class, rumors begin.

episodes.title: The Gap Behind the Dumpster
episodes.description: Atticus tries to start a secret club with Rory.

episodes.title: The Relationship
episodes.description: Rory is confused when a grade six girl likes him.

episodes.title: The Halloween Horror Story
episodes.description: Atticus is excited to be starring in the Halloween play at school, but he finds out that the day of the play will be his last day of school because his mother got a new job in Singapore.

episodes.title: The Nightmare Before Graduation
episodes.description: Mrs. Gonsha's class is is excited about going to high school, but they learn that Rory is unable to graduate with them.

42cebad4-c80b-48f0-9492-be6253a9f55f.description: Emmy Award–winner: A British ghost seeks redemption with aid from unlikely allies.

episodes.title: Spring
episodes.description: The Otis family moves into an abandoned mansion that comes with its own mysteries. As they get to know their new neighbors, they also meet the angry ghost of Sir Simon de Canterville (Anthony Head).

episodes.title: Summer
episodes.description: Sir Simon steps up his efforts to terrorize the Americans, but the Otis family refuses to be frightened. And when the Otises are challenged by Lady Deborah to host a local cricket match, everyone braces for a royal embarrassment.

episodes.title: Autumn
episodes.description: The haunter becomes the hunted as the Otis kids attempt to capture Sir Simon. And after Hiram receives devastating news, Lucy is determined not to wallow in the loss and resolves to host a Christmas ball.

episodes.title: Winter
episodes.description: Virginia must summon all her courage to defend Sir Simon in the court of the dead. Meanwhile the twins search for buried treasure, but things go terribly wrong. Past and present collide in this stirring conclusion to the miniseries.

4385ae57-b5d7-4dcc-9bfe-ba907bbe5a27.description: The Rotation brings together Big 12 talent and personalities to lead authentic conversations at the intersection of sports and business

episodes.title: The Game Has Changed
episodes.description: King McClure launches The Rotation with Jaden Owens, Cat Osterman, Olivia Petnicki, Alex Glover-Jemison and Diljeet Taylor for a candid conversation about college athletics, culture and life beyond sports.

48836059-8b1d-49e7-a67c-d1e3f31e4dde.description: A collection of new documentary series chronicling and exploring the varied works of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints

episodes.title: People of Faith: Pioneers of Brazil
episodes.description: From humble beginnings with only a few members, the Church in Brazil has grown into a thriving community of faith. This episode highlights the resilience, devotion, and gratitude of its members as they face life’s challenges.

episodes.title: People of Faith: Pioneers of Hawaii
episodes.description: Celeste Ha'o, Mufi Hannemann, and Ryan Tanaka share pivotal moments and personal stories from their lives as members of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints in Hawai'i, revealing how faith shapes their journeys and daily experiences.

episodes.title: People of Faith: Pioneers of the Philippines
episodes.description: Lani Misalucha, Lilian Villamor, and Alex Castillo share key moments in their faith journeys and everyday life as members of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints in the Philippines, showing how faith shapes and inspires them daily.

episodes.title: Harvest of Faith: Welfare Farms
episodes.description: From Idaho to Texas, welfare farms grow more than crops. They cultivate healing, miracles, and hope. Deep bonds bring strength through loss, orchards defy nature, and volunteers uplift communities. Every harvest helps feed the world -- and hearts.

episodes.title: Harvest of Faith: Processing & Distribution
episodes.description: Staffed almost entirely by volunteers, welfare facilities transform donated crops into life-saving goods. From miracles in mills to  factories, witness how service, sacrifice, and faith fuel a global mission to care for God’s children.

episodes.title: Harvest of Faith: AgReserves
episodes.description: Across Brazil, Washington, and Chile, for-profit farms power a greater purpose, funding a global humanitarian mission. From life-changing education to tech innovation and national sustainability, witness AgReserves' farms transform lives and futures.

episodes.title: Voices of Faith: In Defense of Religious Freedom
episodes.description: Stories from LDS members in Ghana, Rabbi Diana Gerson, Professor Robert P. George, and leading scholars reveal the challenges facing religious freedom and the determined efforts to uphold faith amid global threats.

episodes.title: Voices for Faith: An Approach of Religious Freedom
episodes.description: A compassionate exploration of religious freedom through the personal faith stories of Kori Porter, Dean G. Marcus Cole, Asma T. Uddin, Simmer Singh, and other respected scholars and thought leaders.

episodes.title: Voices for Faith: Joined in Religious Freedom
episodes.description: A hopeful look at the strength found in unity for religious freedom, shared through the personal faith stories of Marian Edmonds-Allen, Amos C. Brown, the Commission of Religious Leaders in New York City, and Elder Quentin L. Cook.

497f9c62-98e0-48ba-bc42-e97620a031ef.description: Host Ben Lomu and special guests study the concepts and doctrines from the sacred scriptures. A companion to the Come, Follow Me resource.

4b703b20-daeb-47c2-8cfc-192352ffb3b5.description: Comedian Joel Creasey and dog expert Laura V are on a mission to rescue pound dogs and pair them with a family in need of a hound.

episodes.title: Ringo
episodes.description: In their search to find Paul a rescue dog, Joel and Laura are drawn to Ringo - a vocal young German Shepherd/Siberian Husky-cross. He is both big and black, and the hardest type of dog to rehome.

episodes.title: Memphis
episodes.description: Memphis faces being euthanized unless the right foster carer can be found. No-one can get close to this seemingly aggressive hound except Derek. Can Laura and Joel win Memphis' trust and help find Memphis a new home?

episodes.title: Jade
episodes.description: After a terrible accident, Tracy is looking for a canine to restore purpose in her life again. She's open to any dog as long as it's not a small, yappy dog. Can she overcome her aversion to a pint-sized pair?

episodes.title: Arty
episodes.description: Grieving migrant nurse, Rosey, wants to get a large rescue dog to help fill the void of losing her husband. Will big, beautiful but very anxious Arty be too much for first-time dog owner Rosey to handle?

episodes.title: Bailey
episodes.description: Host Joel Creasey and dog expert Laura V help loved up couple, Ian and Gail who need a small dog to keep lonely Ian company while Gail's at work.

episodes.title: Scout
episodes.description: After a series of traumatic and tragic events, newlyweds Ned and Gabriella want to start a new chapter with a dog who'll give them comfort and joy. Will they connect with Scout, the handsome comedian of a dog?

episodes.title: Silent Night
episodes.description: A BYUtv Original Movie about the true story behind the most popular Christmas carol of all time. As a priest in Austria, Joseph Mohr was inspired by those he met in his ministry. Together with Franz Gruber, he spread God's word in song.

episodes.title: Central Arkansas vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU tips off its season opener against Central Arkansas under new coach Kevin Young, debuting a talent-rich roster led by top recruits and transfers, with high expectations and a new balanced, NBA-style approach.

episodes.title: UC Riverside vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU faces UC Riverside in game two after an 88–50 opener, led by freshmen Egor Demin and Kanon Catchings, whose standout debut highlights a fast, NBA-style system under new coach Kevin Young.

episodes.title: Queens vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU hosts Queens at 2–0, led by standout freshman Egor Demin and dominant big Keba Keita. The Cougars aim to improve shooting, defense, and chemistry against a fast-paced, three-point-heavy opponent.

episodes.title: Idaho vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU, 3–0, faces Idaho behind freshman star Egor Demin and dominant rebounding from Keita and Traore, combining elite shooting, depth, and strong early momentum while continuing to improve defense and consistency.

episodes.title: Fresno State vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU, 6–2, hosts fast-paced Fresno State with Egor Demin sidelined, while Dallin Hall steps up. The spotlight also centers on AJ Dybantsa’s signing, signaling major momentum for the program.

episodes.title: Florida A&M vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU hosts Florida A&M in its final nonconference game, leaning on depth and rebounding while managing injuries to key players. The Cougars aim to sharpen defense and chemistry ahead of Big 12 play.

episodes.title: Arizona State vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU opens Big 12 play vs Arizona State at 9–2, with Egor Demin and Richie Saunders returning to lead a deep, rebounding-driven Cougars team against a defensive, shot-blocking Sun Devils squad.

episodes.title: Texas Tech vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU returns home to face Texas Tech after a tough loss at Houston, aiming for a 15th straight home win. The Cougars must improve rebounding, guard play, and defense against one of the nation’s top offensive teams.

episodes.title: Oklahoma State vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU hosts Oklahoma State needing to end a three-game skid, focusing on limiting turnovers, improving defense, and boosting effort, with lineup changes and strong urgency in a key Big 12 matchup.

episodes.title: Cincinnati vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU hosts Cincinnati in a must-win Big 12 matchup, relying on elite three-point shooting, Richie Saunders’ scoring, and Egor Demin’s playmaking to challenge one of the nation’s top defensive teams.

episodes.title: Baylor vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU faces Baylor in a key Big 12 matchup, seeking its first Quad 1 win after a dominant victory over Cincinnati, with momentum, strong shooting, and home-court advantage fueling the Cougars.

episodes.title: Arizona vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU hosts No. 20 Arizona on a four-game win streak, facing a red-hot Wildcats team led by Caleb Love, with both teams battling for Big 12 position and a key Quad 1 opportunity.

episodes.title: Kansas State vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU hosts Kansas State in a key Big 12 showdown as the Wildcats enter on a six-game win streak. With tournament stakes rising, the Cougars rely on bench depth, rebounding edge, and Egor Demin’s playmaking.

episodes.title: Kansas vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU hosts Kansas in a major Big 12 matchup with both teams 17–8, as the Cougars seek a Quad 1 win behind strong bench play and home crowd energy against a defensive Jayhawks squad led by Hunter Dickinson.

episodes.title: West Virginia vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU hosts West Virginia ranked No. 25 on a five-game win streak, led by Richie Saunders and Egor Demin, using elite shooting, depth, and fast pace to challenge a defensive, slow-tempo opponent.

episodes.title: Utah vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU hosts Utah in a sold-out rivalry finale, riding a seven-game win streak and strong momentum. Led by Richie Saunders and deep rotation play, the Cougars seek revenge while building toward postseason success.

episodes.title: BYU vs Villanova
episodes.description: No. 8 BYU opens vs Villanova with top recruit AJ Dybantsa, transfer PG Rob Wright, and star Richie Saunders, combining elite talent and high expectations while focusing on chemistry, defense, and team identity.

episodes.title: Delaware vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU, ranked No. 7, hosts Delaware led by AJ Dybantsa, Richie Saunders, and Rob Wright. The Cougars aim to improve shooting, rebounding, and chemistry while building momentum before a key matchup with UConn.

episodes.title: UC Riverside vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU returns home at 8–1 after a historic 22-point comeback vs Clemson, led by AJ Dybantsa and Rob Wright. The Cougars aim to improve early execution while maintaining momentum against UC Riverside.

episodes.title: Pacific vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU hosts Pacific at the Marriott Center riding momentum from a dominant 100–53 win over UC Riverside, highlighted by 59% shooting and a season-high 36 bench points. Ranked No. 10 with a top-10 national profile, the Cougars are led by freshman star A

episodes.title: Abilene Christian vs BYU
episodes.description: No. 10 BYU hosts Abilene Christian at 10–1, led by AJ Dybantsa and a dominant “big three,” while relying on strong defense, rising bench play, and depth as injuries test the lineup.

episodes.title: Eastern Washington vs BYU
episodes.description: No. 10 BYU hosts Eastern Washington at 11–1, led by AJ Dybantsa’s dominant play and a high-powered “big three,” while adding G League big Abdullah Ahmed in a final test before Big 12 action.

episodes.title: Arizona State vs BYU
episodes.description: No. 9 BYU hosts Arizona State in its Big 12 home opener at 13–1, led by AJ Dybantsa and strong team play, facing an injury-hit Sun Devils squad while emphasizing rebounding, defense, and ball movement.

episodes.title: TCU vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU hosts TCU after a rivalry win over Utah, riding a 12-game streak behind Saunders, Wright, and Dybantsa. The Cougars face a physical, defensive challenge while focusing on rebounding, defense, and ball control.

episodes.title: Utah vs BYU
episodes.description: No. 13 BYU hosts rival Utah after a tough loss at Texas Tech, aiming to improve shooting and execution. Led by AJ Dybantsa, the Cougars rely on home-court energy in a high-stakes Big 12 rivalry matchup.

episodes.title: Arizona vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU hosts No. 1 Arizona (20–0) in a marquee matchup. The Wildcats bring elite balance and paint dominance, while AJ Dybantsa, Rob Wright, and Richie Saunders lead BYU in a high-stakes showdown.

episodes.title: Houston vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU hosts No. 8 Houston seeking to end a three-game skid, facing elite defense and rebounding. AJ Dybantsa leads the Cougars, who must improve defense, handle pressure, and play with urgency.

episodes.title: Colorado vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU hosts Colorado on Jimmer Fredette jersey retirement night, building on a Baylor win behind AJ Dybantsa’s hot streak, while focusing on defense and rebounding against a deep but inconsistent Buffs team.

episodes.title: Iowa State vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU hosts No. 6 Iowa State seeking a major win without Richie Saunders, led by scoring leader AJ Dybantsa. Turnovers, rebounding, and support scoring are key against an elite Cyclones team.

episodes.title: UCF vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU hosts UCF in a key Big 12 matchup after a win over No. 6 Iowa State, led by scoring leader AJ Dybantsa. With both teams tied in the standings, rebounding, defense, and avoiding a letdown are critical.

episodes.title: Texas Tech vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU hosts No. 10 Texas Tech on senior night, aiming to end a three-game skid and build momentum. Led by scoring leader AJ Dybantsa, the Cougars seek a statement win while honoring injured star Richie Saunders.

episodes.title: Southern Illinois vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU opened its season with a 41-13 win over Southern Illinois led by Jake Retzlaff’s 348 passing yards and three touchdowns The Cougars totaled over 500 yards controlled possession and showed improved chemistry and defense.

episodes.title: BYU vs SMU
episodes.description: BYU defeated SMU 18-15 in a defensive showdown holding the Mustangs without a touchdown The Cougars relied on clutch special teams and key stops late to secure the win and improve to 2-0.

episodes.title: BYU vs Wyoming
episodes.description: BYU defeated Wyoming 34-14 to improve to 3-0 led by strong defense big plays and a kickoff return touchdown The Cougars controlled the game and now prepare for a Big 12 matchup with Kansas State.

episodes.title: Kansas State vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU dominated 13th ranked Kansas State 38-9 behind strong defense turnovers and a punt return touchdown The Cougars forced three takeaways allowed no touchdowns and improved to 4-0 with a statement win.

episodes.title: BYU vs Baylor
episodes.description: BYU defeated Baylor 34-28 to improve to 5-0 starting fast before holding on late The defense sealed the win with a key interception as the offense slowed in the second half but showed resilience on the road.

episodes.title: Arizona vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU beat Arizona 41-19 to reach 6-0 forcing four turnovers and scoring 24 points off them Jake Retzlaff led a balanced offense while the defense dominated with interceptions and key stops in a strong team win.

episodes.title: Oklahoma State vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU rallied to beat Oklahoma State 38-35 with a last minute touchdown drive Jake Retzlaff led the comeback and Darius Lassiter caught the game winner as the Cougars overcame turnovers to improve to 7-0.

episodes.title: BYU vs UCF
episodes.description: BYU beat UCF 37-24 to move to 8-0 controlling the game with strong rushing defense and balanced offense Jake Retzlaff led efficiently while the Cougars dominated time of possession and made key plays.

episodes.title: BYU vs Utah
episodes.description: BYU beat Utah 22-21 on a last second 44 yard field goal completing a comeback after a key penalty kept the drive alive The Cougars shut out Utah in the second half and improved to 9-0 with resilience and clutch play

episodes.title: Kansas vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU lost to Kansas 17-13 ending its unbeaten season despite strong defense turnovers and missed red zone chances proved costly as the Cougars outgained Kansas but failed to finish drives late

episodes.title: BYU vs Arizona State
episodes.description: BYU lost 28-23 to Arizona State after a second half comeback fell short A final Hail Mary was caught at the two yard line as mistakes slow start and missed chances prevented a comeback win

episodes.title: Houston vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU beat Houston 30-18 to finish 10-2 in a turnover filled game The defense led the way with key plays while the offense struggled for consistency after halftime as the Cougars secured a share of the Big 12 title

episodes.title: BYU vs Colorado
episodes.description: BYU beat Colorado 36-14 in the Alamo Bowl behind dominant defense and special teams big plays The Cougars held Colorado to two rushing yards and controlled the game to finish 11-2 with a statement win

episodes.title: Portland State vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU dominated Portland State 69-0 behind 600 total yards and a powerful run game Freshman QB Bear Bachmeier had 5 TDs while the defense held PSU to just 51 yards in a complete team performance

episodes.title: Stanford vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU beat Stanford 27-3 behind dominant defense holding the Cardinal to 19 rushing yards Bear Bachmeier managed the game without turnovers while LJ Martin led with 110 rushing yards in a strong team win

episodes.title: BYU vs East Carolina
episodes.description: BYU beat East Carolina 34-13 to improve to 3-0 as freshman QB Bear Bachmeier threw for 246 yards with no turnovers while LJ Martin topped 100 yards and the defense led by Evan Johnson forced key turnovers

episodes.title: BYU vs Colorado
episodes.description: BYU beat Colorado 24-21 rallying from 14-0 behind Bear Bachmeier’s dual threat play and strong defense Isaiah Glasker sealed the win with a late interception as the Cougars stayed perfect at 4-0

episodes.title: West Virginia vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU beat West Virginia 38-24 to move to 5-0 as Bear Bachmeier threw for 351 yards The Cougars had explosive plays but turnovers and penalties kept the game close despite strong defense and key stops

episodes.title: BYU vs Arizona
episodes.description: BYU beat Arizona 33-27 in double overtime rallying from a 10 point deficit Bear Bachmeier led the comeback while the defense made key stops late as the Cougars improved to 6-0 with a resilient road win

episodes.title: Utah vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU beat Utah 24-21 to move to 7-0 behind a strong fourth quarter comeback Bear Bachmeier led with two rushing TDs while the defense forced turnovers and key stops to secure a third straight rivalry win

episodes.title: BYU vs Iowa State
episodes.description: BYU beat Iowa State 41-27 rallying from 24-10 behind Bear Bachmeier’s 307 yards and three TDs The Cougars forced four turnovers including a pick six and dominated the second half to improve to 8-0

episodes.title: BYU vs Texas Tech
episodes.description: BYU fell 29–7 to Texas Tech in a top-10 clash marked by turnovers, poor field position, and stalled offense. Coaches and players cited execution issues but remain optimistic, emphasizing improvement and future opportunities.

episodes.title: TCU vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU beat TCU 44–13 behind Bear Bachmeier’s 296 passing yards and two total touchdowns. The Cougars scored on seven straight drives, forced turnovers, and held TCU to 1-of-10 on third down to improve to 9–1.

episodes.title: BYU vs Cincinnati
episodes.description: BYU beat Cincinnati 26–14 behind 222 rushing yards from LJ Martin and a strong defensive performance. The Cougars improved to 10–1, controlling the game with physical play, clean execution, and key turnovers.

episodes.title: UCF vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU rallied from a 14–0 deficit to beat UCF 41–21, finishing 11–1 and undefeated at home. Bachmeier led efficiently, Martin scored three TDs, and Kingston added a punt return TD as the Cougars advance to the Big 12 title game.

episodes.title: BYU vs Texas Tech
episodes.description: BYU lost 34–7 to Texas Tech in the Big 12 title game, undone by turnovers and poor field position. After an early score, the offense stalled as the Red Raiders capitalized on mistakes and controlled the game.

episodes.title: BYU vs Georgia Tech
episodes.description: BYU rallied to beat Georgia Tech 25–21 in the Pop Tarts Bowl, scoring 15 fourth-quarter points. Bachmeier threw for 325 yards and earned MVP honors, while Evan Johnson sealed the win with a late interception.

episodes.title: Southern Illinois vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU opens its season vs. Southern Illinois with renewed focus after a tough 2023 finish. With Jake Retzlaff at QB and improved health, the Cougars aim to play disciplined football and build momentum in year two of the Big 12.

episodes.title: BYU vs SMU
episodes.description: BYU faces SMU in Dallas aiming to end a five-game road skid. Underdogs rely on QB Jake Retzlaff and disciplined defense against a high-powered Mustangs offense. Fast start and limiting mistakes are key.

episodes.title: BYU vs Wyoming
episodes.description: BYU travels to Wyoming in a rivalry clash, focusing on ball security and defensive strength. Injuries shift the run game to Miles Davis, while the Cougars aim to exploit a struggling Cowboys offense.

episodes.title: Kansas State vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU (3–0) hosts No. 13 Kansas State in a key Big 12 opener. With a top defense, strong night-game history, and growing confidence, the Cougars aim to prove themselves against a run-heavy Wildcats team.

episodes.title: BYU vs Baylor
episodes.description: No. 22 BYU travels to Baylor at 4–0 after a dominant win over Kansas State. With strong defense, explosive special teams, and growing confidence, the Cougars aim to prove Big 12 contender status on the road.

episodes.title: Arizona vs BYU
episodes.description: No. 14 BYU hosts Arizona undefeated and in the national spotlight. With Jake Retzlaff leading and key players returning, the Cougars aim to prove contender status against a dangerous Wildcats offense.

episodes.title: Oklahoma State vs BYU
episodes.description: No. 13 BYU (6–0) hosts Oklahoma State in Provo under the lights. With a dominant defense, strong culture, and energized home crowd, the Cougars aim to stay unbeaten against a struggling Cowboys team.

episodes.title: BYU vs UCF
episodes.description: No. 11 BYU (7–0) travels to UCF riding a win streak and playoff buzz. With a strong run game and disciplined defense, the Cougars aim to stay unbeaten while stopping UCF’s explosive rushing attack.

episodes.title: BYU vs Utah
episodes.description: The BYU–Utah rivalry returns for its 96th meeting, with BYU undefeated and No. 9 in the CFP. Utah struggles offensively, while emotion, turnovers, and a fast start shape this intense, historic matchup.

episodes.title: Kansas vs BYU
episodes.description: No. 6 BYU (9–0) hosts Kansas after a thrilling Utah win, aiming for 10–0 and Big 12 control. With strong home-field advantage and cold conditions, the Cougars must execute, start fast, and handle pressure.

episodes.title: BYU vs Arizona State
episodes.description: BYU faces Arizona State in a pivotal Big 12 clash with championship hopes on the line. After a recent loss, the Cougars must fix red zone issues, rely on QB Jake Retzlaff, and execute against a disciplined Sun Devils team.

episodes.title: Houston vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU hosts Houston on Senior Night needing a win to stay in the Big 12 title hunt and secure 10 wins. After a strong season and recent slide, the Cougars must limit turnovers, start fast, and rely on senior leadership.

episodes.title: BYU vs Colorado
episodes.description: No. 17 BYU faces No. 23 Colorado in the Alamo Bowl after a breakout 10–2 season. With Jake Retzlaff and key playmakers, the Cougars meet Heisman winner Travis Hunter in a high-profile matchup.

episodes.title: Portland State vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU opens the 2025 season vs Portland State with a sold-out crowd and a true freshman QB debut. With strong defense, deep skill positions, and growing Big 12 momentum, the Cougars aim to build on last year’s success.

episodes.title: Stanford vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU hosts Stanford in a sold-out night game, led by freshman QB Bear Bachmeier after his five-touchdown debut. With strong defense and LJ Martin’s run game, the Cougars aim to make a statement against a rebuilding Cardinal team.

episodes.title: BYU vs East Carolina
episodes.description: BYU visits East Carolina with the nation’s top defense and a freshman QB making his first road start. The Cougars must rely on LJ Martin, protect the ball, and handle a fast ECU offense in a challenging environment.

episodes.title: BYU vs Colorado
episodes.description: No. 25 BYU (3–0) opens Big 12 play at Colorado behind freshman QB Bear Bachmeier and a top-ranked defense. With LJ Martin’s run game and strong ball security, the Cougars aim to stay unbeaten.

episodes.title: West Virginia vs BYU
episodes.description: No. 23 BYU (4–0) hosts West Virginia under the lights, riding strong defense, ball security, and night-game dominance. Freshman QB Bear Bachmeier leads the Cougars against an injured but run-heavy Mountaineers team.

episodes.title: BYU vs Arizona
episodes.description: No. 18 BYU (5–0) heads to Arizona for a key Big 12 road test. Led by freshman QB Bear Bachmeier and a top defense, the Cougars face a strong Wildcats secondary in a game that will define their identity.

episodes.title: Utah vs BYU
episodes.description: No. 15 BYU hosts No. 23 Utah in the 97th rivalry meeting with Big 12 stakes on the line. Fueled by history and emotion, the Cougars rely on defense, run game, and QB Bear Bachmeier to face Utah’s physical attack.

episodes.title: BYU vs Iowa State
episodes.description: No. 11 BYU (7–0) faces Iowa State on the road, chasing an eighth straight win. Led by freshman QB Bear Bachmeier and RB LJ Martin, the Cougars must handle a hostile crowd and physical Cyclones team.

episodes.title: BYU vs Texas Tech
episodes.description: No. 7 BYU faces No. 8 Texas Tech in a historic top-10 clash with playoff stakes. Underdog Cougars rely on QB Bear Bachmeier, RB LJ Martin, and strong turnover margin to win in a hostile Lubbock environment.

episodes.title: TCU vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU Sports Nation Game Day is your inside access to BYU Football. Tune in before the game for behind-the-scenes access to coaches, players, fans, and expert analysis.

episodes.title: BYU vs Cincinnati
episodes.description: No. 11 BYU faces Cincinnati in a prime-time road clash with Big 12 and CFP stakes. With strong defense, a +8 turnover margin, and QB Bear Bachmeier’s poise, the Cougars aim to stay in control of their championship path.

episodes.title: UCF vs BYU
episodes.description: BYU hosts UCF on Senior Day at 10–1, seeking an undefeated home season and momentum before the Big 12 Championship. With freshman QB Bear Bachmeier and RB LJ Martin, fast starts and discipline are key.

episodes.title: BYU vs Texas Tech
episodes.description: No. 11 BYU faces No. 4 Texas Tech for the Big 12 title with a playoff berth at stake. Fueled by momentum, strong finishes, and perceived disrespect, the Cougars aim to avenge an earlier loss and prove they belong.

episodes.title: BYU vs Georgia Tech
episodes.description: No. 12 BYU (12–2) faces No. 22 Georgia Tech in the Pop-Tarts Bowl, seeking a 12th win. Without RB LJ Martin and with QB Bear Bachmeier limited, the Cougars rely on creativity, defense, and young playmakers.

61d20338-e6cd-4cf4-b60a-4154019da6a6.description: Stories of students transformed by faith through the power of religious education and guidance.

episodes.title: Paris
episodes.description: Growing up in Tuskegee, Alabama, Paris faced limited opportunities, until a knock on the door changed his life. A caring missionary believed in him, guiding Paris toward confidence, purpose, and a law degree from BYU.

episodes.title: Kareisha
episodes.description: Kareisha, an Afghanistan veteran and mother, overcame obstacles to graduate from Colorado Christian University. With faith and support, she proves that when life’s odds are against you, God’s support helps transform dreams into reality.

episodes.title: Nikki Maxon
episodes.description: Returning to the Arizona town she once struggled to leave, Nikki brings her daughter along for the ride. In facing her past, she sees how faith and education became the foundation of her future.

episodes.title: Arien Benadie
episodes.description: After losing her father and brother in South Africa and facing health challenges during COVID, Arien found support in Zimbabwe, which led her to BYU-Idaho, where she’s breaking family cycles and finding deep meaning in education.

episodes.title: Hinatea Ah Chookoon
episodes.description: Born on the small island of Huahine in Tahiti, Hinatea traveled by boat each day just to attend high school. With few expectations set before her, she dreamed of BYU–Hawaii. Through BYU–Pathway, that distant dream became reality.

episodes.title: Wilford Wu
episodes.description: Wilford grew up in China where his education had no elements of faith. Because he served a Church mission his university ambitions were dashed in China, but the iWORK program at BYU-Hawaii restored his ability to still seek higher education.

episodes.title: Jay Cannon
episodes.description: From failing first grade to failing out of college, Jay’s path was rocky. Though he loved learning, classrooms never fit, and faith felt unrelated. Marriage and spiritual renewal changed that. Now his faith fuels growth he once thought impossible.

episodes.title: Kyla Ford
episodes.description: Kyla loved going to school and had big college plans. But soon after high school found herself in a faith crisis. As a young mom with three little kids, she’d found the education she’d always dreamed of through BYU Pathway.

6c81fb38-f9a5-42aa-85a2-d81d7c15dcc5.description: Watch highlights from general conferences of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.

episodes.title: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf | God among Us
episodes.description: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "God is among us—and is personally involved in our lives and actively guiding His children."

episodes.title: Joy D. Jones | Essential Conversations
episodes.description: Joy D. Jones, recently released Primary General President. "We cannot wait for conversion to simply happen to our children. Accidental conversion is not a principle of the gospel of Jesus Christ."

episodes.title: Elder Gary E. Stevenson | Hearts Knit Together
episodes.description: Elder Gary E. Stevenson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "As you extend yourself with kindness, care, and compassion, I promise that you will lift up arms that hang down and will heal hearts."

episodes.title: Elder Gerrit W. Gong | Room in the Inn
episodes.description: Elder Gerrit W. Gong of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "In this Easter season, Jesus Christ invites us to become, like Him, a good Samaritan, to make His Inn (His Church) a refuge for all."

episodes.title: President Henry B. Eyring | I Love to See the Temple
episodes.description: President Henry B. Eyring, Second Counselor in the First Presidency. "It is in the temple that we can receive the assurance of loving family connections that will continue after death and last for eternity."

episodes.title: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland | Not as the World Giveth
episodes.description: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "The instruments we need to create a brighter day and grow an economy of genuine goodness are abundantly provided for in the gospel of Jesus Christ."

episodes.title: Elder Dale G. Renlund | Infuriating Unfairness
episodes.description: Elder Dale G. Renlund of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Jesus Christ both understands unfairness and has the power to provide a remedy."

episodes.title: Elder Neil L. Andersen | The Personal Journey of a Child of God
episodes.description: Elder Neil L. Andersen of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "As covenant children of God, we love, honor, nurture, safeguard, and welcome those spirits who are coming from the premortal world."

episodes.title: President M. Russell Ballard | Hope in Christ
episodes.description: President M. Russell Ballard, Acting President of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "We long to help all who feel alone or feel they don’t belong. Let me mention, in particular, those who are currently single."

episodes.title: Elder Quentin L. Cook | Bishops—Shepherds over the Lord's Flock
episodes.description: Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "The bishop has a paramount role in serving as a shepherd to guide the rising generation to Jesus Christ."

episodes.title: President Henry B. Eyring | Bless in His Name
episodes.description: President Henry B. Eyring, Second Counselor in the First Presidency. "The purpose for our receiving the priesthood is to allow us to bless people for the Lord, doing so in His name."

episodes.title: President Dallin H. Oaks | What Has Our Savior Done for Us?
episodes.description: President Dallin H. Oaks, First Counselor in the First Presidency. "Jesus Christ has done everything that is essential for our journey through mortality toward the destiny outlined in the plan of our Heavenly Father."

episodes.title: President Russell M. Nelson | What We Are Learning and Will Never Forget
episodes.description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "If you look at your life prayerfully, I believe you will see many ways in which the Lord has been guiding you through this time of hardship."

episodes.title: Elder Ulisses Soares | Jesus Christ: The Caregiver of Our Soul
episodes.description: Elder Ulisses Soares of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "As we genuinely repent of our sins, we allow the atoning sacrifice of Christ to become wholly effective in our life."

episodes.title: Sister Reyna I. Aburto | The Grace Has No Victory
episodes.description: Sister Reyna I. Aburto, Second Counselor of the Relief Society General Presidency. "Through the redeeming Atonement and glorious Resurrection of Jesus Christ, broken hearts can be healed, anguish can become peace, and distress can become hope."

episodes.title: President Russell M. Nelson | Christ Is Risen; Faith in Him Will Move Mountains
episodes.description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Faith in Jesus Christ is the greatest power available to us in this life. All things are possible to them that believe."

episodes.title: President Dallin H. Oaks | Defending Our Divinely Inspired Constitution
episodes.description: President Dallin H. Oaks, First Counselor in the First Presidency. "Our belief in divine inspiration gives Latter-day Saints a unique responsibility to uphold and defend the United States Constitution and principles of constitutionalism."

episodes.title: Elder Ronald A. Rasband | "Behold! I Am a God of Miracles"
episodes.description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Miracles, signs, and wonders abound among followers of Jesus Christ today, in your lives and in mine."

episodes.title: Elder D. Todd Christofferson | Why the Covenant Path
episodes.description: Elder D. Todd Christofferson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "The difference of the covenant path is uniquely and eternally significant."

episodes.title: Elder David A. Bednar | "The Principles of My Gospel"
episodes.description: Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "A gospel principle is a doctrinally based guideline for the righteous exercise of moral agency."

episodes.title: Elder Alfred Kyungu | To be a Follower of Christ
episodes.description: Elder Alfred Kyungu of the Seventy. "To be a follower of Christ is to strive to conform our actions, conduct, and lives to those of the Savior."

episodes.title: Elder Vaiangina Sikahema | A House of Sequential Order
episodes.description: Elder Vaiangina Sikahema of the Seventy. "'Sequential order' is a simple, natural, and effective way for the Lord to teach us, as His children, important principles."

episodes.title: Elder Michael A. Dunn | One Percent Better
episodes.description: Elder Michael A. Dunn of the Seventy. "Every effort to change we make—no matter how tiny it seems to us—just might make the biggest difference in our lives."

episodes.title: President Camille N. Johnson | Invite Christ to Author Your Story
episodes.description: President Camille N. Johnson of the Primary General Presidency. "Let your narrative be one of faith, following your Exemplar, the Savior Jesus Christ."

episodes.title: President Bonnie H. Cordon | Come unto Christ and Don't Come Alone
episodes.description: President Bonnie H. Cordon of the Young Women General Presidency. "The best way for you to improve the world is to prepare the world for Christ by inviting all to follow Him."

episodes.title: Sister Susan H. Porter | God's Love: The Most Joyous to the Soul
episodes.description: Sister Susan H. Porter, First Counselor in the Primary General Presidency. "God’s love is not found in the circumstances of our lives but in His presence in our lives."

episodes.title: Sister Sharon Eubank | I Pray He'll Use Us
episodes.description: Sister Sharon Eubank of the Relief Society General Presidency. "Small efforts collectively make a big impact, magnifying the many individual things we do as disciples of Jesus Christ."

episodes.title: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland | The Greateset Possession
episodes.description: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Each of us is to come to Christ with uncompromised commitment to His gospel."

episodes.title: Elder Dale G. Renlund | The Peace of Christ Abolishes Enmity
episodes.description: Elder Dale G. Renlund of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "When love of Christ envelops our lives, we approach disagreements with meekness, patience, and kindness."

episodes.title: Elder Ronald A. Rasband | The Things of My Soul
episodes.description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "What things do you ponder? What things really matter to you? What are the things of your soul?"

episodes.title: President M. Russell Ballard | "Lovest Thou Me More Than These?"
episodes.description: President M. Russell Ballard, Acting President of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostle. "What things can you do within your own life to show that you love the Lord first?"

episodes.title: Elder Gary E. Stevenson | Simply Beautiful—Beautifully Simple
episodes.description: Elder Gary E. Stevenson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "May we keep the gospel simple as we take upon us our divinely appointed responsibilities."

episodes.title: Elder Gerrit W. Gong | Trust Again
episodes.description: Elder Gerrit W. Gong of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Trust in God and each other brings heaven’s blessings."

episodes.title: Elder D. Todd Christofferson | The Love of God
episodes.description: Elder D. Todd Christofferson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Our Father and our Redeemer have blessed us with commandments, and in obeying Their commandments, we feel Their perfect love more fully and more profoundly."

episodes.title: Elder Ulisses Soares | The Savior's Abiding Compassion
episodes.description: Elder Ulisses Soares of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "The expression of compassion for others is the essence of the gospel of Jesus Christ."

episodes.title: Elder David A. Bednar | With the Power of God in Great Glory
episodes.description: Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Honoring covenants arms us with righteousness and with the power of God in great glory."

episodes.title: Elder Neil L. Andersen | The Name of the Church Is Not Negotiable
episodes.description: Elder Neil L. Andersen of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "When we willingly follow the counsel of the Lord as revealed through His living prophet... the Lord blesses us with additional spiritual power."

episodes.title: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf | Daily Restoration
episodes.description: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "We need an ongoing, daily infusion of heavenly light. We need 'times of refreshing.' Times of personal restoration."

episodes.title: Elder Quentin L. Cook | Personal Peace in Challenging Times
episodes.description: Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "It has never been more important to seek personal peace."

episodes.title: President Henry B. Eyring | The Faith to Ask and Then to Act
episodes.description: President Henry B. Eyring, Second Counselor in the First Presidency. "Faith in Jesus Christ is the key to receiving revelations of truth."

episodes.title: President Dallin H. Oaks | The Need for a Church
episodes.description: President Dallin H. Oaks, First Counselor in the First Presidency. "The scriptures clearly teach the origin and need for a church directed by and with the authority of our Lord, Jesus Christ."

episodes.title: President Russell M. Nelson | The Temple and Your Spiritual Foundation
episodes.description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Whenever any kind of upheaval occurs in your life, the safest place to be spiritually is living inside your temple covenants!"

episodes.title: President M. Russell Ballard | Missionary Service Blessed My Life Forever
episodes.description: President M. Russell Ballard, Acting President of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "I pray that you young men and young women and your parents will see and know how missionary service will forever bless your life."

episodes.title: Sister Reyna I. Aburto | We Are The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
episodes.description: Sister Reyna I. Aburto, Second Counselor of the Relief Society General Presidency. "The Church is more than the buildings and the ecclesiastical structure; the Church is us, the members, with Christ at the head and the prophet as His mouthpiece."

episodes.title: Elder David A. Bednar | But We Heeded Them Not
episodes.description: Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Covenants and ordinances point us to and help us always remember our connection with the Lord Jesus Christ as we progress along the covenant path."

episodes.title: Elder Neil L. Andersen | Following Jesus: Being a Peacemaker
episodes.description: Elder Neil L. Andersen of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Peacemakers are not passive; they are persuasive in the Savior’s way."

episodes.title: President Henry B. Eyring | Steady in the Storms
episodes.description: President Henry B. Eyring, Second Counselor in the First Presidency. "When the storms in life come, you can be steady because you are standing on the rock of your faith in Jesus Christ."

episodes.title: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland | Fear Not: Believe Only!
episodes.description: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Begin your search for happiness by embracing the bounty we have already received from the giver of every good gift."

episodes.title: Elder Gerrit W. Gong | We Each Have a Story
episodes.description: Elder Gerrit W. Gong of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Please come find your family, all your generations, and bring them home."

episodes.title: Elder Quentin L. Cook | Conversion to the Will of God
episodes.description: Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Our personal conversion includes the responsibility to share the gospel of Jesus Christ with the world."

episodes.title: Sister Susan H. Porter | Lessons at the Well
episodes.description: Sister Susan H. Porter, First Counselor in the Primary General Presidency. "We can turn to the Savior for the strength and healing that will enable us to do all that we were sent here to do."

episodes.title: Sister Rebecca L. Craven | Do What Mattereth Most
episodes.description: Sister Rebecca L. Craven, Second Counselor in the Young Women General Presidency. "As we center our lives on Jesus Christ, we will be blessed with spiritual strength, contentment, and joy."

episodes.title: President Jean B. Bingham | Covenant with God Strengthen, Protect, and Prepare Us for Eternal Glory
episodes.description: President Jean B. Bingham, Relief Society General Presidency. "As we choose to make covenants and keep them, we will be blessed with more happiness in this life and a glorious eternal life to come."

episodes.title: Elder Dale G. Renlund | Your Divine Nature and Eternal Destiny
episodes.description: Elder Dale G. Renlund of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "I invite you to center your life on Jesus Christ and remember the foundational truths in the Young Women theme."

episodes.title: Elder D. Todd Christofferson | Our Relationship with God
episodes.description: Elder D. Todd Christofferson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "No matter what our mortal experience may entail, we can trust God and find joy in Him."

episodes.title: Sister Amy A. Wright | Christ Heals That Which Is Broken
episodes.description: Sister Amy A. Wright, Second Counselor in the Primary General Presidency. "He can heal broken relationships with God, broken relationships with others, and broken parts of ourselves."

episodes.title: Elder Gary E. Stevenson | Love, Share, Invite
episodes.description: Elder Gary E. Stevenson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "As we love, share, and invite, we take part in that great and glorious work that prepares the earth for the return of its Messiah."

episodes.title: Elder Ronald A. Rasband | To Heal the World
episodes.description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Wounds and differences can be resolved and even healed when we honor God, the Father of us all, and Jesus Christ, His Son."

episodes.title: President Russell M. Nelson | The Power of Spiritual Momentum
episodes.description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "I would like to suggest five specific actions we can take to help us maintain positive spiritual momentum."

episodes.title: President Dallin H. Oaks | Divine Love in the Father's Plan
episodes.description: President Dallin H. Oaks, First Counselor in the First Presidency. "The purpose of the doctrine and policies of this restored Church is to prepare God’s children for salvation in the celestial kingdom and for exaltation in its highest degree."

episodes.title: Elder Ulisses Soares | In Awe of Christ and His Gospel
episodes.description: Elder Ulisses Soares of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "May the remembrance of what our eyes have seen and our hearts have felt increase our amazement at the Savior’s atoning sacrifice."

episodes.title: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf | Our Heartfelt All
episodes.description: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "If we want the Savior to lift us heavenward, then our commitment to Him and His gospel can’t be casual or occasional."

episodes.title: President Russell M. Nelson | Overcome the World and Find Rest
episodes.description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Find rest from the intensity, uncertainty, and anguish of this world by overcoming the world through your covenants with God."

episodes.title: President Dallin H. Oaks | Helping the Poor and Distressed
episodes.description: President Dallin H. Oaks, First Counselor in the First Presidency. "The Church of Jesus Christ is committed to serving those in need, and it is also committed to cooperating with others in that effort."

episodes.title: President Henry B. Eyring | Legacy of Encouragement
episodes.description: President Henry B. Eyring, Second Counselor in the First Presidency. "I encourage you to continue striving to qualify to return to Heavenly Father and Jesus Christ."

episodes.title: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf | Jesus Christ Is the Strength of Youth
episodes.description: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Put your trust in Jesus Christ. He will lead you the right way. He is your strength."

episodes.title: Elder Dale G. Renlund | A Framework for Personal Revelation
episodes.description: Elder Dale G. Renlund of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "We need to understand the framework within which the Holy Ghost functions. When we operate within the framework, the Holy Ghost can unleash astonishing insight."

episodes.title: Elder Ronald A. Rasband | This Day
episodes.description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Our living prophet is doing his part to flood the earth with the Book of Mormon. We must follow his lead."

episodes.title: President M. Russell Ballard | Follow Jesus Christ with Footsteps of Faith
episodes.description: President M. Russell Ballard, Acting President of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Christ can carry us today through difficult times. He did it for the early pioneers, and He will do it now for each one of us."

episodes.title: Elder Ulisses Soares | In Partnership with the Lord
episodes.description: Elder Ulisses Soares of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "The restored gospel of Jesus Christ proclaims the principle of full partnership between woman and man, both in mortal life and in the eternities."

episodes.title: Elder D. Todd Christofferson | The Doctrine of Belonging
episodes.description: Elder D. Todd Christofferson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "The doctrine of belonging comes down to this for each of us: I am one with Christ in the gospel covenant."

episodes.title: Elder Neil L. Andersen | Drawing Closer to the Savior
episodes.description: Elder Neil L. Andersen of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Seeking to know and love the Savior, we separate ourselves from the world through covenants with God... without isolating ourselves from others who believe differently."

episodes.title: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland | Lifted Up upon the Cross
episodes.description: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "To be a follower of Jesus Christ, one must sometimes carry a burden and go where sacrifice is required and suffering is inevitable."

episodes.title: Elder Gerrit W. Gong | Happy and Forever
episodes.description: Elder Gerrit W. Gong of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "True, enduring joy and eternity with those we love are the very essence of God’s plan of happiness."

episodes.title: Elder David A. Bednar | Put On Thy Strength, O Zion
episodes.description: Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Each of us should evaluate our temporal and spiritual priorities sincerely and prayerfully."

episodes.title: Elder Gary E. Stevenson | Nourishing and Bearing Your Testimony
episodes.description: Elder Gary E. Stevenson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "I invite you to seek opportunities to bear your testimony in word and in deed."

episodes.title: Elder Quentin L. Cook | Be True to God and His Work
episodes.description: Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "We all need to seek our own testimony of Jesus Christ, bridle our passions, repent of our sins, and be true to God and His work."

episodes.title: Sister Tracy Y. Browning | Seeing More of Jesus Christ in Our Lives
episodes.description: Sister Tracy Y. Browning, Second Counselor in the Primary General Presidency. "The Savior invites us to see our lives through Him in order to see more of Him in our lives."

episodes.title: Sister Kristin M. Yee | Beauty for Ashes: The Healing Path of Forgiveness
episodes.description: Sister Kristin M. Yee, Second Counselor in the Relief Society General Presidency. "To live in such a way that you give beauty for the ashes of your life is an act of faith that follows the Savior."

episodes.title: Sister Michelle D. Craig | Wholehearted
episodes.description: Sister Michelle D. Craig, First Counselor of the Young Women General Presidency. "We should be followers of Jesus who are joyful and wholehearted in our own personal journey of discipleship."

episodes.title: Sister J. Anette Dennis | His Yoke Is Easy and His Burden Is Light
episodes.description: Sister J. Anette Dennis, First Counselor in the Relief Society General Presidency. "Let us remember that each person on this earth is a child of God and He loves each one."

episodes.title: Elder Joseph W. Sitati | Patterns of Discipleship
episodes.description: Elder Joseph W. Sitati, Emeritus Member of the Seventy. "Learning about Christ and His ways leads us to know and to love Him."

episodes.title: Elder Isaac K. Morrison | We Can Do Hard Things through Him
episodes.description: Elder Isaac K. Morrison of the Seventy. "We grow in our discipleship when we exercise faith in the Lord during difficult times."

episodes.title: Elder Gary E. Stevenson | The Greatest Easter Story Ever Told
episodes.description: Elder Gary E. Stevenson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Look at the Book of Mormon in a new light and consider the profound witness it bears of the reality of the risen Christ."

episodes.title: President Bonnie H. Cordon | Never Give Up an Opportunity to Testify of Christ
episodes.description: President Bonnie H. Cordon of the Young Women General Presidency. "True joy rests on our willingness to come closer to Christ and witness for ourselves."

episodes.title: Elder Gerrit W. Gong | Ministering
episodes.description: Elder Gerrit W. Gong of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Let us reach out and care as our Savior would, especially to those whom we are privileged by love and assignment to minister."

episodes.title: Elder Quentin L. Cook | Safely Gathered Home
episodes.description: Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "We are in a unique position to gather Israel on both sides of the veil as never before under the Father’s plan."

episodes.title: President Henry B. Eyring | Finding Personal Peace
episodes.description: President Henry B. Eyring, Second Counselor in the First Presidency. "I pray that you may find peace, help many others to find it, and pass it along."

episodes.title: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf | Jesus Christ Is the Strength of Parents
episodes.description: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Help your children build faith in Jesus Christ, love His gospel and His Church, and prepare for a lifetime of righteous choices."

episodes.title: Elder Dale G. Renlund | Accessing God's Power through Covenants
episodes.description: Elder Dale G. Renlund of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "As you walk the covenant path, from baptism to the temple and throughout life, I promise you power to go against the natural worldly flow."

episodes.title: Elder Juan A. Uceda | The Lord Jesus Christ Teaches Us to Minister
episodes.description: Elder Juan A. Uceda of the Seventy. "With our Savior’s help, we can love His precious sheep and minister to them as He would."

episodes.title: Elder D. Todd Christofferson | One in Christ
episodes.description: Elder D. Todd Christofferson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "It is only in and through our individual loyalty to and love of Jesus Christ that we can hope to be one."

episodes.title: President Camille N. Johnson | Jesus Christ Is Relief
episodes.description: President Camille N. Johnson of the Primary General Presidency. "We can partner with the Savior to help provide temporal and spiritual relief for those in need—and in the process find our own relief."

episodes.title: Elder Ulisses Soares | Followers of the Prince of Peace
episodes.description: Elder Ulisses Soares of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "As we strive to develop attributes like the Savior’s, we can become instruments of His peace in the world."

episodes.title: Elder Neil L. Andersen | My Mind Caught Hold upon This Thought of Jesus Christ
episodes.description: Elder Neil L. Andersen of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "As you continue to attentively catch hold of the thought of Jesus Christ, I promise you not only heavenly guidance but heavenly power."

episodes.title: President Russell M. Nelson | Peacemakers Needed
episodes.description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "You have your agency to choose contention or reconciliation. I urge you to choose to be a peacemaker, now and always."

episodes.title: President Dallin H. Oaks | The Teachings of Jesus Christ
episodes.description: President Dallin H. Oaks, First Counselor in the First Presidency. "We are given the scriptures to direct our lives. My message today consists of a selection of the words of our Savior—what He said."

episodes.title: President M. Russell Ballard | Remember What Matters Most
episodes.description: President M. Russell Ballard, Acting President of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "What matters most is our relationships with Heavenly Father and His Beloved Son, our families, and our neighbors, and allowing the Spirit to guide us."

episodes.title: Elder Ronald A. Rasband | Hosanna to the Most High God
episodes.description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Jesus Christ’s triumphant entry into Jerusalem and the events of the week that followed exemplify doctrine we can apply in our lives today."

episodes.title: Elder Ahmad S. Corbitt | Do You Know Why I as a Christian Believe in Christ?
episodes.description: Elder Ahmad S. Corbitt of the Seventy. "Jesus Christ had to suffer, die, and rise again to redeem all humanity from physical death and to give eternal life with God."

episodes.title: Elder David A. Bednar | "Abide in Me, and I in You; Therefore Walk with Me"
episodes.description: Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "The Savior’s promise to abide in us is true and available to every covenant-keeping member of His restored Church."

episodes.title: Elder David A. Bednar | In the Path of Their Duty
episodes.description: Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "You who today are pressing forward in the path of your duty are the strength of the Savior’s restored Church."

episodes.title: Sister Amy A. Wright | Abide the Day in Christ
episodes.description: Sister Amy A. Wright, Second Counselor in the Primary General Presidency. "Jesus Christ makes it possible for us to 'abide the day.'”

episodes.title: Elder D. Todd Christofferson | The Sealing Power
episodes.description: Elder D. Todd Christofferson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "The sealing power makes individual salvation and family exaltation universally available to the children of God."

episodes.title: President Dallin H. Oaks | Kingdoms of Glory
episodes.description: President Dallin H. Oaks, First Counselor in the First Presidency. "We have a loving Heavenly Father who will see that we receive every blessing and every advantage that our own desires and choices allow."

episodes.title: Elder Neil L. Andersen | Tithing: Opening the Windows of Heaven
episodes.description: Elder Neil L. Andersen of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "The windows of heaven open in many ways. Trust in the Lord’s timing; the blessings always come."

episodes.title: Elder Gary E. Stevenson | Promptings of the Spirit
episodes.description: Elder Gary E. Stevenson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "The constant companionship of the Holy Ghost is one of the greatest spiritual gifts Latter-day Saints enjoy."

episodes.title: Elder Ronald A. Rasband | How Great Will Be Your Joy
episodes.description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "I now invite you to take your know-how, coupled with your time-honored testimonies, and go on a mission."

episodes.title: Elder Joni L. Koch | Humble to Accept and Follow
episodes.description: Elder Joni L. Koch of the Seventy. "Humility is a mandatory requirement for us to be ready to return to the presence of God."

episodes.title: Sister Tamara W. Runia | Seeing God's Family through the Overview Lens
episodes.description: Sister Tamara W. Runia, First Counselor in the Young Women General Presidency. "I believe we can, through the eye of faith, zoom out and view ourselves and our families with hope and joy."

episodes.title: Elder Ulisses Soares | Brothers and Sisters in Christ
episodes.description: Elder Ulisses Soares of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "May we enjoy more the spiritual kinship that exists between us and value the different attributes and varied gifts we all have."

episodes.title: President M. Russell Ballard | Praise to the Man
episodes.description: President M. Russell Ballard, Acting President of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "How abundantly blessed we are to know all that we know because we have Joseph Smith, the prophet of this last dispensation of time."

episodes.title: President Emily Belle Freeman | Walking in Covenant Relationship with Christ
episodes.description: President Emily Belle Freeman of the Young Women General Presidency. "The One who was bruised and broken for us will allow mortality to do its work in us, but He doesn’t ask us to face those challenges alone."

episodes.title: Elder Adilson de Paula Parrella | Bearing Witness of Jesus Christ in Word and Actions
episodes.description: Elder Adilson de Paula Parrella of the Seventy. "As we strive to live our lives in harmony with the gospel of Jesus Christ, our conduct will be a living testimony of our Redeemer."

episodes.title: Elder Quentin L. Cook | Be Peaceable Followers of Christ
episodes.description: Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "I testify that 'peaceable followers of Christ' will find personal peace in this life and a glorious heavenly reunion."

episodes.title: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf | The Prodigal and the Road That Leads Home
episodes.description: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Though choices may have taken you far from the Savior and His Church, the Master Healer stands at the road that leads home, welcoming you."

episodes.title: President Henry B. Eyring | Our Constant Companion
episodes.description: President Henry B. Eyring, Second Counselor in the First Presidency. "You and I have the opportunity to have the Holy Ghost as our constant companion."

episodes.title: Elder Dale G. Renlund | Jesus Christ Is the Treasure
episodes.description: Elder Dale G. Renlund of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Focus on Jesus Christ. He is our Savior and Redeemer, the 'mark' to whom we should look, and our greatest treasure."

episodes.title: Elder Gerrit W. Gong | Love Is Spoken Here
episodes.description: Elder Gerrit W. Gong of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "May we each learn to speak and hear His love here, in our hearts and homes, and in our gospel callings, activities, ministering, and service."

episodes.title: President Russell M. Nelson | Think Celestial!
episodes.description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Your choices will determine where you will live throughout eternity, the kind of body with which you will be resurrected, and those with whom you will live forever."

episodes.title: President Jeffrey R. Holland | Motions of a Hidden Fire
episodes.description: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland, Acting President of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "God hears every prayer we offer and responds to each of them according to the path He has outlined for our perfection."

episodes.title: Sister J. Anette Dennis | Put Ye On the Lord Jesus Christ
episodes.description: Sister J. Anette Dennis, First Counselor of the Relief Society General Presidency. "Through honoring our covenants, we enable God to pour out the multitude of promised blessings associated with those covenants."

episodes.title: Elder Ulisses Soares | Covenant Confidence through Jesus Christ
episodes.description: Elder Ulisses Soares of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "When we enter the Lord’s house, we embark on a sacred journey of learning to become higher and holier disciples of Christ."

episodes.title: President Henry B. Eyring | All Will Be Well Because of Temple Covenants
episodes.description: President Henry B. Eyring, Second Counselor in the First Presidency. "There is nothing more important than honoring the covenants you have made or may make in the temple."

episodes.title: Elder David A. Bednar | "Be Still, and Know That I Am God"
episodes.description: Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "We can be still and know that God is our Heavenly Father, we are His children, and Jesus Christ is our Savior."

episodes.title: Elder Gerrit W. Gong | All Things for Our Good
episodes.description: Elder Gerrit W. Gong of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "In time and eternity, the purpose of Creation and the nature of God Himself are to bring all things together for our good."

episodes.title: Elder Quentin L. Cook | Be One with Christ
episodes.description: Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "We are united by our love of and faith in Jesus Christ and His Atonement. The essence of truly belonging is to be one with Christ."

episodes.title: Sister Andrea Muñoz Spannaus | Faithful to the End
episodes.description: Sister Andrea Muñoz Spannaus, Second Counselor of the Young Women General Presidency. "By His hand, you will be able to bring down every Goliath that appears in your life."

episodes.title: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf | A Higher Joy
episodes.description: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "May we all seek and find the higher joy that comes from devoting our lives to our Heavenly Father and His Beloved Son."

episodes.title: Elder Ronald A. Rasband | Words Matter
episodes.description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Words set a tone. They voice our thoughts, feelings, and experiences, for good or bad."

episodes.title: President Susan H. Porter | Pray, He Is There
episodes.description: President Susan H. Porter of the Primary General Presidency. "I invite you to pray to know Heavenly Father is there, pray to grow to become like Him, and pray to show His love to others."

episodes.title: Elder Dale G. Renlund | The Powerful, Virtuous Cycle of the Doctrine of Christ
episodes.description: Elder Dale G. Renlund of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "I invite you to live the doctrine of Christ repeatedly, iteratively, and intentionally and help others on their way."

episodes.title: Elder Patrick Kearon | God's Intent Is to Bring You Home
episodes.description: Elder Patrick Kearon of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Everything about the Father’s plan for His beloved children is designed to bring everyone home."

episodes.title: President Dallin H. Oaks | Covenants and Responsibilities
episodes.description: President Dallin H. Oaks, First Counselor in the First Presidency. "The Church of Jesus Christ is known as a church that emphasizes making covenants with God."

episodes.title: Elder D. Todd Christofferson | The Testimony of Jesus
episodes.description: Elder D. Todd Christofferson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "My invitation is to act now to secure your place as one who is valiant in the testimony of Jesus."

episodes.title: Elder Gary E. Stevenson | Bridging the Two Great Commandments
episodes.description: Elder Gary E. Stevenson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Our ability to follow Jesus Christ depends upon our strength and power to live the first and second commandments with balance and equal devotion."

episodes.title: Elder Neil L. Andersen | Temples, Houses of the Lord Dotting the Earth
episodes.description: Elder Neil L. Andersen of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "As you come worthily and prayerfully to His holy house, you will be armed with His power."

episodes.title: President Russell M. Nelson | Rejoice in the Gift of Priesthood Keys
episodes.description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Priesthood keys govern how the priesthood of God may be used to bring about the Lord’s purposes and bless all who accept the restored gospel."

episodes.title: Elder Neil L. Andersen | The Triumph of Hope
episodes.description: Elder Neil L. Andersen of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Hope is a living gift, a gift that grows as we increase our faith in Jesus Christ."

episodes.title: President Emily Belle Freeman | Live Up to Your Privileges
episodes.description: President Emily Belle Freeman of the Young Women General Presidency. "Learn how priesthood ordinances and covenant promises will allow God’s power to flow into your life."

episodes.title: Elder Dale G. Renlund | "This Is My Gospel"—"This Is My Church"
episodes.description: Elder Dale G. Renlund of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "This is the Savior’s gospel, and this is His Church (see 3 Nephi 27:21; Mosiah 26:22; 27:13). The combination of the two is powerful and transformative."

episodes.title: President Dallin H. Oaks | Following Christ
episodes.description: President Dallin H. Oaks, First Counselor in the First Presidency. "As followers of Christ, we teach and testify of Jesus Christ, our Perfect Role Model. So let us follow Him by forgoing contention."

episodes.title: Elder D. Todd Christofferson | Burying Our Weapons of Rebellion
episodes.description: Elder D. Todd Christofferson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "May we bury—very, very deep—any element of rebellion against God in our lives and replace it with a willing heart and a willing mind."

episodes.title: Elder Juan Pablo Villar | His Hand Ready to Help Us
episodes.description: Elder Juan Pablo Villar of the Seventy. "As we reach out to Jesus Christ in faith, He will always be there."

episodes.title: Elder Patrick Kearon | Welcome to the Church of Joy
episodes.description: Elder Patrick Kearon of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Because of the redeeming life and mission of our Saviour, Jesus Christ, we can—and should—be the most joyful people on earth!"

episodes.title: Elder D. Martin Goury | Be Thou Clean
episodes.description: Elder D. Martin Goury of the Seventy. "Daily repentance allows us to discern the guidance of the Lord through the Holy Ghost."

episodes.title: Elder Ulisses Soares | Aligning Our Will with His
episodes.description: Elder Ulisses Soares of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Following the Lord’s will in our life will enable us to find the most precious pearl in the world—the kingdom of heaven."

episodes.title: Elder Gerrit W. Gong | Holiness to the Lord in Everyday Life
episodes.description: Elder Gerrit W. Gong of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Holiness to the Lord makes daily living sacred. It draws us closer and happier to the Lord and each other."

episodes.title: Sister Kristin M. Yee | The Joy of Our Redemption
episodes.description: Sister Kristin M. Yee, Second Counselor in the Relief Society General Presidency. "Jesus Christ’s love and power can save each of us from our mistakes, weaknesses, and sins and help us to become something more."

episodes.title: Elder David A. Bednar | In the Space of Not Many Years
episodes.description: Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "If we are not faithful and obedient, we can transform the God-given blessing of prosperity into a prideful curse that diverts and distracts us."

episodes.title: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland | "I Am He"
episodes.description: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Christ’s charity—evident in complete loyalty to divine will—persisted and continues to persist."

episodes.title: Sister Tracy Y. Browning | Seeking Answers to Spiritual Questions
episodes.description: Sister Tracy Y. Browning, Second Counselor in the Primary General Presidency. "Our sincere gospel questions can provide Heavenly Father and Jesus Christ with opportunities to help us grow."

episodes.title: Elder Gary E. Stevenson | Days Never to Be Forgotten
episodes.description: Elder Gary E. Stevenson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Upcoming moments will provide members of the Church everywhere with increased opportunities to share the glad tidings of the gospel of Jesus Christ."

episodes.title: President Henry B. Eyring | Simple Is the Doctrine of Jesus Christ
episodes.description: President Henry B. Eyring, Second Counselor in the First Presidency. "I bear witness of the sacred work of teaching Heavenly Father’s children the simple doctrine of Jesus Christ."

episodes.title: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf | Nourish the Roots, and the Branches Will Grow
episodes.description: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "The branches of your testimony will draw strength from your deepening faith in Heavenly Father and His Beloved Son."

episodes.title: Elder Takashi Wada | The Words of Christ and the Holy Ghost Will Lead Us to the Truth
episodes.description: Elder Takashi Wada of the Seventy. "Knowing this incredible plan will help us know we are children of God and we can become like Him."

episodes.title: Elder Ronald A. Rasband | "Behold I Am the Light Which Ye Shall Hold Up"
episodes.description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "We hold up the Lord’s light when we hold fast to our covenants and when we support our living prophet."

episodes.title: Elder Quentin L. Cook | Sacred Scriptures—the Foundations of Faith
episodes.description: Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "We cannot underestimate the significance of sacred scriptures both in conversions and in remaining faithful in the gospel."

episodes.title: Elder I. Raymond Egbo | Focus on Jesus Christ and His Gospel
episodes.description: Elder I. Raymond Egbo of the Seventy. "When we ignore the distractions of the world and focus on Christ and His gospel, we are guaranteed success."

episodes.title: President Russell M. Nelson | The Lord Jesus Christ Will Come Again
episodes.description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Now is the time for you and for me to prepare for the Second Coming of our Lord and Savior, Jesus the Christ."

episodes.title: Jeffrey R. Holland | As A Little Child
