episodes.description: Elder Jeffery R Holland from the quorum of the 12 apostles. "Children really do love Him, and that love can carry over into their other relationships in the playground of life."

episodes.title: Camille N. Johnson | Spiritually Whole in Him
episodes.description: President Camille N. Johnson, Relief Society general president. "‘We can choose to be made whole by exercising our faith in Him."

episodes.title: Ronald A. Rasband | Right Before Our Eyes
episodes.description: Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “Right before my eyes were missionaries who had set aside the things of this world to serve the Lord and help hasten His coming.”

episodes.title: Quentin L. Cook | The Atonement of Jesus Christ Provides the Ultimate Rescue
episodes.description: Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "As we turn to Jesus Christ, the Savior of the world, He rescues us from the storms of life through His Atonement."

episodes.title: Henry B. Eyring | Draw Near Unto Me
episodes.description: President Henry B. Eyring, second counselor in the First Presidency. "Jesus Christ loves each of us. He offers the opportunity to draw closer to Him."

episodes.title: Neil L. Andersen | Cherishing Life
episodes.description: Neil L. Anderson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Nurturing and protecting life that is yet unborn … is a moral law confirmed by the Lord through His prophets"

episodes.title: Dale G. Renlund | Personal Preparation to Meet the Savior
episodes.description: Dale G. Renlund of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "We are wise when we accept the gospel, seek to have the Holy Ghost with us and avoid deception."

episodes.title: Dieter F. Uchtdorf | By This All Will Know That You Are My Disciples
episodes.description: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Our love for God and His children is a powerful testimony to the world that this is truly the Savior’s Church."

episodes.title: Gary E. Stevenson | And We Talk of Christ
episodes.description: Elder Gary E. Stevenson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Christ is at the center of His Church and should be at the center of our lives."

episodes.title: Amy A. Wright | Thou Art the Christ
episodes.description: Sister Amy A. Wright, first counselor in the Primary general presidency. "Lifelong discipleship of Jesus Christ begins in our homes — and in Primary."

episodes.title: D. Todd Christofferson | Worship
episodes.description: Elder D. Todd Christofferson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “True worship means loving God and yielding our will to Him — the most precious gift we can offer.”

episodes.title: David A. Bednar | The Times of Restitution of All Things
episodes.description: Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “Joseph did not pray merely to know what was right. Rather, he prayed to know what was right so he could do what was right.”

episodes.title: Tamara W. Runia | Your Repentance Doesn’t Burden Jesus Christ; It Brightens His Joy
episodes.description: Sister Tamara W. Runia, first counselor in the Young Women general presidency. “The Savior is forever brighter than the darkness of shame. He would never attack your worth.”

episodes.title: Gerrit W. Gong | Eternity’s Great Gifts: Jesus Christ’s Atonement, Resurrection, Restoration
episodes.description: Elder Gerrit W. Gong from the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "May we each find in Jesus Christ atonement, resurrection and restoration -- peace, becoming and belonging -- that which is enduringly real and joyful, happy and forever"

episodes.title: Dallin H. Oaks | Divine Helps for Mortality
episodes.description: President Dallin H. Oaks, first counselor in the First Presidency. “By far God’s strongest mortal help was His provision of a Savior, Jesus Christ, who would suffer to pay the price and provide forgiveness for repented sins,”

episodes.title: Ulisses Soares | Reverence for Sacred Things
episodes.description: Ulisses Soares of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Reverence for the sacred fosters genuine gratitude, expands true happiness, leads our minds to revelation and brings greater joy to our lives."

episodes.title: Patrick Kearon | Receive His Gift
episodes.description: Elder Patrick Kearon of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "You are a child of God. This is not just a nice song we sing."

episodes.title: Russell M. Nelson | Confidence in the Presence of God
episodes.description: President Russel M. Nelson, president of the Church of Jesus Christ. “In the Lord’s own words, charity and virtue open the way to having confidence before God!”

episodes.title: Gary E. Stevenson | Blessed Are the Peacemakers
episodes.description: Elder Gary E. Stevenson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “To be peacemakers, we forgive others and deliberately build others up instead of tearing them down.”

episodes.title: Tracy Y. Browning | Tune Your Heart to Jesus Christ: The Sacred Gift of Primary Music
episodes.description: Sister Tracy Y. Browning, Second Counselor in the Primary General Presidency. “Primary songs have carried a holy influence in my life and have lifted my soul, taught me eternal truths and drawn me nearer to the Savior and to His gospel.”

episodes.title: Dieter F. Uchtdorf | Do Your Part With All Your Heart
episodes.description: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “Simply put, discipleship takes self-discipline. It is not a casual endeavor, and it doesn’t happen by accident.”

episodes.title: Ronald A. Rasband | The Family Proclamation — Words From God
episodes.description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “The proclamation has a divine origin, so we must treat it with the reverence deserving words from God.”

episodes.title: Kevin G. Brown | The Eternal Gift of Testimony
episodes.description: Elder Kevin G. Brown, General Authority Seventy. “The gift and witness of the Holy Ghost are available to everyone.”

episodes.title: Gerrit W. Gong | No One Sits Alone
episodes.description: Elder Gerrit W. Gong of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “In His Church and through His ordinances and covenants, we come to each other and to Jesus Christ.”

episodes.title: Quentin L. Cook | The Lord Is Hastening His Work
episodes.description: Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “Let me once again assure all new converts and those returning to the Lord’s Church: We love you; we need you; the Lord needs you.”

episodes.title: Patrick Kearon | Jesus Christ and Your New Beginning
episodes.description: Elder Patrick Kearon of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “Little by little, the more we invite His goodness into our hearts and cast out the self-defeating voices in our heads, we become His people because we truly make Him our God.”

episodes.title: J. Anette Dennis | Cheering Each Other On
episodes.description: Sister J. Anette Dennis, First Counselor in the Relief Society General Presidency. “Christlike love and care are higher and holier. The pure love of Christ is charity.”

episodes.title: Neil L. Andersen | The Atoning Love of Jesus Christ
episodes.description: Elder Neil L. Andersen of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “Your Heavenly Father rejoices in your resolve to come unto Him with a broken heart and contrite spirit.”

episodes.title: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland | And Now I See
episodes.description: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “When we participate in any of the ordinances of the gospel and honor the corresponding covenants, we come to know the Savior much more personally.”

episodes.title: Ulisses Soares | Adorned With the Virtue of Temperance
episodes.description: Elder Ulisses Soares of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “The gospel of Jesus Christ invites us to exercise this virtue especially in times of challenge, for it is precisely on these occasions that the true character of individuals is revealed.”

episodes.title: D. Todd Christofferson | Look to God and Live
episodes.description: Elder D. Todd Christofferson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “Looking to God means that He is not just one of our priorities; it means rather that He is our one highest priority.”

episodes.title: Andrea Muñoz Spannaus | Prophets of God
episodes.description: Sister Andrea Muñoz Spannaus, Second Counselor in the Young Women General Presidency. “Each member of the First Presidency and the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles is a prophet, seer and revelator.”

episodes.title: Henry B. Eyring | Proved and Strengthened in Christ
episodes.description: Elder Henry B. Eyring of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “When we continue to have faith in Jesus Christ — even when things might feel impossible to us at the moment — we become spiritually stronger.”

episodes.title: David A. Bednar | They Are Their Own Judges
episodes.description: David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "In the Lord’s presence, we will acknowledge what we have chosen to become in mortality and know for ourselves where we should be in eternity.”

episodes.title: Dale G. Renlund | Taking on the Name of Jesus Christ
episodes.description: Elder Dale G. Renlund of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “As His disciples, we … strive to become like Him and seek to be blessed with His attributes.”

episodes.title: Dallin H. Oaks | The Family-Centered Gospel of Jesus Christ
episodes.description: President Dallin H. Oaks, President of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “Parents — single or married and others like grandparents who fill that role for children — are the master teachers.”

episodes.title: Patrick Kearon | About His Business
episodes.description: A call to center our lives on Jesus Christ by actively engaging in His work through serving, loving, and choosing discipleship daily with intent and purpose.

episodes.title: Kristin M. Yee | Ministering—“That Ye Love One Another; as I Have Loved You”
episodes.description: An invitation to follow Christ's example of pure love by showing compassion, patience, and kindness to all, especially in difficult moments, reflecting His love in how we treat others every day.

episodes.title: Clark G. Gilbert | Come Home
episodes.description: A loving invitation to come home to Christ, reminding us that no matter how far we feel we have strayed, He is always ready to receive us as we turn back with faith, humility, and a willing heart.

episodes.title: David A. Bednar | All Who Have Endured Valiantly
episodes.description: A hopeful reminder that those who have endured valiantly in faith, despite struggle or doubt, are known and loved by God, and their quiet perseverance is honored in His eyes.

episodes.title: Henry B. Eyring | Prayers for Peace
episodes.description: An invitation to seek peace through sincere prayer, trusting that God hears and answers, bringing comfort, guidance, and calmness even in life's most uncertain and difficult moments.

episodes.title: Gary E. Stevenson | Lost Luggage, Redeemed Souls
episodes.description: As disciples of Jesus Christ, we rise with renewed determination to succor and care for those with whom we come in contact.

episodes.title: Gérald Caussé | Love All; Love Each
episodes.description: May we follow the Lord's perfect example and learn to love all and to love each, just as He does.

episodes.title: Clement M. Matswagothata | He Knows You by Name
episodes.description: The most eternity-shaping name we can receive is the sacred name of Jesus Christ.

episodes.title: Ulisses Soares | Jesus Christ—the True Vine
episodes.description: In a world of many voices, remaining connected to the True Vine is not merely desirable; it is essential to our spiritual survival.

episodes.title: Dieter F. Uchtdorf | Encounter at the Empty Tomb
episodes.description: President Dieter F. Uchtdorf reflects on the women who discovered Christ's empty tomb, teaching that we must encounter the reality of His Resurrection, come to know that He lives, and then share that witness with others, as those first witnesses did.

episodes.title: Emily Belle Freeman | Best Days and Worst Days
episodes.description: President Emily Belle Freeman teaches that because of Jesus Christ, our best days are ahead no matter how bad things are now. Drawing on Peter's story and her family's trial with cancer, she shows testimony is built over time, on best days and worst.

episodes.title: Ronald A. Rasband | He Is Risen
episodes.description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband testifies that Christ's Resurrection secured salvation from physical death for all God's children. Drawing on scriptural witnesses and the loss of his grandson Paxton, he affirms the hope of reunion, resurrected whole, through

episodes.title: Dale G. Renlund | Because of Jesus Christ
episodes.description: Elder Dale G. Renlund teaches that amid life's many competing concerns, focusing on Jesus Christ and His Atonement brings joy and clarity. Using the story of his dog chasing two balls at once, he shows why keeping our eye on the Savior matters most.

episodes.title: Thierry K. Mutombo | The Joy of a Covenant Relationship with God
episodes.description: Elder Thierry K. Mutombo teaches that whatever we face, we can feel God's infinite love through Christ. Sharing how he and his wife lost four children and faced pressure to separate, he testifies that keeping covenants brings peace, for Sunday will c

episodes.title: Dallin H. Oaks | Alive in Christ
episodes.description: President Dallin H. Oaks teaches that the literal, universal Resurrection changes our whole view of mortality. He calls followers of Christ to love even their adversaries, forgo contention, and become peacemakers, without surrendering their values.

episodes.title: D. Todd Christofferson | The Character of Christ
episodes.description: President D. Todd Christofferson teaches that preparing for Christ's Second Coming means acquiring His character, which grows from a Christlike heart: pure love, a desire to lift and minister to others, and devotion to doing the will of God.

episodes.title: Chi Hong (Sam) Wong | Remember, Remember
episodes.description: Elder Chi Hong (Sam) Wong draws on five 'remember, remember' verses from the Book of Mormon, teaching that we are blessed for keeping God's commandments, saved through Christ's Atonement, secure when built on Him, and free to use our agency wisely.

episodes.title: Susan H. Porter | Here Am I, Send Me
episodes.description: President Susan H. Porter teaches children that, like the boy with loaves and fishes, they can offer what they have, however small, and let Heavenly Father make it great. She invites them to pray, as Jesus did, 'Here am I, send me.'

episodes.title: Neil L. Andersen | Eternal Marriage Is an Eternal Journey
episodes.description: Elder Neil L. Andersen teaches that eternal marriage, sealed by priesthood power, is not a short-term experiment but a lifelong journey of becoming like Christ, requiring patience, repentance, and forgiveness, sustained through the Holy Ghost.

episodes.title: Quentin L. Cook | Keys, Covenants, and Easter
episodes.description: Elder Quentin L. Cook connects Easter to the Savior's Atonement and Resurrection and to priesthood keys restored by Elijah in the Kirtland Temple. These sealing keys, he testifies, make eternal families possible for God's covenant people.

episodes.title: Taniela B. Wakolo | Come unto Christ—Together
episodes.description: Elder Taniela B. Wakolo shares stories of part-member families who waited years in patient faith, teaching that the gospel is a bridge, not a wedge, to unite families, and that the Lord honors patience and fulfills His promises in His timing.

episodes.title: Gerrit W. Gong | Tis Eastertide: No One Walks Alone
episodes.description: Elder Gerrit W. Gong draws on the road to Emmaus, teaching that the risen Christ walks with us even when unrecognized, and that through scripture, covenants, and the Holy Ghost we come to know He abides with us, so no one should walk alone.

6f53762e-5568-43e2-b27f-31b48dc4f91b.description: Watch uplifting devotionals from speakers at BYU-Idaho.

episodes.title: President Henry and Kelly Eyring | A Samaritan Spring, This Winter // What is Your "Why?"
episodes.description: President Henry J. Eyring of Brigham Young University-Idaho and Sister Kelly Eyring. "I love our Savior Jesus Christ and want to be physically and spiritually fit to serve Him. That is my why. What is yours?"

episodes.title: LaNae H. Poulter | Sixteen Stones
episodes.description: LaNae Poulter, Scheduling Manager at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "As I now share with you experiences gleaned from my decades at BYU-Idaho, please reflect how they might equate to your own past, present, and future."

episodes.title: Elder Quentin L. Cook | The Sunny Side of the Street
episodes.description: Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "I want you to be optimistic, joyful, of good cheer, and also to be united in and through the gospel of Jesus Christ to be one with the Savior."

episodes.title: Erin Bennion | The Best Self-Help
episodes.description: Erin Bennion, Nursing Department Chair at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Helping others is one of the best physiological ways to reduce your own stress and increase your own happiness."

episodes.title: Paul Roberts | Learning the True Principles of Life
episodes.description: Paul Roberts, Education & Human Development Associate Dean at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "We will all have problems, big problems, but there are true principles of life to be learned through having problems... and overcoming problems."

episodes.title: Julie Shiffler | Perfect in Christ
episodes.description: Julie Shiffler, Counselor at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "If we are not able to complete everything but are accomplishing the things that the Lord is guiding us to do, we don’t need to feel guilty, and we can have peace."

episodes.title: Kimberly Thueson | Cardboard connections and the Doorway to Heaven
episodes.description: Kimberly Thueson, Online Training Coordinator at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Home can bring feelings of comfort, guidance, and love. Seeking connection with our heavenly home is no different despite its distance and current, veiled location."

episodes.title: Sister Cristin B. Franco | Be of Good Cheer
episodes.description: Sister Cristina B. Franco of the Primary General Presidency. "My brothers and sisters, the spirit of the gospel is optimistic. President Nelson taught that you can face the future with optimism and joy as you look forward to the future with faith."

episodes.title: Bill Lewis | His Infinite Love
episodes.description: William Lewis, IT Application Systems Engineer at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "God is sending us His love through His words and example. It is like the light of the sun that shines on everything, everywhere."

episodes.title: Elder Evan A. and Cindy Lee Schmutz | Great Shall Be Their Reward // Remembering our Baptismal Covenants
episodes.description: Elder Evan A. Schmutz, General Authority Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, and Cindy Schmutz. "God has reserved indescribably rich and eternal blessings for those who faithfully keep His commandments and obey His law."

episodes.title: Robert Tueller | Testimony Building: Steady and Strong
episodes.description: Robert Tueller, Music Faculty at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "One of my most prized possessions is this simple yet steady and strong testimony that has been with me throughout my life as a result of me being able to 'believe on their words.'"

episodes.title: President Henry and Sister Kelly Eyring | Making Changes in Our Lives // Here We Go
episodes.description: President Henry J. Eyring of Brigham Young University-Idaho and Sister Kelly Eyring. "This mortal life is a divinely crafted learning opportunity, a test of faith and willingness to change."

episodes.title: Elder Chi Hong and Sister Carol Wong | 22 Stones; General Conference Study Plan
episodes.description: Elder Chi Hong, General Authority Seventy, and Carol Wong. "As you continue to chart your future consider [the] stones of planning...five stones of preparation...the most important stone, our foundation stone, our rock, our Savior Jesus Christ."

episodes.title: Doug Thompson | Living a Celestial life
episodes.description: Doug Thompson, IT Business Officer at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Our greatest test today is to live a celestial life while living in a telestial world."

episodes.title: Sahar Qumsiyeh | I Can Do All Things Through Christ Which Strengtheneth Me
episodes.description: Sahar Qumsiyeh, Mathematics Faculty at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Focusing on our weaknesses may hinder our progress. We may think that we must be born with certain skills and abilities; they must be in our genes. This is not the case."

episodes.title: Elder Ulisses and Sister Rosana Soares | Drawing Near to the Savior
episodes.description: Elder Ulisses Soares of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles and Sister Rosana Soares. "As we diligently draw near unto the Savior, we will find Him and feel His love for us and understand more clearly the answers to our prayers."

episodes.title: Brenda Summers | The Hand of the Lord
episodes.description: Brenda Summers, Admissions Processing Coordinator at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "I encourage each one of you at the end of your day to reflect on your day and find how the Lord has been involved and then write it down."

episodes.title: Scott Cameron | I Glory in My Jesus: Forging a Personal Relationship with Christ and Heavenly Father
episodes.description: Scott Cameron, English Faculty of Brigham Young University-Idaho. "In this statement, Nephi is not glorying in a theoretical Jesus and His universal sacrifice; he is glorying in a very personal and particular relationship with 'his' Christ."

episodes.title: Elder Jeremy R. and Sister Amy Jaggi | Arise, and Get Thee into the Mountani
episodes.description: Elder Jeremy R. Jaggi, General Authority Seventy, and Sister Amy Stewart Jaggi. "Removing mountains, overcoming mountains, and climbing mountains all seem like fitting symbols for our mortal sojourn here on earth."

episodes.title: Kristin Ballou | In Pursuit of Happiness
episodes.description: Kristin Ballou, Academic Support Centers Faculty at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "I hope you come away from this devotional with the assurance that when you feel you are drowning in despair and you can barely breathe, Christ’s hand is extended."

episodes.title: Scott Johnson | Devoted Disciples of the Lord Jesus Christ
episodes.description: Scott Johnson, Chemistry Faculty at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "I testify of the Lord's great love for each of you...I am confident that He rejoices in every effort, no matter how small, that you make to be His disciple."

episodes.title: Jennifer Jones | Go About Doing Good
episodes.description: Jennifer Jones, Ticketing and Ushering Assistant at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Who may be in need of your inclusiveness, kindness, and love?... Who can you include? Who can you serve? Make this a matter of prayer and counsel with the Lord."

episodes.title: Barbara McKenna | Come Home
episodes.description: Barbara McKenna, Financial Aid Operations Analyst at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "We are here on earth trying to do our best and are ever grateful for the Atonement of Jesus Christ...Eternal life is with our Father in Heaven."

episodes.title: Taunya Hansen | Seek the Light
episodes.description: Taunya Hansen, Accounts Payable Specialist at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "In His perfect love for us, God grants the Light of Christ to every person."

episodes.title: Kevin Redd | Aligning with the Light
episodes.description: Kevin Redd, Campus Recreation Advisor at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Please take the opportunity to be a light for others and help them... Your light—no matter how great or small—can have an eternal effect on somebody else."

episodes.title: Kort Black | God's Positive Power
episodes.description: Kort Black, IT Project Manager for Brigham Young University-Idaho. "[God] is our Father. We are His offspring, and He has endowed us with power—power that can change our lives in dramatic ways...this understanding can change your life."

episodes.title: Patty Hendricks | Resilience: the Ability to Recover from Difficulties
episodes.description: Patty Hendricks, Curriculum Designer at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "During challenging times people can become bitter, while others develop empathy, courage, and faith. So, how do you get the good stuff? I believe that resilience is the key."

episodes.title: Dallin Hansen | "Seeking the Higher View"
episodes.description: Dallin Hansen, Music Faculty Member at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "In your personal pursuit of excellence, don't allow the placement of imperfect steps distract you from your long-term goal. Trust your trajectory."

episodes.title: President Henry and Sister Kelly Eyring | In Your Patience Possess Ye Your Souls; Better Than Expected
episodes.description: President Henry J. Eyring of Brigham Young University-Idaho and Sister Kelly Eyring. "As we persevere patiently, insight will come slowly but surely, often in the course of humble trial and error."

episodes.title: Brother Ahmad S. Corbitt | Graduating Your Faith to the Next Level
episodes.description: Brother Ahmad S. Corbitt of the Young Men General Presidency of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "And how can we increase our faith in Christ and help others do the same, such that leaving the covenant path is never an option for us?"

episodes.title: Luwana Roberts | Keys to Happiness
episodes.description: LuWana Roberts, Music Faculty at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "The more faithfully we keep the commandments of God, the happier we will generally be."

episodes.title: Susan Orme | Encircled in the Arms of Our Savior's Love
episodes.description: Susan Orme, Mathematics Faculty at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "It is only through our Savior’s Atonement that we can break free from Satan and be encircled about in our Savior’s arms of safety and love."

episodes.title: Brian Atkinson | Seeing Miracles
episodes.description: Brian Atkinson, Art Faculty at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "The thought seems to be that miracles are things that happened long ago, but they are no longer happening or even necessary today...God, it seems, is being taken out of the picture."

episodes.title: Doug Barker | Being Prepared Spiritually to Help Others
episodes.description: Doug Barker, Clery Act Compliance Coordinator at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "[Our spiritual safety] is our own responsibility. However, we are not alone. We do not have to deal with the challenges of mortality alone."

episodes.title: Daris Howard | Gaining a Knowledge of the Truthfulness of the Gospel
episodes.description: Daris Howard, Mathematics Faculty at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "I realize that a person never will be able to prove the gospel by intellect alone. The reason is that one of the main purposes we have for being here on earth is to live by faith."

episodes.title: Melissa Everett | Succored by the Lord
episodes.description: Melissa Everett, Online Instructor Manager at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "The foundation of my conversion to the gospel of Jesus Christ is based on the knowledge that God loves us."

episodes.title: Elder Gary B. and Sister Valerie Sabin | Principles of Peace and Happiness
episodes.description: Elder Gary B. Sabin, General Authority Seventy, and Sister Valerie Sabin. "Since we each experience life with our own unique abilities and challenges, we need to focus on doing our own personal best and not someone else’s."

episodes.title: President Dallin H. and Sister Kristin Oaks | Faith
episodes.description: President Dallin H. Oaks of the First Presidency of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints and Sister Kristen Oaks. "This is our time to become stronger, more dedicated, more faithful, even in difficult circumstances."

episodes.title: Shawn Andreason | Sure Provisions
episodes.description: Shawn Andreasen, Health Center Pharmacist at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "I testify that God will answer your prayers and guide you to that person and direct you as to what you can do to aid them in their current struggle."

episodes.title: Holly Johnson | Seasons with the Savior
episodes.description: Holly Johnson, Customer Experience Coordinator at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Today, I want to speak about the seasons of our lives and how we can be influenced and improved as we draw near to the Savior and His teachings."

episodes.title: Blake Willis | Attitude over Obstacles
episodes.description: Blake Willis, Applied Plant Science Faculty at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "We can be broken by obstacles, or we can become stronger. The final result relies heavily on your attitude. Are you prepared to triumph?"

episodes.title: President Henry and Sister Kelly Eyring | Honor in Tough Times // Honoring Our Father in Heaven by Loving Each Other
episodes.description: President Henry J. Eyring of Brigham Young University-Idaho and Sister Kelly Eyring. "To us, the motto signifies that we are bound, or sealed, by eternal covenants and we are bound, or trying, to return together to our Heavenly Father."

episodes.title: Bryan Pope | Cleave unto God
episodes.description: Brian Pope, Online Portfolio Management Director for Brigham Young University-Idaho. "'Cleave' means to 'stick to' or 'hold fast.' She explained that knowing God was cleaving unto her gave her strength to make it through her challenges."

episodes.title: John Reed | Using The Book of Mormon in Our Lives
episodes.description: John Reed, Operations Facilities Asset Coordinator at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "I am aware that some of the healing we need may take a lifetime to receive... But I’m confident the Lord can and will heal each of us in due time."

episodes.title: Brandon Isle | Surround Yourself with Faith
episodes.description: Brandon Isle, Radio News & Programming Coordinator at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "We work hard to become a disciple of Jesus Christ in how we act, in how we speak, and in how we conduct ourselves."

episodes.title: DJ Teichert | The Priveges of Discipleship
episodes.description: DJ Teichert, Director of the Study Skills Center at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Knowing this, [our loving Heavenly Father] provides us with tailor-made experiences—opportunities—to help us realize our potential and live up to our privileges."

episodes.title: J. Ryan Nielson | Understanding and Applying the Atonement in Our Lives
episodes.description: J. Ryan Nielson, Physics Faculty at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "I wonder if we have similar difficulties with our faith, that we don’t understand something simple deeply enough to apply it in our lives."

episodes.title: Elder Ronald A. and Sister Melanie Rasband | What's Not to Love // Soul Shined?
episodes.description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles and Sister Melanie Rasband. "How much are you willing to pay? How strong is your sense of debt to move you to want to be more like our Savior? To love what He loves?"

episodes.title: Haley Krumblis | Not There--Yet!
episodes.description: Haley Krumblis, Online Advising Manager; Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Our direction is purposeful, our responsibility clear as we continue to move forward with a new or renewed understanding of our immense capacity and divine potential to learn."

episodes.title: Elder Alfred Kyungu | Finding Hope in Our Lives
episodes.description: Elder Alfred Kyungu, of the Quorum of the Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Sometimes you get discouraged, you get depressed, you get left out, you get disappointed, and you lose hope."

episodes.title: Trish Carvajal | I Can Do Hard Things with the Savior by My Side
episodes.description: Trish Carvajal, University Scheduling Manager for Brigham Young University-Idaho. "I testify that Heavenly Father answers prayers and strengthens us when we need Him. Exercise your faith and you will see what the Lord will do for you."

episodes.title: President Henry and Kelly Eyring | Preparing for the Promised Land; Gratitude, Kindness, and Effort
episodes.description: President Henry J. Eyring of Brigham Young University-Idaho and Sister Kelly Eyring. "But, while keeping an eye on the pandemic, we have a valuable opportunity to learn and benefit from the events of the last two years."

episodes.title: Brother Jan E. Newman | The Word of God, Sacred Places, and Spiritual Momentum
episodes.description: Brother Jan E. Newman of the Sunday School General Presidency. "A sure way to find places of beauty and holiness in your life is to humbly respond to what the Lord wants you to do. He will lead you to sacred experiences and holy places."

episodes.title: Stephen Turcottle | The Gospel of Hope
episodes.description: Stephen Turcotte, Physics Faculty of Brigham Young University-Idaho. "We had hope that the Savior would perform His great atoning sacrifice. My goal...is to rekindle some of this great hope that each of us nobly demonstrated so long ago."

episodes.title: Jake Romney | Steadfastness in Christ
episodes.description: Jake Romney, Online Programs Faculty Member at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Anyone can choose to stay the course and to be 'steadfast and immoveable' in following Jesus Christ."

episodes.title: Elder Arnulfo Valenzuela | Following the Promptings of the Holy Ghost in Our Daily Lives
episodes.description: Elder Arnulfo Valenzuela, of the Quorum of the Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Through the Holy Ghost, we can receive gifts of the Spirit for our benefit and for the benefit of those we love and serve."

episodes.title: Dan Peterson | Seek, Listen, Act, Receive
episodes.description: Dan Peterson, End User Technologies Manager at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "I challenge you as you make decisions in your life to seek direction from your Heavenly Father and listen for the Spirit to teach what you should do."

episodes.title: Lane Williams | A Book of Steadfast Love
episodes.description: Lane Williams, Communications Faculty Member at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "God be thanked for the Book of Mormon, this astonishing testament of Jesus Christ, this book of steadfast love. It is a miracle for a world in desperate need of one."

episodes.title: Jason Flora | We Each Have a Work to Do!
episodes.description: Jason Flora, Humanities and Philosophies Department Chair at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Work has always entailed intentional effort or exertion on the part of our Heavenly Father and His Son, Jesus Christ, and so it must be with us."

episodes.title: Phillip Crane | Get Up and Win the Race!
episodes.description: Phillip Crane, Sports Activities Manager at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "The prize is exaltation and eternal life...To win, we must overcome temptations and trials placed in our path. We must get up each time we fall."

episodes.title: Jacquel Fluckiger | The Lord's Timing
episodes.description: Jacquel Fluckiger, Admissions Specialist at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Trust is firm belief in the reliability, truth, ability, or strength of someone or something."

episodes.title: Heather Hall | Life is a Race-- Are You All In?
episodes.description: Heather Hall, Online Hiring Coordinator for Brigham Young University-Idaho. "If we want to find balance in life, and if we want the Savior to lift us heavenward, then our commitment to Him and His gospel can’t be casual or occasional."

episodes.title: Brian Schow | Receiving Revelation
episodes.description: Brian Schow, Support Center Contacts Manager at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "I have come to realize...that when we use our spiritual gifts to bless the lives of others, we are receiving revelation from the Holy Ghost to act."

episodes.title: Brian Carter | You, Too, Have a Voice
episodes.description: Brian Carter, Online AV Productions Lead at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Trust that the Lord can heal you and needs your unique voice—not in spite of, but because of the personal struggles that you endure—to help lift others."

episodes.title: Jolene Mickelsen | Believe in Yourself
episodes.description: Jolene Mickelsen, Student Honor Office Assistant at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "The Little Blue Engine had the knowledge of who she was, what her purpose was, and where she was going...This can apply to each trial we face."

episodes.title: Byron Gilbert | Putting on the Armor of God
episodes.description: Byron Gilbert, Environment, Health, and Safety Coordinator at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "We all must have an emergency plan developed, and practiced that we can use in the war that we are fighting against Satan and his forces every single day."

episodes.title: Gene Clements | The Light of Christ: A Ray of (Fill In the Blank)
episodes.description: Gene Clements, Cabinet Maker at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "The Light of Christ is what many people would call a conscience...but it's more. It is the influence of God that pulls us, that influences us to be good and to do good."

episodes.title: Stephen Mendenhall | The Lord is My Light
episodes.description: Stephen Mendenhall, Media Creation Manager at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Allowing the Lord to be our light allows us to better understand our Heavenly Father’s will, even during those times when things seem the darkest."

episodes.title: President Henry and Sister Kelly Eyring | A Consecrated Life; Advice from Sister Hinckley
episodes.description: President Henry J. Eyring of Brigham Young University-Idaho and Sister Kelly Eyring. "With time and steady effort, our consecration can change the world for the better."

episodes.title: Curtis Henrie | Called to Serve
episodes.description: Curtis Henrie, Director of Online Research and Evaluation at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Not only will a calling let you practice discipleship, but it will also bless you in a variety of ways."

episodes.title: Joel Judkins | Glimpses
episodes.description: Joel Judkins, Communications Faculty at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "As we make our way back home, we may run into a telephone pole or two. But God will give us glimpses of our path if we will trust in Him."

episodes.title: Sam Brubaker | Learning to Learn as a Disciple of Jesus Christ
episodes.description: Sam Brubaker, Student Success Managing Director at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Whether gathered on campus or spread across the globe, as we engage in learning through BYU-Idaho, we are developing as disciples of Jesus Christ."

episodes.title: Amy A. Wright | Follow the Prophet
episodes.description: Amy A. Wright of the Primary General Presidency of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "We don’t always need to be doing bad things to stop our eternal progression. Sometimes we just need to be doing 'something else.'"

episodes.title: Sam Nielson | The 1830 Book of Mormon
episodes.description: Sam Neilson, Reference/Instruction Librarian at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "The Book of Mormon needed to be there...I believe the publication of the Book of Mormon to be a miracle...I believe the miracle is in the people."

episodes.title: Dean Allen | Patterns with Purpose
episodes.description: Dean Allen, Product Manager at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "I believe personal revelation is the only way we can understand and define our mission and gain that underlying knowledge that will allow us to develop successful spiritual patterns."

episodes.title: Elder Kazuhiko and Tazuko Yamashita | Wrestle Before God in Prayer
episodes.description: Elder Kazuhiko and Tazuko Yamashita, of the Quorum of the Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "We are at a crossroad where we must make a choice. We need to pray always throughout our lives, not just once or twice."

episodes.title: Lynne Landon | Fear Thou Not; for I Am with Thee
episodes.description: Lynne Landon, Online Hiring Manager at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "I know as we give our trials to the Lord, He will take them again and again, as often as necessary, with complete patience and love. He keeps His promises."

episodes.title: Pat Saurey | Am I Enough?
episodes.description: Pat Saurey, Online Scheduling Coordinator at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Satan, the father of all lies, wants us to feel like we are not enough. The Savior, on the other hand, loves us more than we can comprehend and is cheering us on."

episodes.title: Dean Cloward | Building Testimonies That Will Withstand the Challenges of Our Day
episodes.description: Dean Cloward, Elementary & Special Education Faculty Member at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "We live in a day when the storms beat upon us... Our testimonies need a lattice of structural steel running through them to help us stay strong."

episodes.title: Shirley Weekes | Our Journey of Life
episodes.description: Shirley Weekes, Student Accounts Coordinator at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Why did we take the risk of mortality?...All of this is part of a great plan, a plan that would enable us as children of God to be exalted and to become like Him."

episodes.title: President Henry J. Eyring and Sister Kelly Eyring | Nurturing // Listening to Trusted Voices
episodes.description: President Henry J. Eyring of Brigham Young University-Idaho and wife Sister Kelly Eyring. "Even as we focus on our studies and develop capabilities to lift ourselves and others, we can be nurturers."

episodes.title: Sister Bonnie H. Cordon | Commending Ourselves unto the Lord
episodes.description: Sister Bonnie H. Cordon, Young Women General President. "Our trials, struggles, and concerns may be the very catalyst for us to come to know our Savior better as we trust the Lord with all our hearts, commending ourselves to the Lord.

episodes.title: Sam Merrick | Finding Purpose and Having Courage
episodes.description: Sam Merrick, Facilities Management Operations Director at BYU-Idaho. "As we all find our courage in the adventures of life, focus it on the good things that come."

episodes.title: Troy Spratling | That Ye Should Not Be Offended
episodes.description: Troy Spratling, Engineering Technology Faculty Member at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "We need to be teachable if we are to find happiness. Schooling our feelings and being willing to accept correction is something of a repentance process."

episodes.title: Elder Alvin F. Meredith III | Receiving Revelation for Life Decisions
episodes.description: Elder Alvin F. Meredith III, of the Quorum of the Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. The confirmation from the Holy Ghost to sincere inquiries about life decisions is usually a process and rarely an event."

episodes.title: Darren Clark | Sacrifice: A Love Letter
episodes.description: Darren Clark, Art Faculty Member at BYU-Idaho. "I am eternally grateful to those who have made those seemingly impossible sacrifices so that I and my family can live the beautiful and privileged life in the gospel that we enjoy today."

episodes.title: Karl Karstad | Striving for Lasting Happiness
episodes.description: Karl Karstad, Support Center Director at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "I encourage each of us to work, learn, search, pray, repent, and improve and then work to encourage family and friends to take the action needed to press forward."

episodes.title: Roy Sleight | Living Our Best Life Through Trusting the Lord
episodes.description: Roy Sleight, Director of Institutional Data and Analysis at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "The Lord doesn’t just want to give us the answers. He also wants us to learn and grow through the process."

episodes.title: Elder Peter M. Johnson | Applying the Doctrine of Jesus Christ into Our Lives
episodes.description: Elder Peter M. Johnson, of the Seventy of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "As we consistently and intentionally apply Jesus Christ’s doctrine into our lives, I promise that you will have the strength to overcome temptations."

episodes.title: Amy Hanks | Who Do You Want to Be?
episodes.description: Amy Hanks, Chemistry Faculty Member at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Are you willing to let God prevail in your life? Are you willing to let God be the most important influence in your life?"

episodes.title: Eileen Nuffer | A Once in an Eternity Experience
episodes.description: Eileen Nuffer, Online Adjunct Faculty at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Isn’t it amazing that Heavenly Father knows each of us individually. He knows our strengths, our weaknesses, our struggles, our triumphs."

episodes.title: President Henry J. Eyring and Sister Kelly Eyring | Prophets, Plans, and Persistence // Experiencing More This Summer
episodes.description: President Henry J. Eyring of Brigham Young University-Idaho and wife Sister Kelly Eyring. "I hope you will join me in continuing to persist in faith through the trials and challenges of mortality."

episodes.title: Elder Kyle S. McKay | A Sure and Certain Foundation
episodes.description: Elder Kyle S. McKay of the Quorum of the Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Finding answers is not the solution...The solution is a sure and certain foundation whereon if you build, you cannot fall."

episodes.title: Brett Crandall | Let Us Be Seekers of Truth
episodes.description: Brett Crandall, Public Affairs Director at BYU-Idaho. "We come to BYU-Idaho to continue to develop as disciples of Jesus Christ. We must look to Christ to help us discern truth, overcome the fallen world we live in, and give us eternal life."

episodes.title: Elder Mark D. Eddy | Fear Not, I am with Thee
episodes.description: Elder Mark D. Eddy of the Quorum of the Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Our faith—the choice we make to believe in Christ and to act on that belief—grows as we exercise it in different contexts."

episodes.title: Elder D. Todd Christofferson | Be Strong and of A Good Courage
episodes.description: Elder D. Todd Christofferson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "I rejoice that in the months and years ahead, you will be blessed by the leadership and influence of President Alvin F. Meredith and Sister Jennifer Meredith."

episodes.title: Eric Embree | To the Would-Be Lifeguards
episodes.description: Eric Embree, Communication Faculty at Brigham Young University- Idaho. "Most of us hide our struggles behind masks of good cheer and confidence. It isn’t always obvious when someone is drowning. Drowning doesn’t look like drowning."

episodes.title: Joel Galbraith | Pioneering Up! Leaning on the Faith of Our Fathers for Life's Journey
episodes.description: Joel Galbraith, BYU-I Online Academic Support Director. "Why do we dwell so much on their suffering and faith...As a convert with no Latter-day Saint pioneer ancestors, how does she connect with the faith of those early pioneers?"

episodes.title: Sister Susan H. Porter | So Great a Cloud of Witnesses
episodes.description: Sister Susan H. Porter of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Receiving and becoming witnesses of God’s love for us, and of the atoning sacrifice of His Son...are fundamental to strengthening our faith and becoming more like our Savior.

episodes.title: William Brugger | Seek Ye Our of the Best Books
episodes.description: William Brugger, English Faculty at Brigham Young University- Idaho. "Your literacy—your facility with language, your familiarity with literature—will help you vividly capture your life’s snapshots more captivatingly."

episodes.title: John Mackenzie | Strength Through Gathering
episodes.description: John Mackenzie, Manager of IT Project Management at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Let us commit to staying connected and to supporting each other through both good times and bad."

episodes.title: Ben Haacke | How to Trap or Free a Fox
episodes.description: Ben Haacke, Mentoring Director at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "As we place our faith in Christ and repent daily, even our mistakes can make us stronger. With faith in Christ, Satan stands no chance, zero."

episodes.title: Nathan Watson | Go to the Temple!
episodes.description: Nathan Watson, First Year Experience Coordinator at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "The temple can and will heal our spiritual wounds. Look to the temple!"

episodes.title: Matthew Miles | Expectation, Christian Living, Belief
episodes.description: Matthew Miles, Systems Librarian at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "We must show greater love, compassion, and forgiveness to ourselves and to others when we fail at overcoming whatever our challenges might be."

episodes.title: Daniel Balls | Cast Thy Burden Upon the Lord, and He Shall Sustain Thee
episodes.description: Daniel Balls, Lead Data Analyst at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "When we are asked to travel these difficult roads, there is only one source of true relief, and that is the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. We can rely on Him."

episodes.title: Heather Carter | Strong at the Broken Places
episodes.description: Heather Carter, Online Instructor Manager at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Not only did the Savior overcome death, He has the power to heal and mend all the broken places—that includes the broken places in our lives."

episodes.title: Benjamin Yates | Navigating Life with an Eternal Perspective
episodes.description: Benjamin Yates, University Communications Strategist at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "The Atonement was prepared for us so that we could make mistakes, learn from our mistakes, and grow and change through the process."

episodes.title: President Alvin F. Meredith III and Sister Jennifer E. Meredith | The Honor Code and Coming unto Christ // Enroll in the Master’s Class
episodes.description: President Alvin F. Meredith III of Brigham Young University-Idaho and his wife Sister Jennifer E. Meredith. "At BYU-Idaho, we humbly strive to maintain the highest standards of personal conduct... That makes you different, a good kind of different."

episodes.title: Elder Juan Pablo Villar | Becoming Christlike Leaders: Making Things Happen
episodes.description: Elder Juan Pablo Villar of the Quorum of the Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "As you become more comfortable with your own growth, you will naturally become an example and leader for others."

episodes.title: Jason Williams | Thy Sins Are Forgiven Thee: What the Book of Mormon Teaches About Repentance
episodes.description: Jason Williams, Dean of the College of Language and Letters at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Reading the Book of Mormon regularly will give us the courage to speak to others, if necessary, either to confess, to apologize, or to seek help."

episodes.title: Brandie Miguel | Living the Mission of BYU-Idaho
episodes.description: Brandie Miguel, Student Leadership Activities and Events Coordinator at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "You, all of you, can become disciple-leaders. It is through the small and simple things we do each day."

episodes.title: David Allen | Receive One Such Little Child in My Name
episodes.description: David Allen, Early Education and Special Education Faculty Member at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "No matter what experience you have had or the lack of control of the past, we can strive to build a family that is more like our heavenly parents."

episodes.title: Elder Dale G. Renlund | Stronger and Closer Connection to God through Multiple Covenants
episodes.description: Elder Dale G. Renlund of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "God established covenants to bless us. That is the covenant path. God has given us multiple covenants to help us, not to condemn us."

episodes.title: Doug Sorenson | If Thou Endure It Well
episodes.description: Doug Sorenson, Maintenance Services Manager at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "These trials or tests are part of our learning process, and if we learn to navigate through the challenges of life, they will help us grow and become closer to Him."

episodes.title: David Magleby | The Eyes of Our Understanding Were Opened
episodes.description: David Magleby, History & Political Science Faculty Member at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Filled with the Spirit, as I recognize the hand of the Lord in the lives of my ancestors and feel connection, belonging, and love from beyond the veil."

episodes.title: Chris Lowry | The Best Gifts
episodes.description: Chris Lowry, Psychology Faculty Member at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "As we receive and respond to the whisperings of the Holy Ghost, this great gift will allow Christ’s atoning power to work in our lives."

episodes.title: Tony Carpenter | Mortality is a Master Class
episodes.description: Tony Carpenter, Creative Services Manager at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Life itself is a remarkable classroom. Each day brings new opportunities to learn, grow, and develop a deeper understanding of God's plan."

episodes.title: Bishop Gérald Caussé | I Saw Your Potential
episodes.description: Bishop Gérald Caussé, Presiding Bishop of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "I testify that each one of you is literally a son or daughter of God, endowed with the capacity to become like Him and to live with Him in eternal families."

episodes.title: Roger Nichols | Embracing Change
episodes.description: Roger Nichols, UX and Web Development Manager at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "I’ve come to recognize that I feel the most joy in my life when I am embracing both the big and small changes Heavenly Father wants me to."

episodes.title: President Alvin F. Meredith III and Sister Jennifer E. Meredith | Begin with the End in Mind // C.A.N.
episodes.description: President Alvin F. Meredith III of Brigham Young University-Idaho and his wife Sister Jennifer E. Meredith. "We will make better choices if we lift our eyes up regularly to ensure we are headed in the right direction."President Alvin F. Meredith III

episodes.title: Dwight Wray | Small Things
episodes.description: Dwight Wray, Biology Faculty Member at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "As I have consistently incorporated the small and simple things of the gospel into my life, I have been happier and have had more peace and joy."

episodes.title: Mindy Harris | Finding Joy in the Journey
episodes.description: Mindy Harris, Advising Director at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Understanding why you would want to do each task can help you live with more passion for accomplishing the things you will want to, get to, or choose to do."

episodes.title: Brother Michael T. Nelson | A Familiar Ring
episodes.description: Brother Michael T. Nelson, Second Counselor in the Young Men’s General Presidency of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "When truth becomes our motivation, our experiences can become celestial."

episodes.title: Kerry Powell | Sermons in Our Subjects
episodes.description: Kerry Powell, Animal and Food Science Faculty Member at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "May you recognize the truth that you have the potential to become like our heavenly parents, or future heirs of God, as declared in the opening scripture today."

episodes.title: Anna Taylor | Finding Peace and Strength through the Atonement of Jesus Christ
episodes.description: Anna Taylor, Online Employment and Scheduling Director at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Amid the challenges we face, we can understand that God is our steadfast companion, listening to our prayers and urging us to trust in His guidance."

episodes.title: Candace Willmore | Jesus Christ is Joy
episodes.description: Candace Willmore, Data Analyst at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Life is a series of metaphorical mountains. As we summit these mountains, we discover the joy of being eternally progressing children of God who have access to His power to endure."

episodes.title: Elaine S. Dalton | The Lord Will Lead Thee by the Hand
episodes.description: Elaine S. Dalton, former Young Women General President of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "As you progress on the covenant path, your relationship deepens with Jesus Christ. He will walk with you and He will lead you by the hand."

episodes.title: Jason S. Carroll | A True Temple Marriage
episodes.description: Jason S. Carroll, Family Initiative Director at the Wheatley Institute, BYU. "True temple marriages are disciple marriages founded on patterns of prayer, scripture study, church attendance, worshiping in the temple, and serving in Church callings."

episodes.title: Elder Ricardo P. Giménez | Awake, Put on Your Strength!
episodes.description: Elder Ricardo P. Giménez of the Seventy of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "When you turn to the Lord, you will be able to see the path, awaken to your potential, and be guided and inspired by the Holy Ghost."

episodes.title: Jeremy Hall | We Are Creators and Builders
episodes.description: Jeremy Hall, Financial Reporting Director at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "When our creating and building efforts aren’t enough, His grace is sufficient to see us through."

episodes.title: Bill Riggins | In the Hands of the Lord of the Harvest
episodes.description: Bill Riggins, Student Honor Office Director at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Please consider what the Lord is offering you, claim the blessings, don’t leave them unused."

episodes.title: Nate Wise | A Blessed and Happy State
episodes.description: Nate Wise, Digital Context/Intellectual Property Rights Specialist at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "When we face trials, we can lift our eyes to the heavens, knowing that our mortal challenges are part of the grandeur of God’s plan for us."

episodes.title: President Alvin F. Meredith III and Sister Jennifer E. Meredith | The Temple, An Evidence of God's Love // How Will the Lord Manifest Himself to You in the Temple?
episodes.description: President Alvin F. Meredith III of Brigham Young University-Idaho and Sister Jennifer E. Meredith. "There are many manifestations of the truth that God loves us, the greatest of which is that He sent His Son to earth to atone for each of us."

episodes.title: Becky Roesler | See with Grace
episodes.description: Becky Roesler, Music Department Faculty at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "They were given assistance in that which they could not do alone. That is grace. In this case, they had grace to see. That is grace we can all access."

episodes.title: Darby Stapelman | Numbered Among the Sheep
episodes.description: Darby Stapelman, Director of Elementary Student Teaching Services at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Consider the stranger. Are we inclusive and welcoming? Do we let others into our circles and help them feel they belong?"

episodes.title: Elder James W. McConkie III | Doctrine and Covenants 109: A Prophet's Invitation
episodes.description: Elder James W. McConkie III, General Authority Seventy. "Go to the place where heaven and earth overlap; where God the Father and His Son, Jesus Christ, can be more present in your lives. Go to the temple."

episodes.title: Paul W. Lambert | Go Forth With Faith
episodes.description: Paul W. Lambert, Religion Initiative Director at the Wheatley Institute, Brigham Young University. "As you consider what will bring you true success, joy, and peace, remember that religion and your personal faith in Christ matter."

episodes.title: Becky and Ronald Craven | Humility in Covenant Leadership//Doers of the Work
episodes.description: President Ronald L. Craven of the Salt Lake City Headquarters Mission and Sister Rebecca L. Craven, Former Member of the Young Women General Presidency. “Humble leaders are aware of their shortcomings and are eager to listen and learn."

episodes.title: Sister Andrea Muñoz Spannaus | The Fast Track to Light and Truth
episodes.description: Sister Andrea Muñoz Spannaus of the Young Women General Presidency. "We have the light of Christ. Each of his children is born with a sense of what is right, a sense of justice and truth, and a sense to be loved and to love others."

episodes.title: Jennifer Hunter | Increase Your Capacity to Receive Personal Revelation
episodes.description: Jennifer Hunter, Cirriculum Designer at Brigham Young University-Idaho. “I’m starting to see that increasing my spiritual capacity means increasing my spiritual work. I have to put in more spiritual effort building on original primary answers."

episodes.title: John Fisher | Pillars of Making Critical Decisions Correctly
episodes.description: John Fisher, Associate Dean of Agriculture and Life Sciences at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "It is important fo me to remind you that you can do hard things and make critical decisions correctly."

episodes.title: Adam Bair | Lessons of Hope
episodes.description: Adam Bair, Program Director for Applied Business Management at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Working with the Lord through these setbacks, declines, or drops can help us learn meaningful lessons and prepare us for future upward growth."

episodes.title: President Alvin F. Meredith III and Sister Jennifer E. Meredith | Covenant-Keeping Disciple Leaders // True Identity and Love
episodes.description: President Alvin F. Meredith III of Brigham Young University-Idaho and Sister Jennifer Meredith. "The power and confidence granted to covenant keepers help them as they strive to become true disciples of Christ."

episodes.title: Danny Ricks | True Doctrine Understood Changes Attitude and Behavior
episodes.description: Danny Ricks, Religious Education Faculty Member at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "At times we can forget that we're in the midst of a celestial plan that is leading us to exaltation."

episodes.title: Jennie Pardoe | Righteous Failures
episodes.description: Jennie Pardoe, Theatre and Dance Faculty Member at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "If you find yourself ever wanting to hide yourself or your actions from the Lord, you have found a pretty good sign that you are giving into fear over faith."

episodes.title: Brother Gabriel W. Reid | Fumbling Is Not Failing
episodes.description: Brother Gabriel W. Reid, Second Counselor of the Sunday School General Presidency of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.

episodes.title: Kevin J. Worthen | Disciple Scholars and the Constitution
episodes.description: Kevin J. Worthen, Former President of Brigham Young University. "Like disciple-scholars in any field, those who study constitutional government in the light of gospel truths become more, not less, positive about the future."

episodes.title: Sister Michelle D. Craig | Hope In Thine End
episodes.description: Sister Michelle D. Craig, Former First Counselor of the Young Women General Presidency. "When [clear right and wrong choices and moments of truth] come, stand up. Stand tall, have courage, do the right thing."

episodes.title: Tom Waldron | Receiving Revelation and Acting in Faith
episodes.description: Tom Waldron, Engineering Technology Faculty Member at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "As our relationship with God grows, our light gets brighter, and the wire or conduit between God and us expands."

episodes.title: Elder Hans T. Boom | I Can Do All Things Through Christ Which Strengtheneth Me
episodes.description: Elder Hans T. Boom, General Authority Seventy. "Once you start working on your relationship with Christ, you will notice that the strengthening part is taking place immediately and can only deepen."

episodes.title: Janalee Meeker | Peace and Confidence through the Atonement of Jesus Christ
episodes.description: Janalee Meeker, Student Honor Administrator at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Please pay attention to the words and warnings of living prophets and apostles."

episodes.title: Richard Whiting | Weakness: A Condition of Mortality
episodes.description: Richard Whiting, Sociology and Social Work Faculty Member at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "If we are humble and have faith, Jesus can show us our weakness. He can then show us that... He can make weak things become strong."

episodes.title: Ryan Buttars | You Have Never Been Lost to His Sight
episodes.description: Ryan Buttars, Auxiliary Services Managing Director at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "You are by no means lost to His sight... He has known you from the very beginning and promises that one day, you will have a full understanding."

episodes.title: Marc Stewart | Our Prophet's Teachings for Our Day
episodes.description: Marc Stewart, Budget Officer at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Studying the scriptures, worshiping in the temple... and heeding the words of prophets, seers, and revelators, will help us hear Him more fully."

episodes.title: Presidetn Alvin F. Meredith III and Sister Jennifer E. Meredith | The Atonement of Jesus Christ // The Secret to a Life of Joy
episodes.description: President Alvin F. Meredith III of Brigham Young University-Idaho and Sister Jennifer E. Meredith. "The blessings of the Atonement of Christ are not only for the next life, but also enrich and uplift us in our mortal journey."

episodes.title: Josh Figueira | Workmen of All Kinds
episodes.description: Josh Figueira, University Legal Counsel at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "So bring your differences. Let others bring theirs. Rejoice in the majesty and diversity and design of a gospel that welcomes all."

episodes.title: Sister Kristin M. Yee | Believe in God
episodes.description: Sister Kristin M. Yee of the Relief Society General Presidency. “When we get transplanted into new places, with new experiences, people and relationships, it takes us a bit of time to acclimate and in some cases to understand why we are there.”

episodes.title: Jason Reeder | Look!
episodes.description: Jason Reeder, Communication Department Chair at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Let's look unto Christ... After our very best righteous efforts to be and do good, it is still only Jesus that saves."

episodes.title: Jenet Erickson | Designed for Love and Connection. Designed for Family.
episodes.description: Jenet Erickson, Family Fellow at the Wheatley Institute. "Ours is the day of healing and binding the family. This is what we were born for, to experience His healing redemption and enable that covenant redemption for others."

episodes.title: Diantha Hopkins | The Ten Minute Miracle
episodes.description: Diantha Hopkins, English Faculty Member at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "When we make time to give pure love to others, especially in the simple act of giving them our full attention, miracles can happen."

episodes.title: Elder Lance B. Wickman | Don’t Shrink!: Facing Life’s Uncertainties
episodes.description: Elder Lance B. Wickman, Emeritus General Authority Seventy. "When we learn to trust so completely in the Lord that we can accept His will in our lives no matter what, then we have found the calm jet stream of life well above the turbulence."

episodes.title: Elder Jorge M. Alvarado | Your Covenant Love
episodes.description: Elder Jorge M. Alvarado, General Authority Seventy. "[The endowment] is an essential ordinance that includes making sacred covenants that bless you now and throughout all eternity."

episodes.title: Scott Burton | How Will you Answer the Call?
episodes.description: Scott Burton, CSE Faculty Member. "In addition to blessing others, as we answer the call with an attitude of 'here am I, send me.' It will bring blessings into our own lives as well."

episodes.title: Max Bartschi | Building Discipleship
episodes.description: Max Bartschi, Construction Projects Manager at Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Prayers to our Heavenly Father are directly connected to the success we will have not only as students or employees but also as builders in the kingdom of God."

episodes.title: President and Sister Meredith | The Great Plan of Happiness
episodes.description: President Alvin Meredith and Jennifer Meredith of Brigham Young University-Idaho. "Jesus Christ is essential to each of us in every conceivable way, He is the ultimate expression of God's love to us."

episodes.title: Cindy Goodwill | With All Your Heart, Might, Mind, and Strength.
episodes.description: Cindy Goodwill, Worldwide Online Curriculum Instruction Director at BYUi and math teacher. "Consistent small efforts, both academically and spiritually, lead to deep lasting growth."

episodes.title: Elder Kevin G. Brown | Hastening the Work in You
episodes.description: Elder Kevin G. Brown of the General Authority Seventy. "Will you give access to the one who will work with you based on certainty, one who will never tire or give up on you?"

episodes.title: Elder and Sister Homer | Choose to Believe
episodes.description: Elder and Sister Homer of the General Authority Seventy. "We must approach uncertainty with patience and recognize that true enlightenment comes not only from knowledge but also from personal revelation and the confirming witness of the Holy Spirit."

episodes.title: Jim Lawrence | Choose Love
episodes.description: Jim Lawrence, Mechanical Engineering Faculty Member. "My brothers and sisters, we can change the world! Just as hatred and contention spread darkness, isolation, and loneliness, love can spread light, connection, and understanding."

episodes.title: Jenifer Craner | Trials are God's Plan for Growth
episodes.description: Jenifer Craner, Human Resources Coordinator. "Remember that faith is not the absence of fear, it’s the decision to follow God even when we’re afraid."

episodes.title: Casey Puzey | Trust the Refiner
episodes.description: Casey Puzey, Student Honor Officer. "Pain and suffering are part of everyone's mortal experience... The Lord needed me to have experiences so that I would become what the Lord needed me to become."

episodes.title: Alicia Willis | The Gospel of Jesus Christ: A Powerful Pattern for Life
episodes.description: Alicia Willis, Workday Governance Officer. "Unshaken faith in Christ, repentance, baptism, and the Holy Ghost are the path back to Him."

episodes.title: Elder I. Raymond Egbo | A Testimony of Jesus Christ
episodes.description: Elder I Raymond Egbo of the Quorum of the Seventy. "The benefits of this pursuit are joy and happiness, salvation, and a personal relationship with God and Jesus Christ."

episodes.title: Brian Christensen | Remember and Perish Not
episodes.description: Brian Christensen, Marketing Faculty Member.  "We remember as a source of future blessings. We remember to strengthen us in the present and bless us in the future."

episodes.title: Jodi Robison | Have A Nice Test!
episodes.description: Jodi Robison, Course Assessment Manager. "If life itself is a test, how is your test going? Are you having a nice test?"

episodes.title: Jared Boyter | Facing Zion
episodes.description: Jared Boyter, IT Portfolio Manager. "Seize every opportunity to face toward Zion in your heart, to serve without being asked, to cultivate grateful perspectives, and to uplift."

episodes.title: President and Sister Meredith | Preserving the Spirit of Ricks at BYU-Idaho
episodes.description: President and Sister Meredith of Brigham Young University Idaho.  “The Spirit of Ricks suggests the spirituality, the desire for obedience, the personal caring and warmth... and so many other elements that make [up] this university."

episodes.title: Elder Clark G. & Sister Christine C. Gilbert | Finding the Savior in the Proclamation
episodes.description: Elder Clark G. & Sister Christine C. Gilbert of the Quorum of the Seventy. "As you look for the Savior in the family proclamation, you will see yourself in God’s plan for His family and learn more of His plan for your eternal family."

episodes.title: Stephanie L. Colvin | First Things First
episodes.description: Stephanie L. Colvin, First-Year Experience Director. "That’s why we keep trying. That’s why we repent. That’s why we put Him first."

episodes.title: Elder Kim B. Clark | In the Hands of the Lord
episodes.description: Elder Kim B. Clark, Emeritus General Authority and Former President of BYU-Idaho. "The Lord has gone before this school, preparing the way, protecting, guiding, and blessing those who study and work here."

episodes.title: Heidi Egan | Hearts Knit Together in Song
episodes.description: Heidi Egan, Curriculum Designer. "Let’s find ways to sing the hymns as one important way to feel the Spirit and be united with bridges of empathy and with our hearts knit together in love."

episodes.title: Andy Johnson | The Divine Power of Relationships
episodes.description: Andy Johnson, Director of Architecture and Construction Management Services. "Let us work hard to be part of the relationships we love, [and] have the courage to shed the relationships that are not improving our lives."

episodes.title: David Ashby | Your Call to Adventure
episodes.description: David Ashby, Director of Learning Innovation & Technology. "Before you head out tomorrow morning, pray and ask Heavenly Father to show you who might need a smile, a word, or a friend."

episodes.title: Elder Karl D. Hirst | Repentance at Its Fullest
episodes.description: Elder Karl D. Hirst, General Authority Seventy. "It is about completely replacing the pipes for a much greater capacity so that my Savior’s power can flow more freely to me."

episodes.title: Jane Clayson Johnson | Silent Souls Weeping—Finding Help and Hope in Mental Illness
episodes.description: Jane Clayson Johnson Journalist and Best-Selling Author. "God lives and loves us. He will bear our grief and carry our sorrows. That is our promise."

episodes.title: Perry Rockwood | When Sorrow Meets the Savior
episodes.description: Perry Rockwood, Social Media Manager. "If you’re feeling stuck, numb, or like heaven has gone quiet, I invite you to lament."

episodes.title: President and Sister Meredith | Go and Do Thou Likewise & The Majesty of Your Moment
episodes.description: President of BYU Idaho, Alvin F. Meredith, and his wife Jennifer E. Meredith. "Be a Good Samaritan. See one another. Choose kindness. Be someone who builds and lifts."

episodes.title: Jennifer Platt | Washing Their Nets
episodes.description: Jennifer Platt, Religious Education Assistant Department Chair. "Through the making and keeping of covenants, we are called to discipleship: a holy redefining of fallen men and women."

episodes.title: Elder Bruce C. & Sister Marie Hafen | “Severe Mercy”—Love and Sacrifice
episodes.description: Elder Bruce C. & Sister Marie Hafen Emeritus General Seventy & Former Ricks College President. "A true disciple’s life requires a lifetime of spiritual experience, not just a once-in-a-lifetime experience."

episodes.title: Neihlee Muir | I Will Prepare the Way Before You
episodes.description: Neihlee Muir Construction Projects Manager. "May I challenge each of you to choose every day to do better and to put on your spiritual harness and claim the safety of the covenant path."

episodes.title: Elder Aaron T. Hall | Becoming is a Joyful Challenge
episodes.description:
Elder Aaron T. Hall,
General Authority Seventy. "Always and forever, He encircles you in the arms of His eternal love to help you know you can do this—you are His work and His glory!"

episodes.title: Elder Clement M. Matswagothata | Anchored in Christ
episodes.description:
Elder Clement M. Matswagothata
General Authority Seventy. "I testify that as you anchor your faith and testimony in Jesus Christ through sacred covenants, He will always be the answer to your honest questions of the soul."

episodes.title: President Robert and Sister Robin Chambers | Joy of Serving and Becoming Spiritually Resistant to Sin
episodes.description: President Robert and Sister Robin Chambers, Rexburg Idaho temple president and matron. "The temple is a sacred and joyful place of spiritual rejuvenation, sanctification, and sealing."

episodes.title: Justin Collings | A Prophet’s Vision for Your Education
episodes.description: Justin Collings, BYU Academic Vice President. "I too am a product of Joseph’s teachings. I too know him and love him through the words he taught and the truths he revealed."

episodes.title: Jon Linford | Conversion
episodes.description: Jon Linford Academic Vice President. "It was the uttering of the Spirit who knew what I needed. I needed hope. And he gave it to me."

episodes.title: President & Sister Meredith |  How Can One Person Be a Peacemaker & Building Intentional Families
episodes.description: President Alvin F. Meredith III and his wife Sister Jennifer E. Meredith, President of Brigham Young University-Idaho. "If there were ever a time that the world needed peacemakers, it is now. And that work begins with each of us."

episodes.title: Kassandra M. Mackley | The Transforming Power of Jesus Christ
episodes.description: Kassandra M. Mackley Tours and Events Coordinator. "I know that as you ask in faith, you will receive your own specific direction from the Lord."

episodes.title: Elder Robert C. Gay | Be True to the Voice of God
episodes.description: Elder Robert C. Gay, Emeritus General Authority Seventy. "I know that His voice and His hands are ever present in your world and mine today."

episodes.title: Trent Shippen | Become Legendary
episodes.description: Trent Shippen, Campus Recreation Activities Advisor. "Counseling together multiplies wisdom. We learn so much by being the participants rather than the spectators."

episodes.title: Elder B. Corey Cuvelier | A Great Check
episodes.description: Elder B. Corey Cuvelier, General Authority Seventy. "You do not need to wait for some future milestone to become closer to God."

episodes.title: Selena Robins | Spiritual Discernment
episodes.description: Selena Robins, Curriculum Maintenance Manager. "He speaks to each of us in ways we can learn to recognize because He loves us."

episodes.title: Elder Mark A. Bragg | Christlike Resiliency
episodes.description: Elder Mark A. Bragg, General Authority Seventy. "Christlike resilience is the holy capacity... not only to survive our trials but to be sanctified by them."

episodes.title: Sam Eidam | Divine Intelligence Guiding Our Use of Artificial Intelligence
episodes.description: Sam Eidam, HR Compensation Administrator. "God's knowledge is greater than anything we can create."

episodes.title: Ezra Gwilliam | The Temple and the Plan
episodes.description: Ezra Gwilliam, Religious Education Faculty Member. "The language of the Lord is necessary when attending the temple."

episodes.title: Kriss Pond | Our Covenant Connection to Jesus Christ
episodes.description: Kriss Pond, Student Living Manager. "The Lord is focused on your progress and the direction you're headed, no where you lack."

episodes.title: Tiffany Savage-Humphreys | Trust the God Who Knows the Ending
episodes.description: Tiffany Savage-Humphreys, Religious Education Faculty Member. "God often asks His covenant people to move forward in faith long before they understand His purposes."

episodes.title: Jon Paul Johnson | Bound to Christ by Covenant
episodes.description: Jon Paul Johnson, Physics Faculty Member. "God can give us power as we keep our covenants, allowing us to become people we otherwise couldn't."

episodes.title: President and Sister Meredith | The Mission of BYU-Idaho & Remember, Seek Revelation, and Prepare to Change
