episodes.description: President of BYU Idaho, Alvin F. Meredith, and his wife Jennifer E. Meredith. "Our mission is to develop disciples of Jesus Christ who are leaders in their homes, the Church, and their communities."

episodes.title: Elder James O. Fantone | "The Battle Is the Lord's"
episodes.description: Elder James O. Fantone, General Authority Seventy. "Let’s overcome our Goliaths by allowing the Lord to fight with us on each and every battle we have."

episodes.title: Rob Garrett | He Will Make More of You
episodes.description: Rob Garrett, Chief of Staff, Executive Strategy & Planning Vice President of BYU-Idaho. "When we have faith in Jesus Christ, we have faith that He understands more than us, and that He wants the best for us."

episodes.title: Chris Allison | Revelation: Opening the Heavens
episodes.description: Chris Allison, Religious Education Faculty Member at BYU-Idaho. "I urge you to stretch beyond your current spiritual ability to receive personal revelation."

episodes.title: Rob Barnes | Worth, Identity, and the Great Plan of Our Eternal Father
episodes.description: Rob Barnes, Counseling Center Counselor at BYU-Idaho. "Our true worth is infinite and eternal, it is constant and it dos not change. Your worth is not diminished by what others do or possess."

76a45338-ae1d-425c-b34d-ca6b365b3ffd.description: The fearless, clever, 14-year-old Theodosia Throckmorton lives and breathes Egyptology.

episodes.title: Theodosia Trailer
episodes.description: Watch the trailer for Theodosia.

episodes.title: The Eye of Horus
episodes.description: When she unearths an ancient amulet while in Egypt with her family, Theo begins to suspect that the relic might be cursed.

episodes.title: The Curse
episodes.description: Now certain that her father, Alistair, has been cursed, Theo's desperate search for answers is interrupted by the arrival of Safiya.

episodes.title: The Missing Princess
episodes.description: After recovering an ancient book of spells, Theo puts her newfound powers to the test to defeat her father's curse; however, her powers are more effective then she thinks.

episodes.title: An Accidental Odyssey
episodes.description: After falling through a magical portal, Will and Henry are whisked away to the Valley of the Kings; back in London, Theo and Safiya must work together.

episodes.title: The Games People Play
episodes.description: After experiencing a vision of her favorite haunt engulfed in flames, Theo rushes to the Penny Arcade to find a table-tennis tournament.

episodes.title: Cleaning Catastrophe
episodes.description: As the Throckmortons prepare for a visit with an important official who could ensure their ticket back to Egypt, Theo contends with visions.

episodes.title: The Head of the Snake
episodes.description: As the Serpents of Chaos close in, Theo and Henry must work to protect both the museum and the Eye of Horus.

episodes.title: The Sound of Magic
episodes.description: Theo and her friends begin a desperate search to recover the Eye of Horus and prevent the Serpents of Chaos from gaining control of the powerful artifact.

episodes.title: Double Danger
episodes.description: With the eclipse just days away, Theo hatches a daring plan to infiltrate the Serpents of Chaos' lair and take back the Eye.

episodes.title: The Darkening
episodes.description: With a total eclipse imminent, the Throckmortons prepare the museum for a celebratory fundraiser that draws the attention of the Serpents

episodes.title: The Pit of Despair
episodes.description: When Theo and Safiya are magically whisked away to Egypt, the Eye of Horus guides them inside Hatshepsut's Mortuary Temple.

episodes.title: Wild Child
episodes.description: Hoping life can get back to normal, Theo finds herself channeling her magical abilities for protection against the Serpents.

episodes.title: The Eye of the Needle
episodes.description: After the Serpents unleash the power of chaos across the globe, it's up to Theo, Will, and Safiya to save Henry and all of London from certain doom.

episodes.title: A Date with Destiny
episodes.description: The Serpents of Chaos are defeated and the only cloud on the horizon is Alistair and Henrietta’s upcoming return to Egypt, leaving the museum, Theo and Henry in stuffy Lady Throckmorton’s care.

episodes.title: Time Waits for Nobody
episodes.description: When Henry sets off a trap, Will and Safiya are caught inside the secret room. Worse, the walls start to rush in! Theo must take up her magic once more to save her friends.

episodes.title: The Age of Wisdom
episodes.description: With Lady Throckmorton in charge, life at the museum is no picnic. Worse, Theo can’t unlock the secrets of the mysterious journal she found in Sir Harold’s hidden room. She’ll need all the help she can get to put things right.

episodes.title: The Nightmare at the Museum
episodes.description: When an unlucky stumble cracks the mysterious pyramidion, Will, Safiya and Henry are all swept away into strange dreamworlds, where each of them faces a terrible test, while Theo and Nigella can only look on.

episodes.title: The Amazing Will
episodes.description: Theo and Nigella work to uncover the secrets of the pyramidion at the museum while, at the Penny Arcade, Safiya and Henry help prepare for Will’s big debut as a stage magician.

episodes.title: The Magic Flute
episodes.description: The pyramidion’s dangerous secret is revealed – it holds the key to the prison of the giant chaos-snake Aapep himself. Theo is desperate to seal it away but the others insist she enjoy her party first – it is her fifteenth birthday, after all!

episodes.title: An Impossible Choice
episodes.description: The truth is out! One of Theo’s closest friends is a Serpent and they mean to free the giant chaos-snake Aapep! Worse, the Serpents of Chaos have caught Theo’s parents in a deadly trap beneath the Great Sphinx!

episodes.title: What Big Teeth You Have
episodes.description: When an unusual key is discovered in Nigella’s abandoned belongings, Theo and Will set off to discover exactly what Aapep and the Serpents of Chaos are planning. Meanwhile, back at the museum Safiya, Henry and Lady T deal with a familiar foe.

episodes.title: Snake and Ladder
episodes.description: Theo’s parents are back from Egypt at last, but Henrietta is distinctly unwell. At the same time, someone or something has been stealing magic from the artefacts in the museum.

episodes.title: Mummies Alive!
episodes.description: Aapep is loose in London and museum mummies have been seen wandering at night. Blaming Aapep, Theo and her friends decide to follow the mummies to the chaos-snake’s base.

episodes.title: In Her Shoes
episodes.description: The trip to Aapep’s lair has left Safiya extremely sick. To undo her friend’s illness, Theo uses a powerful spell which accidentally swaps her and Safiya’s bodies.

episodes.title: Once Bitten
episodes.description: As Lady Throckmorton follows a trail of clues through Paris to find the Flail of Hemiunu, Will risks a return to Aapep’s lair.

episodes.title: The Last Sunrise
episodes.description: As they battle to stop the sun being swallowed, Theo and her friends must face Aapep’s unbelievable power without their most important weapons. Soon, Theo and Will are caught in a deadly-game of cat-and-mouse beneath the Great Pyramid.

episodes.title: Magic Memories
episodes.description: When the barge of Rameses II is loaned to the museum, Theo's magic grows out of control.

episodes.title: New Blood
episodes.description: Theo faces the unexpected challenge of starting life at a new school.

episodes.title: Bugs and Kisses
episodes.description: Rameses II's barge unleashes a magical plague on Theo's beloved museum.

episodes.title: The Ruin
episodes.description: Theo and Maya are carried off to Egypt by the magic of Rameses II's barge.

episodes.title: Stop the Press
episodes.description: Maya's attempt to publish the story of her trip to Egypt is thwarted by strange figures.

episodes.title: Into Darkness
episodes.description: When Theo's magic goes into overdrive at school, she ends up accidentally hurting Darius.

episodes.title: The Names of the Game
episodes.description: Henry throws a secret party at the museum; people disappear.

episodes.title: The Zodiac
episodes.description: On her hunt for the Oasis of Magic, Theo faces a perilous journey into a sunken temple.

episodes.title: The Phoenix
episodes.description: Jealous of Darius' adventures with Theo in Egypt, Will performs a death-defying trick.

episodes.title: A Fête Worse Than Death
episodes.description: Theo plans to unmask the Eternal Flame once and for all at the school fête.

episodes.title: In the Balance
episodes.description: The Eternal Flame moves through the school fête, playing mind games and sowing confusion.

episodes.title: Monsters of the Underworld
episodes.description: Theo and Darius travel through the Underworld and must face its dangerous guardians.

episodes.title: The Oasis of Magic
episodes.description: Theo guides the Eternal Flame to the Oasis, facing judgement by an ancient god.

episodes.title: The Sisterhood
episodes.description: After spotting a museum thief, Theo finds herself dangerously out of her depth.

episodes.title: No Rest for the Wicked
episodes.description: Theo begins training to become a true ankh mage with the Sisterhood of the Chosen Keepers.

episodes.title: In Plain Sight
episodes.description: Theo heads out to Egypt to stop a powerful artifact from falling into the wrong hands.

episodes.title: The Fog
episodes.description: As Darius tries to build a time machine, a terrible time fog is unleashed across London.

episodes.title: The Frosty Sands of Time
episodes.description: Theo is on a mission to an ice-bound desert tomb when familiar faces surprisingly turn up.

episodes.title: Weather or Not, Here I Come
episodes.description: After losing vital time machine artifacts, Theo is sent home by the Sisterhood.

episodes.title: The Prophecy
episodes.description: Darius needs Theo to activate the time machine, and he has the perfect bait for a trap.

episodes.title: Time Warp
episodes.description: Maya, Henry and Alistair must get past the Sisterhood and an ultra-tricky time loop.

episodes.title: Too Much Magic
episodes.description: Theo fights to halt Josie's unstoppable powers after she steals everyone's magic.

episodes.title: Prison Break
episodes.description: In order to restore the time machine, Theo and Will must free Darius from the Sisterhood.

episodes.title: Power Move
episodes.description: Theo and Maya must face off against a dangerously powerful Josie at the penny arcade.

episodes.title: For Better or Worse
episodes.description: Theo and Will travel back to ancient Egypt with Darius to recover the Djed Stone.

episodes.title: Climate of Fear
episodes.description: Theo finally battles Darius in Egypt, while Clive and Elena's wedding is crashed by Josie.

76ae4f70-01d1-4029-940f-e77a5d4ebae4.description: Jane Austen's cherished tale of sisters rebuilding their lives after their father's passing.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: When Mr. Dashwood passes away, Mrs. Dashwood and her daughters are forced to move into a tiny Devonshire cottage and start their lives again.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: While Colonel Brandon is away on business in London, Marianne and Willoughby find themselves falling in love.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Heartbroken at the hands of Willoughby and Edward, Marianne and Elinor travel to Cleveland; when they return to Devon, there's some good news.

76efba24-92ec-4d44-9920-eb3cdcb956b6.description: Take an honest look at genuine difficulties families face, and listen to real solutions.

episodes.title: The Boy Crisis
episodes.description: Young men are struggling around the world. The Jolleys show how they practice self-love while the Watsons work on goal setting. Warren Ferrell, author of The Boy Crisis and American political scientist, shares the importance of male role models.

episodes.title: The Loneliness Epidemic
episodes.description: Kinsey Larsen shares about battling loneliness and how she finds comfort in teaching. David Kozlowski, a licensed marriage and family therapist, discusses the link between loneliness and social media, as well as investing in authentic connections.

episodes.title: The Entitlement Intervention
episodes.description: The Losees share how they dealt with an entitled child and Nate Mitchell, co-director of the Anasazi Foundation, talks about keeping a strong relationship with your child. The Lonos are grateful for the kindness shown to their special needs son.

episodes.title: Pushing Back Against Instant Gratification
episodes.description: Moms discuss why their kids work in their homes. Nicholeen Peck, President of the Worldwide Organization for Women, talks about the importance of work being a positive thing. The Bennetts show how they’re rewarded for their work.

episodes.title: When Your Family is Different
episodes.description: Feeling different when dealing with special needs is challenging. The Ricks-Meles share how they show patience. Zion Clark, a professional wrestler and wheelchair racer, speaks on the importance of kids following their passions.

episodes.title: The Over-Scheduled Child
episodes.description: Moms talk about finding balance in their kids' schedules. Eli Harwood, best selling author of Securely Attached, discusses being in tune with your child. The Savages listen to their kids' feelings about their busy schedules.

episodes.title: Overcoming the Chaos of the World
episodes.description: Seeking refuge at home varies for every family. Brooke Romney, author of 52 Modern Manners for Today’s Teens, promotes intentional parenting. The blended Buehner-Walter family prioritizes connection while the Jones family values trust.

episodes.title: A Parent's Guide to Social Media
episodes.description: Moms discuss how they have taught their kids to use social media as a tool. Amie Anger, a licensed child and family therapist, talks about the decision to be on social media. The Geigles talk about the pressures of the internet.

826172bc-e895-4166-8a36-a646198d6ddd.description: A 12-year-old boy finds the skin of a selkie, a mythical creature that changes from seal to human.

episodes.title: A Date With Some Rocks
episodes.description: While visiting his dad in Wellington, New Zealand, 11-year-old Jake obtains the skin of a selkie, a mythical sea creature who transforms from a seal to a woman when on land.

episodes.title: It Wasn't A Dream
episodes.description: Jake follows in his dad's footsteps by gathering clues to support his hypothesis. Jessie teaches Jake a valuable lesson when he gets in trouble with some of the local kids.

episodes.title: Its Power Is Strong
episodes.description: Jake’s friend Jessie reveals that Cara cannot return to the sea without her seal skin. Jake agrees to return the skin to where he found it but fears the alluring pelt has too great a hold on him.

episodes.title: Where's Ted?
episodes.description: When Ted goes missing, Jake and Jessie must use their smarts to get him back to safety. Robert falls under Cara’s allure as she confronts Jake regarding the whereabouts of her seal skin.

episodes.title: Do The Right Thing
episodes.description: Ted desperately searches for Cara to stop her dangerous plan. Jake finally locates Cara's skin but must outrun the local kids in order to keep it. An unlikely ally saves the day.

episodes.title: Open Your Mind A Little
episodes.description: Jake embarks on a daring mission to find a special kelp that can heal Jessie's injuries. Ted reveals the truth to Robert about Cara by telling the story of his own Selkie experience. But the danger has already set in.

episodes.title: People We Care About
episodes.description: Jake enlists the help of Ted and Jessie when Robert refuses to give Cara's skin back. Ted reveals to Robert more of his tragic story but not before Robert's betrayal turns Cara into a different creature.

episodes.title: The Only Way This Can End
episodes.description: With Robert injured by Cara's animal rage, Jake embarks on a perilous mission to retrieve the seal skin from its underwater hiding place.

8b20c104-42fa-44c6-ac07-43febd77b163.description: The biggest names in Christian music share the inspiring stories behind their favorite songs.

episodes.title: Francesca Battistelli / Sidewalk Prophets
episodes.description: Billboard music award nominees Sidewalk Prophets perform "Come to the Table" and "I Believe It Now." Grammy award and Dove winner Francesca Battistelli performs "Holy Spirit" and "God is Good."

episodes.title: Jonathan McReynolds / Marie Osmond
episodes.description: #1 Billboard artist and Grammy Nominee Jonathan McReynolds performs "Best Thing" and "Lover of My Soul." Marie Osmond performs "The Only One" and "I Need Thee Every Hour."

episodes.title: Christmas Special
episodes.description: Amy Grant, CeCe Winans, Kirk Franklin, Michael W. Smith, Lecrae, Michelle Williams, Ben Rector and more celebrate Christmas with musical performances.

episodes.title: Cece Winans / Jordan Smith
episodes.description: Season 9 winner of The Voice Jordan Smith performs "Be Still and Know" and "Don't Quit." Cece Winans, the most awarded female Gospel artist of all time, performs "Believe For It" and "Great Is Thy Faithfulness."

episodes.title: Zach Williams / Naomi Raine
episodes.description: Grammy Award–winner and contemporary gospel singer Naomi Raine sings "Find My Peace" and "Promises." Grammy and GMA Dove Award–winner and southern rock artist Zach Williams performs his hit songs "Heaven Help Me" and "Chainbreaker."

episodes.title: Brandon Lake / Tasha Layton
episodes.description: Worship singer and Billboard Music Award winner Brandon Lake performs his songs "Grave Into Gardens" and "Gratitude." Christian artist and Christian Airplay chart-topper Tasha Layton performs her songs "Look What You've Done" and "Into The Sea."

episodes.title: Evan Craft / DOE
episodes.description: Contemporary gospel music singer/songwriter and Grammy nominee DOE performs her songs "So Good" and "Brighter." Worship singer and Dove Award nominee Evan Craft performs his songs "Be Alright" and "All I Ever Need."

episodes.title: Phil Wickham / MŌRIAH
episodes.description: Contemporary Christian musician and GMA Dove Award winner Phil Wickham performs his songs "Hymn of Heaven" and "Battle Belongs." Entertainer MŌRIAH performs her songs "Brave" and "Known, Seen, Loved."

episodes.title: Kevin Olusola / Elle Limebear
episodes.description: Pentatonix beatboxer Kevin Olusola performs "Turn Your Eyes Upon Jesus" and "Because He Lives." Singer Elle Limebear performs her original songs "Angels" and "Call On Your Name."

episodes.title: We Are Messengers / Elaine Bradley
episodes.description: Billboard Top Christian Albums chart-topper Darren Mulligan of Irish band We Are Messengers performs “Come What May,” and “Maybe It’s Okay.” Singer, songwriter, drummer, and Billboard Music Award–winner Elaine Bradley sings “Show Me,” and “What If.”

episodes.title: Matt Maher / Anna Golden
episodes.description: Singer and songwriter Anna Golden performs “Take It To Jesus,” and “Amazing Grace.” Five-time GMA Dove Award winner Matt Maher performs “Leaning” and “Run to the Father.”

episodes.title: Rhett Walker / Matt Sallee
episodes.description: Grammy winner Matt Sallee of Pentatonix performs "Yes and Amen" and "Word of God Speak." Grammy nominated country and Christian singer Rhett Walker sings his songs "Believer" and "Gospel Song."

episodes.title: Rend Collective / Mali Music
episodes.description: Grammy Award–winner Mali Music performs "Way For You" and "Miracle." GMA Dove Award nominees Gareth Gilkeson and Chris Llewellyn from Rend Collective perform  "Your Name is Power" and "Counting Every Blessing."

episodes.title: Cory Asbury / Dante Bowe
episodes.description: Grammy Award–nominated singer and songwriter Dante Bowe performs "Champion" and "Voice of God." GMA Dove Award–winner Cory Asbury sings "Reckless Love" and "Egypt."

episodes.title: A Grace Notes Christmas: Vol. 3
episodes.description: Zach Williams, Brandon Lake, Naomi Raine, Tasha Layton, DOE, Kevin Olusola, Matt Sallee, Phil Wickham and more celebrate Christmas on the Grace Notes studio.

episodes.title: Tye Tribbett / Evvie McKinney
episodes.description: Evvie McKinney performs "Look Not Further" and "Just Like God." Grammy-nominated Tye Tribbett performs "I Need You" and "Anyhow."

90dbdb42-4aa9-41da-becb-152ee922ad9b.description: A 75th anniversary celebration of the first full-length production of “The Nutcracker” in America.

episodes.title: Ballet West's The Nutcracker Celebration
episodes.description: This immersive presentation of Ballet West’s “The Nutcracker” commemorates the 75th anniversary of Willam Christensen staging the first full-length production of the ballet in America with performances and interviews.

episodes.title: Ballet West's The Nutcracker
episodes.description: This special performance of Ballet West’s “The Nutcracker” commemorates the 75th anniversary of Willam Christensen staging the first full-length production of the ballet in America, featuring his original choreography.

92b91bfe-d7ff-42bf-86d1-f870b210a913.description: Solving clues from a magic well, teenage sleuth Ruby brings hope and healing to her community.

episodes.title: I Wish He Was Still Here
episodes.description: Upon moving to a new town with her dad, Ruby discovers a magic well that shows her the wish of a woman in town. Ruby, with the help of her new friends Sam and Mina, work to help reunite the woman's family.

episodes.title: I Wish I Knew Where to Start
episodes.description: Ruby, Sam, and Mina fulfill the wish of the town librarian, leading them on a treasure hunt to uncover a centuries-old mystery and Emerald’s best kept secret. Meanwhile, Daniel attempts to fix his old home with help from a new friend.

episodes.title: I Wish I Could Walk With Her
episodes.description: Ruby, Sam, and Mina try to fulfill the wish of a local family to save a wedding, and in the process, they learn not to judge a book by its cover. Daniel discovers more revelations about Old Tom's property.

episodes.title: I Wish She Would Trust Me
episodes.description: Trust is brought into question when Ruby wonders if she can tell her dad about the magical well. Daniel meets a military friend of his father's who sheds some light on the past.

episodes.title: I Wish I Got The Credit I Deserve
episodes.description: Ruby, Sam, and Mina help a science camp teacher get the credit she deserves. Daniel investigates Ruby’s good deeds around town.

episodes.title: I Wish I Could Stop Pretending
episodes.description: Ruby, Sam and Mina learn the importance of telling the truth when they bring a long-kept secret to light. Meanwhile, Daniel and Paula try to win over a developer interested in Emerald who could potentially put the town back in business.

episodes.title: I Wish I Could Have Another Chance
episodes.description: The Emerald Apple Festival is back and reveals a new, unusual wish for Ruby to fulfill. Daniel and Paula revive the festival’s apple cart race, and a longstanding tradition of competition between the Prices and the O’Reillys.

episodes.title: I Wish I Could Meet My Family
episodes.description: Ruby wrestles with how to solve a wish that hits close to home, involving Sam's desire to meet his biological family. Ruby’s maternal grandparents come to town for a visit.

episodes.title: I Wish I Could Get Back at Her
episodes.description: Development endangers Ruby's wishing well, while Daniel makes a wish of his own. Ruby and Sam learn about the consequences of seeking revenge when they discover a wish regarding two feuding actors.

episodes.title: I Wish We'd Stayed Friends
episodes.description: Ruby discovers a wish from beyond the grave that needs to be fulfilled. Daniel fights for the preservation of the wishing well, but the development company has other ideas.

episodes.title: I Wish Things Could've Turned Out Differently
episodes.description: After a wishless winter, Ruby struggles to save the well while granting the wish of an enemy of the town. Are these two tricky missions somehow intertwined? Meanwhile, Daniel and Paula plan to delay a construction crew poised to demolish the well.

episodes.title: I Wish I Could Find Her
episodes.description: Ruby’s latest wisher hopes to find someone, but figuring out who turns out to be the hardest part of the wish. Meanwhile, Daniel is bombarded by calls from his father who wants Daniel and Ruby to give up the orchard and leave Emerald for good.

episodes.title: I Wish I Could Get Away
episodes.description: As Ruby and friends tackle a new wish, they run into a strange new problem: the wish appears to be granting itself. Meanwhile, Ruby worries her dad is lonely in Emerald and embarks on a mission to find him some new friends.

episodes.title: I Wish We Could Get Back Together
episodes.description: Ruby receives a musical wish that involves a local celebrity and a broken friendship,while Daniel  and Paula organize a benefit concert.

episodes.title: I Wish I Could Spend Time With Her
episodes.description: As Ruby embarks on her newest wish, she rekindles the search for a long-missing Emerald resident. Meanwhile, Daniel’s efforts to bring back the O’Reilly apple tree uncovers a brand new mystery.

episodes.title: I Wish They Would Just Listen
episodes.description: After the well gives Ruby clues but no wish, Ruby must figure out what that means. Only then can she help a wisher enjoy their wish to travel. Meanwhile, Daniel’s efforts to solve a mystery sets off a misunderstanding among Emerald’s residents.

episodes.title: I Wish I Had Some Space
episodes.description: Ruby and her friends struggle to grant the wish of a very intimidating and mysterious wisher. Meanwhile, Ruby and Daniel are both unsure how to handle an important date on the calendar: what would’ve been Summer’s birthday.

episodes.title: I Wish I Could Get It Back
episodes.description: Ruby and her friends embark on a thrilling and unexpected adventure close to home as they try to recover something precious lost by a wisher. Meanwhile, Ava and Daniel bond over raising teenage daughters.

episodes.title: I Wish I Could Stop Hurting
episodes.description: A confusing wish challenges Ruby with brokering peace after a longstanding family feud. Meanwhile, Daniel and Sam take a journey through the orchard and discover more about Ruby’s well-keeping ancestors.

episodes.title: I Wish the Well Would Let Us Be
episodes.description: Ruby receives her toughest wish yet from someone who knows all about the well’s magic. If the wisher is who she thinks it is, granting this wish could mean the end of the wishing well itself.

episodes.title: I Wish I Knew Where It Was
episodes.description: A famous bank robbery in Emerald’s past becomes the focus of Ruby’s latest wish, but the wisher is the last person she would’ve suspected. After a lifetime of keeping a crushing secret, the wisher worries the past is about to catch up with them.

episodes.title: I Wish I Could Stop This Monster
episodes.description: A wish expressed in barks instead of words leads Ruby to help a rural veterinarian struggling with a lot more than panicky pets. But she soon realizes the monster he’s facing is scarier than she thought.

episodes.title: I Wish I Could Rest In Peace
episodes.description: The well gives Ruby a wish from beyond the grave from Viole O’Reilly, the Victorian well keeper from her previous visions. This wish is part of All Souls Day, the Irish day of the dead, which means Ruby only has until midnight tomorrow to grant it.

episodes.title: I Wish He Knew the Whole Story
episodes.description: Sam and his mom find themselves on opposite sides of a hot-button community issue. Meanwhile, Ruby receives a wish so vague that it’s going to take all her and Mina’s legwork even to make a dent in it.

episodes.title: I Wish He was Dead
episodes.description: After missing an important family event, Ruby is racked with guilt. Worse, she receives a wish too awful to grant! Mina and Sam are ready to take over for her and manage to supply Ruby and her dad with a much-needed bonding opportunity.

episodes.title: I Wish I Could Feel Love Again
episodes.description: Ruby and Sam join forces to help someone who wants to “feel love again”. But after the wisher is discovered, a misunderstanding leads to a possibly disastrous revelation. Now, they must figure out what the wish really means before it’s too late.

episodes.title: I Wish She Was Out of the Way
episodes.description: Ruby believes that a wisher wants to get rid of rivals for Daniel's affections– including her mom's memory. Given the growing importance of family in Ruby’s life, that is a step too far! That is, unless Ruby is wrong about the intent of the wish.

episodes.title: I Wish I Was the Next Well Keeper
episodes.description: After struggling to balance wish granting with regular teen life, Ruby’s now ready to rock her next challenge. But when she gets the worst-possible wish, will she find a way out? Meanwhile, Seb is onto Mina and the secret she’s keeping from him.

episodes.title: I Wish... I Wish... I Wish...
episodes.description: Ruby returns to Emerald from Ireland with fresh concerns about keeping the well alive. She receives three different visions of wishes to fulfill with the help of Mina and Sam. Meanwhile, Dan and Leah have an awkward reunion--and a new secret.

episodes.title: I Wish I Could Land a Sweet Deal
episodes.description: Ruby has her hands full with a particularly ambitious wish from powerhouse realtor Amanda "The Wolf" Wilczek, which includes working with the most haunted house in Emerald. Meanwhile, Dan helps out the local firehouse, sparking a dream of his own.

episodes.title: I Wish I Was A Kid Again
episodes.description: Ruby and her friends search for a wisher who wants to be a kid again. When they find that it's another kid, they dig deep to find an extra special answer. Dan starts his journey as a probationary volunteer fireman with an unlucky Emerald resident.

episodes.title: I Wish I Knew What She Was Hiding
episodes.description: Ruby's fear of losing the well intensifies when she sees a vision of video footage at the well. She, Mina, and Sam launch an investigation into vintage items to find the videographer. Meanwhile, Dan helps Mrs. Martin look for a newer, safer home.

episodes.title: Ecnahc Rehtona Dah I Hsiw I
episodes.description: Ruby receives a garbled clue from the well that forces her, Mina, and Sam to think in a different direction. Dan runs interference between Amanda and her sudden interest in the magical well.

episodes.title: I Wish Tom Didn't Ruin Everything
episodes.description: With more scrutiny than ever before, Ruby uses her wish to keep the well healthy and secret. Meanwhile, Emerald's Thanksgiving dinner could be ruined if the wish isn't fulfilled in time. Dan and Brea work together to get Wally to join the fun.

episodes.title: I Wish I Wouldn’t Lose
episodes.description: The well's clues are the most garbled and blurry yet. Ruby worries that she will lose the well forever. She, Mina, and Sam still work to fulfill the wish and get involved in the world of football. Dan continues to cope with the idea of Ruby leaving.

episodes.title: I Wish...
episodes.description: Ruby hopes that her wish is the next to come out of the well--but is shocked when it's Dan's that comes next. Time is running out for the well as Mrs. Rivers-Snyder asks more questions. A surprise visitor provides answers about the failing well.

9b96b4bd-d7a1-47b3-9687-95751f0e42ce.description: Teens with an array of personal challenges bring meaningful and sustainable change in Bolivia, Vanuatu, and Mongolia.

episodes.title: Vulnerability
episodes.description: The journey begins for three groups of teens as they travel to Bolivia, Vanuatu, and Mongolia to serve the local people and find meaningful growth and spiritual healing.

episodes.title: The Outsiders
episodes.description: The teens in Bolivia and Vanuatu start building the foundation for new schools, while those in Mongolia begin work on a public bath with hot water. As they learn about the struggles of the locals, their own mental and spiritual trials are revealed.

episodes.title: The Pivot Point
episodes.description: The teens start finding joy in their service while facing their personal struggles. They begin constructing walls, laying foundations, and installing insulation. The teens also spend time with locals, and learn more about local culture.

episodes.title: The Good Path
episodes.description: In Bolivia, a teen learns how to serve when he can’t do physical labor. In Mongolia, another teen misses loved ones. In Vanuatu, a teen analyzes his relationship with God.

episodes.title: Yesterday's Scars
episodes.description: A teen in Mongolia struggles to connect with others. In Bolivia, a teen battles hopelessness. In Vanuatu, a teen works to overcome body image issues. Friendships are deepened and the final stages of their projects begin.

episodes.title: What We Carry Home
episodes.description: The groups finish their service projects and prepare for their return home, looking back on the personal growth, healing, and the friendships they've formed.

ff84ac33-97ef-426f-b7af-4d167c3a0710.description: A collection of award-winning animated shorts from students in the the acclaimed BYU Center for Animation.

episodes.title: Dream Giver
episodes.description: Where do dreams come from? A magical creature unlocks the subconscious imaginings of children as they sleep.

episodes.title: Estefan
episodes.description: Estefan is the world's greatest hairdresser; however, his latest client proves to be a challenge.

episodes.title: Metro
episodes.description: A ticket purchase to ride the metro train leads a young woman to a fantastical discovery.

episodes.title: Owned
episodes.description: An unwitting slacker faces off against a baby in the ultimate video game challenge.

episodes.title: Papa
episodes.description: An overprotective angel does everything in his power to sabotage his daughter’s first date.

episodes.title: Grendel
episodes.description: A dragon’s peaceful and solitary existence is disrupted when pesky Vikings settle on his island.

episodes.title: Ram's Horn
episodes.description: An adventurer faces off against a mountain goat in a quest to scale a difficult mountain peak.

episodes.title: Salt
episodes.description: A Senegalese mother helps her daughter find joy in the sounds and rhythms of their everyday life.

episodes.title: Stowaway
episodes.description: A young sea monster is accidentally brought aboard a pirate ship.

episodes.title: Taijitu
episodes.description: A young boy must confront his fears when he is chosen to live in a remote monastery.

episodes.title: Cenote
episodes.description: When Axel, a young axolotl, gets separated from his family by ancient magic it’s up to him and Memo, an unlikely human ally, to get him out of the Cenote he’s trapped in and back to his home.

episodes.title: Xing
episodes.description: The ghost of an armadillo is frustrated by her still-living boyfriend’s wishy-washiness.

episodes.title: Turtles
episodes.description: An inconsiderate turtle gets his comeuppance while attempting to grab a bite to eat.

episodes.title: Pajama Gladiator
episodes.description: A boy recounts to his mother his fantastical abduction by aliens.

episodes.title: Lion and the Mouse
episodes.description: A timid mouse comes to the rescue of the lion who spared his life.

episodes.title: Lemmings
episodes.description: A reluctant lemming has second thoughts about jumping off a cliff.

episodes.title: Kites
episodes.description: A boy takes a magical journey on a kite as he mourns the loss of his grandfather.

episodes.title: Las Pinatas
episodes.description: In sunny Mexico, two pinatas must survive a birthday party.

episodes.title: Chasm
episodes.description: A brilliant scientist travels through time and space to find her husband who disappeared years earlier.

episodes.title: The Witch's Cat
episodes.description: Jealousy strikes a witch’s cat when the witch’s boyfriend proposes, prompting the cat to take drastic action in this heartwarming tale of love, acceptance, and forgiveness.

a36f2931-a6fc-4324-b94b-75d4f943603f.description: Seven young adults from around the world explore the Salt Lake Temple's renovation, history, architecture, and purpose.

episodes.title: All Nations Will Flow Unto It
episodes.description: Seven young adults from around the world come to Salt Lake City to experience the historic Salt Lake Temple. As they meet for the first time, they begin exploring its renovation, history, and purpose, and what it means to draw closer to Jesus Christ.

episodes.title: Strengthening Foundations: The Salt Lake Temple Renewal
episodes.description: The six young adults go beneath the Salt Lake Temple to discover the massive seismic engineering effort designed to protect it from earthquakes and preserve this sacred place for generations as an ensign to the nations.

episodes.title: Covenant Connections
episodes.description: At a remarkable Jerusalem film set, the seven young adults explore the ancient history of temples and their purpose today. They discover why temples are called the House of the Lord and how these sacred spaces can bring us closer to Jesus.

episodes.title: Heavenly Design: The Gift of the Salt Lake Temple
episodes.description: The seven young adults visit the historic Kirtland Temple to discover why early Saints sacrificed to build it and learn how sacred promises made with God in temples can provide strength, direction, and a deeper connection to Jesus Christ.

episodes.title: Sealed by Love: Eternal Families
episodes.description: The seven young adults discover how temples bind us to Jesus Christ and can unite families for eternity. Through the temple's stained glass and sacred imagery, they also explore how the light of Christ can bring hope and direction to our lives.

a3f02223-ac08-45b7-9118-5cbf33136fd8.description: A team of expert builders make a world of difference in communities around the globe.

episodes.title: Mt. of Olives, Mexico
episodes.description: The Fixers travel to Uruapan, Mexico to the Mount of Olive orphanage to build a vocational school for orphans—adding their own artistic touches along the way. Giving the kids a chance to build their future and join the job market ready to work.

episodes.title: Waves of Hope, Nicaragua
episodes.description: The Fixers travel to Northern Nicaragua to help Waves of Hope—a local charity determined to provide fresh water for the community. They’ll dig a well while simultaneously refurbishing an entire elementary school.

episodes.title: Shelter to Soldier, Oceanside
episodes.description: The Fixers travel to California to help Shelter to Soldier—an organization dedicated to adopting dogs and pairing them with post 9/11 veterans suffering from PTSD. They’ll build new kennels and training areas, hoping to save lives…two at a time.

episodes.title: New Roots Haiti
episodes.description: The Fixers help New Roots Haiti, a farm that raises livestock to create jobs for the Haitian community. They work together to build a grain mill that will allow the Haitian people to sell their corn.

episodes.title: Sustainable Bolivia
episodes.description: Working with Sustainable Bolivia, the Fixers travel to a remote village in the Bolivian Amazon. Using traditional construction methods, they help the local people build a community-run restaurant and tourism center.

episodes.title: Global Village Connect, Thailand
episodes.description: The Fixers travel to Chiang Mai, Thailand to help Global Village Connect. They will build a chicken-fish farm for the local school’s students to have an abundant source of protein.

episodes.title: Association of the Beatitudes, Peru
episodes.description: The Fixers travel to Lima, Peru to help Asociación de las Bienaventuranzas, an organization that gives abandoned special needs people a home. They build a recycling facility to help the organization generate money and promote recycling in Lima.

episodes.title: Orchard: Africa, South Africa
episodes.description: The Fixers go to Khayelitsha, South Africa to assist Orchard: Africa to build a training facility for vertical gardening.

episodes.title: One Heart Bulgaria
episodes.description: The Fixers travel to Plovdiv, Bulgaria to help One Heart Bulgaria, an organization that helps Bulgarian orphans. They will build a horse arena and sensory obstacle course to give orphans, both young and old a new type of therapy.

episodes.title: The People's Farm, AZ
episodes.description: The Fixers travel to Arizona to help the White Mountain Apache Tribe. Working with Ndee Bikiyaa (People’s Farm), they’ll repurpose an old building into a fresh market where locals can sell produce and restore confidence in local heritage.

episodes.title: Alaska's Healing Hearts
episodes.description: The Fixers travel to Alaska to help Alaska’s Healing Hearts, an organization helping veterans reintegrate into society through outdoor recreational activities. The Fixers transform the island with an outdoor kitchen, painted cabins, and a dock.

episodes.title: CAEMBA, Ecuador
episodes.description: The Fixers are off to Ecuador to work with CAEMBA, an organization that builds bamboo homes for underprivileged women. The Fixers are building a trade school with a sewing room, woodshop, kitchen, and nursery for the children.

episodes.title: The Lake Clinic, Cambodia
episodes.description: The Fixers head to Cambodia to help The Lake Clinic restore one of their floating medical clinics. They’ll update the clinic with a new floating dock, roof, kitchen, and floor.

episodes.title: Arecibo Capitanes, Puerto Rico
episodes.description: The Fixers venture to the small coastal town of Arecibo, Puerto Rico, to help rebuild a basketball court that has fallen into disrepair. The Fixers will rehabilitate the court and create murals that will draw in crowds and add beauty to the area.

episodes.title: Hope & Humanity United, Honduras
episodes.description: The Fixers travel to the rural community of La Coroza, Honduras, to help Hope and Humanity United build a bakery for a team of local women. The Fixers will build the bakery from the ground up, adding industrial kitchen appliances and a cozy cafe.

episodes.title: TOPPS, Arkansas
episodes.description: The Fixers journey to Pine Bluff, Arkansas, to work with TOPPS, a program dedicated to providing meals and a safe space for children. A facility remodel inside and a playground build outside will give the children a safe space to play and learn.

episodes.title: Concerned Black Men, Los Angeles
episodes.description: The Fixers team up with Concerned Black Men of Los Angeles and rehab an old building as CBMLA's new home.

episodes.title: Blue's Gym, Grand Rapids
episodes.description: The Fixers travel to Grand Rapids, Michigan, to help world champion kickboxer Dino Newville and Blue’s Gym in their mission to empower and educate the city's at risk youth.

episodes.title: COMEA, Cheyenne
episodes.description: The Fixers are heading to Cheyenne to work with COMEA, the largest homeless shelter in Wyoming, to build a homeless shelter designed specifically for families. And winter is coming. But the Fixers will do whatever it takes to get the job done.

episodes.title: CRIT, Mexico
episodes.description: The Fixers fly to Tampico, Mexico to work at a rehabilitation center for children with neuromuscular issues. The center is missing one crucial item – a repair shop for the equipment. The Fixers will pull out all the stops to make this build happen.

episodes.title: Daisy Centre Kenya
episodes.description: The Fixers go to the Daisy Centre School in Kenya. They educate over 500 children a year and need more resources to provide enough protein. The Fixers are here to help improve their livestock area, providing more space for cows and chickens.

episodes.title: ROMP Guatemala
episodes.description: The Fixers travel to Zacapa, Guatemala, to build a mobility lab so newly-amputated patients can test out their prosthesis on a variety of terrain.

episodes.title: Hunters Greave England
episodes.description: In Leeds, England, the Fixers refurbish an old scout camp that has fallen on hard times. This camp gives the local children a safe, fun way to experience the outdoors, but could be shut down without improvements from the Fixers.

episodes.title: Nizhoni Garden Navajo Nation
episodes.description: The Fixers go to the Navajo Nation to create a garden project at the Red Valley/Cove High School and provide fresh produce for more kids and their families.

episodes.title: Down Home Ranch, Texas
episodes.description: The Fixers head to Texas to build a gym for the Down Home Ranch, a nonprofit that gives vocational, social, and residential opportunities to adults with disabilities.

episodes.title: CEPIA Costa Rica
episodes.description: In Costa Rica, the Fixers create a space for the women in San Jose de la Pinilla to sell their baked delicacies and handmade artisanal goods.

episodes.title: Asajaka Weno Suriname
episodes.description: The Fixers travel to the remote, indigenous village of Pierre Kondre, Suriname to work with Asajaka Weno cooperative, whose mission is to inspire women from rural communities by creating entrepreneurship opportunities with pineapple products.

episodes.title: Crescer Portugal
episodes.description: In Portugal, the Fixers help Barrio Padre Cruz to build É Um Restaurante, a large restaurant that provides jobs for the unhoused community.

episodes.title: Trails of Purpose Virginia
episodes.description: The Fixers work with Trails of Purpose, a small equine therapy center that provides services free of charge to veterans struggling with PTSD.

episodes.title: Siksha Foundation Zambia
episodes.description: The Fixers head to Kitwe, Zambia to visit the Kapoto Primary school. With 3,400 students, the school is in desperate need of more classrooms. The Fixers goal is to build six new classrooms and a pre-school, giving them the space they need.

episodes.title: Socks
episodes.description: Hosts Andi Sweeney Blanco and Courtney Dober create a unique way to give socks to those in need.

episodes.title: Mi Casa Esperanza, Mexico
episodes.description: In Mexico, the Fixers help build a new playground for a women’s shelter, Mi Casa Esperanza. A new Fixer, Nick Bishop, finds an unexpected connection with the people of Mi Casa Esperanza.

episodes.title: Unsilenced Voices, Sierra Leone
episodes.description: The Fixers travel to Sierra Leone to build a cassava processing plant for an impoverished village. As they work, they learn how Muslims and Christians coexist in the area.

episodes.title: Humanity & Hope, Honduras
episodes.description: The Fixers reunite with familiar faces as they return to a location from a previous build in Honduras to repair hurricane damage and reinforce homes in preparation for future storms.

episodes.title: The Lemong'o Project, Kenya
episodes.description: The Fixers help the Maasai in Kenya build a bead processing plant that will provide revenue for their village. Short on time and manpower, the Fixers work to provide a safe place for the women of the tribe to practice their traditional craft.

episodes.title: Engineering Without Borders, Argentina
episodes.description: In Argentina, the Fixers help a town construct an education center for students learning agriculture. The school specializes in beekeeping, and the Fixers must figure out how to extract honey from the hives.

episodes.title: Green VI, British Virgin Islands
episodes.description: The Fixers revitalize a recycling center in the British Virgin Isles to help alleviate the growing problem of trash buildup on Tortola. Original Fixer Nick Apostolides returns as a guest star to help the group with their work.

episodes.title: It's Humanity Foundation, Bangladesh
episodes.description: The Fixers face their most unique challenge yet in Bangladesh where they must turn a bus into a mobile classroom to help get pre-school education to the disadvantaged areas of Dhaka.

episodes.title: Battle Scarred Motorsports, Louisiana
episodes.description: In Louisiana, the Fixers build a racing garage for a track that serves Veterans through adrenaline therapy. A potential new Fixer is put to the test to see if he has what it takes to become a member of the team.

episodes.title: Ya'axché Conservation Trust, Belize
episodes.description: The Fixer’s work with their newest teammate, Rob, to build a new ranger station in the jungles of Belize. Their efforts help provide protection from wildfires, illegal logging, and poachers.

episodes.title: Caribbean Christian Center for the Deaf, Jamaica
episodes.description: The Fixers travel to Kingston, Jamaica to build a culinary institute for the Caribbean Christian Center for the Deaf. There they find a welcoming and generous community ready to work hard to give access to those who cannot hear.

episodes.title: The Fixers Season 4 Trailer
episodes.description: Watch the trailer for season 4 of The Fixers.

episodes.title: Uruguay
episodes.description: In Montevideo, Uruguay, the Fixers join forces with Cireneos and Father Gordo, a Catholic priest dedicated to serving his community. Together, they construct a much-needed kitchen workspace that will provide support for local residents.

episodes.title: Chicago
episodes.description: In the Pullman neighborhood of Chicago, the Fixers start off with a tour from teammate Rob North who grew up there. After the tour, they join Pullman Tech students in transforming a workshop, helping to create a lasting impact for future students.

episodes.title: Philippines
episodes.description: The Fixers partner with Smile Train, an organization that provides free care for children and young adults with cleft lips and palates. With one less day than usual and a team member falling ill, they must push through to finish the project.

episodes.title: Togo
episodes.description: n Togo, the Fixers work on a special project that promises to give more help and support teens and youth struggling with mental health.

episodes.title: Ghana
episodes.description: After receiving a call from LA Galaxy soccer star Joseph Paintsil, The Fixers travel to Ghana to team up with Project Maji, an organization dedicated to bringing safe and clean drinking water to villages all over Africa.

episodes.title: Greece
episodes.description: Working with the group We Need Books, the Fixers renovate and improve a library space for youth in Athens. During the build, they hear inspiring stories of resilience from both the founders and the young people who attend the library regularly.

episodes.title: Nepal
episodes.description: With a goal to help the organization Paint the Globe Foundation transform a classroom in Nepal, the Fixers create an inspiring space to facilitate academic opportunities for women.

episodes.title: Mongolia
episodes.description: In Mongolia, the Fixers tackle a project in a remote area. Faced with harsh weather and limited materials, their build slows and the project is put at risk.

a8c5a2a6-60e6-4088-a9bc-86f1b0cca26d.description: Follows five kelpies from the same litter on their journey to become champion muster dogs.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Breeder Joe Spicer and trainer Neil McDonald play matchmaker for five sweet, energetic kelpies, as they strive to pick the perfect handler for each one.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: As the four-month assessment approaches, the handlers test different ways of connecting with their pups; one naughty kelpie gets a devilish new name.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: At six months, the pups have strong bonds with their handlers; they face big tests as they learn how to herd livestock and respond to calls.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: With the year now completed, the kelpie siblings reunite for their final herding test.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Debbie and Snip become the mother and father of the newborn litter of pups in Goondy Creek, NSW; these pups are sent to five Australian graziers, who will each attempt to train their pup in less than a year.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: The five-month assessment looms, and the handlers struggle to dedicate focused time to their pups; some trainers stumble while others leap through the tasks; the pups and trainers have a long road ahead of them.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: At seven months, the pups have a strong bond with their handlers; but they face big tests as they learn to herd livestock and respond to calls.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: At 10 months, the dogs have hit puberty and start to show some new teenage rebelliousness; there are mixed levels of success in the assessment and one of the pups falls gravely ill.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: The 12 month experiment is complete, the Australian border Collie siblings reunite for the first time to face their final challenge; it's neck and neck but one dog shines brighter than the pack and is crowned Champion Muster Dog.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Six Border Collie and Kelpie pups are trained by graziers across Australia in a year-long challenge, guided by expert trainers, to test which will become the ultimate Champion Muster Dog.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: Six trainers face unique challenges with their pups as they prepare for the five-month assessment. Balancing life and training, they must prove bond, obedience, calmness, and instinct to advance.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Six pups face their five-month test. Banjo shines, Pockets struggles, Hudson and Chief thrive, Banksi bonds with Blythe, and Pesto lags. Results surprise Mick and Neil as trainers prepare for the next stage.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: The pups face their eight-month assessment. Handlers juggle farms, family, and school while Kelpies and Collies battle flaws. With surprising results, the race to crown the Champion Muster Dog heats up.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: Mick and Neil travel to assess their teams as the ten-month deadline nears. From Nathan’s struggles with Chief to Kim’s standout with Banjo, each gains vital feedback. Team Kelpie and Team Collie face a fierce finish.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: Six pups and trainers face their final test in Warialda. With judges watching closely, the challenges are fierce. One team rises above the rest, earning the title of Champion Muster Dog.

ae7ef399-a9ee-48ac-99b1-9c22ad9bd12e.description: Expand your audio files and discover some of the nation's favorite bands.

episodes.title: 12 Bands of Christmas
episodes.description: Discover the power of music as twelve local bands, including Fictionist, Ryan Innes, and Mindy Gledhill, perform Christmas songs old and new.

bfc02cdb-b8d0-480c-b5b5-af072705f470.description: Enter the fantastical world of The Knot, a beautiful and secluded farm, where Rocket and Alli host foster children and embark on magical adventures.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Rocket and Alli welcome their newest foster siblings, Casey and Lena, to The Knot. As Rocket and Alli prepare to compete in the annual village show, they discover that Casey and Lena might not be who they say they are, uncovering a world of magic.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: Rocket's search for the truth will uncover a web of secrets that reaches further than he had ever imagined.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: With just hours left in the doomsday prophecy, Alli and Rocket come closer to learning the truth about Casey and Lena.

episodes.title: An Answer for Everything
episodes.description: There's a new foster kid coming to stay.

episodes.title: Brandon and the Beast
episodes.description: When a mythical creature is sighted in the woods, Rocket is determined to save it from extinction.

episodes.title: The Fairy Queen
episodes.description: When an old lady, Mary Mac, comes to stay, Jade discovers that she is the queen of the fairies.

episodes.title: The Golden Egg
episodes.description: When Alli breaks a rare bird's egg at school, she embarks on a quest to find a new one.

episodes.title: Alli and the Wish Friend
episodes.description: After Alli makes a wish for a best friend, she is shocked to find it comes true.

episodes.title: Fallout
episodes.description: Alli and Shada are trapped in a haunted fallout shelter.

episodes.title: The Mermaid's Song
episodes.description: Rocket and friends find themselves trapped in a cove with the tide coming in.

episodes.title: The Wolf Tree
episodes.description: Rocket learns about the ancient Wolf Tree, which is said to make the old young again.

episodes.title: The Lost Boy
episodes.description: When a mysterious new foster kid arrives at the Knot, the others think that he is hiding something.

episodes.title: Rocket's Return
episodes.description: When a time machine crash-lands, Archie explains that the stranger is actually a time traveler.

episodes.title: The Goblin Curse
episodes.description: Brandon triggers an ancient goblin's curse.

episodes.title: The Ballabungie Detective Agency
episodes.description: Rocket and Dibber re-activate the Ballabungie Detective Agency to find who set fire to the school.

episodes.title: The Tearpot
episodes.description: Rocket tries to show his mother how much the village loves them at the Ballabungie parade.

episodes.title: Here Be Dragons
episodes.description: After Rocket discovers a giant fossil, new foster kid Benjamin thinks he sees a real dragon.

episodes.title: The Tell Stones
episodes.description: After Dibber cheats on a school presentation, he appears to become the target of ancient powers.

episodes.title: The Broken Soldier
episodes.description: After Archie finds an old toy soldier under his bed, Jade worries that he might have brought it to life.

episodes.title: Madison the Vampire
episodes.description: Madison's sudden strange behavior leads the Knot kids to believe that she might be a vampire.

episodes.title: Jade the Magnificent
episodes.description: After being struck by lightning, Jade appears to have developed potentially dangerous magical powers.

episodes.title: The Mirror of Morglaw
episodes.description: A skeleton washes up on the Dirgelmor shore, uncovering the journal of Lord Loomis and his quest to find a mirror that reflects a person's true self.

episodes.title: Telling Porkies
episodes.description: A new foster kid, the energetic Izzy Wizzy, makes a noisy arrival at the Knot.

episodes.title: The Selkie Boy
episodes.description: After a handsome, mythical Selkie arrives, Alli hopes for an end to her loneliness; Izzy gets herself into more trouble when she loses one of Sarah's treasured rings.

episodes.title: Mountain Post
episodes.description: A lone mailbox atop Dirgelmor's only mountain is rumored to be able to send letters to historical figures. But when Brandon uses it to contact his mother, it leads to a big surprise.

episodes.title: The Knights of Dirgelmor
episodes.description: Upset over Brandon's departure, Jade searches for a ruined castle in the hope that she can be happy forever, but she becomes trapped by ancient knights who defend it.

episodes.title: Izzy Wizzy and the Weeping Oak
episodes.description: Rocket believes Izzy Wizzy has been acting strangely because she is possessed by tree sprites.

episodes.title: Goodbye Island
episodes.description: Peter tells the family that there will be no new foster kids at the Knot. Meanwhile, Jade, Archie and Izzy Wizzy go in search of the legendary Dirgeldoor, which is rumored to transport you to your true home.

episodes.title: The Dirgeldoor
episodes.description: Jane, Archie and Izzy find themselves trapped in the mines while searching for the Dirgeldoor to take them to their true home.

c75f3367-039e-4598-a9ab-b87751fc857a.description: Join with youth gathered worldwide and in the Conference Center on Temple Square to learn how Jesus Christ is the strength of youth.

episodes.title: I Can Do All Things Through Christ
episodes.description: Join with youth gathered worldwide and in the Conference Center on Temple Square to learn how Jesus Christ is the strength of youth.

episodes.title: I Am a Disciple of Jesus Christ
episodes.description: Worldwide discussion featuring Elder Gary E. Stevenson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.

episodes.title: Celebration of Light
episodes.description: A worldwide discussion with the youth of the Church focused on celebrating life featuring Elder Ulisses Soares of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles, Young Women General President Emily Belle Freeman, and Young Men General President Steven J. Lund.

episodes.title: Look Unto Christ with Elder Uchtdorf (1-5-25)
episodes.description: Youth gather to discuss the 2025 youth theme, “Look unto Christ,” and listen to messages by Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf, President Emily Belle Freeman, and President Steven J. Lund.

episodes.title: Look Unto Christ with President Holland (10-26-25)
episodes.description: President Jeffrey R. Holland encourages young women and young men to reflect on their experiences throughout the year with the the 2025 youth theme, “Look unto Christ,” and to find strength in Christ.

ffa37a16-5d6d-4922-9856-09642ac0406e.description: Spreading sticky goodness through real stories, uplifting moments, and everyday joy.

episodes.title: Linda
episodes.description: Emma Nissen shares Linda’s story, and how “Gotta Have Faith” helped her through the loss of her son, performing a tender rendition inspired by her.

episodes.title: Heather
episodes.description: Emma Nissen catches up with her long-time friend Heather who shares her journey with hearing loss. Together, they perform Emma’s heartfelt song "Angel."

episodes.title: Amazing Grace
episodes.description: Emma shares how faith shapes her relationship with Christ and her music as she Jazz scats her rendition of ‘Amazing Grace.’

episodes.title: Breathe
episodes.description: Emma Nissen brings her soulful jazz vibes with "Breathe" and shares the story behind the song.

episodes.title: New Song
episodes.description: Emma Nissen takes the stage with her band to perform her uplifting new song, a heartfelt anthem about loving yourself and spreading that love to others.

episodes.title: Duet
episodes.description: Annika Wickihalder joins Emma Nissen to perform “Hold On,” sharing a powerful message: if you keep holding on, things will get better.

seasons.title: Stand up and Do Something with Michael Jr.

episodes.title: Comedian Visits Recovery Center
episodes.description: Stand-up comedian Michael Jr. brings laughter and hope to an addiction recovery center, reminding everyone that no one is too far gone for grace.

episodes.title: Stand-up Comedian Visits Jail
episodes.description: Stand-up comedian Michael Jr. reminds inmates that their past doesn’t define their future. Change is always possible.

episodes.title: Comedian Visits Sober Living Home
episodes.description: Healing starts with hope. Stand-up comedian Michael Jr. brings laughter to a sober-living home. Sharing a message that leaves a lasting impact.

d09039d8-4a7c-4508-bbc5-0c18522cc051.description: Dr. Kwane helps pets of men, women, and families who have fallen on hard times.

episodes.title: Justin & Um
episodes.description: Genesis helps a terrier who needs its sutures removed from a past surgery; Dr. Kwane performs an emergency surgery on a cat who was involved in a car accident.

episodes.title: Bill & Eli Manning
episodes.description: Dr. Kwane examines a dog with several skin tumors and an eye condition that requires surgery to fix; Genesis gives vaccinations to animals in need.

episodes.title: Andre & Kuma
episodes.description: Kwane meets Andre and his puppy Kuma on the streets, and gives Kuma his vaccines.

episodes.title: Barbara’s Birds
episodes.description: Dr. Kwane meets ex-bird breeder Barbara and her two cockatoos who live on the streets and in temporary housing.

episodes.title: Mike & Crazy Girl
episodes.description: Dr. Kwane and Genesis help a dachshund who has received an eye injury; the duo meets a shelter dog who lives with two hitchhikers.

episodes.title: Mike & Goldie
episodes.description: Dr. Kwane meets Mike, and offers to give his little dog Goldie a health check.

episodes.title: Shay & Shilo
episodes.description: Dr. Kwane examines a cat with painful skin issues before performing a surgery on a dog with a hernia.

episodes.title: The Monterey Zoo
episodes.description: Genesis becomes emotionally overwhelmed after hearing the story of Carl and his dogs, so Dr. Kwane treats her to a visit to an animal sanctuary that rescues exotic animals where she can get up-close with her favorite animals, elephants.

episodes.title: Lawrence’s Dogs
episodes.description: Dr. Kwane examines an older dog whose teeth are infected, but its owner disappears before he can perform the surgery.

episodes.title: Antonio & Piglet
episodes.description: Dr. Kwane assists a bullterrier with an injured leg; Genesis adopts a rescue puppy but suffers from painful memories of her first dog.

episodes.title: The Mercer Clinic
episodes.description: Genesis helps a dog who has been scooting around on its rear; Dr. Kwane visits a clinic run by volunteers that treats homeless pets.

d9d6effd-f8d1-476c-9f6b-4a3ba35e9b02.description: A family finds hope and strength together as they restart their lives in a neighborhood where the fantastic and mundane curiously exist.

episodes.title: Water Buffalo
episodes.description: Klara and Pim arrive in their new home, daunted by the upheaval. Klara meets two strange girls—edgy, street-smart Cat and mysterious, reclusive Esme. Meanwhile, Pim runs away and discovers a huge, enigmatic Water Buffalo.

episodes.title: Broken Toys
episodes.description: When Pim’s favourite toy is broken by their grumpy neighbor and Mum is too busy to help, Klara takes him to the park to cheer him up. There, they encounter a strange man in what looks like a space suit, who needs their help.

episodes.title: Distant Rain
episodes.description: Budding artist Klara considers braving an art competition, while Pim and Lucy bond by writing stories together. As they all struggle to express themselves, a peculiar storm is brewing in the skies above.

episodes.title: Making A Friend
episodes.description: With Klara enthralled by an intriguing neighbour and Lucy starting a new job, Pim needs someone to play with. He builds a dinosaur friend out of junk, stunned when it comes to life. But their fun quickly gets out of hand.

episodes.title: Eric
episodes.description: Klara, Pim and Lucy are feeling disconnected and out of place, but they’re all forced to find a new way of looking at the world, when a mysterious, tiny houseguest comes to stay.

episodes.title: Inner Courtyard
episodes.description: Pim and Klara stumble into a strange and beautiful garden within their own house—and have a wondrous encounter that will forever change the way they see their mum. But can they make it out before it’s too late?

episodes.title: Moonfish
episodes.description: Pim grapples with big feelings about his absent dad, so Grandpa takes him sky-fishing to lift his spirits. Meanwhile Grandma helps Klara realise she can no longer deny her own overwhelming emotions.

episodes.title: The Badlands
episodes.description: Klara and Pim go with Grandma and Grandpa on a thrilling treasure hunt, beyond the borders of suburbia. Faced with perplexing challenges, they must decide if they can stick together to find their way home.

episodes.title: Dugong
episodes.description: Klara’s self-doubt threatens to swallow her whole, while Pim’s birthday takes a strange turn when a dugong inexplicably appears on the front lawn, far from the ocean and in desperate need of help.

episodes.title: Turning
episodes.description: Klara nervously heads to the city for her art competition, with supportive Pim in tow. But when the journey doesn’t go as planned, Klara’s despair leads to a confrontation that will change her—and her neighborhood—forever.

episodes.title: Tales from Outer Suburbia Trailer
episodes.description: Watch the trailer for the stunning new animated series from Academy Award® winner, Shaun Tan—Tales from Outer Suburbia.

e7733b96-77c3-4268-9fa0-b63e1ff14b78.description: Christmas specials of The Tabernacle Choir and Orchestra at Temple Square. Featuring appearances and performances by guest artists.

episodes.title: Season of Light
episodes.description: Christmas special of The Tabernacle Choir and Orchestra at Temple Square. Featuring appearances and performances by Lea Salonga and Sir David Suchet.

episodes.title: Joy
episodes.description: Broadway sensation Michael Maliakel and star of stage and screen, Lesley Nicol, join The Tabernacle Choir at Temple Square for a musical celebration of the Savior's birth.

episodes.title: Hope of the Season - Ruthie Ann Miles and Dennis Haysbert
episodes.description: Christmas specials of The Tabernacle Choir and Orchestra at Temple Square. Featuring appearances and performances by guest artists.

e88095fa-ebac-4e5b-9c8e-7d6e1608d642.description: Brave teens coping with various mental health issues leave behind their cell phones and embark on a 15-day journey.

episodes.title: NEW SHOW: Braver
episodes.description: Seven teens coping with various mental health issues leave behind their cell phones and embark on a survival adventure to learn how to reconnect with themselves and heal from their past. With the help of two seasoned survival experts and one group therapist, they must learn to survive with the bare essentials and face their demons. Can they learn from nature, or will their fears get the better of them?

episodes.title: Off the Screen and Into the Wild
episodes.description: Seven teens are selected to spend two weeks in the wilderness without their phones. As they hike to their campsite, Ryan is appointed the first group leader, but he must confront his own anxieties and self-doubt to become the leader the group needs.

episodes.title: A Storm is Brewing
episodes.description: This week, some members struggle with negative inner voices. John learns success isn’t defined by others, while the group leader takes charge with ease but struggles to open up to Dr. Z during their one-on-one.

episodes.title: Cracks on the Surface, Storms Underneath
episodes.description: As the group journeys to the third campsite, homesickness sets in for some campers, and tension begins to grow. Things take a turn when John suffers an injury and paramedics have to be called in.

episodes.title: Trial by Fire
episodes.description: Haunted by a past of bullying, John digs deep to overcome his anxiety, forming new bonds and stepping up to lead the group through an intense fire vigil challenge.

episodes.title: We're Cooked!
episodes.description: Tensions rise as the group splits, with Ravon, Jessica, and Yani forming a new clique that clashes with Kitana. Meanwhile, the group faces a grueling trek to two separate campsites and must take on back-to-back challenges over the next two days.

episodes.title: Who's Got Beef?
episodes.description: When Dr. Z's fireside chat fails to ease tensions, the team organizes their own discussion. However, conflicting views on the seriousness of the situation only deepen existing rifts and spark new in-group conflict.

episodes.title: Suffer Well
episodes.description: As the days draw to a close, each group member takes time for quiet reflection, contemplating their journey and personal growth. In a moment of vulnerability, Jessica confides in Dr. Z about the profound loss of her father.

episodes.title: Together
episodes.description: Battling exhaustion and poor nutrition, the group struggles to keep their raft afloat and push toward the finish line. Ravon overcomes his fear of the water by bravely volunteering to test the raft.

ec0344b9-3473-4572-a0d3-a252a6324490.description: Join BYUtv for an in-depth look at everything Cougar sports. The latest and greatest from basketball to football and everything in between.

episodes.title: All Access- 2011 BYU Football Team
episodes.description: BYU football players Terrence Brown and JJ Di Luigi give a behind-the-scenes tour of campus and team facilities. The episode also features Thursday's Heroes, a pumpkin-carving contest, the Reynolds football family and an inside look at practice.

episodes.title: Cougar Conversations - Riley Nelson
episodes.description: BYU quarterback Riley Nelson shares stories about faith, family, football, and perseverance. He discusses recruiting, his mission in Spain, injuries, leadership, and the dramatic Utah State comeback that helped define his BYU career.

episodes.title: BYU Football: The Top 50 Plays
episodes.description: “BYU Football: The Top 50 Plays” showcases the greatest moments in Cougar football history. Fans voted on iconic plays featuring Ty Detmer, Steve Young, John Beck, Austin Collie, Kyle Van Noy, and other BYU legends.

f92fc055-de69-4ef5-8356-5c3a1c12fb81.description: Four teens must learn to trust each other when they find a strange artifact near their summer camp. Watch Season 2—exclusively on BYUtv.

episodes.title: Dragonfly
episodes.description: Four teens--Louis, Kaz, Meg, and Glen--begin their mysterious journey when they stumble upon a strange artifact in the woods near the Silverpoint summer camp.

episodes.title: Fermi's Paradox
episodes.description: An abandoned cabin isn’t quite what it seems for Bea and Louis, while the mysterious rock reveals a new power to Meg and Glen.

episodes.title: 43 Seconds
episodes.description: After testing the rock's teleportation powers, Louis agrees to let Glen jump through the portal. But when Glen fails to appear back at camp, Team Dragonfly must find out where he went.

episodes.title: The Man in the Basement
episodes.description: Louis confesses his real reason for being at the camp to the rest of the group, leading the four a step closer towards unlocking the alien rock’s secrets.

episodes.title: Today We Vanish
episodes.description: After discovering what he thinks is a portal, Louis must convince the rest of Team Dragonfly to cross over with him to see what’s on the other side. Meg, however, has other plans.

episodes.title: Here There Be Monsters: Part 1
episodes.description: Feeling the pressure to find their missing friend, Kaz tasks Louis with getting Meg back. Meanwhile, something monstrous is lurking in the woods.

episodes.title: Here There Be Monsters: Part 2
episodes.description: With things becoming increasingly stranger and the camp under attack by a monster, Team Dragonfly must face some personal demons to save themselves and their friends.

episodes.title: Whatever Happened to Meg?
episodes.description: While Bea and Team Dragonfly try to make sense of their predicament, Kaz tries to run away, only to encounter an invisible barrier surrounding the camp.

episodes.title: This is the Way Our World Ends
episodes.description: As Bea and Team Dragonfly find some fun distractions in the alternate world, Bea realizes she was never meant to be there.

episodes.title: Detour
episodes.description: Sent into the past, Louis, Kaz, Glen, Bea and Louis discover that Meg is the only one who can bring them back to the present. Louis finally gets an answer to the mystery that brought him to Silverpoint.

episodes.title: The Silent, Strong Type
episodes.description: Fisher takes control of the alien rock. With no time to lose, Meg needs Finn, Alice and Elliot to join her on a mission to save her friends.

episodes.title: Someone Worth Saving
episodes.description: Kaz is still missing and the rest of Team Dragonfly feel uneasy about leaving the camp without her. Fisher has a proposal for Louis -- but can he be trusted?

episodes.title: Us Four Together Again
episodes.description: Having made it to the facility and discovered even more about the mysterious alien rock, a reunited Team Dragonfly seeks out the truth of what lies behind the red door.

episodes.title: Focus
episodes.description: Louis, Meg, Glen and Kaz discover they’re one of four groups, each with their own alien Artefact and part of a game to save the world.

episodes.title: Little Sister
episodes.description: Dragonfly discover a way into their rival’s alternative environment and learn more about how the alien game works. Emma begins to suspect that Greenfront can’t be trusted.

episodes.title: Don't You Forget Me
episodes.description: Feeling they’re in danger, Emma shares her night-time discovery with Maeve. Dragonfly know their friendship is at stake as they ally with Landslide and take on the first challenge.

episodes.title: One Door Closes, Another One Opens
episodes.description: As Glen joins Monika and Isabel to rig a TV and scan for news, Jay, Kaz and Louis get a nasty shock when they explore the spaceship. But Louis finds a clue to the aliens’ identity.

episodes.title: The Amnesia Girls
episodes.description: Back in the city, Bea McConnell makes contact with one of the losers of the first challenge. And, with Alice and Finn’s help, the four go in search of her missing friends.

episodes.title: Day 1
episodes.description: With the second challenge seemingly impossible, it’s left to Louis to find a solution. While frustration grows for Meg, as Jay and Kaz find an unlikely distraction in each other.

episodes.title: Lights Out
episodes.description: Certain Greenfront are hiding something, Louis, Glen, Monika, and Isabel stay up to see what happens after 1AM. And, with everyone else asleep, the truth finally reveals itself.

episodes.title: Special
episodes.description: With the news from the previous night still on everyone’s minds, an unexpected visitor shows up at the facility. While in the camp, Meg and Kaz find they’re stronger together.

episodes.title: Don't Touch
episodes.description: Allegiances are tested for Dragonfly when a new player joins the game. While the third challenge reveals the last of the Artefacts’ locations and something lurking in the shadows.

episodes.title: Headaches
episodes.description: With Louis in a bad way and his condition worsening, Meg blames herself. However, Kaz manages to buy them a little time and looks to Dragonfly’s past for a way to save him.

episodes.title: The Things We Did
episodes.description: Following Isabel’s advice, Bea gets a little closer than expected to the Artefacts. While a call for help from some old acquaintances sees Meg and the rest of Dragonfly reunited.

episodes.title: Time to Save the World
episodes.description: The shape-shifting alien has escaped and those left at the facility must face the fact that one of them is not who they say they are. Bea must decide who she can trust.

episodes.title: How I Wonder What You Are
episodes.description: Trapped on the spaceship, Dragonfly must decide to stay or fight, as the prospect of a life off-world looms closer. Back on earth, some important people have questions.

fc8cdce5-ae3a-468b-9320-95c85810e615.description: A super genius billionaire goes back in time to teach his 11-year-old self to be a better person.

episodes.title: Super Mega Sophie Kapow!
